postings.title: Senior QA Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About DualEntry

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

Where You'll Create Impact

• Build!

• Design automated QA and CI/CD integration

• Execute test strategies across UI, API, and integrations

• Create test case management and reporting systems

• Own bug triage, reporting, and release validation

What Sets You Up For Success

• Hardcore work ethic and high agency

• 4+ years in Software QA, focused on SaaS/web applications

• UI and API testing experience at scale

• Familiar with CI/CD, AWS, and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)

• Strong with bug/test tooling (Jira, TestRail) and automation frameworks (Selenium/Cypress/Playwright)

• Product intuition, user empathy, and sharp instincts for testability

Why You’ll Thrive Here

• Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

• You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

• Your feedback shapes the product directly

• High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

Meet the Engineering Team

• Ignacio shaped the baseline of our integration framework from scratch in a single weekend, then spent most weekends - while coordinating the team - shipping what was never on the roadmap: webhooks, a search engine for millions of transactions, and Puma itself. Pure initiative, compounding.

• Marcin took a non-existent tax structure and built it end to end, setting the north star for how the team keeps improving it on top of it; modular and robust, always setting the bar for the rest.

• Puhiza grew her team from one to full capacity, while owning our integration framework end to end; scaling it to support migrations, integrations, and bank connections. The queen of I/O on our platform.

• Danylo took ownership of our bank connection engine end to end and rebuilt it from scratch over a weekend.

How You Operate

• Pragmatic: you like to move forward and make decisions based in reality (not theory). We don't debate if Cassandra has the most theoretical scalability - we use Postgres until it breaks

• Hard working: 'You can work long, hard, or smart, but [here] you can't choose two out of three' - Jeff Bezos.

• Curious: you love to learn, are highly curious about new frameworks and solutions to engineering problems

• Fast-moving: you deploy daily, iterate quickly, and never wait for permission

Benefits & Compensation

• Equity: $25,000 - $45,000

• Base salary: $75,000 - $140,000

• Remote-first team - the fastest team you will have ever worked with

• Home internet, co-working space & office setup support

• Flexible PTO (27 days incl. public holidays)

• Unlimited AI token usage

• AI skills development & enablement

• Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

• Visa sponsorship and relocation support for a move to NYC (after 2 years’ tenure)

• In-person team meetups (our last ones: Lisbon, Vienna, Warsaw, Cyprus, and more!)

“Join us to fix the boring, think the hard, and build the impossible, so we become the most robust engineering platform for accounting the world has ever seen.”

Ignacio Brasca , Head of Engineering at DualEntry

Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes.

From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're backed by Andreessen Horowitz and co-build alongside leading AI companies.

Product at Hilbert is a small, senior group at the core of the company. The people in these seats shape how Hilbert's agentic solution evolves, how our customers grow, and how we go to market.

About The Role

This is a 0-to-1 seat with founder-level ownership. You'll take a whole surface of Hilbert and own it end-to-end — vision, roadmap, specs, ship dates, and the customer results it produces. We're stubborn about the mission and flexible on tactics, and we expect the same from you.

Two things make this role different from most PM jobs. First, we're forward-deployed: you'll spend real time inside our customers' businesses — discovery, onboarding, growth reviews — and what you learn there becomes the roadmap. Second, the product is technical: what our customers buy is growth, but what we build is data and ML infrastructure with an agent on top. Your decisions will touch ingestion pipelines, model behavior, the agent, and activation platforms, working daily with software, ML/AI, and data engineers across time zones.

Core Responsibilities

• Own the product roadmap end-to-end: synthesize a complex problem space into clear direction, and carry it from idea to shipped product to measured business impact.

• Engage directly with customers to understand their domain, uncover the highest-impact growth opportunities, and act as their trusted product advisor.

• Track and prioritize customer requests across a large pool of accounts and topics, keeping trade-offs explicit and the roadmap trusted across the company.

• Define success metrics for everything you ship, tying product outcomes to customer KPIs and company OKRs with numbers you can defend.

• Partner day-to-day with software, ML/AI, and data engineers to scope ruthlessly, ship in weeks not quarters, and prototype yourself where it helps.

Who Thrives In This Role

• 8+ years as a product manager, including at least one product taken from zero to one — engineers or data scientists who became PMs are especially welcome.

• Owner's mindset: you operate autonomously, navigate ambiguity, make sound calls without perfect information, and kill your own ideas when the evidence says so.

• Strong technical foundation: comfortable with SQL, data pipelines, and warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery), able to hold your own in architecture and modeling discussions with engineers, with sound judgment on AI products — evals, non-determinism, when a model is good enough to ship.

• Clear, compelling communicator who translates strategy into execution across engineering, GTM, and customer stakeholders.

• Customer empathy paired with commercial instinct: you hear the problem behind the request, get creative about solving it, and know what customers will pay for.

Location

This role will start remotely as we build Hilbert's presence and establish our first LATAM hub.

You'll travel regularly to work directly with customers across the region, particularly during onboarding, implementation, and key deployment milestones.

As our team and customer presence grow and we establish a hub in a specific LATAM city, relocation within Latin America may be required in the future . We're looking for people who are excited about helping build that presence from the ground up and have flexibility around where the hub ultimately takes shape.

You'll also collaborate closely with Hilbert teams across the US and Europe, so comfort working across time zones is important.

Compensation

Competitive salary + equity package, commensurate with experience.

Performance-based bonuses tied to project milestones and customer impact.

postings.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, Banking Platform
postings.descriptionText:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $8,000 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Technical Product Manager who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Sezzle is building the platform that will carry us from a BNPL provider into a full-stack financial institution. This role owns the system at the center of that: Sezzle’s banking core — the ledger, accounts and balances, and the money movement that every future Sezzle financial product will run on.

You would own it end to end. Discovery, architecture and vendor decisions, requirements, build, launch, and everything after — not a slice of someone else’s roadmap, but the full product lifecycle for the platform itself. You’d work directly with Engineering, Finance, Compliance, Treasury, and Risk, with real authority over how this gets built.

Ideally you’ve built something like this before. If you haven’t, but you’ve owned a ledger, a payments platform, an issuing program, or other financial infrastructure — and you’re the kind of person who learns a domain properly rather than around the edges — we want to talk to you. What matters most is that you’ve owned real infrastructure and that you’re willing to go deep on the parts you don’t know yet.

What You'll Do:

• Own the banking platform roadmap. Define and sequence the platform work required to support accounts, deposits, cards, and lending on a single ledger and account model.

• Help drive the build-vs-buy decision. Evaluate core banking platforms and processors, run vendor diligence, model cost and time-to-market, and help leadership decide whether we extend what we have or integrate a third party.

• Shape the account and ledger model. Work with Engineering and Finance on account hierarchies, sub-ledgers, chart-of-accounts mapping, posting rules, holds, interest and fee accrual, and general ledger integration.

• Specify money movement. Own product requirements for transfers, ACH, card issuing and network settlement, real-time rails, and returns and reversals — including exception handling, cutoff windows, and settlement reconciliation.

• Make the platform auditable. Ensure the system produces the reporting, traceability, and controls that Finance, audit, and regulators need — reconciliation breaks, balance attestation, and complete transaction history.

• Partner on regulatory readiness. Work with Compliance and Legal to turn their requirements into platform capabilities: screening hooks, onboarding data, error resolution, disclosures and statements, and reporting. You don’t need to arrive fluent in US banking regulation — you do need to be someone who learns it properly.

• Plan migration and cutover. If a migration is in scope, own data mapping, parallel-run strategy, validation criteria, rollback plans, and phased cutover.

• Write the technical requirements. Own detailed specs, API contracts, event schemas, data models, user stories, and release plans end-to-end.

• Use data to prove it works. Write your own SQL. Define platform KPIs — posting latency, reconciliation break rate, settlement accuracy, failure rates — and monitor them relentlessly.

• Manage risk early. Anticipate technical risks, edge cases, race conditions, and dependencies before they become incidents. Money movement defects are the expensive kind.

• Operate with urgency. Deliver against an evolving regulatory and business timeline with incomplete information.

What We Look For:

• Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or other technical discipline (required).

• 5–10 years of product experience, with meaningful time spent on financial infrastructure rather than only customer-facing surfaces.

• Real ownership in at least one of the following. You do not need all of them, and we care much more about depth in one than exposure to several:

• Ledgers, general ledger, or balance and transaction systems

• Payments processing, orchestration, or money movement — ACH, card networks, transfers, settlement, or the LATAM equivalents (PIX, SPEI, PSE, CCE)

• Card issuing or card program management

• Deposit, wallet, or account platforms

• Lending origination or loan servicing platforms

• Product work at a processor, BaaS provider, or core banking vendor

• Comfort with double-entry accounting concepts as they show up in software — debits and credits, sub-ledgers, accruals, reconciliation — or a genuine appetite to get comfortable with them quickly.

• Deep technical understanding of APIs, event-driven architecture, idempotency, distributed system failure modes, batch vs. real-time processing, and data flows.

• Strong SQL skills and comfort querying and interpreting data independently.

• Experience working directly with Compliance, Legal, Finance, or Treasury as stakeholders — not only Engineering and Design.

• Comfortable working in ambiguity and making sound, documented decisions with incomplete information.

• Strong written and verbal communication — can hold your own in an engineering standup, a Finance review, and an executive discussion.

• Hands-on familiarity with AI tools, data models, or generative AI applications—personally, professionally, or better yet, both!

Preferred Qualifications:

• Direct experience with a core banking platform, in-house or vendor (Thought Machine, Mambu, 10x, Finxact, Temenos, Technisys, Galileo, Pismo, or similar).

• Experience with a core migration, conversion, or major ledger replacement.

• Experience at a chartered or licensed financial institution, or supporting a charter, banking licence, or deposit insurance application.

• Familiarity with consumer finance regulation — US (Reg E, Reg DD, Reg CC, Reg Z, TILA, FCRA, BSA/AML) or equivalent local regimes.

• Background in consumer credit or BNPL, card products, or bank-fintech sponsorship programs.

• Experience with third-party risk management and vendor oversight in a regulated environment.

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

#Full-time

postings.title: Lead Product Designer
postings.descriptionText:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About The Team

MetaMask's design team is working to establish MetaMask as the premier wallet in fintech, elevating the craft of design and leading the industry as the next phase of decentralized finance unfolds. Our focus is reducing friction while preserving user trust, so more people can safely explore the world of Web3.

Prediction markets are one of the most exciting areas in consumer finance right now, sitting at the intersection of trading, sports, news, culture, and real world events. This is a big growth area for MetaMask, and we're looking for a Lead Product Designer to help shape where it goes next. This is a chance to take real ownership of the end-to-end Prediction Markets experience inside one of the most widely used products in web3 — helping define how people discover markets, understand what's happening, trade, manage positions, and come back as events unfold. The product is still evolving, so much of the experience is still there to be defined, and that's a big part of what makes this role interesting: we're not looking for someone to polish a finished product, we want someone who wants to help shape it. You'll work closely with Product and Engineering, have a strong voice in what we build, and take ideas from early thinking through to something real in the hands of users.

What You’ll Do

• Own the Prediction Markets experience from early thinking through launch and iteration.

• Define how users discover markets, understand them, trade and manage their positions.

• Make complex ideas like probabilities, liquidity and market mechanics feel clear and easy to understand.

• Work closely with Product and Engineering to shape what we build, not just how it looks.

• Prototype quickly using AI to explore ideas and get to stronger solutions faster.

• Set a high bar for visual and interaction design, and use research and data to keep improving the product.

Would be great if you brought this to the role

• 5+ years of product design experience with a strong portfolio of shipped consumer products.

• You have a proven track record of delivering impactful, customer-centric designs that solve complex problems and drive commercial outcomes.

• Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with strong product instincts and attention to detail.

• Experience taking complex or ambiguous problems from early ideas through to shipped experiences.

• Comfortable using AI, code and modern design tools to explore, iterate and build quickly.

• High ownership, strong communication and the confidence to push work forward without waiting for a perfectly defined brief.

• Someone who genuinely loves sports and understands how fans follow teams, leagues, games and major sporting events.

Bonus points

• Experience in trading, investing, fintech, sports, betting, marketplaces or other high frequency consumer products.

• An interest in prediction markets and where the category could go.

• Experience working with market data, probabilities, charts or financial positions.

• Experience designing discovery, feeds, ranking or personalised content.

• Experience with crypto or web3, although deep crypto knowledge is not required.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range.

US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits)

$125,000—$195,000 USD

In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.

MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

MetaMask is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself, which can be found on our page.

MetaMask may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications, screening resumes, or conducting initial candidate assessments. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and improve efficiency — they do not replace human judgment. A human recruiter or hiring manager reviews every candidate, and all final hiring decisions are made by people, not AI.

It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants may be required to submit to background and identity verification checks, including but not limited to employment, education, criminal record checks, and other such checks as determined necessary by the company.

Who are we?

We're also big believers that great companies are built by great people. Our culture has grown organically, shaped by our people and the experiences they bring to the table. Differences are celebrated here, and we believe our diverse perspectives make us stronger as a whole.
Want to know more about ecoPortal? Take a look at our About Us page , or watch our short video 🎥 for a quick look at who we are and what we're all about.

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Product Designer to join our talented team.

About you

👨 💻 As one of our highly valued designers, you will engage in a range of challenging activities, including:

• Planning/scoping of design and research

😄 Workplace Enjoyment: We believe in fostering a positive, engaged, and diverse team through various social activities. Enjoy monthly virtual social events and company-wide activations with the ecoPortal HQ team in NZ and our global offshore team.

What now?
Ready to introduce yourself? Don’t be shy! We want to hear from you. Please upload your resume, cover letter, and any other information, documents and links that will help you stand out.

Find out more about ecoPortal visit us at ecoportal.com. ecoPortal is an equal opportunity employer.

postings.title: Senior UX Designer
postings.descriptionText:
Senior UX Designer

The company and our mission:

Zartis is a global AI transformation and technology consulting partner where talented engineers and technologists work on cutting edge innovation. We partner with ambitious organizations to design, build, and scale technology solutions that deliver real impact.

Our teams bring deep expertise in AI driven platforms, secure API architectures, and cloud native engineering. You will work on meaningful projects that accelerate the adoption of advanced technologies, from strategy and discovery through to full product delivery, helping turn complex challenges into measurable outcomes.

With engineering hubs across EMEA and LATAM, and long term partnerships in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, and energy and climate, we offer opportunities to work on projects that truly matter. Here, you will not just build technology, you will drive business impact and grow your career alongside industry leaders.

We are looking for a Senior UX Designer to work on a project in the online marketplace industry.

The project:

Our teammates are talented people that come from a variety of backgrounds. We’re committed to building an inclusive culture based on trust and innovation.

You will be part of a distributed team developing new technologies to solve real business problems. The project is for a company that owns global marketplace websites, with teams working on various regional platforms. The initiative is being set up as a new legal entity with board backing, and the work will run as time-boxed experiments through to the end of the year, with the objective of building experimental platforms using artificial intelligence. The core intention is to learn: the client is not only looking for delivery capacity, but for expertise on how to do this right and what it could mean for how they transform the broader organisation. The Service marketplace platform is particularly interesting in this regard, as it is a clean slate with a new entity and no inherited constraints on how to approach it. They want it done differently precisely so they can learn from it, and from the outset it should also be able to integrate as a macro app within their existing logins and apps.

We are looking for someone with good communication skills, ideally with experience making decisions, being proactive, used to building software from scratch, and with good attention to detail.

What you will do:

• Work on AI development, helping to build experimental platforms using artificial intelligence

• Contribute to the Service marketplace platform, a clean-slate build with no inherited constraints

• Bring expertise on how to approach the work in a new way, so the client can learn from it

• Help design the platform so it can integrate as a macro app within the client's existing logins and apps

• Collaborate within a squad team

What you will bring:

• 9+ years of experience as a UX Designer, at senior level or above

• Strong front-end capabilities, as the UX role also focuses on front-end technologies

• Strong AI knowledge and significant prior experience, as the work involves AI development

• Expertise in how to approach a new build the right way, as the client is looking to learn from the team

• Proficiency in Figma (or Sketch/Adobe XD) and prototyping tools

• Solid portfolio showing end-to-end design process, not just final visuals

• Knowledge of UX methodologies such as design thinking, Lean UX and Jobs to Be Done

• Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG) and responsive design principles

• Experience working with design systems and design tokens

• Familiarity with user research and testing tools (Maze, UserTesting, Hotjar, Optimal Workshop)

• Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and front-end constraints, so designs are feasible

• Strong ability to leverage AI solutions, including Claude

Nice to have:

• Experience with UX writing and microcopy

• Knowledge of motion design and micro-interactions

• Experience with data-driven design, analytics and A/B testing

• Background in a specific domain (fintech, healthtech, e-commerce, SaaS)

• Experience facilitating workshops such as design sprints or co-creation sessions

What we offer:

• 100% Remote Work

• WFH allowance: Monthly payment as financial support for remote working.

• Career Growth: We have established a career development program accessible for all employees with a 360º feedback that will help us to guide you in your career progression.

• Training: For Tech training at Zartis, you have time allocated during the week at your disposal. You can request from a variety of options, such as online courses (from Pluralsight and Educative.io, for example), English classes, books, conferences, and events.

• Mentoring Program: You can become a mentor in Zartis or you can receive mentorship, or both.

• Zartis Wellbeing Hub (Kara Connect): A platform that provides sessions with a range of specialists, including mental health professionals, nutritionists, physiotherapists, fitness coaches, and webinars with such professionals as well.

• Multicultural working environment: We organize tech events, webinars, parties, and activities to do online team-building games and contests.

postings.title: DTC E-Commerce Marketing Manager
postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.
Our client is an established, fourth-generation family jewelry business specializing in matching bridal ring sets. The company is profitable, growing, and uses internally built systems powered by Claude and Lovable.
Its customers make high-value, emotional purchases, and its marketing approach is built around trust and nurture rather than impulse volume.
Role Overview
The DTC E-commerce Marketing Manager will take over the day-to-day marketing function currently managed by the CEO, owning everything that creates an order.
The role covers paid ads, email and SMS, organic social, promotions, site conversion, and follow-up on inbound leads. Everything after the order is managed by a separate operations lead.
The DTC E-commerce Marketing Manager will lead a small team of specialists across outbound sales, email and SMS, organic social, and design. The team handles execution, while this role sets priorities, writes briefs, maintains standards, and brings the different functions together into one funnel.
This person will personally own strategy, the promotional calendar, weekly performance reporting, conversion experiments, and creative direction from day one.
Location
Fully Remote (Work from Home) | 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST
Key Responsibilities
Full-Funnel Marketing

• Own the day-to-day marketing function across paid ads, email and SMS, organic social, promotions, site conversion, and inbound lead follow-up.

• Set priorities across the different marketing functions.

• Bring the different marketing functions together into one funnel.

• Lead Generation Strategy: Work with the leadership team to develop a lead-generation strategy that serves sales, and challenge ICP assumptions when the data disagrees.

• Creative Leadership: Manage the creative team, including what they produce, how they work, and how quickly they deliver. You can hire for this. Oversee thought leadership, social, video, and podcast production, and decide how to structure the content and organic team.

• SEO & Organic Growth: Manage our SEO agency. You won’t execute SEO yourself, but you’ll set the direction and hold the agency accountable for organic traffic, rankings, and the pipeline it generates.

The Team You’ll Lead

You’ll lead a flat team of six to eight people across four lanes, all reporting to you. Several seats are already filled, and you’ll shape and hire the rest.

• Paid Media: A media buyer is already in place. An agency or senior buyer may also be hired. This lane owns budget, campaign structure, bidding, and channel mix.

• Creative: Includes a creative strategist, video editor, and production assistant. This lane owns concepts, hooks, scripts, and ad volume.

• Conversion: Includes a CRO specialist and a web and analytics specialist. This lane owns landing pages, forms, testing, and tracking.

• Brand, Content & SEO: Includes a part-time organic social lead, an SEO agency, and a senior content marketing manager to be hired. This lane owns thought leadership, social, video, podcasts, SEO, and organic growth.

• Days 1–30: Audit the funnel end to end, from impression to held meeting. Learn the account, creative pipeline, and team. Sit in on sales calls, establish a weekly sync with sales, and identify the three biggest leaks.

• Days 31–60: Finalize the paid media setup, whether through an agency or senior hire. Establish a weekly creative testing cadence and ship the first conversion improvements.

• Days 61–90: Demonstrate a measurable reduction in cost per meeting held. Have a senior content marketing manager hired or in final rounds, with a clear plan for content and organic growth.

• 10+ years of growth experience, including at least 3 years in paid media and at least 4 years in management. For this role, management means you have fired at least four people.

• Led growth for a B2B services, lead-generation, or sales-led B2B software company where success was measured by booked or held sales meetings, not e-commerce transactions or self-serve signups.

• Owned a paid media budget of $50K+/month across Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and X (Twitter) Ads, with real depth in each channel.

• Scaled paid media spend while maintaining or improving meetings, SQLs, and CAC, rather than optimizing only for CPL.

• Strong funnel math skills, including CAC, conversion rates by stage, and forecasting spend against outcomes.

• Managed or collaborated with conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.

• Worked hand in hand with a sales team in a sales-led funnel and earned their trust on lead quality.

• Managed an SEO agency or organic growth program and can evaluate its performance without doing SEO hands-on.

• Worked closely with a creative team.

• Strong HubSpot skills.

• Advanced AI fluency beyond prompting. You’ve built tools with Claude Code or similar, created reusable skills or agents, and set up your own dashboards and automations. Be ready to show examples.

• Staffing, recruiting, or outsourcing experience.

• Experience building a brand or thought-leadership program alongside performance marketing.

• Experience with CRO testing tools

We are hiring an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Canonical

Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective of reducing risk and churn, facilitating the adoption of new products or services, and supporting expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. By clearly understanding their customers’ objectives, the CSM can align expectations, suggest a large range of additional services or product capacity to increase loyalty, alleviate any pain points, and help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.

We are growing our Customer Success team to continue to offer thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open-source infrastructure and applications. To provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer, CSMs are specialized in one of the following segments:

• Mass - SMEs or large businesses starting their journey with Canonical

• Focus - Large companies with established ARR

All CSMs contribute to business support at the company level for all remaining, not-yet-assigned customers (Tech segment), including our Store customers.

Location: This role will be based remotely.

• Supporting customers through reactive ticket requests.

• Create campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.

What We Are Looking For In You

The ideal candidate would display impeccable customer-facing skills with a passion for cloud and data centre infrastructure technologies. We are also looking for:

• Minimum 5 years of work experience with a strong relation to IT and with exposure to projects related to at least one of these topics: Linux OS, data applications, storage, cloud computing, networking, security, migration, IoT.

• Excellent presentation skills with the ability to guide a conversation about complex software.

• Experience building and improving internal processes while maintaining timely delivery to customer-related projects.

• A true team player capable of interacting with all departments and at all levels, both internally and externally.

• Knowledge of agile methodologies.

• We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Spanish and Portuguese alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

• Experience with Salesforce, Jira and CRMs is a big plus!

What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

The client is a growing digital marketing company that helps businesses improve their online presence and generate measurable growth through strategic marketing initiatives.
The company works with clients across a range of marketing services, including paid media, social media, SEO, content, and lead generation. As the business continues to grow, it is looking for a highly capable Client Success Manager to help manage client relationships, coordinate internal marketing efforts, and identify opportunities to improve client performance and expand accounts.
The company is focused on building an empowered team where employees are trusted to take ownership, solve problems independently, and make thoughtful decisions without requiring constant oversight.

About the Role
The Client Success Manager is a high-ownership hybrid role combining client relationship management, marketing project coordination, campaign oversight, reporting, and account growth.
The successful candidate will serve as a key point of contact for clients while working closely with internal marketing specialists to ensure projects stay on track and clients receive strong results and service.
This is not a traditional customer service role focused primarily on responding to client requests.
The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem-solver who understands digital marketing, can evaluate campaign performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and take ownership of moving initiatives forward.
This role requires someone who can operate independently, manage multiple priorities, communicate confidently with clients, and coordinate effectively with internal team members.
Most importantly, the company is looking for someone who thinks for themselves, takes initiative, and is comfortable making decisions within their area of responsibility.

Key Responsibilities
Client Success & Relationship Management

• Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned clients and maintain strong, professional relationships.

• Communicate regularly with clients to understand their goals, priorities, challenges, and overall satisfaction.

• Proactively follow up with clients regarding ongoing initiatives, deliverables, performance, and next steps.

• Identify potential client concerns or risks before they become larger issues.

Marketing Campaign Oversight

• Work closely with internal marketing specialists to evaluate campaign performance and recommend improvements.

• Ensure client requests and priorities are translated into clear internal action items.

Reporting & Performance Analysis

• Review key performance indicators and marketing metrics to understand client performance.

• Help interpret reporting and identify meaningful insights, trends, and areas for improvement.

• Prepare and communicate clear performance updates for clients and internal stakeholders.

• Monitor client performance over time and identify opportunities for optimization.

• Use data and reporting to support recommendations and strategic conversations with clients.

Account Growth & Opportunities

• Identify opportunities for additional services, increased marketing budgets, or expanded client engagements.

• Recognize when client needs may be changing and proactively bring potential opportunities to the internal team.

• Partner with leadership and marketing specialists to develop recommendations for account growth.

• Understand the connection between marketing performance, client goals, and business outcomes.

• Help ensure clients are receiving the appropriate level of support and strategic value as their businesses grow.

Ownership & Problem Solving

• Take ownership of client and project issues from identification through resolution.

• Solve problems independently whenever possible rather than escalating every decision to leadership.

• Identify what needs to happen next and take action without waiting for detailed instructions.

• Use sound judgment when prioritizing competing requests and deadlines.

• Proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, client experience, and team efficiency.

• Communicate important issues clearly and escalate when leadership involvement is genuinely needed.

• Contribute to a culture of accountability, initiative, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Services, Project Management, Digital Marketing, or a similar role.

• Experience working with digital marketing campaigns and a strong understanding of marketing concepts and performance metrics.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

• Excellent client relationship and interpersonal skills.

• Strong organizational and project management abilities.

• Ability to manage multiple clients, projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.

• Comfortable working with reporting, data, and performance metrics.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently with limited supervision.

• Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.

• Strong follow-through and accountability.

• Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple team members and departments.

• Confidence communicating with clients and internal marketing specialists.

• Proactive mindset with a strong sense of ownership.

• Ability to make reasonable decisions independently and take action without constant approval.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment where priorities may change.

Technical Skills

• Slack

• CRM platforms

• Marketing reporting and analytics platforms

• Google Analytics

Benefits

Persona was founded in 2018 by two Stanford graduates on a simple idea: talent is everywhere, but opportunity isn’t. By recruiting globally for specific client roles, we’ve grown into one of the fastest-growing companies in the global staffing industry. Every applicant goes through the same steps, and each one is designed to let you show what you can actually do.

We hire people who care about the craft of their work, take ownership without being asked, and want to build a career rather than just hold a job. If that’s you, and one of our open roles fits, we’d like to meet you.

Role Summary
We are hiring a Customer Success Manager to manage a book of growing advertiser accounts at a performance-marketing / commerce-media company. You will own mid-market and test-stage accounts day to day ($10K-$20K pilots and steady monthly spenders) while supporting senior team members on the largest enterprise accounts. This role is hands-on and operational, built for someone who lives inside an Ads Manager, uses AI agents and SQL/Hex to pull performance data, and is the first person to notice when an account is overspending, underdelivering, or broken.
You must be technically comfortable — not an engineer, but able to set up a postback, test a tracking link, and explain to a client in plain language why their CPA moved. • Prepare data and talking points for QBRs, support senior teammates in running them, and re-engage lapsed advertisers with relevant offers

• Turn client feedback and platform friction into clear feature requests and bug reports for Product and Engineering, and keep internal playbooks (postback docs, onboarding checklists, QA steps) current

Required Qualifications

• 2-4 years in customer success, account management, or campaign operations — ideally in performance marketing, affiliate, commerce media, or ad tech

• Fluent in performance metrics: CPC, CPA, CTR, CVR, pacing, and IO cap management are part of your everyday vocabulary

• Technically curious — you've worked with tracking links, pixels, or postbacks, or you can follow API and integration docs on your own

• Comfortable with daily account hygiene across many budgets, launches, and client threads simultaneously

• Strong written communication; can draft a concise client recap and explain a performance change without jargon

• AI-forward: already uses AI tools to work faster and wants to get better at it

• Proactive: flags problems early, asks for help when stakes are high, doesn't wait to be told to check an account

Tools & Technologies

• Technically curious without needing to be an engineer

• Clear communicator; translates performance moves into plain English

postings.descriptionText:
About DualEntry

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

Where you'll create impact

• Build and execute DualEntry’s recruiting strategy across Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Leadership roles

• Partner with founders and hiring managers on role definition, target profiles, and market positioning

• Source and close exceptional candidates in competitive markets using creative, non-obvious sourcing strategies

• Own the candidate experience, employer brand, and hiring process end to end

• Build pipeline reporting and analytics to know what’s working

What Sets You Up For Success

• Hardcore work ethic and high agency

• 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting at high-growth startups, ideally building a function from scratch (ATS, candidate experience systems, process)

• Deep sourcing expertise - you find talent beyond inbound

• Analytical: you track what's working and manage against KPIs

Why you’ll thrive here

• Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

• You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

• Your feedback shapes the product directly

• High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations

Meet the TA Team

• Shweta was DualEntry's first Talent hire before there was a team, an ATS, or a process, there was just her building it from zero. Ex-Meta recruiter, agency founder and the reason the TA team below moves as fast as it does.

• Nikolija conducted an interview process in 24h - from LinkedIn outreach, through prescreen and team interviews to on-site case presentation and offer - all in one day.

• Polina joined as a 2nd TA hire and built the product and design team 0 > 1, with the fastest hire closed in just 6 days.

• Magdalena joined as Founding TA, setting up ATS, KPIs and sourcing processes and leading the Engineering hiring function. Closed multiple strategic hires across the business, setting the fastest time-to-hire record: 4 days

• Valentina an Ashby ghostbuster who built the reporting and dashboard stack from scratch, filled a historically hard-to-fill partnerships role within her first month with 9 days time to hire.

Compensation & Benefits

• Equity: $40,000 - $65,000 USD

• Base salary: $120,000 - $170,000 USD

• Variable compensation: $15,000 - $60,000 USD

• Remote-first team - the fastest team you will have ever worked with

• Home internet, co-working space & office setup support

• Flexible PTO (27 days incl. public holidays)

• Unlimited AI token usage

• AI skills development & enablement

• Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

• Visa sponsorship and relocation support for a move to NYC (after 2 years’ tenure)

• In-person team meetups (our last ones: Lisbon, Vienna, Warsaw, Cyprus, and more!)

“The biggest problems are solved by people willing to take on what others think is impossible. At DualEntry, you’ll work with exceptional builders. Join us at the moment where everything is still being written. You’ll have the chance to build, influence our direction and see your impact every day.”

Shweta Sharma, Head of Talent at DualEntry

postings.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (Argentina)
postings.descriptionText:
About Us

At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.

We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.

Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long because we are obsessed with our customers . We get things done with urgency and focus , driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego , fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together. Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay insatiably curious —always experimenting, building the future today, and delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better.

About The Role

As a key member of our engineering team, you will have a unique opportunity to shape the core technology behind our chat-driven platform. You will work on the Félix's Product Engineering team — a sophisticated system that not only processes high volumes of transactions but also delivers conversational experiences through integrated chatbots and natural language interfaces. Your role will be crucial in designing and enhancing interactive chat services and frontend (mobile and web) experiences that enable seamless, intuitive user interactions on platforms like WhatsApp, Web, and Mobile Application. If you have experience building chatbots, mobile applications, webpages, or crafting conversational experiences, this is your chance to make a significant impact.

Technology Stack

We are technology agnostic and value candidates with diverse backgrounds. While familiarity with the following is helpful, your willingness to learn and adapt is paramount:

• Back-end: Python, Flask/FastAPI, REST APIs, Redis, SQL, gRPC

• Fronted: React, HTTP, HTML/DOM, JavaScript, CSS, AJAX

• Mobile: React Native

• Cloud: Google Cloud services (Firestore, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Google Artifact Registry, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, etc.)

• Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Terraform, NewRelic, PagerDuty

Responsibilities

• Design & Architecture: Architect and implement high-performance, scalable backend microservices, including core components of our Chat Platform.

• User Interfaces: Build, deploy, and iterate on UI services and conversational interfaces that empower users to interact naturally with our remittance services.

• Infrastructure: Design and manage infrastructure capable of handling millions of daily requests with real-time messaging capabilities.

• Cloud Integration: Develop backend services using established industry standards and Google Cloud services.

• Collaboration & Mentorship: Foster the growth of junior developers through mentorship and best practice implementation, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including product, UX/UI, and business units.

• Continuous Improvement: Leverage customer feedback and analytics to iterate and improve our conversational experience, ensuring that our chatbots remain effective and user-friendly.

Requirements

These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.

• 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer in a fast-paced environment.

• Proven ability to build, ship, and iterate on software applications with an emphasis on real-world impact.

• Strong foundation in algorithms and data structures.

• Experience with web services, including SOAP and REST APIs.

• Familiarity with architectural patterns like Hexagonal Architecture, Event Driven Architecture, A/B Testing, Feature Flags, and Gradual Rollouts.

• Familiarity with AI tools such us: Claude, Cursor, Codex or similar technologies.

• Passion for building products that positively impact millions.

• Commitment to continuous learning and exploration of new technologies.

• Ability to thrive in a collaborative environment and contribute actively with innovative ideas.

• Excellent prioritization skills.

• Curiosity and/or experience in Fintech is an added advantage (though equivalent competencies will also be considered).

• Fluent or Advanced English.

What We Offer

• Competitive salary

• Initial stock options grant

• Annual performance bonus

• Health, dental, and vision plans

• Work model: Currently fully remote, with a future transition to a hybrid setup.

• Continuous learning opportunities

• Unlimited PTO

• Paid parental leave

• Empowering opportunities for growth in a dynamic entrepreneurial environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Félix, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and termination.

Want to learn more about our privacy practices? Check out our Privacy Policy .

Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

• Design, and implement scalable multi-tenant backend services and APIs.

Requirements

About you:

• Business-level fluency to read, write and speak in English

You’ll thrive as a Senior Software Engineer, Fullstack if you:

• Have 5+ years developing and deploying web applications, with a proven track record of shipping code.

• Are familiar with Node.js and TypeScript and can write scalable services and APIs using Express.js, GraphQL, Apollo, and MongoDB.

• Can debug production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack.

• Have proven experience building complex web systems.

• Have used testing frameworks (e.g. Jest, Mocha, Playwright, Cypress).

• Are comfortable working in an agile, safe-to-fail, environment.

• Stay curious and open to growth-Demonstrate a proactive embrace of AI, actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

Our Core Behaviors

• Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.

• Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.

• Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits

• Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.

• Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.

• Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.

• Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.

• Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.

• Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.

• Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

Be you, with us

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and/or Glassdoor.

Please Note

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for accommodation requests will be administered.

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.

postings.descriptionText:
Sobre el rol

¡Hola! Somos Flash ⚡️ La forma más rápida, segura y conveniente de vender un auto usado. Nacimos como parte del ecosistema de Mercado Libre, combinando tecnología y experiencia en el mercado para transformar cómo se realizan las transacciones de autos en Argentina.

Tu desafío es ser parte de un equipo que todavía lo hace todo: diseñar, construir, lanzar e iterar.

En Flash no buscamos que simplemente resuelvas tickets. Queremos que te involucres en los problemas, propongas soluciones y tengas autonomía para llevarlas de punta a punta. Vas a tener mucho ownership, desafíos grandes y la oportunidad de impactar directamente en el producto y el negocio.

Valoramos la iniciativa, la autonomía y la capacidad de aprender rápido. Buscamos personas que se entusiasmen con desafíos complejos, se animen a salir de su zona de confort y tengan ganas de asumir responsabilidades e impulsar proyectos de punta a punta.

¿Qué tareas vas a realizar?

• Herramientas internas que usan los equipos de operaciones, comercial y atención al cliente. Vas a estar cerca del negocio y de quienes usan lo que construís.

• APIs y sistemas que acompañen el crecimiento de nuestras transacciones.

• Integraciones con medios de pago, validaciones de identidad y procesos de transferencia.

• Nuevos productos y funcionalidades que todavía estamos imaginando.

Requisitos

• High agency: no esperás a que alguien te diga exactamente qué hacer. Identificás problemas, proponés soluciones y hacés que las cosas pasen.

• Mentalidad de aprendizaje: tenés curiosidad, aprendés rápido y no te asusta enfrentarte a tecnologías o desafíos nuevos.

• Ownership: te hacés cargo de lo que construís, desde entender el problema hasta verlo funcionando en producción.

• Mentalidad de producto: te importa entender por qué estamos construyendo algo, no solamente cómo programarlo.

• Pragmatismo técnico: sabés que resolver y entregar valor es más importante que sobreingenierizar.

• Comodidad con el cambio: te entusiasma trabajar en un entorno dinámico, con prioridades que evolucionan y mucho por construir.

• Es un plus (no excluyente): experiencia en startups, marketplaces, C2C o fintech, o haber construido productos propios o llevado proyectos de punta a punta.

Por qué Flash

• Somos una startup en crecimiento, con respaldo grande, un equipo chico y muchísimo por construir.

• Acá vas a tener autonomía real, responsabilidad desde el primer día y espacio para aprender, experimentar y crecer rápido.

• Buscamos personas que, frente a un desafío grande, no piensen “nunca hice esto”, sino “no sé hacerlo todavía, pero voy a encontrar la manera”.

• Si te entusiasma construir cosas desde cero, tener impacto real y ser parte de algo grande desde el inicio, queremos conocerte. ⚡️

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer, Build Loop
postings.descriptionText:
Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help us build the next generation of Agentic Codebases

About The Role

• Location: Remote-first (Argentina)

• Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position)

• Application Information:

• Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled

• This posting is for an existing vacancy

• Reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager, Developer Productivity

As a Senior Software Engineer, Developer Productivity, You'll

• Design and build the Nest.js service scaffolding that lets product teams stand up new backend services in our next-generation monorepo

• Implement paved paths, generators, and the platform primitives that make a new service work on day one rather than after a week of wiring.

• Build the seams that let new services run independently of our existing monolith.

• Own the deployment story for services and web applications on Cloudflare, and the interoperability with our existing AWS and Kubernetes estate managed through Pulumi and Argo CD.

• Lead migrations of substantial codebases into the monorepo and turn each one into a repeatable recipe rather than a bespoke effort.

• Partner directly with product teams as platform customers, treating their adoption as the measure of success and their friction as your backlog.

• Raise the leverage of the whole team by encoding what you learn into tooling, generators and agent-assisted workflows, so the next migration costs less than the last.

• Participate in engineering citizenship activities such as co-authoring engineering blogs, strengthening our hiring processes, and leading internal hackathon teams.

Requirements

About you

• BA/BS Degree or equivalent experience

• 5+ years building and operating backend services in production

• Demonstrated experience in backend service design defining service boundaries, contracts and data ownership, not only implementing within them

• Business-level fluency to read, write and speak in English

You'll thrive as a Senior Software Engineer, Developer Productivity, if you:

• Have worked inside a large, heavily-coupled codebase and found the seams: extracting or bypassing functionality incrementally, behind behaviour-preserving contracts

• Are fluent in TypeScript and Node, and comfortable with edge runtimes.

• Have hands-on experience with monorepo tooling at scale (Nx, Turborepo or similar) and understand why build-graph correctness is a product concern rather than a config detail.

• Treat migration work as engineering rather than chores: you budget for the parts that fail silently, verify generated output rather than trusting a green build, and know that bug-for-bug translation beats improvement when the goal is proving nothing changed.

• Enjoy being a platform engineer with real customers — partnering with product teams, adapting the platform to how they actually work rather than requiring them to change, and measuring yourself on their adoption.

• Are comfortable working across cloud boundaries, with a considered view on where a workload belongs and what crossing between clouds costs in latency and spend.

• Communicate decisions in writing well enough that someone can pick up your work from the ticket — and are willing to say plainly when the fast answer and the right answer diverge.

• Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

Our Core Behaviors

• Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.

• Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.

• Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.

• Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits

• Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.

• Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.

• Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.

• Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.

• Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.

• Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.

• Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.

• Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

Be you, with us

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and/or Glassdoor.

Please Note

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for accommodation requests will be administered.

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.

Webflow uses AI tools to assist in screening and evaluating applications. AI does not make final hiring decisions. For details on how we process your personal information, see Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice .

• Strong understanding of data integration concepts and workflows.

• Experience with event-driven architecture (EDA) and publish/subscribe messaging (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, SNS).

• Experience monitoring and maintaining application health and performance.

• Skilled in applying object-oriented and functional programming principles to real-world software engineering problems.

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies.

• AWS (advanced cloud services and infrastructure management).

• Kafka (real-time data streaming and event processing).

• PostgreSQL (advanced database features and performance tuning).

postings.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Growth & Experimentation – Krak
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world’s longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join a small, dedicated growth and experimentation team within Krak, focused on accelerating acquisition, activation, engagement and trading activity across the Krak app. This is a frontend-leaning full-stack role: the majority of your work will be in React Native, supported by enough backend capability to take an experiment from idea to live without waiting on another team.

Rather than executing against a rigid roadmap, you’ll work closely with Product on a continuous pipeline of fast, lightweight experiments, owning each one from hypothesis through implementation, launch, measurement and iteration. The mandate is simple: find the highest-leverage opportunities to grow users and revenue, prove what works, and scale the winners – with direct, measurable impact on how millions of customers discover and use Kraken’s products.

The opportunity

• Build and ship consumer-facing features quickly in React Native and TypeScript, favouring small, high-velocity experiments over long-running projects.

• Own experiments end-to-end – hypothesis, design, build, launch, measurement and iteration – using platforms such as Statsig to test globally or within specific markets.

• Improve onboarding, activation and feature discovery to drive conversion, engagement and trading revenue, iterating rapidly on features that are already live.

• Build viral acquisition features and value-add growth features on top of Krak’s existing product offering.

• Contribute to backend services and APIs wherever an experiment requires it, so you can ship across the stack without being blocked. Our backend is primarily Rust; prior Rust experience is not expected, but enthusiasm for picking it up is.

• Read your own results, including trade-offs between conversion gains and other metrics, and decide whether to scale, iterate or kill – driving technical decisions autonomously amid evolving priorities and limited upfront planning.

What You Bring

• 6+ years of software development experience building and shipping large-scale, consumer-facing applications. Strong, hands-on React and React Native experience is essential.

• Demonstrated experience running growth experiments at consumer-facing businesses, with measurable impact on conversion, activation, retention or revenue. This is a consumer growth role, so B2B or platform-only backgrounds are not a fit.

• Working backend proficiency: you can design and implement services and APIs yourself. We care about backend fundamentals rather than any particular language, and you should be open to working in Rust.

• Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, with hands-on experience across APIs, WebSockets and real-time systems, mobile performance, testing, and modern development workflows.

• Practical experience designing, running and analysing A/B tests – feature flags, statistical significance, product analytics, funnel and cohort data – with the judgement to act decisively on what the results show.

• End-to-end ownership of product features and a strong product engineering mindset, with the initiative and adaptability to operate with minimal direction amid ambiguity and frequently changing priorities.

Nice to haves

• Customer-facing product experience within fintech, digital banking, payments, trading or crypto.

• Hands-on experience with Statsig or a comparable experimentation platform, including regional and global rollouts.

• Rust experience, given our backend stack.

• SQL and self-serve analytics, so you can pull and interrogate your own data.

• AI fluency. Familiarity with how AI tools and patterns have fundamentally shifted your development workflow and problem-solving approach.

• Native mobile development (iOS/Android), distributed systems or microservices, or engineering within a hyperscaling consumer technology organisation.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.
