postings.title: Staff Software Engineer, Identity and Authorization
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are

At Domino, we build software that helps the largest, AI-driven organizations build and operate advanced data science and AI solutions at scale. Our platform integrates a streamlined model development environment, MLOps capabilities, and novel features for collaboration, reuse, and reproducibility — all of which make data science teams more productive, reduce time to value, and ensure compliance. Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. Especially in the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai

What We Are Building

Domino’s Identity and Access platform (IDSM) is the foundation for how customers in some of the world’s most regulated industries manage who can see and do what. We’re evolving it into a centralized, relationship-based authorization framework built on SpiceDB, and you’d be the technical anchor for its next phase.

• A unified authorization model. Extend a centralized, fine-grained, relationship-based model across the platform, replacing feature-specific permission checks with consistent, reusable primitives.

• Production-grade operations. Harden the authorization layer for the scale, reliability, and security that enterprise and public-sector customers expect.

• A thoughtful migration path. Make the sequencing and design calls that let us retire legacy access checks without disrupting customers along the way.

• Groups and organizations that mirror real customers. Rethink how we model groups and organizational hierarchies so large enterprises can represent their teams the way they actually work.

• Cloud-native identity. Deepen integration with cloud workload identity, starting with AWS IRSA and extending to Azure and GCP equivalents.

• Foundations other teams build on. Design core identity and access capabilities, with clean interfaces and flexible abstractions, that engineers across the company can adopt with confidence.

• A stronger way of building. Set the patterns for how the team uses AI-assisted development to ship high-quality features faster, without compromising security or code quality.

What Your Impact Will Be

• Set the architectural direction. Design identity and access solutions that meet customer demands for managing user and group access, and are secure, scalable, and built on primitives teams can reuse.

• Bring clarity to complex decisions. Articulate the architecture clearly enough that the rest of Engineering can rally around it.

• Be the go-to authority. Engineers and teams building on IDSM will bring their auth questions to you, and your technical judgment will carry real influence.

• Raise the engineering bar. Lead design reviews, unblock engineers facing ambiguity, and champion flexible abstractions and well-thought-out interfaces.

• Increase velocity and reduce maintenance. Improve our architecture, including removing tech debt, so the team ships faster with less ongoing maintenance.

• Shape how we build with AI. Establish patterns for using AI-assisted development to deliver high-quality features faster without compromising security or rigor.

• Foster ownership and urgency. Help the team know what to build and value both quality and speed of iteration and contribute to experiences that make identity and user management easier for the enterprises we serve.

What We Look For In This Role

• A track record of evolving an enterprise-grade authorization system under real production traffic, with strong opinions about the architecture of these systems

• Experience designing a new auth system and migrating to it from a legacy approach (a plus)

• Experience on a platform team supporting other services within a larger engineering organization

• A background at a company that builds authentication or authorization products (a plus)

• A concrete example of an auth system you helped build that solved a recurring class of customer challenges

• A history of helping teams become better engineers by improving designs, velocity, and quality

• Authorization systems: Hands-on experience with relationship-based or fine-grained authorization, including schema design (relations, permissions, caveats) and the tradeoffs versus traditional RBAC

• Identity protocols: Solid grounding in OIDC and SAML, and ideally experience with an IdP such as Keycloak, Auth0, Okta, or ForgeRock

• Cloud identity: Practical experience with workload identity patterns such as AWS IRSA, Azure Workload Identity, or GCP Workload Identity Federation

• Secrets management: Familiarity with a credential management system such as Vault

• Backend engineering: Strong Go, Java, or a comparable language, comfort running services on Kubernetes, and API design instincts from owning a platform others build on

• System architecture: Experience architecting auth frameworks that scale to enterprise customers

• AI-assisted development: Considered, real-world experience using AI coding tools while maintaining code quality and security rigor

What We Value

• We value a growth mindset. High-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and see the opportunities for success

• We believe in individuals who seek truth and speak the truth and can be their whole selves at work

• We value all of you that believe improving is always possible At Domino Everything is a work in progress – we can do better at everything

• We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company

• We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply

postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are.

Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving millions of customers globally. Our customers know us through our robust portfolio of brands. We have some of the industry's most prominent and storied go-to-market brands, including Bluehost, HostGator, Domain.com, Network Solutions, Register.com and Web.com. We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs. The strength of our company lives in the intersection of our people, our customers, and our brands.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a hands on Senior Applied AI Engineer who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical AI problem solving. You will help build production AI experiences across Network Solutions, including conversational agents, business and website creation, knowledge and FAQ agents, content experiences, domain discovery, and intelligent automation.

You will work with senior engineers, architects, and product partners to turn customer and product problems into reliable, secure, observable, and cost efficient AI systems. This is an applied engineering role focused on building, measuring, and continuously improving real AI products.

What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark

• Translate product requirements into practical AI solutions using LLMs, RAG, tool calling, agents, deterministic workflows, or traditional software where appropriate.

• Build production AI services using Python, FastAPI, asynchronous workers, PostgreSQL, Redis, queues, model APIs, and external tools.

• Implement reliable tool calling agents and multi step workflows that interact with internal APIs, MCP tools, business systems, and knowledge sources.

• Build event driven workflows using RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent platforms, including retries, dead letter handling, idempotency, and failure recovery.

• Build and improve RAG systems covering ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, context construction, and citations.

• Integrate models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, and open weight ecosystems, and help select models based on quality, latency, reliability, and cost.

• Build and run AI evaluations using curated datasets, regression tests, retrieval metrics, LLM as judge techniques, groundedness checks, and tool execution evaluation.

• Debug hallucinations, retrieval failures, incorrect tool usage, agent loops, latency issues, provider failures, and unexpected inference costs.

• Operate as an AI powered engineer using Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent coding agents to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation.

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed

• 5 or more years of professional software engineering experience building production backend, distributed, or cloud based systems.

• At least 1 year of hands on experience building Applied AI, LLM, RAG, NLP, or agent based applications, with production experience strongly preferred.

• Strong Python skills including FastAPI, asynchronous programming, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy or SQLModel, and production API development.

• Good backend and distributed systems fundamentals including REST APIs, concurrency, background processing, caching, reliability, and production debugging.

• Hands on experience with RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent queue and messaging architectures is required.

• Hands on experience integrating LLM APIs and building structured output, function calling, tool calling, or agent execution workflows.

• Experience building or contributing to a RAG or knowledge grounded system, including retrieval, embeddings, indexing, context construction, and evaluation.

• Working knowledge of PostgreSQL and data modeling, with exposure to Redis, pgvector, vector databases, or hybrid search technologies.

• Demonstrated use of AI coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent tools as a regular part of software engineering work.

Nice to have.

• You should be comfortable going beyond a working demo and understand the core engineering patterns needed to make AI systems reliable in production.

• Understanding of prompting, structured outputs, tool schemas, context management, retries, fallbacks, rate limits, caching, and streaming responses.

• Ability to use experiments and evaluations to compare approaches using measurable outcomes rather than subjective testing alone.

• Understanding of retrieval quality, grounding, hallucination mitigation, prompt injection risks, tool authorization, and practical agent guardrails.

• Experience with Docker, CI/CD, automated testing, logging, observability, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar tooling.

How You’ll Work

• You will often receive a product goal or technical direction rather than a fully specified implementation.

• You should be able to break the problem into manageable pieces, validate assumptions, implement the solution, and work with senior engineers when architecture tradeoffs require discussion.

• Turn product goals into testable technical tasks and prototype alternatives when the best approach is not obvious.

• Choose simple, maintainable solutions and avoid using an agent or LLM when a deterministic approach solves the problem better.

• Measure quality, latency, reliability, safety, and cost and use those signals to improve the solution over time.

• Own implementation across APIs, workflows, data, queues, model integration, evaluations, observability, and production support for assigned features.

• Use AI coding agents aggressively to increase engineering velocity while preserving testing discipline, security, maintainability, and code quality.

What Will Make You Stand Out

• Experience with Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, PydanticAI, or equivalent agent frameworks.

• Experience building or consuming Model Context Protocol tools and servers, or working with model gateways such as LiteLLM.

• Experience with Azure AI Search, pgvector, Chroma, Kubernetes, Azure, OCI, or similar production AI platform technologies.

• Experience contributing to customer facing AI products, open weight model inference, AI safety controls, automated evaluations, or high scale backend platforms.

• Curiosity, strong problem solving, solid software engineering fundamentals, and the ability to learn quickly and turn ideas into reliable production features are the foundation for this role.

Join us to build the agent-powered backbone of our AI platform—robust, model agnostic, and ready for millions of users.

This Job Description is not an exhaustive list of all functions that the employee performing this job may be required to perform. The Company reserves the right to revise the Job Description at any time, and to require the employee to perform functions in addition to those listed above.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

You’ll use your creativity, problem-solving, and technical expertise to design tailored solutions that make a real impact.

postings.title: Senior Blockchain Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Remitee , a fast-growing fintech specialized in international payments, is looking for a Senior Blockchain Engineer to join our Technology team.

Our Blockchain team is building the on-chain infrastructure behind Remitee's treasury and cross-border settlement: stablecoin liquidity flows, tokenized balances and on-chain accounting that reconciles with our core ledger. In this role you will design, write, test and ship smart contracts and the backend services that interact with them, running in production and moving real value for our Treasury team and our banking and payment partners. You will own technical decisions end-to-end, from contract architecture and security to custody integration, gas management and monitoring.

We are looking for a developer who has already taken blockchain products to mainnet, not just tutorials or hackathon projects, and who understands what it takes to operate them safely in a regulated financial environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, test and deploy Solidity smart contracts on EVM networks, including token contracts (ERC-20 and custom token logic), access control and upgradeable patterns.

• Build and maintain the backend services that interact with the chain: transaction submission, nonce and gas management, event indexing and reconciliation against our internal ledger.

• Integrate with digital asset custody and wallet infrastructure (MPC wallets, policy engines, transaction signing workflows).

• Implement stablecoin flows (e.g. USDC) for funding, settlement and liquidity across corridors, including on/off-ramp and cross-chain integrations (e.g. Circle CCTP or bridge protocols).

• Own smart contract security: threat modeling, comprehensive test suites, fuzzing and static analysis, and coordination with external auditors.

• Evaluate and benchmark EVM networks (L1s and L2s) considering finality, cost, tooling, custody support and liquidity.

• Set up observability for on-chain components: monitoring and alerting on failed or stuck transactions, balance thresholds and contract events.

• Take part in architecture decisions and translate requirements from Treasury, Finance and Compliance into robust technical designs.

• Review code, mentor other engineers and help define development standards, CI/CD and deployment processes for on-chain components.

• Use AI tools to accelerate development, testing and documentation.

Must Have

• 5+ years of software development experience, with at least 2 years building blockchain products.

• Proven track record shipping smart contracts to mainnet that are (or were) used in production with real value at stake.

• Strong proficiency in Solidity and deep understanding of the EVM: gas optimization, storage layout, upgradeability patterns (proxies) and common vulnerabilities (reentrancy, access control flaws, oracle manipulation, etc.).

• Hands-on experience with modern development frameworks such as Foundry and/or Hardhat, and libraries such as ethers.js, viem or web3.js.

• Solid backend development skills in at least one language such as TypeScript/Node.js, C#/.NET, Go or Python, including APIs and asynchronous services.

• Experience with wallets, key management and the full transaction lifecycle (signing, broadcasting, confirmations, reorgs).

• Hands-on experience with ERC-20 tokens and stablecoins.

• Experience with Git, automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.

• Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Economics or related fields.

• Advanced English.

Nice to Have

• Background in fintech, payments, banking or treasury operations (liquidity management, prefunding, reconciliation).

• Experience with institutional custody providers (e.g. Fireblocks) or MPC wallet infrastructure.

• Experience with cross-chain messaging and bridges (CCTP, LayerZero, Wormhole, Axelar or similar).

• Experience with smart contract security tooling (Slither, Echidna, Mythril) or participation in audits and bug bounties.

• Experience running nodes, working with RPC providers and building indexers (The Graph or custom).

• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (Azure, Kubernetes) and containerized deployments.

• Knowledge of crypto-asset regulation (e.g. MiCA) and KYC/AML in regulated environments.

• Public GitHub, open-source contributions or audited contracts you can share.

About Remitee

Remitee is an international, expanding organization with a vibrant culture that sets us apart. Our work environment is fast-paced and stimulating, offering numerous opportunities for growth and development. If you're a self-starter who thrives in a collaborative and challenging environment, we encourage you to apply. Our company values are fundamental to our daily operations. To succeed here, you'll need to embrace and live our company values.

• We build trust (Integrity and Transparency).

We inspire through example, fulfilling promises, and communicating sincerely.

• We embrace diversity (Respect and Empathy).

We listen and connect, valuing diverse perspectives. We recognize achievements and efforts.

• We trust in the synergy that emerges from effort and collaboration (Teamwork).

We forge authentic bonds through offering opportunities and sharing responsibilities.

• We focus on what is essential (Simplicity).

We simplify complexity, constructing effective solutions. We promote simple and accessible communication

• We create our best version (Excellence).

We act with discipline and perseverance, taking care of our physical and mental well-being. We live with passion and purpose in everything we do

Product Description

KernelCare provides automated live patching for Linux kernels without requiring reboots. Our Extended Lifecycle Support products keep end-of-life Linux distributions secure by backporting important security and bug fixes to older software versions used by enterprise customers.

Role and Team

We are looking for a Kernel Developer to join the KernelCare ELS Team. The team investigates upstream Linux kernel changes, backports fixes to supported enterprise kernels, builds distribution packages, and validates that patches are safe and reproducible. The role is centered on practical patching and building work. You will also use automation and agentic development tools to accelerate investigation while retaining engineering ownership of every result.

Responsibilities

• Investigating upstream security and bug fixes and identifying their dependencies.

• Backporting Linux kernel patches to older RPM- and Debian-based distributions.

• Resolving conflicts caused by differences between upstream and target kernel versions.

• Building and rebuilding kernel source and binary packages in reproducible environments.

• Validating patched kernels through focused tests, build checks, and regression analysis.

• Improving patch preparation, build, and validation workflows with Python, Go, or Shell.

• Using agentic development tools.

• Documenting technical decisions and participating in code review with the kernel team.

Requirements

Must Have:

• Strong C programming and Linux debugging skills.

• Practical Linux kernel development, patching, or backporting experience.

• Confident use of Git, GNU build tools, and standard Linux development utilities.

• Experience building Linux kernels or distribution packages.

• Automation experience with Python, Go, Shell, or a similar language.

• Some experience with agentic or AI-assisted development and a clear approach to validating generated output.

• English at an intermediate level or higher, both written and spoken.

• Strong ownership, careful technical judgment, and readiness to explain trade-offs.

Nice To Have

• Experience with RPM/SRPM or Debian kernel packaging.

• Security patching, CVE analysis, or extended lifecycle maintenance experience.

• Familiarity with Docker, QEMU, Jenkins, or other CI systems.

• Experience designing kernel tests or investigating core dumps and regressions.

Benefits

What's in it for you?

• Fully remote work with flexible working hours, that allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide.

• Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves.

• Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.

• Budget for education.

• The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent.

By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy ( https://tuxcare.com/privacy-policies-hub/candidate-privacy-notice/ ) , which provides detailed information on how we maintain and handle your data.

Visionary in future focused problem-solving

What You'll Do

• Lead efforts to design, implement software and support systems using industry best-practices

• Establish and enforce data quality standards—implement validation frameworks, anomaly detection, and SLA-driven alerting to ensure data reliability.

• Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and drive preventive improvements.

• Define and drive engineering best practices code reviews, CI/CD for data pipelines, and DataOps principles

What We're Looking For

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or similar technical field of study

• 8+ years of professional software or data engineering experience, with at least 4 years focused on cloud data platforms.

• Strong Python programming skills. Proficiency in coding in any other language, preferably Java and Golang

• Strong understanding of highly distributed architecture

• Experience working with secured APIs (REST, GraphQL, etc)

• Cloud computing experience (AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar)

• Experience in Docker and Kubernetes, preferred

• Experience working with observability and monitoring tools (Grafana, Kibana, etc)

• Strong experience working with agile development teams

• Understanding of best practices in performance tuning

• Excellent communication, planning and organizational skills

Why Proofpoint?

At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us

• Competitive compensation

• Comprehensive benefits

• Career success on your terms

• Flexible work environment

• Annual wellness and community outreach days

• Always on recognition for your contributions

• Global collaboration and networking opportunities

Our Culture

Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success-every day, for everyone.

We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com.

How To Apply

Interested? Submit your application along with any supporting information- we can’t wait to hear from you!

postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible.

As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within Network Services, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.

Job Responsibilities

• Executes creative software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems

• Develops secure and high-quality production code, and reviews and debugs code written by others

• Drives team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test strategy acceleration, incident/root-cause analysis support), while establishing consistent validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team.

• Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.

• Identifies opportunities to eliminate or automate remediation of recurring issues to improve overall operational stability of software applications and systems

• Leads evaluation sessions with external vendors, startups, and internal teams to drive outcomes-oriented probing of architectural designs, technical credentials, and applicability for use within existing systems and information architecture

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

• Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and advanced applied experience

• Hands-on practical experience delivering system design, application development, testing, and operational stability

• Advanced in one or more programming language(s)

• Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security.

• Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices

• Proficient in all aspects of the Software Development Life Cycle

• Advanced understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security

• In-depth knowledge of the financial services industry and their IT systems

• Practical cloud native experience

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

• Experience with source-of-truth systems and model-driven telemetry.

• Ability to build robust validation and release controls to minimize partner-facing risk.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills across distributed engineering team

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

postings.descriptionText:
About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

• Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.

• Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.

• Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.

• Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.

• Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a Senior Software Developer.

• You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of professional Software Development experience.

• Advanced English is required.

• Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.

• Proven experience in building high-performance RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI.

• Demonstrated experience with modern frontend frameworks, specifically Vue.js and TypeScript.

• Hands-on experience with relational database design, query optimization, and management using PostgreSQL.

• Solid background in deploying and hosting web applications on AWS and modern cloud platforms like Vercel.

• Practical experience with end-to-end automation testing and test frameworks such as Playwright.

• Well-versed in software engineering best practices, including version control, unit testing, and continuous integration.

• Proficient in translating analytical or research insights into functional, production-ready features.

• Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.

• Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.

• Forensic attention to detail.

• A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.

• Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams.

• Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.

• Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.

• Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Nice To Have

We’re Seeking Engineers Who Are AI-enthusiastic In Their Workflow. Professional Experience Or Personal Project Work With The Following Is a Significant Plus

• Cursor, Windsurf, or Google Antigravity.

• Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Copilot CLI.

Work Authorization Requirements

• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.

• FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

• Competitive pay.

• 100% remote work.

• The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.

• Continuing education opportunities.

• Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

This is an architecture role that writes code, not a coding role that occasionally diagrams.

The hard problems here are not framework problems. There are questions like

What is the right abstraction for behavior that must stay identical across brands with wildly different experiences?

Where does a system have to be deterministic and reproducible, and where can human judgment live?

What belongs in a shared contract versus a local implementation?

How do you make a system's invariants checkable rather than aspirational?

We need someone who thinks in systems and concepts first, and who can then build the thing. Specifically

System architecture and concept design

Define service boundaries, data models, and contracts between components

Design seams that let the same code run locally and hosted without a rewrite

Turn fuzzy capabilities into clear models of core entities and rules

Apply MIT concept design methodologies to agentic system design

Design abstractions that keep behavior consistent across brands with very different experiences

Decide where systems must be deterministic and where human judgment can apply

Make architecture decisions alongside founders with product and engineering backgrounds

Verification and documentation

Plan up front how each system will prove its correctness, rather than retrofitting tests

Make system invariants checkable through code and tests

Write specifications, decision records, and product invariants in RFC 2119 language

Agent-driven development

Direct AI agents to build features and review their output in depth before merging

Write specs that agents can execute and reviewers can check

Maintain agent instructions and skills as first-class artifacts

Run independent adversarial reviews before opening pull requests

Catch plausible but wrong results (e.g. silent safety gates, empty version pins, hollow dependency directories)

• 8+ years of software development experience

• Proficiency with TypeScript

• Experience building component-driven front-ends and data-heavy internal consoles

indie Semiconductor is a fabless semiconductor company specializing in the design of innovative mixed-signal System-on-Chip (SoC) solutions for automotive applications.

Our design team develops custom and standard SoC solutions for automotive applications that integrate advanced digital ICs (Arm® Cortex® MCUs and/or DSP) with mixed-signal devices into a single System-in-Package (SiP). You will join a small team of highly competent engineers involved in the design, implementation, and verification of firmware for embedded systems targeting automotive driver assistance system (ADAS) applications. This is an excellent opportunity for a talented and motivated firmware developer to join a growing team of engineers who strive to solve automotive problems.

Job Responsibilities

• Design top-level simulation and FPGA tests from the test plan to ensure correct system-level integration before tape-out

• Collaborate with digital design engineers to integrate software with SoC-specific accelerators, so firmware is ready for silicon bring-up on day 1

• Profile and map neural-network models onto hardware accelerators when required, translating high-level framework metrics into efficient machine code and data flow

• Design, develop, and optimize DSP embedded software for ADAS systems, including DSP techniques, data-path design, and cycle/memory profiling

Job Requirements

• B.S. in Electronic/Computer Engineering or Computer Science (or equivalent experience)

• 1+ years of embedded firmware experience (or equivalent depth), including bring-up and debugging on real hardware or FPGA

• Deep understanding of computer architecture principles: pipelining, memory hierarchy (caches/MMU), interrupts/exceptions, and ISA-level behavior

• Solid command of build toolchains and object-file formats (ELF), including linker scripts for memory placement and system initialization

• Familiarity with HW/SW partitioning and mapping of neural-network models onto heterogeneous architectures (CPU/DSP/NPU)

What Extra Skills Make You Stand Out?

The following skills are not required for the position. If you have experience in any of them, it would be a plus. The goal is to understand candidates' backgrounds and/or strengths.

• Experience with SIMD/VLIW, fixed-point arithmetic, and cycle-accurate profiling

• Hands-on firmware development experience with Cadence Tensilica (Xtensa), ARM Cortex-M/R/A, as well as familiarity with RISC-V (RV32/RV64), including CSRs, interrupt and exception models, toolchains, and ABI conventions

• RTOS experience (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or AUTOSAR OS) in addition to bare-metal

Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and make it hold up in the real environment.

This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer . You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are debugging why an agent’s tool-calling loop degraded after a context change. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday.

On this track, your edge is application engineering: you make agents real inside the client’s actual systems, workflows, and delivery pipelines.

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up.

How We Approach The Work

FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment:

• Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec.

• Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology.

• Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why.

• Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value.

Consultative Discovery

Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch.

• Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes.

• Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually.

• Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two.

• Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success.

• Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with “why,” “how do you know,” and “what happens today when…” — without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better.

• Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology.

What You'll Do

• Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business and engineering stakeholders. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. Come back with a scoped, defensible point of view.

• Structure the process and the spec. For any business or engineering process being automated, map the current state, decision points, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably.

• Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end — orchestration, context and retrieval architecture, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and the boundaries between deterministic and non-deterministic components.

• Build. Ship working systems — agents, multi-step automations, internal tooling, integration layers. You are hands-on. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware.

• Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build: build, test, release, environments.

• Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of professional software development experience with at least one mainstream production stack (TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java, C#/.NET, or Go).

• 1 - 4 years of professional experience building and shipping LLM-powered and agentic AI systems beyond prototypes or demos.

• Advanced English is required.

• Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.

• Hands-on experience with frontier AI developer tools including Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenAI Codex.

• Proven experience evaluating current-state environments and defining technical roadmaps.

• Demonstrated experience with APIs, service design, event-driven and distributed systems, and data modeling.

• Experience designing and owning CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, release, environments, and deployment processes.

• Strong understanding of context and specification engineering to produce reliable AI output.

• Solid understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including APIs, webhooks, event streams, iPaaS platforms such as n8n or MuleSoft, and MCP.

• Track record of leading client-facing discovery calls, asking "why" before "how" to decompose unstructured business problems.

• Skilled at exercising end-to-end delivery ownership and managing project scope without requiring product manager supervision.

• Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.

• Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.

• Forensic attention to detail.

• A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.

• Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams.

• Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.

• Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.

• Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Strong Plus

• Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems.

• Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases.

• Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing).

• Pre-sales support: discovery calls, SOW and estimate shaping, technical proposal defense.

• Process mining, operations analysis, or transformation consulting background.

• Client enablement and training — building the client team’s capability, not just the system.

• Prior consulting or agency environment; comfort with ambiguity and multiple accounts.

Work Authorization Requirements

• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.

• FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

• Competitive pay.

• 100% remote work.

• The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.

• Continuing education opportunities.

• Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

• Collaborate on Dagster-orchestrated data pipelines — understanding lineage and dependencies well enough to troubleshoot issues and contribute to data model design, not just consume the output.

• Explore and prototype agentic AI and data science solutions (e.g., LLM-powered analysis, automated insight generation, predictive/propensity modeling) to accelerate how the team surfaces and acts on data.

• Apply data governance principles in day-to-day work: support privacy and retention deletion workflows (OneTrust), and ensure PII is handled correctly across CRM/MarTech data integrations (Customer.io, Twilio Segment).

• Own the end-to-end reporting lifecycle — requirements gathering, data modeling, dashboard build, validation, and stakeholder walkthroughs.

• Experience supporting a cloud data migration (GCP, Azure, or AWS) is a plus.

• A curious, insight-first mindset — comfortable going beyond “build the dashboard that was asked for” to proactively surface what the data is actually saying.

People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY. We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. Here are a few benefits we offer to support you:

A partir de ese entendimiento profundo del negocio y de la empresa, identificar y proponer nuevas oportunidades fuera del core actual, que permitan capitalizar la base de clientes existente en nuevos ámbitos de Salud y Bienestar.

📌 ¿Cuáles serán tus desafíos?

Entendimiento del cliente y del negocio actual

• Analizar el comportamiento de los clientes (compras por categoría, recurrencia, ticket, mix, entre otras variables) para detectar oportunidades de negocio, de mejora de rentabilidad y de fidelización/retención.

• Identificar insights sobre el recorrido del cliente y traducirlos en acciones concretas que mejoren el mix de producto, la recurrencia y el LTV.

• Explorar y explotar los datos del Data Warehouse (SQL Server / BigQuery) para responder preguntas de negocio y anticipar nuevas.

postings.title: Rapid Response Reporting - Assistant Director - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
The Opportunity

To join a high-performing multi-national team within the Global R&DA that provides financial reporting, analytics, and insights support in response to strategic and ad hoc business requests. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders across a diverse portfolio of customers to design, develop and test reports and dashboards that support strategic initiatives and inform leadership decision-making.

What We Look For

We are seeking for Assistant Directors with 10+ years of experience in professional services, or other leading global organizations, to join the Global R&DA Leadership Reporting Pillar.

The successful candidate will play a key role within a small dedicated team working with stakeholders to understand business requirements and advise on the most appropriate reporting solutions.

The role involves producing reporting specifications, designing and developing reports and dashboards, managing user acceptance testing, creating user documentation and delivering demonstrations and training sessions.

The ideal candidate will:

• Combine strong technical expertise with excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to translate complex business requirements into impactful reporting solutions.

• Demonstrate a strong aptitude for understanding commercial financial reporting and analysis.

• Be capable of working independently while collaborating effectively within a geographically diverse team environment.

• Be a practical and analytical problem-solver with the ability to clearly articulate approach, findings and recommendations.

• Thrive in a fast-paced environment managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines simultaneously.

• Take ownership of deliverables ensuring a high standard of quality, accuracy and timeliness.

Key Responsibilities

• Demonstrate the confidence to ask the right questions to ensure outputs align with business requirements and stakeholder expectations.

• Ensuring the timely and accurate delivery of tasks assigned to you, keeping stakeholders and colleagues informed of progress and any potential issues.

• Develop a broad understanding of EY’s commercial Finance reporting portfolio that can be drawn on for direction and knowledge.

• Ensure all reports and dashboards are developed in accordance with established build standards, governance requirements and approved style templates.

• Act as a liaison between source data providers and the Global R&DA Leadership Reporting Pillar.

Stakeholder management

• Act as a trusted business advisor to finance and business stakeholders.

• Develop a thorough understanding of business requirements building stakeholder confidence through insightful questioning and high-quality delivery.

• Manage stakeholder expectations and provide regular updates on priorities, timelines, risks, and deliverables.

• Challenge requests constructively and in a consultative manner ensuring proposed solutions align with strategic objectives, reporting standards and best practices.

• Present findings, insights, and recommendations in a clear, concise, and impactful manner tailored to the audience.

Continuous improvement

• Support process improvement initiatives to enhance reporting efficiency, data quality, automation and stakeholder experience.

• Document reporting processes and business logic for reporting assigned to you.

• Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate processes.

Technical skill set

• Demonstrate extensive experience designing, developing and maintaining complex reports and dashboards using Power BI.

• Design and develop advanced SQL queries to extract, interrogate, transform and analyse large datasets to help inform on the build of new reports and dashboards.

• Advanced Excel skills including complex formulas, data modelling, Power Query, automation and large-scale data analysis.

• Interpret, troubleshoot and enhance complex reports and dashboards developed by others.

• Demonstrate experience working with large and complex financial datasets.

• Understanding of concepts such as Wins, Pipeline, Backlog, Revenue, Margin.

Skills And Attributes For Success

• Excellent listening and communication skills.

• Strong curiosity and awareness of emerging business and technology trends.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent attention to detail.

• A proactive customer-focused approach with a willingness to embrace new ideas and a commitment to continuous improvement.

postings.title: Business Intelligence Solutions Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Nos encontramos acompañando a una importante compañía en la búsqueda de un/a Business Intelligence Solutions Specialist para sumarse al equipo de operaciones del área de Legal & Compliance . Buscamos un perfil analítico e innovador que diseñe e implemente soluciones basadas en datos, automatización y tecnología para mejorar la toma de decisiones y la eficiencia operativa.
El rol actúa como nexo estratégico entre las áreas de negocio e IT, desarrollando soluciones de BI, optimizando modelos de datos, liderando la automatización de procesos e integrando herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para generar valor medible.
Responsabilidades principales:

• Business Intelligence & Analytics (~35%): Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards e indicadores en Power BI. Escribir y optimizar consultas SQL avanzadas, diseñar modelos de datos escalables e implementar políticas de seguridad (Row-Level Security).

• Data Integration & Automation (~25%): Desarrollar procesos ETL con Power Query, integrar sistemas mediante APIs y construir flujos automatizados con Power Automate para eliminar tareas manuales.

• Business Partnership & Solution Delivery (~20%): Relevar requerimientos con stakeholders de Legal, Compliance e IT, traducir necesidades operativas en soluciones tecnológicas y coordinar pruebas de sistemas (UAT).

• Project & Process Improvement (~10%): Liderar iniciativas de optimización de procesos de punta a punta, documentar flujos de trabajo en Visio o Lucidchart y apoyar la gestión del cambio.

• Operational Support & AI Exploration (~10%): Brindar soporte operativo a las soluciones de Legal & Compliance, monitorear integraciones y explorar tecnologías emergentes e inteligencia artificial para potenciar las operaciones.

Requisitos del perfil:

• +3 años de experiencia en Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Análisis de Sistemas/Funcional o Mejora de Procesos.

• Nivel de inglés avanzado ( C1, excluyente ) con sólidas habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita.

• Experiencia práctica en el desarrollo de reportes y tableros con Power BI y diseño de modelos de datos.

• Sólidos conocimientos de SQL para extracción, transformación y análisis de datos de múltiples fuentes.

• Experiencia en procesos ETL y manipulación de datos con Power Query.

• Experiencia construyendo o soportando flujos de automatización (Power Automate) e integración vía APIs.

• Capacidad demostrada para el relevamiento de requerimientos y la gestión de proyectos de principio a fin.

• Título universitario en Sistemas, Cs. de la Computación, Ingeniería, Análisis de Datos, Administración de Empresas o combinación equivalente de educación y experiencia.

Deseable:

• Manejo avanzado de DAX, lenguaje M y optimización de rendimiento en Power BI.

• Experiencia o conocimientos en Python para análisis de datos y automatizaciones.

• Experiencia previa en áreas o industrias de Legal, Compliance, Gestión de Riesgos o entornos altamente regulados.

• Conocimientos de gobernanza de datos, metodologías de mejora continua (Lean Six Sigma) o soluciones de IA.

• Certificaciones profesionales (Microsoft Power BI, PMP, CBAP, Lean Six Sigma).

postings.title: Lead Analyst, Traceability and Labeling Controls
postings.descriptionText:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function

Data Analytics & Computational Sciences

Job Sub Function

Business Intelligence

Job Category

Professional

All Job Posting Locations:

Mendoza, Argentina

Job Description

We are searching for the best talent for a Lead Analyst, Traceability and Labeling Controls to be based in Argentina, New Brunswick, NJ; Raritan, NJ; or Titusville, NJ.

Purpose: The role supports GTC T&LC platforms and programs in the Serialization & Traceability and GS1 standards, by leading the scoping, planning, and execution of activities required to meet new and evolving regulatory and customer requirements.

This position partners with cross functional teams, business stakeholders, technology groups, and external customers across both Innovative Medicine and MedTech to translate requirements into actionable steps and ensure operational excellence. It also provides day-to-day leadership of base business operations, team oversight, and delivery of high-quality data and digital capabilities.

You Will Be Responsible For

• Lead base business team including direct responsibility for contract resource(s) and J&J associate(s).

• Lead scoping activities for new and updated regulatory and customer requirements and translate them into clear, actionable steps to ensure compliance.

• Collaborate with T&LC team members, vendors, J&J Technology, cross functional partners, and business stakeholders across Innovative Medicine and MedTech.

• Serve as a primary point of contact for customers, supply chain partners, business franchises, and internal functions to ensure execution of TL&C capabilities and consistent service delivery.

• Own and maintain dashboards used to manage base business performance and operational activities.

• Lead and execute projects within established timelines and budgets while coordinating tasks across functions and geographies.

• Partner with business leaders, J&J Technology, Quality, Make and Deliver organizations to improve data quality and enable efficient digital strategies for customers.

• Support customers in staying aligned with requirements during new product introductions and process changes.

• Define and assess business requirements for system‑to‑system connectivity, including data modeling and data mapping, and work with technology partners to deliver solutions.

• Troubleshoot system operations and provide guidance to the user community.

• Lead UAT/SIT activities for system deployments supporting customer, regional, or global rollouts, including dashboard development and deployment.

• Develop and maintain metrics, track issues, drive problem resolution, and communicate timelines effectively.

• Contribute to the development of SOPs, training materials, and education related to GS1 standards and T&LC capabilities.

• Collaborate with T&LC team members, vendors, J&J Technology, cross‑functional partners, and business stakeholders across Innovative Medicine and MedTech.

• Drive compliance during the deployment phase to ensure all milestones are met in accordance with regional Serialization regulatory requirements.

• Development of scope and plans for new market regulations and compliance requirements.

• Lead the Senior Analysts and Analysts with base business support as needed.

• Challenge the organization by identifying innovative opportunities that drive value for our business.

Qualifications/Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree.

• Advanced English is required

• Greater than 5 years of experience, with supply chain experience preferred.

• 3+ years of experience participating in large, cross functional projects.

Initiative Leadership & Ownership

• Independently identify and prioritize analytics opportunities aligned with business needs.

postings.title: Gender and Diversity Mainstreaming Support Consultant
postings.descriptionText:
We improve lives

The IDB Group is a community of diverse, versatile, and passionate people who come together on a journey to improve lives in Latin America and the Caribbean. Our people find purpose and do what they love in an inclusive, collaborative, agile, and rewarding environment.

About This Position

We are looking for an operational consultant to support the strategic-alignment validation process that helps ensure Bank processes and operations reflect and benefit all. This includes support for the design, use, and continuous improvement of AI agents and related tools. Additionally, the consultant will support operational-related tasks (such as technical-cooperation preparation and execution) as well as other analytical or alignment-related tasks required by the division chief or other team members.

You will work in the Gender and Diversity Division (GDI), a part of the Social Sector (SCL). The division supports Bank operations, provides policy and strategic guidance, and carries out technical assistance and training. Learn more here.

What You’ll Do

• Review project documents at Eligibility Review Meeting (ERM) and Quality and Risk Review (QRR) stages to identify opportunities to strengthen gender and diversity analysis that captures target demographics, actions, beneficiary targeting, and results indicators. Participate in ERM, QRR, and other relevant project-review meetings.

• Support the division’s specialists and operational teams in assessing strategic alignment and integrating considerations related to women’s economic empowerment and society-wide inclusiveness throughout the project cycle.

• Maintain portfolio databases and monitoring systems on alignment, activities, indicators, and beneficiary disaggregation.

• Prepare analytical, management, and corporate reports on portfolio performance, alignment trends, and GDAP progress.

• Collaborate with GDI, the Office of Strategic Planning and Development Effectiveness (SPD), and other departments to ensure consistency in alignment methodologies, validation, monitoring, and reporting.

• Support the development, testing, implementation, and use of analytical tools, dashboards, and AI-enabled solutions to strengthen gender and diversity strategic alignment, portfolio monitoring, reporting, and knowledge management processes, including the division’s Impact Tracker and related functionalities.

• Deliver training and capacity-building activities on alignment requirements, methodologies, tools, and reporting processes.

• Support the preparation and implementation of GDI's technical cooperation (TC) portfolio and corporate work program, including annual TC reports, knowledge products, corporate reports, and other activities aligned with the division’s priorities.

What You'll Need

• Education: Master’s Degree in Economics, Public Policy, International Development or another related field to the responsibilities of the role

• Experience: At least 5 years of progressive experience working with aspects of development, finance, and equity (gender and/or diversity). Deep knowledge of Excel and other Office tools is required. Familiarity with artificial intelligence tools applied to analytical and operational processes is highly desirable, preferably Microsoft Copilot and Copilot agents. The consultant should have the ability to work independently as well as in a team in a proactive and highly responsive manner. The consultant should understand how to effectively communicate information through charts and graphs. Experience at the IDB is preferred.

• Languages: Proficiency in Spanish and English, spoken and written, is required. Additional knowledge of French and Portuguese is preferable.

Requirements

• Citizenship: You are a citizen of one of our 48-member countries. We may offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your eligible dependents).

• Consanguinity: You have no family members (up to the fourth degree of consanguinity and second degree of affinity, including spouse) working at the IDB, IDB Invest, or IDB Lab.

Type of contract and duration

International consultant Full-Time, 12 months (up to 48 months, subject to eligibility).

What We Offer

The IDB Group provides benefits that respond to the different needs and moments of an employee’s life. These benefits include:

• A competitive compensation package.

• Leaves and vacations: 2 days per month of contract + gender-neutral parental leave.

• Health Insurance: The IDB Group provides a monthly allowance to supplement the purchase of health insurance.

• Savings plan: The IDB Group cares about your future, depending on the length of the contract, you will receive a monthly savings plan allowance.

• We offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your family when it applies.

• On-site position with the occasional flexibility of teleworking.

• Development support: We offer learning opportunities to boost your professional profile, such as seminars, 1:1 professional counseling, and much more.

• Health and well-being: Access to our Health Services Center that provides preventive care and health education for employees.

• Other office amenities (as available): Lactation Room, Daycare Center, Gym, Bike Racks, Parking, spouse career support, and others.

Our culture

At the IDB, we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. Our people consistently strive for excellence, and we recognize and celebrate the impact of their contributions.

In our efforts to drive innovation, we intentionally include all voices, cultivate a sense of belonging and champion fairness. We welcome individuals from underrepresented groups to join us and share their unique perspectives.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job interview process. If you require an accommodation to complete this application, please email us at accommodations@iadb.org.

postings.title: Performance Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Remote position available for candidates based in La Plata, Bahía Blanca, CABA, Córdoba, Rosario, or Mendoza.

Avature is a large, highly configurable platform serving hundreds of client instances across multitenant environments, running on both on-premise and cloud infrastructure. As a Performance Analyst , you will investigate how that system behaves under real load: why a response time degraded, whether the infrastructure can absorb a planned campaign, where capacity is being wasted, and what a degradation in production is actually telling us. You will be one of the first people engineering turns to when something looks slow, and you will work with development, infrastructure and support teams to get to the root cause and a possible solution.

Your Challenges And Objectives

• Build a working model of our platform: its modules, services, and how they interact under load.

• Investigate performance issues end to end, from a symptom on a dashboard to a root cause in infrastructure, configuration, or code.

• Turn observations into evidence: use statistics to separate a real degradation from noise, and correlation from causation.

• Take on progressively more complex and more ambiguous problems as you grow in the role.

• Improve how we see the system: cross data sources, script your own analyses, automate what you repeat, and maintain the dashboards and tooling the team relies on.

Your Day-to-day Activities

• Investigate performance issues end to end, from a symptom on a dashboard to a root cause in infrastructure, configuration, or code, and hand your findings to the team that owns the fix.

• Analyze response times, throughput, and resource usage across logs, metrics, traces, and profiles, using statistics to separate a real degradation from noise and correlation from causation.

• Act as an entry point for engineering when a performance question appears, triaging it and connecting the right teams.

• Validate planned changes before they reach production: run performance tests with artificial load in dedicated environments, and confirm whether infrastructure and configuration can absorb limit extensions, bulk imports, go-lives, and campaigns.

• Work on capacity and cost efficiency: sizing rules, resource utilization, and where we are over- or under-provisioned.

• Plan preventive measures: take part in post-crisis procedures, learn from what went wrong, and think ahead about preventing issues rather than only diagnosing them.

About You

• You have a background in STEM, or equivalent practical experience.

• You are comfortable with statistics: distributions, percentiles, variance, correlation, and the difference between a real signal and noise.

• You have strong analytical skills, you are autonomous and curious, and you enjoy open-ended investigation more than well-defined tasks.

• You can reason about software systems without being a developer: how components interact, where time goes in a request, and what logs, metrics and dashboards tell you about what is actually happening.

• You can read code well enough to follow a call path and understand what it does.

• Intermediate oral and written English (B1), mainly for internal communication.

• Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day work and genuinely interested in staying up to date with emerging AI capabilities.

About Us

Avature is a market-leading enterprise SaaS provider for global talent acquisition and talent management. We have a strong commitment to high-quality engineering and customer service and are recognized innovators in the large enterprise market. Leading organizations around the world rely on Avature, including Fortune 500 companies, global consulting firms, some of the world's largest banks and manufacturers, and government organizations.

We design, build, implement, and support our product ourselves. With a strong culture of ownership and innovation, we continuously evolve our platform to help organizations meet the changing demands of talent acquisition and talent management. As technology continues to reshape the world of work, we leverage AI and emerging technologies to help organizations innovate, adapt, and gain competitive advantage.

At Avature, we value opportunities to learn and grow within a dynamic, creative, and collaborative environment. We encourage autonomy and empower our people to approach challenges innovatively while bringing their unique perspective to the table. We believe curiosity, continuous learning, and openness to emerging technologies are essential to building the future. Through our career development programs, mentorship, and leadership opportunities, we support each person's professional growth while making a meaningful impact on our product and our customers' success.

What We Offer

• A fast-paced, energetic, and engaging environment.

• We combine flexible remote work with in-person collaboration, encouraging team members to spend one day a week at their nearest office. We have workplaces in Buenos Aires (Palermo, La Plata and Bahía Blanca), Rosario, Mendoza and Córdoba.

• Flexible hours.

• Periodic salary reviews.

• Three weeks vacations from the first year.

• Four weeks paternity leave.

• OSDE 360 health coverage (family plan).

• Four days a year to attend events related to professional development.

• Paid internet service expenses.

An organizational culture that empowers everyone to be themselves is key to thrive in business, but more importantly, it is a pathway for creating a more equitable society. Avature fosters a diverse and inclusive environment and celebrates that each unique person brings something different to our team. We are committed to considering all qualified applicants equally and to promoting equal opportunities within our organization.

Somos una AI-first EdTech con base en Europa . Buscamos una persona ambiciosa, resolutiva y MUY manija para sumarse a la mesa chica de nuestra startup de más de 100 personas creciendo +80% YoY, con un equipo 70% europeo .

Antes de seguir:

• Es exigente. Jornadas largas, presencial en Palermo y con dedicación exclusiva (sin otro trabajo ni proyectos paralelos). Resignás equilibrio a cambio de crecimiento acelerado y ownership real. Si no es lo que buscás hoy, está perfecto, pero no es para vos.

• Acá no vas a recibir un paso a paso. Vas a encontrar problemas abiertos: esperamos que hagas preguntas, investigues y propongas cómo resolverlos.

• Necesitás experiencia práctica con AI: haberla usado para construir algo, mejorar un proceso o resolver un problema concreto.

• Excellent spoken and written English is essential: vas a trabajar diariamente con un equipo internacional.

Te seguimos contando en inglés.

THE ROLE
During your first week, you’ll sit down with all three founders to discuss your interests, strengths and the opportunities we see in the business. Together, we’ll identify an initial project for you to own across sales, marketing, growth or operations.

You’ll take it from diagnosis to results: understand the problem, analyze the data, test a solution, implement it and measure its impact.

Recent examples from our team:

• Facundo - Growth & Business Strategy: took ownership of paid acquisition, funnel experiments and upsell initiatives, managing the whole advertising budget.

• Mateo - AI Sales Manager: took ownership of the whole sales funnel covering 50+ sales reps within 3 months driving AI initiatives to increase end-to-end lead conversion and reduce manual operations.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• Business judgment: you break down messy problems, prioritize and identify what matters.

• Execution: you can show something you built, improved or grew.

• AI-native mindset: AI is already part of how you work, and you validate its outputs.

• Ownership: you take initiative and follow through without constant supervision.

This role typically suits someone with 0-3 years of experience . We welcome backgrounds in business, economics, marketing, engineering and data.

Coding, API and automation experience are nice to have, not requirements. What matters is your ability to use AI to solve business problems and deliver results.

WHAT WE OFFER

• Founder-like ownership and responsibility. Involvement in key business decisions and rapid growth.

• EUR 2,500/month during an initial six-month period.

• EUR 6,000-9,000 sign-on bonus if we continue after that period . From there, a long-term package with a clear path to ownership, such as profit share and equity-like participation.

• Company-paid AI tools, including Claude Code and access to leading models.

¿Te ves en este rol? Postulate. Si completás el campo de motivación, ponele onda: contanos qué hiciste, qué te entusiasma de esta oportunidad y qué podrías aportar. Un ejemplo concreto nos dice mucho más que una presentación genérica.

postings.title: Senior FP&A - Fractional & Advisory
postings.descriptionText:
About MAVI

MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. Founded in 2023 and backed by a $4 million seed round led by Harlem Capital, MAVI was recently featured in TechCrunch.

Our professionals join in-house finance teams in full-time, long-term roles, not short-term projects. The companies we work with range from venture- and PE-backed businesses to public companies and CFO advisory firms, including Athena Club, MotherDuck, and Within.

The work centers on judgment. As AI takes over more transactional accounting, the people who review the output, question it, and own the result matter more than ever. MAVI professionals work alongside US finance leaders, using AI tools to do more and applying the judgment to catch what those tools get wrong. At one client, an AR dashboard now used across the organization was built almost entirely by MAVI talent.

We stay involved throughout, from role alignment and interview preparation to onboarding and long-term career development.

About the role

We’re looking for a strong FP&A professional who enjoys working across different businesses, solving different problems, and partnering directly with founders and CFOs.

In this role, you’ll support multiple high-growth US companies and help them improve forecasting, modeling, cash planning, management reporting, and strategic decision-making.

This is especially suited to someone who enjoys variety, can switch contexts quickly, and is comfortable building trusted relationships with multiple stakeholders.

What you’ll own

• Build and maintain financial models, budgets, and rolling forecasts across multiple companies

• Own or support cash-flow forecasting, working-capital analysis, and scenario planning

• Review monthly performance and explain the key drivers behind variances

• Build management reporting packages, KPI dashboards, and decision-ready analysis

• Work directly with founders, CFOs, and senior business leaders

• Translate different business models into financial assumptions and forecasts

• Manage priorities across multiple companies at the same time

• Help clients improve planning, reporting, and finance processes

• Support strategic decisions around growth, hiring, pricing, investment, and cash management

• Bring structure and clarity to businesses that may still be building out their finance function

Must-haves

• 5+ years of finance experience, with meaningful FP&A or strategic finance exposure

• Strong budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling skills

• True multi-client, portfolio, advisory, or consulting exposure

• Experience working across multiple companies or business units at the same time

• Strong cash-flow and working-capital understanding

• Comfortable working directly with founders, CFOs, or senior leaders

• Strong communication and stakeholder management

• Excellent written and spoken English

Nice to have

• Fractional CFO, outsourced CFO, finance advisory, or consulting background

• Experience with startups, SMBs, or high-growth companies

• SaaS, DTC/eCommerce, CPG, retail, consumer, or marketplace exposure

• Experience building models from scratch

• Process improvement, automation, or finance transformation experience

• Board, investor, or fundraising support experience

Why this role is exciting

You’ll get broader exposure than a traditional in-house FP&A role, work across several business models, and build strong client-facing and strategic finance experience — a great step toward senior advisory, Finance Lead, or Fractional CFO opportunities.
