2. Account-Based Intelligence (AI-Native Approach)

• Deep Mining: Use AI tools to build targeted account lists and analyze client "tech landscapes" (e.g., scraping client job boards to identify hidden talent gaps and active tech stacks).

• Stakeholder Mapping: Identify key Decision Makers and Influencers to build maps of mutual influence within target organizations.

• Hyper-Personalization: Leverage LLMs and AI tools to synthesize prospect LinkedIn activity, interviews, or news into high-relevance outreach hooks.

Requirements
• Experience: 1+ year of hands-on SDR / lead generation experience in IT Outstaffing, Staff Augmentation, or Nearshore software development targeting the US market.

• Track Record: Documented success in cold outbound hunting, quota attainment, and running outreach strategies from scratch.

• Language: Bilingual or Native-level English (C2) with exceptional written and verbal communication skills tailored to US tech executives.

• Tech & AI Savvy: Fast comprehension of complex tech stacks (SaaS, Cloud, AI/ML) and daily hands-on experience using modern outreach/AI tools (Clay, Apollo, ChatGPT, Perplexity, HubSpot/Salesforce) to automate and scale outreach workflows.

• Soft Skills: High level of persistence, strategic empathy, grit, and strong self-organization.

Conditions
• Contract Type: B2B contract (Long-term).

• Work Setup: 100% Remote.

• Compensation: Base salary + performance bonuses. Payment in USD.

postings.title: Full-Time MVA Legal Intake and Retainer Conversion Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
MVA Legal Intake & Retainer Conversion Specialist Accident Recovery Network | Full-Time & Part-Time Opportunities | English & Spanish Speakers

Position Overview Accident Recovery Network is seeking experienced, results-driven MVA Legal Intake & Retainer Conversion Specialists to engage prospective clients, qualify motor vehicle accident (MVA) cases, conduct inbound and outbound calls, and convert qualified leads into signed retainers and successful live transfers.
This is a sales-focused role, not simply a phone-answering or administrative intake position. Success depends on the ability to build trust quickly, follow up consistently, handle objections, overcome hesitation, and guide qualified prospects toward taking the next step in the legal representation process.
We are looking for confident communicators who understand that generating interest is only the beginning. The real value comes from moving qualified prospects through the pipeline and turning opportunities into completed intakes, successful transfers, and signed retainers.
We welcome both full-time and part-time applicants , including qualified Spanish-speaking and bilingual English/Spanish callers who can communicate naturally and confidently with prospective clients.
Candidates with a strong background in MVA, personal injury (PI), legal intake, retainer conversion, or performance-driven outbound calling are encouraged to apply.

Employment Type & Schedule
• Full-time and part-time opportunities available

• Schedules based on availability, campaign needs, and performance requirements

• Monday through Friday, with occasional Sunday availability depending on campaign needs

• Coverage may include Eastern and Pacific Time zones

• Daytime and evening calling schedules may be available

• Consistent attendance, punctuality, and schedule adherence are required

• Candidates must be available during their assigned calling and follow-up windows

Please specify your preferred employment type and availability when applying.

Primary Responsibilities
1. Sales-Focused Intake & Client Engagement
• Handle inbound calls from prospective MVA and personal injury clients.

• Establish trust and rapport while maintaining control of the conversation.

• Ask structured questions to understand the accident, injuries, treatment, and circumstances.

• Identify qualified prospects and explain the next steps in the case-review process.

• Build confidence and help eligible prospects move forward with consultations, transfers, or retainer signing.

• Recognize opportunities to advance a qualified lead rather than simply record information and end the call.

2. Outbound Calling, Follow-Up & Conversion
• Make outbound calls to new, aged, incomplete, and previously contacted leads.

• Re-engage prospects who have not completed intake or signed their retainers.

• Follow up on unsigned agreements, missing information, and incomplete documentation.

• Handle objections, hesitation, confusion, and common concerns professionally.

• Use persuasive, empathetic communication to help qualified prospects make informed decisions about the next step.

• Follow approved call scripts and follow-up cadences while communicating naturally.

• Maintain consistent follow-up through telephone, SMS, and email where authorized.

• Work toward measurable conversion targets instead of focusing solely on call volume.

3. MVA Case Qualification Evaluate potential cases against established qualification criteria, including:

• Accident date and applicable jurisdiction

• Liability and fault

• Injury type and severity

• Medical treatment and treatment timelines

• Gaps in medical treatment

• Insurance coverage and police-report availability

• Vehicle and property damage

• Existing attorney representation or prior attorney rejection

• Potential statute-of-limitations concerns

• Commercial vehicles, rideshare, pedestrian, motorcycle, bicycle, and hit-and-run cases

• Other campaign-specific qualification and disqualification criteria

Accurate qualification is essential. Candidates must balance conversion performance with compliance and case quality, without misrepresenting eligibility or promising legal outcomes.

4. Retainer Conversion & Live Transfers
• Guide qualified prospects through the electronic retainer-signing process.

• Explain the process and next steps clearly without providing unauthorized legal advice.

• Send retainers, forms, and required documentation.

• Confirm document receipt and completion.

• Follow up persistently on unsigned retainers.

• Facilitate warm, properly qualified live transfers to the appropriate legal team.

• Introduce the caller and summarize the case before transferring.

• Confirm successful connections and recover missed or failed transfers through timely follow-up.

• Help move qualified opportunities through the pipeline toward signed retainers and completed handoffs.

5. CRM & Pipeline Management
• Maintain accurate lead records, call notes, dispositions, and case statuses.

• Update pipeline stages, follow-up dates, and tasks promptly.

• Document qualification decisions and disqualification reasons.

• Track outstanding prospects and prevent qualified leads from being neglected.

• Identify stalled opportunities and prioritize appropriate follow-up.

• Follow confidentiality, data-security, and communication procedures.

Required Experience Candidates should demonstrate:

• At least five years of legal intake experience preferred, with substantial direct MVA experience strongly desired.

• Hands-on experience with motor vehicle accident and personal injury inquiries.

• Experience conducting inbound and outbound calls.

• A track record of converting qualified prospects into signed retainers, consultations, or successful live transfers.

• Strong objection-handling and follow-up skills.

• Experience working toward measurable sales, conversion, or productivity targets.

• Familiarity with MVA qualification and disqualification criteria.

• Experience managing high volumes of prospective-client inquiries.

• Strong CRM and pipeline-management skills.

• Experience with electronic retainer and document-signing platforms.

• The ability to communicate effectively with injured, distressed, hesitant, or uncertain callers.

Candidates with mass tort intake experience, personal injury law firm experience, or legal intake call-center/BPO experience will be particularly relevant.

Language & Communication Requirements We are interested in candidates for both English-speaking and Spanish-speaking calling needs.

English-speaking roles

• Fluent spoken and written English.

• Clear, professional telephone communication and strong listening comprehension.

• Ability to understand different speaking styles and regional dialects.

• Confidence explaining information in simple, understandable language.

• Accurate call documentation and professional written communication.

Spanish-speaking roles

• Strong spoken Spanish and the ability to communicate naturally with Spanish-speaking prospects.

• Confidence conducting intake, follow-up, qualification, and retainer-conversion conversations in Spanish.

• Ability to understand prospects' concerns, explain next steps clearly, and handle objections professionally.

• English proficiency appropriate to the assigned campaign and internal reporting requirements.

Bilingual English/Spanish candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. Please identify your language proficiency and the languages in which you can confidently conduct full telephone conversations.
An accent alone is not disqualifying. Clear communication, listening comprehension, professionalism, and the ability to avoid repeated clarification are what matter.
Applicants may be asked to complete a recorded voice assessment, mock intake call, outbound sales call, or language assessment.

Preferred Qualifications
• GoHighLevel (GHL) or other legal CRM experience

• Power-dialer or predictive-dialer experience

• Automated SMS and email follow-up experience

• Personal injury law firm or legal intake call-center experience

• Experience with multistate MVA campaigns

• Familiarity with signed-retainer and qualified-transfer campaigns

• Experience with attorney referral or case-acquisition networks

• Demonstrated success improving lead-to-retainer conversion rates

Core Competencies The ideal candidate demonstrates:

• Sales confidence and ethical persuasion

• Strong objection handling and closing skills

• Empathy without losing control of the conversation

• Active listening and emotional intelligence

• Confidence asking sensitive questions

• Persistence without being aggressive

• Excellent telephone presence

• Strong follow-up discipline

• Attention to detail and accurate documentation

• Ability to prioritize qualified, high-potential opportunities

• Comfort working toward measurable performance goals

• Coachability and willingness to improve through feedback

• Professional judgment and discretion

Performance Expectations Performance will be evaluated using measurable indicators, including:

• Outbound call volume and contact rate

• Speed-to-lead and inbound answer rate

• Completed intake and qualification rates

• Consultation-booking and live-transfer rates

• Retainer-send and signed-retainer conversion rates

• Follow-up completion and recovery of stalled prospects

• CRM accuracy and call quality

postings.title: Account Executive
postings.descriptionText:
Account Executive

Location
Hybrid - Buenos Aires, Argentina (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)

SHAPE THE FUTURE OF PRIVACY WITH USERCENTRICS
Usercentrics is a global leader in the field of consent management platforms (CMP). We follow our company vision to build a world where user privacy enables a thriving digital ecosystem. Our mission is to provide privacy solutions that empower organizations to embrace data privacy while building trust with their users through freedom of choice. With our product, businesses can collect, manage and document user consents on websites and apps, and achieve full compliance in accordance with global privacy regulations while facilitating high consent rates and building trust with their customers.

Usercentrics is looking for a driven, full-cycle Account Executive who can also operate effectively at the top of the funnel. This hybrid role combines traditional SDR responsibilities with AE ownership, offering the opportunity to manage the complete sales journey - from lead generation to closed-won revenue. Ideal for a hands-on seller who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment.

Your Tasks

Top-of-Funnel / Sales Development:

• Identify and engage key decision-makers at target accounts using outbound outreach (cold calling, email, and LinkedIn)

• Qualify inbound leads from marketing and move them into active sales conversations

• Conduct discovery calls to assess fit and align on customer pain points and needs

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through strategic prospecting and market segmentation

• Collaborate with Marketing to optimize campaign follow-up and lead handoffs

Full-Cycle Sales Execution:

• Manage the entire sales process from discovery to proposal, negotiation, and close

• Deliver engaging product demonstrations and tailor the solution to customer requirements

• Build trusted relationships with legal, marketing, and compliance teams within target organizations

• Strategically pursue mid-market and enterprise accounts across regulated industries

• Provide accurate sales forecasting and CRM hygiene through HubSpot (or similar tools)

• Work closely with Customer Success and Product to ensure smooth onboarding and feedback sharing

Requirements

• 2+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, ideally with exposure to privacy, martech, or legaltech

• Demonstrated success in both outbound prospecting and closing new business

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts

• A consultative sales approach focused on value creation and long-term client success

• Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, SalesLoft, or similar CRM/Sales engagement platforms

• Self-starter with high accountability and a growth mindset

Benefits

BENEFITS INCLUDE

• 401K plan contribution

• Vacation days

• Health insurance

• Hybrid workplace

• Online yoga sessions

• Events - Team Buildings, happy hours, parties/get togethers, occasional company covered breakfasts/lunches, in/across offices, online/in person etc

• Gifts - We celebrate life & work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new bom babies and similar)

• Snacks, fruits, coffee and drinks in the office

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Usercentrics we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Why join Usercentrics?

• Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

• Company culture is important to us - we strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

• Get involved! We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all department enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

• Your work-life balance is important to us too - we offer flexible working hours, hybrid working and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

• We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our other office locations in Munich, Prague, Lisbon, Copenhagen, Odense and Buenos Aires or online

• You are the most valuable asset to our company which is why we're happy to offer awesome benefits

En SanCor Salud #EstoyDondeQuieroEstar

postings.title: Asesores/as Comerciales - Santa Rosa, La Pampa
postings.descriptionText:
La posición tiene como objetivo gestionar el proceso de comercialización de planes de salud, acompañando a potenciales clientes en todo el proceso de asesoramiento, con foco en la concreción de ventas y el cumplimiento de objetivos mensuales.

Buscamos perfiles con fuerte orientación comercial, habilidades de comunicación y vocación de servicio, que puedan brindar una experiencia de atención de calidad y excelencia.

• Modalidad de Contratación Relación de dependencia (sueldo básico + atractivo esquema de comisiones)

Principales responsabilidades

• Generar y gestionar contactos con potenciales clientes interesados en nuestros planes de salud.

• Asesorar de manera integral sobre las distintas opciones disponibles.

• Concretar ventas, asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos comerciales.

• Registrar y dar seguimiento a las oportunidades a través de CRM.

• Brindar atención y asesoramiento tanto a clientes externos como internos.

Requisitos

• Experiencia previa en ventas (preferentemente en servicios o intangibles).

• Manejo de herramientas digitales (CRM, celular, etc.).

• Perfil comercial con orientación a resultados.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y negociación.

• Proactividad, autonomía y capacidad de organización.

• Disponibilidad para trabajar por objetivos.

• Residir en Santa Rosa - La Pampa o zonas aledañas.

• Movilidad propia (deseable)

Beneficios

🎉 ¡Tu cumpleaños es tu día libre!

🏖 Vacaciones adicionales para que disfrutes más tiempo libre.

✨ Beneficio de guardería para apoyar a tu familia.

📚 Descuentos exclusivos en ofertas académicas para potenciar tu desarrollo profesional.

💰 Descuentos exclusivos en nuestro moderno centro deportivo.

Y muchos beneficios más 😁

Somos Mutual porque las personas están en el centro de nuestras

acciones. Nacimos para brindar un servicio de salud mutualista

para que el Socio cuente con cobertura médica sin diferenciación

por región, ni prestadores. Escuchando las necesidades del Socio

fuimos sumando servicios que promueven la educación, el bienestar

integral y el desarrollo de la comunidad.

Resolvemos las gestiones priorizando la innovación en la mejora

de los servicios, y la calidez en la atención. Por ello, cuidamos el

buen clima laboral, impulsando acciones que benefician la calidad

de vida de los colaboradores

postings.title: Appointment Setter (Real Estate Lead Follow-Up)
postings.descriptionText:
To apply, you will only have to fill a short form on our website that will take you less than 5 minutes.

Job Title: Appointment Setter (Real Estate Lead Follow-Up)

About The Company

Our client is a Southwest Florida real estate team that helps people buy and sell homes. They have a large database of leads that they want to use more effectively. They are looking for someone to build rapport with potential clients and book more meetings.

Job Description

Our client needs a dedicated Appointment Setter to follow up with their existing leads. You will make warm calls to people who are interested in buying or selling homes. Your main goal is to qualify these leads and book appointments for the real estate agents. You will use provided scripts and guides to have quality conversations. You will also keep detailed records of your calls and outcomes.

You will work with a daily list of about 50 leads through a restricted system. Success in this role means building rapport, booking meetings, and managing your leads effectively.

Responsibilities Of The Role

• Make warm calls to existing leads, including expired listings, for sale by owner properties, and pre-foreclosures.

postings.title: Account Executive (SMB SaaS)
postings.descriptionText:
About MyPlace
Hi! I'm the founder of MyPlace, the guest engagement platform for hospitality. MyPlace captures every guest automatically through WiFi and other touchpoints, then turns visits into five-star reviews and repeat business. We serve 500+ locations worldwide, mostly restaurants, bars, hotels, and entertainment venues in the US.

We're a small company. In 2023, we were accepted into the TinySeed accelerator program and raised seed funding. We're growing, our customers stay with us, and we're now making our first sales hire.

MyPlace is a fully remote company. This role is 100% remote, based in Latin America and working US hours. All internal meetings and customer calls happen online.

Why You Should Apply
This is a chance to join as team member #5 and our first Account Executive . You'll work directly with the founder and take over the sales conversations he runs today.

You won't start from zero. Leads are already coming in, we have a sales process in place, and the tools are built. Your job is to take ownership of the opportunities, run great sales conversations, and close deals.

You'll also help us improve the sales process as we grow. As you prove the model, we'll increase lead flow and build the sales team around you.

About the Role
We're looking for an experienced SMB Account Executive who loves selling over the phone, works fast, and knows how to close.

Our outbound email engine and SDR book meetings onto your calendar, while inbound demo requests and free trials come in every week. Your job is to run the calls, manage your pipeline, follow up, and close.

Our customers are restaurant owners, marketing managers, and operators. Plans start at $49 per location per month. Some deals are a single location, while others involve larger groups with multiple locations.

This is a high-volume, phone-first sales role. Many deals can close after a single 15–30 minute conversation, without ever needing a screenshare. Others require a focused demo, additional follow-ups, or conversations with multiple decision-makers.

You need to be comfortable with both. We want someone who can keep simple deals moving quickly, but also knows how to manage more involved opportunities without losing momentum.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities
There are four main parts to the role:

• Sales Conversations: Run 15–30 minute calls, primarily over the phone. Ask good questions, understand how the business operates, uncover problems worth solving, and explain how MyPlace can help. You'll need to be comfortable selling without a screen and confident asking for the sale when the customer is ready.

• Demos and Deal Management: Know when a conversation is enough and when a customer needs to see the product. Run focused screenshare demos when needed, handle objections, and work with multiple stakeholders on larger opportunities. Every deal is different, and you'll need to adapt your approach.

• Follow-Up and Closing: Establish clear next steps, send useful recap emails, and follow up by phone and email to keep opportunities moving. You'll own each deal from the first conversation through to a decision, rather than relying on prospects to come back to you.

• Pipeline and Handover: Manage a high volume of opportunities, keep our CRM (Attio) up to date, and hand won deals over to our onboarding lead. Our dialer, call notes, and AI-drafted follow-ups are already built to help you spend more time selling and less time on admin.

Requirements
You'll have the leads, process, and tools you need, along with weekly call reviews and direct coaching from the founder.

Here's what we're looking for:

• 2+ years of closing experience selling SaaS or other B2B solutions to small businesses, with responsibility for your own quota and pipeline.

• Strong phone-selling skills. You're confident running discovery, explaining value, handling objections, and closing deals without relying on a presentation or lengthy demo.

• Experience with high-volume, short-cycle sales. You're comfortable managing lots of smaller opportunities simultaneously and know how to keep deals moving quickly.

• Good commercial judgment. You can recognize when a customer is ready to buy, when they need a demo, and when a deal requires more conversations or decision-makers.

• Excellent follow-up habits. You don't let deals go quiet. You're proactive about booking next steps, following up, and getting decisions.

• Highly organized and process-driven. You keep your CRM current, manage your time well, and use technology and AI tools to work efficiently.

• Native or near-native English. You'll be speaking with US restaurant owners and operators every day.

• Coachable and open to feedback. You're comfortable reviewing your calls, learning from them, and continuously improving.

• Reliable, fast internet connection and a suitable remote working environment.

Nice to Haves

• Experience selling to restaurants, hospitality businesses, or other owner-operated local businesses.

• Experience selling both single-location and multi-location solutions.

• Based in a time zone that overlaps fully with US business hours.

• Strong SDRs looking to move into an AE role are welcome, provided you've already gained meaningful experience running sales conversations and closing your own deals.

• Experience selling an unknown product, at a small startup brand, in a competitive market

Benefits

• $3,000–$5,000 USD per month OTE, depending on experience.

• Fully remote, full-time, long-term role.

• Foundational position as our first Account Executive, working directly with the founder.

• Steady lead flow from inbound and outbound, with room to scale as you grow.

• Established sales process, dialer, CRM, and AI tools so you can focus on selling, not admin.

• Weekly coaching and call reviews to develop your skills.

• 20 days PTO.

How to Apply
We'd love to hear about your actual sales experience, not just read a résumé.

Along with your application, tell us a little about the types of customers you've sold to, the typical deal sizes and sales cycles you've managed, and how much of your selling was done over the phone.

We're especially interested in people who've consistently closed small-business deals through strong conversations, good follow-up, and a well-managed pipeline.

postings.title: GTM/ Sales - Sales Lead - Buenos Aires (Hybrid)
postings.descriptionText:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region's fastest-growing company. We're passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region's competitiveness. We're ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

We're looking for a Sales Lead to accelerate the growth of Clara Global and strengthen Clara's presence in Argentina. This is a strategic, hands-on Individual Contributor role that combines enterprise sales, business development, and market expansion. You'll be responsible for generating new business, closing high-value opportunities, and helping position Clara as a leading financial technology solution for companies operating across borders.

You'll work closely with our teams in Mexico to identify growth opportunities, develop the market, and build a scalable commercial pipeline.

In this role, you will:

• Own the end-to-end sales cycle for Clara Global, from prospecting and qualification to product demos, negotiation, and closing.

• Drive new business acquisition, identifying and engaging companies that can benefit from Clara's global reimbursement and financial solutions.

• Build and execute a strong outbound strategy, generating a high-quality pipeline through targeted prospecting, referrals, and multi-channel outreach.

• Develop relationships with CFOs, Finance Directors, HR leaders, and other key decision-makers, positioning Clara as a strategic partner.

• Help drive Clara's positioning and expansion in Argentina, identifying market opportunities, building strategic relationships, and increasing brand awareness within the business ecosystem.

• Identify opportunities within our existing customer base to drive product adoption, expansion, and Total Payment Volume (TPV).

• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product, Partnerships, and other teams to support go-to-market initiatives and accelerate growth.

• Bring valuable market insights, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to help refine Clara's commercial strategy and product positioning.

• Leverage AI and automation to improve prospecting, account research, outreach personalization, and sales productivity.

• Manage your pipeline and forecasts through HubSpot, using data to prioritize opportunities, track performance, and improve conversion.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

• 5+ years of experience in B2B Sales, Enterprise Sales, Account Executive, or Business Development roles, ideally within fintech, SaaS, payments, or financial services.

• Proven track record of generating pipeline, managing complex sales cycles, and consistently achieving commercial targets.

• Experience selling to C-level executives and senior decision-makers, particularly within Finance, HR, or Operations.

• Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Experience developing new markets, territories, or customer segments, with the ability to build opportunities from scratch.

• Strong understanding of B2B sales processes, pipeline management, and forecasting.

• Hands-on experience with HubSpot or similar CRMs, and prospecting tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Amplemarket, or Apollo.

• Experience using AI tools and automation to improve prospecting, productivity, or commercial workflows.

• Strong analytical mindset, high ownership, and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent communication skills in Spanish and English.

Nice to haves

• Experience selling cross-border payments, corporate financial solutions, expense management, or reimbursement products.

• Strong network within the Argentinian business, fintech, or technology ecosystem.

• Experience supporting go-to-market strategies, market expansion, or brand positioning.

• Experience working with multinational companies or customers with cross-border operations.

• Familiarity with AI and automation tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar platforms.

• Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL, or BI tools.

• Portuguese proficiency.

How we work in this territory

Argentina is an emerging territory for Clara — there's no office to go into, so this role works remotely from Argentina day to day. You'll ramp up in person with the team, and come together in person for team moments, events and customer visits through the year.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

• An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

• English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

• Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

• Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

• Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

• Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

• ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

• Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

postings.title: Key Account Manager (KAM)
postings.descriptionText:
En Grupo La Emilia seguimos transformando la movilidad. 🚀
Tras más de tres décadas de trayectoria e infraestructura industrial en el mercado de dos ruedas, estamos dando un paso clave en nuestra expansión con el desarrollo de nuestra División Automotriz (4 Ruedas) .
A través de Fleetone y alianzas estratégicas con marcas internacionales como Rely , Karry, de Chery Commercial Vehicle impulsamos la comercialización de vehículos utilitarios y comerciales en todo el país.

Para acompañar este crecimiento, buscamos sumar un/a Key Account Manager (KAM) a nuestro equipo de Nuevos Negocios.

¿De qué se trata el desafío?
Al tratarse de una unidad en pleno lanzamiento y expansión, buscamos un/a profesional que asuma un rol protagónico en la estructuración, prospección y escalabilidad de la cartera comercial.
Trabajarás codo a codo con la Gerencia Comercial en la estrategia B2B, articulando sinergias con Posventa, Logística y Marketing para consolidar relaciones comerciales de largo plazo con cuentas clave y redes de distribución.

Responsabilidades Principales

• Liderar la prospección, desarrollo y fidelización de cuentas estratégicas a nivel nacional.

• Diseñar y ejecutar la planificación comercial (mensual, trimestral y anual) para alcanzar las metas de volumen y rentabilidad.

• Expandir la red territorial de clientes de acuerdo con la estrategia de cada marca.

• Acompañar la gestión comercial 360°: desde la negociación de acuerdos y capacitaciones técnicas, hasta el seguimiento de cuentas corrientes y garantías.

Requisitos del Perfil

• Experiencia (Excluyente): Trayectoria comercial comprobable en terminales automotrices, redes de concesionarios/agencias o empresas importadoras del sector automotor .

• Formación: Lic. en Comercialización, Administración, Marketing o carreras afines (deseable).

• Herramientas: Dominio de herramientas de gestión y datos (PowerBI, Excel avanzado, Google Suite y deseable SAP).

Habilidades Clave para el Éxito en el Rol

• Negociación B2B e Interlocución Multinivel:

• Visión Estratégica y Negocio 360°:

• Autonomía y Resiliencia en Entornos de Lanzamiento:

• Articulación y Trabajo Interdisciplinario

• Análisis Comercial y Orientación a Datos: Capacidad para analizar métricas de ventas, márgenes y potencial de zona (vía Excel/PowerBI) para tomar decisiones estratégicas basadas en datos.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
La oportunidad de poner tu sello en el desarrollo de una nueva unidad de negocios respaldada por la solidez y estructura de un grupo nacional líder, en un esquema de trabajo flexible (Remoto / Clientes / Casa Central).

postings.title: Asesor de Venta Técnica
postings.descriptionText:
ASESOR/A DE VENTA TÉCNICA

OBJETIVO GENERAL DEL CARGO

Responsable por el cumplimiento de las ventas, promoción y trabajo de campo de la terapia / zona a su cargo. Debe conocer en profundidad la línea de negocios a su cargo, el mercado, y diferenciación de los productos y servicios que ofrece.

FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES

• Venta técnica especializada: 100% orientado a detectar, desarrollar y convertir oportunidades en ventas incrementales dentro de su grupo de terapia o indicación.

• Trabajo colaborativo con Ejecutivos de cuenta y distribuidores: actúa como socio estratégico aportando expertise técnico para acelerar cierres y visibilizar nuevos negocios.

• Interacción continua con profesionales de la salud: Construye y fortalece relaciones con referentes clínicos para asegurar la adopción y el crecimiento de la terapia.

• Identificación y conversión de oportunidades: Realiza scouting técnico-comercial a nivel nacional o regional según la terapia, priorizando cuentas con mayor potencial.

• Diseño e implementación de proyectos comerciales: Elabora proyectos que permitan abrir nuevas líneas de negocio e implementa soluciones directamente en los clientes.

• Enfoque por especialidad: Domina la terapia correspondiente para posicionar el portafolio con mayor profundidad.

• Desarrollo de negocios de mayor complejidad: Aporta el análisis técnico y visión a largo plazo, respondiendo a las necesidades de mercado para lograr la capilaridad esperada para nuestros productos.

• Participación en eventos: promociona en Congresos y Jornadas el uso de los productos de la terapia asignada.

REQUISITOS

ACADÉMICOS: Profesional graduado de las carreras de Ingeniería Biomédica, licenciatura en instrumentación quirúrgica, carreras afines.

EXPERIENCIA LABORAL: De 2 a 4 años de experiencia en Empresas de Medical Devices, preferentemente del rubro de Implantes.

IDIOMAS: Inglés nivel intermedio

Otros Conocimientos

• Experiencia trabajando con financiadores y en la gestión de distribuidores (excluyente)

• Experiencia en quirofano (excluyente)

• Será un plus conocimiento del mercado de neurocirugía.

postings.title: Forex, Futures, Stocks Sales Broker
postings.descriptionText:
Tradeview Markets is looking for intelligent, positive, and adaptive hard workers to join our growing global sales force. If you surpass your goals and are proud of it, the rewards will be unlimited. We offer our global account executives an unparalleled opportunity to operate in a fast pace international sales environment where ambition is rewarded, and we are all business builders. If you have the confidence and hustle to open and close business, we encourage you to apply for a role in our fast-growing company. Another tremendous plus to this position is that you can work from your home or home office (in certain regions).

Are you a person who prides yourself in creatively solving problems and "Owning the outcome" to deliver results for your stakeholders? If you are this person, this position will provide an unlimited rewarding experience with unlimited earning potential and an exciting future for professional growth in our firm. This is central to our global operations and you will receive the resources, tools and team support to have unlimited success.

Tradeview Markets is an equal opportunity employer, looking for energetic Forex, Futures, On Exchange Equities, Options and CFD global Account Executives with at least 2 years' experience and knowledge of Forex, Futures, On Exchange Equities, Options and CFD products as well as MT4, MT5, cTrader or equivalent trading platform knowledge. The successful Account Executive will have a strong focus on the retail Forex industry but must also be able to serve Tradeview’s other markets. Qualified individuals will be selling a broad range of financial products and services to a diverse international client base and will have their own book of clients. Previous industry experience is a must.

Desired Skills & Experience

• Do you have a proven sales track record?

• Are you coachable?

• Do you look for solutions vs excuses?

• Are you an amazing communicator with the power to influence people?

• Are you a go-getter?

Are you hungry for success? Are you passionate? Outcome/mission oriented?
Are you saying “YES! This is me!” That’s a good start. The ideal person for this job is a sales professional of the highest caliber. They have the perfect balance of ego and empathy.
They don’t JUST close, they build a relationship and sustain a future.

As an account executive, one can only succeed if you are a quick learner and dynamic. Our deals are not simple, and our customer expectations are very high. You have to be able to follow the transaction all the way from its opening to its final destination each and every time.

Minimum Qualifications

• Drive to succeed.

• Willing to travel.

• Sales skills and previous experience in the Forex, CFD or Financial Industry is a must, preferably someone with the book of Foreign Introducing Brokers, Money Managers, and customers.

• Knowledge/Skills/Competencies are required as well as a minimum two years of experience.

• Ability to thrive in a challenging and collaborative sales environment that is fast-paced and subject to frequent change and to work effectively as a member of a team and share best practices, as well as a strong individual contributor.

• Knowledge of the organization's operations, products and services.

• Established skills with software used (PowerPoint, Windows, and customer relationship management software) on a day-to-day basis.

• Keeping abreast of the industry, the competition, and related products.

• Self-disciplined, self-motivated - requires minimum supervision, well organized with good follow-up skills.

• Stay on top of the local and national economy and financial markets activity.

Preferred Qualifications

• Knowledge of and established relationships within the forex industry

• Knowledge of traditional as well as contemporary B2B sales tactics and strategy.

• A deep understanding of the industry’s issues, a vision for its growth and a commitment to advance Tradeview Forex strategies within the marketplace

• Fluency in another language is a plus.

“Must Have” Experience, Skills and Personal Qualities
Experience in the Forex industry (retail markets).
Knowledge/Skills/Competencies are required as well as minimum two years of experience
Sales skills and previous experience in Forex, Futures, On Exchange Equities, Options and CFD products as well as MT4/MT5, cTrader or equivalent trading platform knowledge is a must. The ideal candidate must have a book of Foreign Introducing Brokers, Money Managers, and customers.

Ability to thrive in a challenging and collaborative sales environment that is fast-paced and subject to frequent change and to work effectively as a member of a team and share best practices, as well as a strong individual contributor.
Knowledge of the Company’s operations, products, and services.

Company Description
Tradeview Markets was established in 2004 with a vision: To provide unmatched online trading solutions to a broad range of traders and investors from around the world. We are more than just a brokerage, Tradeview gives its clients the latest trading technology, flexibility, and personal support with our cultivated team of industry professionals. This means 24-hour trade support and streamlined administrative procedures to ensure your needs are met with speed and accuracy.
Over 20,000 Trading Accounts
Over 100 White Labels
Multiple Trading Platforms
Offices Worldwide

Tradeview Markets is recognized as one of the fastest growing Forex Brokers with a focus on customer service and lightning-fast execution. Tradeview is in a phase of constant growth. Customers of Tradeview Markets benefit from super low spreads to flexible Leverage and commission pay-outs. Tradeview Markets works to support customers in all of their needs. Below are some the reasons customers choose Tradeview.

• Fully regulated & authorized by CIMA, the MFSA, LSFA, SCA (UAE) and Financial Services Commission of Mauritius.

• Truly Global presence, with offices and representatives worldwide.

• Complete Protection of client funds with segregated accounts at Tier 1 banks.

• Forex, Futures, Stocks, Options and CFDs products offerings.

• MT4, MT5, Rhino Trader (Interactive Broker) and cTrader trading platforms.

• Mobile Trading.

• Best-of-market spreads from 0 pips

Our Team

Identifique y responda a las necesidades de los responsables de la toma de decisiones departamentales y técnicas de cuentas clave y mantenga registros de contacto con los clientes en las herramientas de CRM relevantes.

• Desarrollar y mejorar continuamente una red de líderes de opinión clave dentro del territorio asignado.

• Trabajar con los equipos comerciales para priorizar cuentas, organizar visitas y desarrollar oportunidades en Argentina y los demás países asignados.

• Experiencia en productos y mercados

• Mantener actualizado un conocimiento detallado de las soluciones de upgrades, principalmente de Resonancia Magnética, Tomografía y Rayos X.

• Presentar los beneficios técnicos, clínicos y financieros de las actualizaciones tecnológicas en términos relevantes para cada cliente.

• Mantener actualizado el conocimiento del mercado y de la competencia relacionado con sus soluciones/servicios.

• Actualizar continuamente su comprensión de los problemas y desafíos clínicos y/o operativos cambiantes de los clientes.

• Diseñar configuraciones viables que modernicen los equipos, extiendan su vida útil y mantengan un margen óptimo para GE.

• Representar a la empresa en conferencias médicas y exposiciones técnicas relevantes para promover el producto / solución y la empresa.

• Identificar y crear nuevas oportunidades y trabajar con los líderes de ventas y los equipos de cuentas (cuando corresponda) para aumentar continuamente el embudo de clientes potenciales.

• Estimar la fecha de entrega al cliente con base en el conocimiento de los programas de producción y entrega de la compañía, asegurando que el cumplimiento del pedido esté de acuerdo con las expectativas del cliente y mejore la satisfacción del cliente.

postings.title: Account Manager - Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
Account Manager – Argentina
Location: Greater Buenos Aires, Argentina
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Model: Hybrid, with regular travel within Argentina

About Sigenergy
Sigenergy develops intelligent solar, energy storage and EV charging solutions for residential, commercial and industrial applications. Our technologies integrate energy storage, power electronics, digital platforms and artificial intelligence to deliver safe, efficient and user-friendly energy solutions.We are looking for a results-oriented Account Manager to help launch and grow Sigenergy’s business in Argentina.

The Role
The Account Manager will be responsible for developing customers, channel partners and a qualified sales pipeline across Argentina. This is a hands-on business-development position for someone who understands the local solar and energy market and can convert relationships into orders and sustainable partnerships.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and develop distributors, wholesalers, EPC companies, installers, integrators and strategic customers.
- Build and manage a qualified pipeline across residential, commercial and industrial segments.
- Achieve agreed sales, revenue and partner-development targets.
- Conduct customer visits, product presentations, commercial negotiations and partner reviews.
- Develop key accounts and establish long-term relationships with decision-makers.
- Support partner onboarding, training, product launches and joint marketing activities.
- Work closely with technical teams to develop appropriate solutions for customer requirements.
- Prepare quotations, commercial proposals, forecasts and regular pipeline reports.
- Monitor competitors, pricing, market trends and customer feedback.
- Support payment collection and manage commercial risk within company policies.
- Represent Sigenergy at trade shows, conferences and customer events.

Qualifications
- At least four years of successful B2B sales or business-development experience.
- Relevant experience in solar PV, energy storage, inverters, electrical equipment or related technologies.
- Demonstrable sales results and experience developing customers in Argentina.
- Existing relationships with distributors, EPCs, installers or energy-sector customers are strongly preferred.
- Ability to understand technical products and translate their value into commercial benefits.
- Strong prospecting, negotiation, account-management and closing skills.
- Self-motivated, structured and comfortable working in a market-entry environment.
- Native or fluent Spanish and professional working proficiency in English.
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business or a related field is preferred.
- Availability to travel regularly within Argentina.

What We Offer
- The opportunity to play a central role in launching Sigenergy in Argentina.
- An innovative and competitive clean-energy product portfolio.
- Direct exposure to regional and global teams.
- Career growth based on demonstrated results and leadership potential.
- Competitive compensation with performance-based sales incentives.
If you know Argentina’s solar and energy ecosystem and enjoy creating business from the ground up, we would like to hear from you.

Gerente de Ventas – Argentina
Ubicación: Gran Buenos Aires, Argentina
Modalidad de contratación: Tiempo completo
Modalidad de trabajo: Híbrida, con viajes frecuentes dentro de Argentina

Acerca de Sigenergy
Sigenergy desarrolla soluciones inteligentes de energía solar, almacenamiento y carga de vehículos eléctricos para aplicaciones residenciales, comerciales e industriales. Nuestras tecnologías integran almacenamiento, electrónica de potencia, plataformas digitales e inteligencia artificial para ofrecer soluciones energéticas seguras, eficientes y fáciles de utilizar.
Buscamos un Gerente de Ventas orientado a resultados para contribuir al lanzamiento y crecimiento de Sigenergy en Argentina.

El rol
La persona seleccionada será responsable de desarrollar clientes, canales comerciales y un pipeline de oportunidades calificadas en Argentina. Es una posición práctica de ventas y desarrollo de negocios para alguien que conozca el mercado solar y energético local y pueda convertir relaciones en pedidos y alianzas sostenibles.

Responsabilidades principales
- Identificar y desarrollar distribuidores, mayoristas, empresas EPC, instaladores, integradores y clientes estratégicos.
- Construir y gestionar un pipeline calificado en los segmentos residencial, comercial e industrial.
- Cumplir los objetivos acordados de ventas, ingresos y desarrollo de socios.
- Realizar visitas comerciales, presentaciones de producto, negociaciones y revisiones de negocio con los socios.
- Desarrollar cuentas clave y relaciones de largo plazo con sus responsables de decisión.
- Apoyar la incorporación y capacitación de socios, lanzamientos de producto y acciones conjuntas de marketing.
- Trabajar con los equipos técnicos para desarrollar soluciones adecuadas a las necesidades de cada cliente.
- Preparar cotizaciones, propuestas comerciales, pronósticos de ventas e informes periódicos del pipeline.
- Monitorear competidores, precios, tendencias de mercado y feedback de los clientes.
- Colaborar en la gestión de cobranzas y riesgos comerciales de acuerdo con las políticas de la empresa.
- Representar a Sigenergy en ferias, conferencias y eventos con clientes.
Requisitos
- Al menos cuatro años de experiencia exitosa en ventas B2B o desarrollo de negocios.
- Experiencia relevante en energía solar, almacenamiento, inversores, equipamiento eléctrico o tecnologías relacionadas.
- Resultados comerciales demostrables y experiencia desarrollando clientes en Argentina.
- Se valorará especialmente contar con relaciones existentes con distribuidores, EPCs, instaladores o clientes del sector energético.
- Capacidad para comprender productos técnicos y traducir sus características en beneficios comerciales.
- Sólidas habilidades de prospección, negociación, gestión de cuentas y cierre de ventas.
- Autonomía, organización y comodidad para trabajar en una etapa de entrada al mercado.
- Español nativo o fluido e inglés profesional.
- Se valorará formación universitaria en ingeniería, negocios o una disciplina relacionada.
- Disponibilidad para viajar regularmente dentro de Argentina.

Qué ofrecemos
- La oportunidad de desempeñar un papel central en el lanzamiento de Sigenergy en Argentina.
- Un portafolio innovador y competitivo de soluciones de energía limpia.
- Colaboración directa con equipos regionales y globales.
- Desarrollo profesional basado en resultados y potencial de liderazgo.
- Incentivos competitivos asociados al desempeño.
Si conocés el ecosistema solar y energético argentino y te motiva desarrollar un negocio desde su etapa inicial, nos gustaría conocerte.

About the Role

We're looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Compliance Operations Coordinator to support Postscript's Compliance team. In this role, you'll provide the operational foundation for our compliance audit program by coordinating documentation, tracking audit progress, managing deliverables, and ensuring effective communication across internal stakeholders.
You'll partner closely with Compliance Specialists to keep audits organized, accurate, and on schedule. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in process-driven environments, takes pride in precision, and is interested in building expertise in compliance operations within a fast-growing technology company.

What You'll Do
Audit Documentation & Coordination

• Collect, organize, and maintain audit documentation, including screenshots of opt-in experiences and other merchant-facing compliance elements, using internal tools and manual processes as needed.

• Create and manage structured Google Drive folders for each audit engagement, ensuring documentation is clearly labeled, accessible, and current.

• Prepare and maintain audit materials using standardized templates to ensure consistency and accuracy across all engagements.

• Review audits against established checklists, identify missing information or discrepancies, and escalate findings to the assigned Compliance Specialist.

• Support audit execution by ensuring all required documentation and deliverables are completed on time.

Customer Deliverables & Reporting

• Create clear, professional audit outcome reports and presentations based on findings provided by the Compliance Specialist team.

• Ensure customer-facing materials meet Postscript's quality standards for accuracy, organization, and presentation.

• Maintain version control and proper filing of finalized audit deliverables and supporting documentation.

Communication & Project Support

• Coordinate with internal teams to initiate audits, gather required information, and drive completion of outstanding action items.

• Track progress across active audit engagements and proactively communicate delays, blockers, or at-risk items.

• Serve as a primary point of contact for routine audit-related inquiries, escalating more complex questions to the appropriate Compliance Specialist.

• Help maintain visibility into audit timelines, priorities, and deliverable status.

Process Improvement

• Execute established audit workflows and procedures with a high degree of accuracy and consistency.

• Identify process gaps, documentation issues, or workflow inefficiencies and escalate recommendations for improvement.

• Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of audit templates, tracking systems, documentation standards, and operational processes as the team grows.

What We're Looking For
Required Qualifications

• Minimum 3 years of experience in an operations coordinator, administrative support, project coordination, or similar role.

• Experience in SaaS, ecommerce, compliance, legal operations, or a related environment is a plus.

• Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.

• Proficiency with Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Slides, and Sheets), including managing documentation and folder structures at scale.

• Strong written communication skills with the ability to draft professional emails and follow-up communications for internal and external stakeholders.

• Comfortable working within structured processes, checklists, and workflows while proactively identifying issues and escalating when appropriate.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and maintain visibility across several ongoing projects.

• Quick learner who is comfortable adopting new tools and navigating web-based platforms to gather and organize information.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience creating customer-facing presentations in Google Slides or Microsoft PowerPoint with strong formatting and visual organization skills.

• Familiarity with compliance, legal, regulatory, risk, or audit-related functions.

• Experience in a customer-facing support, onboarding, account coordination, or operations role.

• Experience working successfully within a remote or distributed team environment.

postings.title: Operations Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description: Operations Coordinator OPERATIONS COORDINATOR
at AtlasBrands | Remote - Worldwide

About AtlasBrands We’re building and scaling high-velocity DTC brands. In just a few months, we scaled from $0 to $3M MRR and from a team of 3 to a team of ~30. We’re now pushing toward 9 figures — and building a world-class team of A+ talent that can support, sustain, and accelerate that level of growth. At this stage, growth is no longer just about products or marketing. It’s about people. The next phase of this company will be defined by who we bring in — the quality of talent, the speed at which we hire, and the systems we build around it.
Role Objective We are seeking a highly organized, proactive Operations Coordinator to serve as the direct right hand to our Head of Operations & Finance. In this role, you will act as the operational glue that keeps our logistics, supply chain, back-office finance, and legal documentation running flawlessly.
This position requires a rare blend of extreme attention to detail and radical resourcefulness. You will own the follow-through on complex workflows, ensuring data never slips through the cracks and tasks keep moving seamlessly across international vendors and cross-functional teams.
What You’ll Do
• Supply Chain & Logistics Execution: Stay entirely on top of high-volume order fulfillment, global shipments, and proactive inventory follow-ups. Own daily communications with our suppliers and third-party fulfillment (3PL) partners to guarantee seamless operational loops.

• Finance & Payroll Support: Administer critical back-office operations including tracking vendor invoices, reconciling operational expenses, and preparing payroll or vendor payments for final executive approval.

• Legal Coordination & Compliance: Serve as the internal traffic controller for legal workflows. Coordinate contract routing, secure digital signatures, organize corporate documentation, and manage ongoing follow-ups with our external legal counsel.

• Data Architecture & Tracker Governance: Build, optimize, and ruthlessly maintain project trackers. Ensure data integrity across multiple systems so that leadership has absolute visibility into inventory, timelines, and legal statuses.

• Independent Problem Solving: Act as an internal investigator. When a shipment delays or an invoice mismatches, you will independently research the root cause, propose practical solutions, and see the fix through to completion with minimal oversight.

Required Skills and Qualifications
• Experience: Proven track record in an operations, logistics, or project coordination role—ideally within a fast-moving e-commerce or startup environment.

• Data & Technical Tools: High proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets. You must be entirely comfortable working with complex formulas, large datasets, and rigorous data reconciliations.

• Execution & Follow-Through: Elite organizational skills. A natural ability to manage multiple moving parts simultaneously without losing momentum or dropping details.

• Communication & Drive: Exceptional written and verbal English communication. You are a proactive, zero-friction communicator who knows how to get answers from global vendors and internal team members alike.

• Mindset: A resourceful "finder of answers." You don't just point out operational roadblocks—you dig into the details, suggest structural solutions, and take pride in total ownership.

Working Hours & Culture
• Role Timeline: Full-time hire (~40 hours per week).

• Async-First: Global, remote-first team setup requiring core daily overlap with US EST business hours for team syncs and cross-functional alignment. For offshore hires, you must be willing to overlap at least 4+ EST hours (between 9am–5pm EST).

How to Apply & What to Expect At AtlasBrands, we value your time and expertise, which is why we’ve built a streamlined, highly transparent interview process designed to look for a true partner rather than a transactional contributor.
Here is exactly how our application workflow operates through our platform:

• Step 1: Submit Your CV
Click the "Apply Now" button below to submit your CV along with a brief overview of the operational systems or inventory trackers you have managed.

• Step 2: Initial Screening & Video Intro
Our recruiting team will conduct a brief initial screening call to evaluate your communication style, structural organization frameworks, and problem-solving agility.

• Step 3: Paid Assessment
Complete a paid operational or data assessment that the hiring team will use to assess core skills and determine final steps.

• Step 4: The 45-Minute Strategic Deep Dive
Selected candidates will join two members of our leadership team for 45-minute conversational interviews.

No third party or agency submissions will be accepted.
AtlasBrands is an equal opportunity employer.

postings.title: Associate Operations Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Overview Of Position

The Associate Operations Analyst supports client and community onboarding for Assurant’s Renters business, helping move requests from intake through production launch. In this role, you will configure information across internal systems, coordinate with Business, Operations, and IT partners, test solutions, troubleshoot issues, and help ensure each implementation is accurate and delivered on time.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional who is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and interested in developing skills across operations, systems, testing, analytics, and stakeholder management.

What makes us different?

• Your work has direct business impact: faster, accurate onboarding helps communities go live and supports premium growth.

• You will gain cross-functional exposure by partnering with Business, Operations, IT/development, and Global Housing leaders.

• You will receive structured, hands-on training from the manager and experienced team members.

• You can build practical experience with operational analytics, testing, troubleshooting, process improvement, and production support.

• You will join a collaborative team that encourages questions, recognizes improvement ideas, and supports long-term career development within Assurant.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

• Support the end-to-end onboarding of clients and communities, from request intake through production launch.

• Review onboarding requests and accurately configure community and client information across multiple internal systems and applications.

• Manage tickets, priorities, and deliverables while meeting service-level expectations and escalating risks or blockers early.

• Partner with Business, Operations, IT/development, and other internal teams to clarify requirements and resolve implementation or production issues.

• Perform user acceptance testing, regression testing, peer reviews, audits, and maintenance activities to support high-quality launches.

• Troubleshoot service and system issues, identify root causes, recommend solutions, and coordinate timely resolution.

• Maintain clear documentation and status updates, and contribute to onboarding reporting for leadership.

• Participate in daily team huddles, training, knowledge sharing, and continuous-improvement initiatives.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

• Up to 2 years of relevant professional experience in operations, implementation, production support, business analysis, systems support, quality assurance, or a related environment. Equivalent internship or early-career experience will be considered.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with US-based and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Excellent attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple requests in a high-volume environment.

• Strong computer literacy and working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel.

• Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and communicate recommended actions.

• Ability to work with urgency, maintain accuracy under deadlines, and take ownership of tasks through completion.

• Ability to learn new systems, applications, processes, and technical concepts quickly.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

• A bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Operations, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Exposure to SQL, Postman, SOAP UI, system integrations, APIs, or application-support tools.

• Experience with user acceptance testing, regression testing, requirements documentation, ticket management, or production support.

• Experience in insurance, insurtech, financial services, property-management technology, SaaS, shared services, or another technology-enabled operational environment.

• Experience working with performance measures, service-level agreements, operational KPIs, standard operating procedures, or process-improvement initiatives.

• A collaborative mindset, curiosity, adaptability, and confidence asking questions or escalating issues when needed.

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?

General office demands. This Argentina-based position supports a US business team and requires schedule alignment with US operating hours. The final work arrangement and specific schedule will be communicated during the recruiting process.

If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Helping People Thrive in a Connected World

Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we’ll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at jobs.assurant.com.

What’s the culture like at Assurant?

Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

Company Overview

Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

AI and Biometric Usage

Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.

Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant’s privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Assurant is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not use or consider race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in employment decisions.

Job Scam Alert

Please be aware that during Assurant's application process, we will never ask for personal information such as your Social Security number, bank account details, or passwords. Learn more about what to look out for and how to report a scam here.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.
As a Prime Operations Assistant on the Custody Product Ops team within Institutional , you'll support the operational workflows that keep Coinbase's token management platform running for Prime customers. This team manages the full billing lifecycle, contract operations, customer onboarding, and token distributions for crypto-native teams, protocol foundations, and institutional clients. You'll execute established processes across revenue, contract, customer, and token operations, maintaining the accuracy and reliability that Prime customers depend on.
What you'll do:

• Reconcile billing and subscription records, investigate discrepancies, and coordinate collections follow-up to maintain accurate revenue operations across the Prime customer base.

• Manage MSA intake and agreement workflows through Ironclad, track signatures and renewals, and maintain complete contract records for all active accounts.

• Coordinate TLS and Vesting Platform onboarding for new customers, triage Pylon inboxes, and deliver timely communications throughout the customer lifecycle.

• Prepare token distributions, support grant setup and M2M migrations, and execute controlled lockup coverage in accordance with documented approval requirements.

• Maintain SOPs, reporting methodology, and canonical operational datasets, flagging opportunities for automation and escalating policy questions to designated owners.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 1+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, contract administration, or customer operations within financial services, fintech, or digital assets.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent workflows with consistent accuracy, including billing reconciliation, subscription tracking, and record maintenance.

• Hands-on experience with operational tooling such as Ironclad, Pylon, CRM platforms, or subscription billing systems.

• Familiarity with KPI tracking, data hygiene practices, and documented controls sufficient to maintain reporting across revenue and customer metrics.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Overview Of Position

The Associate Operations Analyst supports client and community onboarding for Assurant’s Renters business, helping move requests from intake through production launch. In this role, you will configure information across internal systems, coordinate with Business, Operations, and IT partners, test solutions, troubleshoot issues, and help ensure each implementation is accurate and delivered on time.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional who is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and interested in developing skills across operations, systems, testing, analytics, and stakeholder management.

What makes us different?

• Your work has direct business impact: faster, accurate onboarding helps communities go live and supports premium growth.

• You will gain cross-functional exposure by partnering with Business, Operations, IT/development, and Global Housing leaders.

• You will receive structured, hands-on training from the manager and experienced team members.

• You can build practical experience with operational analytics, testing, troubleshooting, process improvement, and production support.

• You will join a collaborative team that encourages questions, recognizes improvement ideas, and supports long-term career development within Assurant.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

• Support the end-to-end onboarding of clients and communities, from request intake through production launch.

• Review onboarding requests and accurately configure community and client information across multiple internal systems and applications.

• Manage tickets, priorities, and deliverables while meeting service-level expectations and escalating risks or blockers early.

• Partner with Business, Operations, IT/development, and other internal teams to clarify requirements and resolve implementation or production issues.

• Perform user acceptance testing, regression testing, peer reviews, audits, and maintenance activities to support high-quality launches.

• Troubleshoot service and system issues, identify root causes, recommend solutions, and coordinate timely resolution.

• Maintain clear documentation and status updates, and contribute to onboarding reporting for leadership.

• Participate in daily team huddles, training, knowledge sharing, and continuous-improvement initiatives.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

• Up to 2 years of relevant professional experience in operations, implementation, production support, business analysis, systems support, quality assurance, or a related environment. Equivalent internship or early-career experience will be considered.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with US-based and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Excellent attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple requests in a high-volume environment.

• Strong computer literacy and working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel.

• Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and communicate recommended actions.

• Ability to work with urgency, maintain accuracy under deadlines, and take ownership of tasks through completion.

• Ability to learn new systems, applications, processes, and technical concepts quickly.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

• A bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Operations, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Exposure to SQL, Postman, SOAP UI, system integrations, APIs, or application-support tools.

• Experience with user acceptance testing, regression testing, requirements documentation, ticket management, or production support.

• Experience in insurance, insurtech, financial services, property-management technology, SaaS, shared services, or another technology-enabled operational environment.

• Experience working with performance measures, service-level agreements, operational KPIs, standard operating procedures, or process-improvement initiatives.
