postings.title: AI-Supercharged Executive Assistant
postings.descriptionText:
This is a remote position.
Rockstar is hiring an AI-Supercharged Executive Assistant to support U.S.-based healthcare practice owners on a full-time remote basis. This is a new role at Rockstar. It's built for an experienced executive assistant who wants to run AI inside a real business, and who knows that the tool is only as good as the person operating it.

In this role, you'll own the owner's calendar, inbox, tasks, and daily follow-through, working in a Claude AI environment built specifically for that practice. Claude drafts. You review, decide, and send. The practice owner never touches the technology. You'll get structured Claude training from your first week, weekly coaching with Rockstar's role lead, and a community of other EAs doing the same work.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Calendar & Scheduling

• Manage the owner's calendar with consistent color coding, time blocking, and protected focus time

• Confirm every meeting's time, attendees, link, and purpose at least 24 hours in advance

• Use Claude's calendar connector to prepare daily and weekly calendar summaries, then check them against the real calendar before they go out

• Coordinate personal appointments and travel where the placement includes it

Inbox & Communication

• Triage the inbox daily: handle routine items, draft what needs the owner's voice, and escalate what needs their decision

• Draft outbound email through Claude in the practice's brand voice and review every draft before sending

• Follow a defined escalation matrix with set response windows for urgent, same-day, and routine items

• Acknowledge email within 4 business hours and flag anything urgent to the owner within 30 minutes

Tasks, Projects, Meetings & Reporting

• Keep one task tracker current every day, covering every commitment, owner, and deadline

• Coordinate projects across the owner, staff, and vendors, breaking them into clear steps and tracking milestones through to completion

• Build meeting agendas in Claude from what's open on the tracker

• Create presentations and slide decks for the owner's meetings, trainings, and partner conversations

• Turn meeting notetaker transcripts into same-day recaps with action items assigned to the right people

• Deliver a Daily Summary and Weekly Summary so the owner never has to ask what happened

• Pull reports from the practice's CRM, EMR, or spreadsheets and spot-check the numbers before they go anywhere

Practice Coordination & Administrative Support

• Follow up with patients and clients after interactions and close the loop

• Support referrals, waitlists, and scheduling-related workflows

• Handle invoices, PTO tracking, vendor coordination, and compliance reminders

• Write and maintain SOPs for recurring work

• For practices that include it, monitor social platforms and Google and Yelp reviews, and draft responses for the owner's approval

Claude Environment

• Keep the practice's brand voice file current as the practice changes

• Bring real drafts to weekly coaching calls and refine the environment based on what's working

• Maintain strict HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality at all times. Claude never contacts a patient or staff member without your review

Requirements

Required

• Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or similar role supporting a business owner or leader

• Hands-on experience using AI tools for real work

• Strong project coordination and task management skills, with a track record of moving work from assigned to done

• Excellent time management and the ability to prioritize competing deadlines without dropping anything

• Strong presentation skills, including building clear, polished slide decks

• Excellent written English. You'll review and send communication in a business owner's voice every day

• Strong judgment about what to handle on your own and what to escalate

• Comfort working in Google Workspace or Microsoft 365

• Ability to work independently and keep steady communication with the practice owner

• Willingness to complete Rockstar's confidentiality and compliance training before your start date

• Reliable home office setup with a stable internet connection suitable for HIPAA-compliant remote work

Preferred

• Experience with ChatGPT and Claude

• Experience in the healthcare industry, especially outpatient practices such as physical therapy, occupational therapy, or speech therapy

• Experience with Canva

• Familiarity with HIPAA and handling patient information

• Familiarity with EMR platforms such as Prompt, WebPT, or Raintree, or CRMs such as HubSpot or Zoho

• Experience with project management tools such as Asana or Monday.com

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

• Judgment: you know what to handle, what to draft, and what to escalate, and you don't escalate out of caution

• Follow-through: if it's not written down and tracked, it isn't handled. You close every loop

• Discretion: you handle the owner's information and patients' information with care, and only share it with the people who need it

• Curiosity: you want to get better at running AI, and you bring real drafts and real questions to coaching every week

• Ownership: you never send a draft you haven't read. Claude makes you faster. You make it correct

Benefits

• Competitive salary based on experience

• Structured Claude training, including connectors, reporting, meeting summaries, and agenda building

• Weekly one-on-one coaching with Rockstar's role lead

• A private community of EAs in this role to share what's working and solve problems together

• Access to Rockstar's playbooks and VA Academy for long-term career growth

• Stable, full-time remote work with U.S.-based healthcare practices

postings.title: Executive Assistant (Inflection Club)
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Inflection Club is a private co-investment community for accredited investors, operators, and family offices who want direct access to pre-IPO deals in the companies shaping the future. Built under Catalyst Capital Holdings, we provide curated access from early to late-stage opportunities that traditionally only flow to endowments, pension funds, and institutional allocators - names like Anthropic, Polymarket, Kraken, and Lovable.

Our thesis is simple: the biggest returns of the next decade will come from companies built on the cost curves of artificial intelligence, robotics, longevity, and next-generation infrastructure. Every deal goes through institutional-grade diligence and is executed as a Reg D 506(c) SPV. No blind pools. No lock-ups. Just rigorous deal flow, presented with conviction.

The Role

The Executive Assistant supports the Director of Community & Operations and the Director of Investments - the two leaders who run the member experience and the investment engine. You will own their calendars, inboxes, follow-ups, and meeting logistics so they spend their time on members and deals, not on coordination.

This is not an order-taking role. We need someone who anticipates what each Director needs next, keeps projects moving without being chased, and protects their time with sound judgment. You will work across both seats, balancing competing priorities and surfacing conflicts early. You will handle confidential member and deal information with complete discretion.

You are not the decision-maker on investments, member policy, or legal matters. You are the person who makes sure the people who decide are prepared, on time, and never dropping a thread.

What You'll Own

• Calendar & Inbox Management

• Manage both Directors' calendars: scheduling, prioritizing, resolving conflicts, and protecting focus time

• Triage inboxes: draft replies, flag what needs a decision, and close loops on follow-ups

• Coordinate across time zones with members, founders, co-investors, and counsel

• Meeting & Roundtable Support

• Prepare agendas, briefing notes, and materials ahead of Investment Committee sessions, member calls, and Roundtable events

• Take notes, capture decisions and action items, and distribute them the same day

• Track every action item to completion, with owners and dates

• Project & Task Coordination

• Keep each Director's priorities, deadlines, and open items visible and current in ClickUp and Slack

• Follow up with team members, outside counsel, and vendors on deliverables

• Support deal logistics for the Director of Investments: diligence request lists, document collection, and IC and SPV-close timelines. You coordinate; legal sits with outside counsel

• Member & Community Operations Support

• Support the Director of Community & Operations with member communications, onboarding logistics, event coordination, and member requests

• Keep member-facing scheduling and follow-ups on time and on brand

• Maintain accurate member and meeting records in HubSpot with the CRM Coordinator

• Reporting & Briefings

• Prepare a weekly priorities and open-items brief for each Director

• Compile summaries, trackers, and updates for leadership - signal, not noise

• Travel, Events & Admin

• Arrange travel, offsites, and in-person member events

• Handle expenses, subscriptions, and administrative requests accurately and on time

• Supporting directors with special projects/ ad-hoc queries e.g. reaching out to podcast guests, partners, research etc

• Supporting the team with ad-hoc queries if needed

Requirements

Who You Are

• 3+ years as an executive assistant, chief of staff associate, or operations coordinator supporting senior leaders - ideally more than one at once

• You operate with urgency. Our customers rely on us to always meet our deadlines

• You anticipate. You notice what is coming next week and have already prepared for it

• You write clearly and concisely - emails and briefs people act on without a second read

• You are expert in Google Workspace, Slack, and calendar management across time zones; comfortable learning ClickUp and HubSpot quickly

• You exercise discretion. You handle confidential member, financial, and deal information with complete care

• You are async-first and reliable in a fast-moving, distributed team. You do not need to be chased, and you over-communicate status

• You exercise judgment on priorities and escalate the right things at the right time

Bonus Points

• Experience supporting leaders in venture capital, private equity, financial services, or private membership organizations

• Familiarity with Web3, DeFi, or crypto-adjacent audiences

• Exposure to investor relations, SPV workflows, or regulated communications

• Experience with ClickUp, Slack automation, n8n, or AI-assisted workflows

Benefits

Benefits

• Fully remote - work from anywhere

• Flexible, async-first culture with deep focus time built in

• Competitive independent contractor rate commensurate with experience

• Direct exposure to institutional-grade deal flow and a high-calibre investor community

• Ground-floor opportunity in a private co-investment club being built to scale

Are You Ready?

This is a rare opportunity to sit at the center of a private investment community that is growing fast and playing for the long game, working side by side with the leaders who run it. If you are the kind of person who is three steps ahead of the calendar and wants to be part of something built to last - we want to hear from you.

Apply with your CV in English, along with a brief note on how you manage competing priorities for more than one executive and one process you improved end-to-end. We move quickly and will be in touch with shortlisted candidates within two weeks.

postings.title: Clinical Support Specialist | Ideal Opportunity for Regulatory, Study Start-Up & Site Activation Specialists | Argentina Hybrid
postings.descriptionText:
Description

Clinical Support Specialist | Ideal Opportunity for Regulatory, Study Start-Up & Site Activation Specialists | Argentina Hybrid

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.

• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.

• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

• Responsible for providing operational and administrative support to one or more clinical functions.

• Responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

• Provide administrative support by coordinating documentation and communications, including maintaining and managing shared mailboxes, organizing project files, tracking action items, and ensuring timely follow-up with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Enter, maintain and reconcile information in agreed project and clinical tracking systems.

• Timeline and milestone tracking.

• Perform document management activities including document creation, compilation, formatting, version control, and quality control (QC).

• Translation of documents using approved vendors/systems

• Use AI-enabled tools, dashboards, and automated reports to provide logistical, organizational, and analytical support

• Support Trial Master File (TMF) filing and related document process activities within scope, ensuring inspection-ready documentation.

• Responsible for providing quality deliverables. Follow project requirements and applicable country rules, with oversight at the project level from functional leads.

• Review and comply with applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs), ensure training compliance, and maintain accurate timesheet reporting.

• Monitor workload/scope, budgeted effort, and project hours; escalate discrepancies in a timely manner

• Maintains overall awareness in the field of clinical research by completing all necessary and assigned training Qualifications:

• Associate’s degree or equivalent combination of education, training and experience.

• Minimum 1 year clinical operations experience

• Demonstrated understanding of clinical operations

• Utilize problem-solving techniques effectively

• Strong documentation and communication skills (written and spoken English) as well as a team[1]oriented approach.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Publisher) and ability to embrace new technologies and demonstrate ability to learn and adopt new technologies and tasks (including AI-enabled tools and dashboards where approved/available).

• Ability to manage competing priorities and work in a dynamic fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently as well as part of a team

• Good organizational skills and attention to detail, proven ability to take direction from multiple individuals and set priorities accordingly.

• Quality-driven in all assigned activities.

• Flexibility and willingness to adapt to rapidly changing environment and learn/perform new functions.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

Summary

The position is responsible for providing operational and administrative support, with limited supervision, to one or more clinical functions, including but not limited to Project Management, Site Management, Data Management, Biostatistics, Medical Writing, Site Selection, Site Activation, Site Contracting, and Regulatory clinical trials submissions. Accountable to functional leads for project level deliverables, and to line manager for performance across projects.

postings.title: Corporate Accounts Assistant
postings.descriptionText:
Our team and what we’ll accomplish together

Our team delivers key operational and commercial support across Latin America, serving as a critical backbone for our Account Management team and commercial department. As a Corporate Accounts Assistant based in Buenos Aires, you'll be at the heart of our mission to drive client loyalty, retention, and portfolio growth, directly impacting the success of our client partnerships and new service launches. You'll work in a collaborative environment where your organizational skills, proactive follow-through, and ability to seamlessly bridge client relations with internal teams make a tangible impact every day.

What You'll Do

• Deliver client presentations and support account launches. Prepare, execute, and deliver informative service presentations to new EAP clients in both Spanish and English, ensuring they understand the full scope of wellness, legal, financial, and nutritional resources available to their employees.

• Drive account performance insights. Prepare usage and utilization reports that track portfolio performance, providing account managers with actionable data to strengthen client relationships, identify growth opportunities, and demonstrate ROI.

• Execute account onboarding and client retention activities. Support the Account Management team in onboarding new clients and maintaining existing relationships through operational coordination, communications, and promotional activities that enhance client loyalty and satisfaction.

• Manage client information and communications. Update and maintain client information across company technology platforms and manage the distribution of marketing and communication materials that reinforce our value proposition.

• Represent the team at client events. Attend client fairs to promote EAP and B2C benefits, manage travel logistics, and prepare marketing materials that showcase our services and strengthen in-person relationships.

• Execute assigned strategic tasks. Follow up on account management priorities and respond to organizational strategy shifts or commercial updates, ensuring all deliverables meet quality standards and turnaround times.

• Build cross-functional partnerships. Maintain continuous relationships with account managers, internal teams, and external clients to ensure seamless communication and support across the organization.

What You Bring

• Educational background. Students or recent graduates of Business Administration, Marketing, Accounting, Industrial Engineering, or related fields.

• Professional experience. Less than 2 years of experience in account support, client services, customer service, or similar client-facing roles.

• Intermediate English proficiency. B1 level of English required for communication and collaboration in a multicultural business environment.

• Strong organizational and detail orientation. Exceptional ability to track multiple tasks, prioritize competing deadlines, and deliver high-quality work consistently and on time.

• Proficiency with essential business tools. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) for creating reports, presentations, and client materials. Familiarity with Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Meet, Forms, Sheets, Calendar) is a plus; we provide training if needed.

• Presentation and communication skills. Comfortable preparing and delivering presentations to clients in bilingual settings, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly and professionally.

• Client-focused mindset. A genuine interest in supporting clients and colleagues, with the ability to listen, empathize, and connect people with the right resources.

• Work schedule and model . Full-time position with a hybrid work model.

• Location requirement. Based in Buenos Aires.

• Cross-functional collaboration. Willingness to work closely with cross-functional commercial teams and participate in client-facing initiatives that drive business growth and client satisfaction.

postings.title: Executive Assistant to CEO
postings.descriptionText:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT TO THE CEO
Fully remote | Full-time, 1099/ contractor | Monday-Friday, US Eastern Time business hours, with availability for urgent items

ABOUT THE ROLE

A fast-growing, founder-led company is hiring a remote Executive Assistant to work directly alongside its CEO.

The CEO is growing fast on social media, personally runs the company's highest-value sales, and is also the creative strategist on client ad accounts. This role exists to remove those bottlenecks: organize him, protect his time and keep everything moving, so he can focus on content and on selling to high-net-worth clients.

This is not a passive support role. The CEO wants a partner who builds the structure, holds him to it and tells him what he needs to hear.

The single goal of this role is to buy back the CEO's time.

This role is focused on the business. Household and family logistics are handled by a separate on-site Life Manager.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Calendar and priorities
- Own and defend the CEO's calendar. Build the day around his highest-value work (content, high-value sales calls, consultations) and hold him to it.
- Run a daily priority list so nothing important gets pushed aside by noise.
- Triage the inbox and messages: handle what you can, flag what needs him, and close loops.

Removing bottlenecks
- Track every deliverable, approval and decision waiting on the CEO, including creative strategy for client ad accounts, and drive turnaround so client work does not stall.
- Act as the single intake point for company reporting: collect, review and present short digests instead of passing raw reports through.
- Coordinate follow-ups across the team so approvals and decisions keep moving.

Sales, content and offers support
- Schedule and prepare high-value sales calls, consultations and coaching calls: briefing notes beforehand, CRM updates and follow-ups afterwards.
- Keep the social media content pipeline on schedule: recording blocks, coordination with editors and the team, and the publishing calendar.
- Support the launch and delivery of new offers (coaching, consultations): scheduling, documents and logistics.

Travel and administration
- Book business travel and build itineraries.
- Handle business admin: documents, agreements, expense tracking.

Systems and tools
- Build and maintain the operating layer: trackers, SOPs, checklists and recurring process documentation.
- Expected fluency: Google Workspace, Slack, a project management tool (ClickUp, Notion or equivalent), a CRM, spreadsheets, and daily use of AI assistants.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In the first 90 days you have taken the calendar, inbox triage and reporting flow off the CEO's plate, there is a live tracker of everything waiting on him, and client creative work no longer sits on his desk for weeks.
By 6-12 months you are the CEO's right hand: the business runs on a weekly rhythm you built, nothing depends on him remembering it, and his time goes to content and high-value sales.

Requirements

IDEAL CANDIDATE
- 3+ years as an Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff or equivalent to a founder, CEO or senior executive, ideally in a fast-growing or entrepreneurial company.
- Proven remote experience: you have run an executive's day without being in the room.
- Fluent professional English, written and spoken.
- Able to work US Eastern Time business hours consistently, with reliable internet and a quiet workspace.
- Strong administrative and operational backbone. You build systems, you don't just follow them.
- Exceptional discretion with confidential business and financial information.
- Tech-savvy: you master Google Workspace, Slack, a project management tool (ClickUp, Notion or equivalent), a CRM, spreadsheets, and daily use of AI assistants.

You will thrive here if
- You are direct, unflappable and comfortable with a straightforward, high-energy, fast-moving principal. Feedback is candid and immediate, and nothing is personal.
- You are willing to push back and tell the CEO what he needs to hear. He wants a partner who holds him accountable, not someone who waits for instructions.
- You are energized by walking into disorder and creating structure.

Nice to have
- Experience in a marketing agency, paid ads or creative production environment.
- Social media or content operations experience.
- Experience supporting a founder who sells coaching, consulting or premium offers.

Benefits

WHY THIS ROLE

- Employment type: full-time 1099 independent contractor
- Paid Time Off and fully remote
- Growth: direct mentorship from the CEO and a clear path to grow into a Chief of Staff position
- Network: exposure to high-impact leaders

Complete discretion and confidentiality are required. The people who succeed in this seat enjoy managing complexity and operate with a high level of ownership in a dynamic, sometimes chaotic environment.

Description

Patient Reimbursement Coordinator (Argentina Based)

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.

• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.

• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

• Manage either travel logistics or reimbursement processing for patients participating in assigned clinical trial projects.

• Collaborate with PCS Project Managers, the Patient Concierge Services Manager, and internal teams tounderstand study requirements and implement appropriate patient support services.

• Support the setup of new projects, including mailbox creation, portal access, SharePoint folders, and the preparation of study-specific documentation.

• Review andvalidate patient enrolment information and approve patient access to the designateddigital platforms (e.g.,PatientGO®).

• Serve as a primary point of contact for patient requests submitted through the app, email, or phone, ensuring timely and compassionate responses.

• Coordinate flight, train, accommodation, or ground transport bookings as required, using approved systems or travel providers.

• Review and verify patient reimbursement requests, ensuring compliance with study-specific Travel & Reimbursement Policies.

• Approve, reject, or escalate reimbursement or stipend submissions as appropriate, based on study criteria and internal policies.

• Communicate with patients or caregivers to confirm logistics, provide reimbursement updates, and resolve any queries or concerns.

• Liaise with clinical sites to provide guidance or resolve issues related to reimbursement or patient travel coordination.

• Ensure timely processing of patient payments, stipends, or travel confirmations using approved systems andvendor platforms.

• Manage the allocation and tracking of patient payment cards when required by the project.

• Maintain accurate documentation by updating patient information, visit records, and service logs in real-time.

• Assist with or complete reimbursement submissions on behalf of patients, when needed.

• Contribute to ongoing service improvements by identifying operational gaps, sharing feedback, and supporting internal initiatives.

• Support financial tracking activities by providing relevant data andupdates for monthly reporting.

• Ensure strict patient confidentiality and compliance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), data protection regulations, and company SOPs.

• Participate in client meetings, site initiation visits, and investigator meetings when requested, representing PCS services.

• Stay current on tools, technologies, and processes related to patient travel and reimbursement coordination.

• Support internal team projects and initiatives as needed to contribute to the growth and improvement of the PCS function.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

Summary

The Patient Concierge Coordinator supports patients participating in clinical trials by managing either travel logistics or patient reimbursement activities, depending on the assigned focus area. The role ensures patients have a smooth, supportive experience while participating in studies by coordinating timely, compliant, and personalized services. Coordinators work closely with patients, sites, vendors, and internal stakeholders and are responsible for upholding the highest standards of confidentiality, accuracy, and service.

En Central Puerto somos la empresa líder en la producción de energía eléctrica a nivel nacional. Nuestro objetivo es producir energía en forma eficiente, sustentable y en armonía con el medio ambiente, contribuyendo al abastecimiento de la demanda eléctrica con calidad y generando valor tanto para la compañía como para la sociedad en su conjunto.

Actualmente, contamos con un portafolio energético diversificado compuesto por 16 centrales distribuidas en todo el país, que abarcan distintas tecnologías de generación térmica, hidroeléctrica, eólica y solar. Nuestros activos representan una potencia instalada de 6.933 MW , con una generación anual aproximada de 18.603 GWh , lo que equivale a una participación de mercado del 15,9% , posicionándonos como el principal grupo privado de generación eléctrica a nivel nacional.

A su vez, somos el mayor accionista privado de la sociedad Central Vuelta de Obligado S.A. y contamos con participación en Termoeléctrica José de San Martín S.A. y Termoeléctrica Manuel Belgrano S.A.

En línea con nuestra estrategia de crecimiento, continuamos ampliando nuestra capacidad instalada tanto en generación térmica como renovable, a través de nuevas inversiones, respaldados por una sólida posición financiera. Como parte de esta estrategia de diversificación, en 2026 ingresamos al negocio de Oil & Gas a través de la adquisición de los bloques Aguada del Chivato y Aguada de Bocarey, en Neuquén, con potencial de hidrocarburos no convencionales en la formación Vaca Muerta. También estamos desarrollando 2 proyectos de almacenamiento de energía mediante baterías (BESS), por un total de 205 MW , en nuestras centrales Puerto y Costanera.

En paralelo, somos uno de los principales grupos inversores del sector forestal en la Argentina. A través de nuestra subsidiaria Forestal Argentina, poseemos y operamos más de 160.000 hectáreas de plantaciones forestales ubicadas en distintos puntos del país.

Central Puerto también participa en proyectos de minería bajo el formato de Corporate Venture Capital, impulsando el desarrollo de iniciativas estratégicas vinculadas a nuevas cadenas de valor energético.

About The Role

CKH Group is hiring a full-time, Philippines-based Government Accountant with hands-on Bisan ERP experience and a background in U.S. governmental accounting. The role is dedicated to a single international public-sector engagement for approximately 12 to 14 months, with potential extension and future engagements. You will support a national government finance ministry, funded by a multilateral development bank, that reports under U.S. governmental accounting standards (GASB) and runs its general ledger in Bisan ERP. The work covers:

• Reconciling fiscal year 2026 balances and clearing a reconciliation backlog;

• Helping government-owned component units reconcile open balances;

• Preparing audit schedules; and

• Helping ministry staff use Bisan.

You will be the team member who works in Bisan every day, reporting to a U.S.-based Engagement Manager.

Key Responsibilities

• Reconcile general ledger balances in Bisan to bank statements, subsidiary ledgers, and third-party support, and document each reconciliation in a clear, reviewable workpaper.

• Clear backlogged monthly and year-end reconciliations, research reconciling items, and draft proposed adjusting journal entries with support for client approval.

• Produce a reconciled year-end trial balance ready for financial statement preparation and audit.

• Work with finance staff at government-owned entities to reconcile and resolve open balances across multiple fiscal years, including amounts due to and from the primary government.

• Prepare audit schedules from the auditor's request list for the accounts you reconcile, and help answer auditor questions.

• Pull reports, trace transactions, and use Bisan's general ledger, banking, fixed asset, and reporting functions to support the work.

• Show client staff how to record journal entries, run reconciliations, and produce reports in Bisan. Client staff make all postings.

postings.title: Accounting & Finance Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Political Asylum Lawyers is a Houston-based immigration law firm focused on asylum cases. We help immigrants all over the United States secure their futures here through asylum, combining exceptional standards with deep respect for the human reality behind every case.

Our work changes lives. The standards we maintain, the discipline behind our work, and the way we show up every day can determine whether someone is able to stay safe and build a stable future in the United States. That is why we operate with integrity, urgency, and excellence, and why we expect every team member to take full ownership of their role.

Everything we do is guided by our core values: integrity, excellence, accountability, teamwork and passion.

Working here means:

• High-stakes responsibility: our work is of great consequence for our clients

• Deeply meaningful outcomes: our work changes lives for the better

• Emotionally demanding moments: resilience and maturity are essential

• High standards and constant growth: excellence and continuous improvement are expected

• Mission-driven teamwork: we're passionate about helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum, and we know that meeting our high standards requires each of us to take ownership, communicate proactively, and support one another

If you want a career where your skills create tangible change in the world, this is it.

Learn more about what it's like to work with us here: politicalasylumlawyers.com/careers

The Role

In this role, you'll be an integral part of our team's mission of helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum. We believe that those fleeing persecution deserve expert guidance and unwavering support as they seek safety and a new beginning in the United States.

The Accounting & Finance Manager (Hands-on) is responsible for managing the firm's financial operations, accounting systems, billing, accounts receivable, cash flow forecasting, financial reporting, trust accounting compliance, payroll oversight, tax reporting coordination, internal controls, and finance-related operational projects.

This role serves as the firm's first level of financial analysis and operational financial control. The Accounting & Finance Manager ensures that financial records are accurate, timely, compliant, and useful for decisions. This is a hands-on role. The initial focus is to learn the firm's systems, work with existing staff and providers, and establish accurate, reliable financial operations.

Recurring accounting and billing work will be delegated progressively, while the manager retains responsibility for controls, review, quality, and results. As readiness and scope are agreed with leadership and current senior finance support, the manager will gradually assume selected planning and reporting responsibilities from that support.

The Accounting & Finance Manager must explain complex financial information in plain English, identify financial risks, recommend corrective action, and follow approved actions through implementation and verified results. The role supports leadership decisions on budgeting, profitability, cash management, pricing, collections, and strategic planning.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day responsibilities will vary based on the firm's needs, but will include a combination of the following:

Financial Operations Management

• Perform and manage day-to-day financial operations, working with existing staff and service providers and documenting procedures so the work is completed accurately and on time

• Follow financial issues through to resolution: identify who is responsible for each next step and its deadline, follow up, raise problems with recommended solutions, and confirm that the agreed actions were completed correctly

• Ensure accurate execution of accounting, billing, A/R, A/P, payroll, trust accounting, collections, tax coordination, and general ledger maintenance.

• Maintain clean and current financial records in the accounting system.

• Ensure the legal team is supported with accurate financial information related to client matters, billing, retainers, and collections.

• Monitor daily cash balances, bank accounts, credit card activity, merchant activity, and other key financial accounts.

• Ensure bills, vendor payments, check requests, and reimbursements are processed accurately and on time

Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and Forecasting

• Prepare, review, and analyze monthly financial statements and key financial reports on time

• Validate supporting records, calculations, and assumptions; investigate material inconsistencies and disclose unresolved limitations.

• Ensure monthly financial reports are completed accurately and on time.

• Prepare annual and periodic budgets and forecasts as required throughout the year. Provide budget variance reports and explain the results to the Owner/CFO in clear business language, including conclusions, recommendations, and decisions needed

• Support the creation, maintenance, and monitoring of the annual budget.

• Maintain a forward-looking cash flow forecast to help leadership anticipate shortfalls, plan distributions, and manage working capital.

• Track year-over-year revenue growth, gross profit, operating profit, and other key financial trends.

• Provide analysis that supports strategic planning, operational planning, and financial decision-making.

Billing, Collections, and Accounts Receivable

• Own and continuously improve the firm's billing and collections process.

• Supervise timely preparation and delivery of client invoices.

• Monitor payment plans and ensure clients comply with payment terms.

• Track, measure, and report accounts receivable aging.

• Ensure collection protocols are followed consistently and professionally.

• Work with billing staff and leadership to prevent A/R from accruing unnecessarily.

• Address client billing questions and payment concerns professionally while protecting the firm's financial interests.

• Own the operational handling of chargebacks, refund requests, billing disputes, and merchant service issues through documented resolution.

• Review billing records, payment history and related correspondence to understand and resolve chargebacks, refund requests and billing disputes. Coordinate follow-up, obtain required approvals, and confirm that any approved refunds, credits or other adjustments are correctly recorded in the relevant systems and account balances

• Recommend process improvements to increase collection rate and reduce financial leakage.

Trust Accounting and Compliance

• Ensure trust/IOLTA account activity is properly monitored, reconciled, and documented.

• Own or review three-way trust reconciliations.

• Identify and resolve trust accounting discrepancies with urgency.

• Ensure compliance with applicable legal, ethical, and accounting requirements.

• Work with the Owner/CFO and CPA to correct accounting or reporting issues.

• Maintain strong internal controls to protect the integrity of firm financials.

Internal Controls and Risk Management

• Design, recommend, and enforce financial controls that protect the firm.

• Identify financial risks, reporting gaps, compliance issues, cash flow risks, billing breakdowns, and process weaknesses.

• Recommend practical corrective actions to leadership and work within approved policies and authority limits.

• Support audits, tax preparation, financial reviews, and outside accounting reviews.

• Ensure balance sheet reconciliations, payroll liability reconciliations, and bank reconciliations are completed accurately.

• Monitor payroll taxes, tax liabilities, vendor obligations, debt obligations, and compliance deadlines.

Finance Team and Vendor Oversight

• Oversee existing staff and providers formally assigned to the role, including the bookkeeper, billing specialist, payroll provider, outsourced finance vendors, and other accounting support.

• Provide direction, accountability, and feedback to finance/accounting staff.

• Progressively delegate recurring accounting and billing work while retaining controls, review, and accountability for results, as appropriate.

• Participate in onboarding, training, and performance reviews for other assigned finance-related positions.

• Ensure finance team members understand expectations, deadlines, reporting requirements, and quality standards.

• Hold vendors accountable for timely and accurate work.

• Serve as the internal subject matter expert for accounting software, billing systems, chart of accounts, reporting processes, and financial workflows

• Identify practical improvements in QuickBooks, Stripe, Google Sheets, Asana, and related workflows

• Define financial requirements and implement, test, and document changes with technical support as needed.

• Maintain controls, data quality, security, and approval boundaries, and own completion and accuracy even when technical colleagues build the solution.

Financial Analysis and Business Support

• Analyze profitability by service, SKU, practice area, attorney, labor cost, marketing channel, and client/matter type when data is available.

• Support pricing reviews to ensure services produce adequate gross profit.

• Evaluate underperforming investments, expense categories, vendors, and initiatives.

• Track production labor return, utilization, realization, collection rate, and cost of acquisition where applicable.

• Help leadership understand Total Owner Benefit, owner distributions, working capital needs, and firm financial health.

• Support centralized KPI reporting and scorecard development.

Requirements

Who You Are

We're looking for professionals who combine technical competence with genuine passion for our mission. The ideal candidate brings:

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance

• Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounting or finance experience, preferably in a law firm, professional services firm, or other service-based business.

• Strong understanding of general accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, A/R, A/P, payroll, and month-end close.

• Experience managing or reviewing trust/IOLTA accounting and reconciliations.

• Experience with billing systems, client payment plans, collections, and accounts receivable management.

• Strong proficiency with accounting software, legal billing systems, Microsoft Excel, and financial reporting tools

• Practical experience using AI tools and automation to improve accounting or finance workflows, with a working understanding of APIs, scripts, and how data moves between systems

• Ability to identify improvement opportunities, define clear financial requirements, collaborate with technical colleagues on implementation, and validate the accuracy and reliability of results. Advanced coding skills are not required

• Ability to prepare accurate financial reports and explain them clearly to non-financial leaders.

• Demonstrated ability to identify financial risks, implement controls, and resolve discrepancies.

• Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• High integrity, confidentiality, discretion, and professional judgment.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced law firm environment

Preferred Qualifications

• CPA, MBA, advanced finance/accounting credential, or equivalent experience.

• 8+ years of accounting, controller, or finance operations experience.

• Microsoft Excel Expert Certification preferred

• Experience building lightweight scripts or integrations to improve finance workflows.

• Prior experience in a law firm or legal services environment.

• Experience with systems such as QuickBooks Online, Clio, MyCase, Time Matters, PracticePanther, Smokeball, Lawmatics, Infusionsoft/Keap, or similar platforms.

• Experience designing dashboards, centralized KPI reporting, balanced scorecards, or financial pe

postings.title: People Operations Generalist
postings.descriptionText:
Slate is the #1-rated nationwide commercial cleaning company in the US, specializing in overnight and recurring janitorial services for premium client sites. We use standardized checklists, photo documentation, and app-based quality control to deliver consistent, high-quality results — every location, every shift, every time. We do not operate as a franchise. Every team member is a direct Slate employee, and our culture is built on accountability, excellence, and mutual respect.

About The Role

The People Operations Generalist runs the HR operations engine for Slate. You'll own the employee lifecycle and the accuracy of employee data, executing to the standards the People Operations Manager sets.

What You'll Do

Run the employee lifecycle day to day: status and pay changes, leaves of absence, transfers, and offboarding coordination, documented to the People Operations Manager's standards

Own employee and new-hire follow-up end-to-end: proactively contact employees, resolve blockers, coordinate with Operations when needed, document outcomes, and close the loop.

Investigate employee cases thoroughly before escalation by reviewing available records, communications, timekeeping, and documentation; escalate to the People Operations Manager with clear findings, actions taken, and the specific support needed.

Take ownership of assigned cases through resolution rather than handing off actionable tasks; escalate only when manager input or policy/compliance review is required.

Work the HR ticket queue: respond to employee and manager tickets, resolve what you can, and escalate policy, employee relations, or compliance issues to the People Operations Manager

Own payroll preparation, audits, and disputes: collect and audit hours, process pay-rate and status changes, investigate discrepancies, and reconcile payroll data before submission, escalating exceptions to the People Operations Manager

Resolve payroll inquiries (missing hours, rate questions, deductions, final pay) that the HR Coordinator logs and escalates, coordinating with Operations on timekeeping issues

Audit new-hire files for completeness before day one, in coordination with the Onboarding Coordinator

Maintain HRIS data integrity: employee records, changes, and terminations entered accurately and on time

Provide documentation support to the People Operations Manager on employee relations: gather facts, timekeeping records, and prior documentation, and maintain investigation files

Produce standard HR reports (headcount, turnover, overtime, payroll summaries) for the People Operations Manager

Support multi-state compliance tasks: required notices, wage statements, and state-specific paperwork

What You'll Need

4+ years in HR

Bilingual (English & Spanish) required

Exceptional attention to detail: you catch the missing signature and the payroll error before they go out

Strong organization; comfortable tracking many employees through multiple touchpoints and pay periods

Proficient with HRIS, payroll, and e-signature systems; strong Excel or Google Sheets

Reliable availability on payroll processing days

Calm, clear communicator with employees and managers

Familiarity with I-9/E-Verify and multi-state wage and hour rules is a plus

First 90 Days

Lifecycle checklists (onboarding, changes, offboarding) documented and in use

Payroll running on schedule with a pre-submission audit checklist

Payroll inquiry log in place with response-time tracking

HRIS audit completed and data cleaned

Skills: english,onboarding,human resources

Líder de Administración y Contabilidad

Desde HUMMA RH acompañamos a una importante empresa líder en su segmento en la búsqueda de un/a Líder de Administración y Contabilidad para incorporarse a un equipo y organización en crecimiento.

Buscamos un perfil profesional con sólida experiencia administrativa contable, capacidad de liderazgo y visión integral del negocio, que pueda garantizar la calidad y confiabilidad de la información contable, fortalecer los procesos del área y contribuir a la toma de decisiones.

Principales responsabilidades:

• Liderar el ciclo contable integral, garantizando la correcta ejecución de los cierres mensuales y anuales en tiempo y forma.

• Elaborar y analizar estados contables, informes financieros y reportes de gestión para la Gerencia y el Directorio.

• Coordinar la preparación de balances, declaraciones juradas y demás documentación contable e impositiva.

• Supervisar el análisis de las cuentas, las conciliaciones bancarias y los controles contables, asegurando la integridad y la consistencia de la información.

• Coordinar las auditorías internas y externas, así como los procesos de inventario y valuación de activos fijos.

• Gestionar la relación con auditores externos, entidades bancarias y organismos de control.

• Identificar oportunidades de mejora y promover la optimización de los procesos y circuitos contables.

Requisitos excluyentes:

• Título universitario de Contador/a Público/a, Cs. Económicas.

• Experiencia mínima de 5 años liderando o coordinando procesos del área contable.

• Sólidos conocimientos de contabilidad general, cierres contables y elaboración de estados financieros.

• Experiencia en el manejo de SAP, aplicado a la gestión contable, el análisis de información y la generación de reportes.

• Residencia en Comodoro Rivadavia o Rada Tilly.

Se valorará:

• Posgrado o especialización en Contabilidad Superior, Auditoría o Finanzas.

• Experiencia en empresas de mediana o gran envergadura.

• Participación en proyectos de implementación, migración o mejora de SAP.

• Experiencia en liderazgo de equipos y mejora de procesos.

• Capacidad analítica, autonomía y orientación a resultados.

¿Qué ofrece la posición?

• Participación en procesos clave para la gestión y el desarrollo del negocio.

• Plan de desarrollo profesional con proyección de crecimiento.

Si buscás nuevos desafíos profesionales y querés seguir desarrollando tu carrera, esta oportunidad puede ser para vos.

En HUMMA RH garantizamos la confidencialidad de las postulaciones durante todo el proceso de selección.

postings.title: Accounting & Finance Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Political Asylum Lawyers is a Houston-based immigration law firm focused on asylum cases. We help immigrants all over the United States secure their futures here through asylum, combining exceptional standards with deep respect for the human reality behind every case.

Our work changes lives. The standards we maintain, the discipline behind our work, and the way we show up every day can determine whether someone is able to stay safe and build a stable future in the United States. That is why we operate with integrity, urgency, and excellence, and why we expect every team member to take full ownership of their role.

Everything we do is guided by our core values: integrity, excellence, accountability, teamwork and passion.

Working here means:

• High-stakes responsibility: our work is of great consequence for our clients

• Deeply meaningful outcomes: our work changes lives for the better

• Emotionally demanding moments: resilience and maturity are essential

• High standards and constant growth: excellence and continuous improvement are expected

• Mission-driven teamwork: we're passionate about helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum, and we know that meeting our high standards requires each of us to take ownership, communicate proactively, and support one another

If you want a career where your skills create tangible change in the world, this is it.

Learn more about what it's like to work with us here: politicalasylumlawyers.com/careers

The Role

In this role, you'll be an integral part of our team's mission of helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum. We believe that those fleeing persecution deserve expert guidance and unwavering support as they seek safety and a new beginning in the United States.

The Accounting & Finance Manager (Hands-on) is responsible for managing the firm's financial operations, accounting systems, billing, accounts receivable, cash flow forecasting, financial reporting, trust accounting compliance, payroll oversight, tax reporting coordination, internal controls, and finance-related operational projects.

This role serves as the firm's first level of financial analysis and operational financial control. The Accounting & Finance Manager ensures that financial records are accurate, timely, compliant, and useful for decisions. This is a hands-on role. The initial focus is to learn the firm's systems, work with existing staff and providers, and establish accurate, reliable financial operations.

Recurring accounting and billing work will be delegated progressively, while the manager retains responsibility for controls, review, quality, and results. As readiness and scope are agreed with leadership and current senior finance support, the manager will gradually assume selected planning and reporting responsibilities from that support.

The Accounting & Finance Manager must explain complex financial information in plain English, identify financial risks, recommend corrective action, and follow approved actions through implementation and verified results. The role supports leadership decisions on budgeting, profitability, cash management, pricing, collections, and strategic planning.

What You'll Do

postings.descriptionText:
En Strategy LATAM nos encontramos en búsqueda de un/a Gerente de Contabilidad y Control de Gestión para nuestro cliente, importante grupo empresario nacional de servicios.

Reportando al CFO, será responsable de liderar la gestión contable y el control de gestión de las distintas empresas del Grupo, garantizando información financiera confiable para la toma de decisiones estratégicas.

Principales responsabilidades

• Liderar los cierres contables y la consolidación de estados financieros de las empresas del Grupo, asegurando el cumplimiento de las normas contables e impositivas.

• Diseñar y supervisar los procesos de control de gestión, incluyendo presupuestos, forecasts y análisis de desvíos.

• Analizar la rentabilidad por empresa y unidad de negocio, elaborando reportes para el CFO y la Dirección.

• Coordinar la relación con auditores externos, asesores impositivos y organismos de control.

• Supervisión de la gestión impositiva.

• Liderar un equipo de aproximadamente 10 colaboradores e impulsar mejoras, automatización y estandarización de procesos contables y sistemas de gestión.

Requisitos

• Formación: Contador/a Público/a graduado/a (excluyente). Posgrado en Finanzas, Administración o afines (deseable).

• Experiencia: 8 a 10 años en Contabilidad y/o Control de Gestión, con al menos 3 años liderando equipos. Se valorará especialmente la experiencia en grupos económicos o estructuras multiempresa.

• Conocimientos técnicos:

• Normas contables (NIIF/RT), régimen impositivo argentino y consolidación de estados financieros multiempresa.

• Presupuestos, forecasts, análisis de desvíos y modelos financieros.

• Manejo avanzado de Odoo o ERP similares y Excel avanzado.

• Herramientas de IA aplicadas a Contabilidad y Control de Gestión.

• Implementación o integración de sistemas contables (deseable).

• Inglés intermedio/avanzado (deseable).

• Modalidad de trabajo: Esquema híbrido con presencialidad de 4 días semanales durante la etapa inicial, con posibilidad de mayor flexibilidad posteriormente.

Nos enfocamos a un perfil analítico, estratégico y orientado a resultados, con capacidad de liderazgo, autonomía, comunicación efectiva y orientación a la mejora continua.
Si contás con experiencia en Contabilidad y Control de Gestión en entornos corporativos y querés asumir un nuevo desafío profesional, nos gustaría conocerte.

postings.descriptionText:
About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights‑driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient‑focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart ®.

About The Role

We are seeking a Site Payment Lead to join our team in a remote capacity The Site Payment Lead is responsible for coordinating with the team members and their activities across studies, liaising with the project teams to ensure set-up and site payments are effectively managed; and is accountable for the management of payments for the assigned studies. This includes the accountability for payment setup and modifications within the investigator payment system for expenses aligned to budget templates.

Working independently, they will show an elevated level of ownership assisting the project team project planning, decision making process and timely payments to investigator sites. As a dedicated team player, the Site Payment Lead provides excellent proactive support across projects and tasks as assigned with supervision, identifying risks, their impact, and potential resolutions.

Key Accountabilities

Overall Accountabilities:

• Be the accountable Lead for Site Payment Services related queries on assigned studies and point of contact for project teams.

• Proactively and effectively solves customer problems and accepts responsibility for actions.

• Work closely with Project Leadership, Global Site Contracts, eClinical Business Implementation, Global Clinical Operations, and other internal Site Payment Services team members to obtain additional information required to perform tasks, when applicable.

• Participate as the Lead representative of the Investigator Payment team in study start-up meetings, including payment strategy meetings, to ensure initial funds setup requirements are documented for seamless payment processing.

• Lead and follow-up on audits/inspections

• Knowledge of clinical trial pricing/budgeting tools and how to reflect operational changes within the tools

• Thorough knowledge of Parexel’s SOPs, Operational Guidelines and Work Instructions procedures.

• Complete routine administrative tasks in a timely manner (e.g. timesheets, metrics, and expenses).

• In depth understanding of the set-up and payment process; including ability to analyze agreements.

• Collection of information from all teams/systems/tools wherever needed on a timely and proactive basis.

• Analyze and present data to various stakeholders.

• Trains team members within the Site Payment Services.

• Discover and implement opportunities for process efficiencies.

End To End Management Of Site Payments

• Keeps internal and external team members aware of site payment status and issues.

• Accurately authorize study setups before starting payments.

• Resolve escalated second line helpdesk issues for assigned portfolio.

• Assist in the preparation of project status reports as needed.

• Works with IFA and project team to ensure appropriate funding prior to administering payments.

• Proactively participates in Project Strategy Meetings (PSM), providing input to payment strategy planning for incoming studies.

• Compliance with the Investigator payment timelines as per the contractual terms.

• Resolve payment discrepancies to ensure accurate processing of payments.

• Provide payments reports for assigned projects to customers as requested.

Skills

• Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.

• Ability to make decisions and advise other staff even in ambiguous situations.

• Ability to conduct root cause analysis in problem solving and process development.

• Strong customer focus, ability to interact professionally.

• Patient, Quality and Client focused approach to work.

• Ability to manage multiple and varied tasks with enthusiasm and prioritize workload with attention to detail.

• Expert in using MS Excel for spreadsheet analysis.

• Strong proficiency in use of MS Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, and Word.

• Analytical mind with strong attention to detail.

• Commitment to high quality work and consistent performance.

• Comfortable with working in a decentralized matrix environment and being a conversant team player.

• Delivers standard/typical work deliverables without issues.

• Thoroughly understands fundamentals of CRO industry and how Investigator Payments influence in the organization.

Knowledge And Experience

• 4+ years’ experience are preferred within a Clinical Research Organization; Business; Finance/Accounting; or other comparable experience.

• Must have experience supporting Clinical Site Payments

Education

• Advanced to excellent English level for non-native English speakers.

• Minimum bachelor’s degree or equivalent degree.

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Political Asylum Lawyers is a Houston-based immigration law firm focused on asylum cases. We help immigrants all over the United States secure their futures here through asylum, combining exceptional standards with deep respect for the human reality behind every case.

Our work changes lives. The standards we maintain, the discipline behind our work, and the way we show up every day can determine whether someone is able to stay safe and build a stable future in the United States. That is why we operate with integrity, urgency, and excellence, and why we expect every team member to take full ownership of their role.

Everything we do is guided by our core values: integrity, excellence, accountability, teamwork and passion.

Working here means:

• High-stakes responsibility: our work is of great consequence for our clients

• Deeply meaningful outcomes: our work changes lives for the better

• Emotionally demanding moments: resilience and maturity are essential

• High standards and constant growth: excellence and continuous improvement are expected

• Mission-driven teamwork: we're passionate about helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum, and we know that meeting our high standards requires each of us to take ownership, communicate proactively, and support one another

If you want a career where your skills create tangible change in the world, this is it.

Learn more about what it's like to work with us here: politicalasylumlawyers.com/careers

The Role

In this role, you'll be an integral part of our team's mission of helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum. We believe that those fleeing persecution deserve expert guidance and unwavering support as they seek safety and a new beginning in the United States.

The Accounting & Finance Manager (Hands-on) is responsible for managing the firm's financial operations, accounting systems, billing, accounts receivable, cash flow forecasting, financial reporting, trust accounting compliance, payroll oversight, tax reporting coordination, internal controls, and finance-related operational projects.

This role serves as the firm's first level of financial analysis and operational financial control. The Accounting & Finance Manager ensures that financial records are accurate, timely, compliant, and useful for decisions. This is a hands-on role. The initial focus is to learn the firm's systems, work with existing staff and providers, and establish accurate, reliable financial operations.

Recurring accounting and billing work will be delegated progressively, while the manager retains responsibility for controls, review, quality, and results. As readiness and scope are agreed with leadership and current senior finance support, the manager will gradually assume selected planning and reporting responsibilities from that support.

The Accounting & Finance Manager must explain complex financial information in plain English, identify financial risks, recommend corrective action, and follow approved actions through implementation and verified results. The role supports leadership decisions on budgeting, profitability, cash management, pricing, collections, and strategic planning.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day responsibilities will vary based on the firm's needs, but will include a combination of the following:

Financial Operations Management

• Perform and manage day-to-day financial operations, working with existing staff and service providers and documenting procedures so the work is completed accurately and on time

• Follow financial issues through to resolution: identify who is responsible for each next step and its deadline, follow up, raise problems with recommended solutions, and confirm that the agreed actions were completed correctly

• Ensure accurate execution of accounting, billing, A/R, A/P, payroll, trust accounting, collections, tax coordination, and general ledger maintenance.

• Maintain clean and current financial records in the accounting system.

• Ensure the legal team is supported with accurate financial information related to client matters, billing, retainers, and collections.

• Monitor daily cash balances, bank accounts, credit card activity, merchant activity, and other key financial accounts.

• Ensure bills, vendor payments, check requests, and reimbursements are processed accurately and on time

Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and Forecasting

• Prepare, review, and analyze monthly financial statements and key financial reports on time

• Validate supporting records, calculations, and assumptions; investigate material inconsistencies and disclose unresolved limitations.

• Ensure monthly financial reports are completed accurately and on time.

• Prepare annual and periodic budgets and forecasts as required throughout the year. Provide budget variance reports and explain the results to the Owner/CFO in clear business language, including conclusions, recommendations, and decisions needed

• Support the creation, maintenance, and monitoring of the annual budget.

• Maintain a forward-looking cash flow forecast to help leadership anticipate shortfalls, plan distributions, and manage working capital.

• Track year-over-year revenue growth, gross profit, operating profit, and other key financial trends.

• Provide analysis that supports strategic planning, operational planning, and financial decision-making.

Billing, Collections, and Accounts Receivable

• Own and continuously improve the firm's billing and collections process.

• Supervise timely preparation and delivery of client invoices.

• Monitor payment plans and ensure clients comply with payment terms.

• Track, measure, and report accounts receivable aging.

• Ensure collection protocols are followed consistently and professionally.

• Work with billing staff and leadership to prevent A/R from accruing unnecessarily.

• Address client billing questions and payment concerns professionally while protecting the firm's financial interests.

• Own the operational handling of chargebacks, refund requests, billing disputes, and merchant service issues through documented resolution.

• Review billing records, payment history and related correspondence to understand and resolve chargebacks, refund requests and billing disputes. Coordinate follow-up, obtain required approvals, and confirm that any approved refunds, credits or other adjustments are correctly recorded in the relevant systems and account balances

• Recommend process improvements to increase collection rate and reduce financial leakage.

Trust Accounting and Compliance

• Ensure trust/IOLTA account activity is properly monitored, reconciled, and documented.

• Own or review three-way trust reconciliations.

• Identify and resolve trust accounting discrepancies with urgency.

• Ensure compliance with applicable legal, ethical, and accounting requirements.

• Work with the Owner/CFO and CPA to correct accounting or reporting issues.

• Maintain strong internal controls to protect the integrity of firm financials.

Internal Controls and Risk Management

• Design, recommend, and enforce financial controls that protect the firm.

• Identify financial risks, reporting gaps, compliance issues, cash flow risks, billing breakdowns, and process weaknesses.

• Recommend practical corrective actions to leadership and work within approved policies and authority limits.

• Support audits, tax preparation, financial reviews, and outside accounting reviews.

• Ensure balance sheet reconciliations, payroll liability reconciliations, and bank reconciliations are completed accurately.

• Monitor payroll taxes, tax liabilities, vendor obligations, debt obligations, and compliance deadlines.

Finance Team and Vendor Oversight

• Oversee existing staff and providers formally assigned to the role, including the bookkeeper, billing specialist, payroll provider, outsourced finance vendors, and other accounting support.

• Provide direction, accountability, and feedback to finance/accounting staff.

• Progressively delegate recurring accounting and billing work while retaining controls, review, and accountability for results, as appropriate.

• Participate in onboarding, training, and performance reviews for other assigned finance-related positions.

• Ensure finance team members understand expectations, deadlines, reporting requirements, and quality standards.

• Hold vendors accountable for timely and accurate work.

• Serve as the internal subject matter expert for accounting software, billing systems, chart of accounts, reporting processes, and financial workflows

• Identify practical improvements in QuickBooks, Stripe, Google Sheets, Asana, and related workflows

• Define financial requirements and implement, test, and document changes with technical support as needed.

• Maintain controls, data quality, security, and approval boundaries, and own completion and accuracy even when technical colleagues build the solution.

Financial Analysis and Business Support

• Analyze profitability by service, SKU, practice area, attorney, labor cost, marketing channel, and client/matter type when data is available.

• Support pricing reviews to ensure services produce adequate gross profit.

• Evaluate underperforming investments, expense categories, vendors, and initiatives.

• Track production labor return, utilization, realization, collection rate, and cost of acquisition where applicable.

• Help leadership understand Total Owner Benefit, owner distributions, working capital needs, and firm financial health.

• Support centralized KPI reporting and scorecard development.

Requirements

Who You Are

We're looking for professionals who combine technical competence with genuine passion for our mission. The ideal candidate brings:

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance

• Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounting or finance experience, preferably in a law firm, professional services firm, or other service-based business.

• Strong understanding of general accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, A/R, A/P, payroll, and month-end close.

• Experience managing or reviewing trust/IOLTA accounting and reconciliations.

• Experience with billing systems, client payment plans, collections, and accounts receivable management.

• Strong proficiency with accounting software, legal billing systems, Microsoft Excel, and financial reporting tools

• Practical experience using AI tools and automation to improve accounting or finance workflows, with a working understanding of APIs, scripts, and how data moves between systems

• Ability to identify improvement opportunities, define clear financial requirements, collaborate with technical colleagues on implementation, and validate the accuracy and reliability of results. Advanced coding skills are not required

• Ability to prepare accurate financial reports and explain them clearly to non-financial leaders.

• Demonstrated ability to identify financial risks, implement controls, and resolve discrepancies.

• Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• High integrity, confidentiality, discretion, and professional judgment.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced law firm environment

Preferred Qualifications

• CPA, MBA, advanced finance/accounting credential, or equivalent experience.

• 8+ years of accounting, controller, or finance operations experience.

• Microsoft Excel Expert Certification preferred

• Experience building lightweight scripts or integrations to improve finance workflows.

• Prior experience in a law firm or legal services environment.

• Experience with systems such as QuickBooks Online, Clio, MyCase, Time Matters, PracticePanther, Smokeball, Lawmatics, Infusionsoft/Keap, or similar platforms.

• Experience designing dashboards, centralized KPI reporting, balanced scorecards, or financial pe
