postings.title: People and Culture Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Catalyst Capital Holdings is the group behind Decentralized Masters, Inflection Club, Legacy, Future Finance, and Beyond Members Club - a fast-growing, bootstrapped ecosystem spanning DeFi education, private co-investment, and membership communities. Each entity operates with its own brand, hiring managers, and pace, but shares a single People & Culture function.

That function is small, lean, and stretched across five businesses at once - which is exactly the problem this role exists to solve.

Our Impact

Across the group, we have built and scaled teams from the ground up while empowering thousands of members and investors globally. We hire fast, we hire often, and we hire across very different functions - sales, ops, tech, finance, investment, and executive support - sometimes all in the same week.

Our Vision

We want every entity in the group to hire with the same rigor: structured, scorecard-first, and fast enough that a great candidate never slips away while we figure out process. Getting there requires a dedicated recruiter who can operate across the whole group, not just one company's pipeline.

Are You Ready?

This is a build role inside a lean team - you will run full-cycle recruiting for multiple businesses at once, with real autonomy and a direct line to the person who owns People & Culture for the entire group.

The Role

The People & Culture Specialist reports directly to the People & Culture Manager and covers two things across every Catalyst Capital Group entity (Decentralized Masters, Inflection Club, Legacy, Future Finance, and Beyond Members Club): full-cycle recruiting and People Operations and HR administration .

You will run multiple concurrent searches for different hiring managers while also keeping the group's people admin accurate, compliant, and on time. Expect roughly 60% recruiting and 40% People Ops, shifting week to week with hiring volume. You are the connective tissue that keeps quality and process consistent across all five businesses.

What You'll Own

• Full-Cycle Recruiting Execution

• Run requisitions end to end: intake with the department lead, job description and scorecard build in Workable, sourcing, screening, structured interview logistics, through to offer

• Run searches concurrently across multiple entities and role types without dropping quality standards

• Sourcing & Pipeline

• Source directly via LinkedIn, Workable, free and Web3-specific job boards, and outbound headhunting rather than waiting on inbound applicants

• Build and maintain warm talent pipelines for recurring, high-volume role types (setters, closers, mentors, VAs) so new reqs open with a head start

• Screen for CV fraud and AI-tailored application patterns - a known and recurring issue across recent hiring cycles

• Cross-Entity Coordination

• Partner with department leads and hiring managers across all five entities, each with different hiring maturity and norms

• Enforce the group's standard hiring process - approval, structured interview sequence (Loom review, Talent Team interview, Hiring Manager interview, exercises and assessments, etc.)

• Systems & Reporting

• Maintain Workable pipeline hygiene: accurate stages, notes, and candidate status across every open requisition

• Maintain a live recruiting report for the People & Culture Manager - time-to-fill, pipeline volume, and source effectiveness by entity

• Coordinate a minimum of two reference checks per hire before any offer is extended

• Offer Support

• Draft first-pass offer language aligned to each entity's comp structure and route for sign-off before it goes to the candidate

• Onboarding & Offboarding

• Run the new-hire process end to end: contracts, pre-start paperwork, tool and system access, equipment, Day 1 and Week 1 schedule

• Run offboarding: access removal, equipment return, final admin, and exit documentation

• Keep one consistent onboarding experience across all entities

• HR Administration & Records

• Maintain accurate contractor records, org charts, and entity assignments in our HRIS and shared drives

• Prepare and issue employment and contractor agreements, amendments, and role or comp change letters from approved templates

• Collect and prepare inputs for payroll and contractor invoicing, and coordinate with Finance on accuracy and timing

• Arranging of Birthday gifts, gifts for special occasions, and company swag for all team members.

• Policy, Compliance & Team Member Support

• Maintain the handbook, policies, and People & Culture templates, and keep them current

• Be the first point of contact for contractor questions on policy, leave, payroll, and tooling

• Escalate industrial relations issues to the People & Culture Manager promptly

• Keep records audit-ready and handle all personal data with strict confidentiality

• People Reporting

• Maintain a live headcount and people dashboard: joiners, leavers, open roles, and entity splits

• Flag admin backlogs and compliance gaps to the People & Culture Manager

Requirements

What You Need

• 3+ years in recruiting and/or HR operations, with at least 2 years of full-cycle recruiting across multiple business units, brands, or portfolio companies at once

• Hands-on experience with HR administration: onboarding and offboarding, contracts, employee records, and payroll or contractor inputs. Experience with remote, international, or contractor-heavy teams is a plus

• Comfortable running several concurrent searches across functions while keeping admin work on schedule, without a coordinator behind you

• Fluent with an ATS (Workable strongly preferred) and an HRIS (BambooHR), and confident building structured interview scorecards

• High attention to detail and sound judgment with confidential information

• Experience partnering directly with a People & Culture leader and with hiring managers across multiple entities

• Excellent written English and comfortable working async across time zones, with availability for EST hours or overlap with both EST and CET

Nice to Have

• Recruiting or HR experience in Web3, DeFi, fintech, or membership/education businesses

• Experience in a holding company or group structure with multiple P&Ls

• Familiarity with Testlify or similar assessment tools

• Working knowledge of employment practices for contractors and employees across multiple countries, or experience with an employer-of-record provider

• Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, and ClickUp

Benefits

What we offer you

• Competitive salary

• Unlimited PTO

• Flexible work schedule

• Team off-sites

• Fully remote with a very supportive team

postings.title: Talent Development Team Lead
postings.descriptionText:
About Us

MEDLIFE is a non-profit organization that partners with low-income communities in Latin America and Africa to improve their access to medicine, education, and community development projects. Our mission is to build a worldwide Movement empowering the poor in their fight for equal access to healthcare, education, and a safe home. Our vision is a world free from the constraints of poverty. MEDLIFE works with students from around the world in order to broaden their perspectives and better equip them to advocate for social justice.

Our Ideal Talent Development Team Lead

We're looking for a hands-on, mission-driven people leader who is eager to learn and to build. You work side by side with team leads on feedback, follow-up, clear KPIs and development plans for their teams. You learn how an organization works, propose improvements and make them happen rather than waiting for direction. You lead your team with clear standards and accountability, and you develop each person on it. Above all, you bring MEDLIFE's values: FIRE (energy, urgency and ownership of results), GROWTH (curiosity, openness to feedback and constant learning) and IMPECCABLE CHARACTER (integrity, consistency and discretion with sensitive information). As we continue growing, we'd love for you to be part of the MEDLIFE Movement.

About The Role

You will build MEDLIFE's leaders, culture and performance system, so every team has clear KPIs, regular feedback and development plans, and our leaders grow from within. Your main focus will be helping team leads give feedback, follow up with their teams, set clear KPIs and build development plans for their people. You will also lead the Talent Development team, which includes Talent Acquisition and People Administration, so those areas deliver on their goals. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will design and personally run our core talent programs, supported by a part-time administrative assistant. You will report directly to MEDLIFE's Founder and work closely with the Leadership team and team leads across all departments.

What will your day-to-day look like at MEDLIFE?

• Work side by side with team leads on giving direct feedback, running regular 1:1s, following up with their teams and holding hard conversations.

• Build and facilitate our Leadership Development Program, and agree a development plan with each team lead.

• Help every team lead define 3 to 4 clear KPIs and a weekly scorecard, and review them regularly with each lead.

• Make sure every employee has a role scorecard, clear goals and a development plan, and run performance review cycles hands-on with team leads.

• Bring MEDLIFE's values to life: run recognition programs (including our monthly Level Win meeting), behavior assessments and team-building initiatives.

• Run engagement and climate surveys end to end, from design to results, and lead the action plans.

• Identify skill gaps and own our training framework (Core MEDLIFE, Sales and Leadership development).

• Run 360 feedback, quarterly talent reviews and succession planning for critical leadership roles.

• Lead, coach and develop the Talent Acquisition and People Administration team, setting the area's KPIs and weekly scorecard.

• Learn our current people processes, document the key ones as simple SOPs, and put improvements into practice.

What will you bring?

• 4+ years of experience in HR, Talent Development or Organizational Development, with real experience leading people or coordinating other leaders.

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, Organizational Development or a related field.

• Hands-on execution, not only design: you have personally built and facilitated trainings, run review cycles, created scorecards or rubrics, and presented results.

• Experience developing leaders: coaching managers or team leads to give direct feedback, run 1:1s, follow up with their teams and hold difficult conversations.

• Practical experience in performance management (goal setting, role scorecards, review cycles, correction plans) and/or Learning & Development (skills-gap analysis, onboarding, leadership training), with working knowledge of the other.

• Experience running culture, values, recognition or engagement initiatives and turning results into concrete action plans.

• Experience setting clear expectations and KPIs, running 1:1s and holding people accountable for results.

• A KPI and data mindset: you define simple metrics, track them consistently and use evidence to make decisions.

• Process improvement: you learn how work is done today, document it, propose improvements and put them into practice.

• Practical use of generative AI to build training content and automate HR reporting.

• Proficiency in Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot, an ATS (e.g., Hiring Room) and HR tools (performance management, survey platforms, LMS).

• Advanced English and Spanish.

Nice To Have

• Experience in non-profit or mission-driven organizations.

• Experience in multi-country or fast-growing organizations.

• Experience designing or facilitating a leadership development program.

• Exposure to succession planning, talent reviews, or compensation and benefits.

• Knowledge of labor regulations in Latin America (Peru is a plus).

What do we offer you?

• Full-time position, Monday to Friday from 8:00am to 5:00pm (Peru time, GMT-5).

• Flexible work model: hybrid for candidates based in Lima, Peru, and remote for candidates based in other countries.

• Competitive salary commensurate with the role.

• Birthday day off.

• Growth opportunities in a fast-growing, multi-country organization.

• Mission-driven work: the chance to shape the people system that helps MEDLIFE serve more students and communities.

Please note: We welcome applications from candidates across Latin America. We are grateful to all interested candidates, but only those chosen for an interview will be contacted.

Early Careers Attraction Project Manager

Rank: Supervising Associate

The Opportunity

The Early Careers Attraction Project Manager will serve as the central coordinator for EY's project manager led school strategy, leading the execution of campus strategy plans and ensuring alignment across recruiting teams, alumni stakeholders, and campus partners. This role will virtually manage and support stakeholder teams responsible for university engagement efforts, ensuring they have the resources, tools, materials, communications, and guidance needed to effectively support stakeholders and maintain strong campus relationships. The individual will oversee campus strategy, communications, governance processes, event and engagement requests, budget tracking, and reporting.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Coordinate and remotely support university engagement activities by partnering with University Relationship Leaders (URLs), client-serving professionals, alumni, and recruiting stakeholders to execute targeted campus initiatives.

• Support necessary event planning, logistics, outreach, communications, and operational coordination to ensure successful execution of campus engagement efforts.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholder teams, ensuring they have the necessary resources, materials, guidance, and information to effectively support university relationships and recruiting activities.

• Communicate with candidates identified from school teams who are interested in career opportunities with EY

• Manage engagement requests and help align campus activities with talent priorities, local market needs, skills-based hiring objectives, and high-potential candidate development strategies.

• Partner with internal and external stakeholders to tailor engagement approaches based on university priorities, stakeholder objectives, and evolving talent attraction needs.

• Track project milestones, stakeholder commitments, and engagement outcomes while providing regular updates, reporting, and recommendations to leadership.

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have

• 5-7 years of experience in recruiting, talent operations, or stakeholder-facing roles

• Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, adapting priorities and shifting focus as business needs and firm objectives change.

• Experience working with recruiting systems, CRM tools, or candidate tracking platforms

• Strong teaming and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence, collaborate, and drive results across diverse stakeholder groups in a highly matrixed environment.

Ideally, You’ll Also Have

• Experience supporting Early Careers or campus recruiting programs

• Familiarity with stakeholder engagement at senior levels (e.g., PPMDD, client leaders)

• Experience in process improvement, operations, or workflow optimization

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals who demonstrate a relationship-first mindset while maintaining a strong commitment to process integrity and fairness. The ideal candidate thrives in a highly collaborative environment, values consistency and accountability, and is motivated to enhance both candidate and stakeholder experiences at scale.

EY’s Commitment to Fairness and Consistency

This role operates within established recruiting frameworks and does not influence hiring decisions. All referrals are managed consistently, with no preferential treatment, and communication is provided transparently without overpromising outcomes.

Talent Enablement Center | Supervising Associate

The Supervising Associate Talent Team Coordinator is an experienced HR operations professional who partners with Talent Consultants and Talent leadership to coordinate employee life-cycle activities, guide team members, and strengthen consistent, high-quality service delivery.

The opportunity

As a Supervising Associate Talent Team Coordinator, you will combine hands-on operational expertise with team support. You will support complex Talent activities, coach coordinators, oversee quality and service delivery, and help improve processes, controls, tools, and the client experience.

ROLE FOCUS Operational excellence, client service, quality, development, and continuous improvement

Your key responsibilities

• Operational support to Talent Team Coordinators, including setting priorities, monitoring workloads, reinforcing established procedures, and helping the team meet service expectations.

• Coordinate the administration of employee life-cycle and Talent processes, which may include performance management, promotions, variable pay, orientation, people surveys, upward feedback, separations, and other assigned programs.

• Coach team members in real time, provide ongoing feedback, support development planning, and serve as a trusted resource for questions, escalations, and complex or non-standard requests.

• Lead or support onboarding and training for new hires, including scheduling, documentation, process education, system readiness, and consistent integration into the team.

• Conduct or support in-person candidate interviews and assess communication skills, professional presence, and alignment with role requirements and team culture.

• Oversee the timely and accurate completion of transactions, documentation, system updates, and tracking activities, including work performed in SuccessFactors and other firm tools.

• Interface with employees, Talent Consultants, Talent leadership, and partner teams; resolve routine and moderately complex inquiries and escalate higher-risk matters with relevant context and recommended next steps.

• Use metrics, quality reviews, trend information, and client feedback to identify service risks and recommend improvements to workflows, controls, documentation, and customer experience.

• Create and maintain workstream procedures, job aids, and training materials; promote consistent application of firm policies, confidentiality requirements, and data-handling practices.

• Support local administrative counseling processes, including feedback collection, documentation, system updates, and summary reporting to appropriate leadership.

• Lead or contribute to special projects, process improvements, and technology or automation initiatives that strengthen operational efficiency and service delivery.

Skills and attributes for success

How your skills and experience will make an impact:

• Strong client-service orientation with the judgment to balance responsiveness, consistency, confidentiality, and policy requirements.

• Ability to lead through influence, coach others, build trust, and maintain effective working relationships across a matrixed organization.

• Sound analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify root causes, evaluate options, and recommend practical solutions.

• Strong organization and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple requests, deadlines, stakeholders, and changing priorities.

• Clear written, verbal, presentation, and listening skills, including the confidence to communicate with Talent leadership and key client contacts.

• Ability to work independently with limited supervision while knowing when to consult or escalate.

To qualify for the role, you must demonstrate

• Five or more years of progressive experience in human resources operations, shared services, Talent coordination, or a related field.

• Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and common case-management, tracking, and HR systems.

• Broad working knowledge of HR policies, procedures, employee life-cycle processes, and the importance of safeguarding confidential information.

• Demonstrated experience training, mentoring, coordinating, or providing day-to-day direction to less experienced colleagues.

• Ability to work flexibly across time zones and during peak business periods, as needed.

Ideally, you'll also have

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience.

• Experience in a professional services or large, matrixed organization.

• Experience supporting process improvement, automation, quality assurance, or service-level reporting.

What working at EY offers

This role provides broad exposure to Talent operations and the opportunity to strengthen team capability, improve the employee and client experience, and build trusted relationships across the Talent organization. The role offers meaningful leadership experience while continuing to develop operational, technology, communication, and people-development skills.

About EY

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible. Join us in building a better working world.

Negocio:

• Conocer y analizar las necesidades de negocio actuales y futuras para alinearlas a las herramientas y procesos de talento humano, buscando responder a los gaps de gestión y desempeño de los equipos mediante la implementación de las políticas de talento vigentes y/o solicitar a las áreas especialistas nuevas soluciones de gestión o rediseño de estructura, que permitan cubrir las demandas del negocio, realizando seguimiento, evaluación y mejora continua de todos los procesos que implementa.

• Responder a la línea en forma rápida y adecuada a sus necesidades objetivas.

postings.title: Sales Trainer US
postings.descriptionText:
TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market .

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do:

• Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.

• Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.

• Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.

• Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.

• Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.

• Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.

• Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.

• Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.

• Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements:

• Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.

• 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.

• Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.

• Strong communication and facilitation skills — you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.

• Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.

• Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.

• Energy and charisma to motivate people, maintain engagement, and create a positive but demanding learning environment.

• Comfort with digital tools and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including CRM, telephony, messaging, presentation, and online training tools.

• Ability to work remotely with stable internet connectivity and availability aligned with Colombia working hours.

Nice-to-have:

• Experience in B2C sales, especially high-ticket, consultative, or fast-paced sales where discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing happen directly with the customer.

• Previous experience as a Sales Trainer, Sales Coach, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Sales Manager.

• Experience coaching or developing underperforming salespeople and helping them improve through practice, feedback, and structured follow-up.

• Experience working in high-volume sales environments, including call centers or similar teams.

• Experience creating or maintaining training materials, scripts, presentations, onboarding guides, or process documentation.

• Experience using AI and modern productivity tools to create or improve training content, scripts, exercises, presentations, or documentation.

• Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

What we can offer you:

• A supportive and proactive work environment.

• Competitive compensation: 1000-2000 USD Gross per month

• Fully remote and full-time collaboration.

• Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.

• Tangible results measured by student success.

postings.title: Instructional Designer, TRM Academy (Compliance)
postings.descriptionText:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The Instructional Designer on TRM Academy designs and builds the courses, certifications and learning paths that help financial institutions, crypto businesses, regulators and law enforcement understand crypto risk, apply compliance principles and combat crypto-enabled financial crime. You turn the expertise of TRM's intelligence, policy and compliance teams into published, assessment-backed training across self-paced courses, live sessions and product documentation, in multiple languages. What makes this role different: you use AI to build faster, and you own the accuracy that government agencies and financial institutions rely on when they train and certify their people.

The Impact You Will Have

• Design learning pathways for a widening range of learners. Turn the Academy's catalog into clear paths through self-paced courses, live sessions and scenario-based assessments, with a particular focus on helping compliance teams understand crypto activity, assess risk and apply regulatory requirements in practice.

• Keep TRM's certifications accurate and defensible. Run the review cycle for the Academy's certification programs. Route content and exam items to subject-matter experts for sign-off, check figures and citations against their sources, and update courses quickly as crypto risks, regulatory requirements and source material evolve.

• Turn expert knowledge into strong training. Coach subject-matter experts with editorial feedback so their expertise becomes clear, well-built courses, hands-on exercises and trainer toolkits for live delivery. Help learners connect technical and regulatory concepts to everyday compliance decisions.

• Co-own product documentation and training across TRM's platforms. Keep help content, onboarding and product training accurate and in step with releases, connecting platform capabilities to practical compliance and investigative workflows.

• Deliver content in multiple languages without losing accuracy. Run the localization workflow: first-draft translation, native-speaker review and SME sign-off for technical and regulatory material.

• Make the team faster, and prove the training works. Draft with AI and own the verification, so no unsupported figure, source or regulatory detail reaches a learner. Build reusable workflows the Academy adopts, and measure both the build time saved and learner outcomes beyond completions.

What We’re Looking For

• 3 to 5+ years of instructional design or curriculum development for adult learners, with a portfolio of published, assessment-backed courses.

• Experience building on an LMS and writing valid assessments and item banks.

• Ability to translate technical and regulatory subject-matter content into practical curriculum; familiarity with crypto compliance, anti-money laundering, sanctions or financial-crime risk is a strong plus.

• Production AI fluency: you already use AI daily to draft content, generate assessment items and speed up build and research workflows.

• Readiness to build reusable AI workflows others adopt, including item generation checked against source and comparisons of existing modules against new intelligence and regulatory developments, and to own the human verification step.

• Excellent written communication and a track record owning courses end-to-end as the single accountable owner.

About The Team

• You will join TRM Academy’s Training and Certification team, which builds engaging, mission-relevant content and teaches to every level of expertise.

• The work is intellectually demanding: you keep curriculum accurate across crypto, compliance and investigations, with an emphasis on translating evolving risks and regulatory expectations into practical education and valid certification assessments.

• Mission-first, execution-oriented culture that values speed, high build quality and measurable business impact through education.

• AI-native team: designers use AI daily to build content and ship reusable assets the whole Academy adopts.

Team Operating Rhythms

• Distributed, not distant: a team that collaborates across time zones with regular overlap for syncs and content reviews.

• Slack-first, async communication; @mention for timely responses.

• Weekly 1:1s and team syncs, plus regular content-build and review rhythms tied to launch windows.

• Close working cadence with SMEs in Intelligence, Policy and Compliance and with Product for accuracy.

Required Online And Collaboration Hours

• Schedule: Business hours with overlap across US time zones for internal syncs and content reviews.

Travel Requirements

• Schedule: Minimal; occasional travel for team or customer content sessions if needed.

Onsite Requirements

• Schedule: None required; distributed role.

Learn About TRM Speed In This Position

• Within your first 30 days, scope a requested course and stand up a V1 using AI to draft the slides, workbook and assessment, so a first version is ready to review that same month.

• Within 60 days, ship a reusable AI item-generation workflow, with items checked against source, that at least one other Academy team member adopts.

• Within 90 days, publish practical crypto compliance or certification content end-to-end, with measurable completion or assessment results, and standardize the build play so it repeats.

The following represents the estimated range of compensation for this role:

• Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

• The estimated base salary range for this role is $155,000–$175,000.

• Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

• Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

• Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

• Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

• First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

• Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

• References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

• Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

• Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To

• Accelerate repeatable workflows

• Structure and solve problems

• Improve output quality

• Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, You Should Expect

• Priorities and targets to change quickly

• Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

• A high level of personal ownership and accountability

• Close collaboration across teams and functions

• Frequent, high-touch communication

• Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

• A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

• Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

• Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

• Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy And Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating you

postings.title: Customer Onboarding Specialist - AgTech / Tecnología Agrícola
postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About The Role

As a South American Launch Specialist, you'll be one of the first people on the ground establishing Halter's presence across the region — and you'll own what it means to bring Halter to producers in Argentina, Uruguay, and Brazil for the first time.

You'll lead the rollout of Halter on new operations end-to-end: training cattle and operators, solving problems in the field, and supporting producers as they get started. You'll work directly with ganaderos and pecuaristas — on the estancia, on the fazenda, in the campo — building the onboarding experience that every future customer in the region will inherit.

This role is partially field-based. Expect roughly a 70/30 split toward time on the ground, with regular travel across Argentina, Uruguay, and Brazil. You'll be with customers where they run their cattle, and the quality of what you build depends on you being there and understanding their operations deeply..

It's practical, hands-on, and highly ownership-driven. Every operation is different, and you'll tailor each deployment to help producers build confidence with Halter. Because we're early here, your read on what's working — and what local producers actually need — feeds straight back into how we build. You'll work closely with our Product team to make sure Halter meets the realities of South American ranching, not a playbook borrowed from somewhere else.

What Your Day Could Look Like

• Own deployments from sales handoff through a smooth transition to the broader customer team

• Travel to estancias and fazendas across Argentina, Uruguay, and Brazil to deploy Halter in person

• Work directly with producers to bring Halter into their operation and support day-to-day use

• Lead training that fits the operation: practical, straightforward, and useful

• Act as the main point of contact during deployment, giving customers a clear, reliable owner

• Partner closely with Sales, Support, Product, and Operations to keep deployments coordinated across borders

• Keep deployments on track by managing timelines, aligning resources, and clearing blockers

• Solve problems quickly and adapt plans as conditions change — language, terrain, and infrastructure will all vary

• Spot patterns in the field and feed them directly to Product to shape how Halter works for the region

• Set customers up with the confidence and foundation needed for long-term success with Halter

• Whatever else it takes: This is an early-stage market entry. You’ll do what needs doing to make Halter succeed in South America.

Who Are We Looking For

• Experience working with customers: whether onboarding, supporting, deploying, or managing complex rollouts

• Genuine comfort with travel and field work

• Fluency in Spanish and English, Portuguese is a bonus.

• Confidence operating independently and keeping priorities organized

• The ability to coordinate moving pieces and keep things progressing without constant oversight

• A practical, solutions-focused mindset when challenges come up

• Comfort working cross-functionally: pulling in the right people and keeping everyone aligned

• Clear, straightforward communication

• Good judgment and the ability to adapt when plans change

• A genuine care for the people we serve and the quality of the work

• Agriculture or cattle ranching experience, especially with extensive grazing systems

English proficiency is a requirement for this role. The recruitment process will include interviews conducted in English, and a significant part of the day-to-day work will also be conducted in English. Candidates should feel comfortable communicating, participating in professional conversations, and working effectively in English. If you are not comfortable having professional conversations in English, this role may not be the right fit for you.

NICE TO HAVES

• Familiarity with the South American beef sector across one or more of Argentina, Uruguay, or Brazil

• Startup or high-growth environment experience

• Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Intercom, or similar systems

• Experience working in ag-tech

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

Implementation Consultant I

Sovos·Full-Time·Argentina

Build Your Future With Us

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

The Role

At Sovos, we're looking for an Implementation Consultant I to guide new clients through the onboarding journey, from kickoff to successful go-live. You'll manage project plans, complete configurations, deliver training, and ensure a smooth transition to our ongoing support teams, all while building strong client relationships and contributing to continuous process improvement.

More Specifically, You Will

• Serve as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the implementation process, managing project plans, timelines, risks, and issues to ensure on-time delivery and high satisfaction.

• Complete configuration tasks and document all setup details in comprehensive Client Procedures documents that support long-term success.

• Lead collaborative work sessions with clients to understand their business logic, translate requirements into technical specifications, and deliver technology-based solutions to their compliance challenges.

• Provide training to clients and execute seamless, well-documented transitions to Client Support or Compliance Services teams upon project completion.

• Leverage AI tools and identify process improvements across implementation workflows, documentation, reporting, and tooling to enhance the client onboarding experience.

• Continue service activities for clients as needed, especially during peak processing periods, ensuring continuity and support beyond initial implementation.

What You Bring to Sovos

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, highly preferred.

• You've built experience in service-related roles, ideally 1-2 years, where you've managed multiple projects, timelines, and client relationships.

• Foundational understanding of tax compliance software, SaaS implementations, or related product offerings.

• Strong time management, organizational, and decision-making skills with the ability to balance competing priorities across multiple client engagements.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English with the ability to comprehend and explain complex concepts clearly.

• Comfort with AI-assisted workflows and technology platforms including project management tools, CRM systems, and collaboration software.

• Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

The Process

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:

1

Pre-Employment Assessment

Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.

2

Video Interview

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.

3

Meeting with a Recruiter

A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.

4

Live Interviews with the Hiring Team

Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.

Life at Sovos

• Global Mentoring Programs

• AI Tools and Technology from Day 1

• Continuous Learning and Development

• Language Learning Support

• Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs

• Global Parental Leave Policy

• Comprehensive Health Insurance

• Life Insurance

• Monthly Meal Vouchers

• Gym Membership Subsidy

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.

More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.

postings.title: Customer Engineer (BigQuery)
postings.descriptionText:
Rabbit helps enterprises cut their GCP spend — and the difference between a customer who saves millions and one who churns is the engineer standing next to them during adoption. We’re hiring a Customer Engineer to be that person for our customers across the US and the broader Americas.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing engineering role. Your focus is making customers successful: gluing Rabbit into each customer’s GCP environment, getting them onboarded and integrated, and keeping them unblocked so the product delivers real savings on their workloads. You’ll work closely with the core engineering team, but your center of gravity is the customer, not the roadmap.

Initial domain: BigQuery cost optimization — slot management, reservation models, job-level optimization, query analysis at petabyte scale. As Rabbit’s optimization scope expands across GCP, so will yours.

What You’ll Actually Do

• Own technical adoption for a portfolio of enterprise customers — onboarding, configuration, and integrating Rabbit into their GCP setup until they hit first measurable savings

• Be the go-to technical contact when something breaks — investigate, debug, and fix issues across data anomalies, pipelines, and BigQuery cost questions

• Advise customers on GCP cost strategy — BigQuery reservation models, slot management, billing mechanics — and how Rabbit fits in

• Run technical Q&A, troubleshooting sessions, and hands-on workshops with customer teams

• Relay field signal back to Product and Engineering — you’ll have more customer context than anyone, and the core team builds on what you surface

• When the product genuinely can’t cover a customer need, build a custom solution to bridge the gap — but the goal is always to fold that need back into the platform, not to maintain bespoke one-offs

How We Work — AI-First, Agentic by Default

Rabbit is an AI-first company. Agentic development practices are mandatory, not optional — Claude Code, Cursor, and agent-driven workflows are how we move. You’ll use them to integrate, debug, and unblock customers in hours, not days.

You Should Have

Must-have:

• 5+ years in a technical, customer-facing role — Customer/Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, TAM, or similar — with real hands-on engineering, not just advisory

• Deep BigQuery expertise — slots, reservations, pricing models, INFORMATION_SCHEMA, query optimization. Hard requirement; we’ll test for it.

• Strong SQL, and comfort in backend code (any language) — enough to integrate, script, and debug in a customer’s environment

• Hands-on GCP experience — you’ve worked with production workloads on Google Cloud

• Customer-facing instinct — you can run a technical conversation with an enterprise team without an Account Executive holding your hand

• Fluent with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) on real production work — not just demos

• Autonomy — small team, no middle management, you own customer outcomes

Strong plus:

• GCP cost management, FinOps, or cloud billing optimization background

• Familiarity with BigQuery reservation models, slot pricing, and workload management

• Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform on GCP)

Why This Role

• Direct customer impact. You see your work land in dollars saved on real workloads, customer by customer.

• Hard problems, hands-on. BigQuery optimization at petabyte scale, real-world anomalies, messy integrations — not generic SaaS onboarding.

• Short path to the product. What you surface from the field shapes what the core team builds next.

• Own the relationship. Small team, real ownership over whether your customers succeed.

Why Join Rabbit

• Ownership from day one: Design your own pipelines, choose your own tools, architect your own solutions. We trust senior engineers and managers to make senior decisions

• Work with cutting-edge at scale: BigQuery optimization at petabyte scale, real-time anomaly detection, cost prediction algorithms — these are hard, unsolved problems.

postings.title: Partner Solutions Engineer - LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
About DevRev

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

Role Overview

The Partner Solutions Engineer (PSE) at DevRev is a customer-obsessed technical professional who plays a key role in driving partner-led growth and adoption. You will serve as the technical bridge between DevRev and our ecosystem of resellers, OEMs, system integrators, and strategic alliances.

In this role, you will lead pre-sales discovery, design custom solutions, enable technical teams at partner organizations, and act as a trusted advisor across the full partner lifecycle. You’ll collaborate closely with DevRev’s Sales, Product, and GTM teams, empowering partners to independently position, implement, and scale DevRev solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Partner Enablement & Technical Leadership

• Articulate the features, benefits, and business value of the DevRev platform.

• Translate partner business models and objectives into DevRev-aligned solutions.

• Support partner solution discovery, architecture, and proposal creation during the sales cycle.

• Deliver technical enablement programs including:

• Tailored product and solution updates

• Hands-on bootcamps, SE shadowing, and technical workshops

• Joint solution and service co-creation

• Enable partners to deliver independent pre-sales motions and contribute to regional revenue growth.

Sales & Evaluation Support

• Support demos, technical presentations, and PoCs for partner-led sales cycles.

• Guide and manage technical evaluations and proof-of-value engagements.

• Collaborate with DevRev support and product teams to resolve technical roadblocks.

• Capture and relay product feedback, partner insights, and customer pain points.

Technical Enablement Planning

• Co-create enablement plans with partner sales leaders, including:

• Certification pathways and role-based training modules

• Joint technical goals and milestone tracking

• Lead certification bootcamps and instructor-led enablement tracks.

• Host Expert Sessions to update partner SEs on product releases and best practices.

• Optimize reach and impact by scaling enablement across partner organizations.

Partner Relationship & Technical Account Management

• Develop strategic relationships with partner architects and C-level leaders.

• Conduct roadmap alignment sessions and technical QBRs.

• Build and maintain partner org charts and communication matrices.

• Champion DevRev inside partner orgs to drive mindshare and product positioning.

• Identify, qualify, and support partner-driven upsell and cross-sell motions.

• Collaborate with DevRev Field SEs and Solution Architects for co-selling and support.

Community Engagement & Thought Leadership

• Build and foster a technical partner community:

• Organize roundtables, regional events, and community forums.

• Mentor technical champions within partner orgs and elevate them through enablement tracks.

• Maintain active visibility via LinkedIn, blog posts, forums, and content contributions.

• Support media and co-marketing efforts, including reference case development and campaign support.

Qualifications & Experience

An ideal candidate for this role would bring the following background:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

• A minimum of 10 years of experience at B2B SaaS or platform vendor(s) in technical pre-sales or solutions engineering roles, of which a minimum of 5 years of experience in a partner focused role.

• Proven track record delivering technical demos, workshops, and tailored solution proposals.

• Strong technical acumen with the ability to explain complex concepts to both technical and business audiences.

• Excellent communication, storytelling, and interpersonal skills.

• Experience conducting competitive analysis, identifying partner white-space, and influencing roadmap direction.

• Willingness to travel up to 75% depending on business and partner needs, including out of country or overseas travel.

Skills & Proficiency Requirements

To thrive in this role, a DevRev Partner Solutions Engineer should have the following capabilities:

Soft Skills & Consultative Capabilities

• Consultative mindset; skilled at mapping business problems to technical solutions.

• Clear communicator with confidence presenting to technical and executive stakeholders.

• Strong partner enablement and mentoring capabilities.

• Cross-functional collaborator; works well with GTM, Product, and Customer Engineering.

• Relationship builder across C-level, solution architect, and SE personas.

Ecosystem & Platform Experience

• Familiarity with:

• DevOps & Agile: Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins

• CRM & CX: Salesforce, Zendesk, Intercom, ServiceNow, HubSpot

• Incident Management: Datadog, PagerDuty, Sentry

• Collaboration Tools: Slack, Notion, Confluence

Technical Hands-On Proficiency

• Proficient in: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Bash

• Experienced in using: REST APIs, webhooks, OpenAPI/Swagger

• Skilled with CLI tools, Git, JSON/YAML, log parsing, and basic SQL.

• Tools: Postman, Beeceptor, Docker, VS Code, GitHub.

• Exposure to low-code platforms and workflow builders.

• Frontend familiarity (React, Tailwind, Flask, HTML/CSS).

Modern Script Development & AI Tooling

• Able to rapidly prototype using:

• Cursor, Claude Code, MCP

• Comfortable with prompt design and LLM-based workflows.

• Experience with GenAI use cases like:

• Conversational AI

• Ticket deflection & triage

• AI assistants & agents

Cloud, Infrastructure & DevOps Familiarity

• Working knowledge of:

• Cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, Azure

• App architecture: middleware, APIs, frontend/backend layers

• Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes

• CI/CD: GitHub Actions, CircleCI, GitLab

• Networking basics: HTTP, DNS, auth, proxies

Application & Solution Development

• Experience modeling AI-driven workflows and SaaS use cases.

• Able to design solutions around:

• Incident resolution loops

• Product feedback cycles

• End-to-end service operations

• Co-creates embedded offerings with partners leveraging DevRev’s building blocks.

How do we work?

Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger

Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly

We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

Own the outcome

Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

That’s DevRev!

postings.descriptionText:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About The Role

Worker Operations is the team that owns end-to-end operations and support for the supply-side (the workers) of our marketplace. We are over 200 team members who serve the 400,000+ (and growing) active professionals on our marketplace. As a Worker Operations Team Lead your primary role is to be an exceptional coach for your team.

Your responsibility is to provide agents with constructive feedback, identify the root causes of performance issues, and train them to address and correct those problems. You maintain high standards for your team and aren’t afraid to say, “This needs improvement, and here’s why.” You ensure that the customer experience remains the focal point of every discussion, set SMART goals for performance improvement, and deliver feedback that aligns with our standards. You’re also hands-on, willing to dive into customer issues directly, and you become a product expert so that you can coach your agents effectively.

This is a fully remote position. Team members are expected to maintain working hours that overlap with Pacific Time (PT) and be available to work weekend shifts as needed.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

• Closely monitoring agent performance, primarily in terms of quality, productivity, and attendance metrics, with a primary goal of maintaining quality assurance scores above 90%

• Providing frequent coaching to agents based QA feedback, metrics, customer survey responses, and your own ticket observations

• Occasionally handling angry customer escalations

• Ensure schedule adherence by agents and desired productivity levels

• Maintaining coaching logs and providing regular written feedback to agents

• Comfortably navigate our support environment, which includes tools such as Zendesk, Metabase, and Amazon Connect

• Listen to team members’ feedback and resolve any challenges or conflicts

• Initiate consequence management steps in the case of low-performing team members

• Delegate tasks to high potential team members to build a culture of learning and development in the team

• Suggest and lead team building activities for team motivation

Experience

• 2+ years of coaching experience – Demonstrated success coaching individuals through structured feedback, development planning, and performance improvement.

• 2+ years of people management experience – Experience leading customer support teams, driving performance, engagement, and accountability.

• 2+ years of customer support experience – Strong foundation in delivering exceptional customer service and resolving complex customer issues.

What Success Looks Like In Worker Operations

• Customer obsessed – Puts workers at the centre of every decision and consistently delivers a world-class experience.

• Data-driven problem solver – Uses data, trends, and root cause analysis to identify issues and deliver sustainable improvements.

• Thrives in ambiguity – Adapts quickly to changing priorities, products, and processes while maintaining high performance.

• Communicates with clarity – Shares information proactively, aligns stakeholders, and provides clear, actionable feedback.

• Bias for action – Takes ownership, moves with urgency, and focuses on delivering outcomes over perfection.

• Continuously learns – Quickly develops expertise in new tools, products, and processes, applying that knowledge to improve both personal and team performance.

• Raises the talent bar – Invests in coaching, challenges others to improve, and builds a culture of accountability and excellence.

• Resilient under pressure – Maintains sound judgement and consistent execution during periods of high volume, incidents, and operational change.

System Requirements

• Minimum 15Mbps wired internet connection

• Minimum i5 processor or equivalent

• Minimum 12GB Ram

• Quiet working environment

• Steady power and internet connection

Hiring Process

• Application Review

• Case Study

• First Round Interview/Case Discussion

• Interview with Head of Worker Support

Quick Note On Scammers

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

Compensation Range: $30K - $70K

Build Your Future With Us

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

The Role

You'll work with complex, large-scale implementations and collaborate across teams to deliver exceptional client experiences.

More Specifically, You Will

• Serve as the primary point of contact for large, complex client implementations, managing project plans, risks, and resolution of issues from kickoff through transition.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to complete configuration tasks and deliver thorough solution architecture documentation that supports clients long-term.

• Prepare and manage detailed project plans across multiple initiatives, balancing scope, schedule, and quality while keeping stakeholders informed and aligned.

• Lead dynamic working sessions with clients to design technology solutions for business challenges, ensuring a seamless and documented handoff after implementation.

• Provide training, coaching, and mentoring to both clients and teammates, supporting continuous improvement during peak processing times and beyond.

• Identify and implement process improvements across tools, templates, and workflows to strengthen the customer onboarding experience.

• Leverage AI tools and emerging technologies to streamline configuration workflows and enhance project delivery efficiency.

What You Bring to Sovos

• You've built solid experience in client implementation, project management, or a related discipline.

• You bring strong knowledge of tax rules and processes relevant to the product market you'll be supporting.

• You have excellent time management, organizational, and decision-making skills with the ability to juggle multiple priorities.

• You communicate clearly and effectively in English, both written and verbal, and can explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.

• You're comfortable working with AI-assisted tools and workflows to improve configuration and delivery outcomes.

• Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

The Process

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:

1

2

Video Interview

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.

Meeting with a Recruiter

Live Interviews with the Hiring Team

Life at Sovos

We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.

About Remote

What this job can offer you

Remote is building the infrastructure that makes global payroll and employment possible for everyone, everywhere. We're founded on the principle that where someone lives should never limit what they can achieve, and we operate exactly that way.

Step into the exciting role of HR AI and Automation Operations Lead , a position that offers a dynamic blend of operational and technical responsibilities within the EOR Operations vertical.

EOR Operations teams help Remote customers and their employees navigate the employment journey with speed, ease, consistency, responsiveness, and care. In support of our mission, you will design and implement intelligent automation systems that connect data across platforms, eliminate manual tasks, and enable scalable, high-performance operations on a global stage. This role sits at the intersection of HR, technology, and process excellence - ideal for someone passionate about streamlining complex workflows and leveraging AI to drive impact on massive volumes of data, tasks and customer needs.

In your capacity as HR AI and Automation Operations Lead, you will be part of a peer group supporting our globally distributed HR Operations teams and partner with cross-functional teams in Operations, Product, Design, Engineering and IT.

Come and join us as a critical partner to enable Remote’s operations as we continue to scale!

What You Bring

• A manager of one who operates with strong ownership and autonomy, able to identify what needs to be done, set direction, and deliver outcomes independently in a fast-moving environment.

• Comfortable moving from “scout to scale”, taking initiatives from early exploration through to sustainable delivery with solid project management and stakeholder engagement skills.

• Ideal candidate has experience in HR Operations or Shared Services across a wide range of operational contexts, with a strong understanding of user experience, operational efficiency, and demonstrated experience building automation in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments such as hiring, employment or payroll.

• Strong understanding of sensitive data lifecycle risk and data privacy obligations, and how these materially influence system design, integration and automation decisions.

• Extensive hands-on experience of using low-code workflow tools (Zapier, Make, Retool, n8n or similar) to orchestrate cross‑system flows and stitch agents into a broader process landscape and role-based access controls.

• Comfortable working with light scripting (e.g. Python, TypeScript, JavaScript) to build custom agents, API integrations, webhooks or message queues and glue services.

• Excellent communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to lead complex conversations independently and constructively.

• Writes and speaks fluent English.

• It's not required to have experience working remotely, but considered a plus.

Key Responsibilities

• Automation Strategy & Ownership:

• Use customer and employee feedback, alongside operational data and insights, to inform improvements to the HR experience, quality, and outcomes.

• Scope and deliver as the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) multi-phase initiatives across process redesign, tooling, and change management from planning, prototype, launch and optimization.

• Workflow Optimization & System Integration:

• Map operational processes, identify bottlenecks, and architect end-to-end automated workflows that increase speed, accuracy, and scalability.

• Build and maintain data pipelines via native connectors or APIs across HRIS, case management, payroll, and other tools to ensure seamless data flow, event triggers and reporting.

• Low-Code Development & AI Implementation:

• Leverage low-code/no-code platforms (like Zapier, Make, Retool, n8n or similar) to prototype and deploy rapid automations.

• Deploy and govern AI tools or agents (e.g., for document processing, query triage, policy guidance, data auditing) that enhance efficiency, compliance and user experience.

• Design and Implement multi-agent patterns (e.g. maker/checker setups, routing to specialised agents) and governance policies (e.g. retries, fallbacks, guardrails), embedding appropriate human oversight in employment-related workflows to ensure compliant and responsible AI deployment.

• Build and maintain automation observability and governance (e.g. tracing, logging, agent runs evaluation) including access controls and auditability suitable for HR data.

• Data Analytics & Insights:

• Develop and maintain fit-for-purpose operational data models to support reporting, audit, compliance and data integrity initiatives within HR Operations.

• Leadership & Team Enablement:

• Foster strong cross-functional collaboration and support effective change management, training, adoption and continuous improvement of AI & Automation driven solutions.

Application process

• 3. Interview with team member or cross-functional colleague

This role is focused on functional support, client setup and configuration, troubleshooting, issue diagnosis, and user support across the core GP application.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics GP, understands how GP has evolved across several versions, and is comfortable troubleshooting both application-level issues and GP client workstation/environment issues.

Requirements:

Key Responsibilities

• Provide day-to-day support for Microsoft Dynamics GP clients.

• Diagnose and resolve functional issues across core GP modules.

• Triage support cases, gather relevant details, and identify root causes.

• Assist clients with configuration questions, transaction processing issues, posting errors, reporting questions, and month-end/year-end processes.

• Use SQL queries where appropriate to investigate data, validate transactions, and support issue diagnosis.

• Escalate technical or development-related issues with clear documentation and supporting evidence.

• Work with clients to reproduce issues and confirm resolution steps.

• Document findings, resolutions, and recommendations in the support case system.
