postings.title: AI-First Copy & Community Manager
postings.descriptionText:
💸 USD 24,000 - USD 28,000 per year, on a full-time, contractor contract
🌎 Fully remote working!
✨ Create sharp copy and meaningful community conversations for globally recognised brands in US TV and entertainment.
🔍 Work with AI agents, reusable skills and editorial context libraries at the centre of your craft.
💻 High-end, fast computer
💡 All the latest software and productivity tools you’ll need

About the Role

You write copy that sounds right for the brand and gives people a reason to care. You also know how to join a fan conversation: when a thoughtful reply adds something, when humour fits, and when an issue needs escalating. This is a hands-on role owning the relationship between a brand and its community through strong copy and thoughtful engagement.

Storm is an AI-native agency. AI tools and agentic workflows are central to how our teams work, and we hire people who want to work that way from day one.

AI-first doesn't mean AI-generated. The work itself is craft: finding the right angle, shaping a line and responding with judgment. You direct agents through Codex, using reusable skills and context libraries of brand voice, source material and editorial examples to produce copy variants, edit working documents and run structured checks. You catch the bland line, unsupported claim or reply that misses the mood, and make it better. Your editorial judgment stays in charge of every word.

You'll learn the ground first: what we make and the bar it has to hit. Social copy that earns attention. Community replies that make the brand feel like part of the fandom. Then you'll work from Storm's stack of AI and creative tools, and play a real part in improving how this work gets done.

About Storm Ideas

Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.
Storm brings together entertainment, fandom, creative production, community and technology.

We help major brands build stronger relationships with their audiences, while using AI to improve how that work is created, checked and delivered.

We are a remote-first, fast-moving company with established clients, a growing team, and a strong appetite for better tools, better systems, and better ways of working. AI is central to how we operate — every team, every role, this one included.

What You Will Do

• Write engaging, on-brand social copy for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, YouTube and other relevant platforms, with AI tools and agentic workflows as your default way of working.

• Review and refine social copy for clarity, accuracy and audience fit, adapting each piece to its platform and purpose.

• Learn each brand's voice, audience and subject matter deeply enough to judge when AI output fits. Maintain and evolve tone-of-voice guidance, source context and examples that people and agents can use consistently.

• Fact-check against supplied sources and proofread everything you deliver, including anything AI touched. Check names, claims, grammar, punctuation, links, accessibility and platform-native formatting; treat rights and brand safety as fixed points.

• Pitch social content angles and approaches that improve engagement and visibility. Apply copywriting best practice, using performance signals and feedback to improve attention, reach and the quality of the writing.

• Engage communities day to day: respond to comments and join relevant conversations on fan, talent and partner content. Keep replies timely, appropriate and consistent with the brand's personality and engagement approach.

• Stay close to culture, fandom, trends and platform developments. Surface timely engagement opportunities that suit the audience, and feed what you learn from conversations back into copy and content ideas.

• Use agents for repeatable work such as preparing copy variants, checking against source material and summarising community themes. Review their work critically, make the editorial decisions and keep useful records for clear handovers.

• Prioritise deadlines and responsive community work, balance a shared workload with colleagues across time zones, and adapt constructively to feedback and changing priorities.

• Keep improving how the work gets done: encode your best methods into reusable skills and workflows that agents and teammates can pick up and run, and teach what works so the whole team levels up with you. Test new capabilities against real briefs, compare the results with your current approach, and update shared methods when they improve quality or reliability.

Success means distinctive, accurate copy; timely community responses that fit the conversation; and improvements that reduce avoidable revisions and help teammates deliver consistently. You can show what your methods changed, using examples, feedback and useful measures.

What We Are Looking For

• Excellent written English and a strong editorial ear. Your writing shows precision, range, personality and an ability to adapt tone without losing clarity.

• Community judgment: you understand fan behaviour, can write a natural response and recognise when to engage, pause or escalate. You bring a real interest in TV, film and online culture.

• Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI agents in work, study or personal projects. You can show how you build context, direct production and checks, reject weak output and improve the result. You have examples beyond asking a chatbot for ideas.

• Confidence working with editorial documents, social platforms and AI tools. You may bring a traditional copy background with a developed AI practice, or have built your craft using AI from the start. Either path works here.

• Sound fact-checking and accessibility knowledge, with the attention to detail to hold the quality bar at speed. You can explain the choices behind your copy and replies.

• A systems mindset and ownership: you spot repeatable work, improve it and follow through. You can demonstrate a reusable method and explain how you help someone else use it successfully.

• Clear communication, reliable organisation and thoughtful asynchronous handovers. You share work well, respond to feedback and learn new tools with an eye for what improves the result.

What It's Like To Work Here

Modern Tech Stack
You’ll work with a supported AI stack, shared context and reusable skills, backed by our AI Operations team. You’ll build on established tools and methods, contribute improvements, and help colleagues put them into practice.

Your Methods Can Become How The Team Works
We actively encourage people to bring forward better ways of working. When a method you develop proves itself, you won't just use it quietly: you'll encode it as a skill others can run, teach it to the team, and watch it become the new standard, with your name on it.

Team-based
Join an international, remote-first team of 175+ people who value skill, initiative and collaboration. You work closely with copy and account colleagues and contribute to a shared quality bar.

Flexibility
Fully remote-first. You will work 37.5 hours per week within a 9am–5:30pm Pacific Time schedule, Monday–Friday, collaborating with colleagues across time zones.

Recruitment Process

Apply with your CV, a short note explaining your fit for the role, and writing samples or a portfolio. Samples are required; personal projects count. Social copy and community-response examples are especially useful.

Shortlisted applicants complete self-recorded video questions and a short, time-boxed copy and community practical task as one screening stage.

If successful, you'll meet Tania Pardisi, Senior Copy Manager, and Nicola Taghizadeh, Chief Creative Officer, together for an interview. We'll discuss your work, your approach to community relationships and your experience using AI, and answer your questions about the role and team.

Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway if this sounds like how you already work. We are more interested in your operational judgement, reliability, follow-through, and ability to use modern tools well than in a perfect traditional CV.

postings.title: Product Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Equipo de Producto · Houm · Proptech (YC W21) · Santiago híbrido · Argentina remoto · Chile, Argentina

Todo el mundo habla de agentes de IA. Pocos los ponen a trabajar de verdad en un producto que cobra arriendo, firma contratos y atiende a miles de personas todos los días. Esa es la capa donde se gana la pelea: software en producción, con ownership, y con IA como fuerza multiplicadora. Es justo donde vas a trabajar.

En Houm ya tenemos agentes y sistemas corriendo en producción, y para que sigan funcionando y escalen a todo lo que viene necesitamos a alguien con 1–3 años construyendo software de verdad, que entregue sin que le digan cada paso, y que use IA (Cursor, Claude, Copilot) como parte del oficio, no como anécdota.

Qué vas a hacer y con qué

Vas a diseñar, construir y operar servicios y features de producto: APIs, backends, integraciones, a veces frontend. Vas a manejar el producto en su totalidad: desde la definición del problema hasta la implementación, medición y evolución en producción. Vas a tomar un problema de negocio, dejarlo claro, shippearlo con tests, y dejar el contexto listo para el siguiente. No es un rol de "ticket cerrado y me voy": lo que construyas vive en producción en Chile, México y Colombia.

Este rol es versátil de verdad: vas a partir cerca del producto, pero hacia dónde crezcas depende de ti y de lo que descubras que te apasiona. Acá nadie se queda haciendo lo mismo por años.

El equipo (esto es lo que más nos enorgullece)

Somos un equipo de producto y tecnología chico, cercano y ameno, pero con una cantidad de desafíos casi infinita. Acá todos son máquinas: gente capaz, técnica y humanamente, de tomar problemas difíciles y sacarlos adelante. No hay egos ni capas eternas, hay personas buenas resolviendo cosas grandes.

Y estamos subidos con todo al boom de la IA, transformando cómo opera Houm de punta a punta. Sabemos que los primeros en llegar son los que ganan, así que apostamos a movernos rápido: probar, equivocarnos rápido y aprender, antes que quedarnos atrás esperando la certeza perfecta. Si te gusta aprender rápido y que las cosas se muevan, tienes un pie adentro.

Lo que de verdad nos importa

Antes que cualquier tecnología, buscamos una forma de ser:

Autodidacta . Cuando no sabes algo, lo aprendes. No esperas que te lleven de la mano.
Inquieto o inquieta. Te aburre quedarte quieto y siempre andas buscando cómo mejorar las cosas.
Motivado por la IA. No le tienes miedo: la usas (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, lo que sea) y te emociona lo que se puede construir con ella hoy. Sabes cuándo confiar y cuándo validar.
Buena persona , fácil de trabajar, que se explica bien con cualquiera.

¿Y lo técnico?

No necesitas saber nuestro stack de memoria el día 1. Sí necesitas base sólida y velocidad de aprendizaje. Lo que no se enseña es la actitud, y esa es justo la que andamos buscando.

En el día a día vas a estar cerca de esto (suma fuerte si ya lo has tocado):

Backend: Python (APIs / servicios; Django o FastAPI son un plus)
Frontend / producto: TypeScript y React (no hace falta ser especialista; sí haber construido UI real)
Datos: SQL y/o MongoDB; modelar y consultar sin miedo
Cómo trabajamos: Git, PRs, tests; Docker; algo de nube (AWS ideal)
IA en el oficio: Cursor / Claude / Copilot usados de verdad (prompt → validar → shippear)

Ideal: cómodo en Python o TypeScript y con ganas de moverte al otro. No buscamos alguien que solo haga tickets o solo scripts sueltos.

Lo único no negociable

Título (o próximo a egresar) de Ingeniería en Computación, Informática, Software o Civil Industrial con foco en TI/software.
Entre 1 y 3 años (aprox.) en el mercado: este rol no es junior-junior ni “arquitecto de 10 años”.
Actitud abierta a cómo trabajamos con IA. Si te resiste el cambio de tooling, este no es el lugar.

Lo que ofrecemos

Modalidad: Remoto a menos que estés en Chile (en este caso sería híbrido, 2 días presencial).
30 días de vacaciones
Tarde libre en tu cumpleaños (y el de tu hijo/a)
5 días extra de licencia por paternidad

Si eres esta persona, postula. Nos encantaría conocerte.

Escríbenos a postula.producto@houm.com con tu CV y pretensión de renta.

postings.descriptionText:
Role Title: Senior Mobile Software Engineer

Role Type: Contractor (~15 hrs a week)

Location: Remote

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

As an expert, you will create Reinforcement Learning Environments that test an AI model’s ability to solve complex mobile software engineering problems related to fixing code, creating features, refactoring code, and optimizing performance. You will be tasked with creating a reproducible environment and a golden reference solution for each problem.

Scope of Work

• Create realistic, interesting, and extremely challenging mobile coding tasks for frontier AI models using your preferred repositories.

• Design problems that require strong mobile engineering skills, such as tracking down subtle bugs, building non-trivial features, handling application state and lifecycle, or improving performance.

• Develop tasks relevant to your expertise: cross-platform applications using TypeScript, JavaScript, or Dart; iOS applications using Swift; or Android applications using Kotlin.

• For each task, define the problem, build a reproducible environment, and write deterministic verifiers that accept correct solutions across different valid implementations while rejecting incorrect, incomplete, or hard-coded approaches.

• Provide a reference solution showing how the task can be solved.

Preferred Qualifications

• Significant hands-on expertise in at least one of the following mobile development tracks:

• Cross-platform:TypeScript or JavaScript with React Native, or Dart with Flutter.

• iOS:Swift with SwiftUI or UIKit.

• Android:Kotlin with Jetpack Compose or the Android View system.

• Deep understanding of mobile application architecture, state management, asynchronous programming, and application lifecycle.

• Proven ability to debug complex mobile applications, resolve bugs, and deliver effective performance improvements.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum weekly submission requirements apply and will be communicated during onboarding.

Start Timeline & Availability

About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

• Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.

• Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.

• Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.

• Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.

• Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Position

Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and make it hold up in the real environment.

This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer . You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are debugging why an agent’s tool-calling loop degraded after a context change. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday.

On this track, your edge is application engineering: you make agents real inside the client’s actual systems, workflows, and delivery pipelines.

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up.

How We Approach The Work

FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment:

• Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec.

• Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology.

• Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why.

• Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value.

Consultative Discovery

Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch.

• Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes.

• Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually.

• Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two.

• Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success.

• Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with “why,” “how do you know,” and “what happens today when…” — without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better.

• Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology.

What You'll Do

• Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business and engineering stakeholders. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. Come back with a scoped, defensible point of view.

• Structure the process and the spec. For any business or engineering process being automated, map the current state, decision points, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably.

• Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end — orchestration, context and retrieval architecture, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and the boundaries between deterministic and non-deterministic components.

• Build. Ship working systems — agents, multi-step automations, internal tooling, integration layers. You are hands-on. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware.

• Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build: build, test, release, environments.

• Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of professional software development experience with at least one mainstream production stack (TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java, C#/.NET, or Go).

• 1 - 4 years of professional experience building and shipping LLM-powered and agentic AI systems beyond prototypes or demos.

• Advanced English is required.

• Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.

• Hands-on experience with frontier AI developer tools including Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenAI Codex.

• Proven experience evaluating current-state environments and defining technical roadmaps.

• Demonstrated experience with APIs, service design, event-driven and distributed systems, and data modeling.

• Experience designing and owning CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, release, environments, and deployment processes.

• Strong understanding of context and specification engineering to produce reliable AI output.

• Solid understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including APIs, webhooks, event streams, iPaaS platforms such as n8n or MuleSoft, and MCP.

• Track record of leading client-facing discovery calls, asking "why" before "how" to decompose unstructured business problems.

• Skilled at exercising end-to-end delivery ownership and managing project scope without requiring product manager supervision.

• Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.

• Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.

• Forensic attention to detail.

• A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.

• Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams.

• Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.

• Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.

• Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Strong Plus

• Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems.

• Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases.

• Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing).

• Pre-sales support: discovery calls, SOW and estimate shaping, technical proposal defense.

• Process mining, operations analysis, or transformation consulting background.

• Client enablement and training — building the client team’s capability, not just the system.

• Prior consulting or agency environment; comfort with ambiguity and multiple accounts.

Work Authorization Requirements

• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.

• FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

• Competitive pay.

• 100% remote work.

• The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.

• Continuing education opportunities.

• Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

postings.title: Senior SDET, Agentic Quality
postings.descriptionText:
About Onfleet

Onfleet’s mission is to power the future of commerce by enabling businesses of all sizes to move goods more efficiently and delightfully . Our product includes intuitive smartphone apps for drivers, a powerful modern web dashboard for logistics teams, and automatic notifications and real-time tracking for recipients. Onfleet powers millions of deliveries every week for thousands of businesses around the world across a range of industries, from grocery and prepared meals to pharmacy, flowers, and furniture.

About The Role

Onfleet is hiring two senior SDETs to shape how our engineering teams build and trust automated quality. At Onfleet, the team that builds a feature owns its quality. Developers write and maintain their own tests. Your job is to make those teams better at it: you pair with them, teach, review, and find the cases they missed. You will not be the person who tests everyone else's work.

Together with our quality leads, you’ll own our test frameworks and the shared quality tooling every team depends on. You’ll also do feature development in production code and internal tooling. You’ll be part of our core quality engineering group, sometimes embedded on one team and sometimes working across several.

You’ll start by taking ownership of our existing automation and making it more reliable and complete, alongside greenfield work on new platform services. We measure this role by what the teams can do because you were there.

How We Work

We code using agents, and nearly 100% of our code is written this way. Generating code is the easy part. Knowing what good looks like, and holding the bar, is the job. The engineers who thrive here are scrutinizing and questioning: they reject AI slop and catch the wrong call before it ships.

Every engineer helps improve how we work instead of only following it. For this role that means building and improving the agentic tooling itself: test generation, review, verification, and the workflows around them.

We are candid and have a low ego. Challenge us on tooling direction, and expect to be challenged back.

What You’ll Do

• Strengthen the current suite. Improve reliability, extend coverage, and modernize patterns. A flaky test is a failing test.

• Own the test frameworks. Unit, integration, and end-to-end, treated with the same care as production code.

• Own the quality gates in CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous delivery). Pipelines, checks, and gates, so standards are enforced by the system and not by people.

• Build agentic quality tooling. Extend the agents and workflows we use for test design, review, and verification.

• Raise the bar through teams. Pair on test design, review code, help make hard-to-reach code testable, and write things down so the practice outlives any one person.

• Ask the testability question early. In planning, ask how we'll test it and how we'll know it broke in production.

• Know when a release is healthy. Metrics, dashboards and alerts that tell us something is wrong before a customer does, and that tell a team whether a release is safe to keep rolling out.

• Ship features. Full-stack work in production code and internal tooling, alongside the teams you support.

What You'll Bring (required)

• 8 or more years of professional software development experience, in any role.

• 5 or more years where building and maintaining test automation was a core part of your job, as an SDET, test automation engineer, or software engineer who owned test infrastructure. Your title matters less than the work.

• You build software, not just tests: test frameworks, internal tools, CI tooling, or product features. You want feature development in production code and internal tooling to be part of your job here.

• Depth across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, including hands-on work with a browser framework such as Playwright or Cypress.

• Hands-on CI ownership: you have created, configured, or fixed a CI pipeline (GitHub Actions or equivalent), not just used one.

• A track record of being the person who drove automated test coverage on a team, whatever your role was.

• Working knowledge of DevOps practice: how code is built, deployed and monitored in production. You have added metrics, dashboards or alerts so a team knew when something broke.

• Daily professional use of AI coding agents, and experience building or improving agentic tooling, not just using it.

• A multiplier mindset: you get your satisfaction from the team shipping safer and faster, not from your own test count.

• Excellent written and spoken English, roughly C1 level, and experience working day to day on an international team.

Nice To Have

• Mobile development (Android or iOS) and mobile test automation, using native frameworks such as Espresso or XCUITest, or cross-platform tools such as Appium or Maestro.

• TypeScript, Node.js, and React.

• Rust, or another statically typed language.

• Clear evidence of driving CI/CD practice for a whole team or company.

• Production canaries and progressive delivery: you have used production signals (error rates, latency, business metrics) to decide whether a release continues or rolls back, through canaries, feature flags or automated rollback.

• Test data and environment management: getting a realistic system into a known state quickly and repeatably.

• Test-driven development (TDD).

• AWS and cloud-native services.

Location and Benefits:

• Remote, open to candidates based in Canada or Latin America.

• The team works on US Pacific Time. You'll need to reliably work a schedule that frequently matches US Pacific business hours (9am to 5pm PT).

• Flexible PTO.

• Laptop and work-from-home setup stipend.

• Monthly technology stipends (internet and AI tooling).

Onfleet is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Onfleet's culture is one that strongly values diversity in its workplace and we are committed to working with potential team members who can bring diverse perspectives and experience to our company and culture.

We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law.

We highly encourage members of underrepresented groups to apply and we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $70,000 to $95,000 USD per year for candidates in both Canada and Latin America, depending on experience, skills, and background. Where an offer lands within that range reflects the depth and experience a candidate brings to the role.

How We Hire

You need an identity-verified LinkedIn profile to apply. That's the free "Verified" badge, the shield icon next to your name. We check for it, and applications without it don't move forward.

Before any offer, we verify your identity and work history. That includes a live video ID check and reference calls. We use AI, automated systems, and a person to review applications: every application that meets the requirements is also read by an engineering leader or a recruiter. If you misrepresent your identity or experience, the process ends.

• Lead a team of developers on HubSpot integrations, migrations and custom builds
• Plan projects, break work into tasks, and assign and confirm hours each week
• Keep delivery on schedule and step in early when someone is blocked or falling behind
• Set coding standards, review pull requests and mentor developers

Build and own the technical work
• Design and build backend services, APIs, and integrations between HubSpot and other systems
• Plan and run data migrations into HubSpot, including mapping, cleanup, validation and cutover
• Work hands-on with the HubSpot APIs, custom objects, webhooks, private apps and custom-code workflows

Own quality and the client relationship
• Run QA on every project: test plans, UAT and sign-off before anything goes live
• Be the technical point of contact for clients and explain progress, risks and decisions clearly
• Keep projects, tasks and time tracked in HubSpot and our project tools

What You Bring
•Years of professional backend development (Node.js, Python, PHP or similar)
• Hands-on experience with HubSpot APIs, integrations or migrations
• Experience leading developers and managing projects end-to-end: planning, estimating, hours, and delivery
• A disciplined QA process. You don't ship untested work.
• Confidence speaking with clients and explaining technical work to non-technical people
• Fluent English
• Based in Latin America, with daily overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours
• HubSpot or project management certifications (PMP, Scrum or similar) are a strong advantage

What Success Looks Like
• Projects go live on time, on budget, and fully tested
• Your team knows its priorities every week, and hours are planned and confirmed
• Clients understand where their project stands without having to chase for updates
• Bugs are caught in QA, not by the client

Why Join Wendt Partners
• Fully remote. Work from anywhere, with a team spread across several countries.
• Paid time off. Company holidays and year-end closure.
• Employee Assistance Program. Confidential financial and mental health support.
• Real leadership. You lead the development team and own delivery from start to finish, instead of being one developer among many.

• International clients in North America, the UK and Europe, and Australia and Asia-Pacific.
• Continuous learning support. Access to Udemy, plus financial grants for further education where relevant to your role.
• Room to grow. A lean team where strong delivery is noticed and rewarded.

Compensation
Competitive monthly compensation in line with experience.

Interview Process

• Application form and short video introduction

• Technical interview with a senior team member

• Final conversation with our Head of Operations

• Reference checks

How to Apply: Apply through our application form (about 15 minutes; please have your CV ready and record a 3–4 minute video): 👉 https://forms.fillout.com/t/dtnQfWwW7Nus

Wendt Partners is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from every background.

postings.title: SSr iOS Developer
postings.descriptionText:
En Baufest, nuestra misión es mejorar la vida con tecnología, generando un impacto positivo en la sociedad. Por ello, buscamos un/a iOS Developer SSr para sumarse a nuestro equipo de profesionales.

Responsabilidades

• Implementar pantallas y funcionalidades a partir de especificaciones y diseños en Figma, usando el design system interno.

• Integrar las pantallas con los servicios del BFF.

• Corregir bugs y hacer mejoras sobre código existente.

• Escribir tests unitarios de lo que desarrolla.

• Abrir PRs y participar en code reviews.

• Estimar las tareas propias y comunicar avances y bloqueos.

• Usar herramientas de IA generativa como asistente, siguiendo los lineamientos del equipo.

Requisitos

• Mínimo 2 años de experiencia profesional en desarrollo iOS nativo.

• Swift 5.x.

• Experiencia práctica con UIKit y SwiftUI.

• Uso de async/await y manejo del main thread.

• MVVM e inyección de dependencias por protocolos.

• Tests unitarios con XCTest.

• Integración con APIs REST/JSON.

• Git y trabajo con PRs.

• Disposición para aprender y recibir feedback.

• Disponibilidad para asistir híbrido en oficinas en CABA

Requisitos deseables

• Combine.

• Swift Package Manager y CocoaPods.

• Firebase (Crashlytics, Remote Config).

• SwiftLint.

• Experiencia en apps con gran base de usuarios, banca o fintech.

Te ofrecemos

• BAU COMPENSATIONS: Evaluación anual de desempeño y revisión de categorización.

• BAU LUNCH: Recibirás un cupón de Pedidos Ya cada viernes del mes

• BAU INTERNET: Reintegro mensual parcial de tu factura

• BAU ANTI-TRAFFIC: En caso de que tu contratación sea en modalidad Híbrida, tendrás opción de elegir tu rango de horario laboral mientras lo avale el proyecto.

• BAU UTILITIES: ¡Luego de trabajar 4 años con la misma notebook en Baufest, será tuya!

• BAU FAMILY: Maternidad y Paternidad. Softlanding para las madres baufesianas y Paternidad (10 días hábiles de licencia). Flexibilidad horaria planificada

• BAU HEALTH: Medicina prepaga de primer nivel para grupo familiar; Reintegro trimestrales por actividad deportiva

• BAU DAYs: Día de cumpleaños Libre

• BAU ACADEMY: Clases de Inglés in-company; Certificaciones y capacitaciones a cargo de Baufest; Pro Profes (días extra de estudios, premios para estudiantes Universitarios/Terciarios/Posgrados)

• BAU HOME: Luego de 2 años en Baufest, si tienes que cambiar tu residencia y mudarte recibirás una orden de compra para acompañarte en este gran paso

• BAU REFERIDOS: Participa por interesantes premios al referir a tus colegas

• BAU LANGUAGE: Beneficios adicionales por acreditar un nivel de inglés B2/C1/C2

¡Postúlate y sé parte de un equipo inclusivo donde todo pueden crecer!

Baufest promueve la igualdad de oportunidades y no discrimina por razones de Nacionalidad, género, edad, religión, orientación sexual, discapacidad, ni por ninguna otra característica protegida por la ley.

¡Te esperamos!

Baufest protege sus datos personales conforme a las leyes locales de protección de datos aplicables en cada país y siguiendo buenas prácticas de seguridad de la información alineadas con la norma ISO 27001. Su información será tratada con estricta confidencialidad y utilizada únicamente para fines de evaluación y selección.

postings.title: Lead UI Technical Artist (Unreal Engine 5)
postings.descriptionText:
We are looking for a Lead UI Technical Artist to define the core systems, materials, and motion language that unify high-end game UI across platforms in Unreal Engine. You will act as a force multiplier for UX/UI by building polished, performant UI tech art solutions and mentoring the team.

Responsibilities

• Define UI tech art systems, materials, and motion language that others build on

• Craft highly polished and performant UI tech art solutions using materials, UMG, animation, FX, blueprints, lighting, and camera tools

• Build consistent visual patterns for motion, FX, transitions, scale, and proportion across the UI

• Create Sequencer-driven animated transitions and cinematic camera beats that enhance UI feel

• Establish forward-looking templates, thematics, and principles for reusable UI tech art

• Plan cross-platform adaptation strategies balancing fidelity and performance constraints

• Own tooling, pipelines, and UI tech art asset management to improve team throughput

About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

• Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.

• Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.

• Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.

• Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.

• Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a Senior Backend Engineer Tech Lead (3-4 month long).

• You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For

• 6+ years of professional software engineering experience.

• 2+ years of experience in technical leadership influencing architecture and engineering direction.

• Advanced English is required.

• Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.

• Expertise in Node.js and TypeScript.

• Track record of architecting Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) systems and robust API middleware specialized for mobile platforms.

• Demonstrated experience working with AWS cloud services (specifically EC2, ECS, Lambda, ElastiCache, S3, and CloudFront).

• Solid background in MongoDB and optimizing backend deployment pipelines.

• Experienced with Salesforce OCAPI/API, CMS-driven content management, and mobile-specific third-party integrations.

• Strong history of designing and securing scalable microservices and event-driven architectures for high-scale e-commerce systems.

• Comfortable working with AI development tools, including LLM integration (LangChain or LlamaIndex) and agentic workflows.

• Skilled at representing engineering teams in client-facing interactions and collaborating with external vendors.

• Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.

• Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.

• Forensic attention to detail.

• A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.

• Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams.

• Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.

• Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.

• Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Nice To Have

We’re Seeking Engineers Who Are AI-enthusiastic In Their Workflow. Professional Experience Or Personal Project Work With The Following Is a Significant Plus

• Cursor, Windsurf, or Google Antigravity.

• Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Copilot CLI.

Work Authorization Requirements

• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.

• FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

• Competitive pay.

• 100% remote work.

• The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.

• Continuing education opportunities.

• Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

postings.title: Back End Developer (AI Infrastructure)
postings.descriptionText:
About The Role

What if the code you write could directly power the AI systems shaping how millions of people interact with technology? We're looking for Back End Developers in Buenos Aires to design, build, and optimize the server-side systems and APIs that drive cutting-edge AI products — from data pipelines and model-serving infrastructure to scalable microservices that handle real-world traffic at scale.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. Whether you're a seasoned engineer looking for meaningful project work or a strong developer ready to apply your skills to AI-adjacent infrastructure, this is your chance to build things that matter.

• Organization: Alignerr

• Type: Hourly Contract

• Location: Remote

• Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

• Design, develop, and maintain robust back end services, APIs, and data pipelines

• Build scalable, high-performance server-side architecture to support AI training and inference workloads

• Write clean, well-documented, and testable code following engineering best practices

• Integrate with databases, message queues, cloud services, and third-party APIs

• Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability as usage grows

• Collaborate asynchronously with distributed teams of engineers, researchers, and product leads

• Troubleshoot production issues, conduct code reviews, and contribute to architectural decisions

• Work independently on task-based and project-based assignments on your own schedule

Who You Are

• Proficient in one or more back end languages — Python, Go, Java, Node.js, Rust, or similar

• Solid understanding of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and distributed systems

• Experienced with relational and/or NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, etc.)

• Comfortable working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure

• Familiar with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex systems independently

• Self-motivated, reliable, and effective when working asynchronously without close supervision

• Clear communicator who can document decisions and collaborate across time zones

Nice to Have

• Experience building infrastructure for machine learning or AI systems

• Familiarity with data processing frameworks (Apache Kafka, Spark, Airflow, or similar)

• Background in performance optimization, caching strategies, or high-throughput systems

• Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices

• Experience with serverless architectures or event-driven design patterns

• Contributions to open-source projects or a strong portfolio of personal/professional work

Why Join Us

• Work on cutting-edge AI infrastructure projects alongside leading research labs

• Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work from anywhere

• Freelance autonomy with access to meaningful, technically challenging work

• Build systems at the intersection of software engineering and artificial intelligence

• Collaborate with a global network of talented engineers and researchers

• Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

postings.descriptionText:
As a Senior AI Delivery Engineer in the Solution Delivery department, you will be a hands-on technical owner responsible for designing, building, and deploying enterprise-grade voice and conversational AI solutions — IVR, IVA, and self-service automation, increasingly enhanced with agentic automation — on the Omilia platform. You will serve at the intersection of AI engineering and client delivery — translating complex CX requirements into production-ready implementations. This role is structured as the entry point to technical leadership at Omilia.

Accountabilities

• Own technical delivery quality from design through go-live and hypercare — ensuring on-time, on-budget outcomes aligned with client CX goals

• Serve as the primary technical point of contact for assigned client engagements — translating business requirements into technical architectures and CX designs

• Proactively identify and manage delivery risks, escalate complex technical issues, and drive resolution with urgency

• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers within the delivery team

• Contribute to internal delivery accelerators, tooling, reusable solution components, and best-practice documentation

• Collaborate across Solution Delivery, Product, Platform, R&D, Sales, Pre-Sales, and Certified Partners to ensure alignment on project requirements and Omilia platform capabilities

Key Responsibilities

Hands-on AI Solution Delivery

• Design, configure, and deploy end-to-end conversational AI (IVR / IVA) solutions on the Omilia OCP platform — covering agentic workflows blended with traditional NLU modelling, and omnichannel integrations

• Where applicable, integrate GenAI capabilities into production deployments — RAG pipelines, embedding search, and LLM prompt engineering

• Manage contact centre infrastructure integrations: IVR, SIP, CTI, and omnichannel APIs

Client and Cross-functional Collaboration

• Serve as the primary technical point of contact for assigned client engagements — translating business requirements into technical architectures and CX designs, and maintaining trusted relationships with customers and partners throughout the project lifecycle

• Collaborate closely with Solution Architects, Product, Platform, R&D, and Pre-Sales to ensure alignment on project requirements and Omilia platform capabilities

• Proactively identify and manage delivery risks — escalating complex technical issues and driving resolution with urgency

Technical Leadership and Growth

• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers within the delivery team

• Contribute to internal delivery accelerators, tooling, reusable solution components, and best-practice documentation

• Actively research developments in conversational AI, agentic frameworks, and GenAI tooling to drive continuous improvement in delivery processes

• Foster a culture of quality, innovation, and ownership within the team

Requirements

Required

• 5+ years of hands-on experience delivering conversational AI, IVR, or IVA solutions in enterprise environments, with significant time on the voice / telephony channel

• Proven delivery track record with at least one major conversational AI platform: Omilia OCP, Cognigy, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Nuance, Amazon Lex, or equivalent

• Hands-on VUI / voice dialog design: prompt and call-flow design, disambiguation, confirmation strategy, and error-recovery / retry handling for spoken interactions

• Working knowledge of ASR and NLU behaviour under telephony conditions: narrowband (8 kHz) audio, barge-in, DTMF fallback, confidence thresholds, and grammar / word-boosting for difficult inputs such as names, addresses, and alphanumerics

• Practical experience integrating GenAI/LLM capabilities into production systems: RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, etc.)

• Solid proficiency in Python (preferred) or Node.js for backend integrations and automation scripting

• Experience with CX and contact centre infrastructure: IVR, SIP, CTI, and omnichannel API integrations

• Experience with bot analytics, AI quality monitoring, and solution optimization tooling. Working understanding of core business KPIs such as containment rate and CSAT

Skills & Competencies

• Ability to lead technical client conversations and translate complex requirements into implementation plans

• Ability to act as a trusted advisor to customers — navigating delivery challenges, removing blockers, and ensuring the final solution meets their business objectives, customer experience standards, and quality expectations

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — comfortable managing ambiguity in fast-paced, client-facing environments

• Clear communication — able to convey technical concepts to both technical peers and business stakeholders

• Collaborative mindset with demonstrated ability to work across delivery, product, sales, and platform teams

• Self-directed and ownership-oriented — capable of managing multiple concurrent engagements

• Excellent written and spoken English — able to communicate clearly with global customers and engineering teams

• Vendor Professional Certification (e.g., Google Dialogflow, Amazon Lex, Microsoft Bot Framework, Cognigy)

• Participation in AI hackathons or community projects (e.g., NVIDIA, open-source agent frameworks)

postings.title: Principal Software Architect
postings.descriptionText:
Location: Remote (LATAM only)

About The Opportunity

Ryz Labs is looking for a strategic and hands-on Principal Software Architect to join the engineering team of one of our key international clients. In this role, you will lead the technical evolution and modernization of our client's software applications and digital platforms, operating at the intersection of technical strategy, platform architecture, and software craftsmanship.

This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role where you will bridge long-term architectural strategy with day-to-day execution—writing core code, establishing modern software standards, embedding DevSecOps practices, and guiding cross-functional teams across the client's ecosystem.

What You Will Do

• Architecture Strategy & Execution: Drive architecture strategies for both new applications and legacy platform modernizations; write core code components to bootstrap frameworks and set implementation baselines

• Engineering Standards & Optimization: Accelerate adoption of reusable libraries, standardized workflows, DevSecOps principles, and automated CI/CD pipelines across the client's development teams

• Cost & SLA Management: Partner with product managers and client stakeholders to bring visibility to infrastructure costs and help define Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

• Mentorship & Technical Guidance: Lead engineering communities, conduct architectural reviews, and mentor tech leads to foster technical rigor and continuous delivery quality

What We Are Looking For

• 10+ years of experience in software engineering, software architecture, or technical leadership roles

• Hands-on Architecture: Strong track record of designing multi-tier distributed systems while actively writing production code and bootstrapping core technical frameworks

• DevSecOps & Platform Automation: Deep experience with modern CI/CD pipelines, containerization, DevSecOps practices, and Infrastructure-as-Code (OpenTofu / Pulumi)

• Leadership & Influence: Proven capability to guide cross-functional technical teams, establish engineering baselines, and drive architectural adoption without direct management authority

• Client Communication & English: Exceptional written and verbal English skills to translate complex architectural decisions and trade-offs directly to client leadership and non-technical stakeholders

• Agile Delivery: Solid project management foundation grounded in Agile methodologies and modern delivery tools

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience developing software within business consulting, enterprise SaaS, or advisory environments

• Hands-on experience building technical consensus across cross-functional and matrixed client teams

• Active contributions to open-source software projects or technical developer communities

• Track record of designing internal training programs and uplifting engineering practices

About RYZ Labs:

RYZ Labs is a startup studio built in 2021 by two lifelong entrepreneurs. The founders of RYZ have worked at some of the world's largest tech companies and some of the most iconic consumer brands. They have lived and worked in Argentina for many years and have decades of experience in Latam. What brought them together is the passion for the early phases of company creation and the idea of attracting the brightest talents in order to build industry-defining companies in a post-pandemic world.

Our teams are remote and distributed throughout the US and Latam. They use the latest cutting-edge technologies in cloud computing to create applications that are scalable and resilient. We aim to provide diverse product solutions for different industries, planning to build a large number of startups in the upcoming years.

At RYZ, you will find yourself working with autonomy and efficiency, owning every step of your development. We provide an environment of opportunities, learning, growth, expansion and challenging projects. You will deepen your experience while sharing and learning from a team of great professionals and specialists.

Our values and what to expect:

• Customer First Mentality - every decision we make should be made through the lens of the customer

• Bias for Action - urgency is critical, expect that the timeline to get something done is accelerated

• Ownership - step up if you see an opportunity to help, even if not your core responsibility

• Humility and Respect - be willing to learn, be vulnerable, and treat everyone that interacts with RYZ with respect

• Frugality - being frugal and cost-conscious helps us do more with less

• Deliver Impact - get things done in the most efficient way

• Raise our Standards - always be looking to improve our processes, our team, our expectations. Status quo is not good enough and never should be

postings.title: Founding Harness Engineer (AI Agents)
postings.descriptionText:
We're hiring for our partner company, an early-stage startup building an AI coworker: an agent that lives inside a team's everyday tools and actually gets work done. They need a senior Founding Harness Engineer to build the layer that makes it behave. How it pulls in context, when it speaks up, which tool it reaches for, when it stops and asks permission, and how it finishes a long task without falling over halfway. You'll join a seasoned founder and a founding team who spent years building technology in the services world. They watched clients ask for agents long before anyone could deliver them, so they know where the real demand is. The role starts as a contract, with a path to full-time once it's clearly working for both sides. It is remote from Latin America or Eastern Europe, with solid overlap with US Pacific time, since that's where the founder works. If you've shipped tool-using agents to real users and want to build the next one from day one, read on.

Our Culture & Values (read before applying)

We move fast. We take ownership. We work with AI, not against it. And we expect everyone to bring ideas, not wait for instructions.

There are no daily checklists, no micromanagement, and no corporate politics. You get autonomy, trust, and a small team that's always ready to help you grow. Here, impact matters more than titles, and curiosity matters more than seniority.

If you want to level up fast and see your work in real users' hands - welcome aboard.

Responsibilities

• Build the agent runtime: context, tool choice, approval waits, and knowing when to act, ask, or stay quiet

• Write and keep tuning the system prompts. Proactive is great. Spamming the team channel is not

• Own the eval and regression harness. Prompt changes are code, so they get tested like code

• Make long-running work survive interruptions, retries, and the occasional flaky API

• Put the guardrails in: approval gates for risky actions and strict separation between customers' data

• Work directly with the founder and early users, and turn what you hear into shipped behavior

Requirements

• You've shipped tool-using LLM agents to real users in production. Demos and prompt wrappers don't count

• Good instincts for agent initiative, and the test results to back them up

• Hands-on experience building eval and regression suites for LLM behavior

• You understand safe tool execution, prompt injection, and multi-tenant data risk

• Solid backend skills in Python or TypeScript (async jobs, retries, state)

• You take a fuzzy problem from prototype to production and can explain the tradeoffs along the way

• Excellent written and verbal communication; you can explain a tradeoff to a founder or a user without a whiteboard

Nice to have

• MCP, or integrations with tools like Slack, Gmail, Notion, or Linear

• Eval and tracing tools such as Braintrust, Langfuse, or LangSmith

• You've been an early engineer at a startup before and still liked it

Benefits

• A founding seat. You own the agent harness and shape how the product behaves

• Founding equity

• A direct line to the founder and early users, with no layers in between

• Remote from Latin America or Eastern Europe, with solid overlap with US Pacific time

• The tools and models you need to do the job properly

• A small, experienced team that trusts you to run your own work

postings.title: 1038 - Software Engineer (Observability Migration) · Sr · Remoto · LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
Disclaimer – Must read: Commitment & Focus This role requires full-time dedication, with clear priority given to Darwoft projects during the established working hours. It is not compatible with other full-time professional engagements. Any additional professional activities must be disclosed in advance and must not interfere with the responsibilities or working hours of this role.

About Darwoft

Darwoft is a software factory that develops custom software solutions and provides IT staff augmentation services for international clients, primarily in the United States and Latin America. We partner with startups and high-growth companies to build high-impact digital products. Our culture is people-first, focused on technical quality, long-term relationships, and a collaborative mindset. We combine technical excellence with human proximity.

Senior Software Engineer — Observability Migration | Contractor Global

General Information

• Location: Remote (Global)

• Contract Type: Contractor

• Industry / Project: Fintech / Conversational AI & Infrastructure

• Time Zone: Coordination with US / LATAM / Global teams

• English Level: Advanced (C1)

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to support and execute a critical observability migration. In this role, you will lead the transition of our application and infrastructure telemetry from New Relic to a modern, OpenTelemetry (OTel) Collector-based architecture. You will be responsible for re-instrumenting applications, updating infrastructure manifests, validating telemetry outputs, and ensuring seamless monitoring coverage across our high-scale ecosystem without compromising operational visibility.

Key Responsibilities

• Migrate existing application instrumentation, tracing, and telemetry configurations from New Relic to OpenTelemetry.

• Update YAML configuration files, environment variables, and deployment manifests according to established architecture standards.

• Execute unit tests and validation suites to verify that telemetry is accurately generated, transformed, and exported to target backends.

• Perform telemetry gap analysis, comparing existing New Relic data against OTel outputs to identify missing traces, metrics, logs, or resource attributes.

• Assist in updating dashboards, monitoring documentation, and troubleshooting guides to reflect the OTel architecture.

• Investigate telemetry collection and export errors, identifying root causes and collaborating with core platform engineers on complex edge cases.

• Maintain clear tracking and reporting of implementation progress, edge cases, and potential migration risks.

Requirements

Must-Have:

• Proven experience in software engineering with proficiency in at least one modern language (Java, Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript).

• Hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel) concepts, including distributed tracing, metrics, logs, and OTel Collector configurations.

• Deep experience with cloud observability paradigms and transitioning off legacy platforms like New Relic.

• Solid understanding of HTTP, APIs, environment-based configurations, and reading/modifying complex YAML/JSON manifests.

• Strong background in software testing, debugging, log analysis, and validating high-cardinality telemetry data.

• Familiarity with modern software delivery workflows (Git, PRs, CI/CD pipelines).

Nice-to-Have:

• Experience operating or configuring OTel Collectors in Kubernetes or containerized environments.

• Knowledge of FinOps and cost-optimization strategies related to telemetry ingestion rates.

Key Deliverables & Success Criteria

• Execution: Successfully updated application instrumentation, validated OTel Collector configs, and verified end-to-end telemetry delivery to designated backends.

• Documentation: Updated technical documentation, migration checklists, and runbooks.

• Quality & Continuity: Zero removal of critical monitoring coverage during the migration window, with all pull requests passing automated tests and code reviews.

What We Offer (Contractor)

• Contractor agreement with payment in USD.

• 100% remote work in an international setting.

• Access to Argentine public holidays.

• Direct involvement in modernizing core platform observability for a high-growth fintech ecosystem.

• Professional development, learning platforms, and referral programs.

Explore this and other opportunities at: www.darwoft.com/careers

postings.title: MLOps Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About Promtior
Promtior is at the forefront of the Agentic AI revolution, delivering cutting-edge solutions that transform businesses across industries — bridging technology and people to turn AI into a real competitive advantage. Since 2023, we’ve helped organizations boost operational efficiency through tailored Agentic AI solutions, from discovery and development to full implementation, across three core lines: AI Product Delivery (predictive analytics, intelligent automation, AI-driven chatbots, image processing), AI Department as a Service (LATAM-based teams that integrate directly with our clients’ teams), and AI Adoption Consulting (helping companies find and act on AI opportunities across their business).
We’re a team held together by genuine relationships, constant exchange, and shared learning. We believe innovation happens when people feel included and collaborate with purpose, and we aim for professional growth to go hand in hand with personal well-being.

About the Role
We’re looking for an MLOps Engineer to join our Engineering team as the senior technical reference for ML and AI infrastructure. This is a hands-on architecture and leadership role, working embedded with a global fintech client: you won’t own product models yourself, but you will shape how every model and AI component is trained, deployed, monitored and run in production, enabling Data Science and AI teams to take their work from idea to production in a reliable, observable and compliant way.

Key Responsibilities
You will define and evolve the end-to-end ML platform architecture (data, training, model registry, serving, monitoring and governance) used by multiple squads, and set the standard patterns teams build on: reproducible training pipelines and experiment tracking, model packaging, versioning and promotion flows from dev to production, and online and batch inference with safe rollout strategies such as canary, shadow deployments and rollback. You will balance reliability, performance and cost for ML workloads, working closely with SRE, Infrastructure and FinOps.
You will be the go-to reference for complex MLOps questions, reviewing and challenging the design of new models and data pipelines so they meet platform standards and non-functional requirements. You will partner with product squads such as Fraud and Anomaly Detection to establish clear SLAs and SLOs, proper logging, metrics and alerting, and you will strengthen on-call readiness through playbooks, dashboards and incident reviews.
A core part of the role is using agents and AI services to automate as much of MLOps as possible: feature store operations (pipelines, backfills, parity checks, data quality and drift monitoring), training and evaluation pipelines, promotion gates and rollbacks, runbook generation, alert triage and incident enrichment, and cost optimization recommendations. You will define the infrastructure, contracts and guardrails to consume these AI services safely, and contribute to their evaluation, observability and safety (prompts, policies, PII redaction and auditability) together with the AI team.
You will also set technical standards for model and data access control, PII handling, auditability of model changes and deployments, and environment separation, working with InfoSec and Architecture to stay aligned with regulatory requirements while keeping the platform practical for engineers and data scientists. Finally, you will mentor MLOps and Data/ML engineers on system design, reliability, observability and CI/CD for ML, and lead design and architecture reviews that help teams converge on simple, robust solutions.

Required Experience

• Solid experience owning or designing MLOps platforms or ML infrastructure used by multiple teams.

• Strong hands-on experience building and operating production ML workloads on Databricks, including Feature Store (ideally with Unity Catalog), MLflow experiment tracking and model lifecycle management, and batch and real-time model deployment.

• Experience building production-grade ML pipelines: experiment tracking, reproducible training, model registry, CI/CD for models and data pipelines, and online and batch inference at scale.

• Strong background in distributed systems and data/stream processing (Spark, Flink or similar).

• Familiarity with cloud-based ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI or equivalent) and container-based deployments.

• Strong understanding of observability for ML systems: metrics, logs and traces, as well as data and model drift, freshness and quality checks.

• Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating infrastructure and AI/ML trade-offs into business language.

Especially Valued

• Experience rolling out AI assistants inside engineering organizations (code or infra copilots, AI-powered log analysis), including policies and best practices.

• Exposure to LLM and AI infrastructure such as gateways, vector stores and evaluation harnesses.

• Prior experience as Technical Referent, Tech Lead or Architect for platforms or shared services.

• Contributions to internal standards, RFCs, guilds or tech communities.

Benefits

• 20 paid days off per year.

• Hybrid work model.

• Flex Days: monthly team activities.

• Professional development courses.

• Internal clubs (soccer, padel, running, cinema).

Location
Montevideo, Uruguay.
Buenos Aires, Córdoba, Corrientes or Chaco, Argentina.

• · Hybrid work arrangement

postings.title: Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) -  SQL Server
postings.descriptionText:
Tu Misión

Serás uno de los referentes técnicos en confiabilidad, performance y evolución de nuestra plataforma de SQL Server dentro de la organización. Trabajarás junto al equipo actual liderando la evolución de una plataforma crítica que soporta a aerolíneas alrededor del mundo, impulsando mejoras en arquitectura, performance, confiabilidad y seguridad. No buscamos un administrador de bases de datos tradicional: buscamos un ingeniero que combine un conocimiento profundo de SQL Server con principios de Reliability Engineering, capaz de diseñar soluciones, automatizar operaciones, anticipar riesgos y elevar el nivel técnico de toda la organización.

✅ Tus Responsabilidades Clave

• Ingeniería de Plataforma: Diseñar y evolucionar la plataforma SQL Server sobre AWS RDS, actuar como referente en decisiones de arquitectura de alto impacto, definir estándares de performance, operación y confiabilidad, y liderar iniciativas de modernización.

• Performance Engineering: Resolver problemas complejos de rendimiento, analizar execution plans, waits, bloqueos y concurrencia, diseñar estrategias de indexación/optimización y realizar capacity planning y tuning continuo

• Cloud Database Engineering: Administrar SQL Server Enterprise sobre Amazon RDS, optimizando costos, almacenamiento e IOPS, aprovechando las capacidades administradas de AWS y diseñando estrategias de alta disponibilidad (HA) y Disaster Recovery (DR).

• Reliability & Automation: Automatizar procesos operativos, mejorar la observabilidad y el monitoreo, reducir el riesgo operativo y diseñar procesos resilientes para plataformas críticas.

• Liderazgo Técnico y Mentoring: Compartir conocimiento con el equipo, participar en revisiones de arquitectura, promover buenas prácticas de ingeniería y colaborar codo a codo con Desarrollo, DevOps y Arquitectura.

🚀 Desafíos que Enfrentarás

• Garantía de Operaciones Globales: Asegurar la disponibilidad, performance y escalabilidad continua de la plataforma crítica de datos que soporta las operaciones de aerolíneas en todo el mundo.

• Evolución y Modernización del Core de Datos: Impulsar la confiabilidad y la modernización técnica de la infraestructura, reduciendo riesgos operativos mediante automatización y observabilidad.

• Excelencia y Autonomía Técnica: Aportar ownership total sobre la plataforma para cuestionar decisiones técnicas de manera constructiva, proponer mejoras continuas y servir como referente técnico respaldando las operaciones del área.

Requisitos mínimos

🎯 El Perfil que Buscamos

💻 Hard Skills

• Experiencia Previa: Más de 8 años de trayectoria trabajando con SQL Server, incluyendo administración de entornos Enterprise de misión crítica, profundo dominio de SQL Server Internals y manejo avanzado de T-SQL.

• Cloud Database Engineering (AWS): Sólida experiencia en administración de bases de datos sobre Amazon RDS for SQL Server, optimización de costos, almacenamiento e IOPS, y aprovechamiento de capacidades administradas.

• Alta Disponibilidad y Disaster Recovery (HA/DR): Diseño e implementación de estrategias robustas de alta disponibilidad y recuperación ante desastres.

• Performance Engineering: Experiencia avanzada en Performance Tuning, análisis de execution plans, latencias (waits), bloqueos y concurrencia, además de estrategias de indexación, optimización y capacity planning.

• Automatización e Infraestructura como Código: Dominio de PowerShell o Python para la automatización de procesos.

🤝 Soft Skills

• Ownership y Proactividad: Capacidad para tomar la propiedad total de la plataforma, proponer mejoras continuas y cuestionar decisiones técnicas constructivamente sin requerir supervisión constante.

• Capacidad para la Resolución de Problemas complejos: Motivación por enfrentar y resolver desafíos técnicos complejos, priorizando la simplicidad, la confiabilidad y la automatización.

• Liderazgo Técnico y Mentoría: Disposición para actuar como referente dentro del equipo, compartiendo conocimientos, promoviendo buenas prácticas y elevando el estándar técnico general.

postings.title: MLOps Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About Promtior
Promtior is at the forefront of the Agentic AI revolution, delivering cutting-edge solutions that transform businesses across industries — bridging technology and people to turn AI into a real competitive advantage. Since 2023, we’ve helped organizations boost operational efficiency through tailored Agentic AI solutions, from discovery and development to full implementation, across three core lines: AI Product Delivery (predictive analytics, intelligent automation, AI-driven chatbots, image processing), AI Department as a Service (LATAM-based teams that integrate directly with our clients’ teams), and AI Adoption Consulting (helping companies find and act on AI opportunities across their business).
We’re a team held together by genuine relationships, constant exchange, and shared learning. We believe innovation happens when people feel included and collaborate with purpose, and we aim for professional growth to go hand in hand with personal well-being.

About the Role
We’re looking for an MLOps Engineer to join our Engineering team as the senior technical reference for ML and AI infrastructure. This is a hands-on architecture and leadership role, working embedded with a global fintech client: you won’t own product models yourself, but you will shape how every model and AI component is trained, deployed, monitored and run in production, enabling Data Science and AI teams to take their work from idea to production in a reliable, observable and compliant way.

Key Responsibilities
You will define and evolve the end-to-end ML platform architecture (data, training, model registry, serving, monitoring and governance) used by multiple squads, and set the standard patterns teams build on: reproducible training pipelines and experiment tracking, model packaging, versioning and promotion flows from dev to production, and online and batch inference with safe rollout strategies such as canary, shadow deployments and rollback. You will balance reliability, performance and cost for ML workloads, working closely with SRE, Infrastructure and FinOps.
You will be the go-to reference for complex MLOps questions, reviewing and challenging the design of new models and data pipelines so they meet platform standards and non-functional requirements. You will partner with product squads such as Fraud and Anomaly Detection to establish clear SLAs and SLOs, proper logging, metrics and alerting, and you will strengthen on-call readiness through playbooks, dashboards and incident reviews.
A core part of the role is using agents and AI services to automate as much of MLOps as possible: feature store operations (pipelines, backfills, parity checks, data quality and drift monitoring), training and evaluation pipelines, promotion gates and rollbacks, runbook generation, alert triage and incident enrichment, and cost optimization recommendations. You will define the infrastructure, contracts and guardrails to consume these AI services safely, and contribute to their evaluation, observability and safety (prompts, policies, PII redaction and auditability) together with the AI team.
You will also set technical standards for model and data access control, PII handling, auditability of model changes and deployments, and environment separation, working with InfoSec and Architecture to stay aligned with regulatory requirements while keeping the platform practical for engineers and data scientists. Finally, you will mentor MLOps and Data/ML engineers on system design, reliability, observability and CI/CD for ML, and lead design and architecture reviews that help teams converge on simple, robust solutions.

Required Experience

• Solid experience owning or designing MLOps platforms or ML infrastructure used by multiple teams.

• Strong hands-on experience building and operating production ML workloads on Databricks, including Feature Store (ideally with Unity Catalog), MLflow experiment tracking and model lifecycle management, and batch and real-time model deployment.

• Experience building production-grade ML pipelines: experiment tracking, reproducible training, model registry, CI/CD for models and data pipelines, and online and batch inference at scale.

• Strong background in distributed systems and data/stream processing (Spark, Flink or similar).

• Familiarity with cloud-based ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI or equivalent) and container-based deployments.

• Strong understanding of observability for ML systems: metrics, logs and traces, as well as data and model drift, freshness and quality checks.

• Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating infrastructure and AI/ML trade-offs into business language.

Especially Valued

• Experience rolling out AI assistants inside engineering organizations (code or infra copilots, AI-powered log analysis), including policies and best practices.

• Exposure to LLM and AI infrastructure such as gateways, vector stores and evaluation harnesses.

• Prior experience as Technical Referent, Tech Lead or Architect for platforms or shared services.

• Contributions to internal standards, RFCs, guilds or tech communities.

Benefits

• 20 paid days off per year.

• Hybrid work model.

• Flex Days: monthly team activities.

• Professional development courses.

• Internal clubs (soccer, padel, running, cinema).

Location
Montevideo, Uruguay.
Buenos Aires, Córdoba, Corrientes or Chaco, Argentina.
