postings.title: YugaByte Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
postings.descriptionText:
Expert YugabyteDB Database Engineer (DBE)
Database Engineer (DBE) - Enterprise Open-Source Support
Location: Remote
Department: Engineering - Open Source Database Support
Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering

About Deep.BI
We provide enterprise support and consulting for open-source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks, YugabyteDB, and other emerging technologies. Our customers run mission-critical, high-volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We are a small, world-class expert, remote-first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.

Role Overview
As an Expert YugabyteDB Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production, with an emphasis on supporting YugabyteDB clusters. You will dive deep into query optimization, transaction throughput, schema and sharding design, replication, and HA/DR configuration. Your job is to ensure that large-scale distributed SQL systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.
While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills. Knowledge of DevOps, infrastructure, security, or SRE practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful.

Key Responsibilities

• Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in YugabyteDB and other distributed SQL / OLTP database clusters (transaction contention and conflicts, query regressions, tablet hotspots, replication lag, compaction stalls, connection saturation).

• Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, sharding and indexing strategies, connection pooling, and configs to maximize efficiency under high read and write load. Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE and execution plans on the YSQL (PostgreSQL-compatible) layer.

• Architecture and design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, primary key and sharding design, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches including synchronous replication, xCluster asynchronous replication, read replicas, and geo-distributed deployments.

• Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.

• CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.

• Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.

• Optional / nice-to-have:

• Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation).

• Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements.

• Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.

• Additional PostgreSQL proficiency is a big plus.

• Open-source contributions to yugabyteDB.

• C/C++ skills.

Requirements

• 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting YugabyteDB clusters in larger-scale production (not just querying or application usage; no PoCs).

• Proven experience with query optimization, indexing, schema and sharding design, and transaction throughput tuning.

• Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts ( consistency, Raft consensus, replication, failover, scaling).

• Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups.

• Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics, and SQL (PostgreSQL experience strongly preferred given YugabyteDB's YSQL compatibility).

• Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios).

• Strong English language communication skills , able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing.

• Bonus : Experience with PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, TiDB, Google Spanner, Apache Cassandra, Vitess, or similar distributed SQL / OLTP databases.

• Bonus : Experience with Apache Druid, StarRocks, Clickhouse, Apache Doris or similar distributed SQL / OLAP databases.

• Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).

• Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.

• Bonus: C/C++ Skills

What We Offer

• Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale.

• Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases and communities.

• Competitive salary.

• Support for conference travel and OSS contributions.

• Flexible contract structure (direct employment, via a global payroll partner, or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.

Location and Working Style

• Remote-first. We collaborate online across multiple time zones.

• Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

postings.title: Solutions Architect
postings.descriptionText:
About SunnyData: At SunnyData, a leading Databricks technology partner, our mission is to empower customers with scalable architectures, robust data engineering pipelines, seamless data consumption layers, and advanced ML and AI applications. As a Solutions Architect, you will be instrumental in driving customer success, both in terms of technical execution and pre-sales support.

The Impact You Will Have:

• Customer Engagement: Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, guiding them through their data engineering and data architecture needs with a focus on Databricks solutions. In this role you will split your time evenly between billable and pre-sales activity.

• Technical Leadership: Design, build, and deploy comprehensive data solutions that capture, transform, and leverage data to support AI, ML, and business intelligence initiatives.

• Pre-Sales Support: Collaborate with sales teams to present technical solutions to prospective clients, demonstrating the value of SunnyData's offerings.

• Project Oversight: Manage multiple customer accounts, ensuring timely delivery of solutions and tracking progress to report outcomes.

• Solution Design: Architect data solutions, incorporating best practices in data governance, security, and quality.

• Data Analysis: Evaluate data sources for their value, recommending data inclusion strategies to enhance analytical processes.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration and Leadership : Lead internal teams, provide direction and mentorship to project teams to deliver solutions and educate end users on data products and analytic environments.

• Problem Resolution: Perform system analysis, assess and resolve data and system defects, and apply appropriate corrections.

• Quality Assurance: Test data movement, transformation code, and data components to ensure accuracy and reliability.

Required Experience:

• Experience: 7+ years as a hands-on Solutions Architect and/or Sr. Data Engineer designing and more recent experience implementing data solutions with a focus on DataBricks.

• Technical Proficiency: Expertise in Data Engineering technologies (e.g., Spark, Hadoop, Kafka), Databricks platform, and data science/machine learning technologies (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn).

• Architecture and leadership skills: In-depth understanding of the end to end data analytics workflow (e.g., data modeling, ETL processes, and data integration) using modern data engineering techniques; Ability to lead complex architecture requirements(discovery), solution design sessions and build out implementation architecture blueprints that can be implemented by data-engineering and analytics teams.

• Programming Skills: Proficiency in Java, Python, and/or Scala.

• Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.

• SQL Expertise: Ability to write, debug, and optimize SQL queries.

• Client-Facing Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience in client-facing roles.

• Presentation Skills: Ability to create and deliver detailed presentations to clients and stakeholders.

• Documentation: Experience in creating detailed solution documentation including POCs, roadmaps, sequence diagrams, class hierarchies, and logical system views.

• Team Leadership: Experience leading teams and mentoring other engineers.

• End-to-End Solutions: Ability to develop end-to-end technical solutions into production, ensuring performance, security, scalability, and robust data integration.

Preferred Experience:

• Distributed Storage: Familiarity with cloud and distributed data storage systems such as S3, ADLS, HDFS, GCS, Kudu, ElasticSearch/Solr, Cassandra, or other NoSQL storage systems.

• Data Integration: Experience with data integration technologies like Spark, Kafka, Streamsets, Matillion, Fivetran, NiFi, AWS Data Migration Services, Azure DataFactory, and Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS).

• Software Development Lifecycle: Comprehensive experience with the complete software development lifecycle including design, documentation, implementation, testing, and deployment.

• Automated Pipelines: Expertise in automated data transformation and curation using tools like dbt, Spark, Spark streaming, and automated pipelines.

• Workflow Management: Experience with workflow management and orchestration tools like Airflow, AWS Managed Airflow, Luigi, and NiFi.

• Certifications (at least 2 of the following): Associate Developer for Apache Spark; Data Engineer Associate; Professional Data Engineer; Machine Learning Associate; Professional ML Engineer

Education:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Engineering related field.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:

SunnyData is dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the world around us. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to unbiased hiring practices. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Why Join SunnyData?

• Innovative Environment: Work with cutting-edge technologies and industry leaders in data engineering and AI.

• Customer Impact: Make a real difference in how businesses leverage data for strategic decision-making.

• Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

• Collaborative Culture: Join a supportive team that values collaboration and knowledge sharing.

If you are passionate about data engineering and enjoy engaging with clients to solve their most challenging problems, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and become a key player in SunnyData's success story.

postings.title: Sr Site Reliability Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
PedidosYa forma parte de Delivery Hero, empresa líder mundial en servicios de delivery con presencia en ~65 países. PedidosYa es la empresa de tecnología líder en delivery y quick-commerce en Latinoamérica. Es una plataforma simple, rápida y accesible que conecta a millones de personas usuarias, empresas y repartidores con una amplia variedad de productos y servicios. PedidosYa opera en 15 países en latinoamérica, y en 2020 lanzó PedidosYa Markets, el primer mercado 100% digital que entrega alimentos y artículos para el hogar en 15 minutos. Delivery Hero cotiza en la Bolsa de Frankfurt desde 2017 y forma parte del índice bursátil MDAX.

Descripción del empleo

Tenemos una oportunidad para vos, estamos buscando Sr Site Reliability Engineer para sumarse al equipo de Platform Engineering en nuestra Tribu Foundations.

Misión del Rol:

Garantizar la resiliencia, escalabilidad y performance de nuestros sistemas críticos. Como Sr SRE, serás una pieza clave para automatizar la infraestructura, definir los estándares de confiabilidad (SLIs/SLOs) y empoderar a los equipos de desarrollo para que construyan de forma segura y veloz, reduciendo el trabajo manual operativo.

Principales Desafios:

• Diseño e Implementación de Resiliencia (Hands-on): Instrumentar métricas (SLIs), configurar SLOs y construir los tableros de Error Budget en el código e infraestructura de los servicios críticos.

• Construcción de Observabilidad como Plataforma: Desarrollar e integrar librerías de instrumentación, agentes y arquitecturas de monitoreo (Golden Signals: latencia, tráfico, errores, saturación) usando herramientas como Grafana y Datadog.

• Resolución y Gestión Técnica de Incidentes: Participar en las guardias (on-call), liderar la resolución técnica de incidentes críticos, realizar depuraciones profundas y ejecutar post-mortems blameless con ítems de acción concretos.

• Evolución de Infraestructura y Despliegues: Diseñar y mantener componentes de Infraestructura como Código (IaC), gestionar la salud/migración de clusters y automatizar pipelines de CI/CD para garantizar pruebas de despliegue seguras y rollbacks automáticos.

• Ejecución de Pruebas de Carga y Capacidad: Diseñar, ejecutar y analizar pruebas de estrés/carga globales sobre la plataforma para identificar puntos de falla antes de que impacten en producción.

• Automatización y Eliminación de Toil: Codificar herramientas, scripts y soluciones de autoservicio (self-service) para eliminar tareas manuales recurrentes en el ciclo de vida del software.

• Seguridad Operativa Aplicada: Implementar escaneos de vulnerabilidades, configurar la gestión segura de secretos y responder técnicamente ante incidentes de seguridad que afecten la disponibilidad.

Requisitos

• +5 años de experiencia en roles de SRE, DevOps, o Ingeniería de Software orientada a plataforma.

• Programación y Scripting: Sólida experiencia escribiendo código limpio y mantenible en Go (Golang), Python, Java o Kotlin para desarrollar herramientas internas, bots, librerías de instrumentación y automatizaciones.

• Nube, Contenedores y Orquestación: Dominio de plataformas Cloud (AWS) y automatización con Terraform o CloudFormation. Amplia experiencia práctica en la administración, configuración y solución de problemas en Kubernetes y Docker.

• Ecosistema de Observabilidad y CI/CD: Experiencia directa configurando y depurando herramientas de monitoreo, tracing y logging (Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry). Experiencia en integración continua (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) e implementación de estrategias de despliegue avanzadas (canary, blue/green, rollback automático).

• Bases de Datos & Caching: Conocimiento técnico sobre el comportamiento, ajuste de rendimiento y resolución de fallas en MySQL, MongoDB y Redis.

• Colaboración Técnica: Disposición para compartir soluciones técnicas, documentar runbooks y guiar a otros ingenieros mediante el ejemplo técnico (pair programming, revisiones de código y post-mortems).

Información adicional

• Crear valor para un gran ecosistema de negocio.

• Jugar en equipo, siempre: Pensar soluciones y construir colaborativamente, con buena energía.

• Moverte a la velocidad de tus ideas y emprender.

• Aprender, desarrollarte y reinventarte: Permitirte equivocarte, aprender haciendo, iterar y adaptarte a los cambios.

• Generar impacto positivo en las personas y el planeta.

• Trabajar de otra manera, en #ModoPeYa: no importa el tiempo ni el lugar desde donde trabajas, lo que importa es la agilidad con la que tomas decisiones, la flexibilidad para adaptarte y los resultados que alcanzas en equipo.

En PedidosYa, el impacto no se mide solo en resultados sino en cómo los alcanzamos. Buscamos al mejor talento: personas que vibren con nuestros valores, la forma en la que pensamos, decidimos y colaboramos todos los días.

Lo que lográs es clave, pero el “cómo” lo hacés es lo que nos define. Jugando en equipo, hacemos que el negocio y nuestro ecosistema sigan creciendo, mientras le simplificamos el día a día a millones de personas.

👉 Conocé nuestros valores aquí.

La diversidad de talento potencia nuestra Cultura y nuestra organización. Jugamos en equipo en todo lo que hacemos, y lo que más nos gusta de eso es que promovemos la creación de equipos diversos e inclusivos que puedan aportar diferentes perspectivas a PedidosYa. Nuestras oportunidades laborales están abiertas a todas las personas, independientemente de su identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico, religión, edad, discapacidad y/o otras características individuales.

En caso de necesitar algún ajuste razonable o accesibilidad particular para tener la entrevista, por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación. Además, siéntete libre de indicarnos tus pronombres (él/ella/elle) desde el primer contacto.

#CulturaPeYa #LaDiversidadNosPotencia

postings.title: StarRocks Expert Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
postings.descriptionText:
StarRocks Expert Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support
Location: Remote (South & Central America, US Working Hours)
Department: Engineering - Open Source Database support
Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering

Role Overview
As a StarRocks Expert Database Engineer (DBE) , you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.

While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful.

Key Responsibilities

• Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)

• Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.

• Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.

• Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.

• CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.

• Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.

• Optional / nice-to-have:

• Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)

• Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements

• Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.

Requirements

• 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs)

• Proven experience with query optimization, indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines.

• Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)

• Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups

• Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL

• Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (i ncident scenarios)

• Strong English language communication skills, able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing

• Bonus : Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases

• Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).

• Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.

About Deep.BI
We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.

What we offer

• Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale.

• Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.

• Competitive salary

• Support for conference travel and OSS contributions

• Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.

Location & working style

• Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.

• Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

postings.title: Head of Engineering
postings.descriptionText:
About Rebill

Rebill is the financial infrastructure platform for the Americas.

The companies shaping software, AI, travel, and digital services use Rebill to operate across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and the United States.

Rebill brings local payments, installments, recurring billing, stablecoin rails, treasury, global payouts, and financial operations into one platform built for how money actually works across the Americas.

Every market is different. Rebill makes the infrastructure consistent. Engineering, finance, and operations teams can manage local currency acceptance, market-specific payment behavior, funds, and financial workflows from the same platform.

Companies can launch in Latin America in as little as a day and expand across markets without rebuilding their financial stack country by country.

Built locally. Designed to scale globally.

Rebill is backed by leading global investors such as Tiger Global, Y Combinator (W22), Soma Capital and SV Angel, and angels including Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and Arash Ferdowsi (Dropbox).

About The Role

You run engineering day to day: delivery, reliability, and the technical bar of everything we ship.

Rebill processes real money across six markets on its own infrastructure. Event-driven microservices on a message bus, Kubernetes across Azure and AWS, infrastructure as code, and smart routing across a different set of local acquirers in every country. Card data lives in an isolated, tokenized environment.

We are AI-native by design. You will push engineering beyond AI-assisted coding into agentic workflows: autonomous coding and review agents, evals, feedback loops, human-in-the-loop controls, observability, and guardrails that let us safely automate more of the SDLC and production operations. The goal is not to use AI more; it is to rethink how a small engineering team can build and operate financial infrastructure.

You will hire and co-lead a small, high-caliber in-house engineering team alongside the CTO, while managing external engineering partners.

This is a hands-on seat. You review pull requests, write code, automate aggressively, and stay close to production. You are intellectually curious and passionate about documenting and sharing what you learn, inside Rebill and with the broader engineering community.

What You Will Own

• Reliability. Uptime, incident response, observability, and the performance of payment routing. When approval rates drop in one market at two in the morning, you are the person who knows why.

• Delivery. The quarterly technical roadmap, release cadence, and the honesty of our dates. Engineering commitments that hold are worth more than ambitious ones that do not.

• Technical bar. Code review standards, testing, on-call, and documentation across a team that is part in-house and part external. Raising the floor is most of the job.

• Time to market. Today every new acquirer and every new payment method is its own integration project. Your job is to turn that into something closer to configuration, so opening a market takes weeks instead of quarters.

• Capacity decisions. What we build in-house, what we keep with partners, and what that costs. You bring the numbers and defend the call.

What We Are Looking For

• 8+ years as a software engineer building payments, banking, or financial infrastructure that moves real money. This is a hard requirement.

• You come from payments: acquiring, processing, ledgers, reconciliation, or a fintech moving real transactional volume. Not a company that happened to charge cards.

• Hands-on. You still write and review code, and you are the person who goes into the incident, not the one who asks for the postmortem.

• You have worked with external engineering partners or agencies and can describe what you did to make that model work.

• Distributed systems in production: event-driven architectures, queues, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code.

• Fluent English and Spanish. Our acquirers, auditors, and merchants do not share one language.

• Based in Buenos Aires, Bogotá, or Miami (hybrid).

• AI tools as part of how you work. Everyone at Rebill uses them daily to move faster.

Nice to have

• Portuguese at a working level for Brazil.

• Prior startup or YC-company experience at a similar stage.

What We Offer

• A senior package matching the seat: competitive base and meaningful equity.

• Direct access to the founders, with no layers in between.

• Ownership of a payments platform that is already in production across six markets, at the point where the decisions you make still shape it.

• Hybrid base in one of this locations: Buenos Aires, Bogotá, or Miami. (sponsorships not available)

How We Hire

An intro conversation, a technical session on a real problem from our platform, and a conversation with the founders. No take-home exercise that we would not pay for. We will tell you what is still open and what is held together with tape. We expect the same candour back.

postings.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to improve reliability and stability of Webflow’s customer-facing, production infrastructure, serving millions of page views per hour. Our product is used by over 2 million users world-wide across 190 countries, and you’ll help ensure our platform is secure and scalable for these users as tens of thousands of projects are launched on Webflow each month.

• Location: Remote-first (Argentina)

• Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position)

• Application Information:

• Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled

• This posting is for a new position.

As An Senior Infrastructure Engineer You Will

• Own and evolve the cloud platform that Webflow's product and engineering teams depend on, including our compute layer, EKS fleet, serverless infrastructure, networking, and cloud operations across AWS and GCP.

• Help design and maintain our infrastructure-as-code foundation, evolving the patterns and shared components other teams build on.

• Design and maintain the networking layer that connects Webflow's services, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability across our cloud environments.

• Help make observability data the foundation of how we operate, improving the dashboards, alerts, and SLOs for the infrastructure you own so that issues are caught before customers notice, and on-call pages are actionable instead of noisy.

• Build and maintain AI-powered automation that improves how we manage cloud infrastructure, from policy-as-code and drift detection to LLM-assisted runbook generation.

• Help define the culture of this growing team as it expands its international presence.

About You

You’ll thrive as a Senior Infrastructure Engineer if you:

• Have a background as an infrastructure, site reliability engineer or cloud engineer with an enthusiasm for automation and code, or a background as a software engineer with deep enthusiasm for cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.

• Have 5+ years of experience owning and operating cloud infrastructure in a customer-facing environment that allows for little to no downtime.

• Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and a strong opinion on what good cloud operations look like.

• Have experience managing Kubernetes clusters at scale, including upgrades, node group management, autoscaling, and cluster add-on lifecycle.

• Have experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi or Terraform, and a strong preference for changes made through code, not consoles.

• Have experience navigating multi-region or multi-cloud environments on AWS or GCP.

• Stay curious and open to growth, demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

It would be a bonus if you had even one of the following:

• Experience with Karpenter, cluster autoscaler, or other Kubernetes-native scaling tooling.

• Have experience with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus or Grafana

• Experience building AI-assisted infrastructure tooling, including cost optimization loops, anomaly detection, or policy-as-code with LLM assistance.

• Experience contributing to multi-region architecture including data residency, regional failover, or latency-based routing.

You Are

• Collaborative: You possess a collaborative spirit, thriving when working with both your immediate team and cross-functional partners.

• Strategic thinker: You're a strategic thinker, adept at defining clear business needs and evaluating solutions to make informed build-versus-buy decisions.

• Comfortable with ambiguity: You navigate ambiguous situations with ease, gathering data and making progress even with incomplete information or unclear requirements.

If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying . Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

Our Core Behaviors

• Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.

• Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.

• Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.

• Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits

• Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.

• Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.

• Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.

• Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.

• Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.

• Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.

• Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.

• Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

Be you, with us

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and/or Glassdoor.

Please Note

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for accommodation requests will be administered.

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.

Webflow uses AI tools to assist in screening and evaluating applications. AI does not make final hiring decisions. For details on how we process your personal information, see Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice .

postings.descriptionText:

Coderio diseña y entrega soluciones digitales escalables para empresas globales. Con una base técnica sólida y una mentalidad orientada al producto, nuestros equipos lideran proyectos de software complejos desde la arquitectura hasta la ejecución.

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un Especialista Data Engineer (Sr.) para incorporarse al área de Ingeniería de Datos dentro de una Gerencia de Datos del rubro Retail.

El equipo está conformado por 9 colaboradores de diversos perfiles (Data Delivery Lead, Architects, Data Engineers, DataOps, Data QC y Data Analysts) y es responsable del ciclo de desarrollo completo: desde la ingesta hasta la disponibilidad de datos para la gestión y toma de decisiones de los usuarios internos en Argentina. Como Especialista, serás responsable de construir soluciones para requerimientos evolutivos, correctivos de segundo nivel y proyectos regionales que requieran datos del país, trabajando sobre un ecosistema alojado íntegramente en la nube de AWS.

Lo que puedes esperar de este rol (Responsabilidades)

• Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener pipelines de datos eficientes y escalables utilizando servicios de AWS (Redshift, Glue, EMR, MWAA, S3, API Gateway, entre otros).

• Implementar procesos de extracción, transformación y carga (ETL) optimizados mediante PySpark y SQL.

• Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios y stakeholders para comprender los requisitos de datos y diseñar soluciones de alto rendimiento y confiabilidad.

• Monitorear y optimizar continuamente el rendimiento de los pipelines de datos existentes.

• Garantizar la calidad e integridad de los datos mediante la aplicación de prácticas de gobernanza y control de calidad.

• Documentar procesos y flujos de trabajo técnicos para facilitar la mantenibilidad y la transferencia de conocimientos en el equipo.

• Participar activamente en la resolución de problemas y la atención de incidentes de segundo nivel relacionados con pipelines de datos.

Requisitos

• Experiencia acreditada como Especialista / Sr. trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos.

• Experiencia avanzada comprobable en el ecosistema AWS: AWS Redshift, Glue, EMR, MWAA, S3 y API Gateway (EXCLUYENTE).

• Sólidos conocimientos y dominio técnico en PySpark y SQL (EXCLUYENTE).

• Experiencia sólida en el diseño e implementación de arquitectura de sistemas y procesos ETL/ELT.

• Experiencia en optimización de consultas, monitoreo y tuning de rendimiento en pipelines de datos.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, autonomía, proactividad y capacidad para solucionar problemas complejos en entornos dinámicos.

• Familiaridad con herramientas de CI/CD y prácticas de DevOps.

• Experiencia de trabajo bajo metodologías ágiles (Scrum).

Build the machine that makes thousands of photoreal AI pieces a month, cheap enough to be a business and good enough to reach millions. You work directly with the founder.

Most AI influencer work is either beautiful stills nobody sees, or slop at volume for accounts that die in a month. We want both: thousands of photoreal pieces a month, cheap enough to be a business, good enough to reach millions. If you would rather build the machine than click generate, read on.

Vertex Marketing Group builds AI creators and makes the content for real ones. Today one good AI video clip costs us a few dollars on hosted tools. Your job is to get that quality for a fraction of the price, then run it at a scale nobody else does. You own the outcome.

What you'll do

Big plus: a development, infrastructure or IT architecture background, and experience running many Instagram accounts. We want a nerd about the tech and the content, both.

$4,000 to $6,000 per month, full-time, remote. Where you land in the range depends on what you show us. Same rate from day one of the paid test. Reviewed after 6 months.

Possumus is a leading technology and AI company, specialized in software development and Microsoft Cloud solutions for the Banking, Fintech, and Oil & Gas sectors. We focus on delivering innovative technological solutions that help our clients optimize processes and achieve their business goals.

As a Solution Architect, you will transform complex business and technology challenges into viable, secure, scalable, operable, and economically sustainable solutions. You will act as a trusted advisor to our clients, connecting business needs, technology, pre-sales, and delivery throughout the entire solution lifecycle.

Responsibilities

• Lead discovery workshops, technical assessments, ideation sessions, and solution-definition activities with clients and internal stakeholders.

• Understand clients business objectives, technology environments, processes, constraints, and expected outcomes, identifying both explicit and implicit requirements.

• Design and communicate end-to-end solution architectures aligned with business and functional objectives, clearly documenting principles, assumptions, decisions, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.

Minimum Requirements

postings.title: Detection Engineering
postings.descriptionText:
Why Join AspenView?
At AspenView, we’re more than a nearshore IT partner—we’re a people-first, purpose-driven company that believes great culture drives great outcomes. We’re passionate about connecting talent and technology to deliver measurable value for clients—and meaningful career paths for our people.
Here’s what you can expect:

• Competitive base

• Flexible work model: hybrid, remote, or in-office

• Real growth opportunities and leadership visibility

• Inclusive, respectful culture that blends U.S. innovation with Colombian heart

• A company that listens, invests in you, and celebrates wins together

The Senior Detection Engineer is a hands-on professional responsible for designing, building, testing and tuning the detections that decide which security events become alerts for a 24/7 SOC serving a large US consumer lender. Working on-site from AspenView's secure delivery suites in Bogotá, Medellin or Buenos Aires , you will work across telemetry from CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, Okta, Palo Alto, Proofpoint and AWS flowing through Abstract Security into Elastic. You will be one of two senior detection engineers on the service, reporting to a US-based Detection Engineering Lead you speak with daily. This role calls for real autonomy: you will be expected to take a use case from idea to production without being walked through it.
What you will do:
Detection Development

• Own detection use cases end to end, from threat research and logic to testing against simulated attacks, documentation and release, with client approval for changes that affect alerting.

• Build correlation and multi-stage detections across endpoint, identity, network, email and cloud telemetry, designed around the attack chains a consumer lender actually sees.

• Create custom IOAs in CrowdStrike, custom detections in Microsoft Defender, identity detections on Okta, and AWS control-plane coverage.

Tuning & Data Quality

• Tune the noisiest and weakest rules with evidence, documenting what changed, the effect on the false-positive rate, and proof the rule still catches what it should.

• Fix parsers and data-quality issues when a source routed through Abstract arrives in Elastic incomplete or mis-mapped.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

• Peer review rules with your fellow detection engineer and turn hunt findings and Tier 2 feedback into backlog items.

• Work alongside the threat hunters on the same floor, turning good hunts into production detections.

• Support major incidents when needed by writing emergency detections or sweeping for related activity.

Tools & Technologies:

• SIEM & Detection: Elastic Security (EQL, ES|QL, KQL); Splunk (SPL), Sentinel or Chronicle also relevant.

• Data Pipeline: Abstract Security, or equivalents such as Cribl or Logstash.

• Endpoint, Identity & Cloud: CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender, Okta System Log, AWS CloudTrail and GuardDuty.

• Engineering: Git, Python or PowerShell, and MITRE ATT&CK.

• Testing & Automation (Bonus): Sigma, YARA, Atomic Red Team, Caldera and SOAR playbooks.

What you bring:

• Experience: 3+ years writing, testing and tuning detections in production on a SIEM or analytics platform, with rules you can explain and defend. Deep query skills in at least one detection language and the ability to pick up another quickly.

• Technical Depth: Understanding of how attacks show up across endpoint, identity and cloud telemetry, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, plus working knowledge of log pipelines and where data goes missing between source and alert.

• Communication: English at B2 or above, strong enough to defend a rule's logic to a US-based lead and the client's security team.

postings.descriptionText:
Location: LATAM (remote)

The role

We're hiring a hands-on Senior Site Reliability Engineer to keep FileScience reliable for customers. Some of the hardest failures are quiet ones: a backup stops making progress, finishes with files missing, or reports success when it shouldn't. You'll work with our engineering team to catch these problems, improve monitoring and incident response, and fix reliability issues in production code and infrastructure.

What You Will Do

01 Define how we measure reliability. Set service-level indicators and objectives (SLIs/SLOs) for product availability and backup jobs. Show what we can and cannot yet measure, and use the results to decide what to improve first.

02 Make failures easier to find. Add logs, metrics and traces that identify the affected customer and job. Build useful alerts, reduce noise, and regularly check that monitoring works and alerts reach the right person.

03 Lead incident response. Maintain incident tools, escalation paths and runbooks. Diagnose problems, keep people informed, confirm service has recovered, and follow through on fixes that prevent repeat incidents.

04 Check that backups actually work. Build checks for whether each customer's backups run when expected, capture the expected data and can be restored. Work with product engineers to compare source and backup data and test recovery.

05 Automate recurring operational work and ship reliability fixes. Work with product engineers on safer deployments, growing workloads, queue backlogs and third-party API failures. Test changes before rollout, keep a rollback path where possible and verify the result.

Requirements:

Core Experience

• Hands-on experience keeping production systems reliable after launch, including responding to incidents and improving the systems over time.

• Strong AWS troubleshooting skills across services, networks, containers, storage, queues and databases. You can investigate problems that involve both application code and infrastructure.

• Experience building and maintaining observability, SLOs, useful alerts, runbooks and recovery tests in production.

• Ability to read, debug and change production Python code and build dependable automation. Practical understanding of partial failures, retries, idempotency, concurrency and backpressure.

• Experience with infrastructure as code, CI/CD and safe production changes, including testing, rollback and access controls.

• Clear written and spoken English, good organization and independent problem-solving. You can turn incomplete requirements into a practical plan, prioritize your work and communicate progress, risks and decisions.

Nice to have

• Experience with backup, synchronization or data-integrity systems, or data pipelines that run for long periods across many customers.

• OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Sentry or incident-management platforms, or comparable tools.

Our stack

Python and AWS: ECS, Lambda, Step Functions, S3, SQS, DynamoDB, Aurora PostgreSQL and CloudWatch.

How We Work

We work in a fast-paced environment where priorities change and requirements may be incomplete. You will be expected to work autonomously: investigate problems, identify next steps, make sound decisions and drive work forward without waiting for detailed instructions.

Keep the engineering team informed and involve others when their input is needed.

We value practical production experience, sound judgment and seeing work through.

postings.title: Threat Hunting Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Why Join AspenView?
At AspenView, we’re more than a nearshore IT partner—we’re a people-first, purpose-driven company that believes great culture drives great outcomes. We’re passionate about connecting talent and technology to deliver measurable value for clients—and meaningful career paths for our people.
Here’s what you can expect:

• Competitive base

• Flexible work model: hybrid, remote, or in-office

• Real growth opportunities and leadership visibility

• Inclusive, respectful culture that blends U.S. innovation with Colombian heart

• A company that listens, invests in you, and celebrates wins together

We are seeking a Threat Hunter Analyst to join the security operations team of a large US consumer lender in the financial services sector, working on-site from AspenView's secure suite in Bogotá, Medellín or Buenos Aires . You'll design and run hypothesis-driven hunts across endpoint, identity, network, email and AWS telemetry in Elastic, reporting to the on-site Threat Hunting Lead and working closely with Detection Engineering so that every good hunt ends as a working detection. This is a hands-on role for someone who can take raw intelligence and turn it into a hunt without being told how, and who knows what living-off-the-land, credential abuse and lateral movement look like in real logs, not just someone who has triaged alerts from a queue.
What you will do:
Hunt Design & Threat Intelligence

• Build hunts from threat intelligence relevant to US consumer finance, recent incidents and known telemetry gaps

• Turn raw intelligence into testable hypotheses on your own

• Decide which data sources and timeframes will answer each hunt question

• Map attacker tradecraft to MITRE ATT&CK to shape and prioritize hunts

Hunt Execution & Investigation

• Run scheduled and ad hoc hunts across CrowdStrike, Defender, Okta, Palo Alto, Proofpoint and AWS data in Elastic

• Pivot quickly when an initial query surfaces something worth chasing

• Separate real findings from noise

• Escalate live attacker activity to Tier 3 and the Incident Response Lead with the evidence attached

• Run indicator and behaviour sweeps during major incidents to scope how far an attacker reached

Detection Engineering Partnership

• Hand candidate detections to Detection Engineering, written well enough to build from

• Identify logging gaps and document them for remediation

• Make sure your hunts end as production detection rules

Reporting & Knowledge Sharing

• Write clear, reproducible hunt reports covering what was tested, found, ruled out and couldn't be tested

• Walk the client's security team through findings directly, in English

• Document hunts so anyone on the team can rerun them

Tools & Technologies:

• Platforms & Infrastructure: Elastic Security (EQL, ES|QL), Splunk or Microsoft Sentinel (equivalent SIEMs), Palo Alto, Proofpoint

• Security & Threat Intelligence: CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, MITRE ATT&CK, MISP, OpenCTI, Recorded Future, FS-ISAC, malware triage and memory forensics

• Cloud & Data Analysis: AWS (control-plane and cloud telemetry), Okta (identity telemetry), Python, Jupyter

What you bring:

• Experience: 3+ years in threat hunting, Tier 3 investigation or incident response, with hunts you can walk through from hypothesis to outcome, including the ones that found nothing

• Technical Depth: Fluent querying across large data sets in Elastic, Splunk, Sentinel or equivalent, and a strong grasp of living-off-the-land, credential and session abuse, lateral movement and cloud control-plane abuse as they appear in logs

• Consulting / Leadership: Confidence presenting findings straight to a US client's security team, working well with Detection Engineering and IR, and interest in growing into a Threat Hunting Lead, IR Lead or Detection Engineering Lead role

• Mindset: Works independently, stays rigorous and curious, and knows that a hunt proving a control works is a good result

• Language: English at B2 or above

• Location & Schedule: On-site in Bogotá, Medellín or Buenos Aires during US Eastern business hours (no rotating shifts), with occasional call-ins during major incidents

• Security Clearance: Willing to undergo identity, criminal-background, employment and education checks, repeated periodically, and to work in a clean-desk, VDI-only environment

• Clearance: Must pass identity, criminal-background, employment and education checks, repeated periodically.

• Nice to have: Financial-sector threat experience (fraud-motivated intrusion, ransomware, BEC), detection-writing skills, and certifications such as GCTI, GDAT, GCIH, GCFA or eCTHP

Guiar y potenciar un equipo de Site Reliability Engineers de alto rendimiento. • Bases de Datos & Cloud: Conocimientos en bases de datos relacionales y no relacionales (MySQL, MongoDB, Redis) y experiencia en plataformas Cloud (AWS).

• Cultura y Principios SRE: Sólido dominio de la gestión de observabilidad (métrica, *tracing*, *logging*), respuesta ante incidentes, pruebas de carga y automatización de procesos.

• Formación y Comunicación: Formación académica en Ingeniería en Sistemas de Información o carreras afines, nivel de inglés intermedio y excelente capacidad de comunicación transparente, cercana y colaborativa.

Información adicional

• Crear valor para un gran ecosistema de negocio.

• Jugar en equipo, siempre: Pensar soluciones y construir colaborativamente, con buena energía.

• Moverte a la velocidad de tus ideas y emprender.

• Aprender, desarrollarte y reinventarte: Permitirte equivocarte, aprender haciendo, iterar y adaptarte a los cambios.

• Generar impacto positivo en las personas y el planeta.

• Trabajar de otra manera, en #ModoPeYa: no importa el tiempo ni el lugar desde donde trabajas, lo que importa es la agilidad con la que tomas decisiones, la flexibilidad para adaptarte y los resultados que alcanzas en equipo.

En PedidosYa, el impacto no se mide solo en resultados sino en cómo los alcanzamos. Buscamos al mejor talento: personas que vibren con nuestros valores, la forma en la que pensamos, decidimos y colaboramos todos los días.

La diversidad de talento potencia nuestra Cultura y nuestra organización. 💙Con más de 190,000 profesionales en más de 70 países, combinamos un profundo conocimiento con una cultura que valora el aprendizaje, la curiosidad y la colaboración.
Lideramos la transformación y entregamos soluciones seguras, innovadoras y específicas de la industria que impulsan el crecimiento de los negocios. Nuestra gente impulsa todos nuestros logros 🚀, piensan en grande para entregar resultados mientras se asegura que cada voz sea escuchada.

👉 En NTT DATA nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Migration Engineer para sumarse a nuestro equipo!!

Objetivo del rol

Ejecutar batches y waves utilizando el tooling, runbooks y patrones aprobados, asegurando trazabilidad, gestión de errores, validación de datos y reconciliación.

Responsabilidades principales

• Configurar y operar las herramientas de migración aprobadas.

• Preparar migration batches, poblaciones piloto y waves productivas.

• Ejecutar pre-stage, migración inicial, deltas y cutover según runbook.

• Ejecutar scripts y automatizaciones aprobadas para migración/validación.

• Migrar datos y objetos incluidos de acuerdo con la estrategia por workload.

• Monitorear ejecución, throughput, throttling y errores.

• Analizar logs y resolver fallas de migración.

• Ejecutar retries dentro del modelo acordado.

• Identificar fallas persistentes y derivarlas al exception/remediation backlog.

• Realizar validación post-migration, reconciliación y captura de evidencias.

• Mantener dashboards, status de batches y evidencias técnicas.

• Participar en cutovers y command center.

• Escalar incidentes de tooling/producto al Workspace & Migration Lead y SMEs.

Conocimientos y experiencia requeridos

• Experiencia hands-on en migraciones Microsoft 365 y/o Google Workspace.

• Conceptos de Exchange/Gmail y OneDrive/SharePoint/Drive.

• Tooling de migración enterprise.

• APIs, throttling y batch processing.

• PowerShell y/o scripting.

• Análisis de logs, troubleshooting y reconciliación.

• Disciplina operativa con runbooks y change windows. Inglés técnico.

Deseable

• BitTitan MigrationWiz o herramientas similares.

• Tooling nativo Google.

• GAM / Google APIs.

• Migraciones de grandes volúmenes.

• Migration Factory / command center.

Interfaces clave

• Workspace & Migration Lead / GWS Administrator / Microsoft Administrator.

• Technical owners del cliente y Service Desk durante cutover.

• Tooling vendor / Google SMEs para escalaciones.

• Resultados esperados / indicadores de éxito

• Ejecución predecible de batches con status transparente.

• Reconciliación y evidencia suficientes para aceptación.

• Identificación rápida y triage de excepciones.

• Ejecución repetible entre waves con disminución progresiva de defectos.

Beneficios:

• Amplio plan de desarrollo y posibilidades de evolución profesional con desafíos constantes.

• Cobertura médica de primer nivel para vos y tu grupo familiar.

• Reintegro de gastos de home office.

• Campañas con importantes descuentos en Gastronomía y Supermercados.

• Beneficios asociados a la calidad de vida: horarios flex, homeoffice.

• Wellhub (red de gimnasios y bienestar integral).

• Descuentos educacionales.

🌟 ¿Por qué NTT DATA?
🤝 Cultura colaborativa con enfoque “People First”
🚀 Desarrollo profesional y aprendizaje continuo
💻 Flexibilidad laboral con BeFlex
🌿 Bienestar y apoyo a la salud mental
🌈 Entorno diverso e inclusivo

postings.title: Administrador de base de datos
postings.descriptionText:
BÚSQUEDA LABORAL! Database Administrator (DBA Senior)
Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a DBA Senior para sumarse al equipo del Sanatorio Güemes, en pleno proceso de modernización tecnológica.
Buscamos un perfil con mirada integral del dato, capaz de combinar la excelencia operativa con la evolución hacia arquitecturas modernas y liderar procesos de migración clave.
Desafíos Principales

• Administración y Gobierno: Gestionar entornos SQL Server en contextos críticos, aplicar gobernanza de datos y garantizar la seguridad de información sensible.

• Migración: Liderar el relevamiento y la migración desde un motor legacy hacia SQL Server (¡no se requiere experiencia previa en el motor puntual!).

• Alta Disponibilidad: Diseñar e implementar soluciones de clustering, AlwaysOn y planes de DR/Backup para asegurar la continuidad de sistemas clínicos (HIS, internación, turnos).

• Observabilidad & Performance: Monitoreo end-to-end, tuning, optimización en entornos de alta concurrencia y resolución de incidentes.

• Integración y Analítica: Estructurar datos para consumo en Data Warehouse/BI y colaborar en la automatización/evolución hacia entornos híbridos.

Requisitos Excluyentes

• +5 años de experiencia como DBA en entornos productivos críticos.

• Sólidos conocimientos y administración en SQL Server (2016+) , T-SQL y modelado relacional.

• Experiencia demostrable en migraciones y entornos de alta disponibilidad .

Deseables (Plus)

• Experiencia con InterSystems Caché / MUMPS , entornos Cloud (Azure), herramientas de monitoreo, ETL o DevOps de bases de datos.

postings.title: Senior IT Systems Engineer, Collaboration Tools (Google Workspace)
postings.descriptionText:
Overview

Medallia is the pioneer and market leader in Experience Management. Our award-winning SaaS platform, Medallia Experience Cloud, leads the market in the management of experiences, insights, and actions for candidates, customers, employees, patients, and residents alike.

We believe that every experience is a memory that can last a lifetime. Experiences shape the way people feel about a company. And they greatly influence how likely people are to advocate, contribute, and stay. At Medallia, we are committed to creating a world where organizations are loved by their customers and their employees.

We empower exceptional people to create extraordinary experiences together.

Bring your whole self.

Our IT Culture

• We don’t expect to be perfect, but we are always proactively seeking out ways to help solve bottlenecks within our infrastructure and user community. We build strong relationships with team members around the globe. Medallia IT is a global, no-nonsense flat organization where the best ideas are implemented, no matter where they come from.

• We love technology and we are always after the latest technologies to learn and share with our team. We are not afraid of failing when we are experimenting with different technologies, development methodologies, and tools. We’ve got a culture focused on smarts, kindness, continual learning, and feedback.

• IT at Medallia is creating a world class delivery and capabilities organization that will simplify the landscape for support efficiency while also designing, planning and delivering quality new solutions cost effectively.

The Role and Team

As a Senior IT Systems Engineer at Medallia, you will focus on managing and optimizing collaboration tools such as Google Workspace and Slack. You will enhance the employee experience through secure, seamless integrations and automation across these platforms, while collaborating with internal and external teams to ensure consistent performance and security.

This is a hybrid position requiring a minimum of three days per week onsite in our Buenos Aires office in the Palermo barrio. While the primary focus of the role is Collaboration Services engineering and administration, the position will also provide secondary onsite IT support as needed, including hands-on end-user, conference room, and workplace technology support.

Responsibilities

• Architect and manage collaboration tools (Google Workspace, Slack).

• Automate workflows and optimize tool integration across SaaS platforms.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to align IT goals with business needs.

• Troubleshoot complex systems and ensure a secure, high-performing environment.

• Maintain a regular onsite presence at least three days per week and serve as a secondary escalation/support resource for onsite IT needs, including end-user technology, conference rooms, collaboration systems, and other workplace technology issues as required.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of experience managing collaboration tools in enterprise environments including experience with Slack and Google Meets management, and automation and integrations.

• 1+ year of experience with Google Workspace administration and security including Google Apps Manager(GAM).

• Demonstrated knowledge of identity management and SSO solutions (e.g., Okta) and security best practices for collaboration tools.

• Demonstrated experience in scripting (e.g., Google Apps Script, Python, PowerShell) for automation.

• Ability to work onsite a minimum of three days per week and travel to global offices for projects as needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Google Workspace Administrator certification.

• Experience with Slack Enterprise features and Google Meets Room management.

• Knowledge of VoIP systems (e.g., Zoom Phone, Google Voice).

• Experience with API-based integrations and automation tools (e.g., Zapier, Workato).

• Project management experience related to rolling out collaboration tools.

At Medallia, we celebrate diversity and recognize the value it brings to our customers and employees. Medallia is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, genetic information, veteran status or military service, or any other status protected by state or local law. Individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to apply please contact us at ApplicantAccessibility@medallia.com. For information regarding how Medallia collects and uses personal information, please review our Privacy Policies. Applications will be accepted for 30 days from the date this role was posted or until the role has been filled.

postings.descriptionText:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are looking for a Manufacturing & Supply Chain Support Analyst located in Buenos Aires, Argentina . This is your opportunity to join a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

What's In It For You

• Opportunity to support manufacturing and supply chain finance activities within a global organization

• Exposure to financial reporting, operational analysis, and cross-functional business partnering

• Work closely with finance and operations teams to drive data-driven decision making

• Professional growth in a collaborative and dynamic environment

• Experience supporting manufacturing, logistics, and supply chain initiatives

What You Will Do

• Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting activities for manufacturing and supply chain operations

• Prepare and maintain reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to support business decision making

• Analyze financial and operational results, identifying trends, variances, and improvement opportunities

• Support inventory, material usage, and cost analysis activities

• Assist with financial modeling, forecasting, and cost reduction initiatives

• Collaborate with finance and operations stakeholders to provide timely and accurate business insights

• Support process standardization, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives

• Ensure compliance with internal controls, reporting standards, and company policies

• Participate in special projects related to manufacturing, logistics, and supply chain operations

Position Details

• Work location: Buenos Aires, Argentina

• Work schedule: Full-time

• Work modality: Hybrid

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, or a related field

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Advanced Excel skills and ability to work with large data sets

• Ability to analyze financial and operational information and communicate findings effectively

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Ability to collaborate effectively with global teams and stakeholders

• Immigration sponsorship not offered for this role

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in manufacturing, supply chain, operations finance, or cost accounting environments

• Experience supporting financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, or business analysis activities

• Familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, JDE, or similar platforms

• Exposure to multinational organizations and shared services environments

• Strong communication and teamwork skills

About Us

ChampionX is now part of SLB, a global technology company driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. As innovators, that's been our mission for nearly a century.

We are a technology company that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. Today, we face a global imperative to create a future with more energy, but less carbon. Our diverse, innovative change makers are focused on going further in innovation and inventing the new energy technologies we need to get there.

For more news and information, visit SLB.com.

Follow us on Facebook at @WeAreSLBGlobal, LinkedIn: SLBGlobal, or Instagram at @SLBGlobal.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We believe the best teams are diverse and inclusive, and we are on a journey to create a workplace where every employee can grow and achieve their best. We are committed to fair and equal treatment of employees and applicants. We recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement on the basis of individual qualifications and job performance. In all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement, we will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, disability, or status as a covered veteran.

postings.descriptionText:
Descripción de la empresa

Louis Dreyfus Company es una empresa líder en la comercialización y transformación de productos agrícolas. Nuestras actividades abarcan toda la cadena de valor, desde el campo hasta la mesa, a través de una amplia gama de líneas de negocio, aprovechamos nuestro alcance global y nuestra extensa red de activos para servir a nuestros clientes y consumidores en todo el mundo. Estructurada como una organización matricial de seis regiones geográficas y diez plataformas, Louis Dreyfus Company opera en más de 100 países y emplea aproximadamente a 18.000 personas en todo el mundo.

Buscamos un/a Pasante para sumarse a brindar apoyo al Competence Center , un centro de expertise que brinda soporte desde distintas especialidades a las operaciones a nivel global, impulsando la transformación digital a través del análisis de datos, la automatización, la inteligencia artificial y las tecnologías de Industria 4.0.

• Utilizar herramientas y sistemas de Industria 4.0 aplicados a entornos industriales.

• Monitorear tableros de control con indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs) de diferentes plantas y regiones.

• Analizar sistemas de eficiencia energética y mantenimiento predictivo.

• Identificar correlaciones entre variables operativas y desarrollar modelos simples de seguimiento y análisis.

• Gestionar casos de desvíos operativos y realizar el seguimiento junto a referentes locales y regionales.

• Aplicar herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para el análisis de datos y soporte a la toma de decisiones.

• Elaborar reportes e indicadores para presentaciones mensuales.

• Interactuar con equipos multidisciplinarios para entender procesos y detectar oportunidades de optimización.

Requisitos

• Estudiantes avanzados/as de Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería en Sistemas, Ciencia de Datos, Analítica, Automatización, Electrónica o carreras afines.

• Interés por la transformación digital, la analítica de datos y la Industria 4.0.

• Conocimientos intermedios de Excel y herramientas de análisis de datos.

• Inglés intermedio/avanzado.

🤝 Lo que valoramos

• Curiosidad y ganas de aprender sobre tecnología aplicada a procesos industriales.

• Proactividad para identificar oportunidades y proponer mejoras.

• Capacidad para trabajar con múltiples stakeholders en un entorno regional.

• Orientación a resultados y atención al detalle.

• Interés por herramientas digitales, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial.

🚀 Sumate a un equipo que transforma datos en decisiones y tecnología en impacto para nuestras operaciones.

Información adicional

Que ofrecemos

Un entorno multicultural, dinámico y desafiante, que ampliará y desarrollará sus capacidades y canalizará sus habilidades y experiencia con excelentes oportunidades de desarrollo profesional, en una de las companías mas sólidas a nivel global.

Estos son algunos de nuestros beneficios:

• Salario y Beneficios Competitivos.

• Ambiente Laboral Flexible.

• Accesos a Capacitaciones y Desarrollo.

• Programa de Salud y Bienestar.

• Licencia por Maternidad y Paternidad Extendida.

Diversidad & Inclusión

LDC se rige por un conjunto de valores compartidos, elevadas normas éticas, y la diversidad y la inclusión forman parte de nuestro ADN. LDC es una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y se compromete a proporcionar un entorno de trabajo que adopte y valore la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión.

LDC fomenta la diversidad, apoya a las comunidades locales y las iniciativas medioambientales. Animamos a personas de todos los orígenes a presentar su candidatura.

El valor sustentable está en el centro de nuestro propósito como empresa.

Nos apasiona crear un valor justo y sustentable, tanto para nuestra empresa como para las demás partes interesadas de la cadena de valor: nuestra gente, nuestros socios comerciales, las comunidades con las que nos relacionamos y el medioambiente que nos rodea.

postings.title: Analista de Planificación de Compras - Rosario, Santa Fe
postings.descriptionText:
Desde METRA RH nos encontramos en la búsqueda de Analista de Planificación de Compras . El rol se orienta a analizar el consumo semanal, el stock disponible y las proyecciones de demanda (considerando la estacionalidad) para indicarle con precisión al área de Compras qué, cuánto y cuándo comprar. Nos orientamos a profesionales o estudiantes avanzados de Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería de Datos, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines, con experiencia previa en análisis de datos, manejo de Excel/planillas de gestión y apertura hacia el uso de Inteligencia Artificial para optimizar y simplificar la toma de decisiones.

Principales responsabilidades:

• Analizar el consumo semanal, el stock disponible y proyectar la demanda (considerando fechas especiales y estacionalidad) para determinar e indicar con precisión al área de Compras qué, cuándo y cuánto comprar.

• Unificar e integrar datos de distintas fuentes (Excel, planillas de gestión y sistemas) para generar visibilidad clara del flujo de materiales.

• Utilizar herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial y metodologías de análisis de datos para automatizar cruces, optimizar proyecciones y simplificar la toma de decisiones.

• Monitorear niveles de stock, detectar desvíos, inconsistencias y oportunidades de rotación en la operación industrial.

• Elaborar reportes e indicadores de gestión (KPIs) sobre consumo, stock de seguridad y efectividad de la planificación.

• Proponer e implementar mejoras en los procesos de planificación y gestión de información.

Requisitos:

• Graduado o estudiante avanzado de Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería de Datos, Ciencia de Datos, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines.

• Experiencia previa (deseable de 2 años) en funciones de análisis de datos, planificación, control de stock o gestión de insumos.

• Manejo avanzado de Excel y planillas de gestión (excluyente).

• Capacidad para interpretar y unificar volumen de datos, transformándolos en recomendaciones claras para la toma de decisiones.

• Interés y/o experiencia en el uso de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial aplicadas a la optimización de procesos y análisis de información.

• Perfil técnico, estructurado, orientativo al servicio/facilitación entre áreas y con visión analítica.

• Deseable: Conocimientos en SQL, Power BI u otras herramientas de visualización de datos.

• Deseable: Experiencia o conocimiento previo en la industria gastronómica o alimenticia.

Modalidad full time, horario de 09:00 a 18:00 pm - presencial, Rosario.

postings.descriptionText:
En Mercado Libre trabajamos para promover una cultura inclusiva, que busca la equidad y valora las diferentes perspectivas. Esto se traduce en género, religión, personas con discapacidad, LGBTQ+, etnia y diversidad de experiencias. Trabajamos todas nuestras búsquedas con base en esta premisa. ¡Súmate a nuestro equipo!

Estamos democratizando el comercio, el dinero y los pagos en América Latina.

Tenemos un desafío para quienes:

• Vibran energía emprendedora: se mueven por la curiosidad, nunca se rinden y se enfocan en superar sus propios límites.

• Dan el máximo porque les gusta trabajar con compromiso y dedicación.

• Viven los cambios como oportunidades y aprenden de sus errores.

• La excelencia y la ejecución son claves en su forma de hacer las cosas.

• Promueven el buen clima, aportan alegría y diversión.

• Saben cómo construir con otras personas y disfrutan trabajando en equipo.

Es Imaginate emprendiendo proyectos desafiantes, dinámicos e innovadores y siendo responsable de:

• Desarrollar tableros de control para uso de los líderes de equipo, supervisores y presentaciones a la operación, dando seguimiento a los indicadores clave para la toma de decisiones proactiva.

• Detectar oportunidades de mejora y elaborar planes de acción ante desvíos identificados en la operación.

• Analizar datos relacionados con inconsistencias de inventario, pérdidas y daños, productividad del sector y control de insumos.

• Dar seguimiento a las auditorías internas y externas del área.

• Trabajar de manera transversal con distintos equipos de la operación.

Requisitos:

• Dominar herramientas de análisis de datos y desarrollo de tableros de control, siendo excluyente el conocimiento de bases de datos.

• Contar con disponibilidad para trabajar de lunes a viernes en el site de Escobar.

• Estar cursando o haberse graduado en Ciencia de Datos, Ingeniería, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines, con experiencia en logística, calidad o inventario.

• Poseer habilidades de liderazgo, comunicación y trabajo colaborativo, con capacidad de comprensión de métricas y presentación de informes.

Te proponemos:
