postings.title: Customer Success Manager - Enterprise Arg
postings.descriptionText:
Customer Success Manager – Enterprise (Argentina)

Location: Argentina (Remote)

Investors

• Goldman Sachs Asset Management

• FinTech Collective

• Cometa

Company Overview

Founded in 2019, Simetrik is a robust B2B platform powered by no-code and generative AI, empowering financial and operational teams to automate reconciliations end-to-end, manage risks, and streamline operations from a single, spreadsheet-inspired interface. Simetrik is a market leader in Latin America, handling two-thirds of the region’s transactions and serving clients such as PayU, Mercado Libre, Rappi, PagSeguro, Falabella, Oxxo, Itaú, Nubank, and partnering with industry leaders like Deloitte. With expansion into Asian markets including India and Singapore, Simetrik now operates in over 35 countries, monitoring more than 200 million records daily.

Executive Team

• Alejandro Casas Caro – Co-Founder & CEO

• Santiago Gómez – Co-Founder & COO

• Felipe Pardo – CFO

• Juan Pablo Boccardi – VP of GTM

About The Role

As a Customer Success Manager – Enterprise at Simetrik, you will own value realization across a portfolio of enterprise customers in Argentina. You are responsible for ensuring that customers consistently use the platform, achieve measurable outcomes, and expand adoption through structured engagement, data-backed conversations, and strong stakeholder management. This is a customer-facing, outcomes-driven role where success is defined by the consistency and quality of your execution: staying close to your accounts, uncovering expansion opportunities, surfacing risk early, and translating product usage into ROI narratives that resonate with senior stakeholders.

What Does Success Look Like?

A Successful Enterprise CSM At Simetrik

• Maintains consistent and measurable portfolio coverage, engaging monthly with the majority of assigned accounts in Argentina.

• Uses platform data, reporting, and health indicators to drive proactive customer conversations.

• Demonstrates improvements in adoption and usability metrics tied to defined business outcomes.

• Builds and advances a visible expansion opportunity pipeline (cross-sell & upsell) with qualified business cases.

• Identifies commercial and adoption risk early, executing mitigation plans well before renewal cycles.

• Leads executive-level conversations centered on ROI, operational impact, and value proposition—positioning Simetrik as a strategic partner.

Impact & Scope

This role directly impacts Simetrik’s Net Revenue Retention and expansion growth strategy in Argentina. As the CSM for enterprise accounts, you own the performance and commercial durability of a portfolio of strategic customers. You drive adoption, demonstrate measurable ROI, and surface risk early to ensure renewal predictability and expansion readiness. You collaborate closely with Product, Revenue, and Operations, aligning internal teams to deliver outcomes that nurture long-term partnerships and directly influence revenue stability and growth.

Key Results (First 3–6 months)

First 30–60 Days

• Complete onboarding and demonstrate strong product fluency by leading customer conversations focused on business outcomes.

• Establish structured portfolio governance for assigned accounts; define meeting cadence, map stakeholders, document success plans.

• Achieve consistent and trackable portfolio coverage, ensuring active customer engagement each month.

By Month 3

• Achieve 80%+ structured monthly portfolio coverage with documented touchpoints and clear next steps in CRM.

• Build a visible and qualified expansion pipeline by identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities with business cases.

• Proactively surface commercial/adoption risk via health indicators and usage data; implement mitigation plans before renewal.

By Month 6

• Demonstrate measurable improvements in adoption and usability metrics tied to business outcomes.

• Lead executive business reviews, clearly articulating ROI delivered and strategic impact.

• Contribute to renewal predictability and expansion execution, partnering with Revenue and cross-functional teams for long-term growth.

Responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end customer journey for a portfolio of enterprise accounts in Argentina.

• Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including senior decision makers.

• Drive structured governance: cadence, agendas, follow-ups, escalation paths, and accountability.

• Translate product usage and operational data into business-impact conversations (ROI, savings, efficiency).

• Identify expansion opportunities and partner with revenue leaders to execute land-and-expand strategies.

• Detect and mitigate risk early using health indicators, adoption signals, and stakeholder engagement.

• Coordinate with Product, Implementation, Support, and Revenue to unblock customer outcomes.

• Maintain accurate account context and activity tracking in CRM and internal tools.

Must-Have Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or related field.

• 4+ years in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Solution Consulting roles within SaaS or enterprise software environments.

• Demonstrated experience in SaaS customer-facing roles with enterprise customers, including renewals and expansions.

• Commercial acumen: understanding of renewals, contract value, and expansion strategy, with the ability to connect customer outcomes to revenue impact.

• Executive presence and ability to lead outcome-driven discussions with senior stakeholders.

• Analytical, data-driven mindset with experience using usage signals to build account strategies and ROI cases.

• High operational discipline and CRM documentation accuracy for renewal predictability.

• Proven ability to build relationships across multiple stakeholders and proactively mitigate risk.

• Fluent in English (written and spoken); Spanish is a plus.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

• Experience at organizations known for Customer Success rigor (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, Oracle, or high-performance SaaS environments).

• Familiarity with finance operations, reconciliations, enterprise reporting, or data-intensive workflows.

• Experience with value-based frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC) and formal ROI/value realization programs.

• Experience supporting complex, technical products for enterprise clients.

Benefits

• Well-funded and proven startup with ambitious plans and competitive salaries

• Entrepreneurial culture that encourages creativity and collaboration

• Open communication with company leadership

• Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

• 100% Remote Work (work from anywhere)

• $500 USD per year for learning and development

• 2 Family days and 1 day off for your birthday

Simetrik welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and offers equal opportunity for employment.

By applying, you authorize Simetrik to use your data for hiring purposes in accordance with our Personal Data Treatment Policy.

postings.title: Engineering Engagement Lead (S&P 500 Customer) - LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
Space Inch is looking for an Engineering Engagement Lead to look after our engineers within a long-standing partnership with one of the largest investment managers in the U.S, who is a S&P 500 company . Our engineers work embedded in the client's teams, and the client directs their day-to-day work. Your job is everything around that work: making sure each engineer meets Space Inch's standards, understanding what they're building and why it matters to the client's business, helping them grow, and keeping communication clear between our people and the client.

This is a people, communication, and account role , which means that you won't assign tasks, run sprints, or make architecture decisions. An engineering background is a preference, but it's not a disqualifying criteria. What really matters is an engineer's mindset : you can sit down with an engineer or a client's engineering manager, understand what's being built, and have a real conversation about it.

Our mission, vision, and values

At Space Inch, we prioritize alignment with our clients and team, ensuring a deep understanding of their needs. We are committed to delivering exceptional work while supporting the personal and professional growth of our team members.

Working at Space Inch

• Our remote-first team of around 80+ people is based across the EU (mostly Croatia), the US, and Latin America, with a growing presence in Brazil

• Occasional travel for client visits and company retreats

• This role is embedded within a single long-standing client partnership, though you'll draw on Space Inch's broader engineering community and practices

• We support work/life balance for our team

Requirements

• Experience: 10+ years in engineering and people leadership, engagement or account management, or technical project/product management in an agency, consultancy, nearshore, or client-embedded environment; preferably coming from an engineering background, but not a must

• An engineer's mindset: you understand modern software development (SDLC, common architectures and stacks) well enough to follow what engineers are building, hold your own with client engineering and product managers, and notice when something is off. You don't need to write code

• Real curiosity about the client's business: you invest the time to learn the domain, why each application matters, and what workflow it replaces, so client stakeholders see you as someone who adds value

• A clear system for evaluating people: you can explain how you know someone is doing a great job, using standards, evidence, and feedback from several sources, and how you turn that into specific, actionable coaching

• Exceptional communicator and mediator who handles sensitive topics (compensation, retention, disengagement, underperformance) directly and with care, across written, async, live, and cross-cultural communication

• Proven track record of growing engineers: you've guided engineers along their career paths, from junior to senior and from individual contributor toward leadership, built development plans that led to real promotions, and can point to people who grew under your leadership

• Experience managing senior client stakeholders: gathering honest feedback, managing expectations, and showing the value our people bring

• Practical fluency with AI as a working tool: you can assess whether engineers are using AI well against defined practices and push them to improve

• Experience leading distributed or remote people, including those who work mostly on their own

Key Responsibilities

• Evaluation against our standards: Regularly assess every engineer and project against Space Inch's project success standards, and whether we're meeting both the client's needs and our team members' needs

• Client feedback loop: Work with the client's engineering and product managers to gather feedback on each engineer, including quality of work, taking into account how each client team operates

• Coaching and growth: Run regular 1:1s, give candid feedback, and build development plans that help engineers level up. Work with Engineering Leads, who coach informally, to round out evaluations

• Retention and connection: Keep engineers engaged and connected to Space Inch, especially those working alone on client projects. Spot retention risks early and resolve them

• Coaching and career growth: Run regular 1:1s, give candid feedback, and build development plans tied to Space Inch's career paths. Identify engineers who are ready for the next level, build their promotion cases, and support those moving toward leadership roles. Work with Engineering Leads, who coach informally, to round out evaluations

• Account management: Act as Space Inch's senior point of contact with the client on how our people are doing; manage expectations and help tell the story of the impact of our work

postings.title: Risk & Disputes Intern
postings.descriptionText:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Risk & Disputes Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Risk & Disputes Intern , you will be responsible for analyzing and responding to card and ACH disputes filed against Sezzle. Working closely with our fraud/risk team and our customer disputes team, you will navigate issues on a case by case basis to determine the best course of action to help our customers get unstuck. Analysts will also make recommendations to our management on how to improve and scale our processes.

We are looking for a teammate who can work full-time Monday through Friday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm - Central Time. This will be a paid internship.

What You'll Do:

• Investigate disputed credit card, debit card, and ACH transactions and take suitable action to resolve those disputes within the allowed timeframes.

• Work cross functionally with relevant departments (fraud, disputes) to determine next steps on a case to case basis.

• Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to identify patterns or trends.

• Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis.

• Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our loss prevention mechanisms, processes and tools.

• Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies.

• Maintain or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for timely resolution of queued cases to minimize potential losses.

• Handle escalations from internal and external stakeholders in a professional and efficient manner.

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

What We Look For:

• Experience in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment

• Attention to detail and ability to multitask

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills

• Strong business judgment and communication skills

• Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation : The salary for the Risk & Disputes Intern is $800 USD monthly as an independent contractor.

#Full-time

Pay Range

$800 - $800 USD

Gestionnaire principal de projets d’interprétation
(Senior Interpreting Project Manager)

À propos du poste
Le ou la Gestionnaire principal(e) de projets d’interprétation est responsable de la gestion et de la livraison de programmes d’interprétation complexes et multilingues, tout en assurant une expérience client exceptionnelle, l’excellence opérationnelle et l’atteinte des objectifs financiers. Ce poste supervise l’ensemble du cycle de vie des projets d’interprétation, gère des relations clients stratégiques et contribue à l’amélioration continue des processus, de la gestion des ressources et de la qualité des services.
À titre d’expert(e) opérationnel(le) principal(e), cette personne collabore étroitement avec les clients, interprètes, fournisseurs et parties prenantes internes afin de garantir une prestation fluide des services d’interprétation en présentiel, à distance, par vidéo ou lors d’événements multilingues.

Principales responsabilités

• Diriger la planification, l’exécution et la livraison de projets d’interprétation complexes couvrant plusieurs langues, régions et modes de prestation.

• Définir les stratégies de projet, les échéanciers, les plans de ressources et les modèles de prestation en fonction des objectifs des clients.

• Agir à titre de principal point de contact pour les clients stratégiques et assurer une communication proactive ainsi qu’un haut niveau de satisfaction.

• Gérer les ressources d’interprétation, les fournisseurs et les partenaires afin d’assurer une capacité optimale, une qualité élevée et une maîtrise des coûts.

• Superviser les activités d’assurance qualité afin de garantir la conformité aux exigences linguistiques, culturelles et contractuelles.

• Suivre l’avancement des projets, les budgets, les échéanciers et les risques opérationnels, et mettre en œuvre les mesures correctives nécessaires.

• Identifier et conduire des initiatives d’amélioration continue visant à optimiser l’efficacité opérationnelle, la qualité et l’évolutivité des services.

• Produire et présenter des rapports de performance ainsi que des bilans de projet aux clients et aux parties prenantes.

• Analyser l’utilisation des ressources et la performance opérationnelle afin d’améliorer la planification et la prise de décision.

• Collaborer avec les équipes des ventes, des opérations, de la qualité et de l’expérience client pour soutenir la conception de solutions et les initiatives stratégiques.

• Participer aux négociations avec les fournisseurs et aux activités d’approvisionnement liées aux services d’interprétation.

• Gérer les situations d’escalade complexes et coordonner la résolution des problèmes avec les clients, interprètes et équipes internes.

• Accompagner les gestionnaires de projets juniors et intermédiaires afin de promouvoir les meilleures pratiques et l’excellence opérationnelle.

• Contribuer à l’adoption de nouvelles technologies, d’outils d’automatisation et d’innovations dans le domaine de l’interprétation.

Expérience

• 4-6 ans ou plus d’expérience en gestion de projets, services d’interprétation, opérations de localisation, services linguistiques ou dans un environnement opérationnel similaire orienté client.

• Expérience démontrée dans la gestion de projets complexes impliquant de multiples parties prenantes, langues ou régions.

• Expérience de collaboration directe avec des clients stratégiques ou de grandes entreprises.

• Expérience en mentorat, coaching ou accompagnement de professionnels de la gestion de projets fortement souhaitée.

Formation

• Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, gestion de projet, marketing, langues, communication ou dans un domaine connexe.

Compétences spécifiques au poste

• Excellente maîtrise de la gestion de projets d’interprétation et des environnements de prestation multilingues.

• Capacité démontrée à gérer simultanément la qualité, les délais et les objectifs financiers de projets complexes.

• Solides compétences en gestion de la relation client et en prestation d’une expérience client de haut niveau.

• Bonne compréhension des flux de travail d’interprétation, de la gestion des ressources linguistiques et des standards de qualité.

• Excellentes habiletés en planification, priorisation et gestion des risques.

• Capacité à optimiser les processus et à mettre en œuvre des modèles de prestation évolutifs.

• Esprit analytique permettant d’exploiter les données opérationnelles et financières pour soutenir la prise de décision.

• Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes.

• Leadership reconnu et capacité à coordonner, développer et mobiliser les équipes.

• Solides aptitudes en résolution de problèmes et en gestion d’enjeux opérationnels complexes.

Compétences informatiques

• Maîtrise des plateformes de gestion de l’interprétation, des outils de planification et des technologies d’interprétation à distance.

• Excellente connaissance des outils de gestion de projets et des solutions de gestion des flux de travail.

• Maîtrise avancée de la suite Microsoft 365, particulièrement Excel pour la planification, l’analyse et le suivi budgétaire.

• Expérience avec les plateformes CRM, les outils de billetterie et les systèmes de gestion des services.

• Capacité à utiliser des tableaux de bord et des outils de production de rapports pour suivre la performance opérationnelle et les indicateurs clés.

• Connaissance des systèmes de gestion des fournisseurs, de l’approvisionnement et de la planification des ressources.

• Maîtrise des outils collaboratifs tels que Microsoft Teams, SharePoint et plateformes équivalentes.

• Aisance avec l’adoption de nouvelles technologies, de solutions d’automatisation et d’outils assistés par l’intelligence artificielle.

postings.title: Salesforce Administrator
postings.descriptionText:
The Allegro team is united by a clear purpose—advancing technologies that make the world safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor innovation, we bring that purpose to life across every part of the business—from breakthrough product development and customer success to how we show up for each other and the communities we serve.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Salesforce Administrator with 2–5 years of experience to help manage and improve our Salesforce environment. You will own day-to-day administration and configuration and partner with stakeholders across the business to shape how Salesforce supports our operations. This is a hybrid role based in Argentina. You'll work within a governed release process and a ticket-driven (Jira) support model, supporting a Manufacturing Cloud–based org (Opportunities, Sales Agreements, and forecasting) in a regulated automotive-semiconductor environment.

What You Will Do

Administration

• User & security management: Manage users, roles, profiles, permission sets, and permission set groups, applying least privilege access with a clear, auditable trail of approvals.

• Declarative configuration: Build and maintain Flows, validation rules, page layouts, record types, custom objects, and custom fields.

• Reporting: Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and list views for business stakeholders, and support downstream reporting/BI needs, including Tableau.

• Data quality: Support data hygiene through imports, deduplication, and mass updates.

• User enablement: Provide end-user support and training and maintain documentation.

• Ticket management: Triage and work the support backlog in Jira (access requests, data corrections, configuration changes, user provisioning, and day-to-day business support), following documented SOPs and keeping an audit-ready record.

• Release & change management: Support the deployment pipeline (changes promoted through developer and QA sandboxes to production using Git and a Salesforce DevOps tool such as Gearset), participate in the formal change-control process (change requests, approvals, communication and rollback plans, and before/after QA evidence), assist with sandbox refreshes, and administer AppExchange/managed packages.

What You Will Need

• 2–5 years of Salesforce administration experience.

• Salesforce Certified Administrator credential (required).

• Familiarity with declarative tools: Flow, validation rules, reports/dashboards, and the security model.

• Familiarity with a Salesforce deployment/DevOps tool (e.g., Gearset) and basic source-control (Git) concepts.

• Comfortable working within a formal change-management and release-approval process.

• Strong attention to detail and a genuine eagerness to learn.

• Good written and verbal communication skills.

• Professional working proficiency in English.

• Based in Argentina and able to work a hybrid schedule from our local office.

Preferred Qualifications

• Progress toward or completion of additional certifications such as Platform App Builder.

• Exposure to Manufacturing Cloud (Sales Agreements, account-based forecasting), Sales Cloud, and/or Service Cloud.

• Basic understanding of development concepts such as Apex and SOQL (a plus, not required).

• Exposure to integration tooling such as MuleSoft.

• Exposure to Salesforce AI (Agentforce, Prompt Builder).

• Experience in manufacturing, semiconductor, or global B2B enterprise environment.

• Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or in progress / equivalent experience.

Why Allegro?

Join Allegro and become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

We foster a culture of Real Innovation , empowering you to push boundaries, develop cutting-edge solutions, and drive continuous improvement.

Your work will create a Real Impact by solving complex real-world challenges that fuel our success and shape the future of technology.

You’ll experience Real Connection , collaborating with talented colleagues around the globe in an environment built on trust, respect, and a shared purpose.

postings.title: VP of Sales
postings.descriptionText:
About Rebill

Rebill is the financial infrastructure platform for the Americas.

The companies shaping software, AI, travel, and digital services use Rebill to operate across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and the United States.

Rebill brings local payments, installments, recurring billing, stablecoin rails, treasury, global payouts, and financial operations into one platform built for how money actually works across the Americas.

Every market is different. Rebill makes the infrastructure consistent. Engineering, finance, and operations teams can manage local currency acceptance, market-specific payment behavior, funds, and financial workflows from the same platform.

Companies can launch in Latin America in as little as a day and expand across markets without rebuilding their financial stack country by country.

Built locally. Designed to scale globally.

Rebill is backed by leading global investors such as Tiger Global, Y Combinator (W22), Soma Capital and SV Angel, and angels including Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and Arash Ferdowsi (Dropbox).

About The Role

You own new cross-border revenue.

Rebill sells to companies that charge consumers in Latin America without holding a legal entity there: software, AI, travel assistance, education, and subscription businesses. The buyer usually sits in the US. The revenue sits in LATAM. You are the person in front of that buyer.

For the first two quarters you close accounts yourself. After that you build the team that closes them at scale. You inherit a live pipeline and a small commercial team, and you report to the co-founders.

We prefer Miami, where one of the founders is based. New York and the Bay Area work too. So do Mexico City, Bogotá and Buenos Aires, if you already sell to US and global companies from there and can be on a plane when a deal needs it.

Why this role exists

Rebill has grown on founder-led sales. That has taken the company further than it should have, and it has reached its limit.

The cross-border product carries materially better unit economics than local processing, and it is the part of the business with the most room in the US market. Nobody at Rebill wakes up every day responsible for opening and closing those accounts. That is the gap this seat closes.

What you will own

New cross-border revenue. Net new revenue from companies collecting in Latin America without a local entity. You carry a number from month one and you are measured on net revenue, not processed volume.

Closing, personally. The first two quarters you are in the deals, not above them. Discovery, pricing, objection handling, and signature.

The sales team. Hiring, ramping, and managing account executives as volume justifies it. You design the comp plan and the quota structure with the founders.

The commercial motion. Qualification criteria, pricing conversations, and the handoff to implementation. Today that lives in the founders' heads. It should live in a process.

Acquirer and partner leverage. Rebill holds direct relationships with acquirers in Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, and the United States. You turn those relationships and our partner network into a channel.

What we are looking for

• You come from payments. This is the one requirement we do not flex on. 10+ years selling B2B payments, with a track record in cross-border collection or local acquiring into Latin America or the Americas. We are not going to teach you the industry.

• You have closed merchants, not banks or processors. Our buyer is a CFO, a COO, or a founder at a company that sells to LATAM consumers.

• You have built a sales team from a small base and scaled it. We are looking for someone who took a company from a few million in ARR to a multiple of that, not someone who inherited a running machine.

• Fluent English. You run discovery, negotiate and close in English with a US buyer, wherever you are based. Professional Spanish, Portuguese, or both, enough to hold a technical conversation with a merchant.

• Fluency in the economics: take rate, FX spread, installments, approval rates, chargebacks. You can defend a price without a solutions engineer in the room.

• Based in Miami, New York, the Bay Area, Mexico City, Bogotá or Buenos Aires. Miami is preferred. Wherever you sit, you travel to the US, across LATAM and to industry events.

• AI tools as part of how you work. Everyone at Rebill uses them daily to move faster.

Nice to have

• Time at a regional PSP or inside the LATAM business of a global acquirer.

• Experience selling into travel assistance, education, or subscription businesses.

• Portuguese at a working level for Brazil.

• Prior startup or YC-company experience at a similar stage.

What we offer

• A package weighted toward what you close: base, an aggressive variable tied to the net revenue you generate, and meaningful equity.

• Direct access to the founders and to the product team, with no layers in between.

• Hybrid where we have an office (Miami, Buenos Aires, Bogotá). Remote from the other cities, with regular time in Miami.

How we hire

An intro conversation, a working session on a real account from our pipeline, and a conversation with the founders. We will tell you what is still open. We expect the same candour back.

postings.title: Inspections Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
You'll own the daily inspection calls and scheduling for a US home-services company, making sure every permit gets closed out on time.

Remote · LATAM · Full-time · Independent Contractor · Early morning US Eastern shift (approximately 6–7 AM to 2–3 PM ET, with some flexibility)

Why this role exists

Our client is a plumbing and construction company in the US. They run a busy appliance installation side, where almost every job needs a permit and an inspection. Inspections happen after the work is done, but they protect the company's license and close out every permit. They also hold up the whole operation if they aren't closed.

There is a large backlog, over 150 inspections at different stages, and hundreds of new inspections and permits come in every week. The owner is building the system from the ground up: a customer booking portal that connects to the technicians' schedule. It will cut about 30 hours a week of back-and-forth with customers. By the time you start, the process will be organized and documented. You'll learn it alongside the owner and then run it.

You'll report directly to the owner. The team (owner, plumbing coordinator, office team) works together in a WhatsApp group. Everyone has their own role, and the work is a cascade: if one step isn't done, the next person can't do theirs. The owner needs someone they can trust to do the job without being chased.

What you'll own
• Call town inspectors within their narrow windows (often one hour, same day, e.g. 7:30–8:30 AM) to book the day's inspections
• Start every day with a checklist of who to call, for which inspection, and at what time
• Plan one or two days ahead so no call window is missed
• Track bookings in the spreadsheet and send booking links to customers
• Tell each inspector which jobs are scheduled and when, and check them off once confirmed
• Keep the owner informed when a stand-in is needed so plumbers aren't double-booked
• Work down the backlog by prioritizing the towns with the most outstanding permits, then close out town by town
• Handle both past inspections (the backlog) and new inspections and permits
• Navigate the rules of around 50 Massachusetts towns, each with its own process
• Tools: Google Sheets, WhatsApp, FieldPulse

Why this is interesting
• You'll learn a system built from scratch with the owner
• A new booking portal will automate much of the customer scheduling
• A small, close team where each role matters and your work is visible
• Autonomy and trust: the owner doesn't want to micromanage
• A real impact on the business, since closed inspections keep the company running

What we're looking for
• Highly detail-oriented, someone who notices what needs doing and adds it without being told
• Extremely punctual and reliable. Missing a call window means missing the whole day.
• Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets (the whole system runs on spreadsheets)
• Computer-savvy and eager to learn new systems
• Proactive and self-directed: does the job without being checked on
• A confident, personable communicator, bubbly but with a backbone, who can handle (and win over) tough inspectors by phone
• Able to work an early US Eastern morning shift
• Fluent English for daily phone calls with US inspectors and customers

Bonus
• Previous permitting experience
• Experience in the trades or home-services industry

What success looks like

First 90 days
• You've learned the system and can run the daily call routine with little guidance
• The backlog is shrinking steadily
• No missed inspector call windows

Ongoing
• You run inspections independently, with no need for follow-up
• The team can trust that inspections are scheduled and closed without being checked
• You keep up with new inspections and permits, including peaks around US sale seasons (Black Friday, New Year's, Presidents' Day, tax-free weekends, July 4th)

postings.descriptionText:

Job Title: Operations Coordinator

About The Company:

Our client is a small, fast-moving candy startup in San Diego whose founders have about 50 years of combined industry experience. It runs wholesale candy distribution and custom gummy and product development, and it invents its own products.

About The Role

Candy Pros is looking for a highly resourceful, organized, proactive, and commercially minded person who can take an idea or objective and figure out how to make it happen.

We have important projects and opportunities sitting on the back burner because we haven't had the time to move them forward. We need someone who can take ownership of these initiatives, research the best way to execute them, find the right people and resources, and manage the process through completion.

This is not a traditional administrative assistant role. We need a doer, problem-solver, and project owner who combines entrepreneurial resourcefulness with excellent organization, sound business judgment, and high standards for quality.

You don't need to know how to do everything when you start, nobody knows this but we expect you to know how to research, find answers, identify the right resources, and determine the best path forward. Basically, figure it out.

If you encounter something you don't know how to do, your response should be:

"I don't know yet, but I'll figure it out."

We want someone who is scrappy about finding solutions and controlling costs but also has an eye for quality. We don't want the cheapest option simply because it's cheap. We want the best solution for the money.

Above all, we're looking for someone with a "consider it done" mentality who takes ownership, moves quickly, communicates consistently, and follows through.

Key Responsibilities

• E-commerce and sales channel development

Help Candy Pros expand its online sales channels.

Examples:

Launch our wholesale store on Faire.

Research and set up our store on Airgoods.

Gather Product Information, Pricing, Images, And Other Required Materials.

Organize and upload product listings.

Identify additional sales channels that could benefit our business.

Manage Listing Updates And Other Platform Requirements.

• Product pricing and catalog development

Help us finalize our price lists and create professional, accurate product catalogs.

Examples:

Organize product information and SKUs.

Research competitor pricing and market information.

Help develop wholesale price lists.

Coordinate product descriptions, specifications, and images.

Identify missing information and obtain it from our team.

Ensure consistency across catalogs, our website, and sales platforms.

• Research and sourcing

Conduct thorough research to find the best vendors, suppliers, service providers, and business resources.

For example, if we need a candy co-packer, we don't want a random list of companies from Google. We want you to identify qualified candidates, investigate their capabilities and reputations, verify relevant information, compare pricing and quality, and present your strongest recommendations.

The same applies to finding manufacturers, suppliers, contractors, freelancers, agencies, and other business resources.

We want you to find the best sources, not just any sources.

• Social media and marketing operations

Help turn our social media efforts into an organized, effective operation.

Examples:

Research the best approach for our business.

Develop a practical plan for getting our social media operation off the ground.

Find and evaluate marketing professionals, freelancers, agencies, and tools.

Compare costs, capabilities, and deliverables.

Recommend the best resources.

Coordinate execution and manage timelines.

Help establish a consistent content creation and publishing process.

• Website development and management

When we need a new website or improvements to an existing one, figure out how to get it done.

Examples:

Research platforms and potential approaches.

Identify qualified developers or agencies.

Compare capabilities, portfolios, pricing, and proposals.

Interview potential providers.

Recommend the best option and explain why.

Coordinate the project, manage timelines, and follow up on deliverables.

You don't necessarily need to build websites yourself. You need to find the right people, evaluate their work, and manage the project through completion.

• Purchasing and cost optimization

Help us source products, equipment, and supplies for our warehouse and business operations.

Examples:

Research suppliers and compare quotes.

Evaluate quality, shipping costs, reliability, and pricing.

Find the best value rather than automatically choosing the lowest price.

Communicate with vendors and obtain information.

Coordinate orders and follow up.

Identify opportunities to reduce costs without compromising quality.

• Trade shows and special projects

Help organize and execute trade show participation and other business initiatives.

Examples:

Research trade shows and evaluate opportunities.

Coordinate booth requirements, displays, materials, and logistics.

Find vendors and obtain quotes.

Organize deadlines and deliverables.

Coordinate shipments and supplies.

Ensure everything is ready on time.

• Recruiting and finding talent

Help us identify and recruit the people we need to grow.

Examples:

Research job roles and candidate markets.

Write and publish job advertisements.

Identify appropriate recruiting platforms.

Develop interview questions and screening criteria.

Research and evaluate candidates.

Coordinate interviews and organize hiring information.

• General business research and problem-solving

Help with projects that don't fit neatly into a predefined category.

Examples:

Find the best flight and travel arrangements for a trip.

Research unfamiliar business opportunities.

Find professionals or vendors to solve specific problems.

Evaluate software, services, and business tools.

Develop processes for unfamiliar tasks.

Coordinate projects involving multiple people or organizations.

The common thread is simple: you can be given an objective without knowing all the steps in advance, and you can independently determine how to accomplish it.

How We Expect You To Work

Our preferred working process is:

Understand the objective. Clarify what we want to accomplish and any important constraints.

Research thoroughly. Investigate options, verify information, and identify the best resources.

Develop a recommendation. Explain your findings, reasoning, estimated costs, and proposed approach.

Agree on the plan. Discuss your recommendation with us and make important decisions together.

Execute. Coordinate the people, resources, and activities needed to achieve the objective.

Communicate and follow through. Keep us informed, solve problems, and ensure the project reaches completion.

We want someone who exercises independent judgment while collaborating with us on significant decisions.

We don't want to micromanage every step, and we don't expect you to make major commitments without appropriate discussion and approval.

The Skills And Qualities We Need

Resourcefulness and problem-solving

Excellent research and information verification skills.

A natural ability to figure things out.

Persistence when answers aren't immediately obvious.

The ability to find the right people, tools, and resources.

Strong judgment when comparing alternatives.

Speed and initiative

A bias toward action.

The ability to move quickly without sacrificing accuracy.

A proactive approach to identifying next steps.

The ability to work independently without constant direction.

A willingness to take ownership rather than wait for someone else to solve the problem.

Organization and project management

Strong organizational skills.

The ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.

Attention to detail and deadlines.

Consistent follow-through.

The ability to coordinate people, vendors, and deliverables.

Communication

Excellent written and verbal communication.

Proactive updates on progress, milestones, and next steps.

Clear explanations of findings and recommendations.

The ability to raise important questions early.

The ability to present problems alongside proposed solutions.

Business judgment and quality

A commercial mindset and awareness of cost.

The ability to distinguish good value from simply being cheap.

An eye for quality, professionalism, and presentation.

Good judgment when evaluating vendors and business opportunities.

Technology

Experience with Shopify and e-commerce platforms is valuable. HubSpot experience is a plus, but not mandatory.

More important than knowing a particular tool is the ability to learn new systems, research unfamiliar processes, and use technology effectively.

AI tools may be used when appropriate, but candidates must verify information, exercise independent judgment, and take responsibility for the quality of their work.

The Person We Want to Hire

We want someone who combines the organization and reliability of a strong operations professional with the initiative and resourcefulness of an entrepreneur.

You should be able to take a complicated or unfamiliar task, break it into manageable steps, find the right resources, and make steady progress without needing constant guidance.

You should care about the quality of your work and take pride in delivering results.

If people regularly come to you because you're the person who can figure things out, solve problems, and make things happen, we want to hear from you.

9:00 AM to 11:00 AM PT

10 hours per week

postings.company: AFFCT | Global Influencer Marketing & Creative Strategy Agency
postings.descriptionText:
B2B Sales Manager, LatAm (Remote): Sell Influencer Campaigns to Brands
AFFCT | Remote, based in Argentina | All of Latin America

What this job is
You sell influencer marketing campaigns to brands. You find companies that want to advertise, pitch them and sign the deal. You do not search for or manage creators: our team already does that.

Where
You sell across all of Latin America. Our priority markets are Argentina, Mexico and Brazil. Beyond them, we sell to brands across the whole region.

About AFFCT
AFFCT is a high-risk influencer marketing agency. We run influencer campaigns, video production and brand integrations. A significant part of our creator base is 18+ creators. If you are not comfortable selling campaigns built on that segment, this role is not for you. We don’t have a sales department yet. We’re looking for the person who will be first.

Where we are strong
We sell access to audiences we already reach. Creators, scouts and managers are in place and delivery is covered, so you build demand and nothing else. That is why our deals close in days and weeks.

• Priority 1, LatAm : Argentina, Mexico, Brazil, plus the rest of Latin America. This is where our 18+ creators are, and their audience reaches well beyond the region: around 20% of it is in the US on 18+ video platforms, and 40 to 50% on X.

• Priority 2 : Nigeria, Kenya, India, with mainstream creators.

These are priorities, not limits. If you bring warm contacts in another market we can deliver in, we want to hear about it.

Who you’ll sell to
Any brand that wants to reach LatAm audiences, and a sizeable US audience through them, and is comfortable advertising alongside 18+ creators. In practice that is mostly high-risk: prediction markets, our fastest growing segment; crypto, Web3 and trading; dating and social apps; sexual wellness; tier-3 fintech and card products; betting and casino.

The role
Hunting: new business, outbound and closing. No inbound leads, no sales infrastructure, no team behind you yet. You will personally write the first cold messages, run the first pitches and sign the first contracts. This is not account management and not a meeting-setter job.

• Build pipeline through outbound: LinkedIn, Telegram, email, industry events.

• Reach real decision-makers and lead pitches end to end.

• Turn each client’s problem into a tailored proposal: decks, numbers, commercials.

• Negotiate the fee upward instead of discounting to close.

• Keep deals moving so payments land and campaigns launch on schedule.

What matters to us

• Deals you closed yourself, where you found the brand and signed the contract.

• Outbound you built yourself, without warm inbound.

• Speed: first contact to signature in days and weeks, not months.

• Commercial nerve. You can hold and raise margin instead of discounting to win.

• Genuine comfort in high-risk verticals and with 18+ creators.

• Fluent English (B2+), our working language.

• Strong advantages: Spanish or Portuguese ; warm contacts with brands or affiliate managers in Argentina, Mexico or Brazil; a background in influencer marketing, performance, affiliate or media.

Compensation
The fixed base is reasonable but modest, and we’d rather say that plainly. The real money is a serious performance-based share of what you sell. This role is built for someone who wants their income to come from closing rather than from salary.

What you get
Direct access to the founder, real influence over sales strategy, freedom to build your own structure, and a growth path toward Head of Sales. If you’ve built revenue from zero before, send a short intro with examples of how you did it.

postings.descriptionText:
BRÍO STUDIO INCORPORA COMERCIALES EN ARGENTINA
Para vender webs a negocios, con la cartera de tu zona ya analizada y entregada.

Brío Studio es un estudio de diseño y desarrollo web. Trabajamos en remoto para clientes de varios países e iniciamos ahora la operación comercial en Argentina.

LA POSICIÓN
El objetivo es uno: vender webs a negocios. Trabajás la zona que definas —tu ciudad, tu provincia o el país entero— sobre una cartera de empresas que te entregamos ya analizada. Tu función es el contacto comercial: presentás la propuesta, detectás el interés y lo derivás al estudio. Desde ahí entramos nosotros: preparamos el presupuesto, fijamos el precio y llevamos la negociación hasta la firma. Diseño, textos y desarrollo corren por nuestra cuenta.

QUÉ TE DAMOS
— La cartera de tu zona, negocio por negocio: nombre, teléfono y el motivo concreto por el que cada uno necesita una web.
— Formación inicial y el mismo argumentario de venta que usamos nosotros.
— El respaldo del estudio en cada negociación.
— Un producto que se sostiene solo: web profesional completa, con SEO y primer año de mantenimiento incluidos y plazo de entrega firmado en contrato.
— Catálogo para negocios de cualquier tamaño, de la web sencilla a la tienda online, con el presupuesto ajustado a cada caso. Siempre tenés algo que ofrecerle al que tenés delante.

CONDICIONES
— Modalidad: remota, desde donde estés. Presencial, teléfono o WhatsApp, como te resulte mejor.
— Horario: lo organizás vos.
— Comisión: 135.000 pesos por cada web corporativa que firma un cliente, y sube con el tamaño del proyecto. Cinco webs corporativas en un mes son 675.000 pesos. Cuantas más cerrás, más cobrás.
— Se pacta en dólares y se paga por transferencia internacional: lo que se te debe no pierde valor mientras esperás.
— Continuidad: buscamos gente que se quede. Desde el primer cliente la colaboración queda por escrito, y cuando el volumen lo justifica pasamos a condiciones propias.

PERFIL
Comerciales, y también quien trata a diario con dueños de empresas: contadores, fotógrafos, publicidad, consultoría, agencias. Consideramos igualmente a quien empieza — la formación la damos nosotros.

POSTULACIÓN
Cinco datos, dos minutos: brio-studio.es/colaboradores/solicitud
Leemos todas las postulaciones y respondemos por WhatsApp.

postings.title: Regional Sales Manager (Sur)
postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About The Role

This is a rare opportunity to be one of Halter's first Regional Sales Managers (Sur), Argentina — one of the world's great cattle nations — building our customer presence in the region from the ground up.

We're looking for a go-getter who is out in the field, meeting farmers, championing Halter and converting them into our very first local customers. A 'never give up attitude' is crucial for this role; as our first sales hire on the ground, you will be a foundational contributor to the growth and success of Halter in Argentina.

You'll be responsible for using your strong sales background to drive end-to-end sales, from cold calling and on-farm meetings to deeply understanding our customers' farm systems. You'll detail Halter's value proposition, progress the sale, and ultimately close the deal. As the region scales, you'll help shape how we set quotas and commissions, build sales capability, and mentor the team that follows you. Make your mark with Halter and help us push the boundaries of farming, connecting animals and humans like never before.

What Your Day Could Look Like

• Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals/introductions, industry events and other channels, as well as fielding and responding to inbound inquiries.

• Meeting high growth sales targets by managing pipeline through to close, including screening, qualifying, executing on-farm demonstrations and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

• Laying the groundwork for the local sales function — helping to set and manage quotas, commissions and other sales management tasks as the team grows.

• Coaching, mentoring and developing future sales staff to help drive their professional growth and reach targets as we scale the region.

• Collaborating with Customer Success to ensure successful post-sales handoff, implementations, customer satisfaction and account renewal.

• Providing support, insight and communication to help build and foster trusting and enduring relationships with customers as they wait for deployment.

• Leveraging opportunities and participating in relevant industry/Halter events and demonstrations.

• Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand in a brand-new market.

• Focusing on the customer and their needs, providing feedback to help drive the product roadmap.

• Working with the team to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient and more predictable as the company scales.

Who Are We Looking For

• A complete end-to-end sales skill set with at least five years of experience.

• Proven track records and examples of successfully sourcing new prospects, securing meetings with new leads and creating new sales opportunities.

• Someone highly experienced in value-based sales with a proven history of closing deals and high-volume sales results.

• Well-prepared with solid communication skills to present Halter's value proposition.

• Experience in beef farming or within the agricultural sector is highly desirable.

• A person who is results-driven, highly motivated with exceptional time management skills.

• Adaptability in a high-stakes sales environment and the ability to think on your feet — comfort with the ambiguity of building in a new market is a big plus.

• Sales experience in the technology-based industry is preferred.

• Fluency in Spanish, with professional working English to collaborate across our global team.

• A university degree or equivalent would be excellent but not a must.

Halter in Argentina

Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

They are growing their enterprise sales motion across firms with 50+ advisors, with deal sizes ranging from $100K–$500K+ ACV. The company is hiring a closing-focused AE to own complex opportunities from qualified meeting through signed contract.

Need to have qualifications:

• 4+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience with a proven track record selling mid-market and enterprise accounts.

• Consistent history of achieving 100%+ annual quota attainment.

• Experience closing complex deals valued at $100K+ ACV.

• Strong experience navigating multi-stakeholder buying committees, including executives, operations, and compliance leaders.

• Native or near-native English communication skills, written and verbal.

• Proven experience managing enterprise sales cycles with multiple decision-makers and longer timelines.

• Strong negotiation skills, including multi-year agreements, phased rollouts, enterprise deployments, and custom pricing.

• Strong CRM discipline and experience maintaining accurate pipeline data, preferably in HubSpot.

• Comfortable leading executive-level conversations and presenting business value rather than product features.

• Willingness to work as a Latin America-based contractor selling to U.S. customers.

Nice to have:

• Experience selling into wealth management, financial services, or RIAs.

• Experience selling SaaS products to firms with 250+ employees or advisors.

• Familiarity with compliance, advisor workflows, or investment-management operations.

• Experience with complex enterprise pricing and deal architecture.

• Experience using HubSpot and account research tools such as AdvisorPro.

• Experience informally coaching or mentoring other sales team members.

Responsibilities:

• Own qualified opportunities from the first qualified meeting through signed contract.

• Lead deal strategy for SME and enterprise firms with 50+ advisors and $100K–$500K+ ACV opportunities.

• Navigate buying committees involving firm principals, CCOs, COOs, and operations leaders.

• Build and maintain accurate account plans covering decision-makers, competition, timelines, and deal strategy.

• Maintain a clean HubSpot pipeline with accurate stages, next steps, notes, and close dates.

• Create tailored pricing proposals based on firm size, product fit, competitive positioning, and prospect needs.

• Structure multi-year agreements, phased rollouts, and enterprise-wide deployments with the Head of Sales.

• Negotiate pricing and contracts while protecting margins and maintaining discounting discipline.

• Identify deal blockers early and escalate opportunities requiring executive support.

postings.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Chile
postings.descriptionText:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms

• ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

• ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

• ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

• High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

• Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

• AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

• Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

• Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

• Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

• Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

• Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

• Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

• Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

• Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About The Role

We’re looking for a highly motivated, self-starter Account Executive in Spanish Latam who is passionate about voice technology and how it is changing businesses. We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with organizations to help them generate new experiences and monetization opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology. In this role you will:

• Build and manage a growing portfolio of new accounts across industries adopting conversational AI to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals

• Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs’ conversational AI capabilities can drive user engagement, automation, or cost efficiency

• Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends

• Demonstrate expertise—or a strong willingness to learn—about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs’ voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, in-app assistants, and more

Requirements

• 3–5+ years of sales experience in a SaaS or technology company, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API platforms

• Experience selling technical solutions to product, engineering, or innovation teams is a strong plus

• Proven track record of meeting & exceeding sales targets in a fast-paced environment

• Expertise or willingness to learn everything about voice and audio AI and how our solutions can help prospects

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

• A hybrid of customer & product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction & scale

• Fluency in English and Spanish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances

Location

This role is remote and can be executed in Chile, with preference for Santiago or Lima.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

postings.title: Open Source Enterprise Sales Manager - North America
postings.descriptionText:
We are hiring a regional sales manager in North America to lead the direct sales team in the region. Apply here if you believe you possess outstanding revenue generating experience from the Technology industry.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

As we continue to grow we are looking to hire both Enterprise Sales and Alliances Sales representatives to drive revenue growth and meet our goals.

Our Alliances Sales Directors own a book of business helping to enable Canonical to work with its go to market partners, hardware vendors, software vendors, solutions integrators and distributors and channels. With a fast growing channel business, GSI/SI and Hardware partners, we need to enable, manage and grow business opportunities and drive market expansion alongside revenue growth.

Reporting to the Alliances leadership, you will be working with direct sales, marketing, product, customer success, finance, legal and support as you demonstrate thought leadership, practical skills, and apply your knowledge and experience to help us grow in this critical area.

Our Enterprise Sales Executives own the relationships with our direct customers and are responsible for maintaining and growing relationships that result in mutually beneficial engagements. They help craft solutions that enable our customers to be more efficient, solve more complex problems and walk the path with the customer to get the best possible results.

Reporting to Sales leadership, you will work across either a region or a vertical and you can bring your knowledge of previous customers with you. We are committed to giving customers the most knowledgeable and most competent partners in sales so that we can succeed together.

Location: We have remote opportunities available globally.

These roles entail

• Advancing a deep understanding of Linux and cloud software ecosystem, and open source selling models

• Experience with negotiating contracts and commercial business terms

• Building and expanding strategic relationships

• Building and owning the strategy and the development of the sales engagements

• Growing customers awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu

• Delivering on targets, objectives and providing a voice of the partner and/or customer

• Travelling both domestically and internationally to drive partnerships in person

• Aligning and supporting internal Field teams to identify, support, grow and transact

• Working closely with Marketing, Sales Engineering and Product Management to deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner and/or customer

• Leading executive interlocks between partners/customers and our own leadership team

What We Are Looking For In You

• Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve revenue outstanding results in our technological field

• Experience with Linux and opensource

• Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university, regardless of seniority of current position

• Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path

• Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation

• Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship

• Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives

• The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues

• Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

• Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability

• Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation

• Thoughtfulness and self-motivation with results orientated mind set and a high level of personal drive to meet commitments

• Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long and more regularly to meet clients and partners as required

What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Employee Assistance Program including Health and Wellness platform

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: Complex Math Data Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Interested? Click Here to Apply

TELUS Digital is seeking research-level mathematicians to contribute to an advanced mathematical reasoning benchmark for a leading AI research organisation.

As a Complex Math Data Specialist, you will design a single original, research-level mathematical problem intended to probe the limits of current AI reasoning systems. The problem should sit beyond the capabilities demonstrated by current frontier models under the programme's evaluation protocol and must have a precise, machine-checkable answer.
This is problem authoring, not proof formalisation. You will not be asked to produce a machine-checked proof. Instead, you will create one rigorous mathematical challenge, provide its exact answer and solution, and supply the computational materials required to independently verify the result.

The project is particularly suited to researchers with deep expertise in areas such as number theory, combinatorics, algebraic geometry, analysis, topology, differential geometry, PDEs, harmonic analysis, category theory, or mathematical physics.

What You'll Do

• Design one original research-level problem in your area of mathematical expertise. The problem must be new and unpublished. You may build on existing mathematical ideas, but the resulting problem must be sufficiently transformed or combined that its source is not readily identifiable.

• Make the problem completely self-contained. Include all definitions, conventions, non-standard notation and hypotheses required to solve it. The evaluator will not have access to supplementary papers or references at evaluation time.

• Define one exact answer and answer type. Accepted formats may include a Python integer, sympy.Expr, sympy.Matrix, tuple of integers, or another explicitly supported machine-checkable format. Approximate answers do not receive credit.

• Make the problem resistant to guessing. The probability of obtaining the correct answer without performing the substantive mathematical work should be below the programme's threshold. Small integers, familiar constants, simple counts and yes/no answers are generally unsuitable.

• Provide a complete solution write-up, presenting the key mathematical idea first, followed by the reasoning and any required computation.

• Provide reproducible code that computes or verifies the answer and runs in under approximately 60 seconds on ordinary hardware.

• Provide the required reference-answer function in the programme's submission format.

• Evaluate your own problem using the programme's testing harness, including repeated independent model attempts, a statement-only guessing attack and contamination/source-identification checks.

• Submit evaluation logs and the required difficulty metadata, including subject area, techniques used, estimated expert hours to discover the key idea, estimated execution time once the idea is known, and whether programming is required.

Mandatory Qualifications

• Active mathematical research at doctoral level or beyond, such as a senior PhD student with supervisor endorsement, postdoctoral researcher, early-career faculty member or professor.

• Demonstrated depth in a mathematical research area, supported by published or ongoing research. Relevant areas include:

• Number theory

• Combinatorics

• Algebraic geometry

• Analysis

• Topology

• Differential geometry

• Partial differential equations

• Harmonic analysis

• Category theory

• Mathematical physics

• Programming capability sufficient to compute and verify your own result, preferably using Python. Available tools include NumPy, SymPy, SciPy, NetworkX, gmpy2, mpmath and galois.

• Strong mathematical rigour, particularly the ability to state all assumptions and definitions explicitly and identify potential gaps under adversarial review.

• Publication-standard mathematical English.

• Ability to revise the submission following independent mathematical review.

• Willingness to work under strict confidentiality, including compliance with programme NDA requirements and restrictions on external testing or disclosure of the submitted problem.

Qualification path

Nice to Have

• Previous experience writing mathematical benchmarks, olympiad or competition problems

• Experience with AI reasoning evaluation

• Computational algebra or number theory experience using Sage, Magma or PARI/GP

• Formalisation experience with Lean or Coq

• Research in comparatively underrepresented areas such as differential geometry, PDEs, harmonic analysis, category theory or mathematical physics
