postings.descriptionText:
About Us
At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living while reducing emissions. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower-emissions technologies.

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about our What and our Why and how we can work together .

More About Us:

Our Global Business Center (GBC) in Buenos Aires was established in 2004 and our diverse and multinational workforce of more than 2800 colleagues have been powering ExxonMobil’s global businesses ever since. We are proud to be part of an inclusive, safe, and vibrant work environment.

The IT department is seeking new candidates to its dynamic team. The department provides support worldwide to the Organizations all along the value chain from exploration through site development to production.

Based in Buenos Aires, you will collaborate with engineers and users across different regions, contributing to global network initiatives and supporting business growth.

¡Build a career with us and use your energy to change the world!

For more information, follow us on Instagram (@ExxonMobil_BA_GBC) and visit https://corporate.exxonmobil.com/Locations/Argentina

What Role You Will Play In Our Team
As a Network Engineer , you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and operating the company’s network backbone, supporting globally distributed environments.

You will help ensure secure, reliable, and high-performance connectivity across on-premises and cloud environments. This includes working with modern networking technologies, improving observability, and contributing to automation and continuous improvement of network operations.

While this role covers a broad range of networking technologies, we are hiring for multiple teams. We value strong experience in some of these areas and a willingness to learn others, you are not expected to meet every requirement to apply.

What you will do:

• Design, implement, and operate network solutions across LAN, WAN, and hybrid environments

• Ensure network performance, availability, and reliability across global infrastructure

• Strengthen network monitoring and enhance observability to improve troubleshooting capabilities

• Support incident investigation, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis

• Collaborate with teams to support business requirements and network evolution

• Contribute to automation and continuous improvement of network operations

• Work with vendors and internal teams to maintain and enhance network infrastructure

• Support network security practices including firewalls, segmentation, and access control

About You:

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (must be graduated)

• 2+ years of experience in Network Engineering, Infrastructure, or related roles

• Experience working with enterprise network environments (LAN/WAN)

• Understanding of core networking concepts (routing, switching, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP)

• Familiarity with network protocols such as BGP

• Experience with at least one major networking vendor (Cisco, Juniper, Versa, or similar)

• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

• Experience working in collaborative or Agile environments

• Good English communication skills (written and spoken)

Nice to have:

• Experience with SD-WAN, wireless networks, or advanced routing architectures

• Exposure to network observability tools (Datadog, ThousandEyes, or similar)

• Knowledge of network security concepts (firewalls, ACLs, authentication)

• Experience with scripting or automation (Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar)

• Experience with cloud networking (Azure, AWS, or GCP)

• Experience working with global or distributed network environments

• Experience interacting with vendors and third-party providers

The level and seniority for this position will be determined based on the candidate’s experience and skills. We welcome candidates with different experience levels who are eager to grow in Network Engineering.

Your Benefits:

An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep: our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance, and life.

We offer you:

• Competitive health coverage

• Flexible working hours

• 3-week vacation up to 5 years of service plus 1 personal day

• Online training tools

• Gym discounts and activities for sport and general well-being

• A solid ergonomic program

• Free vaccination campaigns

• Medical assistance available in the offices

• Equipped maternity rooms

• Among others

More information on our Company’s benefits can be found here .

* Analista Sr. de Redes y Comunicaciones - Bahía Blanca *

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Analista Sr. de Redes y Comunicaciones , para incorporarse a nuestro cliente, una importante empresa del rubro energético a nivel nacional, con experiencia en entornos productivos, orientado/a a garantizar la continuidad operativa de la red, con foco en infraestructura, seguridad y entornos OT.

La posición está dirigida a perfiles técnicos que deseen desarrollarse en ambientes dinámicos y críticos, participando en la implementación y mantenimiento de soluciones de networking industrial.

Zona de trabajo: Bahía Blanca

Modalidad de trabajo: Híbrido con esquema 4x1 (4 días presencial / 1 día home office)

Principales Responsabilidades

• Implementación y soporte de infraestructura de red (cableado estructurado, fibra óptica y equipos de networking).

• Configuración y mantenimiento de switches, routers y access points.

• Administración de firewalls y segmentación de redes.

• Monitoreo de redes LAN/WAN mediante herramientas SNMP.

• Diagnóstico y resolución de incidentes de conectividad.

• Ejecución de tareas de mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo.

• Gestión de inventario de activos de red.

• Coordinación de migraciones, upgrades de firmware y hardware.

• Desarrollo de documentación técnica y procedimientos.

• Implementación de medidas de seguridad en redes OT.

• Coordinación de licencias de trabajo con áreas involucradas.

Requisitos

• Experiencia mínima de 5 años en redes y comunicaciones.

• Conocimientos avanzados en networking (L1, L2, L3 y TCP/IP).

• Experiencia en configuración de equipos de red (switches, routers, APs).

• Conocimientos en redes industriales o entornos OT (deseable).

• Manejo de herramientas de monitoreo de red.

• Disponibilidad para trabajar en ventanas de mantenimiento.

Se Valorará

• Experiencia en protocolos industriales (Modbus, IEC 61850, DNP3, RS-232/485).

• Certificaciones técnicas en networking.

Perfil Buscado

• Perfil proactivo, autónomo y resolutivo.

• Buenas habilidades interpersonales.

• Capacidad de trabajo en equipo.

• Orientación a resultados y continuidad operativa.

Si contás con experiencia en redes y buscás nuevos desafíos en entornos tecnológicos de alto impacto, ¡te invitamos a postularte!

postings.descriptionText:

• Implementación de nuevo ERP: Liderar el proceso completo de selección, migración y puesta en marcha del nuevo sistema de gestión.

• Gestión de Integraciones y Omnicanalidad: Garantizar la correcta integración del ecosistema tecnológico, conectando el nuevo ERP con las plataformas de E-commerce, sistemas de puntos de venta de las tiendas, WMS y logística.

• Estudios terciarios o universitarios completos (o en curso avanzado) en Sistemas, Ingeniería Informática o afines.

• Perfil dinámico, comunicativo y hands-on .

• Experiencia excluyente en la industria de Retail, Consumo Masivo, Logística o Moda (comprensión del core del negocio: puntos de venta, stock, reposiciones).

• Experiencia comprobable participando o liderando procesos de implementación de sistemas ERP.

• Conocimientos en plataformas de E-commerce, integraciones mediante APIs, y herramientas de BI corporativo.

• Conocimientos sólidos en infraestructura, redes y seguridad informática.

• Excelente presencia y habilidades de interrelación para adaptarse a un entorno dinámico y de fuerte cultura estética.

Si contás con la experiencia requerida y la propuesta es de tu interés, no dudes en postularte. ¡Te estamos esperando!

postings.title: Network Operations Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Join our Buenos Aires Service Center!
We are looking for a Network Operations Engineer to join our global team. In this role, you will support and maintain the Firm’s LAN and WAN infrastructure, ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient network operations while contributing to day-to-day support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives.

What will be your impact?

• Support and maintain the Firm’s global network infrastructure, ensuring reliability, performance, and security.

• Troubleshoot network incidents and support Layer 2/Layer 3 connectivity across enterprise environments.

• Monitor network performance, hardware, and compliance with information security standards.

• Maintain network documentation and support wireless, remote access, firewall, and cloud-connected technologies.

• Collaborate with global teams on day-to-day operations, incident resolution, and network improvement initiatives.

What will help you succeed in this opportunity?

• Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory).

• 2-4 years of experience in Network Operations or a similar networking role.

• Cisco CCNA, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent enterprise networking experience.

• Strong knowledge of Layer 2/Layer 3 networking, routing and switching, including BGP and OSPF.

• Experience with Cisco technologies; exposure to Aruba, Arista, Palo Alto, Cisco Firepower, and Zscaler is highly desirable.

• Knowledge of enterprise wireless networks, VPNs, SD-WAN, and network security solutions.

• Familiarity with network automation, troubleshooting, and performance monitoring across LAN, WAN, wireless, and cloud-connected environments.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills, with a proactive attitude and willingness to learn.

What do we offer?

• Hybrid work model | Offices located in Puerto Madero, Buenos Aires.

• Parking space available.

• Private health insurance (family plan).

• Discounts on internet services, gym memberships, and universities.

• Birthday day off.

If you believe you meet the requirements, please apply by sending your CV in English in PDF format. We look forward to hearing from you!

postings.title: Sr Engineer II Engineering - Field (Buenos Aires)
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
Systems Design & Implementation

Job Description

Candidates MUST reside in Buenos Aires.
Provides high-level technical expertise in the post-sales lifecycle, including the design, installation, commissioning, and maintenance of mission-critical communication systems. Ensures that complex, large-scale solutions (e.g., LMR P25, TETRA, Microwave) are fully functional according to strict performance and safety specifications. Acts as a key technical between internal engineering teams, third-party service providers, and the customer.

Core Responsibilities

• System Implementation: Oversee the deployment and configuration of core radio and infrastructure systems, ensuring reliability standards.

• Infrastructure Design: Define system specificati8ons, server infrastructure, capacity planning, and networking protocols (IP/RF).

• Field Engineering: Conduct site surveys, manage tower/shelter requirements, and execute complex RF/Microwave link installations.

• Project Governance: Develop technical, tactical, and strategic plans; provide feasibility determination and ensure ATP (Acceptance Test Plan) compliance.

• Technical Support: Serve as an expert escalation point for field issues; disseminate technical information to internal and customer personnel.

Ideal Candidate Profile (Technical Competencies)

• RF Engineering: RFDS principles, antenna/cable systems, combiners, multi-couplers, and lightning protection.

• Mission Critical Portfolio: Proven experience with Motorola Solutions or equivalent LMR ecosystems (ASTRO 25, TETRA, HF, DMR).

• Networking & Integration: Deep understanding of the OSI model and network protocols (OSPF, ISIS, BGP, MPLS, SIP, RTP, SNMP, NAT). Ability to design and troubleshoot IP architectures within secure environments.

• System Architecture: Proficiency in server infrastructure (VMware ESXi, Linux, Windows Server) and hardware/software integration via APIs.

• Cybersecurity: Knowledge of security best practices, encryption, port security, and certificate-based authentication for critical infrastructure.

• Site Construction: Experience in the construction of remote communication sites (grounding, compound development, tower/shelter requirements).

• Certifications: CompTIA Network+, CCNA, Juniper JNCIA, Nokia NRS1, or PMP/ITIL methodologies are highly valued.

Basic Requirements

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Telecommunications or Electronics Engineering.

• Driving license is mandatory

• Experience: 3+ years of relevant experience in critical communication systems or mission-critical IT infrastructure.

• Languages: Fluency in both Spanish and English (written and oral) is highly desirable

• Mobility: Availability to travel (25% - 50%) to support remote sites and customer installations.

• Professional Profile: Proactive customer service mindset, autonomy to drive outcomes, and ability to handle increasing project responsibilities.

Travel Requirements: Over 50%

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

postings.title: Soporte IT en obra
postings.descriptionText:
En Fluor estamos orgullosos de diseñar y construir proyectos y carreras. Esto requiere equipos que sean tan únicos como los proyectos que ejecutamos. Estamos comprometidos a fomentar un ambiente de trabajo que abarque la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión (DE&I) para todos, de modo que nuestros empleados y partes interesadas se beneficien de las soluciones creativas derivadas de aceptar las diferencias.

Descripción del puesto

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Soporte IT en Sitio (Deskside Support) para incorporarse a un proyecto minero de gran escala en fase de construcción. La posición será responsable de brindar soporte técnico presencial a usuarios, asegurando la disponibilidad y correcto funcionamiento de los sistemas, infraestructura y equipamiento tecnológico necesarios para la ejecución del proyecto.

Responsabilidades principales

• Brindar soporte técnico en sitio a los usuarios del proyecto.

• Instalar, configurar y mantener equipos informáticos, laptops, dispositivos móviles y periféricos.

• Diagnosticar y resolver incidentes de hardware, software y conectividad.

• Asistir a usuarios en el uso de aplicaciones corporativas y herramientas de colaboración.

• Coordinar con equipos de IT corporativos la escalación y resolución de incidentes.

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de políticas IT, ciberseguridad y procedimientos corporativos.

• Registrar y gestionar incidentes, requerimientos y activos IT.

• Soportar la implementación y mantenimiento de infraestructura IT en oficinas y campamento.

• Participar en procesos de alta y baja de usuarios, incluyendo provisión de equipamiento.

Requisitos

• Formación técnica en Sistemas, Tecnología de la Información o carreras afines.

• Experiencia en soporte técnico, help desk o deskside support.

• Experiencia brindando soporte a usuarios en entornos corporativos o de proyecto.

• Conocimientos en entornos Windows, hardware y redes básicas.

• Buenas habilidades de comunicación y resolución de problemas.

Se valorará especialmente

• Experiencia en proyectos de construcción, minería, oil & gas o industria.

• Experiencia en sitios remotos o campamentos.

• Manejo de herramientas de ticketing (gestión de incidencias).

• Conocimiento de infraestructura IT en entornos de obra.

• Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma en entornos dinámicos.

• Manejo de idioma ingles hablado y escrito, es un plus.

Para Ser Considerados Candidatos

Debe estar autorizado para trabajar en el país donde se encuentra el puesto.

Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y reconoce el valor de una fuerza laboral diversa. Todas las personas calificadas recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de raza, color, edad, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, condición de veterano, información genética o cualquier otro criterio protegido por la ley vigente.

Aviso a Los Candidatos

Las verificaciones de antecedentes se llevan a cabo como parte de cualquier oferta condicional realizada, que incluye (pero no se limita a y según el rol) educación, registro profesional, empleo, referencias, verificaciones de pasaportes y evaluación de la Lista de vigilancia global.

• Conocimientos básicos de infraestructura: SQL, VMware, etc.

• Conocimientos de Linux y macOS/iOS.

• Conocimientos básicos de Active Directory.

Buscamos una persona con:

• Capacidad resolutiva, para analizar situaciones y encontrar soluciones de manera efectiva.

• Autonomía, para desenvolverse en un entorno donde la toma de decisiones y la gestión de prioridades son importantes.

• Buena comunicación, tanto con usuarios como con otros equipos técnicos.

• Escucha asertiva y capacidad para transmitir información técnica de manera clara, precisa y oportuna.

• Orientación al servicio y compromiso con la continuidad operativa.

• Capacidad para trabajar en equipo y adaptarse a diferentes situaciones.

• 🩺 Prepaga Premium.

postings.title: Engineering Manager – Growth Foundations
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Growth Foundations team builds the AI-native Growth Engine, enabling Growth teams across the company. We design and ship powerful AI-driven systems, tools and automations, as well as own the core infrastructure of Growth tools such as our website, user communications and martech. It’s a team with direct influence on company growth, global reach, and user engagement at scale. Our products serve millions of users globally.

The Role

As an Engineering Manager within Growth Foundations, you’ll lead and develop a team of engineers who deliver high-impact features, platforms, and tools that power our growth. You’ll ensure the team is aligned, supported, and set up to execute with excellence — turning complex challenges into simple, reliable solutions that reach users around the world. You will also stay hands-on and deliver production grade features personally every day.

The opportunity

• Lead, mentor, and support a cross-functional team of engineers delivering growth-critical systems and features

• Collaborate daily with Product and Design to define scope, set priorities, and ensure seamless execution

• Keep projects moving forward — maintaining clear expectations, realistic estimates, and transparent communication with stakeholders

• Provide technical guidance and context to help engineers make sound architectural and implementation decisions

• Foster a culture of accountability, trust, and learning — helping the team grow their impact and autonomy

• Improve team processes, communication, and collaboration across time zones

• Partner with other engineering leaders to ensure consistency and best practices across the broader Growth organization

• Leverage AI tooling daily to boost personal and team productivity

• Stay hands-on in the codebase, writing production-grade code and setting the bar for quality, reliability, and speed

What You Bring

• Experience leading engineering teams and delivering high-quality results in a collaborative environment

• Strong people leadership skills — you invest in coaching, clarity, and empowerment

• Solid technical foundation, especially on the backend; you can engage in design discussions, code reviews, and help engineers make pragmatic decisions

• Strong individual contributor background — you write production-grade code and lead by example

• High proficiency in modern AI-driven development — you use AI daily to boost personal and team performance through automation

• Familiarity with one or more modern programming languages (e.g. TypeScript, Rust, Go, Python, or similar)

• A product mindset — you care about how your team’s work impacts users and moves key metrics

• Clear communication and organizational skills, with the ability to align engineering efforts with business goals

• Experience working in distributed, remote-first teams

Nice to haves

• Experience with analytics, performance/paid marketing, experimentation, or growth tooling

• Background in developer experience, SDKs, or internal platforms

• Exposure to scaling teams or processes during high-growth phases

How You Lead

• You lead by setting context, not control — empowering engineers to make decisions with clarity and confidence

• You coach through curiosity, helping others grow their judgment and autonomy

• You communicate transparently, ensuring alignment across engineering, product, and design

• You model accountability and empathy, creating an environment of trust and shared purpose

We know that great engineers come from many backgrounds. If you're excited about the mission but don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

How We Work

We give engineers ownership and trust them to ship high-impact work with craftsmanship and accountability. We move quickly, experiment often, and learn continuously from data and user feedback. We build acquisition and engagement experiences that are fast, resilient, and measurable. We collaborate asynchronously across time zones, connected by clear communication and shared goals.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Job Summary:

About The EY Mercury Support Team (MST)

As an organization jointly owned by Finance and Enterprise Technology, the MST is a centralized and global organization that provides strategic deployment, adoption, and operational support for an integrated, SAP-centric platform (Mercury) and manages and supports the Mercury user community. Responsibilities:

The Business and Technical Communications Analyst maintains and administers the Global Operations Communications Tool (GOCT), helps ensure the platform remains reliable and fit for purpose, and uses it to support planned and unplanned technology communications.

The role administers GOCT configuration, templates, access, audience targeting, monitoring, and documentation. It also partners with Product Management, Development, and communications stakeholders to support tool enhancements, releases, operational maintenance, service disruptions, and P1–P3 incidents.

Key responsibilities include:

• Administers GOCT configuration, communications templates, shared mailboxes, OneAccess groups, audience targeting, and supporting documentation in accordance with brand and governance standards.

• Monitors GOCT dashboards and the administration mailbox, triages user queries and communication failures, and resolves or escalates issues within required timelines.

• Supports planned maintenance, service disruptions, and P1–P3 incidents by drafting, coordinating, targeting, and releasing timely operational communications through GOCT.

• Supports contingency procedures for issuing critical communications when GOCT or dependent services are unavailable.

• Assesses communication needs, tracks issues and risks, identifies competing priorities, and escalates decisions when required.

• Maintains configuration records, operating procedures, support documentation, known-error guidance, release notes, and knowledge articles.

• Tracks GOCT usage, communication failures, incidents, service requests, and recurring issues; identifies trends and recommends operational improvements.

Senior communication capability required with MST leadership. The role also requires relationship management skills to influence and motivate resources from other ET organizations that leverage our communications tool.

Knowledge and Skills Requirements:

• Excellent English writing, editing, proofreading, verbal communication, and active-listening skills, with strong attention to detail.

• Demonstrated ability to understand technology-related information and translate it into clear, relevant communications for business users, with awareness of operational impacts.

• Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage changing priorities and deliver accurate work within compressed timelines.

• Ability to assess requests, identify conflicts, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and escalate decisions, risks, or issues when needed.

• Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.

The role will not have any direct reports.

Other Requirements:

Job Requirements:

To qualify, candidates must have:

• Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Information Systems, Business Administration, Technology Management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

postings.title: Planificador de Medios (Córdoba, Rosario, Mendoza)
postings.descriptionText:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Resumen e Impacto del Rol

El Planificador de Medios Senior Integral lidera el diseño, la ejecución y el análisis de campañas publicitarias 360°. A diferencia de un especialista enfocado en un solo canal, el perfil integral domina la interacción entre los canales tradicionales (TV, exterior, radio, prensa) y los digitales (social ads, programática, search, retail media, CTV, video online).

Su labor va más allá de "comprar espacios": traduce datos del consumidor e insights del mercado en estrategias de contacto efectivas a lo largo de todo el embudo de conversión ( Full-Funnel ).

La búsqueda está centrada en Estudiantes avanzados o promediando carrera Lic. en Publicidad o afines para sumarse al equipo. Buscamos un perfil organizado, prolijo, con ganas de seguir aprendiendo, que tenga capacidad para trabajar en equipo y con excelente predisposición.

Habilidades y Experiencia

• Experiencia de por lo menos un año como planner Sr. en cuentas o agencias grandes, o dos años en cuentas chicas.

• Experiencia en pautas ON y OFF.

• Manejo de Excel

• Manejo de armado de planes, tácticas on, reportes digitales, conocimientos de métricas digitales para armado de recomendaciones.

• Inglés nivel intermedio.

• Residir en Córdoba, Rosario o Mendoza, contando con conocimiento del mercado local.

Vida en WPP Media y Beneficios

Nuestra pasión por construir la nueva era de los medios cobra vida gracias a nuestro compromiso con Ser Extraordinarios ( Be Extraordinary ), invirtiendo en nuestra gente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. También Lideramos con Optimismo ( Lead Optimistically ), creyendo firmemente e Impulsando el Crecimiento y Desarrollo ( Championing Growth and Development ) de cada persona. Este compromiso permite a nuestro equipo en WPP Media aprovechar la amplia red global de WPP Media y WPP para perseguir sus pasiones, construir conexiones profesionales clave y aprender en la vanguardia del marketing y la publicidad.

Creamos un Entorno Abierto ( Create an Open Environment ) basado en la confianza y el respeto, donde cada persona sienta que pertenece y tenga oportunidades reales de crecer. Esta cultura inclusiva se fomenta a través de diversos grupos de recursos para empleados (ERG) y eventos frecuentes en la oficina para destacar los logros del equipo, compartir liderazgo de pensamiento y celebrar fechas especiales e hitos importantes. Nuestro paquete integral de beneficios refleja este compromiso e incluye seguro médico, de visión y dental, planes grupales de retiro, un generoso programa de tiempo libre pagado, descuentos preferenciales con aliados y días dedicados al bienestar y la salud mental de nuestro equipo.

En WPP Media ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades y consideramos todas las postulaciones sin discriminación. Creemos que el mejor trabajo surge cuando estamos juntos, potenciando la creatividad, la colaboración y la conexión en un entorno abierto y colaborativo. Ten en cuenta que, si bien nuestra filosofía es la misma en todo WPP, los beneficios específicos pueden variar según la oficina o el país.

Por favor, consulta nuestro Aviso de Privacidad (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas.

Agradecemos a todas las personas que se postulen a esta vacante; sin embargo, solo contactaremos a los candidatos seleccionados para una entrevista.

Nuestro equipo diverso de expertos de clase mundial apoya a los clientes en todos los niveles de sus organizaciones para operacionalizar la sostenibilidad, respaldado por nuestra profunda experiencia técnica en la resolución de temas ambientales, de salud, seguridad, riesgo y asuntos sociales. Si deseas leer más sobre Diversidad, Equidad, Igualdad e Inclusión (DEIB) en ERM, puedes visitar nuestro sitio web o conocer nuestros avances en el Informe de Sostenibilidad 2026 .

We're seeking an experienced and results-driven Business Development & Relationship Executive to serve as a trusted advisor to credit union leaders across a multi-state territory, primarily in the Midwest and West Coast regions. postings.title: Field Sales Engineer - Rosario, Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact – on our colleagues, partners, customers and society. Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources.

Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water and shipping.

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.

About The Job

We are looking for a Field Sales Engineer to join our team in Argentina, with a strong commercial focus on the oilseed processing industry in the Greater Rosario area.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and strengthening relationships with customers, identifying new business opportunities and promoting Alfa Laval’s products and services through a consultative and value-based sales approach.

Key Responsibilities

• Follow established sales processes and guidelines to promote and sell Alfa Laval products and services.

• Analyze market trends, customer needs and buying behavior to develop sales plans aligned with business objectives.

• Identify, develop and manage leads, converting them into concrete business opportunities and maintaining a healthy sales pipeline.

• Maintain an active presence in the market through customer visits, meetings and regular interactions.

• Develop a deep understanding of customers’ processes and needs, highlighting the value and differentiation of Alfa Laval solutions.

• Manage your customer portfolio through proactive commercial planning and effective use of our sales tools.

• Build and maintain strong relationships and a broad network across key customer organizations.

• Develop competitive and profitable commercial proposals, follow up opportunities and drive conversion.

• Use CRM and other commercial tools consistently to support sales activities and decision-making.

• Contribute to the development of the Field Sales Engineer team by sharing experience and supporting the commercial sales process.

What You Know

• Solid experience in technical and/or industrial B2B sales, ideally at a senior level.

• Strong knowledge of the industrial market and experience managing complex customer relationships.

• Experience within the oilseed, edible oils or related process industries will be considered a strong advantage.

• Degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Industrial Engineering or a related field. Advanced students with relevant commercial and industry experience may also be considered.

• Intermediate English level, with the ability to interact with international and central teams when required.

• Availability to travel domestically, mainly within the assigned territory.

Who You Are

• You are a commercially driven professional who enjoys being close to customers and building long-term relationships.

• You combine autonomy, resilience and a strong results orientation with the ability to understand customer challenges and turn them into business opportunities.

• You are comfortable managing your own agenda, working independently in the field and navigating a competitive industrial environment.

What’s in it for you ?

This role offers a high level of autonomy and ownership, together with the opportunity to work closely with some of the most relevant industrial customers in the Greater Rosario region.

You will join a global company with strong technical expertise, internationally recognized technologies and opportunities for continued professional development and career growth.

We are seeking a Solutions Services Inside Sales - Config Deploy to partner with our Account Sales Team and wider Services sales team in driving customer success through the design, configuration, and deployment of PC and Data Center configuration and deployment services.

Carreras con cuidado integrado: descubre nuestros beneficios aquí.

postings.title: Manager - Sales
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

As a Manager – Sales, you will provide strategic direction and progressive leadership to achieve sales and profit goals within a region, specific line(s) of business or channels. You will design and recommend sales and marketing programs and set short and long-term sales strategies. You will manage a single location with a total sales revenue of up to $50 million and manage a team of direct reports.

Responsibilities

• Develops and administers sales plans to ensure customer satisfaction, assigned quota attainment, good reference accounts, and highly skilled and motivated staff.

• Partners with Marketing to develop and implement sales marketing programs and initiatives.

• Determines annual sales and gross profit plan by implementing marketing strategies and analyzing trends and results.

• Establishes sales objectives by forecasting and developing sales quota for territories.

• Projects expected sales volume and profit for existing and new product lines and customers.

• Maintains sales volume, product mix and selling price by keeping current with market supply and demand, changing trends, economic indicators and competitors.

• Coordinates order service by directing account representatives and executives on quotations, proposals, project order management techniques, and customer complaint resolution.

• Establishes and adjusts billing margin by monitoring costs, competition and market conditions and negotiating cost side levels.

• Manages sales staff by recruiting, selecting, orienting and training employees.

• Maintains sales staff results by coaching employees, planning, monitoring and appraising job results.

• Develops and maintains relationships with top customers.

• Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications and participating in professional societies.

• Forecasts and communicates intricate details to senior business managers.

• interfaces with internal support departments to establish positive customer experience.

• Partners with suppliers to maintain customer relationships, provides training to staff, and executes marketing programs and initiatives.

• Partners with various internal departments to troubleshoot issues such as inventory and operations

Qualifications

• High School Degree or Equivalent required; Bachelor’s Degree - Sales, Business Administration, Engineering, or relevant field preferred

• Prior professional sales experience in related industry/3+ years

• Prior experience with managing a sales team or sales programs/1+ year

• Working knowledge of business and management principles in strategic planning, resource allocation and coordination of people and resources

• Demonstrated verbal, written, analytical, persuasion and interpersonal skills

• Knowledge of principles and processes for providing customer and personal services, including customer needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of customer satisfaction

• Ability to exercise teamwork, leadership, and flexibility

• Excellent time management and computer skills

• 5 years related industry professional sales

• 2 years managing staff and programs at national, district or regional level

• Ability to travel up to 25%

Working Environment: Outside Sales – Work is generally performed in an office environment, but employee may need to travel to customer sites or warehouse facilities. Driving may be required for an extended period of time with frequent stops and starts. Can be exposed to outdoor weather conditions.

postings.descriptionText:
The Opportunity
This is a strategic leadership role — you'll set the direction on complex engagements, lead managers and senior analysts, and bring the depth and judgment that makes Exactera a place clients return to.
This isn't a sales role. We're not asking you to bring in business. We're asking you to be the senior technical and strategic voice on the work, build the next generation of TP leaders behind you, and help shape how a practice that operates differently from a traditional consulting firm continues to evolve.

What You'll Do
You'll lead at the level above engagements — setting direction on the hardest work, developing the managers running it, and being the person clients ask for when things get complicated. The fundamentals of leading great TP work still apply. What's different is the kind of practice you're leading inside.
We've built something that doesn't look like traditional consulting. Less rigidity, more flexibility, and technology and AI woven into how the work gets done — and what that looks like is changing quarter by quarter. The role you're hired into today will look different in a year, and different again in two. At this level, you're not just operating in that environment — you're shaping it.

Day to day, that means:

• Setting direction on complex, high-stakes engagements — method selection, structuring, defensibility, controversy

• Being the senior technical voice clients ask for: intangibles, financial transactions, restructurings, planning conversations

• Leading and developing managers — they are your most important deliverable. Building the bench underneath them

• Setting the standard for how the team operates — how we use the platform, where AI fits, where judgment is non-negotiable, how we handle hard moments with clients

• Helping shape how the practice evolves — what we build, what we automate, what stays human, where the bar should move next

• Stepping in on the hardest moments — escalations, technical disputes, complex negotiations

What's non-negotiable here

• Client first. Their outcomes are how we measure ourselves, and you set that tone for the team.

• AI fluency. Not enthusiasm, not curiosity — fluency, with a strategic point of view. You're not just using these tools well; you have an opinion about where the practice should go because of them.

• Flexibility and ownership. Senior leaders here operate on a moving floor. The role itself will evolve. The leaders we want are the ones who help shape the change, not the ones waiting for it to settle.

What success looks like in your first months
The complex work runs cleanly under your leadership. Your managers are visibly stronger. Clients seek you out on the hardest issues. You're already shaping conversations about where the practice should go — not just running it as it is.

What You Bring

• 10+ years of transfer pricing experience, with substantial engagement leadership and people management at scale

• Deep, demonstrated command of OECD TP principles, with hands-on work across documentation, planning, controversy, and complex transactions

• Track record of leading managers — not just analysts. You've grown people who've grown teams

• Multi-jurisdictional depth and the judgment that comes from having seen audits, disputes, and edge cases play out

• Fluent / professional / native English

• Demonstrated leadership in adopting AI and technology in TP delivery — and a clear point of view on where it goes next

Additional Benefits

• Gympass membership (fully covered by the company) for access to a wide network of gyms in Argentina and wellness apps

• USD 40 monthly internet allowance included in the salary

• USD 40 monthly gift card

• Remote work

• Birthday off

About Us:
At Exactera, a FinTech SaaS start-up founded in 2016, we stand at the intersection of human and machine intelligence. Our corporate tax solutions are powered by AI and cloud-based technologies, serving customers worldwide. With over $100 million in funding from Savant Venture Fund and Insight Partners, we are poised for growth. We are committed to diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities for all.

postings.title: Operational Finance Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description:

Buscamos un/a Operational Finance Analyst para ejecutar y controlar procesos financieros estandarizados, garantizando la precisión de las transacciones, el cumplimiento de los procedimientos internos y la correcta aplicación de los controles establecidos.

La posición podrá involucrar distintos procesos del ciclo financiero, como Order to Cash (O2C), Purchase to Pay (P2P) y Record to Report (R2R), según las necesidades del equipo y el subproceso asignado. Será fundamental contar con atención al detalle, capacidad para resolver discrepancias y orientación al cumplimiento de procedimientos, plazos y estándares de calidad.

Principales responsabilidades

• Gestión de procesos financieros: Ejecutar y controlar actividades operativas vinculadas con los procesos O2C, P2P y/o R2R, de acuerdo con las responsabilidades asignadas.

• Order to Cash (O2C) – De la orden al cobro: Colaborar en la revisión y emisión de facturas, el control de cuentas por cobrar, el seguimiento de discrepancias y la correcta registración y procesamiento de las transacciones vinculadas con clientes.

• Purchase to Pay (P2P) – De la compra al pago: Revisar y procesar facturas de proveedores, validar información, coordinar aprobaciones y realizar el seguimiento de pagos conforme a los procedimientos y controles establecidos.

• Record to Report (R2R) – Del registro al reporte financiero: Participar en tareas de registración contable, conciliaciones, cierres periódicos y preparación de información para reportes financieros, según el alcance del puesto.

• Control y calidad de la información: Verificar la exactitud, integridad y consistencia de los datos y documentos financieros, identificando errores o diferencias y gestionando su resolución.

• Cumplimiento y auditoría: Aplicar los procedimientos internos, las políticas financieras y los controles requeridos, manteniendo la documentación respaldatoria y la trazabilidad de las operaciones.

• Resolución de discrepancias y escalamiento: Investigar inconsistencias, realizar el seguimiento de casos pendientes y escalar situaciones que requieran intervención de otros equipos o responsables.

• Mejora continua: Contribuir a la estandarización de procesos, la actualización de procedimientos operativos y la identificación de oportunidades para mejorar la eficiencia y la calidad del servicio.

Requisitos y conocimientos

• Experiencia en operaciones financieras, administración contable o procesos de finanzas.

• Conocimiento de procesos financieros como O2C, P2P y/o R2R.

• Manejo de información financiera y documentación respaldatoria.

• Capacidad para identificar y resolver discrepancias, errores e inconsistencias.

• Atención al detalle y compromiso con la precisión de las transacciones.

• Conocimiento de procedimientos de control interno, cumplimiento y auditoría.

• Habilidades de organización y gestión de prioridades para cumplir con plazos establecidos.

• Capacidad para trabajar con procesos estandarizados y colaborar con distintos equipos.

Se valorará

• Experiencia en centros de servicios compartidos (Shared Services Centers) o entornos de operaciones financieras regionales.

• Manejo de sistemas ERP y herramientas de gestión financiera.

• Experiencia en conciliaciones, facturación, cuentas por cobrar, cuentas por pagar o cierres contables, según el subproceso.

• Conocimientos de mejora continua y documentación de procedimientos operativos.

postings.title: Payment Operations Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Capchase is on a mission to transform how hardware and software companies sell and get paid, revolutionizing the equipment financing space. Recently named a 2026 Monitor Best Company in Innovation , we're recognized for embedding flexible payment terms directly into the sales workflow, helping teams close faster without the friction of a separate financing system.

We're the modern platform for financing leading enterprise solutions: built for direct and channel sales motions , with $2B+ funded , approvals in seconds , and a seamless experience for both sellers and buyers. Backed by leading fintech investors including 01A, Thomvest, QED, SciFi, and Invesco, we've raised $700M+ in equity and debt to fuel our growth.

In just over five years, we've scaled from four co-founders to 80+ Capchasers across 10 markets, supporting thousands of companies globally and processing billions in payment volume.

Since Our Launch In 2020, We've Achieved Several Milestones

➡ 10K+ active vendors, channel partners and buyers

🙌 Built a team representing over 15 nationalities

🌎 Active in 10 markets

📈 Top decile YoY growth

👫 Built an awesome culture.

In December 2024 we reached the top of the Installment Payment, BNPL category on G2, #1 in B2B.

Why work with us?

Help accelerate an industry!

At Capchase, we are transforming how software and tech-enabled hardware equipment gets financed, we move and innovate fast. We’re always looking for the brightest minds to join us. We’re a diverse team of 15+ nationalities with a shared passion for helping innovative companies thrive. Join the climb with us!

About The Role

We're looking for a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive Payment Operations Specialist to join one of the most dynamic and critical teams at Capchase.

Payment Operations sits at the center of our business, where everything from deal origination and approvals to funding and customer repayments comes together. Our team ensures deals are accurately deployed, funds move on time, and every transaction is properly reconciled.

This is more than a payment processing role. You'll own critical daily operations while helping us build smarter, more scalable processes.

We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, questions things that don't look right, and enjoys understanding how systems work. Someone who doesn't just flag an issue, but investigates its cause, understands its impact, and helps find a solution.

You'll work closely with Finance, Capital Markets, Risk, Product, Engineering, and other Operations teams, combining accurate daily execution with continuous improvement.

What You'll Do

Own Daily Payment Operations

• Review, validate, and deploy approved deals, ensuring financial details, documentation, payment schedules, and approvals are accurate.

• Execute and monitor vendor payouts, customer collections, refunds, and other money movement activities across payment rails and currencies.

• Perform daily cash and payment reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, and resolve failed, returned, duplicate, or misapplied transactions.

• Independently manage time-sensitive priorities while maintaining accuracy and meeting banking deadlines.

Investigate, Question, and Improve

• Challenge unusual transactions, inconsistent information, or suspicious payment instructions before processing.

• Investigate operational issues and platform bugs, identify root causes, assess their broader impact, and drive resolution.

• Develop a strong understanding of our platform and the end-to-end transaction lifecycle, from deal origination through funding and repayment.

• Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale workflows using modern tools, including AI agents and automation.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to improve platform functionality, test solutions, and strengthen operational controls.

Collaborate and Take Ownership

• Coordinate with Finance, Capital Markets, Risk, Collections, and Customer Operations to resolve issues and ensure smooth handoffs.

• Communicate blockers, risks, and outstanding items clearly and proactively, following through until resolution.

• Support operational reporting, month-end reconciliations, and other cross-functional initiatives.

What You'll Need

• 2+ years of experience in operations, payments, treasury, or another analytical, execution-focused role, ideally in a fast-paced environment.

• Exceptional attention to detail and critical thinking. You notice inconsistencies, question assumptions, and understand the importance of financial accuracy.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with confidence working with large datasets and investigating complex issues.

• Curiosity and a systems mindset. You want to understand how things work, why problems happen, and how processes can be improved.

• Strong ownership and independence. You take initiative, follow through, and know when to escalate.

• Comfort with technology, including Excel/Google Sheets, new platforms, and an interest in AI tools and automation.

• Familiarity with US payment rails, including ACH and wire transfers, or comparable payment systems.

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.

• Ability to prioritize and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment.

• Fluent English, written and spoken.

• Availability to work US Eastern/Central business hours.

We value analytical ability, sound judgment, and willingness to learn over a specific degree or extensive industry experience.

Nice to Haves

• Experience in fintech, lending, banking, or B2B payments.

• Familiarity with SQL, BI tools, scripting, or automation platforms.

• Experience improving operational processes, controls, or internal systems.

• Experience using AI agents or automation tools in daily workflows.

• Spanish fluency.

Why Work With Us

Help accelerate an industry

At Capchase, we’re building a category that hasn’t existed before, so we mean it when we say every day is different. We’re always looking for the brightest minds to join us. We’re a diverse team of 15+ nationalities with a shared passion for helping innovative companies thrive. Join the climb with us!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

delivering full-service home renovation through a licensed subcontractor model.

Location - Remote – Argentina or South America (must be available to work within U.S. business
hours)

Reports To - Controller
Salary Range - $18,000-$24,000 annually

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Staff Accountant to join our accounting team. This fully remote position supports the day-to-day accounting operations of a U.S.-based construction company. The ideal candidate will have strong accounting fundamentals, excellent English communication skills, and experience working with U.S. companies or U.S. GAAP. Experience in construction accounting is a plus but not required. The Staff Accountant will assist with month-end close, account reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, financial reporting, and other general accounting functions while collaborating closely with the Controller and accounting team.

Key Responsibilities

• Prepare journal entries and maintain general ledger accounts.
• Perform monthly bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations.
• Assist with month-end and year-end closing processes.
• Review and analyze financial transactions for accuracy and completeness.
• Support preparation of monthly financial statements and management reports.

Accounts Payable & Receivable

• Monitor aging reports and follow up on outstanding balances.Construction Accounting Support

• Support contract billing and retainage tracking.
• Assist in preparing Work-in-Progress (WIP) schedules.
• Support project managers with financial information and reporting requests.

Compliance & Reporting
• Maintain accurate accounting records and documentation.
• Assist with audit preparation and year-end reporting.
• Support sales tax and other regulatory filings as needed.
• Ensure compliance with company policies and accounting procedures.

Process Improvement
• Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and efficiency.
• Assist with ERP and accounting software maintenance.
• Participate in special projects assigned by management.

Qualifications
Required
• Expert in QuickBooks
• Availability to work during US Pacific Time business hours.
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
• 2–5 years of accounting experience.
• Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, lookups, formulas).
• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
• Reliable high-speed internet connection and dedicated workspace.

Preferred
• Experience working for a U.S.-based company.
• Familiarity with U.S. GAAP.
• Construction industry accounting experience.
• Experience with ERP/accounting software such as QuickBooks, Viewpoint Vista, or similar platforms.
• Experience with billings, job costing, and project accounting.

Required Skills
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
• Excellent organizational and time management skills.
• Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

• Professional communication and teamwork skills.

postings.title: Analista Funcional SAP S/4HANA – FI CO SSR
postings.descriptionText:
En Grupo Omint , nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Analista Funcional SAP S/4HANA SSR - FICO para sumar a nuestro equipo en la sede central.
Nos orientamos a personas con un perfil proactivo, analítico y colaborativo, con vocación de servicio y cuyo propósito esté alineado con el de nuestra organización, CUIDAR A LAS PERSONAS.

La misión de tu rol será relevar, analizar y optimizar los procesos financieros y de control de gestión dentro de SAP S/4HANA, asegurando la correcta configuración del sistema y su alineación con las necesidades del negocio.

¿Cuáles son los desafíos de la posición?

• Relevar y comprender los requerimientos funcionales de las áreas de Finanzas, Contabilidad, Impuestos y Control de Gestión.
• Traducir necesidades del negocio en soluciones funcionales claras y viables dentro de SAP.
• Configurar y parametrizar módulos FI y CO.
• Analizar oportunidades de mejora en procesos y proponer soluciones eficientes.
• Elaborar especificaciones funcionales para desarrollos o ajustes técnicos.
• Ejecutar y coordinar pruebas funcionales e integradas (UAT).
• Brindar soporte funcional a usuarios y resolver incidencias.
• Documentar procesos, configuraciones y soluciones implementadas.
• Articular con desarrolladores y equipos técnicos para asegurar la correcta implementación de las soluciones.

¿Qué esperamos de vos?

Es indispensable que seas protagonista, te animes a experimentar y actúes con propósito.
Trabajamos en equipo, en red y actuamos con empatía, esperamos lo mismo de quien se sume al equipo.
Valoramos también que seas flexible, que puedas adaptarte a distintos entornos y contextos, y que pongas en juego tu creatividad e innovación.

Si querés sumarte a este desafío ¡Esperamos tu postulación!

Consultor SAP SD

postings.title: Junior Accountant
postings.descriptionText:
Client Accounting & Advisory Services

Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina

Work Arrangement: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time, Independent Contractor

Compensation: USD 1,400-1,900/month

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm EST

About Convoy Finance

We like working with people who move fast, think for themselves, and care about doing great work. That's pretty much how we run Convoy.

We're a small finance and accounting firm working with technology, SaaS, fintech and Web3 companies across Canada and internationally. Our clients are ambitious businesses, and we work directly with the founders and finance teams building them.

That means you won't just be entering numbers into spreadsheets all day. You'll get exposure to real businesses, real accounting challenges and the people making decisions behind them.

We're a small team, too. Most of us are based in Toronto, with a few people working remotely around the world. There's very little bureaucracy, decisions happen quickly, and good ideas can actually turn into action.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Junior Accountant who wants to build strong accounting fundamentals while getting hands-on experience with growing international companies.

You'll support accounting work across a portfolio of clients, working alongside experienced accountants and gaining exposure to international clients, founders, CFOs and finance teams .

You'll help keep the numbers accurate and the books organized, but we also want you to understand why the numbers matter . If something doesn't look right, we want you to ask questions, investigate and learn.

This is a great opportunity for someone who is early in their accounting career and wants more than a traditional back-office role. You'll learn by doing, take on more responsibility over time and get exposure to different businesses, systems and accounting challenges.

What You'll Do

You'll support the team with:

• Bookkeeping and day-to-day accounting, including AP/AR, journal entries and account reconciliations

• Assisting with month-end close and maintaining accurate client books

• Preparing schedules and supporting financial statements and management reporting

• Reviewing transactions and identifying discrepancies or items that need attention

• Supporting year-end compilations, audits, reviews and tax-related work

• Helping maintain organized and up-to-date client records

• Communicating with the team and, as you grow, working directly with clients on accounting questions

• Helping improve processes, systems and workflows

• Supporting ad hoc accounting and finance projects as they come up

Requirements

What We're Looking For

You have a Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field , or are currently completing one, and have 2-3+ years of relevant accounting experience .

You have a good understanding of basic accounting principles and are comfortable working with numbers, spreadsheets and accounting systems.

You're organized, detail-oriented and able to manage deadlines without losing sight of the details.

You're comfortable communicating in English , both in writing and verbally, and you're willing to ask questions when something isn't clear.

Most importantly, you're curious and eager to learn . If something doesn't make sense, you don't just move on: you try to understand why.

Experience with QuickBooks Online or Xero is a plus. Experience in public accounting, audit, tax, SaaS, technology, fintech or Web3 is also a plus.

Benefits

Why Convoy?

You'll work with interesting companies, smart people and problems that don't always come with an instruction manual.

You'll get hands-on exposure to international businesses and experienced finance professionals, while building the technical skills and judgment that will help you grow as an accountant.

Because we're a small team, your work is visible and your learning curve can be steep. You won't be stuck doing the same task forever.

We're remote-friendly, with team members working from Toronto and different parts of the world. We also make time for team lunches, happy hours and, when the numbers are good, the occasional team trip.

It's fast-paced. It's challenging. And it's definitely not boring.

If you want to build your accounting career, keep learning and get real exposure to international clients , we'd like to hear from you.

Compensation

USD 1,400-1,900 per month , depending on experience and qualifications.

This is a full-time independent contractor position .

How To Apply

Send us your resume and a brief overview of your experience.

We'd love to hear from you.

postings.title: Finance: Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe
postings.descriptionText:
Job Title

Finance Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe

Job Description

Are you a finance professional with a strong background in tax, compliance, and financial governance? Do you enjoy combining technical expertise with team leadership, process improvement, and collaboration across multiple European countries?

At Vanderlande, we are looking for a Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe who will lead the regional Tax & Compliance team and help ensure a strong and compliant tax framework across our European operations.

In this role, you will contribute to managing tax risks, ensuring regulatory compliance, improving processes and controls, and supporting the business with practical tax solutions in a dynamic international environment.

What will you be doing?

As Team Lead Tax & Compliance Europe, you report to the Team Lead Tax & Compliance EU / LATAM and lead a team of tax and compliance professionals supporting the European organization.

You will oversee day-to-day tax compliance activities within Europe and provide guidance on tax matters across multiple countries, working closely with Group Tax, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business stakeholders.

You will combine solid tax expertise with people leadership and a continuous improvement mindset, ensuring tax compliance processes are executed accurately, efficiently, and consistently across the region.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will

• Lead, coach, and develop the Europe Tax & Compliance team.

• Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant execution of tax compliance and reporting activities across Europe.

• Coordinate corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and other relevant tax compliance activities in cooperation with Group Tax and local Finance teams.

• Support transfer pricing compliance activities and documentation requirements.

• Act as a key contact for tax authorities, auditors, external advisors, and internal stakeholders on operational tax matters.

• Identify and manage tax risks, ensuring issues are escalated and addressed appropriately.

• Translate changes in tax legislation into practical guidance and actions for the business.

• Maintain and improve tax controls, documentation, and compliance processes.

• Drive standardization and process improvements across European tax and compliance activities.

• Identify recurring issues and implement sustainable solutions.

• Support business projects and operational activities with practical tax advice.

• Contribute to finance transformation, compliance, and process improvement initiatives.

• Build strong relationships with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business teams.

• Support knowledge sharing and consistent application of Group Tax policies across Europe.

What do we ask from you?

We ask you to bring experience, education, and personality

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Tax, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 8 years of experience in tax, tax compliance, or a related finance function within an international environment.

• Experience leading, coaching, or coordinating a team.

• Good knowledge of corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and general tax compliance requirements.

• Experience working with tax authorities, auditors, and external advisors.

• Experience with process improvement and standardization initiatives.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

• A proactive, pragmatic, and solution-oriented mindset.

• A collaborative leader who combines technical expertise with a strong service-oriented approach.

About The Team

You will join the global FSSC organization and become part of a collaborative international finance community. The Europe Tax & Compliance team supports the region in meeting tax and regulatory obligations while helping the business operate efficiently and compliantly in a rapidly evolving regulatory environment.

The team works closely with Group Tax, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, and local business stakeholders to strengthen compliance, mitigate risks, and continuously improve ways of working.

What We Offer

We offer a position in an international and professional working environment with room for personal development and growth.

This position offers a competitive salary range of € 6.500 to € 7.600 gross per month (excluding 8% holiday allowance).

On top of your fixed salary, you’ll receive the following secondary benefits

• 40 vacation days (20 statutory days and a flexible budget worth 20 days)

• Flexible working hours

• A hybrid workplace (40% working from home and 60% in the office)

• A Health & Wellbeing budget worth € 300 per calendar year.

• Commuting allowance, including full reimbursement of travel by public transport

• Working from home allowance

• Collective pension scheme and discount on additional health insurance

• On-site company health centres with a gym, physiotherapists and occupational therapists

• Vanderlande Academy and training facilities to boost your skills

• A variety in Vanderlande Network communities and initiatives

About Vanderlande

Vanderlande designs, delivers and supports automation solutions, operational software and lifecycle services for leading airports and parcel operations worldwide. Our solutions help customers improve performance, reliability, and sustainable growth in more than 100 countries. How we work matters just as much as what we deliver. Our values, Every Day Better, We Care, and Team Play, guide how we collaborate, support each other, and create value for our customers.

Ready to apply?

Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV.

Questions about this role? Contact Carlijn Kneepkens (Recruiter) at carlijn.kneepkens@vanderlande.com.

Diversity & inclusion

Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

postings.title: Office Manager
postings.descriptionText:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

Skills And Competencies

• 4+ years of relevant experience in office management, administration, workplace operations, executive support, or a comparable role within a professional corporate environment

• Demonstrated ability to independently manage office operations, lead administrative processes, set priorities, and coordinate or supervise an administrative support team

• Practical knowledge of employee lifecycle and human resources administration, including onboarding, offboarding, attendance, employee documentation, benefits administration, and first-line policy support

• Working knowledge of basic legal, corporate, workplace health, safety, and hygiene administration, with sound judgement to recognize when specialist advice or escalation is required

• Experience managing vendors, service contracts, purchasing, accounts payable, office budgets, and expense tracking

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams

• Fluency in Spanish and professional working proficiency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills

• Basic understanding of artificial intelligence concepts, with curiosity and enthusiasm for learning how AI tools can be used to improve processes and drive efficiency. Interest in exploring AI systems and a willingness to develop awareness of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Workplace Management, or a related field preferred, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Responsibilities

Lead the daily administrative and workplace operations of the Argentina office to provide a safe, efficient, and employee-focused environment.

• Lead office operations, set priorities, coordinate resources, and maintain consistent service standards across administrative activities, facilities, access, security, emergency arrangements, and workspace readiness

• Coordinate the local administrative support team, allocate responsibilities, monitor delivery, provide day-to-day guidance, and ensure appropriate backup coverage

• Serve as a trusted administrative and operational partner to the General Manager and designated senior leaders, exercising discretion when handling confidential or sensitive matters

• Coordinate employee onboarding, offboarding, attendance, leave records, documentation, benefits administration, workplace readiness, and routine policy support in partnership with the People team and other responsible functions

• Coordinate routine legal, corporate, compliance, workplace health, safety, and hygiene administration while maintaining required records and escalating matters that require specialist guidance

• Lead the selection, onboarding, and ongoing coordination of office service providers, contracts, renewals, purchase requisitions, invoices, accounts payable documentation, expenses, and operational inventories

• Coordinate travel, expense submissions, office events, employee initiatives, executive visits, and meetings, including scheduling, facilities, technology, suppliers, communications, and on-site logistics

• Act as the principal local liaison for regional and corporate functions, communicate local requirements, support cross-functional initiatives, maintain operational procedures and records, and provide clear updates on risks, open items, supplier performance, and upcoming needs.

About The Team

The Argentina office administration team supports a professional, safe, efficient, and employee-focused workplace. The team partners closely with the General Manager and colleagues across People, Legal, Finance, Procurement, Technology, Security, Compliance, building management, external advisers, and service providers. By joining the team, you will help strengthen local office operations, employee support, service quality, and the responsible adoption of tools and improved ways of working.

Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.
