postings.descriptionText:
Ciudad : Ciudad Autonoma de Buenos Aires País : Argentina (AR) Número de Requisición : 47548

Nuestro equipo de Auditoría Interna Global se encuentra en la búsqueda de un Analista Senior de Auditoria Interna , que reportará directamente al Gerente de Auditoría Interna.

El Senior apoyará el programa de cumplimiento SOX de Bunge y otras iniciativas, en colaboración con los equipos globales/regionales de SOX y con los responsables de procesos y controles en toda la organización.

Principales responsabilidades

• Apoyar en la planificación y definición del alcance de SOX.

• Realizar walkthroughs y ejecutar pruebas de controles, incluyendo la evaluación del diseño y la efectividad operativa con base en la documentación de procesos, así como otras tareas para apoyar el programa de cumplimiento SOX de Bunge.

• Identificar, validar y comunicar oportunamente deficiencias de control.

• Apoyar a grupos internos y externos (equipos globales/regionales de Bunge, responsables de procesos/controles y auditores externos) en temas relacionados con SOX y controles internos sobre reportes financieros, bajo la dirección del Gerente de Auditoría Interna

• Ejecutar programas de auditoría integrales de acuerdo con normas profesionales, utilizando análisis de datos y pensamiento estratégico para evaluar riesgos, analizar evidencias, entrevistar personal clave y documentar procesos y procedimientos relevantes.

• Ejercer juicio profesional independiente para identificar y analizar las observaciones de auditoría, desarrollando recomendaciones fundamentadas para acciones correctivas para la Gerencia.

• Monitorear e informar sobre el presupuesto, el cronograma y el estado de los proyectos al Senior líder y/o al Gerente de manera regular.

• Comunicar de manera efectiva los resultados de los proyectos de auditoría y consultoría mediante reportes escritos y presentaciones orales.

• Construir relaciones de trabajo sólidas con los auditados, colegas y la Gerencia, utilizando eficazmente las interacciones individuales y las habilidades de presentación en grupo.

Perfil técnico requerido

• Profesionales egresados de las carreras de Contador Público, Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas, Licenciatura en Economía u otras afines (excluyente)

• Experiencia comprobable de cuatro años o más en SOX, Auditoría Interna, o Controles Internos.

• Dominio del paquete de herramientas Microsoft Office.

• Nivel de Inglés avanzado.

• Experiencia en compañías big four (deseable).

• Conocimiento de agronegocios (deseable).

• Nivel de Portugués básico-intermedio (deseable).

Buscamos perfiles que cuenten con:

• Sólidas habilidades analíticas, de toma de decisiones y de resolución de problemas.

• Sólidas habilidades de gestión de proyectos y experiencia en la supervisión de equipos de trabajo.

• Capacidad para establecer y mantener relaciones laborales efectivas, y para trabajar eficazmente en un entorno de equipo global.

Ubicacion:

Oficina Buenos Aires

En Bunge (NYSE: BG), nuestro propósito es conectar a los agricultores con los consumidores para entregar alimentos, piensos y combustibles esenciales al mundo. Como proveedor líder de soluciones agroindustriales, nuestro equipo de :34,000 empleados dedicados se asocia con agricultores de todo el mundo para trasladar los productos agrícolas desde donde se cultivan hasta donde se necesitan, de manera más rápida, inteligente y eficiente. Somos un líder mundial en originación, almacenamiento, distribución, procesamiento y refinación de oleaginosas, que ofrece una amplia cartera de aceites, grasas y proteínas de origen vegetal. Trabajamos junto con nuestros clientes en ambos extremos de la cadena de valor para ofrecer productos de calidad y desarrollar soluciones innovadoras y personalizadas que aborden las necesidades cambiantes de los consumidores. Con más de 200 años de experiencia y presencia en más de 50 países, estamos comprometidos a fortalecer la seguridad alimentaria mundial, promover la sostenibilidad y ayudar a las comunidades a prosperar donde operamos. Bunge tiene su domicilio social en Ginebra, Suiza, y su sede corporativa en St. Louis, Missouri. Obtenga más información en Bunge.com.

Cada día, nuestra gente ejemplifica estos valores, que representan la esencia de Bunge:

• SOMOS UN ÚNICO EQUIPO – Colaborativos, respetuosos, inclusivos

• LIDERAMOS EL CAMINO – Ágiles, empoderados, innovadores

• HACEMOS LO CORRECTO – Con seguridad, sustentabilidad e integridad

Reconocemos que nuestro éxito depende de las diversas perspectivas que cada uno de nuestros colaboradores aporta a Bunge. Nos esforzamos por promover acciones que fomenten una cultura de pertenencia. A nivel global, apoyamos iniciativas como los Principios para el Empoderamiento de las Mujeres, de ONU Mujeres. Colaboramos con organizaciones como Disability:IN, un referente en la inclusión de personas con discapacidad y trabajamos continuamente en pro de nuestro compromiso de dejar un legado positivo en todas las comunidades en las que operamos.

Si esto le suena bien, ¡únase a nosotros! Valoramos e invertimos en personas que creen en nuestro propósito y están entusiasmadas por vivirlo cada día: personas que están #OrgullosasDeSerBunge.

Propósito del Rol

- Brindar aseguramiento independiente y objetivo sobre la efectividad de los procesos de control interno, gestión de riesgos y gobierno corporativo, contribuyendo a la mejora continua y al cumplimiento de normativas internas y externas.

postings.title: System Audit Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Position available for candidates based in La Plata, Bahía Blanca, CABA, Córdoba, Rosario, or Mendoza.

As our company grows, maintaining strong information security, compliance, and governance practices becomes increasingly important. As a System Audit Analyst, you’ll play a key role in assessing and improving Avature’s security and compliance posture.
Working closely with technical and business stakeholders, you’ll plan and execute internal audits, coordinate external audits and certifications, support customer security assessments, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our security and compliance programs.

Your challenges and objectives:

• Ensure Avature maintains compliance with applicable information security standards, certification requirements, and customer commitments.

• Contribute to the continual improvement of Avature's Information Security Management System (ISMS) and governance framework.

• Strengthen the organization's audit readiness by improving evidence quality, documentation, and control traceability.

• Promote consistency in the interpretation and application of security and compliance requirements across the organization.

• Build trusted relationships with auditors, customers, and internal stakeholders by providing accurate, timely, and well-supported audit responses.

• Identify opportunities to improve governance processes and increase the effectiveness of security and compliance controls.

• Stay current with emerging regulatory requirements and industry best practices to support the evolution of Avature's compliance program.

Your day-to-day activities:

• Plan and execute internal audits and control assessments to evaluate the design and effectiveness of information security controls.

• Coordinate external audits, certification activities, walkthroughs, and evidence requests.

• Prepare, maintain, and organize audit documentation, evidence, control mappings, compliance records, and status reports.

• Monitor audit findings, corrective action plans, remediation activities through completion.

• Communicate audit observations and recommendations to stakeholders, supporting the implementation and tracking of corrective actions.

About you:

• Experience in IT audit, information security, GRC, compliance, or a related field.

• Familiarity with internal and external audit processes, including control assessments, evidence review, walkthroughs, findings, and remediation.

• Experience interpreting security, compliance, and customer requirements and documenting supporting controls.

• Knowledge of security controls across areas such as access management, encryption, network security, data security, configuration management, and vulnerability management.

• Familiarity with frameworks such as ISO 27001, ISO 27017, SOC 2, NIST 800-53, Cyber Essentials, or similar.

• Strong analytical, organizational, writing, and documentation skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and collaboratively.

• Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day work and interested in staying up to date with emerging AI capabilities.

About us:
Avature is a market-leading enterprise SaaS provider for global talent acquisition and talent management. We have a strong commitment to high-quality engineering and customer service and are recognized innovators in the large enterprise market. Leading organizations around the world rely on Avature, including Fortune 500 companies, global consulting firms, some of the world's largest banks and manufacturers, and government organizations.

We design, build, implement, and support our product ourselves. With a strong culture of ownership and innovation, we continuously evolve our platform to help organizations meet the changing demands of talent acquisition and talent management. As technology continues to reshape the world of work, we leverage AI and emerging technologies to help organizations innovate, adapt, and gain competitive advantage.

At Avature, we value opportunities to learn and grow within a dynamic, creative, and collaborative environment. We encourage autonomy and empower our people to approach challenges innovatively while bringing their unique perspective to the table. We believe curiosity, continuous learning, and openness to emerging technologies are essential to building the future. Through our career development programs, mentorship, and leadership opportunities, we support each person's professional growth while making a meaningful impact on our product and our customers' success.

What we offer:

• A fast-paced, energetic, and engaging environment.

• We combine flexible remote work with in-person collaboration, encouraging team members to spend one day a week at their nearest office. We have workplaces in Buenos Aires (Palermo, La Plata and Bahía Blanca), Rosario, Mendoza and Córdoba.

• Flexible hours.

• Periodic salary reviews.

• Three weeks vacations from the first year.

• Four weeks paternity leave.

• OSDE 360 health coverage (family plan).

• Four days a year to attend events related to professional development.

• Paid internet service expenses.

An organizational culture that empowers everyone to be themselves is key to thrive in business, but more importantly, it is a pathway for creating a more equitable society. Avature fosters a diverse and inclusive environment and celebrates that each unique person brings something different to our team. We are committed to considering all qualified applicants equally and to promoting equal opportunities within our organization.

Job Description:

Buscamos un/a profesional para liderar proyectos de reporting, visualización de datos y analytics, asegurando que los datos de medios se transformen en información clara, confiable y accionable. Su objetivo será facilitar la comprensión del rendimiento de las inversiones publicitarias y contribuir a la toma de decisiones estratégicas del cliente.

La persona será responsable de coordinar equipos, gestionar proyectos de analytics y mantener una relación fluida con los stakeholders del cliente, garantizando la calidad de los entregables, el cumplimiento de los plazos y los objetivos acordados.

Principales responsabilidades

• Liderar el desarrollo de dashboards y soluciones de reporting: diseñar y supervisar tableros de control que permitan visualizar el rendimiento de campañas publicitarias y otros indicadores clave de negocio, incluyendo inversión, impresiones, alcance, frecuencia, clics, conversiones y evolución de KPIs. Trabajar con herramientas de visualización como Power BI, Tableau o Looker, según las necesidades del proyecto.

• Garantizar la calidad y consistencia de los datos: coordinar a los equipos responsables de la construcción de dashboards, validar la precisión de la información, asegurar criterios de medición consistentes y verificar que los reportes cumplan con los requerimientos acordados con el cliente antes de su entrega.

• Gestionar la relación con el cliente: trabajar con los principales stakeholders para comprender sus necesidades de información, definir prioridades, presentar avances, resolver inconvenientes y acordar entregables, plazos y expectativas. Actuar como nexo entre el cliente y los equipos internos de Dentsu.

• Definir y coordinar estructuras de datos: participar en el diseño y la organización de estructuras que permitan integrar distintas fuentes de información y alimentar múltiples soluciones de reporting. Facilitar la comparación de resultados entre canales, campañas, marcas y períodos para responder a diferentes necesidades de negocio.

• Liderar equipos y gestionar proyectos: supervisar y desarrollar equipos de Executives y Analysts, distribuir responsabilidades, revisar la calidad del trabajo y asegurar el cumplimiento de los plazos. Gestionar prioridades y recursos para garantizar la entrega de proyectos de acuerdo con los estándares establecidos.

• Participar en la planificación y el desarrollo comercial: estimar esfuerzos y recursos para nuevos proyectos, contribuir a la elaboración de propuestas comerciales y RFPs, y asegurar el cumplimiento de los compromisos y acuerdos establecidos con el cliente.

Perfil requerido

• Experiencia en reporting, visualización de datos, business intelligence o analytics, preferentemente en medios, marketing digital o agencias de publicidad.

• Experiencia liderando equipos y coordinando proyectos con múltiples stakeholders.

• Conocimiento de herramientas de visualización de datos, como Power BI, Tableau o Looker.

• Capacidad para comprender e integrar datos provenientes de diferentes plataformas y fuentes.

• Experiencia en control de calidad, validación de métricas y definición de indicadores de rendimiento.

• Habilidades de comunicación y presentación de resultados, con capacidad para traducir información técnica en insights relevantes para el negocio.

• Experiencia en gestión de clientes, planificación de recursos, seguimiento de entregables y cumplimiento de plazos.

• Capacidad analítica, orientación a resultados, organización y atención al detalle.

Competencias clave

• Liderazgo y desarrollo de equipos.

• Gestión de proyectos y prioridades.

• Orientación al cliente y habilidades de comunicación.

• Pensamiento analítico y resolución de problemas.

• Planificación, organización y mejora continua.

• Capacidad para transformar datos en información útil para la toma de decisiones.

Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.

The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the Domain Leader and the rest of the Domain team.

Key Responsibilities

Skills & Attributes for Success

• Credible, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at Global/Area leadership level.

postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

Step into a pivotal role where your leadership will shape the future of Global Equities Operations at JPMorganChase. Here, you'll champion a robust control framework, drive governance, and support strategic growth. You'll join a collaborative, innovative environment that values your insights and empowers you to make a lasting impact on our risk culture and operational excellence. At JPMorganChase, your career growth and mobility are supported, and your skills are recognized as key to our continued success.

As an Operations Control Management - Vice President within the Global Equities Operations team, you will play a critical role in safeguarding our business and supporting strategic growth. You will lead the development and execution of control frameworks, coordinate audit and compliance reviews, and drive risk mitigation strategies. In this role, you will partner with cross-functional teams, leverage advanced analytics, and implement innovative technology solutions to enhance operational controls. You will be empowered to anticipate challenges, take ownership, and continuously improve our risk management practices. Your dedication will help foster a culture of risk awareness and operational excellence, making a meaningful impact on our team and the wider firm.

Job Responsibilities

• Conduct functional deep dive reviews and targeted risk assessments to identify, analyze, and address control gaps and emerging risks within operational processes.

• Partner with Audit, Compliance, and Regulatory teams to assess incidents, perform root cause analysis, and drive remediation of control issues.

• Design and execute risk mitigation strategies based on findings from audits, deep dives, and risk reviews, ensuring sustainable control enhancements.

• Develop, analyze, and publish standardized control metrics; leverage business analytics tools (e.g., Tableau, Qlik) to identify trends, errors, and opportunities for process improvement.

• Drive control remediation and risk mitigation programs using data-driven insights and metric-based analysis.

• Manage governance and reporting of control and risk initiatives through advanced business analytics and visualization tools.

• Implement innovative technology solutions (e.g., Alteryx, Xceptor) to automate controls, enhance data analysis, and support operational excellence.

• Review significant change agenda and ensure no diminish of controls environment, assist with designing new controls where required.

• Act as a first line of defense with Operations on the control agenda, serving as a trusted advisor on operations risk, control, and audit matters.

• Help coordinate internal and external audit engagements and regulatory reviews, including preparation, walkthroughs, evidence gathering, and remediation tracking.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

• Demonstrated experience in internal/external audit, operational risk reviews, or targeted risk assessments within financial services or a related industry.

• Strong business analytics skills: ability to extract, analyze, and interpret large data sources using tools such as Tableau, Qlik, Alteryx, or similar platforms.

• Proven ability to conduct functional deep dives and root cause analysis, with a track record of identifying and remediating control gaps.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present complex findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders (VP/ED/MD level).

• Strong influencing and negotiation skills; able to build partnerships across Operations, Technology, Audit, and Compliance.

• Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and process re-engineering skills, with meticulous attention to detail.

• Effective time management and prioritization skills; able to deliver results in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment.

• Proactive/self-starter with a commitment to delivering value-added support to business partners.

Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

postings.title: Policy, Risk and Control (PRC) Methodology Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 950 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting, and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

The opportunity

The Technology Assurance, Risk, and Policy (TARP) function within Information Security strives to create and promote a holistic Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) program by creating a robust, resilient, and proactive governance framework, supported by a strategic risk management approach and stringent compliance structures. It aims to integrate and align its GRC initiatives in line with the global firm's objectives and emerging threats within the cybersecurity landscape.

Furthermore, the Policy, Risk, and Controls (PRC) Enablement & Awareness team aims to establish policies and procedures that reflect the value we place on safeguarding our digital environment, while ensuring that these policies are effectively communicated and enforced across all levels of the organization. The PRC Methodology Program is part of the Global Information Security Policy & Methodology team within PRC Enablement & Awareness and supports the GRC program and its tooling by integrating and aligning the IT PRC Framework operating model to ensure that policies, standards, processes, risks, and controls remain consistent with the principles and data structure of the core GRC platform.

Your Key Responsibilities

The PRC Methodology Analyst will coordinate, maintain, and update the IT PRC Framework, which underpins the Policy and Risk Management Programs through the structured integration of IT risk domains, risk categories, processes, control objectives, common controls, IS documents, and authoritative sources derived from industry standards, control frameworks, and regulatory mandates. The PRC Methodology Analyst will also work closely with the Global Methodology Program Lead to execute the service offerings, strategy, goals, and objectives of the Methodology Program, including those related to IT Risk Management and associated methodologies; implement the PRC Framework operating model; and integrate it with relevant team and organizational projects, programs, and emerging initiatives.

A successful applicant will be analytical, collaborative, and communicative. Information Security Policy Specialist

As an Information Security Policy Specialist, you will help create, maintain, and communicate the global information security (IS) policies and standards that protect EY and client information assets. You will join a global Information Security team of more than 950 professionals who enable EY to work securely, deliver secure products and services, and respond quickly to security events. Together, the team helps protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Across the security lifecycle, EY Information Security brings together risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security, and technology solutions. You will work with security-focused colleagues who support, protect, and enable the business through practical, innovative solutions that deliver speed to market and business value.

The opportunity

The Technology Assurance, Risk, and Policy (TARP) function supports a coordinated Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) program that aligns governance, risk management, and compliance activities with EY’s objectives and the evolving cybersecurity landscape.

Within TARP, the Policy, Risk, and Controls (PRC) Enablement & Awareness team establishes and promotes IS policies and standards that safeguard EY’s digital environment. The team also helps communicate and embed those requirements across the organization.

As part of the Global Information Security Policy, Methodology & Awareness team within PRC Enablement & Awareness, you will help strengthen a security-aware culture by translating security requirements into clear policies, education, awareness, and practical guidance.

Your Key Responsibilities

The Information Security Policy Specialist helps create and maintain EY Global Information Security policies and standards for technology professionals and the wider EY workforce.

Success in this role requires analytical thinking, creativity, sound judgment, and clear communication. You will collaborate with stakeholders across EY to evaluate requirements, develop practical policy solutions, and present recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

Key responsibilities include:

• Maintain a structured global framework for managing Information Security policies and standards throughout their lifecycle.

• Develop, update, and maintain IS policies and standards in collaboration with cross-functional teams consisting of both technical and non-technical personnel, drawing on international standards, industry practices, regulatory requirements, and business needs gathered from subject matter experts and key stakeholders across the firm.

• Assess IS policy gaps and recommend new or revised requirements that align EY with business needs and industry practices.

• Review IS policies and standards regularly to validate their relevance, accuracy, and continued applicability.

• Translate input from subject matter experts, vendors, and industry sources into clear, consistent, and actionable IS policies and standards for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Align Information Security documents and supporting materials with related EY policies and standards.

• Communicate IS policy requirements through clear written guidance, presentations, and stakeholder discussions tailored to relevant audiences.

• Contribute to proposals and related written materials as needed.

• Track and report on IS policy program metrics.

• Confident listening, writing, presentation, and influencing skills across departments and levels of the organization.

• Self-directed approach, with the organization and judgment to manage multiple projects and make sound decisions.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

• Integrity and professionalism in handling sensitive information and decisions.

• Demonstrated ability to handle adversity.

To qualify for the role, you must have

postings.title: Especialista de Seguridad Operativa
postings.descriptionText:
¿Qué buscamos?

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Especialista de Seguridad Operativa para incorporarse a la Gerencia de Seguridad Corporativa .
Buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a con experiencia en Seguridad Operativa, gestión de riesgos y operaciones de la industria Oil & Gas , con sólida trayectoria en activos industriales complejos, operaciones técnicas y servicios críticos. Valoramos especialmente la capacidad para integrar estándares internacionales, normativa local, analítica de datos e inteligencia artificial aplicada a la prevención de eventos de alto potencial y a la mejora del desempeño HSE.

¿Cuál será su desafío?

Contribuir al diseño, implementación y mejora continua de los procesos corporativos de Seguridad Operativa, asegurando su alineación con la legislación vigente, los requisitos internos de la compañía y las mejores prácticas internacionales del sector Oil & Gas.
Asimismo, tendrá un rol clave en la gestión de riesgos críticos, la evaluación de la efectividad de controles y barreras de seguridad, el soporte a operaciones y contratistas, la gestión segura de actividades de alto riesgo y la incorporación de herramientas digitales que fortalezcan la toma de decisiones preventivas basadas en datos.

¿Cuáles serán sus principales tareas?

• Desarrollar, actualizar e implementar lineamientos, procedimientos y estándares corporativos de Seguridad Operativa para operaciones, activos industriales, proyectos, contratistas y servicios críticos.

• Gestionar riesgos críticos y escenarios de alto potencial mediante la identificación de peligros, evaluación de riesgos, definición de controles críticos, monitoreo de barreras y seguimiento de acciones correctivas.

• Brindar soporte técnico a operaciones, mantenimiento, ingeniería, construcción y contratistas especializados para asegurar la planificación y ejecución segura de actividades críticas.

• Participar en la gestión de actividades de alto riesgo vinculadas a permisos de trabajo, aislamiento de energías, trabajos simultáneos, gestión del cambio y análisis de riesgos de tarea.

• Diseñar e implementar tableros de control, indicadores proactivos y reactivos, reportes ejecutivos y rutinas de seguimiento para la toma de decisiones gerenciales.

• Impulsar la automatización de procesos de captura, procesamiento, análisis y visualización de datos HSE, asegurando la calidad, trazabilidad y disponibilidad de la información.

• Participar en proyectos de innovación tecnológica junto a equipos de IT, Operaciones, Mantenimiento e Ingeniería, promoviendo soluciones digitales, analítica avanzada e inteligencia artificial aplicada a la gestión preventiva de riesgos.

• Acompañar auditorías, verificaciones, revisiones de desempeño e investigaciones de eventos, promoviendo el aprendizaje organizacional y la mejora continua.

• Impulsar la estandarización y fortalecimiento de los sistemas de gestión de Seguridad Operativa alineados con estándares internacionales.

• Aplicar metodologías de gestión de riesgos operacionales como Bow Tie, análisis de barreras, controles críticos, HAZID, Control of Work, permisos de trabajo y Gestión del Cambio (MOC) .

¿Qué valoramos?

Formación académica:

• Ingeniería (excluyente).

• Sólidos conocimientos en Seguridad Operativa, gestión de riesgos y operaciones Oil & Gas.

• Se valorará formación complementaria en Sistemas de Gestión HSE, Gestión de Riesgos Operacionales, Ciencia de Datos, Analítica Avanzada, Transformación Digital o Inteligencia Artificial aplicada.

Experiencia profesional:
Experiencia comprobable (mínimo 5 años) en:

• Operaciones de la industria Oil & Gas.

• Activos industriales complejos, operaciones técnicas y servicios críticos.

• Gestión de contratistas especializados.

• Actividades de alto riesgo, mantenimiento mayor, ingeniería, construcción y paradas de planta.

• Implementación, mantenimiento, auditoría y mejora de sistemas de gestión de seguridad.

• Cumplimiento legal y normativo.

Extraordinary Teams Building Inspiring Projects

Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place.

Differentiated by the quality of our people and our relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, we align our capabilities to our customers' objectives to create a lasting positive impact. We serve the Infrastructure; Nuclear, Security & Environmental; Energy; Mining & Metals, and the Manufacturing and Technology markets. Our services span from initial planning and investment, through start-up and operations.

Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments. They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report.

Country Overview

Argentina: Building Our Presence

Bechtel is building a strong local organization in Argentina, partnering with industry, government, suppliers, and communities to support our customers and projects. We’re bringing global expertise to develop local talent, strengthen regional capabilities, and deliver lasting value — establishing a trusted, long-term presence that supports sustainable growth and positions Argentina as a cornerstone market for mining, energy, and infrastructure development.

Job Summary

Manage the obtaining, maintenance and monitoring of environmental and sectoral permits that enable the execution of the project in Argentina, ensuring that the engineering design, constructive planning and field activities comply with the applicable national and provincial regulations, with the commitments assumed before the authority and with the environmental standards of the client.

The position acts as a bridge between engineering and the regulatory authority: it translates the legal requirements into verifiable design criteria, anticipates the environmental restrictions that condition the layout and the construction sequence, and maintains a critical permit route aligned with the project schedule. Its performance is measured by the absence of regulatory detentions and by the technical quality of the information presented to the competent bodies.

Major Responsibilities

Permission management

• Preparing and keeping updated the project permits matrix, identifying competent body, submission requirements, legal deadlines and actual processing deadlines. Prepare, review and submit the Environmental Impact Report and its biennial updates, along with the supporting technical documentation required by the provincial mining authority.

• Managing the associated sectoral permits: water use and concession, effluent dumping, emissions into the atmosphere, hazardous waste management, soil movement, intervention of native vegetation and transport of hazardous substances.

• Maintaining technical dialogue with provincial and national enforcement authorities, responding to observations, requests for additional information and audits.

• Timely alert the permits that constitute a critical route and propose sequencing alternatives when a regulatory deadline compromises the schedule.

Environmental studies and assessment

• Defining the scope of the environmental baselines — air quality, noise, surface and groundwater, soils, flora, fauna, glaciers and periglacial environment, archaeology and socio—economic environment - and technically supervise the consulting firms that execute them.

• Reviewing consultant deliverables verifying methodological sufficiency, representativeness of sampling and traceability of data before its incorporation into the file.

• Evaluating environmental impacts of the project, propose mitigation and compensation measures, and verify that they are reflected in the design criteria and technical specifications.

• Estimating hours, costs and deadlines of environmental studies for their incorporation into the project budget and program.

Compliance, monitoring and interface with the project

• Keeping track of environmental commitments derived from the Environmental Impact Statement and the permits granted, and periodically verify their compliance on the ground.

• Providing the engineering disciplines with the environmental constraints applicable to the design — layout restrictions, exclusion areas, discharge limits and water management criteria — and verify their incorporation.

• Preparing progress reports on the status of permits for the client and for the project management, with status, regulatory risks and mitigation actions.

• Supporting the processes of citizen participation and relations with communities and local authorities, in coordination with the social area of the project and the client.

• Issuing the environmental deliverables under the project's documentary control system, respecting the review scheme and the preparation, review and approval signatures.

Regulatory framework of reference

• Dominating the Argentine environmental regime and its federal articulation: the Nation sets the minimum protection budgets and the provinces, as holders of the original domain of natural resources, are the enforcement authority that grants the permits. The following list is the minimum core required: Law 25.675, Law 24.585; Law 26.639; Law 24.051, Law 25.688, Law 26.331, Law 25.743, Law 25.831, Law 27.520, ILO Convention 169 (Law 24.071).

Level 1

Education and Experience Requirements:

• Requires a university degree in Environmental Sciences, Chemistry, Civil Engineering, Natural Resources, Geological Sciences or Biological Sciences, with professional registration in the corresponding jurisdiction, between 5 and 8 years of professional practice in environmental management and permits, with at least 3 years in mining, energy or infrastructure projects in Argentina.

• A graduate degree, major or diploma in environmental management, environmental impact assessment or environmental law is desirable.

Level 2

• Requires a university degree in Environmental Sciences, Chemistry, Civil Engineering, Natural Resources, Geological Sciences or Biological Sciences, with professional registration in the corresponding jurisdiction, between 8 and 10 years of professional practice in environmental management and permits, with at least 5 years in mining, energy or infrastructure projects in Argentina.

• A graduate degree, major or diploma in environmental management, environmental impact assessment or environmental law is desirable.

Required Knowledge And Skills

• Verifiable participation in at least one complete cycle of environmental processing: preparation of the study, submission to the authority, response to observations and obtaining the approving resolution.

• Experience in direct interaction with provincial and national public agencies, and in technical supervision of environmental consultancies.

• Previous experience in EPC or EPCM environments is desirable, with exposure to document control, change control and management of interfaces between disciplines. Mastery of the Argentine environmental regime described in the previous section and ability to track its provincial regulations.

• Environmental impact assessment methodologies, design of monitoring plans and environmental management programs; notions of modeling of air quality, noise and dispersion of pollutants.

• Management of geographic information systems, advanced spreadsheets and project scheduling tools.

• Native Spanish and intermediate or higher technical English, sufficient to read international standards and participate in meetings with multinational teams.

• The Documentary Organization: Maintains complete, versioned and auditable files at all times.

• Integrity: Does not sign or endorse information that it cannot endorse, even under deadline pressure.

• The technical rigor: Supports each statement of the file in verifiable data and detects methodological weaknesses in third-party studies.

• Regulatory anticipation: Identifies the permit that will become a critical route before it becomes one and activates management well in advance.

• The institutional communication: Maintains a professional and traceable relationship with the authority; writes with legal and technical precision.

• The transversal work: Translates environmental requirements into the language of engineering and negotiates solutions with the disciplines without compromising compliance.

• Experience in metallic and/or non-metallic mining.

• Experience in EPC/EPCM projects and knowledge of the AACE standard.

• Knowledge of local design regulations.

Total Rewards/Benefits

For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of engineers and beyond! Because our teams face some of the world's toughest challenges, we offer robust benefits to ensure our people thrive. Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth. Learn more at Bechtel Total Rewards.

Diverse Teams Build The Extraordinary

As a global company, Bechtel has long been home to a vibrant multitude of nationalities, cultures, ethnicities, and life experiences. This diversity has made us a more trusted partner, more effective problem solvers and innovators, and a more attractive destination for leading talent.

We are committed to being a company where every colleague feels that they belong-where colleagues feel part of "One Team," respected and rewarded for what they bring, supported in pursuing their goals, invested in our values and purpose, and treated equitably. Imagine being part of a team that’s redefining the future of mobility—where your ideas don’t just sit in a lab but power next-generation technology. At indie, we are developing cutting-edge semiconductors, photonics, and radar sensors and systems for automotive, industrial, and adjacent markets. Our innovations are at the heart of advanced intelligent sensing and user experience applications, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

If you're passionate about groundbreaking technology and want to make a real impact alongside a fast-paced team that thrives on creativity and collaboration, we’d love to have you on board!

The Functional Safety Engineer (FSE) at indie plays a key role within our design organization and is central to our automotive safety culture. In this position, the FSE leads and advocates for the functional safety lifecycle across projects, ensuring our designs and processes meet all relevant automotive safety standards.

Job Responsibilities

• Analyze top-level safety requirements and safety goals at the stakeholder level

• Develop technical safety concepts and technical safety requirements for products

• Work with the System Architect to refine system architecture and detailed safety mechanism descriptions

• Derive hardware (HW) and software (SW) safety requirements from technical safety requirements

• Collaborate with design teams to define effective technical solutions that achieve system, HW, and SW robustness in compliance with functional safety standards

• Create safety analysis work products (System FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA, etc.)

• Monitor safety verification and validation activities

• Support customer inquiries and reviews related to functional safety topics and work products

• Cooperate with the Functional Safety Manager (FSM), global FuSa teams, and external contractors as needed

• Support design engineering with impact analysis of design changes and ensure continued functional safety compliance

• Support internal and external safety assessment reviews

Job Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry (e.g., design, test, or quality); highly motivated and capable early-career candidates are also encouraged to apply

• BS or MS in Natural Sciences, Applied Physics, Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering

• Strong manufacturing, quality engineering, and data analysis skills

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills

• Reliable, detail-oriented, and customer-focused mindset with strong documentation skills

• Strong understanding of ISO 26262 and automotive engineering principles

• Experience creating safety documents (Safety Concepts, FMEA, FMEDA, DFA, FTA)

Qualifications

• Experience with requirements management tools (e.g., JAMA)

• Knowledge of product development lifecycles for systems, electrical, or software development

• Strong technical leadership, planning, and organizational skills

• ISO 26262 certification is a plus

• Experience with safety analysis tools (e.g., Medini) is a plus

• Self-motivated with the ability to develop creative solutions

• Familiarity with automotive standards (e.g., IATF 16949, VDA 6.3) is a plus

• Ability to travel internationally as required

indie Semiconductor and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

Concerning agencies: indie Semiconductor does not accept unsolicited resumes and will not be responsible for fees related to such.

postings.title: SSr. HFE Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Sobre Meitner Energy
La misión de Meitner Energy es transformar el panorama energético global mediante soluciones nucleares limpias, sostenibles y escalables. Estamos comprometidos con redefinir cómo el mundo alimenta a la industria y al comercio para liderar la transición hacia un futuro más limpio.
En el centro de nuestro trabajo está el ACR300: un reactor modular pequeño (SMR) Gen III+ de 300 MWe diseñado para tener impacto a escala de red desde el primer día. Construido sobre tecnología probada de agua liviana con innovación dirigida y orientada a la ejecución, el ACR300 ofrece desempeño de carga base de alta utilización, independiente de las condiciones climáticas o las limitaciones de almacenamiento. Es el único SMR diseñado para ser a la vez escalable y rentable, con la menor carga de construcción física por megavatio entre los SMR de escala de red.
Nuestro equipo de clase mundial está basado en Argentina, los Estados Unidos y el Reino Unido, trabajando juntos hacia una sola meta: electrificación a escala, comenzando en 2030.

La Oportunidad
Como Sr. HFE Engineer, vas a desarrollar y ejecutar los elementos del Programa de Ingeniería de Factores Humanos (HFE) para el proyecto ACR300, siguiendo los lineamientos de NUREG-0711 Rev.3. El rol abarca desde los estudios de análisis de tareas hasta el soporte a la verificación y validación de los sistemas HSI.
Este rol es clave para Meitner en este momento porque los factores humanos definen cuán operable, comprensible y segura resulta la planta para quienes la operan. Tu trabajo hoy define cómo los operadores leen, deciden y actúan sobre los sistemas.
Este puesto es ideal para alguien que:

• Cree que la energía nuclear es esencial para un futuro energético limpio y se toma la operabilidad humana como parte central del diseño.

• Disfruta del análisis de tareas, de la ergonomía cognitiva y del diseño de interfaces HSI.

• Tiene capacidad analítica, orientación al detalle y comunicación técnica efectiva.

• Quiere crecer en una empresa donde sus análisis efectivamente moldean el diseño de la sala de control.

Qué Harás
Análisis HFE

• Revisión de Experiencia Operativa para identificar problemas de factores humanos relevantes al diseño.

• Análisis funcional y asignación de funciones de acuerdo con procedimientos preestablecidos.

• Planificación y ejecución del Análisis de Tareas: identificación de tareas críticas, análisis de carga mental, detección de necesidades de información y control.

• Evaluación de situaciones de alarmas y desarrollo del programa de gestión de alarmas conforme a EEMUA 191 / ISA-18.2.

Diseño HSI

• Elaboración y revisión de documentación de diseño de HSI: bases de diseño, especificaciones de pantallas y filosofía de operación.

• Participación en revisiones de diseño formales aportando criterios de HFE al diseño de la planta.

• Revisión de documentación de manuales de operación y del programa de entrenamiento de operadores.

• Soporte al programa de entrenamiento de operadores: revisión de materiales y alineación con los análisis de tareas.

Soporte a V&V

• Planificación y documentación de actividades de verificación y validación de sistemas de I&C y HSI (salas de control, estaciones locales de supervisión/control, etc.).

Qué Buscamos
Capacidad Analítica y Atención al Detalle

• Capacidad analítica y orientación al detalle para sostener análisis HFE rigurosos.

• Comunicación técnica efectiva con disciplinas técnicas y stakeholders del proyecto.

Adaptabilidad y Autonomía

• Adaptabilidad ante requisitos cambiantes en proyectos de largo plazo.

• Autonomía y gestión del tiempo frente a hitos de licenciamiento.

Trabajo en Equipo Multidisciplinario

• Capacidad de trabajo en equipo multidisciplinario con Engineering, Nuclear Safety, Licensing y stakeholders internos y externos.

Requisitos

• Graduado/a en Ingeniería Electrónica, Electromecánica, Industrial o afines.

• Especialidad en Control y Automatización.

• Experiencia mínima de 3 años en Energía, Oil & Gas, Minería o Nuclear.

• Experiencia comprobable en HFE o ergonomía cognitiva aplicada a sistemas de control industrial complejo.

• Participación en proyectos de diseño o evaluación de HMI/HSI en industrias de proceso.

• Inglés avanzado.

• Disponibilidad para viajar a nivel nacional.

• Experiencia en operación de plantas.

• Experiencia en la industria nuclear.

• Experiencia con herramientas de análisis ergonómico, eye-tracking y simuladores de sala de control.

¿Por qué unirte a Meitner Energy?
Una misión que importa. Vas a ayudar a poner en línea energía nuclear limpia y escalable, no como una promesa futura, sino como un plan ejecutable que arranca en 2030. El trabajo que hagas acá acelera directamente la transición energética global.
Ownership real. Meitner es lo suficientemente chica como para que tus decisiones moldeen visiblemente la empresa, y lo suficientemente ambiciosa como para que esas decisiones importen. Contratamos personas que quieren ser dueñas de los resultados, no solo de tareas.
Equipo de clase mundial en tres continentes. Vas a trabajar con ingenieros, operadores y constructores en Argentina, EE. UU. y el Reino Unido, con experiencia profunda en lo nuclear, lo industrial y la ejecución.
Ejecución por encima del hype. El ACR300 está construido sobre tecnología probada de agua liviana con innovación dirigida, porque desplegar energía limpia a escala es un problema de ejecución, no un experimento científico. Valoramos el rigor, el criterio y el seguimiento.

Para postularte
Si estás listo/a para sumarte a nuestro equipo, enviá tu CV a hiring@meitner.energy con el nombre del rol en el asunto.

postings.title: Threat Hunting Lead
postings.descriptionText:
Why Join AspenView?
At AspenView, we’re more than a nearshore IT partner—we’re a people-first, purpose-driven company that believes great culture drives great outcomes. We’re passionate about connecting talent and technology to deliver measurable value for clients—and meaningful career paths for our people.
Here’s what you can expect:

• Competitive base

• Flexible work model: hybrid, remote, or in-office

• Real growth opportunities and leadership visibility

• Inclusive, respectful culture that blends U.S. innovation with Colombian heart

• A company that listens, invests in you, and celebrates wins together

We are seeking a Threat Hunting Lead to join the security operations team of a large US consumer lender in the financial services sector, working 100% on-site from AspenView’s secure office in Buenos Aires, Argentina . You’ll own the hunt plan and lead intelligence-driven hunts across endpoint, identity, network, email and AWS telemetry in Elastic, directing two Threat Hunting Analysts, one in Buenos Aires and one in Colombia, and working daily with the Detection Engineering Lead so that every good hunt ends as a working detection. This is a hands-on role for someone who has actually taken hunts from hypothesis to outcome and knows what living-off-the-land, credential abuse and lateral movement look like in real logs, not just someone who has triaged alerts from a queue.
What you will do:
Hunt Strategy & Planning

• Own the hunt plan, building hypotheses from threat intel on US consumer finance, recent incidents and known telemetry gaps.

• Decide which hypotheses get hunt time and set priorities for the team.

• Help the client decide where GenAI-enabled capabilities add value to hunting and where they don’t.

Hunt Execution

• Run scheduled and ad hoc hunts across CrowdStrike, Defender, Okta, Palo Alto, Proofpoint and AWS data in Elastic.

• Track living-off-the-land techniques, credential and session abuse, and lateral movement, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

• Sweep the estate for related activity to support the incident response team during major incidents.

Detection Handoff & Client Reporting

• Turn hunt outcomes into detection backlog items with Detection Engineering and make sure they ship.

• Write clear client hunt reports covering what was tested, found, ruled out and couldn’t be tested.

• Present results directly to the client’s security leadership.

Team Leadership

• Direct and review the work of two Threat Hunting Analysts across Buenos Aires and Colombia.

• Mentor the team on hypothesis design, tradecraft and query quality.

Tools & Technologies:

• Platforms & Infrastructure: Elastic Security (EQL, ES|QL), Splunk or Sentinel, Palo Alto, Proofpoint, VDI-based client environment.

• Security & Threat Intelligence: CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, Okta, MITRE ATT&CK, MISP, OpenCTI, Recorded Future, FS-ISAC.

• Cloud & Data Analysis: AWS telemetry, Python, Jupyter.

What you bring:

• Experience: 5+ years in threat hunting, Tier 3 investigation or incident response, with hunts you can walk through from hypothesis to outcome.

• Querying: Fluent SIEM or data-platform querying (Elastic, Splunk, Sentinel or equivalent) across large data sets.

• Tradecraft: Solid MITRE ATT&CK knowledge and a sharp eye for LOTL, credential/session abuse and lateral movement in logs.

• Consulting / Leadership: Experience leading or mentoring hunters or analysts, including across different locations, and confidence presenting to client security leadership.

• Mindset: Hypothesis-driven, candid when a hunt comes up empty, and focused on getting detections shipped.

• Language: Fluent English, at B2+ / C1 level.

• Nice to have: Elastic EQL/ES|QL, deep EDR experience, Okta and AWS hunting, threat intel platforms, Python/Jupyter, financial-sector threat knowledge (fraud, ransomware, BEC), detection writing, and GCTI, GDAT, GCIH or eCTHP certification.

• Clearance: Must pass identity, criminal-background, employment and education checks, repeated periodically.

• Location & Schedule: Full-time, 100% on-site from AspenView’s secure office in Buenos Aires, Argentina, on US Eastern business hours (10:00–19:00 Buenos Aires time from November to March, 09:00–18:00 the rest of the year). No shift rotation, but you may be pulled in during a major incident. Direct employment contract with AspenView (relación de dependencia), dedicated to one client.

postings.title: SR. CHEMICAL TREATMENT ENGINEER
postings.descriptionText:
En Pluspetrol potenciamos el desarrollo energético sostenible para el bienestar de las actuales y futuras generaciones.

Somos la empresa privada líder en producción de hidrocarburos de Latinoamérica y día a día buscamos alcanzar los objetivos de crecimiento y sostenibilidad con visión de largo plazo. Aplicamos creatividad y compromiso para afrontar las complejidades de nuestras operaciones.

Te invitamos a sumarte a nuestro equipo, estamos buscando un/a SR. CHEMICAL TREATMENT ENGINEER

Los desafíos con los que te vas a encontrar serán:

• Liderar la estrategia integral de tratamientos químicos de los activos de la UN ARG.

• Definir estrategias de tratamiento químico para nuevas instalaciones y problemáticas identificadas en instalaciones existentes.

• Diseñar, implementar y monitorear programas asociados a corrosión, incrustaciones, parafinas, emulsiones, espumas, calidad de agua, bacterias, H2S y otras problemáticas aplicables al activo.

• Realizar la proyección y el seguimiento mensual de los costos operativos y las mejoras de instalaciones relacionadas con el transporte, dosificación y acopio de productos químicos en campo.

• Definir planes de monitoreo, KPIs, límites operativos, criterios de desempeño y frecuencias de control que permitan evaluar la efectividad de los tratamientos y anticipar desvíos.

• Liderar el desarrollo y evolución de tableros de monitoreo de performance, integrando información operacional, química, laboratorio, integridad y costos.

• Proponer y liderar optimizaciones de mediano y largo plazo con foco en confiabilidad, integridad, eficiencia operacional y reducción del costo total del tratamiento.

• Identificar, evaluar y proponer nuevas tecnologías. Definir alcance, protocolos, KPIs, criterios de aceptación y lineamientos técnicos para pilotos, y aprobar sus conclusiones técnicas.

• Liderar técnicamente la generación de pliegos de contratación de productos y servicios químicos, las evaluaciones técnicas y el seguimiento del proceso licitatorio.

• Gestionar técnicamente el desempeño de proveedores y contratos, estableciendo KPIs, mecanismos de seguimiento y planes de mejora.

• Actuar como Autoridad Técnica de la especialidad, evaluando y aprobando técnicamente todo tipo de modificación relacionada con tratamientos químicos y su infraestructura asociada.

• Generar procedimientos e instructivos operativos.

• Brindar soporte en la resolución de problemáticas operativas complejas y análisis de causa raíz, trabajando de manera integrada con Operaciones, Procesos, Integridad, Mantenimiento, Ingeniería y otras disciplinas.

• Responder y asegurar el cumplimiento de obligaciones y estándares EHS globales y locales aplicables al manejo y utilización de productos químicos.

• Gestionar el empadronamiento ante SEDRONAR u organismos contralores similares,realizar el control y carga trimestral de los movimientos de precursores químicos, asegurando trazabilidad y cumplimiento de los requisitos aplicables.

• Liderar la elaboración de informes trimestrales y semestrales de pozos sumideros, monitores y permisos ambientales.

• Participar en la formación técnica de profesionales del sector, actuando como mentor y referente de conocimiento de la disciplina.

¿Qué buscamos?

• Ingeniería Química, Ingeniería en Petróleo o carreras afines.

• 10 años de experiencia en tratamientos químicos e integridad en Oil & Gas, preferentemente en campos No Convencionales.

• Uso e interpretación de herramientas de modelado de tendencia incrustante y corrosiva, análisis de compatibilidad de aguas y evaluación de escenarios operativos.

• Conocimiento de técnicas y metodologías analíticas aplicadas, incluyendo criterios de muestreo, aseguramiento de calidad, interpretación y validación de resultados de laboratorio.

• Se valora el manejo de herramientas de simulación de procesos, como Aspen HYSYS o equivalentes.

• Capacidad para trabajar en equipos multidisciplinarios e interactuar con Operaciones, Producción y Planificación.

• Inglés avanzado mandatorio.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Ofrecemos a nuestros colaboradores diferentes tipos de beneficios para cuidar de su bienestar físico, emocional y financiero. En nuestra propuesta incluimos:

+Valor

Plataforma de descuentos, reintegros por guardería y cuidadores, préstamos, seguro de vida adicional, obsequios por eventos especiales y nuestro programa de idiomas.

+Balance

Modalidad híbrida y flexibilidad en el horario de ingreso / egreso, vacaciones y licencias adicionales, licencias familiares extendidas y día de cumpleaños.

+Vitalidad

Gimnasio y planes de wellness on site.

Si crees que esta oportunidad es para vos, no dudes en aplicar.

¡Postúlate y anímate a vivir la experiencia Pluspetrol!

postings.descriptionText:
Abogado/a Senior | Corporate & Derecho Empresarial

Compañía multinacional de servicios se encuentra en la búsqueda de un/a Abogado/a Senior especializado/a en Derecho Empresarial y Corporate para incorporarse a su equipo de Legales.

Buscamos un perfil con al menos 10 años de experiencia , con fuerte expertise contractual y capacidad para brindar asesoramiento jurídico integral al negocio, acompañando nuevos productos, servicios, alianzas estratégicas y proyectos en un entorno multinacional.

¿Cuáles serán sus principales desafíos?
🔴 Brindar asesoramiento jurídico integral a la compañía , acompañando al negocio en nuevos productos, servicios y proyectos estratégicos.
🔴 Elaborar, revisar y negociar contratos comerciales con proveedores y terceros, incluyendo tecnología, software, marketing, contact center, compras y otros servicios.
🔴 Asesorar en alianzas estratégicas , incluyendo acuerdos con entidades bancarias y otros partners, identificando riesgos contractuales y regulatorios.
🔴 Acompañar el lanzamiento de nuevos productos y servicios, evaluando marcos regulatorios, riesgos legales y contractuales .
🔴 Brindar asesoramiento sobre publicidad y comunicaciones comerciales , incluyendo revisión de contratos y materiales publicitarios.
🔴 Asesorar a las distintas áreas de la compañía —Operaciones, Ventas, Marketing, Logística, Compras, Finanzas, RRHH, entre otras— en cuestiones legales vinculadas al negocio.
🔴 Participar en proyectos de Compliance , auditorías y procesos vinculados al cumplimiento normativo, trabajando en coordinación con equipos regionales.

¿Qué buscamos?
✔ Abogado/a graduado/a con matrícula profesional vigente.
✔ 10 años o más de experiencia en áreas legales corporativas y/o estudios jurídicos, preferentemente en compañías multinacionales.
✔ Sólidos conocimientos en Derecho Empresarial, Contractual, Societario/Corporate y regulación .
✔ Experiencia brindando asesoramiento jurídico al negocio y participando en nuevos productos, servicios, alianzas y proyectos estratégicos .
✔ Capacidad para identificar y gestionar riesgos regulatorios y contractuales, con una mirada práctica y orientada al negocio.
✔ Inglés B2 o superior .
✔ Perfil autónomo, resolutivo, con criterio jurídico, capacidad de negociación y excelentes habilidades interpersonales.

📍 Lugar: CABA, Buenos Aires

Si tenés experiencia en Derecho Empresarial, Contractual y Corporate y te interesa asumir un desafío con alta exposición al negocio dentro de una compañía multinacional, ¡postulate!

postings.title: Analista de Investigación y Desarrollo
postings.descriptionText:
Analista de INvestigación y Desarrollo, planta Pilar.

Ejecutar las investigaciones y el desarrollo de los productos que la compañía requiera, respetando la normativa vigente, para acompañar el crecimiento sostenido de Gador.

Requisitos

Desarrollar y poner a punto los procesos de síntesis para la obtención de ingredientes farmacéuticos activos (IFA) y/o diferentes fases sólidas de una misma droga, incluyendo la determinación de variables y etapas críticas de los procesos de síntesis y/o purificación.

• Desarrollar el escalado de los procesos hasta la transferencia a los sectores de Planta Piloto y/o Producción según corresponda.

• Realizar los ensayos que permitan la evaluación de proveedores alternativos de materias primas.

• Dar soporte al Sector de producción ante dificultades en el proceso productivo, realizando acciones dentro del laboratorio que permitan investigar las causas y/o aportar información al proceso.

• Participar en las mejoras de proceso para proyectos ya transferidos que tengan un impacto en el negocio, ya sea económico, regulatorio o de seguridad.

• Confeccionar y actualizar toda la información requerida para la transferencia de productos a Planta Piloto y Producción.

• Producir estándares y confeccionar la documentación asociada para dar respuesta a las necesidades de los demás sectores.

Job Purpose And Impact

As part of the Global Learning & Development team, this role will contribute to developing leadership capabilities across Cargill. The focus is on strengthening leaders at all levels, ensuring they have the skills to perform in their current role, and prepare for what’s next.This role will design, implement and manage scalable core and common leadership development programs as part of Cargill Leadership Academy. Programs are rooted in Cargill’s Strategy, Values and Behaviors, Common Competencies, Cargill Capabilities and then differentiated based on the needs of each level of leader, and enabled through assessments and coaching. The position will partner closely with HR Business Partners, Senior Leadership, Talent and Development and HR Operations to assess leadership needs, design fit-for-purpose programming, implement at scale, facilitate programming, and manage and measure the programs. As a recognized partner in Leadership Development and Learning and Development Design, this job works closely with key business and HR stakeholders to consult on leadership needs and conduct needs analysis, translating skill needs into learning experiences that drive performance outcomes. This job partners with internal capability owners, and applies own knowledge of leadership assessment, coaching, program design and delivery, and evaluation to own Leadership Development programming and solutions end-to-end. This role facilitates virtual and in person leadership programs and manages professional services that support Cargill Leadership Academy programs broadly, and/or within a specific region or audience.

This position can be based in São Paulo-Brazil, Heredia-Costa Rica or Buenos Aires-Argentina.

Key Accountabilities

• PROGRAM DEVELOPMENT: Guides the design and development of Leadership Development learning experiences for the organization, ensuring the programs drive performance impact and are aligned with the organization’s talent practices and company strategy. Redesigns existing offers by identifying and analyzing performance impacts, and incorporating improvements.

• PROGRAM IMPLEMENTATION: Develops implementation plans that ensure consistent and scalable delivery of Leadership Development programs, and coordinates with HR Business Partners, Senior Leaders and HR Operations to deliver communication and execute program logistics for in-person and virtual offerings. Facilitates in-person and virtual programs.

• PROGRAM ADMINISTRATION: Partners with HR Operations to plan and manage the logistical elements of each program. This includes course calendar creation, scheduling management, participant communication, assessment administration and coach and facilitator management.

• LEARNING EXPERIENCE DEVELOPMENT: In partnership with Talent Management, Talent Leads and L&D Design Team, ensures application of instructional design principles and leadership development methodologies to create engaging and interactive learning experiences, in alignment with people processes and talent strategies. Reviews analysis of learning needs, approves appropriate instructional strategies, and ensures content and programs are designed in manner that will achieve the desired performance outcomes.

• STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT: Partners collaboratively with HR Business partners and other subject matter experts and stakeholders to provide thought leadership on content and materials. May consult on unique needs and curate or create materials for Senior Leaders and HR Business Partners.

• PROGRAM ANALYSIS: Evaluates the effectiveness of leadership development solutions through analysis of program survey feedback and business metrics and identifies opportunities to improve impact and effectiveness. Delivers insights from this analysis to critical partners.

• VENDOR MANAGEMENT: Manages the relationship and oversight of key professional service providers to enable Leadership Development programs within specific scope, holding them accountable to delivering on their program accountability and annual goals. Stays updated on the latest leadership development methodologies, technologies, tools and design strategies, and identifies opportunities to integrate within programming.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

• Previous experience in leadership development, talent development, learning and development, organizational development, or related.

• Demonstrated knowledge of leadership development methodologies, leadership assessments, performance coaching and adult learning principles.

• Excellent communication, facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills.

• Strong project management capabilities and comfortable working in matrixed or global organizations.

• Demonstrated expertise managing the complete ADDIE process for complex leadership development programs.

• Experience designing and delivering leadership programs for multiple leadership levels, including senior leaders, globally.

• Strong facilitation skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences.

• Experience evaluating learning effectiveness and using data to drive continuous improvement.

• Able to communicate in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

Preferred Qualifications

• Leadership coaching certification (ICF, Co-Active, Hudson, Korn Ferry, or equivalent).

• Certification in leadership assessment tools such as Hogan, Korn Ferry, DiSC, MBTI, EQ assessments, 360 assessments, or similar instruments.

• Certifications in instructional design, talent development, or organizational development.

• Experience supporting executive leadership development and succession planning initiatives, including the development of Acceleration Programs.

• Experience leveraging learning technologies and digital learning platforms.

The Chemical Specialist is responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing chemical treatment and corrosion control programs that support safe, reliable, and efficient operations. This role provides technical expertise in production chemistry, corrosion management, facility treatment systems, and process optimization while working closely with operations, laboratories, and service providers to improve performance and reduce operating costs.

Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to:

• Design, manage, and implement chemical treatment and corrosion control strategies, including chemical treatment, corrosion monitoring and inspection activities, as well as the preparation and delivery of reports and the identification and assessment of significant trends.

• Provide technical assessment and interpretation of chemical treatment monitoring data and recommend changes to corrosion criticality analyses and monitoring/inspection programs (chemical treatment, reservoir souring, corrosion, materials, coating applications, and cathodic protection). Utilize NACE, EPTC, API, ASTM, AISI, AWS, SSCP, and other Oil & Gas industry standards.

• Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for water, oil, and gas treatment facilities and chemical treatment services in El Trapial Field to improve Operational Excellence (OE), production, reliability, efficiency, and cost performance.

• Lead OE execution in the field, with a strong focus on safety, ensuring every activity is performed in accordance with process safety and HSE standards.

• Prepare forecasts and perform monthly tracking of operating costs and facility improvements related to the transportation, dosing, and storage of chemical products in the field.

• Propose and lead medium- and long-term optimization initiatives focused on reliability, integrity, operational efficiency, and reduction of total treatment costs.

• Identify, evaluate, and propose new technologies.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Petroleum, Chemical, or Industrial Engineering.

• Minimum of 5 years of proven experience in chemical treatment and corrosion control strategies, including monitoring, inspection, and implementation activities.

• During the rotation, the selected candidate will stay at the Chevron Camp.

International Considerations

Expatriate assignments will not be considered.

Ofrecemos

¿Qué traerás?

Software, Procesos y Herramientas

• Experiencia en la preparación, revisión, presentación y mantenimiento de dossiers y documentación técnico-regulatoria.

• Capacidad para interpretar regulaciones, guías técnicas, documentación legal y documentos de ingeniería.

• Experiencia en contextos multiculturales y/o con comunidades indígenas (deseable).

• Conocimiento sólido del marco regulatorio ambiental y de O&G argentino: Ley General del Ambiente (25.675), ENARGAS, Ley de Residuos Peligrosos (24.051), normativa provincial de Río Negro.

• Conocimiento de ISO 14001, IFC Performance Standards.

• Muy buenas habilidades de redacción, revisión y edición de documentos técnicos, regulatorios y legales.

• Manejo de herramientas de permit tracking, MS Project y paquete Office avanzado.

• Español nativo.

• Inglés avanzado

Competencias valoradas

• Autonomía, proactividad y capacidad de organización.

• Capacidad para mantener documentación completa, ordenada, actualizada y trazable.

• Capacidad para comunicar información técnica de manera clara, precisa y ejecutiva.

• Buenas habilidades de comunicación, negociación y coordinación con equipos internos y actores externos.

• Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma y, al mismo tiempo, integrarse eficazmente en equipos multidisciplinarios.

Avanzando juntos

Estamos comprometidos a construir un lugar de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso donde todos sientan que pertenecen, puedan hablar y ser escuchados. Brindamos igualdad de oportunidades de empleo a todos los solicitantes y empleados calificados sin importar edad, raza, credo, color, religión, sexo, origen nacional, ascendencia, estado de discapacidad, estado de veterano, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, información genética, estado civil. estatus, estatus de ciudadanía o cualquier otra base protegida por la ley.

Queremos que nuestra gente esté llena de energía y poder para impulsar un impacto sostenible. Por eso, nos centramos en una cultura inspirada en valores que genere brillantez a través de la pertenencia, la conexión y la innovación.

Estamos construyendo un lugar de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso. Crear un espacio donde todos sientan que pertenecen, puedan ser ellos mismos y ser escuchados.

Y no estamos hablando sólo de eso; lo estamos haciendo. Estamos recapacitando a nuestra gente, aprovechando habilidades transferibles y apoyando la transición de nuestra fuerza laboral para convertirse en expertos en la infraestructura y tecnología de energía baja en carbono de hoy.

Cualquiera que sea tu ambición, aquí hay un camino para ti. Y no existe ninguna barrera para el posible éxito profesional. Únase a nosotros para ampliar sus horizontes, explorar diversas oportunidades y ser parte del logro de un cambio sostenible.

postings.title: Remote Clinical Support Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Most remote healthcare roles put you behind a queue — answering calls, moving messages, and working through a checklist without ever really becoming part of the clinical team.

This role is different.

Genesis is looking for a Remote Clinical Support Specialist who will work directly alongside our clinicians throughout the day. You'll be embedded in the clinical workflow — interpreting for patients in real time, supporting a provider with documentation, managing incoming voicemail communication, and helping make sure the small things that keep patient care moving actually get done.

You're remote. But you're part of the clinic.

The Work

This is a hands-on remote clinical support role. Your day will move with the clinic, and priorities will shift based on what our clinicians and patients need.

• On-demand interpretation — provide real-time Spanish/English interpretation for clinicians and patients during office hours

• Dedicated scribe support — work directly with a solo provider to document patient encounters accurately and efficiently

• Epic documentation — create and update telephone encounters, document communication, and support clinical workflows directly within Epic

• Inbound voicemail management — listen to patient voicemails and accurately transcribe them into Epic telephone encounters for the appropriate clinical team

• Provider-directed patient outreach — make limited outbound calls to patients when requested by a clinician and document the communication appropriately

The goal is simple: make it easier for clinicians to take care of patients.

You'll help remove documentation and communication work from the clinical team while making sure patients — especially our Spanish-speaking patients — can communicate clearly with the people taking care of them.

The Stack

• Remote position

• Work performed during Genesis clinic/office hours

• EMR: Epic

• Spanish/English fluency required

• Previous healthcare experience strongly preferred

• Medical terminology and clinical documentation experience preferred

• Medical scribe, medical assistant, interpreter, or similar clinical experience preferred

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

• You're fluent in English and Spanish and can move comfortably between both languages in a healthcare setting

• You know Epic. You understand how clinical documentation works, how telephone encounters move through a practice, and why getting the details right matters

• You're fast without being careless. You can listen to a voicemail, understand what matters, document it clearly, and route it appropriately

• You can keep up with a busy clinic. One minute you may be interpreting for a clinician, the next you're documenting an encounter or entering a patient message. You know how to prioritize without needing someone to constantly manage your day

• Most importantly, you understand that being remote doesn't mean being disconnected. You're part of the clinical team, and you take ownership like you're sitting in the clinic with them

Benefits

About Genesis

Genesis Orthopedics & Sports Medicine is a full-spectrum MSK platform — surgery, physical therapy, and everything between — built on a single conviction: that world-class orthopedic care should be accessible to everyone, not just the patients with the right insurance card.

We operate 16 clinics across Chicagoland, run clinical trials, and have built a care delivery model that serves Medicaid patients at scale without compromising on quality. The care we deliver is good enough for anyone. We've made it accessible to everyone.

That model only works when clinicians have the support to focus on what matters most: taking care of patients.

This role helps make that possible.

If you're looking for a remote healthcare role where you're actually embedded in patient care — not just working through a queue — we want to talk.
