postings.title: Manager, SMB Sales
postings.descriptionText:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Toptal’s inbound sales team is a driving force behind our growth, converting inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. As Manager, SMB Sales, you will lead a team of Client Advisors, coaching them towards growth and holding them to a high standard of excellence in a high-velocity, consultative selling role. You will keep the team responsive to new inquiries while ensuring active opportunities continue to move. You will coach advisors through stalled decisions, specialist involvement, and client follow-up, stepping in where your judgement can help secure the next commitment. You will lead a team that is responsible for executing strong discovery, disciplined qualification, portfolio selling across Toptal’s full offering with complete ownership of the client relationship from first conversation through close. Your team’s job is to position Toptal as a strategic services partner, not a single-transaction talent vendor, and you set that standard.

You will be accountable for improving conversion of inbound leads by identifying conversion leakage, bringing accountability to individuals’ performance, hiring Client Advisors with consultative potential, reviewing calls, demonstrating stronger approaches, and coaching each advisor on changes to improve their sales skill and industry knowledge. Internally, this position works closely with leadership across Client Services, Talent Operations, Client Experience, and People to support a team-based approach to best-in-class service.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by team success, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about what makes a sales team excellent. If you want to sharpen a team’s performance and be recognized for the results, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

• Coach: Coach Client Advisors on discovery, qualification, portfolio selling, and deal management. Demonstrate how to bring a useful point of view, support recommendations with relevant proof points, address concerns, and ask for commitment.

• Develop: Review live and recorded calls, examine active opportunities, and identify specific changes that will improve each Client Advisor’s results. Run focused role-plays, demonstrate stronger approaches, and give clear, actionable feedback.

• Hire and Build: Recruit and interview Client Advisors against our Client Advisor Core Competencies, hiring for consultative potential - curiosity, business acumen, and coachability - as well as sales experience.

• Playbook Ownership: Own and continuously refine the Client Advisor inbound playbook, using call audit findings and conversion data to keep it current and effective.

• Manage Performance: Understand causes of underperformance and agree specific corrective actions and timelines with Client Advisors. Demonstrate sustained improvement in team conversion and sales performance, supported by stronger discovery, qualification, follow-through, and portfolio expansion.

• Onboard and Ramp: Manage onboarding for new Client Advisors, ensuring they complete sales training and assessing each new advisor against the skill-based Client Advisor ramp milestones — running discovery unaided, qualifying a live opportunity, surfacing needs beyond the initial request — on the path to independent, quota-carrying performance.

• Career Development: Support career development and succession planning for Client Advisors, including the path into leadership.

• Pipeline Oversight: Challenge the evidence behind each Client Advisor’s view of an opportunity: why it may proceed, what remains unresolved, when decisions are likely, and use that judgment to improve qualification and prioritize support, and strengthen forecasting discipline..

• Operational Excellence: Identify process improvements that increase Client Advisor efficiency, productivity, and scalability.

• Cross-Functional Partnership: Work seamlessly with cross-functional partners that include, but are not limited to: Client Services, Talent Operations, Client Experience, and People leadership. Additionally, be able to bring in the right specialists (matching, delivery, HireGlobal, service-offering experts) at the right time.

• Reporting: Deliver presentations to cross-departmental partners covering metrics, key takeaways, and action plans based on data analysis.

• Motivation and Recognition: Motivate the team through recognition, incentives, and transparent communication of expectations and results.

• Culture: Drive a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team — including a learn-it-all habit of self and peer call review, and a library of strong calls that show the standard.

In the first week, expect to:

• Onboard and integrate into Toptal leadership.

• Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.

• Become acquainted with the team members who will report to you.

In the first month, expect to:

• Complete Toptal’s leadership/sales training program and build a deep understanding of who our clients are and how Client Advisors sell across our full portfolio.

• Understand your team and their current performance levels, the SMB Sales Leadership and expectations, and identify the main causes of conversion leakage.

• Begin 1-1 coaching with each team member based on ongoing live and recorded call reviews.

In the first three months, expect to:

• Develop and roll out your strategy to increase team performance and productivity, with individual goals set for each team member.

• Run consistent coaching and opportunity-review cadences with specific improvement priorities for each Client Advisor.

• Deliver your first cross-departmental presentation covering metrics, key takeaways, and action plans.

In the first six months, expect to:

• Demonstrate measurable commercial improvement in conversion and sales performance from Client Advisors being coached, supported by stronger call quality scores, opportunity progression, and qualified HireGlobal and services opportunities.

• Regularly assess performance against KPIs, partnering with sales enablement and operations to continuously improve.

• Continue building, coaching, and mentoring your team toward greater results.

In the first year, expect to:

• Run an optimized, well-managed inbound sales function that maximizes Toptal’s ability to capture SMB market demand profitably.

• Develop senior Client Advisors who mentor new team members and serve as reference points on discovery quality and portfolio positioning.

• Sustain a culture of high performance, continuous improvement, and record-breaking results and client experiences.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree required.

• Three or more years in business-to-business sales, featuring one to two years direct leadership of inbound, inside, or end-to-end small business sales teams.

• Demonstrated record of improving individual and team sales performance through specific coaching, disciplined opportunity management, and clear performance expectations. Ability to learn and coach to a structured sales methodology.

• Experience managing pipeline and forecast rigor across a team in a CRM. Genuine, demonstrable passion for AI in the world of work, including using AI to improve how a sales team researches, reviews calls, and coaches.

• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting metrics and strategy to cross-departmental partners.

• Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with evolving processes and priorities.

• Full availability during working hours to support your team and step into client escalations as needed.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

• You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience leading a team that sells more than one product or service line into the same account (portfolio selling).

• Experience with a named sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar).

• Software, tech, or professional-services sales leadership experience.

• Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted call review, conversation intelligence, and CRM workflows.

Core Competencies

These are the skills we evaluate during interviews and continue to develop with you after you join.

• Consultative sales mastery. You can run and model an excellent discovery call yourself — open-ended discovery, disciplined qualification, and a dated, named next step — and show your team what good looks like.

• Coach-first leadership. You develop people through call review, role-play, and specific feedback, not just dashboards. Your team gets better because you are in the details with them.

• Talent judgment. You can spot curiosity, business acumen, and coachability in an interview, and you can tell real potential from polish.

• Insight-led selling. You can teach Client Advisors to bring a point of view, reframe a client’s thinking when needed, and position Toptal as a strategic services partner rather than a talent marketplace.

• Accountable. You take ownership of your team’s results and hold your team accountable to raising their own bar.

• Critical thinker. Strong analytical and problem-resolution skills, with a demonstrated ability to develop data-driven solutions.

• Proactive, collaborative communicator. You drive toward the mission without being told, and you communicate clearly across your team, cross-functional partners, and clients essential in our remote environment.

For Toptal Use Only: #northamerica #southamerica #centralamerica

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:
Toptal’s inbound sales team is a driving force behind our growth, converting inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. As Manager, SMB Sales, you will lead a team of Client Advisors, coaching them towards growth and holding them to a high standard of excellence in a high-velocity, consultative selling role. You will keep the team responsive to new inquiries while ensuring active opportunities continue to move. You will coach advisors through stalled decisions, specialist involvement, and client follow-up, stepping in where your judgement can help secure the next commitment. You will lead a team that is responsible for executing strong discovery, disciplined qualification, portfolio selling across Toptal’s full offering with complete ownership of the client relationship from first conversation through close. Your team’s job is to position Toptal as a strategic services partner, not a single-transaction talent vendor, and you set that standard.

You will be accountable for improving conversion of inbound leads by identifying conversion leakage, bringing accountability to individuals’ performance, hiring Client Advisors with consultative potential, reviewing calls, demonstrating stronger approaches, and coaching each advisor on changes to improve their sales skill and industry knowledge. Internally, this position works closely with leadership across Client Services, Talent Operations, Client Experience, and People to support a team-based approach to best-in-class service.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by team success, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about what makes a sales team excellent. If you want to sharpen a team’s performance and be recognized for the results, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

• Coach: Coach Client Advisors on discovery, qualification, portfolio selling, and deal management. Demonstrate how to bring a useful point of view, support recommendations with relevant proof points, address concerns, and ask for commitment.

• Develop: Review live and recorded calls, examine active opportunities, and identify specific changes that will improve each Client Advisor’s results. Run focused role-plays, demonstrate stronger approaches, and give clear, actionable feedback.

• Hire and Build: Recruit and interview Client Advisors against our Client Advisor Core Competencies, hiring for consultative potential - curiosity, business acumen, and coachability - as well as sales experience.

• Playbook Ownership: Own and continuously refine the Client Advisor inbound playbook, using call audit findings and conversion data to keep it current and effective.

• Manage Performance: Understand causes of underperformance and agree specific corrective actions and timelines with Client Advisors. Demonstrate sustained improvement in team conversion and sales performance, supported by stronger discovery, qualification, follow-through, and portfolio expansion.

• Onboard and Ramp: Manage onboarding for new Client Advisors, ensuring they complete sales training and assessing each new advisor against the skill-based Client Advisor ramp milestones — running discovery unaided, qualifying a live opportunity, surfacing needs beyond the initial request — on the path to independent, quota-carrying performance.

• Career Development: Support career development and succession planning for Client Advisors, including the path into leadership.

• Pipeline Oversight: Challenge the evidence behind each Client Advisor’s view of an opportunity: why it may proceed, what remains unresolved, when decisions are likely, and use that judgment to improve qualification and prioritize support, and strengthen forecasting discipline..

• Operational Excellence: Identify process improvements that increase Client Advisor efficiency, productivity, and scalability.

• Cross-Functional Partnership: Work seamlessly with cross-functional partners that include, but are not limited to: Client Services, Talent Operations, Client Experience, and People leadership. Additionally, be able to bring in the right specialists (matching, delivery, HireGlobal, service-offering experts) at the right time.

• Reporting: Deliver presentations to cross-departmental partners covering metrics, key takeaways, and action plans based on data analysis.

• Motivation and Recognition: Motivate the team through recognition, incentives, and transparent communication of expectations and results.

• Culture: Drive a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team — including a learn-it-all habit of self and peer call review, and a library of strong calls that show the standard.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree required.

• Three or more years in business-to-business sales, featuring one to two years direct leadership of inbound, inside, or end-to-end small business sales teams.

• Demonstrated record of improving individual and team sales performance through specific coaching, disciplined opportunity management, and clear performance expectations. Ability to learn and coach to a structured sales methodology.

• Experience managing pipeline and forecast rigor across a team in a CRM. Genuine, demonstrable passion for AI in the world of work, including using AI to improve how a sales team researches, reviews calls, and coaches.

• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting metrics and strategy to cross-departmental partners.

• Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with evolving processes and priorities.

• Full availability during working hours to support your team and step into client escalations as needed.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

• You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience leading a team that sells more than one product or service line into the same account (portfolio selling).

• Experience with a named sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar).

• Software, tech, or professional-services sales leadership experience.

• Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted call review, conversation intelligence, and CRM workflows.

Core Competencies
These are the skills we evaluate during interviews and continue to develop with you after you join.

• Consultative sales mastery. You can run and model an excellent discovery call yourself — open-ended discovery, disciplined qualification, and a dated, named next step — and show your team what good looks like.

• Coach-first leadership. You develop people through call review, role-play, and specific feedback, not just dashboards. Your team gets better because you are in the details with them.

• Talent judgment. You can spot curiosity, business acumen, and coachability in an interview, and you can tell real potential from polish.

• Insight-led selling. You can teach Client Advisors to bring a point of view, reframe a client’s thinking when needed, and position Toptal as a strategic services partner rather than a talent marketplace.

• Accountable. You take ownership of your team’s results and hold your team accountable to raising their own bar.

• Critical thinker. Strong analytical and problem-resolution skills, with a demonstrated ability to develop data-driven solutions.

• Proactive, collaborative communicator. You drive toward the mission without being told, and you communicate clearly across your team, cross-functional partners, and clients essential in our remote environment.

postings.title: Telco Field Engineering Director
postings.descriptionText:
This is an opportunity to run the worldwide Telco Field Engineering business, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions in public clouds and in their own data centers. We work across the entire spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu itself to virtualisation and private cloud, Kubernetes, and the implementation of sophisticated open source solutions such as MLops platforms, data platforms and more. The Telco department is composed of three regional teams (APAC, EMEA and AMER).

We believe that Engineering Directors should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should feel completely at home troubleshooting technical issues and having technical presales conversations with customers. They should contribute to project delivery themselves, but know that the technical contributions they bring are far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team’s direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers, who are interested in soft skills, to be managers.

We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.

The role of a Telco Field Engineering Director at Canonical

The Field Engineering department is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc. The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process.

Within the Field Engineering department, there are multiple focused teams : the Cloud/DC team, the Alliances/Partners team, the IoT team, and the Telco team.

The telco industry is moving to software-defined services. This transformation is driven by open source software, cloud computing and the move to VNF / CNF approaches. Canonical Ubuntu is a key platform for telco innovation, and we are growing our team of specialists who work in the industry to accelerate the change.

Canonical enables operators and communications service providers to embrace this new world, with a focus on platforms such as Ubuntu, OpenStack, and Kubernetes, and reusable, high quality automation for operations at scale.

A Cloud Field Engineering Director is responsible for driving the strategy in presales and delivery for our telco customers. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals.

Location: This role will be home based, managing teams in worldwide.

What Your Day Will Look Like

• Lead and develop managers and teams of Field engineers in the areas of Presales and Professional Services

• Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor

• Work remotely in a single major time zone

• Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback

• Identify and measure team health indicators

• Implement disciplined engineering processes

• Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers

• Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices

• Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects

• Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

What We Are Looking For In You

• A thorough technical understanding of the telco NFVi (VIM), NFVO, VNFM and MEC space and key telco cloud infrastructure technologies like CPU Pinning, NUMA, SR-IOV, DPDK, etc Familiarity with telco architecture and industry standards Working knowledge of at least one of the following domains: Mobile Packet Core (4G/5G), Private Network, Radio Access Network (RAN), Voice, IP Backbone, VAS or OSS/BSS

• Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies, such as Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph, etc.

• Practical knowledge of Linux and networking

• Experience in technical presales

• You are a dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

• Passion and a track record of developing and growing people

• Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring engineers and managers

• Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results

• An exceptional academic track record from high school and, preferably, university as well

• Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time. Field Engineers attend internal company events, external tech events and customer meetings.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

• Second language - Spanish or French preferred

• Python knowledge

• Experience collaborating with external partners

• Experience collaborating with several internal teams and providing stakeholder feedback for engineering roadmaps

• Understanding of AI and machine learning concepts, including sovereign AI, and their potential applications in telco environments, such as network optimization, predictive maintenance, unified communication, and customer experience improvement

• Exposure to frameworks such as 3GPP, TM Forum ODA, eTOM, ETSI NFV, ONAP, O-RAN, or similar is a plus

What We Offer You

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Employee Assistance Programme

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others

• Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: RFP & Proposal Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Job title: RFP & Proposal Specialist | Remote Contractor | Argentina

About Hauler Hero
Hauler Hero is building the operating system for residential and commercial waste haulers across the United States. Our platform brings dispatch, routing, billing, payments, customer management, reporting, and driver operations into one modern system.
We are looking for a detail-oriented, highly organized RFP & Proposal Specialist to help us win municipal, government, enterprise, and private-sector opportunities.

The role
You will support the full proposal process: finding relevant opportunities, registering the company on procurement portals, assessing RFP fit, coordinating internal contributors, drafting strong responses, and ensuring complete submissions are delivered on time.
This is not a copy-and-paste proposal role. You will turn complex product, technical, operational, and customer information into clear, compliant, persuasive proposals tailored to each buyer.
You will work closely with U.S.-based Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Operations, and leadership. Excellent written and spoken English is essential.
What you’ll own

• Monitor municipal, state, federal, cooperative purchasing, and private procurement portals for relevant RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and vendor opportunities.

• Assess opportunities based on fit, eligibility requirements, deadlines, evaluation criteria, contract terms, and strategic value.

• Maintain a clear pipeline of upcoming, active, submitted, and awarded opportunities.

• Manage procurement-portal registrations, company profiles, compliance requirements, renewals, documents, and credentials.

• Coordinate proposal timelines, internal owners, response inputs, reviews, attachments, and final submissions.

• Draft and edit compelling responses about Hauler Hero’s product, implementation, customer support, integrations, security, reporting, and industry experience.

• Ensure submissions meet every requirement for formatting, compliance, attachments, and deadlines.

• Build and maintain a reusable RFP content library with approved responses, product language, customer examples, technical answers, and standard documentation.

What we’re looking for

• 2–5 years of experience in proposal writing, RFP coordination, sales enablement, procurement support, business development, legal operations, or a related role.

• Excellent written English with the ability to write clearly, professionally, and persuasively.

• Strong spoken English and confidence collaborating with U.S.-based teams.

• Experience managing multiple deadlines, stakeholders, documents, and review cycles.

• Exceptional attention to detail around compliance, formatting, attachments, and submission instructions.

• Ability to translate technical or operational information into clear, buyer-friendly business language.

• Strong follow-up discipline and the confidence to keep busy stakeholders on track.

• Based in Argentina, with reliable internet and availability during core U.S. business hours.

Nice to have

• Experience with municipal, state, federal, or enterprise RFPs in the United States.

• Experience in SaaS, GovTech, logistics, transportation, field services, public works, waste, or recycling.

• Familiarity with procurement platforms such as SAM.gov, GovWin, Bonfire, PlanetBids, BidNet, OpenGov, Loopio, or Responsive/RFPIO.

• Experience with HubSpot, Notion, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, or AI-assisted writing tools.

• Legal, paralegal, contract administration, or vendor-compliance experience.

Compensation and work style

• Remote contractor role, based in Argentina.

• Full-time.

• Approximately USD 4,650 per month, paid in USD.

• Final offer depends on experience and interview performance.

How to apply
Please apply with your CV in English and include:

• The type of RFPs or proposals you have worked on.

• An example of how you managed a complex proposal deadline or multi-stakeholder submission.

• Your English level and availability during U.S. business hours.

DOCA es una firma española especializada en mobiliario de cocinas, vestidores y espacios interiores de alta gama. Su propuesta combina la tradición de la ebanistería con tecnología de vanguardia, materiales de primera calidad y una amplia capacidad de personalización.

ESTA BUSQUEDA ES PARA VOS SI:

• Tenés un interés genuino por el mundo del diseño . Te gusta mantenerte actualizado, seguir de cerca las tendencias, las novedades del sector y las principales marcas internacionales.

postings.descriptionText:
Are you passionate about reservoir engineering, technical consulting, and delivering high-impact solutions for complex reservoir challenges?

Do you enjoy leading multidisciplinary projects, advising clients, and influencing technical strategies across the energy industry?

Join our team! At Baker Hughes, we are transforming the future of energy through advanced technology, engineering expertise, and world-class consulting services. Our GaffneyCline energy advisory team supports clients around the globe by delivering innovative reservoir engineering solutions, strategic insights, and operational excellence that help maximize asset value throughout the energy lifecycle.

Partner with the best Our team is committed to providing advanced reservoir engineering expertise and ensuring operational excellence across global projects. This role demands deep technical knowledge, strong leadership, and the ability to mentor and influence across multiple disciplines. As a Senior Principal Reservoir Engineer in Argentina, Brazil or Mexico , you will act as a technical expert for reservoir engineering consulting projects and coordinate communication between clients and the GaffneyCline energy advisory Latin America team. You’ll lead reservoir engineering studies, manage technical work across disciplines, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality reports and presentations. You will also support business development by providing technical and commercial input for proposals and preparing presentations for external clients.

As a Senior Principal Reservoir Engineer, you will be responsible for:

• Providing reservoir engineering input to multi-disciplinary projects, including field development planning, reservoir performance analysis, and reserves estimation and auditing.

• Conducting reservoir engineering studies using state-of-the-art techniques such as reservoir simulation, material balance, decline curve analysis, well test analysis, and PVT/SCAL data analysis.

• Advising clients on reservoir engineering matters, reserves and resources evaluation, and reporting methodology.

• Managing projects, performing peer reviews, and acting as the principal point of contact for clients, ensuring routine follow-up and project delivery.

• Contributing to business development activities and leading technical input for client proposals.

• Acting as region focal point for development, implementation, or optimization of deliverables, services, technologies, workflows, or processes.

• Representing GCea externally through technical publications and participation in industry organizations.

• Mentoring and developing junior staff members.

• Ensuring compliance with GCea procedures, business, and quality management systems.

Fuel your passion To be successful in this role, you should:

• Hold a Petroleum Engineering degree with at least 15 years of industry experience, including 7 years with an oil and gas operator.

• Possess proficiency in discipline-related software such as PETREL, ECLIPSE, T Navigator, and CMG; JewelSuite subsurface modeling skills are a plus.

• Demonstrate strong knowledge of reservoir engineering topics and the ability to engage clients on discipline applications.

• Have experience across multiple regional petroleum basins and understand geological settings and reservoir complexities.

• Demonstrate full professional proficiency in both Spanish and English.

Desired Characteristics

• Strong oral and written communication skills.

• Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.

• Ability to analyze and resolve problems effectively.

• Demonstrated ability to lead programs and projects.

• Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.

• Established project management skills.

Work in a way that works for you We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. Please discuss your preferred working patterns with the recruiter during the hiring process.

Working with us Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

• Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities.

• Comprehensive private medical care options.

• Safety net of life insurance and disability programs.

• Tailored financial programs.

• Additional elected or voluntary benefits.

About Us With operations in over 120 countries, we provide better solutions for our customers and richer opportunities for our people. As a leading partner to the energy industry, we're committed to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 and we're always looking for the right people to help us get there. People who are as passionate as we are about making energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient.

Join Us Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real impact as a recognized reservoir engineering expert while helping clients solve some of the industry's most complex reservoir challenges? Come join us and grow with a team of people who will energize and inspire you!

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Senior Principal, Geoscience & Petroleum, Disciplinary Engineering and Science

About Us:

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Join Us:

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

postings.title: Databricks Presales Consultant
postings.descriptionText:
Databricks Presales Consultant

Location: Santiago, Chile | 100% On-site | Relocation Required

About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Databricks Presales Consultant to strengthen our Data & AI capabilities and support business growth across the region.

This role is designed for a professional who combines deep technical expertise in the Databricks ecosystem with strong commercial acumen, consultative selling skills, and the ability to translate complex data challenges into valuable business solutions.

You will work closely with our commercial and technical teams to identify opportunities, engage with clients, design solution architectures, and lead presales activities that demonstrate the business value of Databricks-based solutions.

Important: This position is based in Santiago, Chile, and requires 100% on-site work. Candidates currently based in Buenos Aires, Bogotá, or other locations must be willing to relocate to Santiago.

Key Responsibilities

• Technical Presales: Lead technical discovery sessions, understand client requirements, and design Databricks-based solutions aligned with business needs.

• Solution Architecture: Develop high-level architectures and proposals for data engineering, analytics, data platforms, and AI use cases leveraging Databricks.

• Client Engagement: Present technical solutions, conduct product demonstrations, lead workshops, and communicate complex concepts to both technical and executive stakeholders.

• Commercial Support: Partner with sales teams to identify business opportunities, qualify leads, develop value propositions, and contribute to proposals and commercial presentations.

• Proof of Concepts: Define and support proof-of-concept initiatives to demonstrate technical feasibility, business value, and solution differentiation.

• Opportunity Development: Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts and develop new business through data and AI solutions.

• Partner Ecosystem: Maintain strong knowledge of Databricks capabilities, product evolution, certifications, and best practices to strengthen our market positioning.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field , with a strong technical foundation.

• Extensive professional experience in the data ecosystem , including data engineering, modern data platforms, cloud data architectures, analytics, and enterprise data solutions.

• Strong hands-on knowledge of the Databricks platform , including its architecture, core capabilities, and enterprise use cases.

• Relevant, active Databricks certifications demonstrating technical proficiency in the platform. Professional-level certifications are highly desirable.

• Proven experience in technical presales, solution consulting, data architecture, or a comparable client-facing technical role.

• Strong commercial mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs, articulate business value, and support the development of sales opportunities.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage technical teams, business leaders, and C-level stakeholders.

• Experience working with consulting firms, technology services providers, or systems integrators is strongly preferred.

• Ability to work collaboratively across commercial, technical, and delivery teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience designing and positioning enterprise-scale data and AI solutions.

• Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

• Experience with data modernization, lakehouse architectures, data governance, and AI/ML workloads.

• Previous involvement in RFPs, technical proposals, solution estimations, and client presentations.

• A track record of contributing to business development and closing technology services opportunities.

What We Are Looking For
We are looking for someone who can bridge the gap between technology and business: a professional who understands Databricks beyond its features, can confidently discuss architecture and implementation with technical teams, and can explain to decision-makers why a solution matters to their business.

The ideal candidate combines technical credibility, consulting experience, and commercial drive . Someone who can lead a technical conversation, build client confidence, and help transform data capabilities into tangible business opportunities.

Location & Relocation

• Work location: Santiago, Chile.

• Work model: 100% on-site.

• Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate to Santiago and work on-site on a full-time basis.

• Candidates based in Buenos Aires, Bogotá, or elsewhere in Latin America are welcome to apply, provided they meet the relocation requirement.

If you are passionate about data platforms, Databricks, and helping organizations turn data into business value, we would like to hear from you.

Apply now and help us build the next generation of enterprise Data & AI solutions.

postings.title: Customer Support & Field Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

The Customer Support & Field Engineers are part of the post-sales team within the Services organization. The team is responsible for designing and guiding the technical implementation of government and commercial communications system solutions, leveraging new technologies and approaches sourced from both inside and outside of Motorola Solutions.

Job Description

The Customer Support & Field Engineer role will form part of multi-disciplined project teams to design and deliver complex mission critical voice and data systems. The systems may be used directly by our customers or by Motorola Solutions to deliver Managed Services to our customers. The Customer Support & Field Engineers will work in the post sales phases of projects and may support multiple projects in a given period depending on size and complexity. There may also be a requirement to provide support to pre-sales activities.

The Customer Support & Field Engineer role can operate at different levels within the organization and/or projects. The level of the role will be determined by the size and complexity of the project or activity as well as the level of the individual within the organization. The Customer Support & Field Engineering role can be fulfilled at any level within the TS career ladder, however, engineering staff at junior level will focus on smaller projects or elements of larger projects with a higher level of supervision.

Depending on the project scope, a Customer Support & Field Engineer may take a technical lead role responsible for overall deployment, test and handover. Alternatively, the Customer Support & Field Engineer role might specialize in a particular area or sub-system based on their skills and experience.

The Customer Support & Field Engineer role may also fulfill the role of a Subject Matter Expert (SME) supporting projects and opportunities across the wider region.

Responsibilities

The scope of responsibility for a Customer Support & Field Engineer will be determined by their seniority in the organization and the composition of the project team they are working with. The Customer Support & Field Engineer role responsibilities will include the types of activities listed below:

• Leadership for all technical aspects for the implementation phase of the project.

• Manage skills transfer from the design team to the implementation team.

• Leading the field deployment and day-to-day activities: Deploying, Configuring, commissioning, Testing and troubleshooting network equipment problems.

• Management and development of the local FE team.

• Ensure that the project team and the stakeholders are kept up to date with the progress on the project.

• Be the escalation point for the implementation FEs for the raising of issues with the deployment, and escalate these to the relevant parties for resolution. These will need to be tracked from opening to closure;

• Self-motivated and able to maintain team focus in a pressured environment.

• Coordinate the interface between design and implementation.

• Maintain the records related to technical aspects of the work carried out in the sites.

• Interface, communicate, and coordinate the sub-contractor on project deployment best practices.

• Ensure the project is delivered to the desired quality standard.

• Perform preventative and corrective maintenance routines to ensure proper system operation with focus on trend analysis and documentation of results.

• Provide direct local support for customers under support service contracts.

In general a Customer Support & Field Engineer should strive for the following:

• Maintaining an excellent working knowledge of all public safety applications, solutions and services as well as emerging trends within the industry.

• Proactive approach to knowledge sharing and supporting colleagues to enhance both individual and group competencies.

• Do it right the first time, work effectively.

The organization structure in the team enables accountability, focus, and decision making with efficient region wide sharing of our post sale Technical resources. The organizational goal is to maintain the balance between Customer, Business & People which in turn drives improved efficiency, costs & ultimately competitive advantage.

Basic Requirements

Minimal Requirements For The Position Are As Follows

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Telecommunications, Electrical, or Electronics) required; candidates who are within one year of graduation will also be considered.

• 3+ years of experience in the telecommunications field, IT is a plus.

• Intermediate English communication skills (both verbal and written).

• Proactive attitude in customer service, with strong focus on satisfying customers’ needs.

• Availability to travel domestically, and internationally when exceptionally required. A US visa is a plus. (When it’s possible, in a normal business environment).

• Autonomy and Empowerment to take increasing responsibilities.

• Driver license.

The Ideal Candidate Will Comply With The Following

• ITIL certification.

• Knowledge on Networking

• Knowledge on Server Management (ESXi, Vsphere)

• Working technical knowledge of Motorola Solutions portfolio (PCR, DIMETRA Express).

• Cross-cultural and cross-language working experience in teams comprising people from different countries.

• Field engineering experience with Motorola Solutions portfolio, including customer management experience.

• Comfortability with learning about new products and the service portion related to them.

Travel Requirements

Over 50%

Relocation Provided

None

Position Type

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

Yes

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

postings.title: Senior Engineer - Buenos Aires
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
Support and Services Organization - Motorola Solutions Argentina S.A

Job Description

El rol de Customer Support & Field Engineer (Ingeniero de Soporte al Cliente y Campo) formará parte de equipos de proyecto multidisciplinarios para diseñar y entregar sistemas complejos de voz y datos de misión crítica. Los sistemas pueden ser utilizados directamente por nuestros clientes o por Motorola Solutions para brindar Servicios Gestionados a nuestros clientes.
Los Customer Support & Field Engineers trabajarán en las fases de postventa de los proyectos y pueden dar soporte a múltiples proyectos en un período determinado, dependiendo de su tamaño y complejidad. También puede existir el requerimiento de proporcionar soporte a actividades de preventa.

El rol de Customer Support & Field Engineer puede operar a diferentes niveles dentro de la organización y/o de los proyectos. El nivel del puesto estará determinado por el tamaño y la complejidad del proyecto o actividad, así como por el nivel del individuo dentro de la organización.

El rol de Customer Support & Field Engineering se puede ejercer en cualquier nivel dentro de la escala de carrera de TS (Soporte Técnico); sin embargo, el personal de ingeniería de menor nivel se enfocará en proyectos más pequeños o en elementos de proyectos más grandes con un mayor nivel de supervisión.

Funciones Principales

• Gestionar y/o realizar en detalle la implementación de soluciones y servicios de sistemas de comunicación que satisfagan los requisitos del cliente, de los usuarios finales y del operador;

• Dar soporte en la actualización de la documentación del sistema "as built" (conforme a obra);

• Proporcionar soporte local al cliente (en algunos casos, soporte de servicio de guardia 24/7);

• Realizar mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo a los sistemas de los clientes bajo contrato de soporte;

• Construir relaciones con los clientes; presentar soluciones técnicas al cliente, realizar negociaciones con clientes, socios y proveedores, y proporcionar consultas técnicas, asesoramiento y revisiones al cliente, así como la documentación técnica de acuerdo con los requisitos del contrato;

• Proporcionar soporte técnico y consultas para / con los Centros de Integración de Sistemas y aclaración de asuntos técnicos con el cliente, terceros y dentro de Motorola Solutions.

• Proporcionar gestión de terceros para el pedido, instalación e integración, documentación, gestión de calidad y pruebas de aceptación, y gestión de cambios técnicos.

• Participar en las Pruebas de Aceptación en Fábrica (FAT) y en las Pruebas de Aceptación en Sitio (SAT) (en terreno), coordinando todos los aspectos técnicos de las pruebas de aceptación.

• Trabajar con los grupos de productos para asegurar que el equipo esté disponible para cumplir con los plazos del proyecto.

• Proporcionar soporte técnico durante todas las fases del proyecto;

• Dar soporte en actualizaciones de SW / HW (Software / Hardware);

• Asistir a reuniones con clientes, actualizaciones de estado, informes de proyectos, etc.

• Gestionar, supervisar y auditar a los subcontratistas que prestan servicios de soporte complementarios;

• Soporte técnico al CSM.

Dependiendo del alcance del proyecto, un Customer Support & Field Engineer puede asumir un rol de liderazgo técnico responsable del despliegue general, las pruebas y la entrega. Alternativamente, el rol de Customer Support & Field Engineer podría especializarse en un área o subsistema particular en función de sus habilidades y experiencia.
El rol de Customer Support & Field Engineer también puede cumplir la función de un Subject Matter Expert (SME - Experto en la Materia) dando soporte a proyectos y oportunidades en toda la región de manera extendida.

Responsabilidades

El alcance de la responsabilidad de un Customer Support & Field Engineer estará determinado por su antigüedad en la organización y la composición del equipo de proyecto con el que esté trabajando. Las responsabilidades del rol de Customer Support & Field Engineer incluirán los tipos de actividades que se enumeran a continuación:

• Liderazgo en todos los aspectos técnicos para la fase de implementación del proyecto.

• Gestionar la transferencia de conocimientos desde el equipo de diseño hacia el equipo de implementación.

• Liderar el despliegue en campo y las actividades del día a día: Desplegar, Configurar, comisionar, Probar y solucionar problemas (troubleshooting) de equipos de red.

• Gestión y desarrollo del equipo local de FE (Ingenieros de Campo).

• Asegurar que el equipo del proyecto y las partes interesadas se mantengan al tanto del progreso del proyecto.

• Ser el punto de escalamiento para los FE de implementación para el planteamiento de problemas con el despliegue, y escalar estos a las partes correspondientes para su resolución. Estos deberán ser monitoreados desde su apertura hasta su cierre;

• Ser automotivado y capaz de mantener el enfoque del equipo en un entorno bajo presión.

• Coordinar la interfaz entre el diseño y la implementación.

• Mantener los registros relacionados con los aspectos técnicos del trabajo realizado en los sitios.

• Interactuar, comunicarse y coordinar con el subcontratista sobre las mejores prácticas de despliegue del proyecto.

• Asegurar que el proyecto se entregue con el estándar de calidad deseado.

• Realizar rutinas de mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo para asegurar el correcto funcionamiento del sistema, con enfoque en el análisis de tendencias y la documentación de resultados.

• Proporcionar soporte local directo a los clientes bajo contratos de servicios de soporte.

En general, un Customer Support & Field Engineer debe esforzarse por lo siguiente:

• Mantener un excelente conocimiento práctico de todas las aplicaciones, soluciones y servicios de seguridad pública, así como de las tendencias emergentes dentro de la industria.

• Enfoque proactivo para compartir conocimientos y apoyar a los colegas con el fin de mejorar las competencias tanto individuales como grupales.

• Hacerlo bien a la primera, trabajar de manera efectiva.

La estructura organizativa del equipo permite la rendición de cuentas, el enfoque y la toma de decisiones con un intercambio eficiente de nuestros recursos técnicos de postventa a nivel de toda la región. El objetivo organizacional es mantener el equilibrio entre el Cliente, el Negocio y las Personas, lo que a su vez impulsa una mayor eficiencia, costos y, en última instancia, una ventaja competitiva.

Relaciones De Reporte

El Customer Support & Field Engineer reporta directamente a los CSM (Customer Support Managers) del equipo de Soporte y Servicios de Postventa. También existen líneas de reporte de negocio con los PM (Project Managers) y el departamento de Ventas para cumplir con los requerimientos de servicio y contratos del cliente. Como parte del equipo de personal técnico, ayudan a crear y desarrollar nuevas habilidades y oportunidades de negocio.
Cuando el Customer Support & Field Engineer es asignado a un proyecto importante, la estructura funcional de gestión de línea se mantendrá. Sin embargo, el reporte del rol será matricial para reflejar la implementación del equipo o equipos de proyecto. postings.descriptionText:
About Mecenas Mecenas is a certified minority-owned media platform and content studio that connects brands with audiences through culturally relevant content, media, and storytelling. As the parent company of COCINA, co-founded by chef Aarón Sánchez, Mecenas develops and operates a growing portfolio of digital media brands, brand websites, and social channels spanning food, sports, wellness, and lifestyle.
We believe great content starts with understanding the audience. Our team combines cultural fluency, creative storytelling, and data-driven distribution to build meaningful connections between brands and communities.
The Opportunity Mecenas is looking for a hands-on, detail-oriented Brand Website & Social Publisher / Community Manager to support the daily publishing, audience engagement, and operational needs of our growing portfolio of digital brands.
This role is responsible for getting content into the world: scheduling and publishing social posts, updating and publishing content on brand websites, adapting copy for each platform, managing routine audience interactions, supporting content workflows, and monitoring emerging trends. You will also help troubleshoot platform issues, support new channel launches, maintain community and outreach logs, and prepare raw social performance reports.
You should be comfortable working directly in social publishing tools and website content management systems (CMS), such as WordPress or Webflow, to ensure content is accurate, optimized, and published on schedule.
The ideal candidate is digitally savvy, highly organized, culturally aware, and excited by the details of making content work across websites and social platforms.
Key Responsibilities Publishing & Platform Execution
• Schedule and publish content across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and other relevant social channels.

• Publish and update content on brand websites using content management systems (CMS), such as WordPress or Webflow.

• Adapt captions, copy, titles, descriptions, headlines, hashtags, links, images, and other publishing elements to fit each platform's best practices and audience.

• Maintain publishing schedules and ensure all assets, links, tags, captions, and metadata are accurate before content goes live.

• Execute publishing plans across multiple brands while maintaining each brand's voice and standards.

• Support the preparation, adaptation, and publishing of AI-generated and AI-assisted content across websites and social channels.

Community Management & Audience Engagement
• Monitor and respond to routine comments, direct messages, and audience interactions in each brand's voice.

• Escalate sensitive issues, complex inquiries, potential reputational risks, and partnership opportunities to the appropriate team members.

• Maintain community response logs and document recurring questions, audience feedback, and emerging themes.

• Support influencer and creator outreach, follow-ups, and tracking.

• Identify relevant conversations and engagement opportunities that can help strengthen audience relationships.

Platform Support & Optimization
• Provide hands-on technical support and troubleshooting for social accounts, publishing tools, CMS platforms, and website content issues.

• Assist with setting up new accounts, launching new channels and websites, and maintaining access and account information in accordance with internal protocols.

• Monitor platform updates, new features, emerging formats, and social trends; share relevant findings with the team.

• Support the execution and monitoring of paid social promotion campaigns, including post boosting, campaign setup coordination, and basic performance tracking.

• Ensure website content and social posts are published accurately, with appropriate formatting, links, images, and metadata.

Reporting & Insights
• Compile raw social performance reports, including reach, views, engagement, follower growth, and other relevant metrics.

• Track content performance and flag notable successes, underperforming posts, audience reactions, and emerging trends.

• Maintain organized records of publishing activity, community management, outreach, and campaign execution.

• Share timely observations with the operations lead to support reporting and optimization recommendations.

Qualifications
• Professional fluency in English, written and spoken, is required.

• A minimum of 3 years of experience in social media publishing, community management, digital content operations, or a related field.

• Hands-on familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube.

• Experience using social media scheduling tools, publishing dashboards, and platform analytics.

• Familiarity with content management systems (CMS), such as WordPress and/or Webflow, and the ability to publish and update website content directly.

• Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt copy to different platforms and brand voices.

• Comfort working with content creation and publishing workflows, including website and social content.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple accounts, deadlines, and daily priorities.

• Basic troubleshooting skills and willingness to learn new platforms, tools, and workflows.

• Familiarity with paid social boosting and campaign monitoring is a plus.

• Excellent communication, sound judgment, and a proactive, solutions-oriented approach.

What Success Looks Like
• Accurate, consistent, and timely publishing across assigned websites and social platforms.

• Website content that is properly formatted, up to date, and published on schedule.

• Responsive, on-brand community management and effective escalation of issues.

• Organized outreach, response, and publishing logs.

• Reliable raw performance reporting and timely identification of trends.

• Smooth onboarding and ongoing maintenance of social accounts and channels.

• Proactive identification of platform updates and opportunities to improve content distribution.

Why Mecenas? Join a growing, multicultural media organization building content brands and audience relationships across food, sports, wellness, and lifestyle. You'll play a hands-on role in bringing our content to life, connecting with audiences, and helping our brands grow across websites and social platforms.

AI models are often used to summarize market trends, explain supply and demand, or give business advice, but they can sometimes get the "logic of money" wrong. • Check Economic Logic: Read an AI’s explanation of a market event and make sure it correctly understands concepts like inflation, interest rates, or opportunity cost.

• Verify Data & Trends: Look at simple charts or economic summaries generated by the AI and ensure the numbers and conclusions match real-world data.

• Review Business Advice: If the AI is asked to help a small business with pricing or competition, you check to make sure its advice follows sound economic principles.

• Local Market Context: Help the AI understand how the economy works in your specific country, including local currencies and regional trade habits.

postings.descriptionText:
Company Description

Louis Dreyfus Company es una empresa líder en la comercialización y transformación de productos agrícolas. Nuestras actividades abarcan toda la cadena de valor, desde el campo hasta la mesa, a través de una amplia gama de líneas de negocio, aprovechamos nuestro alcance global y nuestra extensa red de activos para servir a nuestros clientes y consumidores en todo el mundo. Estructurada como una organización matricial de seis regiones geográficas y diez plataformas, Louis Dreyfus Company opera en más de 100 países y emplea aproximadamente a 18.000 personas en todo el mundo.

Job Description

Nos encontramos en búsqueda de un Asistente Técnico de Campo para estimar la producción de los principales cultivos de Argentina (trigo, maíz y soja), realizando un seguimiento integral desde la pre-siembra hasta la cosecha. El rol combina análisis de datos, trabajo de campo y monitoreo de cultivos, con el objetivo de generar estimaciones precisas y análisis de mercado.

Responsabilidades:

• Realizar estimaciones de producción de los principales cultivos de Argentina, monitoreando su desarrollo desde la pre-siembra hasta la cosecha.

• Analizar márgenes agrícolas y desempeño de cultivos.

• Monitorear condiciones climáticas y su impacto en los cultivos.

• Realizar estimaciones de rinde a campo y análisis de imágenes satelitales.

• Preparar reportes y visualizaciones de datos utilizando herramientas de Data Science y GIS.

• Combinar trabajo de oficina y de campo, visitando cultivos en distintas provincias.

Experience

Requisitos:

• Agrónomos recibidos o próximos a recibirse.

• Disponibilidad para viajar entre noviembre y abril por el interior del país (Santa Fé, Buenos Aires, Entre Ríos, La Pampa, Córdoba, Chaco, Santiago del Estero).

• Licencia de manejo obligatoria.

• Manejo de herramientas GIS – no excluyente.

• Conocimientos de Data Science: Power BI, manejo de bases de datos y programación básica (Python o similar).

• Experiencia en cultivos deseable, especialmente trigo, maíz y soja.

• Experiencia en ruta y disponibilidad para trabajo de campo.

Ubicación principal: Rosario, con disponibilidad para desplazamientos internos.

Condiciones:

• Plazo fijo de 6 meses.

postings.title: Product Designer SR - Merchants
postings.descriptionText:
#SomosNaranjaX y nos une el propósito de trabajar por la inclusión y la educación financiera de millones de personas. Más de 9.5 millones de clientes nos eligen cada día porque confían en Naranja X para alcanzar sus sueños.

Estamos creando un ecosistema de soluciones tecnológicas financieras que se diferencia por ofrecer la mejor experiencia y facilidad en el acceso.

¿Querés ser protagonista de esta historia e impulsar la transformación financiera de millones de personas? ¡Súmate!

¡Te contamos sobre el puesto!

Buscamos una persona altamente talentosa y motivada para unirse a nuestro equipo multidisciplinario de desarrollo de productos. En este rol, vas a ser responsable de liderar y contribuir activamente al diseño de experiencias excepcionales y soluciones innovadoras que impactarán directamente tanto en la calidad y éxito de nuestros productos como en la vida financiera de millones de personas.

Si te gusta resolver problemas complejos, tenés gran capacidad para bajar una idea a una visión de producto y podes manejarte en un ambiente donde el foco evoluciona de forma constante, este equipo es para vos.

¿Qué desafíos vas a encontrar en esta posición?

1- Diseño De Experiencia De Usuario (UX)

• Guiar el proceso de diseño desde la investigación de usuarios hasta la entrega final del producto, asegurando experiencias intuitivas y centradas en las personas.

• Crear wireframes, prototipos y flujos de trabajo detallados para comunicar eficazmente las soluciones de diseño propuestas.

2- Colaboración Interdisciplinaria:

• Trabajar estrechamente con equipos de desarrollo, producto, negocios y otras partes interesadas para comprender los objetivos del producto, traducirlos en soluciones de diseño efectivas y factibles, y mantener los estándares propuestos durante el desarrollo y futuras iteraciones.

• Proponer activamente nuevas ideas, realizar revisiones de diseño para fomentar la innovación y la mejora continua, y analizar métricas del producto para tomar decisiones.

3- Investigación:

• Trabajar en conjunto con el equipo de research, service y mediciones para realizar investigaciones para comprender las necesidades, comportamientos y expectativas de los usuarios finales.

• Integrar hallazgos de investigación en el diseño de soluciones centradas en el usuario.

4- Prototipado y Pruebas:

• Generar propuestas de diseño en diversos niveles de fidelidad: diagramas de flujo, wireframes en baja, wireflows y prototipos en alta calidad.

• Generar prototipos interactivos para validar conceptos de diseño, realizar pruebas de usabilidad para iterar y mejorar las soluciones propuestas.

5- Estándares de Diseño y Consistencia:

• Establecer y mantener estándares de diseño coherentes en todos los productos y colaborar en la creación de un sistema de diseño.

• Colaborar con desarrolladores para garantizar la implementación fiel de los diseños.

¿Qué buscamos?

• Experiencia comprobada como Product Designer o en un rol similar.

• Portfolio sólido que demuestre habilidades en diseño de interfaz, prototipado y solución de problemas.

• Conocimiento de herramientas actuales del mercado. Ej: Marvel/Invision, Adobe Suite, Figma, Sketch, Zeplin, Maze, etc.

• Habilidades de comunicación excepcionales y capacidad para presentar y defender decisiones de diseño de manera efectiva.

• Capacidad para trabajar en un entorno ágil y adaptarse a cambios rápidos.

• Experiencia planificando, ejecutando y/o dirigiendo investigaciones en campo y tests de usabilidad, incluyendo: reclutamiento, creación de prototipos, scripts para tests, facilitación de las sesiones, reporte de resultados y rediseño basados en los insights.

• Conocimiento y uso de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial (IA) en la rutina diaria para optimizar flujos de trabajo y procesos de diseño.

• Experiencia previa en industrias fintech o relacionadas es un plus.

• Disfrutar de resolver problemas y ser desafiado.

Role: Data Scientist (Generative AI, LLM)
Location: Mexico/Argentina (Remote)

Responsibilities
● As a Data Scientist on the Data Science team, you will develop machine learning, NLP and Generative AI solutions focused on conversational analytics and large language models.
● Design, develop, test and optimise prompts for Large Language Models (LLMs) using conversational datasets.
● Support prompt training and evaluation activities to improve accuracy, relevance and consistency of AI-driven outputs.
● Create scalable data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, sampling and processing of conversational and unstructured text data.
● Develop sampling methodologies for high-volume conversational datasets, including sampling within conversations and across conversations.
● Prepare and process conversational data for use in Athena Studio and related analytics workflows.
● Apply NLP and machine learning techniques for text understanding, classification, summarisation, pattern recognition and conversational insights.
