postings.title: Senior Site Contract Specialist / Contract Manager III (Sponsor Dedicated/ Remote - Mexico, Argentina, Brazil)
postings.descriptionText:
Description

Senior Site Contract Specialist / Contract Manager III (Sponsor Dedicated/ Remote - Mexico, Argentina, Brazil)

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.

• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.

• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Public Health, Life Sciences, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• Demonstrated experience independently managing:

• Clinical Trial Agreements (CTAs)

• CTA Amendments

• Site budget negotiations

• Contract lifecycle management with minimal oversight

• Strong understanding of:

• CTA drafting and negotiation

• Contract templates and fallback language

• Budget development and negotiation strategies

• Clinical trial start-up processes

• Experience maintaining negotiation status and documentation within Sponsor clinical trial tracking systems.

• Excellent understanding ofPhase II-IV clinical trials, ICH-GCP, and clinical development processes.

• Strong project management, organization, and prioritization skills.

• Exceptional negotiation, communication, and relationship-building abilities.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Previous experience supporting a Sponsor-Dedicated/FSP model.

• Leadership or mentoring experience (Senior level).

• CRO experience.

• Experience supporting process improvement initiatives within Site Start-Up or Site Contracts.

Experience-Leveling:

SCS-II/Contract Manager II: Minimum of one (1) year of direct site contract and budget negotiations within CRO, site or pharma company required.

Sr. SCS/Contract Manager III: Minimum of two (2) years of direct site contract and budget negotiation required. Demonstrates strong skillset in overall contract and budget management/oversight and has a minimum of one (1) year of progressive experience leading site contract negotiations as client-facing point of contact within an industry sponsored clinical trial setting.

General Responsibilities:

• Review contract language and budgets for completeness and accuracy, and ensure that corrections are appropriately made and documented.

• Maintain internal project trackers with accurate and timely information to support overall transparency.

• Leverage fallback language provided by sponsor legal to effectively and accurately negotiate site contracting language.

• Negotiate Study budget utilizing the approved budget (medium and high) within approval parameters before escalation is required. Follow appropriate escalation pathway and processes.

• Attend weekly internal and external progress meetings and provide updates and next steps on active contract negotiations.

• Collaborate with primary stakeholders to ensure goals and priorities are aligned as it relates to contract execution date and site activation timelines.

• Establish and maintain positive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders throughout negotiating process.

• Identifying contractual or operational risks early and proactively driving solutions.

• Prepares Contract and Budget Escalations as required.

• Responsible for drafting and finalizing documents for Studies-start up (templates, Start up plans, etc.).

• Responsible for preparing and leading the Kick-Off Meeting with the Study Team.

• Responsible for scheduling other contract and budget prep and overview meetings.

• Responsible for preparing the final contracts (once negotiations are complete and escalations approved).

• Participate in pilot and stretch projects as they align with role and sponsor initiatives.

Why You'll Love This Opportunity

This is more than a site contracts role—you'll become a trusted partner helping drive clinical studies from start-up to activation. You'll work alongside experienced legal, finance, and clinical operations professionals while supporting one dedicated Sponsor, allowing you to develop deep expertise and build lasting collaborative relationships.

If you enjoy owning negotiations, solving complex challenges, and making a meaningful impact on clinical research, we'd love to speak with you.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

Summary

Job Brief: The "Contract Manager" will be responsible for negotiating and executing site contract and budget requests within the Genentech Global Pharmaceutical business units. Are you an experienced clinical trial contracts professional who enjoys negotiating complex agreements, partnering directly with investigative sites, and driving study start-up success? If so, we'd love to hear from you. We are seeking aSenior Site Contracts Specialistto join a high-performing, Sponsor-Dedicated team supporting a leading global biopharmaceutical company. In this highly visible role, you will independently manageU.S. site contract and budget negotiations, partnering with cross-functional teams to help bring innovative therapies to patients faster. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and can confidently manage Clinical Trial Agreements (CTAs) and budgets with minimal oversight.

postings.descriptionText:
Company Description

Join an Award-Winning Personal Injury Law Firm

At The Ward Law Group, Our Mission Is Simple

Changing Lives. One Client at a Time

Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work for consecutive years, we are committed to delivering exceptional legal representation while creating an environment where talented professionals can grow, lead, and make a meaningful impact every day.

We believe our people are our greatest asset. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-accountability culture where every team member is empowered to make informed decisions, continuously improve, and deliver exceptional results for our clients. Every role contributes directly to helping injured individuals navigate one of the most challenging times in their lives while supporting the continued growth and success of our firm.

Our Core Values

Faith – We act with integrity, honesty, and purpose in everything we do.

Accountability – We take ownership of our work, our commitments, and the results we deliver.

Leadership – We lead by example, inspire others, embrace continuous improvement, and develop high-performing teams.

Loyalty – We build lasting relationships through trust, respect, and dedication to our clients, teammates, and community.

Service to Our Clients – We are committed to delivering compassionate, responsive, and exceptional service that maximizes every client's opportunity for success.

Service to Our Teammates – We foster a culture of collaboration, respect, support, and shared success where every team member has the opportunity to grow and thrive.

Service to Our Community – We believe in making a positive impact beyond the workplace by serving and strengthening the communities where we live and work.

If you are passionate about helping injured clients, thrive in a fast-paced, results-driven environment, and are committed to delivering exceptional client service while continuously growing your career, we invite you to join The Ward Law Group and help us change lives—one client at a time.

Please submit your resume in English.

Job Description

The Ward Law Group is seeking an experienced Senior Case Manager to support plaintiff personal injury cases from intake through resolution, working under attorney supervision. This role involves close coordination with clients, medical providers, insurance carriers, and attorneys to keep cases progressing efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

• Possess expert knowledge of the bodily injury claims process.

• Manage an average caseload of 80 to 120 personal injury cases while maintaining quality and efficiency standards.

• Meet or exceed settlement and treatment goals while adhering to established case lifecycle timelines.

• Manage plaintiff personal injury cases from intake through resolution, including insurance communications, medical treatment coordination, and claim management.

• Coordinate with clients, medical providers, insurance carriers, and attorneys to support timely case progression and resolution.

• Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date case documentation and activity records in Litify.

• Assist with case-related activities and legal support functions under attorney supervision.

• Communicate effectively with clients in both English and Spanish as needed.

• Monitor claim status and proactively follow up on outstanding items to prevent delays and advance case resolution.

• Ensure compliance with firm procedures, documentation standards, and case management best practices.

Qualifications

• Minimum 2 years of recent experience in plaintiff personal injury case management

• Experience handling personal injury claims, including familiarity with no-fault, bodily injury (BI), and uninsured/underinsured motorist (UM/SUM) claims

• Experience working in a plaintiff personal injury law firm

• Fluent in English and Spanish

• Strong organizational, communication, and case management skills

• Ability to work independently and manage a full caseload in a remote environment

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience using Litify or Salesforce

Additional Information

Technical Requirements

Contractors supply their own equipment and workspace. Your setup must meet these minimums:

Computer — capable of running a browser-based ATS, video conferencing, and a softphone simultaneously without degradation:

• Windows: Windows 11, Intel i5 (8th generation or newer) or equivalent, 16 GB RAM, 256 GB SSD

• Mac: macOS 14 (Sonoma) or newer, Apple Silicon or Intel i5, 16 GB RAM, 256 GB SSD

• The device must be used solely by you — not shared with family or household members

Internet — Wired Ethernet Preferred, 5 GHz Wi-Fi Acceptable

• 30 Mbps download / 15 Mbps upload minimum

• Latency under 100 ms

• Private, password-protected network. Public Wi-Fi is not permitted for this work.

Peripherals

• USB noise-cancelling headset with microphone

• Webcam capable of clear video for scheduled calls

Security — Required For Handling Confidential Applicant Information

• Full-disk encryption enabled (BitLocker or FileVault)

• Automatic security updates enabled for operating system and browser

• Screen lock after no more than 10 minutes idle

• Active endpoint protection software

• Applicant data stored only in firm-designated systems — never on personal cloud storage or local drives

Additional Information

Contractor Terms

• This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment.

• No paid time off, healthcare, retirement, or other employee benefits are provided.

• You will supply your own equipment, software, internet connection, and workspace.

The Ward Law Group does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

The Ward Law Group is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at The Ward Law Group via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from The Ward Law Group HR/Recruitment will be deemed the sole property of The Ward Law Group. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by The Ward Law Group as a result of the referral or through other means.

Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. The role ensures infrastructure integrity, effective asset maintenance, high-quality technical service delivery, strong order to cash execution performance, and full compliance with Quality and HSE standards.

The position leads service technicians and operational personnel while safeguarding company assets, driving customer satisfaction, and maintaining operational excellence across all site activities, aligned to the regional and global strategy.

Your Responsibilities

HSE

• Responsible for Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) and all other businesses’ compliance, standards and regulations in its own area of responsibility.

• Ensures a safe work environment and continuous improvement in HSE process and integrity performance throughout the local service organization.

• Show personal commitment to HSE by conducting sustainability observations tours consistently.

People and Leadership

• Guides, motivates and develops direct and indirect subordinates. Improves service availability, provides training, and develops capabilities and competencies.

• Ensures that the area of responsibility is properly organized, staffed, skilled and directed.

• Accountable to build an effective, capable and high-performing organization.

Operational Excellence

• Drives, implements, reports and monitors performance targets as part of the respective unit P&L (financial, productivity, investments, customer satisfaction, operational excellence etc.,)

Quality & Customer satisfaction

• Executes service strategy within own area of responsibility. Implements productized service offering, materials and initiatives for marketing and market penetration purposes.

Workshop and Assets Management

• The Station Manager maintains accurate asset registers and maintenance records, monitors equipment utilization and performance, identifies replacement and investment needs, and drives continuous reliability improvement initiatives.

• Additionally, the role ensures effective inventory management of machines spare parts and consumables, optimizes resource allocation, and controls maintenance-related costs to support safe, efficient, and uninterrupted operations.

Infrastructure Management

• Responsible for ensuring that the station’s facilities and infrastructure remain safe, reliable, compliant, and fully aligned with operational requirements and standards.

• The Station Manager oversees the condition, performance, availability, and reliability of workshop equipment, buildings, utilities, and supporting infrastructure, ensuring they effectively support the site's operational strategy.

• This role establishes and maintains preventive maintenance programs for all facilities and ensures full compliance with local regulations, company standards, and technical requirements.

• The position also maintains strong relationships with landlords and industrial site representatives, fostering effective collaboration to support business continuity and long-term site performance.

Your Background

• Strong experience on Facility Management.

postings.title: Document & Business Solutions - Operations Team Leader - Print / Mail Center
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

As an Operations Team Leader (Print / Mail Center) , you will work in a hands-on production role supporting high-volume print center operations. You will produce, finish, and distribute customer print requests while meeting established service-level agreements (SLAs), quality standards, compliance requirements, and productivity targets. You may be required to provide coverage across multiple production locations and shifts based on business need. You will also deliver mail and create print and document products. In partnership with your direct manager, you will coordinate daily mail activities and support clients with document preparation, using digital and technical products in line with global control procedures.

Schedule & Work Arrangement

• Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

• 100% onsite (in-office) role; no remote/hybrid arrangement.

Flexibility / Coverage Requirements

• Must be flexible to work additional hours, including early/late coverage, and on occasions at the weekends as business needs require (e.g., peak production periods, urgent client deadlines, outages, or special projects).

Key Responsibilities

• Operate high-volume production print equipment (digital print engines/MFDs) and associated finishing systems (binding, folding, cutting, stapling, punching, laminating, etc.).

• Produce and release print jobs accurately from queue to completion, (print settings, paper selection, finishing instructions) and reprints as needed.

• Perform print finishing and bindery work to specification, including booklets and other finishing methods used at the site.

• Receive, prioritize, and process incoming and outgoing production work; validate job tickets and ensure accurate delivery/packaging/distribution.

• Maintain intermediate recordkeeping and tracking (job logs, volumes, turnaround, exceptions, rework) per management requirements.

• Identify non-compliant activities (e.g., confidentiality handling, release errors, process deviations, unsafe practices) and escalate appropriately.

• Provide first-line troubleshooting for print/finishing equipment (clearing jams, replacing consumables, basic calibration steps) and coordinate service calls when required.

• Manage inventory for print supplies and finishing materials (paper, toner, binding spines/coils, covers, etc.); support replenishment and fulfillment.

• Respond to end-user inquiries regarding print requests, timelines, delivery options, and service capabilities; provide clear status updates and set expectations.

• Support broader DBS operational functions as needed (e.g., scanning, mail/receiving, distribution, overnight shipping, courier coordination, manifests/documentation).

• Operating functional equipment and related technologies; including mail, printing, scanning, inserting, sortation, confidential paper bins and other equipment, as applicable.

• Scan documents/files and integrate into agreed digital mail or other document workflow/depositories.

• Handle receipt and collection of mail and courier items including x-ray screening, required manifest(s) and documentation.

• Resolve discrepancies, perform research for complex inquiries, and complete escalations through defined channels.

• Participate in cross-training and continuous improvement efforts; recommend process improvements to increase quality, reduce rework, and improve turnaround times.

• Other duties as assigned, including potential rotation between multiple locations within the state/country and variation in work hours to meet coverage needs.

Necessary Skills & Experience

• Demonstrated experience in a high-volume print center / production print environment, including machine printing and bindery/finishing operations.

• Strong attention to detail and deadlines; commitment to safeguarding confidential and personal information.

• Ability to follow direction, show initiative, and independently drive tasks to completion in a production setting.

• Strong customer service orientation; able to communicate professionally with end users and partners.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced team environment with fluctuating priorities and SLA-driven delivery.

• Self-motivated with proven ability to learn; proactive in cross-training and using downtime to build skills.

• Ability to recommend process improvements and contribute to team initiatives/meetings.

• Reliable, responsible, and accountable; accepts constructive feedback and collaborates effectively.

• Ability to resolve complicated problems and escalate appropriately when needed.

• Basic understanding of risk and control for the activities responsible; awareness and maintenance of safe working practices related to Health & Safety.

• Ability to guide and train others and allocate tasks according to priority and timeframe.

• Proficiency with basic business technology and advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook including email and calendar).

• Strong oral and written communication skills.

• Intermediate written and spoken English and communication skills.

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

Mantener frecuente comunicación con el equipo de Planificación, Procura y Construcción del Proyecto, entender y contemplar las necesidades del equipo de Gerenciamiento de Construcción del Proyecto, comunicando tempestivamente y proactivamente cualquier desviación real o potencial

• Generación de Reportes de avance, seguimiento del flujo de información y de alertas sobre desvíos de provisiones, ejecución y planificación.

• Supervisar el cierre de las actividades de fabricación de cada módulo, asegurando la adecuada preparación de los documentos de calidad y entrega requeridos según procedimiento acordado con la Contratista; asegurando que todas las actividades a completarse en Sitio sean claramente enlistadas y referenciadas en planos y/o en físico junto a los materiales necesarios (module carry over list). Facilitar la supervisión y los controles de la preparación para envío de los módulos, coordinando recursos de logística propio de la empresa o terceros.

• Monitorear el desempeño de la Contratista en cuanto a Calidad y HSE, para mantener alineamiento con los estándares de Proyecto y normativos.

• Aseguramiento y apego a normas y procedimientos.

• Participación en reuniones periódicas.

• Tareas administrativas propias de cualquier empleado de la compañía (ej: carga de HHs, capacitaciones, etc.)

Requerimientos

El requerimiento contempla a personas con experiencia probada en el seguimiento estratégico de fabricación y/o montaje de salas eléctricas. El postulante deberá tener conocimientos de planificación y control de obra, desarrollo de ingeniería eléctrica (subestaciones), compra de materiales eléctricos, control de calidad, HSE y Medio Ambiente, propios de un alcance de gerenciamiento en representación de la contratista EPCM y/o del Cliente.

Experiencia previa en la fabricación/montaje en taller de subestaciones modularizadas es preferencial.

Debe tener buenas relaciones interpersonales, perfil profesional (preferentemente Ingeniero Eléctrico) y manejo avanzado del idioma inglés.

Disponibilidad para frecuentes movimientos entre los varios talleres y cuando sea requerido en las oficinas en Buenos Aires u otra ciudad de Argentina.

En caso de que necesites algún ajuste de accesibilidad por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación.

Avanzando juntos

Queremos que nuestra gente se sienta motivada y empoderada para impulsar un impacto sostenible. Por eso, nuestro enfoque está en una cultura inspirada en valores que libera el talento a través del sentido de pertenencia, la conexión y la innovación. Estamos construyendo un lugar de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso, creando un espacio donde todas las personas sientan que pertenecen, puedan ser ellas mismas y sean escuchadas.

Y no solo hablamos de ello; lo estamos haciendo realidad. Estamos recapacitando a nuestra gente, aprovechando habilidades transferibles y apoyando la transición de nuestra fuerza laboral para convertirse en especialistas en la infraestructura y tecnología de energía baja en carbono de hoy. Cualquiera que sea tu ambición, aquí hay un camino para ti.

Y no hay barreras para el éxito potencial de tu carrera. Únete a nosotros para ampliar tus horizontes, explorar oportunidades diversas y formar parte de la entrega de un cambio sostenible.

Whether it's commercializing the world's first plant-based omega-3, delivering innovative crop protection and seed solutions, or unlocking biomass oils for sustainable fuels, Nufarm is evolving with agriculture to create long-term value for customers and communities.

Own Your Growth at Nufarm
Reporting to the Global Lead, Grain & Oils Trade & Supply Chain, this role is responsible for scaling and managing Nufarm's grain and oil production, trading, and supply chain strategy across South America.

This is a unique opportunity to influence the growth of a globally connected business at the intersection of agriculture, commodity markets, and renewable energy. Working closely with commercial, bioenergy, and supply chain leaders, you'll help shape the strategies, partnerships, and trade networks that connect growers to customers across international markets.

Success in this role requires a combination of commercial acumen, value chain expertise, market insight, and relationship-building capability. You'll play a key role in developing scalable supply chain solutions that support Nufarm's growing Bioenergy, Nutritional, and Seeds platforms while creating long-term value across the agricultural value chain.

• Develop and execute grain and oils trade and supply chain strategies that support regional and global business objectives.

• Partner with Commercial, Bioenergy, and Seeds teams to translate customer demand into supply, production, and sourcing strategies.

• Excellent negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong commercial judgement with the ability to evaluate opportunities, risks, and long-term value creation.

• Fluent English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in bioenergy, renewable feedstocks, oilseed processing, grain merchandising, or protein markets.

• Experience building identity-preserved agricultural supply chains.

• Demonstrated success managing complex international supply chain and trading relationships.

Why Nufarm?
At Nufarm, you'll have the opportunity to influence a growing global platform that is helping shape the future of sustainable agriculture and renewable energy.

You'll work alongside talented colleagues across regions and functions, collaborate with industry-leading partners, and contribute to innovative solutions that connect agriculture with emerging global markets. Most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to leave your mark on a business that is building the next generation of sustainable grain and oil value chains.

Nufarm is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all Nufarm employees. Apply today and be part of our journey to shape the future of agriculture.

Our solutions and services support everything from renewable energy and electrification to the infrastructure and digital economy shaping our future. Together, we help our customers meet growing demand while driving the industry toward a more sustainable use of the earth’s natural resources.

Join nearly 18,000 Metsonites worldwide, each bringing unique expertise and experience to positive change. At Metso, you’re supported by a growth culture built on safety, wellbeing, inclusion and collaboration.

This is your opportunity to make an impact and rise above the possible.

Job posting end date: 10/25/2026

Introduction

We are looking for a Manager, Field Service to join our Field Services team in the South America market area. In this role, you will lead the commercial and technical development of Field Services in Argentina, driving business growth, service excellence, and customer value through Metso’s proprietary technologies and OEM service capabilities.

You will report to Director, Field Services, and the role location is San Juan, Argentina, with an onsite working model. The role includes national and international travel as well as visits to customer sites.

Team you will belong to

You will lead the Field Services team based in San Juan. The team is responsible for delivering specialized technical services that support the reliability, integrity, operational continuity, and performance optimization of customer assets. The team plays an important role in supporting customers through Metso’s Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) technologies and service expertise.

The team works closely with customers, commercial teams across the South America market area, Professional Services, Metso Training Academy, and OEM business lines to deliver high-quality service solutions and long-term customer value.

What You'll Do

• Develop and execute the commercial strategy for Field and Expert Services, supporting long-term business growth and customer success.

• Manage the full Field Services Argentina budget and Profit and Loss (P&L) responsibility, ensuring achievement of sales, profitability, cost, and delivery targets.

• Lead and develop a highly specialized technical team while coordinating activities across multiple locations.

• Promote compliance with Quality, Environment, Health and Safety (QEHS) policies, as well as Metso’s values, inclusion practices, and people-focused culture.

• Drive innovation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption to strengthen service execution and customer outcomes.

• Represent Metso at mining industry events, conferences, seminars, webinars, and professional platforms.

• Build partnerships with educational institutions, technology organizations, and strategic technology providers to support talent development, knowledge transfer, and service quality.

What You'll Bring

• Deep experience leading service, maintenance, engineering, or related operations within the mining industry, including executive-level leadership responsibilities.

• Proven ability to drive business development and commercial growth in specialized mining services.

• Strong leadership experience with the ability to guide highly specialized technical teams and foster collaboration across local and global organizations.

• Advanced technical knowledge in at least two of the following areas: mining plant maintenance, process control and instrumentation strategies, mineral processing and copper refining, or data architecture, infrastructure, and data science platforms.

• Broad understanding of OEM equipment and technologies, ideally within environments supporting mining operations.

• Strong focus on operational performance, profitability, cost management, execution excellence, and delivery of customer value.

• University degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline such as Mechanical, Electronic, Electrical, Chemical, Metallurgical Engineering, or a comparable field.

• Ability to build effective relationships with customers, internal stakeholders, and external partners while communicating effectively across different audiences.

• Commitment to safety, quality, continuous improvement, equity, and inclusion.

• Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office and reporting tools.

Nice to have

• Specialization or additional studies in technical disciplines, business administration, or management.

• Balanced experience across both mining companies and mining industry suppliers.

• Experience with customer relationship management (CRM) tools.

• Experience on site in technical assistance.

• Experience in mineral processing plants

What's In It For You

At Metso, you will combine meaningful work with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact in a supportive and inclusive environment. You'll be part of a global team where collaboration, wellbeing, and continuous learning are part of everyday work.

We support your growth and wellbeing by offering:

• Purpose-led work: Contribute to enabling sustainable modern life and transforming the industry.

• Wellbeing: Access to wellbeing programs, occupational healthcare, and supportive services.

• Rewards: Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.

• Growth: Learning pathways, mentoring, internal mobility, and global collaboration opportunities.

• Culture: A caring, collaborative, and inclusive workplace committed to helping you thrive.

Get in touch

Want to rise above the possible with us? Click "Apply now" to submit your application.

Physical work requirements may include visits to mining customer sites, including field environments at elevations above 1,000 meters.

Metso is committed to pay equity and transparent reward practices globally. Compensation information is shared in line with local legislation and applicable recruitment practices.

How to join - Working at Metso - About Metso - Diversity and Inclusion - Meet our people

Metso is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran or status as a qualified individual with a disability.

Metso is a frontrunner in sustainable technologies, end-to-end solutions and services for the aggregates, minerals processing and metals refining industries globally. We improve our customers’ energy and water efficiency, increase their productivity, and reduce environmental risks with our product and service expertise. We are the partner for positive change.

Metso is headquartered in Espoo, Finland. At the end of 2025 Metso had close to 18,000 employees in around 50 countries, and sales in 2025 were about EUR 5.3 billion. Metso is listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki.

• Brindar soporte durante la construcción, precomisionamiento, loop checking, comisionamiento y puesta en marcha de los sistemas eléctricos y de instrumentación.

postings.title: Document & Business Solutions - Print Center Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

As a Print Center Specialist (Operations Specialist) , you will work in a hands-on production role supporting high-volume print center operations. You will produce, finish, and distribute customer print requests while meeting established service-level agreements (SLAs), quality standards, compliance requirements, and productivity targets. You may be required to provide coverage across multiple production locations and shifts based on business need.

Schedule & Work Arrangement

• Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

• 100% onsite (in-office) role; no remote/hybrid arrangement.

Flexibility / Coverage Requirements

• Must be flexible to work additional hours, including early/late coverage, and weekends as business needs require (e.g., peak production periods, urgent client deadlines, outages, or special projects).

Key Responsibilities (Print Center Focus)

• Operate high-volume production print equipment (digital print engines/MFDs) and associated finishing systems (binding, folding, cutting, stapling, punching, laminating, etc.).

• Produce and release print jobs accurately from queue to completion, (print settings, paper selection, finishing instructions) and reprints as needed.

• Perform print finishing and bindery work to specification, including booklets and other finishing methods used at the site.

• Receive, prioritize, and process incoming and outgoing production work; validate job tickets and ensure accurate delivery/packaging/distribution.

• Maintain intermediate recordkeeping and tracking (job logs, volumes, turnaround, exceptions, rework) per management requirements.

• Identify non-compliant activities (e.g., confidentiality handling, release errors, process deviations, unsafe practices) and escalate appropriately.

• Provide first-line troubleshooting for print/finishing equipment (clearing jams, replacing consumables, basic calibration steps) and coordinate service calls when required.

• Manage inventory for print supplies and finishing materials (paper, toner, binding spines/coils, covers, etc.); support replenishment and fulfillment.

• Respond to end-user inquiries regarding print requests, timelines, delivery options, and service capabilities; provide clear status updates and set expectations.

• Support broader DBS operational functions as needed (e.g., scanning, mail/receiving, distribution, overnight shipping, courier coordination, manifests/documentation).

• Resolve discrepancies, perform research for complex inquiries, and complete escalations through defined channels.

• Participate in cross-training and continuous improvement efforts; recommend process improvements to increase quality, reduce rework, and improve turnaround times.

• Other duties as assigned, including potential rotation between multiple locations within the state/country and variation in work hours to meet coverage needs.

Necessary Skills & Experience

• Demonstrated experience in a high-volume print center / production print environment, including machine printing and bindery/finishing operations.

• Strong attention to detail and deadlines; commitment to safeguarding confidential and personal information.

• Ability to follow direction, show initiative, and independently drive tasks to completion in a production setting.

• Strong customer service orientation; able to communicate professionally with end users and partners.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced team environment with fluctuating priorities and SLA-driven delivery.

• Proficiency with basic business technology and advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook including email and calendar).

• Strong oral and written communication skills.

• Self-motivated with proven ability to learn; proactive in cross-training and using downtime to build skills.

• Ability to recommend process improvements and contribute to team initiatives/meetings.

• Reliable, responsible, and accountable; accepts constructive feedback and collaborates effectively.

• Ability to resolve complicated problems and escalate appropriately when needed.

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation :

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Senior Software Engineer with Sezzle, you will work with a highly-motivated team to tackle interesting and challenging problems across multiple areas of the organization. Your experience and guidance will help other members of the team level-up their own skills as well.

In this backend focused role, you will work closely with stakeholders from Product, Support and the business. You’ll also partner with other engineering teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative solutions to internal and customer problems. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering new features, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates.

This role has both an internal and external focus, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in the day-to-day lives of your peers at Sezzle, enhancing their ability to support our business and customers, and you will have opportunities to take any feedback and iterate.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

• Application submitted (you are here)

• Wonderlic test (30-40 min)

• Interview with recruiters (30 min)

• Coding assessment (:1.5 hours)

• Interview with engineers (1 hour)

• Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)

• Offer!

What You'll Do:

• Design software applications and features in Golang and React

• Help build out a distributed architecture, creating solutions that work within it, maintaining consistency while scaling highly

• Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products

• Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products

• Deliver high quality features which can be tested and adheres to reporting standards

• As needed, lead small development teams to bring a project to market

• Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

What We Look For:

• At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience

• Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward

• Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go (preferably) and Java Python or a similar language.

• Experience working in a distributed, cloud-based architecture, with either design patterns like transactional outboxes, or queuing tools like RabbitMQ, SQS, Kafka

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

• Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool

• Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.

• DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines

• Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS

• Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications

• A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback.

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

• Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python

• Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native

• Backend: Golang

• Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch

• DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes

• Version Control: Git

• CI/CD: Gitlab

• Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests

• Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

postings.descriptionText:
Ingeniero/a Senior de Infraestructura AWS y Observabilidad (EKS + SRE)

📍Presencial · Tiempo completo

🚀 Buscamos un/a ingeniero/a senior de infraestructura con mucha profundidad técnica en AWS y Kubernetes para trabajar sobre la observabilidad, la capacidad y la confiabilidad de una plataforma SaaS multi-tenant de gestión comercial: decenas de microservicios .NET y Python desplegados sobre EKS, con imágenes publicadas desde GitHub Actions, mensajería asíncrona y cargas de datos e IA.

Vas a instrumentar lo que hoy no se ve, diseñar las alertas que avisan antes del impacto, dimensionar la capacidad del cluster y convertir los arreglos de urgencia en infraestructura como código.

✅ Requisitos

• AWS en profundidad: EKS, VPC y su red (subnets, CIDR, ENIs, NAT, ruteo), IAM, ECR, SQS, S3 y CloudWatch, con criterio para dimensionar antes de desplegar.

• Kubernetes real: scheduler, requests y limits, probes de liveness y readiness, presupuestos de disrupción, distribución entre zonas, autoescalado y estrategias de rollout y rollback.

• EKS específico: el modelo de una IP de VPC por pod y sus consecuencias de capacidad, prefix delegation, y Karpenter con sus NodePools, límites y consolidación.

• Observabilidad con OpenTelemetry en sus tres señales, instrumentando servicios .NET y Python, con propagación de contexto entre servicios y criterio de cardinalidad y costo.

• Definición de salud por servicio: indicadores, objetivos y presupuesto de error (SLIs, SLOs, error budget).

• Diseño de alertas accionables: síntoma antes que causa, umbral justificado, severidad y runbook enlazado.

• Detección de cuellos de botella: saturación de CPU, memoria, red, IPs, pools de conexión y thread pool; latencia en percentiles altos; profundidad y lag de colas.

• Infraestructura como código con Terraform: módulos, estado, plan previo y detección de drift.

• CI/CD con GitHub Actions: workflows reutilizables, publicación de imágenes y despliegue a Kubernetes con reversión.

• Docker con builds multi-etapa y manejo de secretos que no quedan en la imagen.

• Linux y redes: DNS, TLS y diagnóstico cuando hay que bajar a la capa de red.

• Scripting en Bash y Python para automatizar diagnóstico y tareas repetitivas.

• Gestión de incidentes: severidades, coordinación, comunicación y post-mortem con acciones que se ejecutan.

⭐ Deseables

• Infraestructura como código con CDK o Pulumi como alternativa a Terraform.

• Go para scripting y automatización.

• Stack de métricas y dashboards (Prometheus y Grafana, CloudWatch o suites comerciales), con criterio de diseño del tablero.

• Gestión de secretos con servicio dedicado y montaje seguro en build.

• Seguimiento del costo de infraestructura: atribución, right-sizing y uso de instancias spot.

🧩 Perfil ideal

Es un rol de especialista técnico y de monitoreo activo. No buscamos a alguien que apague incendios rápido: buscamos a quien encuentre el próximo problema mientras todavía es una métrica que sube despacio. La persona ideal:

• Es proactiva y preventiva: instrumenta lo que no se ve y convierte los arreglos de urgencia en infraestructura como código, en lugar de acumular parches.

• Tiene conciencia de radio de impacto: entiende que la plataforma es multi-cliente y que un cambio de infraestructura los alcanza a todos a la vez.

• Tiene criterio sobre la fatiga de alertas: sabe qué merece despertar a alguien y qué no.

• Usa asistentes de IA a diario y tiene la capacidad de detectar cuándo proponen un manifiesto o una política de permisos que abre un problema.

postings.title: Head of Engineering
postings.descriptionText:
About Rebill

Rebill is the financial infrastructure platform for the Americas.

The companies shaping software, AI, travel, and digital services use Rebill to operate across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and the United States.

Rebill brings local payments, installments, recurring billing, stablecoin rails, treasury, global payouts, and financial operations into one platform built for how money actually works across the Americas.

Every market is different. Rebill makes the infrastructure consistent. Engineering, finance, and operations teams can manage local currency acceptance, market-specific payment behavior, funds, and financial workflows from the same platform.

Companies can launch in Latin America in as little as a day and expand across markets without rebuilding their financial stack country by country.

Built locally. Designed to scale globally.

Rebill is backed by leading global investors such as Tiger Global, Y Combinator (W22), Soma Capital and SV Angel, and angels including Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and Arash Ferdowsi (Dropbox).

About the role

Engineering

You run engineering day to day: delivery, reliability, and the technical bar of everything we ship.

Rebill processes real money across six markets on its own infrastructure. Event-driven microservices on a message bus, Kubernetes across Azure and AWS, infrastructure as code, and smart routing across a different set of local acquirers in every country. Card data lives in an isolated, tokenized environment.

You lead a small in-house team alongside external engineering partners, and you report to the CTO, who owns architecture, security, and the technical relationship with our acquirers. You own everything between that and production.

This is a hands-on seat. You will review pull requests and write code in your first year. If you have not been close to a codebase in the last two years, this is not the right seat for you.

Why this role exists

Rebill launched its own payment infrastructure in September 2025, starting with Argentina. In one year it went from that single market to six.

That platform was built fast by very few people. The next stage is different: more volume, more acquirers, more markets, and merchants whose finance teams depend on us settling correctly every day. That needs someone whose full-time job is making the platform reliable, cheap to extend, and predictable to ship on.

What you will own

• Reliability. Uptime, incident response, observability, and the performance of payment routing. When approval rates drop in one market at two in the morning, you are the person who knows why.

• Delivery. The quarterly technical roadmap, release cadence, and the honesty of our dates. Engineering commitments that hold are worth more than ambitious ones that do not.

• Technical bar. Code review standards, testing, on-call, and documentation across a team that is part in-house and part external. Raising the floor is most of the job.

• Time to market. Today every new acquirer and every new payment method is its own integration project. Your job is to turn that into something closer to configuration, so opening a market takes weeks instead of quarters.

• Capacity decisions. What we build in-house, what we keep with partners, and what that costs. You bring the numbers and defend the call.

What we are looking for

• 8+ years building software, with at least 3 leading engineers directly.

• You come from payments: acquiring, processing, ledgers, reconciliation, or a fintech moving real transactional volume. Not a company that happened to charge cards.

• Hands-on. You still write and review code, and you are the person who goes into the incident, not the one who asks for the postmortem.

• You have worked with external engineering partners or agencies and can describe what you did to make that model work.

• Distributed systems in production: event-driven architectures, queues, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code.

• Fluent English and Spanish. Our acquirers, auditors, and merchants do not share one language.

• Based in Buenos Aires, Bogotá, or Miami (hybrid).

• AI tools as part of how you work. Everyone at Rebill uses them daily to move faster.

Nice to have

• You were the first or second engineering leader somewhere and left a platform that ran without you.

• Experience with PCI DSS or an equivalent audit.

• Direct integrations with local acquirers in Latin America.

• Portuguese at a working level for Brazil.

• Prior startup or YC-company experience at a similar stage.

What we offer

• A senior package matching the seat: competitive base and meaningful equity.

• Direct access to the founders, with no layers in between.

• Ownership of a payments platform that is already in production across six markets, at the point where the decisions you make still shape it.

• Hybrid base in Buenos Aires, Bogotá, or Miami.

How we hire

An intro conversation, a technical session on a real problem from our platform, and a conversation with the founders. No take-home exercise that we would not pay for. We will tell you what is still open and what is held together with tape. We expect the same candour back.

Estas grabaciones se realizan mediante una aplicación móvil y un soporte para colocar el celular en la cabeza, y se utilizan para entrenar sistemas de Inteligencia Artificial.
Tu función será presentar brevemente el proyecto a comercios de tu cartera, identificar aquellos que tengan interés en participar y facilitarnos sus contactos para que nuestro equipo continúe con el proceso.

¿Cómo funciona la remuneración?
💰 USD 100 por cada comercio referido que se incorpore al proyecto y alcance las primeras 50 horas de grabaciones aceptadas.
Por ejemplo:
1 comercio incorporado que alcance 50 horas = USD 100.
3 comercios que alcancen 50 horas cada uno = USD 300.
5 comercios que alcancen 50 horas cada uno = USD 500.
10 comercios que alcancen 50 horas cada uno = USD 1.000.
No hay un límite preestablecido de comercios que puedas referir.

Buenas habilidades de comunicación, negociación y relacionamiento comercial.
Capacidad para presentar la propuesta y detectar oportunidades de participación.
¿Qué ofrecemos?
✅ Modalidad independiente y flexible.
✅ Posibilidad de complementar tu actividad laboral actual.
✅ Esquema de comisiones en dólares por resultados, sin sueldo fijo.
✅ Sin exclusividad ni horarios establecidos.
✅ Acompañamiento de nuestro equipo en la incorporación y seguimiento de los comercios referidos.
¡Postulate!
Si tenés experiencia en ventas mayoristas o consumo masivo y contás con una cartera de clientes, esta puede ser una excelente oportunidad para generar ingresos adicionales aprovechando tus vínculos comerciales actuales .

postings.title: Ejecutivo/a Comercial - Prospección y Desarrollo de Cliente - Rosario
postings.descriptionText:
Somos una institución prestadora de servicios de salud, con 40 años de trayectoria y experiencia en la administración de aportes y contribuciones de obra social del personal de dirección de empresas. Conocemos cuáles son tus necesidades, por eso nos orientamos a brindar cobertura médica a nivel nacional por medio de las redes prestadoras más importantes del país. Somos una obra social sólida y dinámica que prioriza el bienestar de 350.000 afiliados que confían en nosotros.
Hay oportunidades que llegan. Y otras que se crean. En Medifé buscamos un/a Ejecutivo/a Comercial con iniciativa, autonomía y ganas de desarrollar nuevos clientes individuales y corporativos.
Tu desafío no será solamente comercializar un plan de salud, sino acompañar a personas y empresas en una decisión importante: elegir cómo cuidar su salud y la de quienes las rodean.
Si disfrutás generar conversaciones, construir confianza y transformar contactos en oportunidades, queremos conocerte.

¿Qué vas a hacer? Prospectar nuevos clientes a través de redes sociales, referidos, contactos, acciones presenciales y canales digitales.
Escuchar cada necesidad y asesorar sobre el plan de cobertura médica más adecuado.
Gestionar el proceso comercial completo: contacto, propuesta, negociación, cierre y documentación para el alta.
Recibir y gestionar leads, complementándolos con acciones de prospección propia para ampliar tu cartera.
Registrar y dar seguimiento a las oportunidades en CRM.
Observar el mercado y aportar información que ayude a potenciar la estrategia comercial.

Este rol puede ser para vos si… Tenés iniciativa para generar oportunidades desde cero.
Disfrutás relacionarte con personas, escuchar y construir vínculos de confianza.
Te organizás con autonomía y sostenés el seguimiento hasta alcanzar el resultado.
Te motivan los objetivos comerciales y los desafíos.
¿Te reconocés en este desafío? Buscamos experiencia comercial, pero también iniciativa, constancia y capacidad para construir relaciones.
Porque vender también es escuchar.
Porque asesorar también es cuidar.
Postulate y contanos sobre una oportunidad comercial que hayas construido desde cero El próximo match puede empezar con esa historia.

Requisitos:
Experiencia mínima de tres años en venta de servicios o productos intangibles. Excluyente.
Contar con cartera propia será valorado. De no tenerla, necesitaremos que puedas demostrar experiencia en prospección y generación de nuevos clientes.
Estudios secundarios completos.
Manejo profesional de redes sociales, WhatsApp y herramientas de venta digital.
Conocimientos de CRM y notebook propia.
Disponibilidad full-time.

Beneficios ‍️ Plan de cobertura médica para vos y tu grupo familiar.
Capacitación continua mediante programas y talleres.
Modalidad remoto–presencial con flexibilidad para organizar horarios.
Convenios educativos: UCES, UADE, San Andrés, Siglo 21, CUI , entre otros.
️ Beneficios como Wellhub, Samshop, Colonia Express, Fiat, Club de Beneficios Unilever , entre otros.
Licencias extendidas por maternidad y paternidad.
Hora de lactancia extendida (1 h 30).
Reintegro de gastos de guardería.
Servicio de asistencia al colaborador/a (legal, financiera e impositiva).
Celular corporativo.

Experiencia en empresas de servicios eléctricos industriales, obras eléctricas, montajes electromecánicos, mantenimiento industrial o automatización.

Formacion técnica o superior.

Autonomía para desarrollar nuevos negocios.

• 1 día libre al año a elección

• Acuerdos con importantes bancos.

Serás responsable de liderar la gestión comercial de la compañía, enfocándote en la búsqueda permanente de nuevos clientes potenciales y en el mantenimiento de la cartera asignada, con el objetivo de incorporar los servicios odontológicos de la clínica en las cartillas de obras sociales, prepagas, gerenciaras y entidades de la seguridad social.

• Gestión Comercial B2B: Identificación, prospección y contacto directo con los decisores clave del mundo de la salud (obras sociales, prepagas y gerenciadoras).

• Desarrollo de Acuerdos: Negociación y cierre de convenios corporativos para la inclusión institucional de la clínica.

• Fidelización y Seguimiento: Mantener y potenciar la relación con la cartera de clientes provista por la empresa, asegurando el seguimiento periódico de los acuerdos.

• Planificación Autónoma: Organización de la agenda de visitas comerciales (CABA y GBA), diseñando estrategias de penetración de mercado.

¿Qué requisitos exigimos?

• Experiencia Excluyente: Comprobable en ventas B2B dentro del sector salud , con experiencia previa comercializando hacia obras sociales, prepagas o entidades afines. (Se valorará contar con antecedentes en auditorías de salud) .

• Perfil Comercial: Perfil dinámico, con fuerte orientación a resultados, capacidad de resolución, autoconfianza y agilidad en la negociación con directivos y tomadores de decisiones.

• Habilidades Informáticas: Manejo avanzado de Excel, herramientas de CRM y excelente manejo de correo electrónico y bases de datos.

• Competencias Blandas: Perfil extrovertido, con gran capacidad de comunicación efectiva, autonomía y profesionalismo.

Condiciones de la propuesta:

• Lugar de trabajo: CABA (Zona Microcentro / Viamonte), con modalidad presencial y esquema de visitas en transporte público.

• Horario: Lunes a viernes de 10:00 a 18:00 hs (con flexibilidad horaria orientada al cumplimiento de objetivos y presencia en reuniones clave).

• Esquema de Contratación: Sueldo básico de convenio + un atractivo e innegociable esquema de comisiones (no absorbibles) que se perciben durante toda la vigencia de los convenios concretados.

• Oportunidad: Posición de liderazgo comercial exclusivo dentro de la estructura de la empresa .

Si posees la experiencia requerida en el rubro salud y buscas un desafío comercial con autonomía y alto potencial de ingresos, ¡esperamos tu postulación!

• Definimos el KPI a mover y su línea de base.

• Decidimos y documentamos el aprendizaje.

• Automatizamos lo que funciona.

• Ser dueño/a de un set de KPIs (CAC, CPA, conversión, activación, retención) y reportarlos semanalmente.

• Ejecutar y optimizar campañas de performance en Meta, Google, TikTok y venta online.

• 2 a 4 años en growth, performance marketing o roles afines.

• Manejo comprobable de al menos dos plataformas de medios pagos (Meta, Google, TikTok, Apple Search Ads).

• Experiencia real diseñando y leyendo experimentos A/B: hipótesis, métrica primaria, criterio de corte.

• Analítica y atribución: GA4, Mixpanel/Amplitude, AppsFlyer o Adjust. Excel/Sheets avanzado; SQL básico deseable.

Reforestación: Cada grupo que viaja planta un árbol en Bariloche, dejando una huella positiva y tangible en el destino.

postings.descriptionText:
Importante empresa inmobiliaria referente en la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires , con cerca de 20 años de sólida trayectoria en el mercado. La organización se destaca por su especialización en alquileres temporarios amoblados y la administración integral de un portafolio activo de más de 1.300 propiedades.
En el marco del rediseño y fortalecimiento de su estructura operativa y financiera, la compañía busca incorporar un profesional analítico, metódico y orientado a la excelencia en procesos para liderar la gestión de ingresos, arqueos y rendiciones a propietarios. La oportunidad ofrece incorporarse a un entorno caracterizado por esquemas de trabajo con controles cruzados, alta transparencia y un equipo de trabajo profesionalizado.
Objetivo estratégico del cargo
Garantizar la integridad, precisión e inmediatez del ciclo de cobranzas y rendiciones de la compañía, asegurando que cada flujo de dinero (pesos y divisas) quede registrado en tiempo real, las liquidaciones a propietarios se ejecuten en fecha y con exactitud, y las diferencias de caja sean auditadas con tolerancia cero a inconsistencias sin justificar.
Principales responsabilidades

• Gestión integral de cobros e ingresos: Percibir e ingresar pagos de alquileres, depósitos en garantía y honorarios en efectivo (ARS/USD), transferencias y plataformas digitales (Mercado Pago, PayPal, Wise, Zelle).

• Registro contable y emisión de comprobantes: Asentar en el sistema de gestión cada cobranza en forma inmediata e instrumentar los recibos numerados correspondientes.

• Rendiciones y liquidaciones a propietarios: Calcular la liquidación neta por propiedad (alquiler menos honorarios de administración), estructurar el pago y consolidar la documentación de respaldo para aprobación.

• Control de Tesorería y arqueo diario: Ejecutar el arqueo diario de fondos de caja y formalizar el cierre diario en conjunto con la Supervisora de Tesorería.

• Gestión preventiva de mora y atención al cliente: Realizar el seguimiento inicial de cuotas vencidas por canales digitales y atender consultas de propietarios sobre sus estados de cuenta con tono formal y respuesta en el día.

• Carga de novedades contractuales: Registrar ajustes, renovaciones y condiciones de pago en el sistema para la validación de la gerencia.

Requisitos y experiencia
Requisitos Excluyentes:

• Experiencia laboral: Mínimo 3 años de trayectoria comprobable en funciones de tesorería, cobranzas, caja o administración contable (deseable en inmobiliarias, administraciones de consorcios o estudios contables).

• Manejo de valores: Experiencia directa en gestión de efectivo y ejecución de arqueos de caja cotidianos. Capacidad demostrada para trabajar de forma fluida con operaciones multimoneda (pesos y dólares), porcentajes y cotizaciones sin margen de error.

• Referencias y antecedentes: Referencias comprobables del último empleador en posiciones con manejo de dinero.

• Modalidad y presencia: Disponibilidad para trabajar de manera 100% presencial en Palermo (CABA), de lunes a viernes de 10:00 a 18:00 h.

• Experiencia rindiendo cuentas a terceros (propietarios o clientes) y explicando balances de liquidación.

postings.title: Analista Senior de Tesorería
postings.descriptionText:
Roche nos encomendó un Analista Sr de Tesorería para sumarse a su equipo.
Su misión será: actuar como socio estratégico del negocio para la organización comercial. Generar confianza para las partes interesadas del negocio y mantener contacto cercano con los clientes, garantizando una asignación eficiente de recursos y el máximo impacto en el recorrido del cliente.
El rol complementa el flujo administrativo, incluyendo el análisis de movimientos en cuentas bancarias e inversiones; la preparación, emisión y entrega de pagos, y la elaboración y envío de documentación para operaciones financieras y Comercio Exterior; asimismo, supervisa el proceso de cobranzas.
Sus responsabilidades serán:
- Realizar el análisis diario de movimientos en cuentas bancarias e inversiones.
- Llevar a cabo estudios y cálculos para preparar la planificación financiera de acuerdo con los estándares previamente establecidos (Cash Flow).
- Monitorear y controlar la contabilidad de todos los movimientos y operaciones financieras de la compañía.
- Analizar las partidas pendientes de las conciliaciones bancarias.
- Preparar, controlar y solicitar el registro de solicitudes de cheques manuales, preparándolos, obteniendo su firma y enviándolos a quien corresponda.
- Elaborar la documentación necesaria para cumplir con las normativas internas de los bancos y del BCRA.
- Mantener contacto con entidades bancarias y asegurar la aprobación de la documentación necesaria para el cierre de cambio por compra o venta de moneda extranjera.
- Controlar los saldos de las cuentas bajo responsabilidad de Tesorería para un correcto cierre mensual.
- Preparar la documentación requerida según la normativa del BCRA para el cierre de cambio en operaciones de comercio exterior.
- Asociarse con el negocio y apoyar o co-liderar puntos de contacto en el recorrido del cliente.
- Garantizar que los indicadores financieros estén encaminados para alcanzar los resultados y métricas del negocio, o asesorar sobre desviaciones y acciones correctivas.
- Mantenerse al tanto y explorar el entorno empresarial interno y externo en busca de tendencias, problemas y oportunidades para crear valor.
- Coordinar con las áreas de Cuentas por Cobrar para asegurar la salud del flujo de caja.
- Brindar respuestas oportunas a las consultas de las áreas financieras Regionales, del Grupo y Divisionales.
- Elaborar pronósticos de cobranza para fines de planificación de Flujo de Caja y Liquidez.
- Proponer metas de NWC (Net Working Capital) para Cuentas por Cobrar e Inventario basadas en los pronósticos de ventas y términos de pago.
- Supervisar y colaborar activamente con la Política de Gestión de Crédito. Proponer soluciones adecuadas para respaldar al negocio y a los clientes.
- Incrementar la concientización sobre Cuentas por Cobrar y cobranzas, definir y visibilizar la exposición al riesgo, y proponer los procedimientos de mitigación necesarios.
- Participar e involucrarse activamente en la red de Cuentas por Cobrar mediante el intercambio de conocimientos y buenas prácticas, asegurar el uso de nuevas herramientas de gestión de crédito y reportes, y responsabilizarse por la validación de los datos.
- Colaborar para garantizar el cumplimiento de todas las normas de compliance y regulaciones durante el proceso de cobranza, creando un camino conforme a las normativas bancarias y del país para el flujo de fondos.
- Participar en la creación de la política comercial, asegurando su adecuada implementación y monitoreo.
- Responsabilizarse de la alineación y liderar las discusiones con la tesorería del grupo para brindar soluciones crediticias o términos de pago extendidos.
- Colaborar activamente con la mejora y el potenciamiento del desempeño de Cuentas por Cobrar, asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos financieros de la red regional.
Requisitos:
* Graduado o estudiante avanzado en Contador Público, Lic. en Administración, Economía o Finanzas.
* Experiencia entre 3 y 5 años en posiciones de tesorería o administración financiera.
* Sólidos conocimientos técnicos en Excel, sistemas ERP (SAP), plataformas bancarias, Normativa lo BCRA e impositivas (ARCA/AFIP) y reporting financiero.
* Inglés avanzado (oral y escrito).
* Modalidad de trabajo: híbrido.
* Modalidad de contratación: Tercerizada.
Competencias:
Visión estratégica, capacidad analítica y autonomía. Liderazgo, orientación al trabajo colaborativo y mentoreo. Excelentes habilidades de negociación y comunicación. Adaptabilidad y resiliencia ante entornos económicos cambiantes.

¡Esta propuesta te puede interesar!

Analista Sr. de Liquidación de Sueldos y Compensaciones

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Analista Sr. de Liquidación de Sueldos y Compensaciones para integrarse a una prestigiosa organización en la ciudad de Rosario.

Objetivo de la posición: Garantizar el pago correcto y puntual de las remuneraciones y beneficios, ejecutando el proceso de nómina y liquidación final de forma autónoma. Debe asegurar el estricto cumplimiento de la normativa legal, fiscal y laboral vigente.

Principales Responsabilidades:

•
Ciclo completo de liquidación: Ejecutar de forma autónoma el ciclo completo de liquidación de sueldos (mensual, liquidación final y pagos extraordinarios), emisión del pago ( .txt ) y correcta emisión de recibos de haberes.

•
Gestión de novedades: Recopilar, validar y cargar todas las novedades del personal (ausencias, licencias, horas extras, comisiones, embargos, adicionales, premios, etc.) que impactan en la liquidación del período, resolviendo las incidencias rutinarias.

•
Cálculos y deducciones: Calcular con exactitud las deducciones de ley, Impuesto a las Ganancias (si aplica), aportes sindicales, seguros y otros conceptos específicos de la legislación.

•
Cumplimiento fiscal y contable: Realizar las presentaciones y pagos ante organismos de control (ej. AFIP , organismos previsionales) en tiempo y forma, y generar los asientos contables relacionados con sueldos.

•
Soporte y asesoramiento: Responder consultas complejas de empleados/as relacionadas con el cálculo de su sueldo, vacaciones o beneficios, sirviendo de referente técnico en el día a día.

•
Compensaciones y mercado: Análisis y desarrollo de bandas salariales, tendencias de mercado y costos laborales.

•
Actualización normativa y sistemas: Gestionar y desarrollar toda la actualización de normativas legales y/o de Convenios Colectivos, así como la actualización de datos de colaboradores/as en AFIP y sistema de gestión.

¿Qué buscamos?

Formación: Profesional graduado/a en Recursos Humanos, Contador/a Público/a, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines.

•
Experiencia: Mínimo 3 años de experiencia comprobable en liquidación de sueldos y compensaciones (excluyente).

•
Conocimientos normativos: Dominio avanzado de la normativa laboral y previsional vigente (ej. Ley de Contrato de Trabajo, Convenios Colectivos, Impuesto a las Ganancias de 4ta Categoría).

•
Herramientas informáticas: Manejo avanzado de sistemas de gestión de nómina y dominio avanzado de Microsoft Excel .

•
Competencias requeridas: Capacidad resolutiva, capacidad organizativa, trabajo en equipo, orientación a resultados, buenas relaciones interpersonales, proactividad, orientación al/a la cliente/a, resiliencia, capacidad de adaptación y excelentes habilidades de comunicación ( skills ).

Condiciones de Contratación y Ubicación:

•
Ubicación: Rosario, Provincia de Santa Fe.

•
Modalidad de trabajo: Presencial.

•
Jornada laboral: Full-time .

•
Beneficios: Sueldo fijo competitivo, integración a un equipo en constante crecimiento y paquete de beneficios corporativos.

Si consideras que reunís los requisitos para el puesto y te gustan los desafíos, no lo dudes…. ¡Postulate!

Sobre Randstad

En Randstad nos moviliza ayudar a las personas y a las organizaciones a desarroll ar todo su potencial. Ese es el compromiso que asumimos como compañía en todo el mundo, un compromiso que nos impulsa a ir más allá para lograr que nuestros clientes y candidatos alcancen el éxito. ¿Cómo lo hacemos?, combinando nuestra pasión por las personas con el poder de la tecnología, creando experiencias más humanas, que nos permitan ser una fuente de inspiración y apoyo para quienes nos eligen. Porque estamos convencidos de que mejores personas hacen mejores empresas.

Importante empresa de Consumo Masivo está en la búsqueda de un/a Especialista de Payroll - Liquidación de Sueldos para integrar a su equipo.
