postings.title: Incident Response Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Incident Response Analyst (AI Training)

About The Role

We're partnering with leading AI research labs to build the next generation of AI-powered security tools — and we need real incident responders to make it happen.

Your hands-on experience in security operations is exactly what's needed to ensure AI-driven analysis reflects how modern response teams actually work. You'll review realistic incident data, evaluate AI outputs, and help shape systems that will be used across enterprise security environments worldwide.

This is a unique opportunity to move beyond the alert queue and directly influence how AI understands and responds to cybersecurity threats.

• Organization: Alignerr

• Type: Hourly Contract

• Location: Remote

• Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

• Analyze real-world security events, alerts, and incident cases for impact and root cause

• Evaluate AI-generated incident analysis against actual SOC workflows and best practices

• Review detection rules, alerting pipelines, and investigative playbooks for accuracy

• Identify gaps where AI outputs miss, misclassify, or misinterpret security signals

• Provide structured expert feedback that directly improves AI model performance

• Work independently and asynchronously on your own schedule

Who You Are

• 2+ years of experience in SOC, incident response, or security operations

• Hands-on familiarity with SIEM platforms, alert queues, and investigation tooling

• Strong ability to triage signals — separating real threats from noise

• Comfortable reviewing and critiquing technical security analysis

• Clear written communicator who can document findings precisely

• No prior AI experience required

Nice to Have

• Experience with EDR, NDR, or SOAR platforms

• Familiarity with threat intelligence frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, etc.)

• Background in digital forensics or malware analysis

• Security certifications such as GCIH, GCFE, CEH, or CISSP

Why Join Us

• Work directly on frontier AI systems with top-tier research labs

• Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, anywhere

• Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration

• Put your security expertise to work on something that scales beyond a single org

• Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

postings.title: Jefe/a funcional asistencial y back office
postings.descriptionText:
¿Cuál es el desafío?

En tu rol de Jefe/a Funcional Asistencial y Backoffice, tendrás la responsabilidad de liderar la gestión funcional de soluciones asistenciales y administrativas, con foco en sistemas hospitalarios, procesos de backoffice e interacción permanente con el negocio.

Tu misión será asegurar que las soluciones tecnológicas acompañen la operación del Sanatorio Finochietto, optimizando recursos, impulsando mejoras y garantizando una correcta articulación entre IT, las áreas usuarias y los distintos proveedores.

Principales responsabilidades

• Liderar y coordinar al equipo funcional de tecnología, asegurando un funcionamiento eficiente de los sistemas.

• Supervisar a los analistas funcionales asistenciales y de backoffice.

• Gestionar la solución HIS y los sistemas administrativos que interactúan con los sistemas principales del Sanatorio.

• Acompañar la definición de requerimientos funcionales, aportando una visión integral de la solución.

• Participar en proyectos e iniciativas tecnológicas, asumiendo ownership sobre el producto/servicio.

• Coordinar implementaciones, validaciones funcionales y documentación técnica.

• Asegurar la disponibilidad, integridad y continuidad operativa de los sistemas.

• Detectar, comunicar y gestionar riesgos, desvíos o conflictos entre sistemas.

• Articular con áreas internas como Facturación, Convenios, Gestión de Pacientes, equipos médicos, enfermería, farmacia, compras y otros sectores clave.

• Interactuar con proveedores de sistemas core, efectores y otras unidades de gestión.

• Acompañar la optimización de sistemas backoffice, HIS, GACI y otras soluciones relacionadas.

• Definir, monitorear y controlar objetivos del área, alineados a la estrategia institucional.

Alcance e interacción

• Rol con impacto directo en la operación asistencial y administrativa del Sanatorio.

• Interacción permanente con equipos de IT, áreas médicas, administrativas y de gestión.

• Participación activa en proyectos de transformación, mejora continua e implementación de sistemas.

• Alta exposición con usuarios clave, proveedores y referentes del negocio.

Requisitos

• Formación en IT, Lic. en Sistemas, Informática o carreras afines. (excluyente)

• Experiencia comprobable en posiciones similares, preferentemente en entornos de salud o atención médica. (excluyente)

• Experiencia liderando equipos funcionales o tecnológicos. (excluyente)

• Experiencia en proyectos de implementación de sistemas, (excluyente)

• Conocimiento o experiencia en sistemas HIS. (deseable)

• Conocimientos en sistemas de información hospitalaria, PACS u otras tecnologías médicas. (deseable)

• Conocimientos técnicos en bases de datos, tecnologías web, migración de datos y/o integraciones. (deseable)

• Conocimiento de protocolos de integración como HL7 o Mirth. (deseable)

• Experiencia en entornos de transformación organizacional. (deseable)

• Experiencia trabajando con metodologías ágiles. (será un plus)

• Inglés intermedio (deseable)

• Cursos o formación complementaria en liderazgo y/o agilidad (deseable)

Buscamos personas con

• Liderazgo y capacidad de gestión de equipos.

• Visión integral del negocio y de las soluciones tecnológicas.

• Excelente comunicación interpersonal.

• Capacidad de organización y planificación.

• Orientación a resultados y mejora continua.

• Proactividad y autonomía.

• Capacidad para gestionar múltiples interlocutores.

• Tolerancia al trabajo bajo presión.

• Habilidad para influir y acompañar a otras áreas, incluso fuera de su autoridad directa.

• Disponibilidad para trabajar en una modalidad de trabajo híbrida (Lunes a Viernes Horario de 9 a 18 hs)

Beneficios ¿Qué te ofrecemos?

• Formar parte de una institución referente en el sector salud.

• Participar en proyectos estratégicos y de alto impacto para la operación sanatorial.

• Posibilidades de desarrollo profesional.

• Excelente clima de trabajo.

• Capacitación continua.

• Desafíos constantes en un entorno dinámico, colaborativo y en transformación.

Beneficios

• Almuerzo incluido en instalaciones.

• Programas de capacitación y desarrollo.

• Wellhub —ex Gympass— y convenios con universidades.

• Descuentos en múltiples marcas y beneficios corporativos.

• Licencias extendidas por maternidad y paternidad.

• Reintegro de guardería.

• Programa de asistencia al colaborador/a —legal, financiera e impositiva—

En Sanatorio Finochietto seguimos creciendo y buscamos sumar un/a Jefe/a Funcional Asistencial y Backoffice para incorporarse al equipo de IT / Sistemas.

Buscamos una persona con sólida experiencia funcional y tecnológica, mirada integral de negocio, capacidad de liderazgo y orientación a resultados, que quiera ser parte de proyectos de transformación dentro de una institución referente del sector salud. Si te interesa liderar equipos, acompañar la evolución de soluciones tecnológicas y trabajar en la mejora continua de sistemas críticos para la operación sanatorial, ¡esta oportunidad puede ser para vos!

postings.descriptionText:
Estamos revolucionando las finanzas en América Latina 🚀

Fundada en 2017, Ualá nació con la misión de llevar los servicios financieros en América Latina al Siglo XXI. Hoy, ya somos el neobanco de más de 11 millones de usuarios y seguimos creciendo para transformar la industria en la región con soluciones fáciles y accesibles.

Con presencia en Argentina, México y Colombia, seguimos expandiendo nuestro ecosistema con productos innovadores en Medios de Pago, Crédito, Inversiones y soluciones para comercios con Ualá Bis. Además, logramos la ronda de inversión más grande de la región en los últimos años y seguimos sumando talento para hacer realidad nuestra visión.

Si querés ser parte de un equipo de +1100 personas que desafía lo establecido, trabaja con la mejor tecnología y siempre pone a las personas en el centro, ¡sumate a Ualá!

#LoMejorEstáPorVenir

Buscamos a nuestro/a próximo/a Product Expert que liderará producto de Adquirencia .

Buscamos alguien que pueda ser referente técnico-funcional dentro de la práctica de producto para definir la visión, diseñar soluciones escalables, alinear stakeholders diversos y asegurar resultados de negocio significativos.

Tendrás El Desafío De

• Definir y evolucionar la visión y estrategia del producto, asegurando su alineación con los objetivos del negocio y las necesidades de los usuarios. Diseñar soluciones escalables y de alto impacto, colaborando con equipos de tecnología, diseño, data y negocio.

• Priorizar iniciativas dentro del roadmap del producto, balanceando impacto en negocio, valor para el usuario y complejidad técnica.

• Alinear y gestionar stakeholders internos y externos para asegurar la correcta ejecución de las iniciativas del producto.

• Contribuir al desarrollo de buenas prácticas dentro de la disciplina de producto.

• Determinar el criterio, basado en datos, para medir el éxito de cada iniciativa implementada.

Qué buscamos para este rol

• Contar con +5 años de experiencia en gestión de productos digitales.

• Haber trabajando con equipos de tecnología, diseño y negocio.

• Haber desarrollado productos de adquirencia y/o productos bancarios.

• Contar con experiencia analizando métricas de producto y comportamiento de usuarios.

• Tener capacidad estratégica y orientación a resultados.

• Título universitario en campos relacionados con Administración, Ingeniería , Economía, o tecnología.

• Conocer el negocio de adquirencia y/o negocios bancarios.

¿Por qué trabajar en Ualá?

Queremos compartir con vos...

• Ambiente laboral flexible, en crecimiento y con un enorme potencial de desarrollo profesional.

• Acceso a formación en instituciones educativas de primer nivel con descuentos en capacitaciones, cursos y carreras.

• Valoramos el equilibrio entre la vida profesional y personal, por eso contamos con tres semanas de vacaciones, licencias extendidas, día libre en tu cumpleaños, políticas de trabajo flexible y más.

• También brindamos cobertura de medicina prepaga para grupo familiar, descuento en gimnasios, cashback del 70% en tus compras con la tarjeta de Ualá con tope de reintegro, bono por referidos y otros beneficios que te acompañan dentro y fuera del trabajo.

Creemos que las mejores ideas nacen de la diversidad de miradas y experiencias, por eso, creamos un espacio seguro y colaborativo, en el que todas las voces cuentan.En Ualá contamos con representantes de 11 nacionalidades, de diversos orígenes y experiencias. El 46% del equipo son mujeres, un hito en una empresa tecnológico-financiera. Si lo comparamos con América Latina, menos del 30% del personal que trabaja en empresas fintech son mujeres. Esa diversidad nos fortalece y es la única manera de desarrollar un producto inclusivo para competir con las mejores empresas de la región y el mundo.Si te motiva transformar la industria y hacer las cosas de otra manera, te estamos buscando. Porque desde el primer día construímos el equipo con una máxima: sólo el mejor equipo puede hacer el mejor producto. Por eso contratar, retener, y apostar al talento es lo más importante que hacemos.

postings.title: Scrum Master SAP – SAP Activate y Células Ágiles | Oil & Gas
postings.descriptionText:
Remoto | Full Time | Freelance | Senior | Argentina y LATAM

MaxIT Consulting – Max Corporate Group busca un/a Scrum Master SAP para sumarse a un servicio AMS de largo plazo sobre SAP S/4HANA en una compañía líder del sector energético / Oil & Gas.

El rol se integra al servicio con foco en la facilitación de la metodología ágil en las células del servicio.

EL DESAFÍO

Trabajar en células ágiles dentro de un servicio SAP exige disciplina metodológica: ceremonias útiles, backlog ordenado y foco en entregar valor en cada sprint.

Vas a facilitar la metodología ágil de las células, acompañando a los equipos y removiendo impedimentos.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES

• Facilitar las ceremonias ágiles y el ciclo de sprints de las células.

• Coordinar la aplicación de la metodología y su adaptación al servicio.

• Remover impedimentos y acompañar a los equipos en la mejora continua.

• Colaborar con los responsables de producto en la gestión del backlog.

REQUISITOS EXCLUYENTES

• Al menos 2 años de experiencia con SAP Activate.

• Participación en al menos 2 proyectos ágiles SAP.

• Experiencia como Scrum Master o rol equivalente de facilitación.

• Muy buena comunicación y capacidad de coordinación.

postings.title: Senior Data and Artificial Intelligence - Cloud Solution
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

Partners with customers, sales, engineering and product teams to design, demonstrate and deploy Oracle Cloud architectures that address customer business problems. Drives Oracle Cloud customer consumption by accelerating the adoption of Oracle cloud services including discovery, design and deployment.

Responsibilities

What you’ll do

• Discover customer's data challenges, priorities, growth expectations, and success criteria.

• Design data platforms for integration, storage, processing, and analytics.

• Recommend data lake, lakehouse, or data warehouse approaches based on each customer’s needs and existing environment.

• Design batch and real-time pipelines, including ETL/ELT and integration across platforms.

• Help customers make informed architecture trade-offs across security, data governance, performance, scalability, resilience, operational needs, and cost.

• Design for reliable operation, including monitoring, failure recovery, and the ability to adapt as demand grows.

• Lead technical discussions, demonstrations, and proofs of concept, and help customers bring validated solutions into production.

• Work with customer and internal teams to resolve integration and operational challenges and support long-term adoption.

• Build the data foundation for analytics, machine learning, and generative AI use cases when relevant.

What We’re Looking For

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or related roles, including hands-on experience designing enterprise data platforms that scale with demand, recover from failures, and operate reliably in production.

• Practical knowledge of distributed processing, data integration, and modern analytics architectures.

• Experience with technologies such as Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or cloud data services.

• The ability to connect architecture decisions to business outcomes and explain trade-offs to different audiences.

• Experience working directly with customers from discovery through delivery.

• Experience with OCI and multicloud architectures is a plus.

If you enjoy understanding what customers need, navigating complex data environments, and helping teams put reliable solutions into production, we’d like to hear from you.

Qué harás

• Comprender los desafíos de datos de cada cliente, sus prioridades de negocio, planes de crecimiento y criterios de éxito.

• Diseñar plataformas para integración, almacenamiento, procesamiento y análisis de datos, eligiendo arquitecturas de data lake, lakehouse o data warehouse según cada caso.

• Diseñar pipelines batch y en tiempo real, incluyendo ETL/ELT e integración entre plataformas.

• Orientar decisiones de arquitectura considerando seguridad, gobierno de datos, rendimiento, escalabilidad, resiliencia, operación y costos.

• Diseñar soluciones preparadas para operar de forma confiable en producción, con monitoreo, recuperación ante fallas y capacidad de adaptación a nuevas demandas.

• Liderar conversaciones técnicas, demostraciones y pruebas de concepto, y ayudar a llevar soluciones validadas a producción.

• Trabajar con equipos del cliente y de Oracle para resolver desafíos de integración y operación e impulsar la adopción sostenida de Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

• Establecer la base de datos necesaria para casos de analytics, machine learning e IA generativa cuando corresponda.

Qué buscamos

• Más de 8 años de experiencia en ingeniería de datos, arquitectura de datos o funciones relacionadas, incluyendo experiencia práctica en el diseño de plataformas empresariales.

• Experiencia con plataformas que escalan, se recuperan de fallas y operan de manera confiable en producción.

• Conocimiento práctico de procesamiento distribuido, integración de datos y arquitecturas modernas de analytics.

• Experiencia con tecnologías como Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery o servicios de datos en la nube.

• Capacidad para relacionar decisiones de arquitectura con resultados de negocio y explicar sus ventajas y compromisos a diferentes públicos.

• Experiencia trabajando directamente con clientes, desde el descubrimiento de necesidades hasta la entrega de soluciones.

• Se valorará la experiencia con OCI y arquitecturas multicloud.

Si te interesa comprender las necesidades de los clientes, trabajar en entornos de datos complejos y ayudar a los equipos a llevar soluciones confiables a producción, nos gustaría conocerte.

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. postings.title: EY GDS - FP&A - Senior
postings.descriptionText:
The Revenue Finance Commercial Excellence Analyst will support revenue performance reporting, migration and renewal planning, business analytics, and executive decision-making. The role will partner with Revenue Finance, Sales, Commercial, Product, and business leadership teams to translate commercial and financial data into clear insights, actionable recommendations, and reliable performance targets.

The successful candidate will combine strong financial and analytical capabilities with business acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to produce executive-ready reporting. The position will also help maintain consistent business definitions, improve reporting processes, and ensure alignment across financial models, operational dashboards, and leadership expectations.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Performance Reporting

• Develop and maintain monthly reporting for renewal and migration performance, including retained and total Monthly Recurring Revenue, target attainment, historical trends, deal drivers, and segment and product views.

• Analyze business results and prepare clear commentary covering performance drivers, risks, opportunities, and recommended calls to action.

• Produce executive-ready materials for Revenue Reviews, EAT reviews, segment reviews, and other leadership discussions.

• Perform quality reviews of management presentations, financial analyses, segment views, and supporting talking points.

• Track historical commercial outcomes, including win rates, deal-size trends, and other relevant performance indicators.

• Maintain a consistent understanding of renewal and migration definitions, opportunity classifications, and reporting treatment.

Analytics and Decision Support

• Manage ad hoc analytical requests by clarifying the business question, intended audience, required output, timing, scope, and appropriate level of detail.

• Transform complex data into concise insights and recommendations that support commercial and financial decision-making.

• Identify material trends, risks, opportunities, and performance gaps.

• Develop clear presentations and analytical outputs tailored to both operational and executive audiences.

Data, Models, and Systems

• Use contract-level information to support renewal and migration analysis, while understanding the available fields, extraction methods, and data limitations.

• Analyze Salesforce opportunity and lifecycle data, including renewal and migration classifications, data quality, and reporting limitations.

• Use the Executive Dashboard to analyze performance, apply filters, validate definitions, extract supporting detail, and review compensable-product results.

• Use the principal revenue dashboard as a centralized reporting source and reconcile its outputs with historical reporting and other internal data sources.

• Identify data-quality or reconciliation issues and work with the appropriate stakeholders to resolve them.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or a related field.

• Experience in Revenue Finance, FP&A, Commercial Finance, Sales Finance, or a similar analytical function.

• Strong financial modeling and quantitative analysis capabilities.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

• Experience working with financial and commercial performance metrics, planning models, forecasts, targets, and variance analysis.

• Ability to interpret large datasets and translate findings into clear business insights.

• Strong attention to detail and experience reconciling results across multiple data sources.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop executive-ready commentary and presentations.

• Ability to prioritize multiple deliverables and respond effectively to ad hoc business requests.

• Professional fluency in English.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Salesforce, financial dashboards, business intelligence tools, or contract-level databases.

• Knowledge of subscription, telecommunications, recurring-revenue, or Monthly Recurring Revenue business models.

• Experience supporting renewal, migration, retention, or commercial transformation programs.

• Familiarity with PxQ modeling, target setting, cohort analysis, scenario modeling, and sensitivity analysis.

• Experience working with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.

• Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar analytical tools would be an advantage.

postings.title: Actuario Ssr
postings.descriptionText:
Como parte del Grupo de Gestión Financiera, el equipo de Recursos Actuariales aprovecha el análisis avanzado, los modelos actuariales y la tecnología de vanguardia para impulsar estrategias basadas en datos que dan forma a nuestro negocio. Al evaluar el riesgo, optimizar los marcos de precios y capital, y pronosticar tendencias emergentes, desempeñarás un papel fundamental en la protección de la solidez financiera a largo plazo de la empresa. Colaborarás con el departamento de Finanzas y otras áreas clave de MetLife en un ambiente dinámico y de curiosidad intelectual que valora la innovación, el aprendizaje continuo y el impacto medible. Para quienes sienten pasión por resolver problemas, trabajar con datos y marcar la diferencia para nuestro negocio y nuestros clientes, este equipo ofrece una trayectoria profesional gratificante y con un propósito claro.

The Opportunity

El Actuario Ssr es responsable de ejecutar y coordinar análisis actuariales para los mercados de Latinoamérica, incluyendo el control y análisis de información, la ejecución de modelos, la evaluación de resultados y la elaboración de reportes para métricas clave de negocio y financieras. Asimismo, contribuye al proceso de consolidación regional, la generación de insights para la toma de decisiones y la mejora continua de los procesos actuariales, asegurando la calidad, consistencia y robustez de la información entregada a stakeholders locales, regionales y corporativos.

Esta es una oportunidad para participar activamente en iniciativas estratégicas de la región, trabajar con múltiples mercados y productos, desarrollar una visión integral del negocio asegurador y generar impacto directo en la toma de decisiones.

Key Responsibilities

• Gestionar los procesos de control y análisis de datos, ejecución de modelos, análisis y comunicación de resultados, mediante la elaboración de reportes para oficinas locales y regionales que soporten el monitoreo y la toma de decisiones sobre las siguientes métricas:

• Embedded Value, Value of New Business & Accelerating Value, a partir de los cuales se mide el valor de la cartera, las ventas de cada trimestre y la proyección de las mismas

• Estudios de experiencia del portafolio para la definición de los supuestos actuariales tales como siniestralidad, persistencia, gastos, comisiones, etc

• Economic Capital, que determinará el capital a riesgo necesario de la compañía para asegurar la solvencia

• ALM, para asegurar un adecuado matcheo entre activos y pasivos

• Identificar oportunidades de mejora y automatización de procesos, utilizando herramientas como Python, para evaluar la razonabilidad y precisión de los datos

• Interactuar con equipos locales y globales, participando en instancias de coordinación y gestión de requerimientos con clientes internos de las oficinas locales

Required Qualifications

• Actuarios/as graduados o estudiantes avanzados de la carrera de Actuario.

• Experiencia mínima de 2-4 años en roles actuariales, preferentemente en Seguros de Vida.

• Conocimiento avanzado de Excel y lenguajes de programación.

• Nivel de inglés Upper Intermediate o superior, con capacidad para interactuar con equipos regionales y globales.

• Perfil con alta capacidad analítica, excelente comunicación, flexibilidad y pensamiento estratégico.

Preferred Qualifications

• Conocimiento de Prophet y de métricas actuariales y financieras como EEV, ALM y Economic Capital (EC).

• Habilidades de programación y automatización mediante herramientas como VBA, Python, R u otros lenguajes,

• Experiencia con el uso de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial aplicadas al análisis, modelización, optimización de procesos y generación de insights.

Beneficios que Ofrecemos

Nuestros beneficios están diseñados para cuidar tu bienestar integral mediante programas de salud física y mental, bienestar financiero y apoyo a las familias. Ofrecemos cobertura de atención médica para ti y tu familia, descuentos en seguros para proteger tu hogar, automóvil y mascotas, así como licencia parental. También ofrecemos una membresía premium de gimnasio para ti y tus familiares directos, tiempo libre para voluntariado, descuentos en universidades seleccionadas, viernes flexibles, reembolso de gastos de conectividad y mucho más.

Acerca de MetLife

Reconocida por Fortune entre las compañías más admiradas del mundo y los mejores lugares para trabajar, MetLife es una de las compañías líderes de servicios financieros a nivel global. A través de nuestras subsidiarias y afiliadas, ofrecemos seguros, anualidades, beneficios para empleados y soluciones de gestión de activos a clientes individuales e institucionales. Con presencia en más de 40 mercados, ocupamos posiciones de liderazgo en Estados Unidos, Latinoamérica, Asia, Europa y Medio Oriente.

Como parte de nuestra estrategia New Frontier, estamos construyendo un futuro centrado en las personas e impulsado por la Inteligencia Artificial. Buscamos personas curiosas, adaptables y con mentalidad de crecimiento, que quieran aprovechar el potencial de la IA para transformar la forma en que trabajamos, mejoramos la experiencia de nuestros clientes y generamos valor para nuestras comunidades. En MetLife, la IA es una herramienta que complementa el criterio humano, potencia la creatividad y promueve la mejora continua, siempre de manera responsable y ética.

Nuestro propósito es simple: ayudar a nuestros colaboradores, clientes, comunidades y a la sociedad en general a construir un futuro más seguro y confiable. Guiados por nuestros valores Ganamos Juntos, Hacemos lo Correcto, Generamos Impacto por Encima de la Actividad y Pensamos en el Futuro, trabajamos para transformar el futuro de los servicios financieros.

#AllTogetherPossible. Súmate a MetLife.

postings.title: Service Innovation & Client Engagement Associate
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

Join the Global Service Delivery Innovation team and help transform how Global GCB Client Service engages clients. This role will advance two connected priorities: scaling a practical near-term model for proactive client meetings that strengthens relationships and supports growth, and building the data, insight, workflow, automation, and measurement capabilities required to sustain that model globally.

You will own defined workstreams, translate strategy into structured deliverables, and coordinate across Service, Product, Operations, Data, and Technology. The successful candidate will combine strong problem-solving, communication, and execution skills with the ability to turn complex ideas into clear materials, decisions, and measurable outcomes.

Job Summary

As a Service Innovation & Client Engagement Associate within Global Service Delivery Innovation, you will drive workstreams that make proactive client engagement more consistent, effective, and scalable across Global GCB Client Service. In the near term, you will develop client-meeting materials, preparation standards, playbooks, engagement triggers, follow-up practices, and pilot approaches that help service teams hold more consultative conversations and identify opportunities to deepen relationships, improve adoption, and support growth.

In parallel, you will help define and deliver the future-state capabilities required for long-term scale, including integrated client insights, standardized content, AI-assisted preparation, workflow orchestration, action tracking, outcome measurement, and governance. You will partner across functions to gather requirements, evaluate options, manage dependencies, and move priorities from concept through implementation.

Job Responsibilities

• Own defined workstreams across the proactive engagement and future-state capabilities agenda, establishing plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and measures of success.

• Develop globally consistent client-meeting materials, briefing templates, discussion guides, and follow-up tools that help service teams deliver consultative, insight-led conversations.

• Design and test the near-term engagement model, including client selection, engagement triggers, preparation requirements, meeting formats, roles, governance, and outcome tracking.

• Partner with regional service leaders and frontline teams to gather feedback, incorporate regional needs, and translate pilot learnings into repeatable standards and playbooks.

• Define business requirements and user journeys for future-state capabilities spanning client insights, recommendations, AI-assisted preparation, workflow, action management, and measurement.

• Coordinate with Product, Technology, Data, Operations, and Control partners to evaluate solutions, resolve dependencies, and advance delivery.

• Analyze client, engagement, and operational data to identify opportunities, develop recommendations, and quantify expected business and client impact.

• Create business cases, executive presentations, governance materials, and decision documents for senior stakeholders.

• Establish metrics and reporting to measure adoption, engagement quality, follow-through, client outcomes, growth opportunities, and operational efficiency.

• Facilitate working sessions, document decisions, maintain accountability, and escalate risks or trade-offs requiring leadership attention.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

• 3+ years of experience in strategy, business management, consulting, client service, product, operations, program delivery, or a related field.

• Demonstrated ability to independently manage workstreams and deliver high-quality outputs in a complex, matrixed environment.

• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data and stakeholder input into clear recommendations.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing presentations and materials for senior audiences.

• Strong project management, organization, and prioritization skills with attention to detail and follow-through.

• Ability to build relationships, influence stakeholders, and drive alignment without direct authority.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

• Experience in financial services, banking, payments, or a global client service organization.

• Experience supporting client engagement, relationship management, service reviews, or growth-oriented programs.

• Experience translating business needs into product, data, workflow, automation, or AI capability requirements.

• Experience with pilot design, user testing, change management, or adoption measurement.

• Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel or comparable presentation and analytical tools.

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Global Banking business is one of the largest wholesale banking client franchises in the world. We serve clients, including corporations, governments, states, municipalities, healthcare organizations, education institutions, banks and investors.

Global Investment Banking supports a broad range of corporations, institutions and governments by providing strategic advice, capital raising and risk management expertise.

postings.title: Head of Exchange Infrastructure
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We're looking for a Head of Exchange Infrastructure to own the layer every Kraken product is built on: the matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, the algo engine and the API engine. Kraken grew up as a set of vertically integrated products, each with its own engine and its own APIs. This role consolidates them into a single exchange stack that serves every product and every interface. You will lead a team of four to five product managers, partnered with an engineering manager. It is a senior, independent team, which means you get leverage quickly and you are expected to stay close to the work.

The opportunity

• Own the product vision and roadmap for the exchange layer: matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, algo engine and API engine

• Lead and grow a team of four to five product managers, and set the bar for product craft across the layer

• Lead the consolidation of multiple matching engines into one, starting with US derivatives, then international derivatives, then spot

• Build interface-agnostic, so every product team and every interface can build on the same platform rather than their own

• Define success metrics (p99 latency, throughput, uptime, resiliency) and hold teams accountable to them

• Partner with engineering leaders across exchange and core infrastructure to sequence the migration without disrupting live markets

• Partner with Risk and Credit Infrastructure so a client can hold one account and trade every product against it

• Anticipate industry shifts and shape our platform to stay ahead

• Align cross-functional teams (product, engineering, risk, compliance) around the exchange strategy

What You Bring

• Senior product leader with experience in exchange, trading, or high-performance platforms

• Experience managing and developing product managers, on a team senior enough to run without you in the room

• Happy to be a player-coach. This team is independent, so you will own roadmaps and write specs yourself at times, not only review them

• Proven ability to set product vision and translate it into a long-term roadmap

• Strong understanding of matching engine and market data architecture, and the tradeoffs low latency forces

• Experience building platforms for internal customers, with the judgment to tell a platform from a series of bespoke builds

• Excellent communication skills — can influence technical and non-technical stakeholders

• A passion for crypto markets, market structure, and building the next generation of infrastructure

Nice to haves

• Engineering background before moving into product, so you've built or operated high-performance systems yourself and not just specced them

• Experience across both spot and derivatives venues, with the market structure differences that come with each

• Time at a crypto exchange operating at comparable scale, volume and uptime expectations

• Track record building platform roadmaps that interlock with adjacent product orgs rather than running in isolation

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

postings.descriptionText:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

About The Role

Monks is seeking a Creative Technologist in Buenos Aires to serve as the vital connective tissue between high-concept creative design , emerging technical execution, and top-tier global client delivery. We are looking for someone who bridges an undeniable design eye with deep technical acumen , optimizing for a candidate with a high-quality track record of applying novel and emerging technologies to scale top-tier creative output across multimodal mediums rather than sheer length of tenure.

In this role, you will embody the philosophy of selecting the right technical approach for the right job—pragmatically evaluating, benchmarking, and pairing the ideal tools, generative AI models, node-based computational workflows, and tech stacks tailored specifically to the brief at hand.

Operating in a highly dynamic environment, you will collaborate across diverse multidisciplinary partners—including Account Management, Program & Project Management, Creative Directors, and Technical Leads—as well as interfacing directly with client teams.

Above all, this position requires a proactive, project-enhancing mindset. We need a self-starter who actively seeks out ways to elevate creative delivery, anticipates roadblocks, and shapes project outcomes rather than waiting for the next ticket to show up in a queue.

Responsibilities

• Technical Evaluation & Benchmarking ("Right AI Approach for the Creative System"): Systematically evaluate and benchmark the output quality of various tools, frameworks, and generative AI models against one another to select the most suitable approach for high-fidelity creative delivery.

• Proactive Delivery Enhancement: Drive projects forward with an ownership mindset—actively identifying opportunities to elevate quality, optimize pipelines, and streamline execution without waiting for top-down task assignments.

• Multimodal GenAI & Node Workflows: Harness, benchmark, and orchestrate generative AI models across modalities (image, music, voiceover, video manipulation) and construct node-based computational workflows to scale creative execution.

• Brand Nuance & Contextual Adaptation: Understand and execute the subtle nuances of various brand marks and identity systems across physical, digital, and game-style worlds.

• Upfront Feasibility Evaluation: Interrogate briefs early alongside Creative Directors and strategy leads to assess technical viability, flag platform limitations, define optimal tech stacks, and protect creative ambition before production begins.

• Cross-Functional & Client Engagement: Partner dynamically across internal disciplines (Account Managers, Program/Project Managers, Creative Directors, and Technical Leads) and engage directly with client teams to present prototypes and manage delivery milestones.

• Proactive Global Communication: Maintain continuous alignment across global teams and client partners with exceptional English communication—setting expectations early, raising flags proactively, and translating complex technical trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders.

About You

The Essentials:

• Design Eye Meets Technical Acumen: High visual design sensitivity (typography, UI/UX polish, spatial aesthetics) combined with clean coding abilities.

• AI-Native Development Fluency: Comfort working within modern AI-assisted development environments (e.g., Anti-Gravity, Cursor, Claude Code) to rapidly build, iterate, and ship solutions. Working knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern web standards (CSS, Tailwind) is expected, along with the ability to read, diagnose, and debug code but deep traditional full-stack depth is not a hard requirement. We're optimizing for speed and craft in AI-assisted iteration over classical engineering tenure.

• System & Model Benchmarking Track Record: Proven experience evaluating, testing, and benchmarking emerging technical systems and generative AI models to determine output quality and suitability for tier-1 brand execution.

• Proactive, Anti-Ticket Mindset: A self-directed operator who thrives in dynamic environments, takes initiative to solve unstated problems, and focuses on enhancing overall project delivery rather than passively checking off tickets.

• Multimodal Generative AI Stack: Familiarity with generative AI models across image, music, voiceover/audio synthesis, and video manipulation/editing.

• Modern Design & Creative Tools: Proficiency with modern design platforms (Framer, Figma) and the Adobe Creative Cloud suite, along with familiarity with node-based creative logic systems (e.g., ComfyUI, Weavy).

• Brand System Literacy: Proven ability to navigate, interpret, and maintain brand identity integrity across diverse visual environments (digital, physical, and gaming/3D contexts).

• Global English Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English with the confidence to lead technical conversations with client teams and collaborate across global time zones.

Nice-to-Haves / Pluses

• Nodal / VFX Background: Experience with Nuke, Fusion, Houdini, or ComfyUI is a huge plus. This background signals a proven ability to architect the technical processes needed to reach beautifully crafted, production-grade output.

• Google Platform & Web Ecosystem: Familiarity with Google web standards, Google Cloud tools, or Google creative and media platforms.

• Scalable Multimodal & 3D Delivery: Hands-on technical execution to scale creative assets across web, 3D interactive environments, and spatial mediums, maintaining strict visual and performance standards.

• 3D Web Frameworks: Experience with Three.js, WebGL, or Babylon.js.

Application Requirements

• Portfolio submission required with application. Please include examples that speak to craft quality and technical problem-solving, not just final polish.

About Monks

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. postings.title: Google Ads Strategist - Home Services
postings.descriptionText:
Founding Google Ads Strategist, Home Services
Sustain Media | Remote | Full-time contractor | U.S. Eastern Time hours

Sustain Media is a local SEO and Google Ads agency built only for home service businesses: roofers, plumbers, HVAC companies, electricians, landscapers, restoration companies, and auto shops. Most of our clients are owner-operated businesses doing $2M to $10M a year. Our job is simple: more calls and more booked jobs.

We're hiring a founding Google Ads Strategist to manage accounts and help us build a Google Ads division that runs on AI far more than any agency we compete with.

What makes this role different
We already use AI agents for a lot of the repetitive work most agencies still do by hand: search term mining, campaign audits, performance checks, and reporting data pulls. We want to take that much further, and we need someone who knows Google Ads well enough to show us where.

You'll work side by side with our AI systems team to build the systems behind your accounts. You know where the time goes and where mistakes happen, so you'll help decide what gets automated next. The more we build together, the more of your week goes to strategy.

The most important part of that strategy is attribution. You'll set up and build out attribution systems for every client, connecting ad spend to calls, leads, and the jobs they actually book. That's how we know our campaigns are adding booked work for the business, beyond what Google Ads reports as leads. This work happens behind the scenes. It isn't client-facing.

This is a founding role. You'll help decide how our Google Ads division works, which systems it runs on, and what the strategists who join after you inherit.

What you'll own

• Your own book of clients. You'll own roughly 20 to 25 accounts end to end, working alongside another PPC specialist who manages a separate book.

• Lead generation. These campaigns exist to drive phone calls, form fills, and booked jobs. You need to know how to build for that and measure it the way a business owner does: qualified lead volume, cost per lead, booked work, and return on spend.

• Tracking and attribution. Google Ads can show a pile of conversions while the client says the phone isn't ringing. You'll own conversion tracking on every account, and when our numbers don't match the client's, you find out why. That means going into their CRM and call tracking, matching leads to real booked jobs, and using AI tools to work through the data faster. You'll know which campaigns are making the client money and which ones only look good inside Google Ads.

• New account builds. When a client signs, you build the account from zero: keyword research, campaign structure, ad copy, bidding, geo-targeting, conversion tracking, and launch.

• Judgment calls. Our AI agent hands you audits and diagnostics. You decide what to do with them. Which bid strategy fits an account with 20 conversions a month versus 100. When Performance Max is helping, and when it's hiding poor lead quality or wasting spend. When to restructure instead of optimizing around a bad setup.

• Landing pages and offers. You work with our development and SEO teams so ad traffic lands on pages that convert. You guide the messaging and structure. You don't build the pages.

• Building the systems. You'll work with our AI systems team to automate the work that slows you down, like account audits, search term reviews, tracking checks, and reporting. You point out the problem, help design the fix, and test it on your accounts until it does the work the way a great strategist would. Reporting already works this way: our agent pulls the data, and you write the story and the plan for next month.

What success looks like
The biggest measure of success in this role is being able to PROACTIVELY troubleshoot client accounts that seem to be working on our end, but aren't booking real jobs for the clients. A major part of this is getting attribution right, so we know which campaigns are producing real booked jobs for each business.

In your first 90 days, you take full ownership of your book, check tracking on every account against the client's own records, find the biggest opportunities, and set a clear strategy for each one.
Longer term, success means more qualified leads and more booked jobs for your clients, and a Google Ads division that runs on systems you helped build.

What we're looking for
We care more about results than years of experience. This is not an entry-level role.

Must-haves

• Proven results running lead generation campaigns for local home service businesses

• Hands-on experience with Search, Performance Max, and Local Service Ads

• Strong conversion tracking and attribution skills. When a client says the leads aren't coming in, "the dashboard looks fine" is not an answer. You're comfortable going into a client's CRM and call data to verify what's real.

• You can build an account from zero and defend every major choice you made

• You read data and make strategic recommendations, not just report what a dashboard says

• Strong written communication. You'll be in Slack daily.

Strong pluses

• Tracing ad spend through call tracking and offline conversions all the way to booked jobs

• CallRail or a similar call tracking platform

• Knowing how Google Business Profile and local SEO work together with paid search

• Agency experience managing multiple accounts at once

• Hands-on with AI tools for analysis and problem-solving. You don't need to code, but you should want to help design the systems that replace manual work.

The environment

• Contractor position, paid biweekly

• Base pay: $3,000 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience

• On-target earnings (OTE): $4,500 to $5,500 USD per month with a full, mature book

• Revenue share: once a client has been with us for 3 months, you start earning a monthly share on that account. It steps up the longer the client stays and is paid every month for as long as they stay.

• Daily tools: Google Ads, CallRail, Slack, Airtable, Google Sheets, and our AI agents

• You can work from anywhere in the world, but you must work U.S. Eastern Time business hours. There's no time tracking, and there never will be, but the Eastern Time schedule is non-negotiable. If you can't commit to these hours, please don't apply.

• Our clients are month to month with no long-term contracts. We earn the business every 30 days, so the work has to be good.

• Small, senior team. You work directly with the founder and the operations team.

postings.descriptionText:
Campaign Executive (Paid Social)

Fully Remote | Global, Independent Growth Agency | $36,000 - $40,000 |

About Webtopia:
Webtopia is a global, remote-first independent growth agency, led by twins Tris and Ben Dyer. Tris brings the long-term vision; both are driven by a shared curiosity about how brands grow and what it takes to build something that lasts.

Today we support brands across fashion, beauty, health and wellness, home, jewellery and more. Our work blends creative thinking, data-led strategy and performance expertise, grounded in a belief in people and the brands they're building.

We're a lean, deliberately-not-scaling team of around 20 people across Webtopia and Oaks. Rather than growing headcount for its own sake, we hold ourselves to a target of £100k+ revenue per head - which means every hire matters and every team member owns real client outcomes.

We operate on a pod model: Pod Lead → Campaign Manager → Executive , backed by shared creative, ops and finance resource. We're social-led and multi-channel — Meta is our engine, Google sits as a support channel, and we bring in TikTok, Pinterest and Klaviyo where they genuinely fit the brand.

Some proof points on the kind of scale we operate at:

• Grown a client (CVG) to ~$9M in gross profit

• Team members managing £500–600k/month in spend before joining us

• A BFCM campaign that scaled spend 646% YoY , drove revenue up 800% , and delivered a 12.48 ROAS

AI fluency is a hard requirement for this role, not a nice-to-have. We've built AI and automation into how our Executives work, and you'll be expected to use tools like Claude every day to move faster and more accurately.

The Role:
We're hiring two Campaign Executives to join our growing pods. As a Campaign Executive, you're the engine room of performance . You'll build, optimise and report on paid social campaigns every day across a portfolio of 4–6 client accounts , working closely with your Campaign Manager and Pod Lead to keep every account accurate, efficient and moving forward.

If that sounds like more accounts than you're used to, that's by design. AI and automation are built into how our Executives work, taking care of the repetitive build, checking and reporting tasks so you can manage a bigger portfolio without cutting corners.

This isn't a client-facing role, but clear written communication matters: you'll be sharing updates, flagging issues and documenting your work for the team in writing, every day.

Campaign Build & Optimisation

• Build paid social campaigns accurately and quickly, primarily on Meta, following the strategy set by your Campaign Manager

• Carry out daily account checks and optimisations to keep clients on track against their KPIs

• Monitor pacing and spend so budgets are delivered as agreed

• Launch and test new creative and audience approaches as soon as assets are ready

• Use AI tools and automation to speed up builds, checks and reporting without sacrificing accuracy

Diagnosis & Account Health

• Spot inefficiencies early - wasted spend, creative fatigue, audience overlap, tracking gaps - and bring a clear recommendation

• Keep an eye on pixel, Conversions API and Shopify backend setup so data stays reliable

• Look beyond ad metrics to site performance, flagging anything on the client side that's holding results back

Reporting & Communication

• Pull together accurate performance reports and insight for your Campaign Manager and Pod Lead

• Communicate clearly and concisely in writing, using Slack and ClickUp, so the team always knows the status of your accounts

• Flag problems quickly and honestly. Catching an error early always beats hiding it

Team & Innovation

• Share wins, tests and lessons with the wider media buying team

• Bring new ideas - whether that's a creative angle, a platform feature or a smarter way to automate a task

• Live our values day to day and help build a team-first culture across time zones

How You'll Be Measured:
We're transparent about what good looks like. Your performance will be reviewed against:

• Accuracy: error count across builds, launches and reporting

• Scale: ad spend and revenue managed across your accounts

• Speed: turnaround time on tasks

• Culture: how you live our values and work with the team

• Innovation: new ideas, tests and improvements you bring

Where This Role Leads:
This is a genuine first step on a clear path: Executive → Campaign Manager → Pod Lead . It isn't theoretical, either - two of our three current Pod Leads started as Campaign Executives . If you do the work and live the values, we'll invest in getting you there.

A Day in the Life:
Expect a mix of morning account checks and pacing, hands-on campaign builds and optimisation, launching new creative, digging into data to diagnose what's working (and what isn't), and writing clear updates for your pod. Most of your collaboration happens in Slack and ClickUp, with regular check-ins during the hours you overlap with the UK.

What You'll Bring:
Must-haves:

• 1–2 years of direct, hands-on Meta Ads experience , with a track record of building and optimising campaigns

• Working knowledge of Shopify

• Daily use of Claude or other AI tools in your workflow

• Ability to diagnose account inefficiencies and explain what you'd change and why

• Awareness of pixel, Conversions API and backend tracking setup

• Clear, accurate written communication

Nice-to-haves:

• TikTok, Pinterest and/or Google Ads experience

• Creative strategy experience: a strong plus

• Influencer or creator marketing experience: a strong plus

• Comfortable with Slack, ClickUp and G-Suite

Skills and approach:

• Detail-obsessed: you check your work before anyone else has to

• Proactive and comfortable working unsupervised

• Curious about why campaigns perform the way they do

• A genuine team player

Our values come first - literally. They're the basis of the first stage of our interview process, before we even get into skills and experience:

• Partner Obsession - we think alongside our clients, not just for them

• Collaboration - we win as a team, across pods and departments

• Integrity - we do right by our clients and each other, even when it's hard

• Curiosity & Growth - we stay hungry to learn, question assumptions, and keep getting better

Engagement & Benefits

• Full-time independent contractor engagement on a fixed monthly fee of $3000

• Flexible working week , with hours spread to suit you and your pod's time zone overlap

• Reduced hours over Christmas, with no requirement to use time off

• Cultural and religious holidays observed (e.g. Eid, Holi, Thanksgiving)

• Fully remote, with a clear progression path to Campaign Manager.

postings.title: Paid Search Strategist, DTC eCommerce (Remote)
postings.descriptionText:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

• Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month

• Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working

• Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people

• Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing

• Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target

• Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule

• Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery

• Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why

• Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team

• Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt

You are a fit if

• You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search

• You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have

• You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it

• You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list

• You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard

• You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you

• Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too

You are not a fit if

• "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed

• You want to be told what to do this week

• You need a ticketing system to know what matters

• You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

• Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month

• Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working

• Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people

• Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing

• Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target

• Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule

• Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery

• Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why

• Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team

• Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt

You are a fit if

• You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search

• You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have

• You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it

• You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list

• You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard

• You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you

• Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too

You are not a fit if

• "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed

• You want to be told what to do this week

• You need a ticketing system to know what matters

• You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

About The Role

As a Media Campaign Agent , you will make an impact by successfully executing end-to-end Ads campaigns across the LATAM market, ensuring high-quality implementations, on-time delivery, and exceptional stakeholder collaboration. You will be a valued member of the MCM team and work collaboratively with Sales teams, internal support teams, Account Managers, and external clients .

In This Role, You Will:

• Execute end-to-end campaign implementations, ensuring adherence to client requirements, timelines, and quality standards.

• Manage project timelines, proactively identify risks and roadblocks, and drive resolutions to ensure successful campaign delivery.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with Sales teams, internal stakeholders, and external clients through clear and effective communication.

• Conduct quality assurance checks to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and compliance throughout the implementation process.

• Demonstrate a proactive, solution-oriented mindset by anticipating client needs, resolving issues effectively, and contributing to process improvements.

Work Model

Hybrid Role

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring attendance in a client or Cognizant office as needed. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need to Have to Be Considered

• Native-level Spanish proficiency.

• Advanced Portuguese proficiency.

• Upper-intermediate English proficiency or higher.

• Experience coordinating projects, campaigns, or operational initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear guidance and maintain positive stakeholder relationships.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify risks and implement effective solutions.

• Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality and accuracy.

• Ability to work independently, demonstrate ownership, and adapt quickly to changing priorities.

These Will Help You Stand Out

• Degree or certification in Business Administration, Marketing, Information Systems, Project Management, Event Planning, or a related field.

• Experience supporting digital advertising, online marketing, or Ads campaigns.

• Familiarity with project management methodologies and agile ways of working.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional and client-facing teams in a multicultural environment.

• Familiarity with AI and productivity tools such as Gemini, NotebookLM, ChatGPT, and Microsoft Copilot.
