Nuestro equipo de Channels

Vas a formar parte del equipo de Channels de Tiendanube, responsable de potenciar y expandir el ecosistema de agencias que acompañan el crecimiento de nuestros clientes. Nuestra misión es maximizar la adquisición de nuevas tiendas y el volumen de ventas (GMV) a través de canales estratégicos, brindando soluciones integrales al mercado.

Como Partner Program Leader, asumirás un rol clave para adaptar la estrategia global e impulsar iniciativas locales de alto impacto, liderando el desarrollo, la educación y el crecimiento continuo de nuestras agencias asociadas.

El tamaño de tu desafío

• Liderar la ejecución y evolución local del programa de partners, adaptando las directrices globales a las dinámicas del mercado.

• Diseñar e implementar campañas de incentivos y planes de crecimiento para acelerar el desarrollo y escalamiento de agencias de alto potencial.

• Gestionar la plataforma de learning que aloja Partner Academy a nivel local.

• Diseñar y ejecutar, en conjunto con Product Marketing y Partner Marketing, sesiones de enablement de producto, con foco en adopción y generación de negocio para las agencias.

• Diseñar y ejecutar el enablement interno del equipo, para que esté capacitado para acompañar a las agencias y sostener los resultados del programa.

• Representar la voz del programa frente a las agencias en eventos, webinars y presentaciones estratégicas presenciales y virtuales.

• Actuar como punto de contacto local para equipos regionales y globales (RevOps, CX, Product Marketing, Affiliates, entre otros). Participar, gestionar o coordinar proyectos en conjunto con estos equipos manteniendo estándares de calidad y relacionamiento con las agencias.

• Monitorear indicadores clave de rendimiento (GMV, adopción de productos, certificaciones y upgrades de nivel) para identificar oportunidades de mejora continua.

Lo que buscamos

• Experiencia previa en roles de Partner/Channel Management, Alliances, Account Management o Customer Success B2B, idealmente en empresas de ecommerce, SaaS o plataformas tecnológicas.

• Perfil analítico y orientado a datos, con autonomía para tomar decisiones estratégicas y resolver problemas complejos.

• Habilidad de comunicación clara y oratoria para liderar presentaciones efectivas frente a audiencias estratégicas y eventos en vivo.

• Capacidad para construir relaciones de confianza e influir en equipos multidisciplinarios sin tener autoridad formal directa.

• Actitud proactiva con foco constante en la experiencia del cliente y el impacto directo en el negocio.

Es un plus

• Experiencia coordinando programas de alianzas, gestión de canales o proyectos comerciales en entornos SaaS, e-commerce o tecnología.

• Experiencia previa trabajando con programas estructurados por niveles (tiers), sistemas de comisiones o esquemas de incentivos.

• Experiencia en el diseño y ejecución de iniciativas de capacitación o enablement para partners o clientes B2B.

Nuestro proceso

Queremos que tengas la mejor experiencia posible a lo largo de nuestro proceso de selección. Después de que te postules, el equipo de Talent Acquisition va a analizar tu perfil con atención e, independientemente del resultado, vas a recibir una respuesta.

Las etapas y los plazos pueden variar según cada vacante, pero no te preocupes — vamos a mantenernos en contacto con vos durante todo el proceso.

Lo que te proponemos

• Cobertura de salud OSDE 310 para el grupo familiar (cónyuge + hijos);

• Clases de portugués 100% cubiertas;

• Reintegro del servicio de Internet;

• Descuentos en cursos de Coderhouse;

• La asistencia de guardería es un beneficio que tiene como objetivo apoyar a los colaboradores en la provisión de un entorno seguro para sus hijos desde los 45 días de vida, hasta los 3 años de edad, durante tu jornada laboral;

• Licencia familiar extendida a 21 días corridos para personas no gestantes o adoptantes;

• 15 días hábiles de vacaciones a lo largo del año;

• Además de las vacaciones, disponemos de una semana de descanso para recargar energías entre final/principio de nuevo año;

• Una Tiendanube gratuita para vos o alguien de tu entorno;

• Somos #remotefirst, priorizamos el trabajo remoto dentro del país de contratación, siempre que el rol lo permita;

• Es un entorno de desafío constante, propósito y protagonismo — acá la innovación nace de pensar en grande y tener actitud gigante.

Política de Privacidad

Tiendanube se compromete a proteger la privacidad y garantizar la seguridad de las personas indicadas para las vacantes que ofrecemos.

Para analizar tu solicitud, tendremos acceso a parte de tu información que será revisada antes de continuar. Utilizaremos estos datos para realizar los procesos de reclutamiento y selección. Además, cuidamos muy en serio a nuestras personas y solo compartimos información realmente necesaria. En última instancia, solo los mantendremos en nuestro sistema durante el tiempo que realmente lo necesitemos.

Para obtener más información sobre cómo manejamos los datos, incluidos tus derechos según la ley, simplemente accedé a nuestra Política de Privacidad.

postings.title: Volunteer Academic Researcher to Join Small Global Team for Consults and Projects of Ashoka Fellows with Ashoka
postings.descriptionText:
This is an opportunity to work with an Ashoka Staff

This is an unpaid, volunteer opportunity

About The Affiliated Organization

Founded in 1980, Ashoka pioneered the field of social entrepreneurship. We are now the largest association of leading social entrepreneurs in the world, a network of 4000+ Ashoka Fellows in 99 countries at work creating systemic change on the most pressing social and environmental issues of our time. We find, support and collaborate with our Fellows to help scale their solutions across nations and continents and work with a wide range of partners to create an "Everyone a Changemaker" world, one in which we all can find and develop our power to create meaningful change for the good of all.

For more information, please visit www.ashoka.org

Job Description

Ashoka is looking for senior-level professionals in specializing in academic qualitative and quantitative research who can provide our staff and Fellows with professional consults and project based engagement. These skillsets are highly valued by Ashoka Fellows, especially in academic fields in which they are working.

We are creating an elite team of 10-12 members from different world regions (to reflect cultural contexts and language) in this field and in nine others of similarly high-value skillsets. We are calling these members Professional Support Partners (PSPs) rather than "volunteers" to reflect the expertise and commitment to impact you will bring to our global community.

As an Ashoka Support Partner your expertise will be promoted to staff and Fellows over the course of two to three months. If there is a need that meets your interests and availability, an introduction will be made so that you can learn more details about the support partnership and ways that you can contribute. Until that time your name and contact details will be held confidentially to protect your privacy.

Please let us know today if you'd like to join us!

Volunteer Logistics

Estimated hours required per week: Flexible and Variable depending on project

The estimated duration of the project is: 1-3 months

This position is Virtual (Remote)

Language Requirements

English plus

Desired Skills And Experience

Candidates should combine advanced methodological expertise with strong social-entrepreneurship literacy, systems-change evaluation experience, and the ability to translate complex evidence into actionable learning for diverse, globally distributed innovators.

Core Qualifications And Experience

• Advanced degree in a relevant field (e.g., Development Economics, Public Policy, Statistics, Social Sciences, Epidemiology, Data Science, or Health Economics); master’s preferred, with 6-8 years of research experience.

• Mixed-methods expertise: strong command of both quantitative (panel data, statistical inference, quasi-experimental designs such as difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity, synthetic control, interrupted time series) and qualitative methods (case studies, theory of change validation, participatory approaches).

• Social-impact and systems-change evaluation: experience evaluating social entrepreneurship, nonprofit programs, or systems-change initiatives; familiarity with proxy indicators, longitudinal tracking, and attribution challenges typical of early-stage ventures.

• Technical tools: fluency in statistical software (Stata, R, or Python), advanced Excel/Sheets, and data visualization tools; ability to write defensible methodology sections and produce donor/investor-ready impact reports.

Ashoka-specific competencies

• SROI and cost-effectiveness: experience with Social Return on Investment (SROI), ROI, or cost-effectiveness analysis is highly valued, especially for Fellows needing investor- or partner-ready evidence.

• Global and intercultural fluency: ability to work across 95+ countries, adapt methods to varied contexts, and communicate clearly in English (additional languages like Spanish, French, Hindi are a plus).

• Capacity strengthening: skill in coaching Fellows and local teams to design lean, credible measurement systems that fit early-stage resource constraints while still producing decision-useful evidence

Soft Skills And Working Style

• Analytical writing and storytelling: ability to synthesize complex findings into concise briefs, dashboards, and narratives for Fellows, partners, and institutional donors.

• Collaboration and empathy: comfort partnering with entrepreneurial leaders who may be measurement novices; ability to balance rigor with pragmatism and maintain a “do no harm” ethics stance in sensitive contexts.

• Learning orientation: commitment to embedding learning loops (not just reporting) so Fellows can iterate on strategy based on evidence.

• Capacity strengthening: skill in coaching Fellows and local teams to design lean, credible measurement systems that fit early-stage resource constraints while still producing decision-useful evidence

Soft Skills And Working Style

• Analytical writing and storytelling: ability to synthesize complex findings into concise briefs, dashboards, and narratives for Fellows, partners, and institutional donors.

• Collaboration and empathy: comfort partnering with entrepreneurial leaders who may be measurement novices; ability to balance rigor with pragmatism and maintain a “do no harm” ethics stance in sensitive contexts.

• Learning orientation: commitment to embedding learning loops (not just reporting) so Fellows can iterate on strategy based on evidence.

postings.title: Payment Rails Regional PSS, Vice President
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

Join J.P. Morgan Payments and help accelerate growth across Latin America. As a Payment Rails Regional Product Sales Specialist (Vice President), you will identify opportunities, shape client solutions, and drive disciplined sales execution across domestic payment rails. You will collaborate closely with sales, bankers, and product partners to deliver impactful outcomes. We value strategic, client-focused leaders who combine strong execution with clear communication.

As a Payment Rails Regional PSS, Vice President within J.P. Morgan Payments in Latin America, you will play a pivotal role in executing our growth strategy across the region. This role focuses on understanding and assessing clients' business flows to identify and develop new opportunities, driving growth acceleration and enhancing Domestic Payment Rails P&L in the region through a comprehensive range of sales activities.

Job Responsibilities

• Strategic Planning and Alignment: Collaborate with Payments Sales, Bankers, and Product teams across Latin America to ensure alignment in client solutions and strategic planning.

• Client Prospecting and Portfolio Mining: Identify and engage potential clients to expand market share, while mining the existing Payments portfolio for new business development opportunities.

• Portfolio Growth and Management: Manage client attrition, pursue portfolio growth with existing clients, and generate new business opportunities.

• Team Support and Collaboration: Assist team members with client pitches, opportunity analysis, and presentations to key stakeholders.

• Pipeline Management: Develop and manage target lists, execute pre-sales activities, and drive deals from inception to closure, including senior management reporting.

• Opportunity Analysis: Leverage internal data to conduct thorough opportunity analysis and measure progress against identified opportunities.

• Client Engagement: Coordinate with Payments Sales, JPM Bankers, and coverage teams for proactive client engagement, and develop tailored solution presentations.

• RFP Coordination: Work closely with Payments sales, product management, and the RFP team to coordinate responses and make informed pricing decisions.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

• Fluency in Spanish and English

• Experience supporting transaction banking, payments, or cash management solutions in a client-facing, sales support, or product-aligned role

• Demonstrated ability to work under direct portfolio growth targets in a competitive environment

• Strong written communication skills with experience producing client-ready documents and presentations

• Strong verbal communication skills with ability to participate in client calls and present alongside partners

• Ability to translate complex requirements into structured solution narratives and clear next steps

• Strong organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

• Experience with domestic payment rails and cross-border payment flows in Latin America with special focus in Southern cone countries.

• Experience creating dashboards or reporting to track pipeline performance and outcomes

• Familiarity with cash management use cases across accounts payable and accounts receivable workflows

• Experience using AI-enabled tools to improve day-to-day productivity and content development

The ideal candidate is someone who thrives in a dynamic, client-centric environment and is eager to directly drive the growth of a key strategic solution for J.P. Morgan. This role requires a deep understanding of domestic payment rails, corporate workflows, and the payments landscape, as well as the role of cash management solutions in AP/AR processes.

About Us

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

postings.title: IBM Global Alliance Director
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Global Alliances Director to join our strategic partnerships team who will be responsible for leading the IBM alliance team globally. Reporting to the Head of IHV Alliances, the IBM Global Alliance Director will work closely with IBM and Canonical teams in all geographies to develop and maintain strong relationships with senior executives at strategic partner organizations, fostering collaboration and alignment on joint business objectives. The IBM Global Alliance Director will manage and grow a global team of Business Development Managers and help them identify and pursue new business opportunities with IBM, driving revenue growth and market expansion, develop and execute go-to-market strategies for joint offerings, oversee the day-to-day management of the alliance including contract negotiations and performance tracking, and issue resolution. The IBM Global Alliance Director will also contribute to thought leadership initiatives, such as joint publications and joint customer events.

Location: This role will be based remotely in AMER regions.

The role entails

• Build and own the strategy and the development of the Alliance on a global level

• Expand strategic relationships and enable IBM teams on the partnership

• Grow business motions with IBM, across sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions

• Grow IBM's awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu

• Manage, develop and grow a team of experienced business development managers

• Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem

• Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner

• Travel internationally - to drive partnerships in person

• Align and support internal canonical field teams - identify, support, grow, transact

• Expand existing footprint with IBM customers with an aim to upsell to broader portfolio

What We Are Looking For In You

• Proven experience as an Alliance Manager/Director

• Solid experience in Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies

• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong relationships with executives at all levels.

• Strong business acumen and a strategic mindset, with a focus on driving revenue growth and market expansion.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively present complex ideas to a variety of audiences.

• Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality

• Passionate about Canonical products and mission

• Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with measurable goals

• Team player with superior accountability and customer support skills

• Experience managing cross-functional teams and track record of operational excellence

What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

• Oficios Técnicos y Sector Industrial: Mantenimiento, electricidad, mecánica, producción, logística y operaciones.

• Tecnología y Sistemas: Desarrollo de software, soporte técnico, infraestructura, datos y ciberseguridad.

• Comercial, Ventas y Atención al Cliente: Desarrollo de negocio, Customer Success y atención al cliente.

• Administración y Gestión: Contabilidad, finanzas, recursos humanos y gestión administrativa.

• Hostelería, Turismo y Servicios: Gestión hostelera, servicios generales y atención al público.

• Otras especialidades: Marketing, comunicación y diseño.

Requisitos generales

postings.descriptionText:
Our Experience Management (EM) team is committed to providing our client-serving professionals with relevant experiences to promote career development and growth. As an Experience Manager, you will be identifying talent with specific skill sets to build diverse teams supporting our clients. You’ll build relationships at all levels and be a trusted and strategic business advisor to our business leaders. You’ll also interact with various business functions, including finance, operations, and business development, and be a crucial piece in helping to drive our business in meeting strategic goals.

The opportunity

You will work to successfully execute resource/scheduling assignments that are complex and require extensive relationships with engagement managers. You’ll focus on matching resource needs with availability while taking into consideration skills required, personal preferences and engagement risk. You’ll coordinate with other EMs and client service leaders to balance workloads and address staffing needs as required.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Assign appropriate client service personnel to engagements by accessing information, reviewing options available and presenting recommendations based on policies and client requirements. Challenge, as appropriate, scheduled hours and personnel to make sure of efficient utilization of resources.

• Promote and monitor the sharing of resources; network with other team members across regions and service lines to address resource needs and/or conflicts.

• Identify and address scheduling risks (e.g., excessively high/low utilization, morale issues, performance issues, staff/engagement/client issues). Take action to decrease individuals’ unassigned time and balance the workload of engagement teams.

• Resolve conflicts with engagement team members to identify appropriate alternatives in a timely manner considering engagement requirements and developmental goals of supported staff.

• Build relationships and communicate continually with client service personnel to identify personal schedule preferences and/or career development goals.

• Focus on engagement needs by appropriately prioritizing staffing decisions.

• Counsel supported personnel as needed/requested; raise issues to leadership as appropriate.

• Work cross-functionally with other support functions, including recruiting, talent, and visa and immigration, to best support client servers.

• Read, review and interpret utilization and scheduling reports. Utilize scheduling tools to assist in forecasting hours, tracking utilization and monitoring headcount. Communicate data to leadership and drive strategic conversations to track plan utilization.

• Raise critical and complex issues identified to EM leadership.

Skills And Attributes For Success

• Strong analytical skills; detail-oriented

• Very strong communication skills, both oral and written

• Proficient at negotiation skills and conflict management

• Ability to be creative and “think outside the box”

• Advanced understanding of Excel

• Strong client service focus; responsive to requests and maintains a sense of urgency in resolving issues.

• Comfortable working longer hours as needed

To qualify for the role, you must have

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience

• 5-7 years of experience.

Ideally, you’ll also have

• Proficiency in Microsoft applications

• Strong problem-solving skills

What We Look For

We’re interested in knowledgeable professionals ready to take ownership for spotting trends and improving our processes. You’ll need to be naturally curious, ready to learn and have a genuine passion for improvement. If you’re aiming to influence change within a world class organization, all while developing your own career, this role is for you.

postings.title: Organizational Learning Advisor, Commercial
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What Organizational Learning & Development Does At Worldwide

The Organizational Learning Advisor, Commercial, is a business-facing role within the Global Organizational Learning & Development team, reporting into the People Strategy & Culture function. This role drives the learning and development strategy for the commercial organization, including business development, proposals and contracts, marketing, feasibility, and commercial operations. The Advisor consults with commercial leaders and partners with the People Partner team to identify capability gaps, skills needed, and opportunities for growth that support revenue growth, win rates, and the client experience. This position acts as an engagement and change agent supporting behavioral transformation and communication across client-facing teams. This is a build role. The commercial learning portfolio is being developed from the ground up, and the Advisor is responsible for establishing the strategy, structure, and curriculum.

What You Will Do

• Lead the learning and enablement strategy for the commercial function, aligned to growth targets, win rates, and client satisfaction priorities.

• Build the foundational commercial learning framework from the ground up, including competency models, role profiles, role-based learning paths, content standards, and intake and governance processes, and author content hands-on where dedicated design support is not available.

• Design and deliver onboarding and ramp-up learning journeys for new commercial hires to shorten time to productivity.

• Build role-based curricula and performance support covering selling skills, service line and therapeutic knowledge, RFI and RFP development, bid defense preparation, pricing and budgeting fundamentals, and client communication.

• Facilitate training sessions and workshops, delivering content in an engaging and impactful manner.

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with commercial leaders, subject matter experts, and key stakeholders across the organization to foster a culture of continuous learning and development.

• Coordinate change management communications and technology onboarding programs for commercial systems, processes, and go-to-market initiatives, and develop engaging content including tutorials, workshops, and e-learning modules.

• Conduct comprehensive needs analysis, consulting with commercial stakeholders to develop effective, targeted learning solutions, and applying methods to measure learning impact and return on investment (ROI) against commercial metrics such as ramp time, win rate, and proposal quality. Continuously gather user feedback and improve subsequent learning and development strategies.

• The Advisor will collaborate closely with the instructional design team and the LMS team to create, communicate, brand, launch, and measure compliance and training effectiveness for the commercial organization. This position requires excellent customer service skills and a strong background in learning and development.

• Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.

What You Will Bring To The Role

• Proven ability to design and implement training programs aligned with adult learning principles for experienced, client-facing professionals.

• Strong business acumen, with an understanding of the CRO commercial model, the drug development lifecycle, and how clients evaluate and select partners.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to measure and analyze training effectiveness, drive adoption and compliance, and connect learning outcomes to commercial performance.

• Ability to influence and build credibility with senior commercial stakeholders in a matrixed, global environment.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple projects and priorities.

Travel Requirements

Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% of the time, including domestic and international travel, to support client-facing teams, facilitate in-person training and workshops, and attend commercial meetings and events.

Your Experience

• Degree in Business, Marketing, Human Resources Management, Education, Life Sciences, or related discipline.

• 5+ years’ experience in learning and development, sales enablement, or commercial training, preferably within a CRO, pharmaceutical, or other client-facing services environment.

• Proven experience consulting and partnering with commercial client groups, such as business development, proposals and contracts, marketing, and feasibility, to identify and address learning and development needs.

• Demonstrated experience building a learning program or function from the ground up, including establishing structure, standards, and processes in the absence of existing infrastructure.

• Working knowledge of the commercial lifecycle, including lead generation, RFI and RFP response, bid defense, contract award, and ongoing client relationship management.

• Strong background in instructional design and LMS management.

• Experience supporting commercial systems and tools, such as CRM platforms, proposal and pricing systems, and content repositories, is preferred.

• Excellent customer service skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with commercial leaders and internal stakeholders.

• Exceptional communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to deliver engaging and impactful training sessions to client-facing audiences.

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit www.Worldwide.com or connect with us on LinkedIn.

Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed and, to that end, we prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and creativity. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative, and successful. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, military status, or other class protected by applicable law .

Company Description

Join an Award-Winning Personal Injury Law Firm

At The Ward Law Group, Our Mission Is Simple

Changing Lives. One Client at a Time

Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work for consecutive years, we are committed to delivering exceptional legal representation while creating an environment where talented professionals can grow, lead, and make a meaningful impact every day.

We believe our people are our greatest asset. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-accountability culture where every team member is empowered to make informed decisions, continuously improve, and deliver exceptional results for our clients. Every role contributes directly to helping injured individuals navigate one of the most challenging times in their lives while supporting the continued growth and success of our firm.

Our Core Values

Faith – We act with integrity, honesty, and purpose in everything we do.

Accountability – We take ownership of our work, our commitments, and the results we deliver.

Leadership – We lead by example, inspire others, embrace continuous improvement, and develop high-performing teams.

Loyalty – We build lasting relationships through trust, respect, and dedication to our clients, teammates, and community.

Service to Our Clients – We are committed to delivering compassionate, responsive, and exceptional service that maximizes every client's opportunity for success.

Service to Our Teammates – We foster a culture of collaboration, respect, support, and shared success where every team member has the opportunity to grow and thrive.

Service to Our Community – We believe in making a positive impact beyond the workplace by serving and strengthening the communities where we live and work.

If you are passionate about helping injured clients, thrive in a fast-paced, results-driven environment, and are committed to delivering exceptional client service while continuously growing your career, we invite you to join The Ward Law Group and help us change lives—one client at a time.

Job Description

Help injured clients keep more of their settlement.

The Ward Law Group is seeking an experienced Personal Injury Lien Resolution Associate to negotiate medical balances and help move settled cases toward disbursement. If you enjoy negotiation, take ownership of your files, and know how to keep a high-volume caseload moving, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful difference for clients.

What You’ll Do

• Negotiate hospital liens and medical provider balances under attorney supervision and firm procedures.

• Review medical bills, verify outstanding balances, and obtain supporting documentation.

• Submit reduction requests, follow up consistently, and obtain written confirmation of negotiated agreements.

• Maintain accurate records of balances, negotiations, agreements, and case status in Litify.

• Coordinate with attorneys and closing staff to resolve outstanding items and prepare files for settlement disbursement.

• Meet expectations for negotiated reductions, turnaround times, productivity, and accuracy.

• Refer legal questions and disputed liens requiring legal analysis to the appropriate attorney.

What You Bring

• At least two years of hands-on plaintiff personal injury reductions experience supporting a U.S. law firm.

• Direct experience negotiating with hospitals and medical providers, with the ability to explain your strategies and results.

• Experience independently managing a high-volume reductions caseload from balance verification through written agreements and closing coordination.

• Bilingual English and Spanish, with strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Proficiency with legal case management software and the ability to work independently in a remote environment; Litify experience preferred.

Remote Engagement Details

• Independent contractor remote position

• 40-hour workweek; schedule confirmed during the interview process.

• Reliable internet, a computer, and a quiet, professional workspace required.

• No employee benefits or paid time off.

Qualifications

• Please submit your resume in English

• Fluent in English and Spanish.

• Minimum 2 year of recent personal injury reductions, liens, or medical bill negotiation experience.

• Experience handling hospital reductions and negotiating directly with medical providers and collection entities.

• Experience working in a plaintiff personal injury law firm; Litify experience preferred.

Additional Information

Join Our Team

At The Ward Law Group, every role contributes to changing lives.

If you're looking for an opportunity to grow your litigation career, maximize client recoveries, and work alongside a high-performing legal team, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of a team committed to excellence, accountability, and changing lives—one client at a time.

The Ward Law Group is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at The Ward Law Group via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from The Ward Law Group HR/Recruitment will be deemed the sole property of The Ward Law Group. About JPMorganChase

JPMorganChase & Co. (NYSE: JPM) is a leading global financial services firm with assets of ＄3 trillion and operations in more than 60 countries. The firm is a leader in investment banking, financial services for consumers, small business and commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

Role Overview

The Latin America & Canada (LAC) Chief Data Office drives regional adoption of the Firm's data governance strategy, ensuring consistent application of firmwide data policies, standards, and procedures across the region's lines of business and legal entities, while meeting regional regulatory expectations and strengthening data risk oversight.

As a Vice President within the LAC Chief Data Office, you will lead regional execution of the Firm's data governance framework and regulatory compliance agenda, enhancing data risk oversight across lines of business and legal entities. This is an individual contributor role (no direct reports) requiring the ability to synthesize cross-country themes, exercise independent judgment, and critically assess and validate information provided by business and corporate function stakeholders, ensuring conclusions and governance records are well-supported and suitable for regulators and audits.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive implementation of data-related regulatory requirements across LAC legal entities, developing project plans and producing requirement summaries, defensible interpretations, and gap assessments; maintain an auditable record of decisions, approvals, and remediation status suitable for governance, audit, and potential regulatory review.

• Represent LAC in firmwide data governance initiatives ensuring the LAC legal-entity perspective is incorporated into firmwide designs and plans, assess regional impacts, and proactively raise, challenge, and escalate when initiatives are not fit-for-purpose.

• Exercise independent challenge and due diligence by developing and maintaining strong knowledge of LAC regulatory requirements; evaluate stakeholder inputs, test assumptions, and triangulate evidence. Probe inconsistencies through critical follow-up questions, escalate when conclusions are not defensible, and provide options with a clear recommendation and rationale.

• Act as a connector across the region, identifying themes, emerging risks, inconsistencies, and opportunities to standardize and improve governance execution

• Support regulatory exam / audit readiness by coordinating evidence, status updates, and written narratives in partnership with stakeholders.

• Foster a strong data culture across LOBs through training, communications, and targeted campaigns; tailor messaging appropriately for senior management and working teams.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree (Law, International Relations preferred).

• 6+ years in risk management, controls, governance, or regulatory compliance (financial services preferred).

• Demonstrated ability to identify patterns and inconsistencies across legal entities facing the same or similar requirements; synthesize evidence and independently challenge assumptions and interpretations.

• Comfortable operating in ambiguity while teams, standards, and processes are being established.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Proven ability to write clear, concise, and factual materials in Spanish and English for executive and regulatory audiences; Portuguese is a plus.

• Familiarity with data governance concepts (data quality, metadata, lineage, controls, issue management, privacy).

postings.title: Ingeniero de Proyectos Senior
postings.descriptionText:
Ubicación: San Juan, Argentina

Modalidad de trabajo: Presencial

Qué hacemos en Weir

Somos líderes globales en tecnología para la minería orientada a un futuro sostenible. Ayudamos a nuestros clientes a extraer los recursos que el mundo necesita de manera más eficiente y sostenible. El futuro de nuestro planeta depende de la transición hacia las energías renovables, y esa transición solo es posible gracias a los metales y minerales que producen nuestros clientes. Por ello, trabajamos junto a operaciones mineras en todo el mundo para mover menos roca, utilizar menos energía, gestionar el agua de forma responsable y generar menos residuos. Juntos impulsamos una minería más inteligente, eficiente y sostenible.

Genera tu impacto

Tendrás un papel clave en la resolución de desafíos del mundo real. Aplicarás tus conocimientos para entregar resultados que generan valor, ya sea a través de la ingeniería, la planificación o el soporte al cliente. Trabajarás con un propósito claro, aprenderás cada día y contribuirás a construir un futuro más sostenible.

Lo que harás

• Planificación Técnica de Proyectos: Planificar el desarrollo técnico de los proyectos definiendo alcance, requerimientos, cronogramas y criterios de ingeniería para asegurar una dirección clara del proyecto.

• Supervisión de Documentación: Supervisar la elaboración de planos, especificaciones, memorias de cálculo y toda la documentación técnica asociada a los proyectos, garantizando calidad y cumplimiento normativo.

• Coordinación Multifuncional: Coordinar actividades entre las áreas de Ingeniería, Administración, Comercial y partes interesadas externas para asegurar respuestas oportunas y completas a las solicitudes de cotización (RFQ) de los clientes.

• Gestión de Cotizaciones de Proyectos: Gestionar la dimensión técnico-comercial de los proyectos mediante la revisión de solicitudes de clientes, la distribución interna de información y la presentación de propuestas integrales dentro de los plazos establecidos.

• Control de Avance y Riesgos: Monitorear el progreso de los procesos de licitación, gestionar desviaciones, riesgos y cambios de alcance, e implementar acciones correctivas cuando sea necesario para resguardar la integridad del proyecto.

• Evaluación de Factibilidad Técnica: Analizar la viabilidad técnica de soluciones, materiales, componentes y procesos involucrados en los proyectos para respaldar una adecuada toma de decisiones.

• Aseguramiento del Cumplimiento: Garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares corporativos, requisitos contractuales y normativas regulatorias durante todo el ciclo de vida del proyecto.

• Comunicación con Clientes y Stakeholders: Mantener una comunicación permanente con clientes, empresas de ingeniería y otras partes interesadas durante las etapas de licitación y ejecución de proyectos, promoviendo la transparencia y la colaboración.

• Reportabilidad: Elaborar y presentar informes técnicos y de avance a la gerencia, manteniendo informadas a todas las partes involucradas sobre el estado de los proyectos.

• Disponibilidad para Viajar: Se podrán requerir viajes ocasionales para apoyar reuniones con clientes y actividades de coordinación de proyectos.

• Seguridad Primero: Demostrar un compromiso absoluto con nuestros comportamientos de cero daños, contribuyendo al desarrollo de una cultura de seguridad de clase mundial.

Lo que aportarás

Requisitos excluyentes

• Título profesional en Ingeniería Industrial, Mecánica, Electromecánica o carrera afín.

• Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en licitaciones y gestión de cotizaciones de proyectos.

• Nivel avanzado de inglés (B2-C1).

• Experiencia comprobada en gestión de proyectos y coordinación de actividades técnico-comerciales.

Requisitos deseable s

• Experiencia en el uso de MS Project.

• Certificación PMP (Project Management Professional) o similar.

• Conocimiento de portales de clientes y procesos RFQ.

• Experiencia en proyectos industriales o sectores relacionados. También se considerarán profesionales de Administración de Empresas u otras disciplinas afines con experiencia relevante.

¿Por qué unirte a Weir?

Vivimos nuestros valores: ponemos la seguridad primero, hacemos lo correcto, nos respetamos mutuamente, aspiramos a la excelencia y buscamos sorprender a nuestros clientes. Promovemos que nuestras personas lideren con el ejemplo y celebramos nuestros logros.

Nos apasiona nuestro propósito de ayudar a entregar los recursos naturales esenciales para construir un mejor futuro para el mundo. Lo logramos combinando un profundo conocimiento de nuestros clientes, ingeniería de clase mundial, experiencia en ciencia de materiales y automatización inteligente para ofrecer soluciones innovadoras de principio a fin integrando nuestras tecnologías líderes.

Creemos que tu voz importa y que tus ideas marcan la diferencia. Trabajamos para fortalecer una cultura diversa e inclusiva donde todas las personas se sientan parte y puedan desarrollar su máximo potencial. Puedes contribuir a construir nuestra cultura única a través de nuestras redes de inclusión e iniciativas de seguridad.

Beneficios

• Remuneración competitiva.

• Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional y aprendizaje continuo.

• Beneficios regionales y específicos por equipo.

postings.descriptionText:
As part of Enterprise Technology function, we are seeking Senior Program Manager / Associate Director to drive measurable business value through the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional programs and transformation initiatives.

The role is responsible for end-to-end program leadership, governance, financial oversight, risk and dependency management, stakeholder alignment, and delivery assurance across business and technology environments. The position combines strategic thinking with practical execution, while leading teams and strengthening project and program management capability.

The opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Manager / Associate Director - Project & Program Management to lead strategic programs and enterprise transformation initiatives across the enablement services functions.

As a program leader, you will translate business priorities into practical roadmaps, integrated plans, governance structures, and measurable outcomes. You will work with senior stakeholders, clients, delivery teams, and partners to manage complexity, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain focus on value, quality, cost, and timelines.

The ideal candidate brings broad experience in program management, business transformation, service transitions, and managed services, together with strong financial, commercial, people leadership, and executive communication skills.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Lead complex, large-scale, cross-functional programs from initiation through execution, transition, and closure.

• Translate strategic objectives into program roadmaps, integrated delivery plans, milestones, governance structures, and measurable outcomes.

• Establish and strengthen PMO frameworks, delivery standards, executive reporting, decision forums, and delivery assurance mechanisms.

• Oversee program budgets, forecasts, resource plans, cost performance, and progress against approved business cases.

• Lead business transformation, operating model changes, process improvement, technology-enabled initiatives, service transitions, automation, and digital modernization.

• Establish effective risk, issue, dependency, change, quality, and escalation management practices.

• Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, clients, business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and strategic partners.

• Lead steering committees and executive reviews, communicate program performance and trade-offs, and resolve complex stakeholder and delivery challenges.

• Lead, mentor, and develop project managers, program managers, PMO professionals, workstream leads, and geographically distributed teams.

• Drive operational readiness and the effective transition of solutions into managed services or business-as-usual operations where applicable.

• Use project and portfolio platforms, analytics, automation, KPIs, and dashboards to improve transparency, decision-making, predictability, and benefits tracking.

• Contribute to investment planning, commercial assessments, proposals, solutioning, and continuous improvement of delivery methods and reusable practices.

Skills And Attributes For Success

To qualify for the role you must have

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Science / Engineering, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

• Typically 18+ years of progressive experience in project and program management, PMO leadership, enterprise transformation, managed services, delivery or global operations.

• Proven experience leading complex programs with multiple workstreams, dependencies, senior stakeholders, and geographically distributed teams.

• Strong capability in program governance, integrated planning, financial management, resource planning, risk mitigation, delivery assurance, and executive reporting.

• Experience delivering business transformation, operating model change, service transition, process improvement, automation, or technology modernization initiatives.

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders, facilitate decisions, manage ambiguity, and resolve complex delivery challenges.

• Experience leading and developing project managers, program managers, PMO professionals, and cross-functional teams.

• Strong business acumen, executive communication, negotiation, structured problem-solving, and change leadership skills.

• Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches, with the judgment to select and tailor methods to program needs.

• Experience using project and portfolio management tools such as Microsoft Project, Planview, Jira

Ideally, you will also have

• PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, MSP, or an equivalent project, program, Agile, change, or service management certification.

• Experience in professional services, consulting, IT services, global business services, regulated industries, or a large enterprise environment.

• Experience contributing to business cases, commercial reviews, proposals, solutioning, or client development activities.

• Experience establishing PMO or delivery governance capabilities and improving project management maturity.

What We Look For

A strategic and delivery-focused leader who can connect business objectives with practical execution. Someone who combines strong program management discipline with commercial awareness, transformation experience, and sound judgment; builds trusted relationships; develops high-performing teams; and remains accountable for measurable outcomes in complex and changing environments.

What Working At EY Offers

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland & the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies & sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills & insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

About EY

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform, and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax & transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

postings.title: Global Information Security Strategist - EY Global Delivery Services
postings.descriptionText:
Global Information Security Strategist

Summary:

The Global Information Security Strategist is a senior role responsible for shaping and implementing the long-term information security strategy of the firm. This individual will work closely with the Global Lead for Information Security Strategy and Research to ensure that security initiatives not only protect the firm’s assets and reputation but also enable business objectives. The strategist will combine deep knowledge of emerging technologies and threats with strong business acumen to drive security programs that align with the company’s global strategy and operational needs. This role involves high-level collaboration, strategic planning, and leadership to keep the Information Security program a step ahead of evolving business demands and cyber risks.

Key Responsibilities:

• Strategic Program Development: Define and drive the development of long-term information security program strategies that support the firm’s business objectives. Ensure security goals, processes, and resources are aligned with overall corporate strategy and priorities, with clear targets for success.

• Business & Leadership Consulting: Collaborate with senior business and technology leaders to understand short- and long-range business plans. Recommend security strategies and solutions that anticipate future changes in services, technologies, and client requirements, ensuring the security program stays ahead of the curve.

• Stakeholder Alignment & Adoption: Work across global business and technology teams to build awareness on security initiatives. Rationalize and present recommendations to stakeholders and champion the security strategy across the organization. Drive organization-wide adoption of strategic security initiatives, resulting in consistent risk reduction and improved security posture.

• Program Evaluation & Improvement: Analyze the Information Security program’s operational effectiveness, processes, and stakeholder feedback. Identify areas for improvement and optimize processes to increase program effectiveness and agility, ensuring the security program remains a competitive advantage for the firm.

• Research & Trend Analysis: Monitor and evaluate emerging security technologies, industry trends, and evolving threat landscapes. Determine how these developments could impact the firm and its security posture. Use these insights to proactively adapt and evolve the security strategy, so the program is prepared for future threats and business needs.

• Innovation & Initiative Planning: Identify strategic opportunities for innovation within the security program. Plan and propose research initiatives or pilot projects to explore new security solutions, architectures, or processes that could strengthen the program. This includes developing business cases for new investments or approaches.

• Early Engagement in Technology Projects: Partner with teams in Information Security, Enterprise Technology, and Client Technology. As new capabilities are conceived and adopted, work with these teams to develop approaches that address security and business needs from the outset.

• Executive Reporting & Guidance: Support and guide senior executive decision-making. Prepare and present high-level analyses, strategic plans, and roadmaps to executive leadership. Provide clear recommendations for the adoption of new capabilities or approaches, backing them with data-driven insights and projections.

• Subject Matter Expertise and Education: Serve as a subject matter expert in information security. Maintain a deep understanding of the firm’s technology portfolio, security architecture, and the business operations of the firm, including how different service lines function. Use this expertise to educate business units on the Information Security program’s strategic direction and to ensure security strategies are well understood and embraced across the organization.

• External Awareness & Partnership: Build and maintain strong relationships with both internal and external partners to stay informed about potential strategic shifts in technology, security, and business operations. Leverage these relationships to inform the firm’s security strategy and ensure that architecture, engineering, and operations teams are prepared for changes impacting the industry.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience: Minimum 10+ years of experience in roles involving strategy development, organizational change, or business process improvement, with a strong track record of driving business impact. At least 10 years of experience in Information Security or Information Technology domains, demonstrating increasing responsibility and breadth of scope.

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience will also be considered.

• Strategic Leadership: Exceptional program leadership and stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in a global organization, aligning diverse teams (security, IT, and business) through influence and relationship-building rather than formal authority.

• Business Acumen: Strong business acumen with the ability to understand the company’s business model and industry (including consulting and audit/assurance services). Capable of translating business needs into security program requirements and articulating the value of security initiatives in business terms.

• Communication Skills: Excellent communication and presentation skills. Able to effectively convey complex concepts and strategies to both technical teams and non-technical executive audiences. Advanced English writing skills are required for clear documentation and strategic plan writing.

• Technical Depth: Broad and deep knowledge of information security domains and technologies – including cybersecurity architecture, risk management, identity and access management (IAM), incident response, and emerging threat mitigation techniques. Able to dive into technical details and also abstract them into high-level insights for decision-makers.

• Results Orientation: Demonstrated track record of delivering results in complex, matrixed environments. Able to manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously, meet deadlines, and drive projects to completion. Experience in driving adoption of new processes or capabilities across an organization is essential.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Global/Enterprise Experience: Experience working in a large multinational company, with exposure to global teams and an understanding of how to navigate a complex enterprise environment. Experience collaborating across different regions and time zones is a plus.

• Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with professional services businesses, such as consulting or assurance (audit). Understanding the dynamics of a partnership or client-serving organization can help in aligning security strategies to such environments.

• Standards & Frameworks: Knowledge of and experience with common information security frameworks and standards (e.g., ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CSA, CIS Controls, etc).

• Certifications: Relevant security certifications are a plus, such as CISSP, SABSA, or other industry-recognized credentials, demonstrating a commitment to professional development and expertise in security strategy/architecture.

• Product Security Lifecycle: Experience with product management or secure development lifecycle (SDLC) practices. For example, having worked on integrating security into the product or software development process.

About the Role:

In this role, the Global Information Security Strategist will join a high-performing team dedicated to advancing the firm’s security posture in alignment with business goals. Success in this position means you will effectively bridge business strategy with deep cybersecurity insight, ensuring that the company not only defends against current and future threats but also enables secure innovation and growth. You will be expected to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders and act as a change agent, guiding the organization toward a resilience-focused, forward-looking security program. This is a challenging and influential position, ideal for a strategic thinker with a passion for cybersecurity and the ability to drive organizational change.

Descripción del cargo
Esta posición es responsable de definir, liderar e implementar la estrategia comercial del canal de Marketplaces dentro de nuestra división Direct-to-Consumer (D2C). El/la especialista estará a cargo de desarrollar el canal garantizando un crecimiento rentable y sostenible, asegurando una experiencia de compra óptima de cara al usuario final y el cumplimiento riguroso de los objetivos de facturación.

Será el/la encargado/a de negociar directamente con las principales plataformas del ecosistema, liderar los eventos comerciales del año y garantizar la excelencia operativa y financiera del canal.

Funciones y Responsabilidades Clave:

• Estrategia Comercial y Pricing: Definir, en conjunto con el equipo de Category Management, la arquitectura de precios y el calendario de promociones para las diferentes plataformas, asegurando la competitividad y la alineación con los objetivos comerciales del negocio.

• Planeación de la Demanda (S&OP): Desarrollar la proyección mensual de demanda ( Demand Forecasting ) para el canal de Marketplaces, integrando las activaciones comerciales en coordinación con los equipos de Category Management y S&OP.

• Gestión de Inventario y Omnicanalidad: Monitorear y garantizar la disponibilidad de stock en el canal, gestionando un flujo eficiente de inventario y asegurando el cumplimiento de los tiempos de entrega pactados ( Fulfillment ).

• Business Intelligence (BI): Analizar el desempeño comercial del canal, utilizando tableros de control y generando insights accionables para la toma de decisiones estratégicas de la alta dirección.

• Negociación Estratégica: Liderar las mesas de negociación y el diseño de campañas comerciales con cada Marketplace para maximizar la visibilidad de la marca, optimizar los términos comerciales y potenciar las ventas.

• Excelencia Operativa: Asegurar la correcta sincronización de los procesos de la cadena de suministro, integraciones tecnológicas y servicio al cliente para garantizar una experiencia de usuario sobresaliente.

• Alianzas Corporativas: Mantener el relacionamiento directo y la comunicación constante con los Key Account Managers (KAMs) de cada plataforma tecnológica para identificar oportunidades de negocio conjuntas.

• Performance & Growth Marketing: Velar por la correcta ejecución de las estrategias de marketing digital y pauta paga dentro de las plataformas para maximizar el tráfico calificado y la tasa de conversión, colaborando con el equipo de Growth.

• Innovación Tecnológica: Investigar constantemente las tendencias del comercio electrónico y las innovaciones en herramientas de automatización para proponer mejoras continuas en los modelos de negocio digitales.

Requisitos

• Formación académica: Graduado universitario en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Marketing, Negocios Digitales, Economía o carreras afines.

• Experiencia profesional: Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia demostrable liderando canales comerciales digitales, preferiblemente dentro de empresas de consumo masivo, Retail o la industria tecnológica.

• Herramientas: Dominio avanzado de herramientas de análisis de datos y hojas de cálculo (Excel / Google Sheets avanzado).

• Idiomas: Español fluido y dominio del inglés

Habilidades

• Pensamiento estratégico y fuerte orientación a resultados comerciales cuantitativos.

• Capacidad de toma de decisiones ágiles basadas en el análisis de datos cuantitativos.

• Liderazgo transversal y habilidad para coordinar proyectos con áreas multidisciplinarias (Operaciones, Finanzas, Marketing y Tecnología).

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación e influencia.

• Dominio e interpretación fluida de métricas de rendimiento digital (Tasa de conversión, Tráfico, CPA, ROAS, GMV, etc.).

• Ecosistema Digital: Conocimiento y manejo avanzado de plataformas de comercio electrónico e integradores multicanal (e.g., VTEX, Mercado Libre, Producteca, u otros Hubs de integración).

postings.title: Head of Marketplaces
postings.descriptionText:
The company

nocnoc is the leading e-commerce facilitator for global brands and retailers looking to increase their sales in Latin America.
We enable sellers around the world to easily access +15 marketplaces through one single platform offering their products to over 500 million online customers. We are committed to connecting Latin America with the world through e-commerce.

The opportunity

We are looking for a Head of Marketplaces to join our Commercial team and own our marketplaces end to end, with direct accountability for sales and gross profit.
Today, each marketplace is run day to day by a dedicated analyst. This role brings the end-to-end view across all of them: setting the pricing and discount levers, understanding what sells, at what price and why, making sure our campaigns are efficient, and keeping every account healthy. You will lead the team of marketplace analysts, set shared priorities across channels, make the strategic calls that make each one grow, and make sure what works in one marketplace gets tested and replicated in the others.
You will also be the commercial face of nocnoc with our marketplace partners, building the relationships and negotiating the terms that unlock growth.

Responsibilities

• Own the marketplace portfolio end to end, accountable for GMV and gross profit, setting targets and defining the pricing and discount strategy per marketplace.

• Understand what drives sales and which campaigns pay off, and use it to decide where to focus. Replicate what works across marketplaces.

• Lead and develop the team of marketplace analysts: clarify roles and priorities, set how they work together, and empower them to make decisions.

• Be the commercial face with the marketplaces: build relationships with key contacts, negotiate commercial terms, and agree on campaigns and joint opportunities.

• Collaborate with Product, Operations, Finance and Data to execute the growth plans.

• Track market trends, category performance and competitors to bring new growth opportunities.

What experience will help you in this role?

• Solid experience in marketplace operations, channels or commercial strategy.

• Proven experience leading and developing teams, and coordinating several channels at once.

• Track record in pricing, forecasting and margin optimization.

• Strong analytical background: advanced Excel and SQL, comfortable reading and working the numbers on your own.

• Strong negotiation and communication skills.

• Fluent English and Spanish.

• Experience working with cross-functional teams (Product, Operations, Finance, Data) to execute plans.

• Experience in fast-growing e-commerce, tech or marketplace businesses is a strong plus.

• Interest in automation and data tools (including AI) to scale the way a team works is a plus.

What do we value the most?

• Simplifying the complex: you turn complex problems into simple, actionable solutions.

• Thinking and acting like an owner: accountability, agility and commitment to results.

• Collective success: empowered teams, transparent communication and shared wins.

• Feel comfortable with dynamic changes as well as high-speed growth.

Thank you for reading and we hope to meet soon!

postings.title: Revisor med nogle års erfaring …
postings.descriptionText:
Job

Revisor med nogle års erfaring …

Vi søger mindst 4 nye ben … om benene er au naturel, beklædt med nylonstrømper eller knæhøje, farve-u-kontrollerede herresokker, ja det er uden betydning (læs: ben m/k). Faktisk nævner vi kun benene, fordi de bærer din krop og dermed også dine hænder, som vi godt kunne bruge flere af. Ikke at hverken dine eller vores hænder skal spildes på trælzzzomme rutineopgaver, der lige så godt kunne udføres af en veltrænet cirkusbjørn. Det har vi kontorrobotter og kunstige intelligenser til at tage sig af, så du slipper, og robotterne er lettere at dressere end en bjørn… og billigere i laks. Derfor bliver den mest eftertragtede del på dig dit hoved og alt det spændende, som du kan byde ind med hos både kolleger og kunder.

Vi mangler et par nye hoveder i “familien”, og ja, sådan ser vi os. Vi har/er ikke medarbejdere, vi er familiemedlemmer. Vi mangler dig man-tirs-ons-tors-fredag, hvor vi værner om, støtter og udvikler vores kunder. Vi mangler dig også i arbejdsdagens små frirum, i frokostpausen og din deltagelse i events, der ryster os tættere sammen og på vores fredagscafé, hvor vi værner om, støtter og udvikler hinanden.

Find et stykke papir, spids din yndlingsblyant og sæt ord bag dit ønske om et nyt job eller gem blyanten til en sjov tegning, din indkøbsliste eller en hilsen til din mor, og send i stedet for en elektronisk ansøgning til nyt-familiemedlem@revision2.dk og fortæl os, hvad du drømmer om som revisor, familiemedlem og menneske.

Et par selvfølgeligheder… nej, du behøver ikke have erfaring tilbage til regnerullens tid, men et par år som revisor vil være fint. Og selvom effekterne i billedet ovenfor er fra en svunden tid, så tag ikke fejl, vores daglige virke beror på AI og de nyeste teknologier for automatisering, hvilket du trives med og er god til at integrere i din arbejdsdag. Attraktiv lønpakke og goder, pensionsordning, sundhedsforsikring, fleksible arbejdstider m.v. er all inclusive. Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig… ja, send først en kærlig hilsen til dine forældre, hvis det er længe siden, så venter vi imens.

Hvad er definitionen på en revisor?

En der løser et problem du ikke vidste du havde, på en måde du ikke forstår!

Lene Noes Registreret revisor HD (R)

postings.title: Bookkeeper
postings.descriptionText:
About Howard Financial

Howard Financial is a tech-forward outsourced accounting and finance firm, founded in 2023. We keep the books, run the close and deliver financial clarity for US-based businesses across four verticals: Vacation Rental, Hospitality, Consumer & E-Commerce, and Development & Real Estate.

We are a fully remote, global team. We hire people who take ownership of their work and their clients, and we give them the tools and structure to do it well.

About The Role

We are looking for a Bookkeeper to join our accounting team and support the day-to-day bookkeeping of a portfolio of US clients. This is a junior position: you will work closely with Accountants and Senior Accountants who review your work and help you grow.

The ideal candidate has solid accounting fundamentals, hands-on QuickBooks experience and a high attention to detail. You will own accurate, timely books for your clients and be the first line of quality in our month-end close.

What You'll Do

• Record and categorize daily transactions accurately in QuickBooks Online.

• Reconcile bank, credit card and loan accounts on a monthly basis.

• Process and track accounts payable and accounts receivable.

• Prepare journal entries for review, including accruals and adjustments.

• Support the month-end close by preparing schedules and flagging discrepancies.

• Keep client files and supporting documentation organized and up to date.

• Prepare basic financial reports (P&L, balance sheet) for review by the Accounting team.

• Communicate with clients to request missing information or clarify transactions.

• Follow internal processes and checklists, and suggest improvements when you see them.

What You Bring

• 1–2 years of bookkeeping or junior accounting experience.

• Degree in Accounting or a related field (completed or in progress).

• Solid accounting fundamentals: double-entry, accruals, reconciliations and the basics of the month-end close.

• Hands-on experience with QuickBooks (Online preferred).

• Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.

• Strong attention to detail and a habit of double-checking your work.

• Good written and spoken English to work with US clients and teammates.

• Ownership and organization: you manage your deadlines without being chased.

Nice to Have

• Experience in one or more of these industries: Real Estate, Consumer & E-Commerce, or Hospitality.

• Exposure to US clients or US accounting standards (US GAAP).

• Experience at an accounting firm or outsourced accounting service, handling more than one client at a time.

• Familiarity with tools such as Bill.com, Ramp, Gusto or similar.
