postings.title: Senior Associate – Service Quotation Management
postings.descriptionText:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena is committed to a people-first approach. Our teams enjoy a culture focused on prioritizing a flexible work environment that empowers individual growth, well-being, and belonging. We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity—driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.

Senior Associate – Service Quotation Management

Location: Mexico / Argentina

Employment Type: Full-Time

About The Role

Ciena is transforming the way global networks are built and evolved, supporting customers across terrestrial, submarine, packet, optical, and network modernization environments. We are seeking a Senior Associate – Service Quotation Management to join our Americas Services organization.

In this role, you will independently develop accurate, customer-ready service quotation deliverables for defined and well-scoped opportunities. You will apply established pricing models, policies, tools, and templates while working with Sales and Service Delivery teams to clarify requirements, assumptions, dependencies, and standard delivery inputs.

This position is ideal for a professional with services or networking experience, strong attention to detail, developing commercial awareness, and the ability to execute standard quotation work independently while escalating risks, exceptions, and unclear requirements appropriately.

Key Responsibilities

• Independently execute service quotation deliverables for defined, well-scoped, and standard service opportunities

• Own the accuracy, completeness, quality, and timeliness of assigned quote components and supporting documentation

• Apply approved pricing models, rate structures, policies, tools, templates, and standard work instructions with minimal guidance

• Review customer requirements and available inputs to confirm service scope, deliverables, assumptions, dependencies, and exclusions

• Collaborate effectively with SQC team members, Sales, and Service Delivery to clarify requirements, validate standard effort and cost inputs, resolve routine quotation questions, and share knowledge that improves team consistency and outcomes

• Develop clear, customer-ready scope and pricing content aligned with approved service offerings

• Perform quality checks on quantities, rates, calculations, assumptions, and proposal content before submission or peer review

• Maintain quotation records and supporting documentation in accordance with governance, approval, and audit requirements

• Identify and escalate risks, missing inputs, non-standard requests, commercial exceptions, or scope changes while managing assigned work to agreed priorities and due dates

• Incorporate peer feedback and use approved AI and automation tools to improve quotation quality, intake, content development, knowledge reuse, and workflow consistency

Required Qualifications

• Post-secondary degree in business, engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience

• Three to five (3–5) years of experience in services, service quotation management, deployment, technical support, project coordination, or a related environment

• Experience working with structured processes, standard pricing inputs, scope documents, or customer proposals

• Developing understanding of financial fundamentals, including cost, price, margin, and the effect of assumptions and risk on a quotation

• Ability to interpret service requirements, identify missing information, and convert defined inputs into clear quotation deliverables

• Working proficiency in Microsoft Excel and common productivity, collaboration, and document-management tools

• Ability to use approved AI-assisted tools to support quotation development, content validation, knowledge reuse, and workflow efficiency

• Strong attention to detail, organization, communication, collaboration, and follow-through, with the ability to contribute positively within a team, manage multiple assignments, share information proactively, and escalate issues appropriately

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in telecommunications, optical networking, network deployment, field services, technical support, or project management

• Practical experience using generative AI, copilots, or workflow automation tools in a business or services environment

• Experience identifying suitable AI use cases and designing prompts, reusable instructions, or AI-assisted workflows that improve consistency, quality, and productivity

• Exposure to or interest in configuring AI agents and workflow automations that support intake, data validation, document generation, knowledge retrieval, or approval workflows

• Ability to define expected outputs, test results, and refine AI-assisted solutions based on user feedback

• Familiarity with bills of materials, network diagrams, service descriptions, statements of work, or delivery assumptions

• Experience collaborating with Sales, Service Delivery, Engineering, Finance, or commercial teams and working within quotation governance, approval, audit, or order-booking processes

• Interest in developing deeper expertise in services economics, risk assessment, automation, and complex quotation development

Why Join Ciena

At Ciena, you will collaborate with experienced Services professionals supporting customer opportunities across a broad range of network environments. You will have opportunities to strengthen your quotation, commercial, and technical skills through practical experience, knowledge sharing, and professional development, while contributing to high-quality customer proposals and building readiness for progression to the Specialist, Service Quotation Management level. Ciena is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone can contribute and grow.

At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.

postings.title: Suscriptor/a de Contratos de Reaseguro
postings.descriptionText:
Ubicación: Buenos Aires, Argentina
Modalidad: Híbrida
Ámbito geográfico: Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay y Bolivia

Sobre la posición
Mapfre Re Sucursal Argentina, una de las compañías de referencia del mercado reasegurador argentino, busca incorporar un/a Suscriptor/a de Contratos de Reaseguro para su oficina de Buenos Aires.
La persona seleccionada gestionará la suscripción y el seguimiento de contratos de reaseguro correspondientes a los mercados de Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay y Bolivia , participando tanto en el análisis técnico de la cartera como en la relación con cedentes y brokers.
Buscamos un perfil con capacidad analítica, orientación comercial, iniciativa y buenas habilidades de organización, interesado en desarrollarse dentro de un entorno técnico, dinámico e internacional.

Principales responsabilidades
Reportando a la Gerencia de Suscripción, sus principales responsabilidades serán:

• Analizar la información recibida durante los procesos de renovación, incluyendo resultados, exposiciones, condiciones y cláusulas de los contratos de reaseguro.

• Cotizar y suscribir contratos de reaseguro de acuerdo con las políticas, procedimientos y niveles de autoridad establecidos por Mapfre Re.

• Evaluar riesgos y elaborar propuestas de términos, condiciones y capacidad.

• Negociar términos y condiciones con clientes, tanto cedentes como brokers.

• Registrar los contratos de reaseguro en los sistemas internos de Mapfre Re, asegurando la calidad y consistencia de la información.

• Revisar y validar la documentación contractual.

• Preparar la información y documentación requerida por los organismos de control.

• Gestionar la cartera asignada y realizar el seguimiento de su evolución, resultados y rentabilidad.

• Mantener reuniones periódicas con cedentes y brokers para comprender sus necesidades y fortalecer las relaciones comerciales.

• Representar a Mapfre Re en reuniones, encuentros profesionales y eventos del mercado.

• Identificar oportunidades de negocio en los mercados asignados y contribuir al desarrollo de nuevas relaciones comerciales.

• Participar en la elaboración, ejecución y seguimiento del Business Plan.

• Colaborar con otras áreas técnicas y de negocio para favorecer una gestión integral de la cartera.

Perfil deseado
Formación

• Titulación universitaria, preferiblemente en Ciencias Actuariales, Ingeniería, Administración de Empresas, Economía o carreras afines.

Experiencia

• Experiencia mínima de cuatro años en reaseguro , preferiblemente en suscripción de contratos, análisis técnico, actuaría, broking o funciones relacionadas.

• Experiencia en análisis y negociación de contratos de reaseguro.

• Se valorará el conocimiento de los mercados de Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay y Bolivia.

Conocimientos y habilidades

• Capacidad para analizar información técnica, financiera y contractual.

• Experiencia y habilidades de negociación.

• Orientación comercial y capacidad para identificar oportunidades de negocio.

• Proactividad, autonomía y orientación a resultados.

• Capacidad de planificación, organización y gestión de prioridades.

• Compromiso y capacidad para trabajar de manera colaborativa.

• Nivel avanzado de inglés, preferiblemente C1.

• Manejo avanzado de Excel y experiencia en el análisis de bases de datos.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

• La oportunidad de incorporarte a una compañía internacional de referencia en el sector reasegurador.

• Responsabilidad sobre una cartera con alcance regional.

• Contacto directo con clientes, brokers y diferentes actores del mercado.

• Un entorno de trabajo técnico, colaborativo y multicultural.

• Oportunidades de aprendizaje y desarrollo profesional.

• Esquema de trabajo híbrido.

Diversidad e igualdad de oportunidades
En Mapfre valoramos la diversidad y promovemos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo. Nuestros procesos de selección se basan en la igualdad de oportunidades, las competencias, la experiencia y el potencial profesional de cada persona.

• Viven los cambios como oportunidades y aprenden de sus errores.

• La excelencia y la ejecución son claves en su forma de hacer las cosas.

• Promueven el buen clima, aportan alegría y diversión.

• Saben cómo construir con otras personas y disfrutan trabajando en equipo.

Imaginate emprendiendo proyectos desafiantes, dinámicos e innovadores y siendo responsable de:

• Definir e impulsar la estrategia regional de evaluación y mitigación de riesgos financieros u operativos para el negocio Fintech, garantizando el crecimiento sustentable de la operación.

• Liderar el diseño y la implementación de modelos predictivos y marcos de control avanzados para anticipar desvíos o vulnerabilidades en el ecosistema de pagos y créditos.

• Establecer indicadores clave de riesgo y métricas de desempeño que guíen la toma de decisiones estratégicas de la alta gerencia.

• Articular soluciones de gobernanza y control con los equipos de Producto y Tecnología, asegurando la integración de estándares normativos en las distintas soluciones digitales.

• Evaluar el impacto de nuevas normativas e innovaciones financieras para adaptar de forma proactiva las políticas internas de riesgo.

• Ser graduada o graduado de las carreras de Ciencias Económicas, Actuario, Ingeniería, Finanzas o afines.

• Contar con 6 años de experiencia desarrollada en gestión de riesgos financieros, análisis de crédito o regulación en la industria financiera, bancaria o fintech.

• Dominar herramientas de análisis y modelado de datos como SQL, Python o BigQuery para la extracción y procesamiento de información compleja.

• Poseer un nivel avanzado del idioma inglés, es deseable.

Te proponemos:

• Ser parte de una compañía con espíritu emprendedor en la que nos encanta pensar en grande y a largo plazo.

• Ser protagonista de tu desarrollo en un ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizaje, crecimiento, expansión y proyectos desafiantes.

• Compartir y aprender en equipo junto a grandes profesionales y especialistas.

• Un excelente clima de trabajo, con todo lo necesario para que vivas una gran experiencia. :)

We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What the Organizational Learning Advisor, Enterprise Systems does at Worldwide

The Organizational Learning Advisor, Enterprise Systems, is responsible for designing, delivering, maintaining, and measuring global systems training for critical clinical and enterprise technology platforms. This role sits within Global Organizational Learning & Development and serves as the dedicated learning partner for Medidata and Certinia, translating complex workflows, compliance requirements, release changes, and business processes into clear, role-based learning experiences that support readiness, adoption, proficiency, and sustainment.

The Advisor partners with system owners, EPMO, IT, Clinical Systems, Finance, Project Operations, functional SMEs, and business leaders to scope training needs, plan learning timelines, develop practical performance support, and maintain training assets as systems and workflows evolve. Primary platform scope includes Medidata CTMS, Clinical Data Studio/CDS, Rave/EDC, eTMF/RCM, eCOA/ePRO, RTSM/IRT/IWRS, RBQM-related workflows, and other Medidata capabilities as implemented, along with Certinia time entry, resource management, forecasting, reporting, project management, financial oversight, and Salesforce-based workflows.

What You Will Do

• Lead learning and enablement strategies for Medidata and Certinia implementations, releases, enhancements, new modules, new hire needs, refresher training, remediation, and sustainment.

• Own the training approach for Medidata and Certinia in partnership with system owners and business stakeholders, ensuring training aligns to go-live timelines, validated-system requirements, financial controls, role-based workflows, and adoption goals.

• Partner with EPMO, IT, Clinical Systems, Finance, Project Operations, Quality, Security, SMEs, and business leaders to confirm audiences, learning objectives, content readiness, approvals, and reverse-planned training timelines.

• Develop, deliver, and maintain role-based learning journeys, curricula, job aids, quick reference guides, facilitator materials, eLearning, videos, workshops, office hours, system practice activities, assessments, and other performance support resources.

• Support global end-user training, demonstrations, train-the-trainer sessions, stakeholder briefings, learner communications, adoption support, and remediation across Medidata, Certinia, related enterprise platforms, and other assigned technology systems.

• Partner with LMS and learning operations teams to ensure training assets are accurately assigned, published, version controlled, discoverable, and reportable within the Worldwide Learning Center or successor learning platforms.

What You Will Bring To The Role

• Strong instructional design, facilitation, systems-training, consulting, stakeholder-management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Ability to translate complex clinical, financial, project operations, metadata, reporting, release, compliance, and workflow requirements into clear learning experiences and practical performance support.

• Working knowledge of regulated or validated systems training, including GCP, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, audit readiness, role-based access, controlled content, training completion records, and system release impacts.

• Strong written, verbal, visual, analytical, and digital fluency skills; comfortable learning new systems quickly and using LMS platforms, authoring tools, AI-enabled productivity tools, and modern collaboration technologies.

• Ability to prioritize competing system demands, manage multiple concurrent releases or implementations, and operate effectively in a global, matrixed environment.

Your Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Human Resources, Education, Communications, Information Technology, Clinical Operations, Life Sciences, or a related discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.

• 7+ years of experience in learning, training, instructional design, systems enablement, technology adoption, clinical operations training, enterprise application training, or related roles.

• Demonstrated experience designing and delivering role-based systems training through instructor-led, virtual, self-paced, blended, video, job aid, workshop, office hour, sandbox, and performance-support formats.

• Experience supporting complex implementations, validated clinical systems, financial or project operations platforms, system releases, global rollouts, training updates, alpha/beta reviews, approvals, LMS publishing, and sustainment.

• Preferred experience with Medidata, Certinia, Salesforce-based platforms, CTMS, CDS, EDC, eTMF/RCM, eCOA/ePRO, RTSM/IRT, RBQM, LMS administration, training matrices, GxP training, 21 CFR Part 11 environments, or similar clinical and enterprise technology platforms.

• Ability to travel up to 10% as needed.

United States of America - $87,000.00 - $173,000.00

The final salary will be determined based on relevant experience, performance, education, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive benefits package depending on location. We ensure pay equity and transparency and comply with all applicable labor laws. Salary information will be discussed during the interview process, and we encourage candidates to inquire about compensation at any stage.

postings.descriptionText:
Systems and Service Platform Administrator / Administrador de Sistemas y Plataforma de Servicio

EN:

About Powerfleet / Sobre Powerfleet

Powerfleet (Nasdaq: AIOT; JSE: PWR) is a global leader in the artificial intelligence of things (AIoT) software-as-a-service (SaaS) mobile asset industry. With more than 30 years of experience, Powerfleet unifies business operations through the ingestion, harmonization, and integration of data, irrespective of source, and delivers actionable insights to help companies save lives, time, and money. Powerfleet’s ethos transcends our data ecosystem and commitment to innovation; our people-centric approach empowers our customers to realize impactful and sustained business improvement. We serve over 2.6 million subscribers across more than 48,000 customers in 120 countries, with commercial operations in every major continent.

ES:

Powerfleet (Nasdaq: AIOT; JSE: PWR) es líder global en la industria de software como servicio (SaaS) de inteligencia artificial de las cosas (AIoT) para la gestión de activos móviles. Con más de 30 años de experiencia, Powerfleet unifica las operaciones empresariales mediante la integración y armonización de datos, independientemente de su origen, brindando información procesable que ayuda a las empresas a salvar vidas, tiempo y dinero. El compromiso de Powerfleet va más allá de nuestro ecosistema de datos e innovación; nuestro enfoque centrado en las personas empodera a los clientes para lograr mejoras empresariales sostenidas e impactantes. Atendemos a más de 2.6 millones de suscriptores y más de 48,000 clientes en 120 países, con operaciones comerciales en todos los continentes principales.

EN:

About the Role / Sobre el Rol

The Systems and Service Platform Administrator is responsible for ensuring the availability, stability, and security of Powerfleet’s technological platforms that support our business operations and customer services. This role oversees the performance and reliability of systems, servers, and applications, providing hands-on technical support and ensuring that internal teams have the tools and resources needed to operate effectively.

This position plays a key role in maintaining a secure, efficient, and modern IT infrastructure that supports Powerfleet’s mission to deliver innovative, connected solutions to our customers.

ES:

El Administrador de Sistemas y Plataforma de Servicio es responsable de garantizar la disponibilidad, estabilidad y seguridad de las plataformas tecnológicas de Powerfleet que respaldan las operaciones comerciales y los servicios al cliente. Este rol supervisa el rendimiento y la confiabilidad de los sistemas, servidores y aplicaciones, brindando soporte técnico directo y asegurando que los equipos internos cuenten con las herramientas y recursos necesarios para operar de manera eficiente.

Esta posición cumple un papel clave en el mantenimiento de una infraestructura tecnológica segura, eficiente y moderna que respalde la misión de Powerfleet de ofrecer soluciones conectadas e innovadoras a nuestros clientes.

Key Responsibilities / Responsabilidades Clave

EN – Platform and Service Management

• Monitor and manage system services and connectivity (Zabbix), including PBX systems, IPSEC tunnels, and related infrastructure.

• Maintain and update servers (Provision1, Web1, Web2) supporting the Connect platform.

• Perform maintenance and optimization of network servers (email, internet, file, and database) and their applications.

• Implement security and contingency measures such as antivirus, firewalls, and backups.

• Coordinate hardware procurement and upgrades for servers and workstations as required.

• Administer and maintain business applications including NAV, the internal ticketing system, and Office 365.

ES – Gestión de Plataforma y Servicio

• Supervisar y gestionar los servicios del sistema y la conectividad (Zabbix), incluidos los sistemas PBX, túneles IPSEC y la infraestructura relacionada.

• Mantener y actualizar los servidores (Provision1, Web1, Web2) que respaldan la plataforma Connect.

• Realizar el mantenimiento y la optimización de los servidores de red (correo electrónico, internet, archivos y bases de datos) y sus aplicaciones.

• Implementar medidas de seguridad y contingencia como antivirus, firewalls y copias de seguridad.

• Coordinar la compra y actualización de hardware para servidores y estaciones de trabajo cuando sea necesario.

• Administrar y mantener las aplicaciones empresariales, incluidos NAV, el sistema interno de tickets y Office 365.

EN – Systems Administration

• Install, configure, and maintain employee workstations and networked devices.

• Provide internal hardware and software support to intranet users.

• Administer and back up servers, storage, and administrative applications (e.g., Spiceworks, Teams).

• Ensure systems documentation and inventory remain current and accurate.

ES – Administración de Sistemas

• Instalar, configurar y mantener las estaciones de trabajo y dispositivos conectados en red.

• Brindar soporte interno de hardware y software a los usuarios de la intranet.

• Administrar y realizar copias de seguridad de servidores, almacenamiento y aplicaciones administrativas (por ejemplo, Spiceworks, Teams).

• Asegurar que la documentación y el inventario de los sistemas se mantengan actualizados y precisos.

EN:

Qualifications / Requisitos

• Bachelor’s degree or technical studies in Systems Engineering, Information Technology, or related field (completed or in progress).

• 5+ years of experience in systems and network administration or a similar technical role.

• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft and Linux network configuration.

• Strong understanding of network services (Proxy, FTP, Telnet, RDP, SSH, Firewalls).

• Experience maintaining MS Windows, Debian/BSD servers, and Office 365 environments.

• Intermediate programming knowledge in .NET and/or Python.

• Experience with IIS and Apache web servers and with MS SQL / MySQL databases.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Customer-oriented mindset with the ability to support both internal and external stakeholders.

• Fluent in Spanish; intermediate English proficiency preferred.

ES:

• Título universitario o estudios técnicos en Ingeniería de Sistemas, Tecnología de la Información o áreas afines (completados o en curso).

• Más de 5 años de experiencia en administración de sistemas y redes o en un rol técnico similar.

• Conocimientos avanzados en configuración de redes Microsoft y Linux.

• Amplio entendimiento de servicios de red (Proxy, FTP, Telnet, RDP, SSH, Firewalls).

• Experiencia en mantenimiento de servidores MS Windows, Debian/BSD y entornos Office 365.

• Conocimientos intermedios de programación en .NET y/o Python.

• Experiencia con servidores web IIS y Apache, y con bases de datos MS SQL / MySQL.

• Fuertes habilidades analíticas y de resolución de problemas.

• Enfoque orientado al cliente, con capacidad de brindar soporte a usuarios internos y externos.

• Dominio del español; se valora nivel intermedio de inglés.

EN:

Preferred Skills and Attributes / Habilidades y Atributos Deseables

• Highly responsible, organized, and adaptable to change.

• Strong motivation to deliver reliable service and continuous improvement.

• Analytical and detail-oriented with a proactive approach to troubleshooting.

• Collaborative and service-oriented mindset.

ES:

• Persona altamente responsable, organizada y adaptable al cambio.

• Motivación para ofrecer un servicio confiable y promover la mejora continua.

• Perfil analítico y orientado al detalle, con enfoque proactivo para la resolución de problemas.

• Mentalidad colaborativa y orientada al servicio.

Powerfleet (Nasdaq: AIOT; JSE: PWR) is a global leader in AIoT (Artificial Intelligence of Things) and SaaS-based mobile asset management. With over 30 years of expertise, we empower organizations worldwide to unify operations by ingesting, harmonizing, and integrating data from any source—transforming it into actionable insights that save lives, time, and money.

Our end-to-end solutions help businesses monitor, manage, and optimize everything from warehouse assets to connected vehicles, driving safety, efficiency, and sustainability across the supply chain. But we are more than just a technology company—our people-centric approach fosters innovation and long-term success for our customers.

Powerfleet serves over 2.6 million subscribers across 48,000 customers in 120 countries, with commercial operations spanning every major continent. Join us as we shape the future of intelligent mobility and business transformation.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Powerfleet is committed to maintaining a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where all individuals are treated with dignity and respect. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate or tolerate harassment on any protected basis under applicable laws in the countries where we operate, including characteristics such as race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, or age.

postings.title: Support Operator LATAM (m/f/x)
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

• Do you enjoy helping customers with complex issues?

• Are you a champion of customer-first processes?

• Do you have an interest in competitive video gaming?

• Are you able to work on weekends?

If the answers to the above questions are yes, then this role could be ideal for you!

In this role, you will join the Support Organization at GRID, a team of 10+ customer-facing Support Agents across the globe, where a professional client-first mentality is crucial to delivering customer service excellence.

You will be involved in various activities before, during, and after esports tournaments, working with our partners (Tournament Organizers, Game Publishers) and customers (which include esports, media, and betting household names) to ensure tournaments are running smoothly and relevant game data is properly captured, processed, and distributed in a timely manner.

You will play a key role in identifying, documenting, and reporting technical and data issues. You will engage with customers through email, Slack, Discord, Telegram, and Teams to ensure customers' questions and issues are quickly acknowledged and resolved as soon as possible or escalated to the engineering team if needed.

Job Requirements

What you will do

• Collaborate with esports tournament organizers to ensure content is correctly configured for GRID to collect and distribute official data

• Monitor live esports data feeds to ensure accuracy, integrity, and uninterrupted delivery to clients

• Identify and resolve real-time data discrepancies, delays, or feed issues, escalating when necessary

• Communicate directly with clients to resolve operational or data-related questions across multiple channels

• Help improve the GRID product suite based on customer feedback and defects you’ve identified.

• Log and track data quality and process issues

• Continuously develop your knowledge of esports titles and GRID products to enhance service quality and decision-making

• Contribute daily to our knowledge base to share your knowledge with GRID employees, partners, and customers

Your skills will include

• A strong customer-first mindset

• An interest in competitive video games (CS2, Valorant, Dota 2, PUBG with other games a plus)

• Understanding of esports tournament structures, formats and rules

• Previous experience in customer-facing Support roles

• Experience with collaborative tools such as Slack, GSuite, Discord, Teams

• Some level of computer science knowledge would be a plus

• Available to work shifts and weekends if required

• Excellent written and spoken English, with other languages a plus

postings.title: Electrical BIM/VDC Director
postings.descriptionText:
Electrical BIM/VDC Director – United States

Who We Are
We are ENG, #1 BIM services provider in the United States, specialized in hands‑on, field‑focused Building Information Modeling (BIM) services for large‑scale projects such as data centers, hospitals, airports, industrial plants, schools, casinos, and more. Our core business is MEP Modeling and Coordination, and we also provide services such as Steel Framing, Prefabrication, BIM for Facility Management, Scan to BIM, and Design Assist, along with an Innovation area that develops tools and apps for the AEC industry.
Our purpose is to innovate and modernize the construction industry by leveraging BIM technologies to make our clients’ work more efficient. As a company, we value candor, accountability, and a win‑win mentality and work as a horizontal, highly collaborative organization.

The Role
The Electrical Business Unit Director will lead a Business Unit (BU) focused on electrical BIM/VDC services for US‑based projects, with a strong emphasis on mission‑critical facilities.
A Business Unit in ENG is a group of approximately 30 team members with its own set of clients, portfolio of projects, P&L, and growth strategy. This BU will be fully dedicated to the electrical subsystems, engineering vs. construction, delivering BIM/VDC solutions for complex, US‑based projects.

You will:
• Own the strategy, financial health, operations, and growth of the Electrical BU.
• Lead a multi‑layer team of Project Managers, BIM Coordinators, Technical Leaders, Job Captains, BIM Specialists, and Modelers focused on US BIM MEP delivery.
• Be the bridge between clients, project execution, and financial performance, ensuring high‑quality delivery, strong client relationships, and a motivated, growing team.
This position reports to the Head of the Electrical VDC, and works closely with other BUDs across ENG’s delivery organization.

Location, Availability & Time Zones: Remote role based in Latin America, with availability across US time zones and occasional travel to industry events.

Mandatory Requirements
Technical & Market Experience
• 10–15 years of experience in the Construction & Engineering industry, with a solid, deep background in electrical systems and construction means & methods.
• Proven hands‑on BIM experience: you must have personally modeled using tools like Revit, Navisworks, Bluebeam, ACC & Teams (profiles that only “managed” BIM without modeling will not be considered).
• Substantial experience delivering US‑based BIM MEP projects (physically in the US and/or remotely for US clients), including familiarity with US standards, construction practices, and workflows.
• Prior experience as a leading of BIM/VDC teams, managing remote teams across multiple seniorities and roles (PMs, Coordinators, Leads, Specialists, Modelers).

Education
• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering and/or Construction Management is strongly preferred.
• Other degrees may be considered if paired with a very strong electrical focus, such as: Construction/Building Sciences and Architecture, with an extensive experience in large-scale commercial construction projects including data centers, hospitals, semiconductor fabrication facilities and airports.
• Advanced, hands‑on proficiency with Revit and Navisworks for MEP/Electrical.
• Professional experience with some of the following is highly valued: Autodesk Construction Cloud, Bluebeam or similar BIM/VDC tools.

Preferred
• Experience leading the full VDC lifecycle from preconstruction through to as-builts, including prefabrication shop drawings & spooling.
• Prior experience in multi‑cultural, distributed teams across US + LATAM.

Top Job Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & BU Ownership
• Position ENG as a leading electrical BIM/VDC partner for US data centers and complex MEP markets.
Financial Management & P&L
• Own full P&L accountability, driving revenue growth, margin performance, and accurate forecasting.
• Optimize profitability through data-driven pricing, staffing, and project portfolio
decisions.
Client Management & Business Growth
• Serve as a strategic advisor to key US electrical clients, managing scope, negotiations, and long-term partnerships.
• Expand business through upselling, cross-selling, and new client development in mission-critical sectors.
Project Execution & Operational Excellence
• Ensure delivery of high-quality, code-compliant, constructible electrical BIM models
across projects.
• Lead scalable QA/QC, risk management, and workflow excellence across parallel engagements.
Team Leadership, Mentoring & Talent Development
• Lead and develop a 30 people BU, fostering a high-performance, accountable culture.
• Drive succession planning, career development, and hiring of top electrical BIM talent.
Technology, BIM Expertise & Innovation
• Champion adoption of BIM/VDC, automation, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency and quality.
• Maintain mastery of core tools (Revit, Navisworks, ACC, Bluebeam) and sponsor innovation in prefabrication and coordination.
Leadership & Business Skills
• Proven experience managing financial KPIs, forecasting, and business line performance.
• Strong client-facing leadership with a track record of account growth and team mentorship.

You Are Great for This Role If You
• Love combining deep electrical/BIM expertise with business ownership and leadership.
• Thrive in fast‑growing, changing environments, and naturally think in terms of scalability and long‑term impact.
• Enjoy coaching and mentoring senior professionals and building strong, autonomous leadership benches.
• Are energized by being the face of ENG to key US electrical clients and by driving
business expansion through trust and technical excellence.

Why Join Us? – Benefits
As a member of ENG’s staff, you are hired as an independent contractor with monthly payments and the following benefits on top:

• Performance Bonus Program: Quarterly performance‑based variable compensation, tied to company billing targets, BU goals, and individual performance.
• Health Insurance coverage reimbursement.
• PTO – “No Policy” Vacation System:
ο No fixed minimum or maximum number of days per year.
ο No accrual, no expiry, no fixed vacation season.
ο National holiday calendars are not mandatory; you coordinate time off with your team and project timelines.
• Full Work Equipment: Laptop, headphones, wireless keyboard and mouse, monitor, chair, and all necessary software licenses.
• Connectivity Stipend: Monthly allowance to cover internet and related expenses.
• Flex‑Work Policy: Full‑time role (40 hours/week), but you can organize your schedule flexibly as long as it is coordinated with your team and does not impact delivery. We focus on results, not face time.
• Work‑From‑Anywhere Policy (with coordination).

postings.title: Security Control Assessor
postings.descriptionText:
Control & Risk Assessment Specialist

Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 950 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team helps protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

The opportunity

The Technology Assurance, Risk, and Policy (TARP) function within Information Security strives to create and promote a holistic Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) program by creating a robust, resilient, and proactive governance framework, supported by a strategic risk management approach and stringent compliance structures. It aims to integrate and align its GRC initiatives in line with the global firm's objectives and emerging threats within the cybersecurity landscape.

Furthermore, the Policy, Risk, and Controls (PRC) Enablement & Awareness team aims to establish policies and procedures that reflect the value we place on safeguarding our digital environment, while ensuring that these policies are effectively communicated and enforced across all levels of the organization. The Control & Risk Assessment team sits within PRC Enablement & Awareness and aims to directly enables the GRC program by designing control testing and risk assessment methodology to measure and quantify compliance to policies and control objectives.

Your Key Responsibilities

The Control & Risk Assessment Specialist will be expected to leading and executing control testing plans, following the model for 1st line and 2nd line testing best-practice strategies. They will be responsible for routinely testing and assesses the effectiveness and efficiency of Information Security controls put in place to mitigate risks to determine if they are supporting the desired business outcomes. Test plans include, but are not limited to, self-assessment questionnaires, control testing, and process assessments.

The Control & Risk Assessment Specialist is also responsible for managing and training a team of junior professionals to assist in executing the test plans. The Control & Risk Assessment team will work collectively to support the Information Security Program in the areas of risk assessment methodology development and execution of risk assessments, control testing design and execution, and identification of gaps and areas of improvement utilizing testing and assessment results.

Collaboration with other Information Security groups and external stakeholders across EY is key to this role. The primary service offering the Control & Risk Assessment Specialist will oversee is the Member Firm and Application Technology Risk Self-Assessment Program, requiring extensive collaboration with stakeholders outside of InfoSec across various global locations, time zones, and service lines. There will also be requirements to partner with other multi-departmental and multi-level stakeholders inclusive of, but not limited to Information Security, Client and Enterprise Technology, Data Protection, Global and Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Audit, Area and Regional Risk & Data teams, Service Line Quality Leaders, etc

Skills And Attributes For Success

• Create and design test plans for a variety of Information Security controls across the full scope of a Technology Risk Universe

• Based on results of assessments and testing, assist control owners with the design and implementation of their controls in the organization's IT environment. Strategize on the appropriate amount of preventive, detective, or corrective controls which will have the most impact on reducing overall risk for the firm.

• Appropriately balance firm security needs with business impact and benefit when recommending advancements in policy and control objectives and directing those efforts to completion.

• Think strategically to assist with the development of a long-term vision for the Control & Risk Assessment Program

• Act as a thought leader in the firm, staying informed of changes in information security, regulatory requirements, audit standards, and industry trends, adjusting strategies, as necessary.

• Build and maintain appropriate relationships with internal and external leaders to ensure awareness and understanding of potential strategic directions.

• Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change.

• Outstanding management, interpersonal, communication, organizational, and decision-making skills.

• Ability to understand and integrate cultural differences and motives and to lead cross cultural teams.

• Evaluate, counsel, mentor and provide feedback on performance of others.

• Plan the training and development of staff to develop their skills and maintain state-of-the-art knowledge in information security.

• Demonstrate integrity and judgment within a professional environment.

To qualify for the role you must have

• 3+ years of experience in the Information Technology, Information Security and/or Risk Management field(s).

• Audit experience or a demonstrated ability to design and test technology controls.

• Experience working on global and virtual teams.

• High proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing skills in English (primary).

• An advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field; equivalent work experience will be considered on a case-by-case basis.

• One or more of the following or equivalent certifications preferred: Certified Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), Certified Information Systems Security Processional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Information System Auditor (CISA), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) in related area, CIPP, CIPT.

Ideally, you’ll also have

• A working knowledge of external control standards like ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, COBIT, etc and regulatory requirements like GDPR and SOX.

• Skilled in Microsoft Office and M365 products; primarily Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, PowerApps, and PowerBI.

• Experience with RSA Archer or other GRC tools.

• Flexibility to work outside of normal business hours when engaging with team members and stakeholders in various time zones.

What We Offer

As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:

• Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

Liderar, planificar, supervisar y revisar los proyectos de diseño, construcción, ampliación y mejora de infraestructura vial (rutas provinciales y nacionales, accesos, calzadas, obras de arte menores y mayores, drenaje, señalización, interferencias y seguridad vial).

• Coordinar la planificación de frentes de obra, desvíos de tránsito, interferencias y logística de materiales (áridos, asfaltos, hormigones).

• Implementar estrategias preventivas para cumplir objetivos de plazo, costo y calidad.

• Definir alcances para proyectos de ingeniería, inspección y construcción.

• Participar en la revisión técnica y económica de ofertas y en la preparación de informes de adjudicación.

postings.title: Conflicts Office - Associate
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

This position is ideal for candidates interested in gaining a broad view of activities globally across JPMorganChase's Lines of Business, including high transaction volumes originating predominately from the Commercial & Investment Bank.

Global Conflicts sits within the Corporate Legal department and we review the firm's transactional activities to avoid or manage any actual or perceived conflicts of interest and/or related reputation risk. We gather relevant information about those relationships, assess where one relationship could conflict with another and provide senior leaders with a recommended path forward. These range from facilitating a business selection conversation to limiting business activities and managing deal team staffing. The Conflicts team partners with JPM's Lines of Business as well as control functions (e.g. Legal / Compliance) globally in performing its role.

Responsibilities Include

• Work with senior team members within Global Conflicts in analyzing requests for Conflicts clearance and thoroughly documenting results in Conflicts' system of record.

• Research of JPM's relationship with entities involved in proposed transactions, utilizing several internal systems; Drafting results of this research for benefit of seniors within Global Conflicts as well as seniors within Global Banking and Legal.

• Participating in ad hoc projects to support the Global Conflicts team.

Qualifications

• 4 year University degree or equivalent.

• 3+ years work experience in a fast moving analytical environment.

• A law degree (Juris Doctor or equivalent) is highly desirable; admission to practice is not required.

• Candidates with a law degree who do not also have 3+ years work experience are also encouraged to consider applying.

• An understanding of investment banking products, services and transactions is highly desirable.

• Must be detail-oriented, organized and thorough.

• Must have the ability to communicate (verbal and written) and document information in a clear, precise and efficient manner.

• Must have the ability to manage multiple projects in an efficient manner and bring them to a timely completion.

• Must be comfortable working and collaborating within a strong team environment.

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

With large, global operations, the Legal team tackles complex issues and helps shape the regulations that affect the businesses. The group is organized into practice groups that align with the lines of business and corporate staff areas, which encourages collaboration on legal, regulatory and business developments as they arise.

• Apoyar en la recopilación, organización y análisis de información geológica, hidrogeológica y ambiental.

• Colaborar en la preparación de informes técnicos, registros de campo y documentación de proyectos.

• Participar en proyectos junto con equipos multidisciplinarios.

• Cumplir con los procedimientos y estándares de calidad, salud, seguridad y medio ambiente de ERM.

• Desarrollar progresivamente conocimientos técnicos y habilidades de consultoría a través de la participación en diferentes proyectos.

Requisitos

• Graduado/a o estudiante de últimos ciclos de Geología o carreras afines.

• Interés en desarrollarse profesionalmente en consultoría ambiental, investigación y remediación.

• Interés y disponibilidad para realizar actividades de campo y viajes.

• Conocimientos básicos de geología e hidrogeología.

• Inglés intermedio o disposición para continuar desarrollándolo.

• Licencia de conducir vigente.

• Proactividad, capacidad de aprendizaje, organización y buenas habilidades para trabajar en equipo.

• Se valorará experiencia previa, prácticas profesionales o participación académica en actividades de campo, toma de muestras, hidrogeología o temas ambientales, sin ser un requisito excluyente.

• Se valorarán conocimientos básicos de GIS, AutoCAD, Surfer, Power BI y herramientas de AI.

Antecedentes

Desde que nos establecimos en la región de América Latina y el Caribe (LAC) en la década de 1990, ERM ha crecido de manera constante, empleando actualmente a más de 800 profesionales en sus oficinas de Argentina, Brasil, Colombia, Guyana, México y Perú. Durante más de 30 años, hemos construido equipos de consultoría especializados en medio ambiente, sostenibilidad y consultoría social, con una sólida base de clientes en múltiples sectores económicos.

Como parte de nuestra expansión regional, ERM busca mantener el liderazgo en la industria asociándose con importantes clientes que comparten nuestro compromiso con la sostenibilidad. Con una base sólida en industrias clave, contribuimos al avance de la agenda ESG (Ambiental, Social y de Gobernanza) en América Latina y el Caribe.

Quiénes Somos

Como la mayor consultora global dedicada exclusivamente a la sostenibilidad, nos asociamos con algunas de las principales organizaciones del mundo para desarrollar soluciones innovadoras frente a sus desafíos de sostenibilidad.

Consideramos nuestra diversidad como una fortaleza que nos permite crear mejores soluciones para nuestros clientes. Nuestros equipos multidisciplinarios combinan experiencia ambiental, social, de salud, seguridad, riesgo y sostenibilidad para acompañar a nuestros clientes desde los desafíos técnicos en campo hasta sus objetivos estratégicos.

Llamamos a esta capacidad nuestro enfoque “boots to boardroom” , un modelo integral que permite a ERM desarrollar soluciones estratégicas y técnicas que generan impacto tanto en campo como a nivel ejecutivo.

Si deseas leer más sobre Diversidad, Equidad, Igualdad e Inclusión (DEIB) en ERM, puedes visitar nuestro sitio web o conocer nuestros avances en el Informe de Sostenibilidad 2026 .

postings.descriptionText:
Description

;About GE Vernova

GE Vernova is a planned, purpose-built global energy company that includes Power, Wind, and Electrification businesses and is supported by its accelerator businesses of Advanced Research, Consulting Services, and Financial Services. Building on over 130 years of experience tackling the world’s challenges, GE Vernova is uniquely positioned to help lead the energy transition by continuing to electrify the world while simultaneously working to decarbonize it. GE Vernova helps customers power economies and deliver electricity that is vital to health, safety, security, and improved quality of life. GE Vernova is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, U.S., with more than 80,000 employees across 100+ countries around the world.

GE Vernova’s Gas Power business engineers advanced, efficient natural gas-powered technologies and services, along with decarbonization solutions that aim to help electrify a lower carbon future. As part of the Gas Power One Field Services team, FieldCore installs, maintains and upgrades power generation equipment, enabling operators of the world’s energy infrastructure to provide more reliable and affordable energy.

Job Summary

A TFA FEP is an entry level position. You will start by being enrolled in FieldCore’s Field Engineering Program (FEP). While in the FEP, you will develop in-depth technical expertise, lean thinking and leadership skills and will have a unique opportunity to go through:

• In-person and Online training Curriculum

• On-the-job trainings

• Learning from experienced Technical Field Advisors (TFA’s)

You will gain experience and grow your career while traveling and helping provide power to communities. Upon successful graduation from the FEP program, you will be eligible for a TFA position.

The TFA travels to customer sites and supports customers with installation, maintenance, and warranty work with industrial power generation rotating equipment (Gas/Steam turbines). This position requires technical competence in reading and interpreting electrical/mechanical flow and instrument diagrams, dial and laser alignment and thermal growth equipment. Implements and executes the work under safety and environmental policies, serving as an example for others and provide full and active commitment in the deployment of the EHS Policies and any additional project-specific written statement or procedure.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

• Manage, perform, coordinate the management of site activities

• Perform on-site installation of systems and equipment and ongoing preventive maintenance, repair, and calibration after installation

• Respond to requests for emergency repairs and services to troublesome equipment

• Provide technical instruction and assistance to customer representatives regarding installation, operation, calibration, repair, and maintenance at customer's sites

• Perform administrative functions such as: writing technical reports, ordering materials, securing quotations, preparing job status reports, reports to customers, time sheet and expense sheets on a complete timely, and thorough basis

• Signs off on all changes implemented

• Drive customer satisfaction through commitment to quality

• Maintain strong safety mindset to assure the executed work reflects the technical requirements within GE safety standards

• Knowledge to troubleshoot and provide routine maintenance checkout for wide range of equipment vintage

• Coach, mentor, and train other team members as required, to impart and perpetuate field engineering and/or product knowledge

• Prepare timely and accurate technical reports for customer records and a reference for future outages

• Ensure all parts needed for the job are shipped to the site

• Perform walk-downs during installation to ensure that the customer’s contractors are working properly

• Perform aftermarket upgrades that need to be performed at the site level

• Ability and willingness to work holidays, weekends and overtime as required by field assignments

• Extensive travel to and from projects and various field assignments will be required

• May be assigned other duties to help proactively drive our FieldCore vision and align with our organization’s

• core values.

• Ability and willingness to work holidays, weekends and overtime as required by field assignments

• Manage and develop employees

Required Qualifications & Experience

• Technical/University degree or qualifying experience OR a High School Diploma / GED with a minimum of 4 years of experience in a Field Services role

• 3+ years of experience in a field services or power generation equipment maintenance position

• Strong technical competence in reading and interpreting electrical/mechanical flow and instrument diagrams dial and laser alignment and thermal growth equipment

• Extensive travel to and from projects and various field assignments will be required

• English proficiency required

Desired Characteristics

• Introductory level. Most new hires with little experience on the GE Product will start in this level. Participates in on-the-job training.

• Experience and training on Alstom, Siemens, or other OEM equipment

• Extensive Field Engineering Services experience

• Strong organizational and project management skills

• Strong oral and written interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills

• Strong business acumen and ability to sell GE products to the customer

FieldCore is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sex, national origin, age, veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law .

postings.title: Dell Global Alliance Director
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Global Alliances Director to join our strategic partnerships team who will be responsible for leading the Dell Technologies alliance team globally. Reporting to the Head of IHV Alliances, the Dell Global Alliance Director will work closely with Dell and Canonical teams in all geographies to develop and maintain strong relationships with senior executives at strategic partner organizations, fostering collaboration and alignment on joint business objectives. The Dell Global Alliance Director will manage and grow a global team of Business Development Managers and help them identify and pursue new business opportunities with Dell, driving revenue growth and market expansion, develop and execute go-to-market strategies for joint offerings, oversee the day-to-day management of the alliance including contract negotiations and performance tracking, and issue resolution. The Dell Global Alliance Director will also contribute to thought leadership initiatives, such as joint publications and joint customer events.

Location: This role will be based remotely in AMER regions.

The role entails

• Build and own the strategy and the development of the Alliance on a global level

• Expand strategic relationships and enable Dell teams on the partnership

• Grow business motions with Dell Technologies, across sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions

• Grow Dell’s awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu

• Manage, develop and grow a team of experienced business development managers

• Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem

• Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner

• Travel internationally - to drive partnerships in person

• Align and support internal canonical field teams - identify, support, grow, transact

• Expand existing footprint with Dell customers with an aim to upsell to broader portfolio

What We Are Looking For In You

• Proven experience as an Alliance Manager/Director

• Solid experience in Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies

• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong relationships with executives at all levels.

• Strong business acumen and a strategic mindset, with a focus on driving revenue growth and market expansion.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively present complex ideas to a variety of audiences.

• Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality

• Passionate about Canonical products and mission

• Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with measurable goals

• Team player with superior accountability and customer support skills

• Experience managing cross-functional teams and track record of operational excellence

What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: Patient Experience Representative
postings.descriptionText:
Our Mission: Hospital-Quality Care, Everywhere.

The healthcare industry still relies on faxes and phone tags to coordinate critical care for patients at home. We think patients and the clinicians who serve them deserve better than a system stuck in 1995.

Verse Medical is building the modern software infrastructure to make it happen. We're a well-funded Series C company (backed by General Catalyst, SignalFire, and Sapphire Ventures) on a mission to heal a fragmented system. Our platform connects the dots between providers, payors, and patients, ensuring people get the high-quality care they need, reliably and right where they live. We’re growing fast and looking for people who are driven by this mission to join us!

Our Values: The Principles That Guide Us

Our values are the operating system for how we work together and with our partners. They aren't just words on a wall; they are the principles we bring to every decision, every day.

• We are transparent, upfront and direct. We operate with honesty and clarity. We share information openly, the good and the bad, and believe that direct, respectful feedback is the foundation of trust and progress.

• We value speed of iteration. We are building something new, which means we learn by doing. We prioritize rapid iteration and getting solutions into the hands of users, believing that progress is more valuable than perfection.

• We give 110% effort, 30% of the time. We are passionate about our mission, and there are moments that require us to go the extra mile. We believe in focused intensity when it counts, balanced by a sustainable pace that keeps our team energized for the long run.

• We empathize with customers to a fault. When our users face a problem, we own it. Instead of asking them to change, we ask ourselves, "How can we make this better?" We believe true innovation comes from deep empathy and a relentless focus on solving the real-world challenges of healthcare.

Your Impact: How You'll Help Us Heal a Broken System

As a Patient Experience (PX) Representative at Verse Medical, you are the frontline for supporting patients and clinics with medical supply orders. Your primary goal is to ensure every patient receives the right supplies, on time, and with clear guidance. You will handle inquiries about insurance coverage, product eligibility, delivery schedules, and returns, all while maintaining a high level of empathy and professionalism.

Key Responsibilities:

• Serve as the first point of contact for patients and clinics via phone, email, and messaging platforms.

• Patient outreach to provide accurate guidance on supply orders

• Provide accurate guidance on supply orders, refill eligibility, and insurance coverage.

• Troubleshoot and resolve patient issues, including delayed shipments, incorrect items, or insurance denials.

• Escalate complex cases to operations, billing, or management as needed.

• Document interactions clearly in internal systems to ensure continuity of care and information.

• Educate patients on company policies, out-of-pocket options, and clinic coordination.

Skills & Qualities:

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex information simply.

• Empathy and patience in dealing with patients experiencing medical challenges.

• Attention to detail for order accuracy and documentation.

• Ability to work with internal teams and external clinics to resolve issues efficiently.

• Comfort using digital systems (VerseOS, knowledge bases, Slack, etc.) to access and record information.

Impact:

PX Representatives ensure patients receive timely and accurate care by facilitating smooth communication between patients, clinics, and Verse Medical's internal teams. You help build trust in the company while improving patient outcomes and satisfaction.

Hours: 24/7

Common Questions You'll Handle

Insurance & Coverage

• Why was my order covered last time but not now?

• Does my insurance cover [specific item]?

• Can I get a product not listed on my clinic's order?

Refills & Eligibility

• When is my next shipment eligible?

• Why do I get multiple shipments at different times?

• Can all my supplies be shipped together?

Product Questions

• What sizes of compression garments do you have?

• How many ostomy pouches can I get at once?

• Can I return an item if it doesn't fit?

Billing & Out-of-Pocket

• Why is there an OOP price for this item?

• What happens if insurance denies coverage?

• How do I submit a claim for workers' comp?

Shipping & Returns

• I didn't receive part of my order — what happened?

• How do I return or exchange an item?

• My package was missing/stolen — what do I do?

Tips

• Check Resources first for answers before responding.

• Always use patient-friendly language.

• Document every interaction clearly and fully.

• Escalate complex cases to Support Ops, Billing, or your team lead.

Our Pledge for an Equitable Future

At Verse Medical, our mission is to deliver equitable, hospital-quality care to everyone, regardless of their background or where they live. We can only achieve this if our own team reflects the diversity of the patients we serve. We are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, where their contributions are valued, and where they can do their best work. We embrace diversity of all kinds: race, gender, age, religion, identity, experience. We are actively working to build a more inclusive and equitable world, starting from within our own walls. We are an equal opportunity employer.

We are also committed to providing a positive and accessible interview experience. If you require any accommodations to participate in our process, please contact us at recruiting@versemedical.com.

postings.title: Project Director, Responsible Critical Minerals
postings.descriptionText:
Position Title: Project Director, Responsible Critical Minerals

Location : Chile or Argentina with regular travel between locations

About Winrock International

Winrock International is a nonprofit organization that empowers communities, expands economic opportunity, strengthens institutions, and sustains natural resources. Winrock seeks a full-time Project Director to lead an anticipated project advancing labor standards compliance and transparency in critical mineral supply chains in Argentina and Chile.

Position Summary

The Project Director will provide overall technical, managerial, financial, and representational leadership for a cooperative agreement focused on copper, lithium, and/or silver supply chains. The position will guide strategies that reduce labor-related risks, strengthen fair and reliable mineral supply, and link improved labor standards in Argentina and Chile to resilient U.S. manufacturing.

The Project Director will lead a multi-country team and partners working with government, employers, mining and processing companies, contractors, workers, civil society, and other stakeholders, and will serve as the primary point of contact with the funder in coordination with Winrock’s Home Office.

ESSENTIAL Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

• Lead an evidence-based theory of change linking stronger labor standards and supply chain transparency to reliable supply for U.S. manufacturers and benefits for American jobs and wages.

• Oversee technical assistance to labor and government institutions to strengthen enforcement gaps, inspectorate transparency and integrity, and risk-based enforcement in mining, refining, and processing.

• Guide assurance, due diligence, traceability, and transparency approaches aligned with international standards and U.S. manufacturer needs.

Stakeholder Engagement and Partnerships

• Maintain relationships with national and subnational labor and mining authorities in Argentina and Chile while avoiding duplication of government responsibilities.

• Engage workers, worker organizations, employers, industry associations, civil society, communities, research institutions, U.S. Government representatives, and other relevant actors.

• Manage subrecipients, contractors, and technical partners, including roles, performance, compliance, risk, and integration into project strategy.

Project Management

• Lead start-up, work planning, implementation, closeout, and orderly termination procedures if required.

• Translate strategy into sequenced work packages, milestones, targets, responsibilities, and budgets aligned across planning, monitoring, technical, and country-budget documents.

• Oversee monitoring, evaluation, research, and learning to define outcomes, verify milestones, ensure data quality, and adapt implementation.

• Ensure timely submission of high-quality technical deliverables, progress reports, economic impact narratives, financial reports, and final/closeout reports.

Financial, Operational, and Award Compliance

• Oversee budget management, country allocations, expenditures, forecasting, controls, procurement, subawards, and financial performance.

• Ensure compliance with the cooperative agreement, funder requirements, Winrock policies, and country requirements.

• Oversee recruitment, onboarding, supervision, and staff development to build a collaborative, accountable, results-focused team.

• Ensure project-funded products meet accessibility, communications, acknowledgment, records-retention, and open-licensing requirements.

Representation and Travel

• Serve as the principal project representative and primary point of contact for the funder and maintain constructive relationships with host-country stakeholders.

• Travel regularly to project sites and mining regions in Argentina and Chile and internationally as required.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications And Background

Education

Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred in a relevant field such as labor relations, law, public policy, international development, human rights, mining, engineering, occupational safety and health, supply chain management, or economics.

Required Experience And Competencies

• At least 10 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years leading complex donor-funded project delivery.

• Demonstrated leadership experience in the mining, mineral processing, extractive, industrial, or critical mineral sector, preferably involving copper, lithium, and/or silver.

• Established professional networks and demonstrated experience in Argentina and/or Chile, particularly in mining regions and/or with labor or mining institutions.

• Knowledge of fundamental labor rights and acceptable conditions of work, including OSH, freedom of association, collective bargaining, wages, hours, and grievance/remediation systems.

• Experience engaging labor ministries, labor inspectorates, mining authorities, employers, contractors and subcontractors, workers and worker organizations, civil society, and private-sector supply chain actors.

• Experience with labor compliance, responsible sourcing, human rights due diligence, assurance, traceability, contractor risk management, industrial relations, or supply chain transparency.

• Success managing multi-country teams, subawards, consultants, budgets, work plans, performance targets, compliance systems, and high-level donor relationships.

• Knowledge of U.S. Government assistance requirements and cooperative agreement management; prior experience strongly preferred.

• Excellent facilitation, negotiation, partnership-building, written communication, and public representation skills.

• Professional fluency in spoken and written English and Spanish required.

• Ability and willingness to travel frequently within Argentina and Chile and internationally.

• Proficiency with Microsoft word processing, spreadsheet, presentation, collaboration, and project management tools.

Position contingent on funding.

Winrock is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal treatment for all people. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, age, disability or any other basis protected by law.

At Winrock we have a clear mission: Empower the disadvantaged, increase economic opportunity and sustain natural resources through unwavering dedication to accountability, equity, innovation, integrity and transformation.
