postings.title: Global Head of Cloud Alliances
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.

Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go-to-market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.

Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.

Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.

The role entails

• Taking ownership of Canonical's global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide

• Building strong, cross-functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution

• Inspiring and guiding teams to achieve accelerated revenue growth with Cloud partners, continually refining and evolving strategies for success

• Establishing and nurturing executive-level relationships with key partners, laying the foundation for long-term success and mutual growth

• Steering our offering from concept to execution, aligning product management and marketing strategies while scaling success through our global sales organization

What we are looking for in you:

• Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

• Undergraduate degree in a technical subject

• Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation

• Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results

• Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship

• Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives

• The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues

• Exceptional leadership and presentation skills, capable of energizing teams and stakeholders while delivering compelling data-driven narratives

• Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability

• Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization

• Thoughtfulness and self-motivation

• Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments

• Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

• An in-depth understanding of open source technologies, Ubuntu, and the competitive ecosystem, with an eye for identifying opportunities that others might miss.

• Autonomous, disciplined, and proactive—take ownership, and deliver exceptional results

Nice to have

• A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success

• Solid experience in the Public Cloud sector, coupled with an understanding of the evolving landscape of technology and innovation.

• Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Employee Assistance Programme

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Would you like to shape the future of cloud computing by identifying and working with the most promising early-stage startups and venture capital firms in Argentina? Your role focuses on supporting meaningful initiatives between the investment community and AWS, helping startups leverage cloud to achieve breakthrough growth. Diverse Experiences

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

Les activités de Ford Canada se déroulent dans un siège social national, trois bureaux régionaux, trois usines de montage de véhicules et de fabrication de moteurs, deux centres de distribution de pièces, deux sites de recherche et de développement et trois centres de connectivité et d’innovation. Pour obtenir de plus amples renseignements, visitez le site www.careers.ford.com

Le responsable de la marque Lincoln agit en tant que représentant terrain dédié, chargé de stimuler la performance de la marque Lincoln au sein d'un portefeuille d'environ 25 à 30 points de vente. Il constitue le lien principal entre les objectifs de l'entreprise Ford/Lincoln et leur mise en œuvre en concession ; il collabore étroitement avec les concessionnaires et le responsable de zone Ford pour rehausser l'expérience client haut de gamme, renforcer les résultats commerciaux et garantir le respect constant des normes de la marque sur le marché qui lui est confié.

Le responsable du développement commercial (BDM) de Lincoln constitue l'interface directe entre la marque et nos concessionnaires Lincoln. Il est responsable de la performance globale des concessionnaires qui lui sont attribués, notamment de l'atteinte des objectifs du plan d'affaires en matière de ventes et de parts de marché, d'expérience client et d'autres indicateurs clés. Il agit en tant que conseiller et facilitateur auprès de chaque concessionnaire et de son équipe de direction pour aider à identifier et à quantifier les opportunités, définir les objectifs clés et les prochaines étapes, et assurer le suivi nécessaire à la réalisation des objectifs. Les BDM se voient attribuer des zones couvrant un territoire géographique spécifique ; ce poste couvrira les concessions de l'Ontario, du Québec et du Canada atlantique.

Des déplacements nécessitant de passer la nuit hors du domicile sont requis.

Ford of Canada's operations take place in a national headquarters, three regional offices, three vehicle assembly and engine manufacturing plants, two parts distribution centers, two research and development sites, and three connectivity and innovation centers. Ford employs nearly 7,000 people in Canada, and 18,000 additional people are employed by over 400 Ford and Ford Lincoln dealerships across the country. For more information, visit www.careers.ford.com

The Lincoln Brand Manager serves as the dedicated field representative responsible for driving Lincoln brand performance across a portfolio of approximately 25–30 Lincoln stores. This individual acts as the primary link between Ford/Lincoln corporate objectives and dealership execution, working hand-in-hand with dealers and the Ford zone manager to elevate the luxury customer experience, strengthen sales performance, and ensure consistent brand standards across the assigned market.

The Lincoln BDM, is the direct Company interface with our Lincoln Retailers. The BDM is responsible for overall

performance of assigned Retailers including achieving Business Plan objectives in sales/share, client experience and other key metrics. They act as an advisor and a facilitator with each Retailer and management team to help identify and quantify opportunities, work with dealers to establish key goals, next steps and follow through to achieve objectives. BDMs are assigned zones that cover a specific geographic area. This job will support Ontario, Quebec and Atlantic Canada stores.

Overnight travel is required. 

Ce que vous ferez...

• Atteindre les objectifs de vente et de parts de marché de la marque Lincoln.

• Piloter l'élaboration du plan d'affaires Lincoln de chaque concession, incluant le développement du plan annuel et les revues trimestrielles de mise en œuvre et d'activation.

• Collaborer avec le responsable de zone Ford pour optimiser l'allocation des commandes en gros, notamment par l'élaboration de plans de merchandising.

• Aider les concessionnaires à gérer leurs stocks et leur fournir des rapports réguliers.

• Réparer des objectifs de vente mensuels pour Lincoln et travailler en étroite collaboration avec les concessionnaires pour les atteindre.

• Contribuer au lancement de la campagne publicitaire Lincoln de niveau 2 en coordonnant et en maximisant la participation et l'efficacité des concessionnaires de niveau 2.

• Développer et améliorer l'expérience client Lincoln en concession chez les concessionnaires les plus prestigieux du marché du luxe.

• Dispenser des formations en concession sur l'expérience Lincoln, incluant la formation produit.

• Poursuivre la mise en œuvre et le suivi des normes opérationnelles Lincoln en concession, y compris à tous les points de contact client (ventes, service).

• Contribuer au lancement de programmes d'expérience client de luxe en concession et sur le marché. Améliorer la satisfaction client (ventes et service), les indicateurs de fidélisation et les indicateurs de l'expérience Lincoln.

What You'll Do...

The primary responsibilities for this position include but are not limited to:

• Achieve Lincoln brand sales and share objectives.

• Spearhead the development of individual store’s Lincoln business plan, including annual plan development and quarterly implementation and activation reviews.

• Work collaboratively with the Ford zone manager to support wholesale allocation, including development of merchandising plans.

• Assist dealers with inventory management and provide them with fast turning reports.

• Establish monthly Lincoln sales targets and work closely with dealers to achieve them.

• Assist in launching Lincoln tier II advertising campaign awareness through coordination and maximizing dealer tier II participation and effectiveness.

• Establish and improve the overall Lincoln in-dealership Luxury experience in top luxury market dealers

• In-dealership training for Lincoln experience including product training.

• Continue to implement and measure Dealership Lincoln Operating Standards throughout facility including all customer touch points (sales, service).

• Help launch in-dealership and in-market luxury experience programs.

• Improve Lincoln sales and service satisfaction, sales and service loyalty metrics, and Lincoln Experience metrics.

postings.title: Senior Event Producer
postings.descriptionText:
Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and detail-oriented Producer to join the Fever Originals team. You will take responsibility for the end-to-end production of complex live entertainment experiences involving the construction of permanent or semi-permanent physical spaces, ensuring they are delivered on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standards.

This role spans technical production, creative development, budgeting, process management, and leadership, and requires strong adaptability, problem-solving skills, and the ability to balance speed and quality.

You will serve as the main production point of contact across a wide portfolio of projects, coordinating technical teams, business leaders, our partners and external vendors, while leading processes that guarantee exceptional experiences for our audiences.

Responsibilities

Project Management

• Oversee all phases of production—from initial concept development through on-site execution and post-event wrap-up.

• Interpret creative briefs, site layouts, and project requirements to ensure feasibility and alignment with company goals.

• Validate site logistics and operational needs through planning sessions, venue scouting, and site visits.

• Coordinate cross-department collaboration across creative, operations, technical, and vendor teams.

Process Documentation

• Create and maintain comprehensive production documentation, timelines, and handover materials.

• Develop and track schedules, milestones, and deliverables using project management tools.

• Support consistent communication flow and version control for all project documentation.

Budgeting and Financial Management

postings.descriptionText:
Description

Project Associate, RWLP

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.

• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.

• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

• Drives the planning and execution of elements of clinical trials in partnership with the Project Lead.

• Ensures projects adhere to strict timelines and are delivered within budget.

• Coordinates internal resources and third parties/vendors for the efficient execution of projects.

• Conducts ongoing analysis of project performance to drive the successful completion of short and

long-term goals.

• May maintain and distribute study-specific financial reports and contribute to study’s financial health using financial processes and systems.

• Documents project scope and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders.

• Leads communication between project team members, ensuring all parties are informed of project status and changes.

• Documents and escalates project risks and issues and drives timely follow-through and completion.

• Maintenance of systems and project management tools and methodologies.

• Drives quality assurance activities, including preparation for audits and internal review, prepare documentation and follow through to resolution on actionable issues.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

Summary

The Project Associate will drive and support overall project management activities to ensure successful execution of clinical trials, which may range from single service studies to full scope or multiple protocol and/or global projects. This role requires coordination of project tasks, maintaining documentation, communicating with stakeholders, and maintenance of timelines and budgets.

Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

ㅤ

*This is a temporary position*

The Job
The Live Events BOC Operator is responsible for supporting the successful delivery of live sports, entertainment, and special event broadcasts across linear and digital platforms. This role plays a critical part in the Broadcast Operations Center (BOC), ensuring the highest standards of audio and video quality, transmission reliability, and operational execution throughout live events. Working closely with production teams, technical partners, and transmission providers, the operator helps ensure seamless live broadcasts that deliver an exceptional viewer experience.

The Daily – Major Activities
1. Coordination via communications matrix (intercom) with the production site (countdowns to enter and exit live).
2. Insertion of promotional and commercial graphics.
3. Link quality control (fiber optics, satellite link, LiveU link).
4. Audio and video quality control.
5. Recording and ingesting live content for archiving or later playback.
6. Operation of streaming productions for social media or OTT destinations (software: vMix).

The Essentials

• Studies in Broadcasting, Audiovisual Production, Film & Television, Image and Sound Design, Communications, or a related field.

• Understanding of live broadcast workflows and transmission operations.

• Ability to react quickly and effectively in time-sensitive, high-pressure environments.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence.

• Excellent organizational and communication skills.

• Flexibility to work rotating schedules and live event coverage as required.

• Proactive problem-solving mindset and ability to collaborate across multiple teams.

The Nice to Haves

• Experience supporting live sports or large-scale live productions.

• Knowledge of video transmission technologies, including fiber, satellite, IP, and bonded cellular solutions (e.g., LiveU).

• Experience with broadcast and streaming platforms such as vMix, Vizrt, EVS, or similar systems.

About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

Some Important Details
We embrace the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit. In line with the laws of the country or region in which the role is based, this includes consideration without regard to race, color, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship status, religion or belief, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, physical or mental disability, genetic information, military or protected veteran status, union status or any other category protected by applicable law.

postings.title: Encargada de Ecommerce Dominio avanzado de Tiendanube - Córdoba  Modalidad presencial Jornada full time
postings.descriptionText:
Buscamos una persona con experiencia comprobable en administración y optimización de tiendas online, dominio avanzado de Tiendanube y conocimientos técnicos para mejorar el funcionamiento, la experiencia de compra y los resultados comerciales de ambas marcas.

IMPORTANTE: Solo se evaluarán los CV que acrediten experiencia concreta en Tiendanube y los conocimientos técnicos excluyentes detallados en este anuncio. La experiencia únicamente en atención al cliente, redes sociales o carga básica de productos no resulta suficiente para este puesto.

Modalidad, horario y lugar de trabajo
• Modalidad 100 % presencial.
• Jornada de lunes a viernes de 8:00 a 17:00 h.
• Es excluyente contar con disponibilidad para cumplir el horario y asistir diariamente al lugar de trabajo, así como tener movilidad propia. 

Objetivo del puesto

Gestionar integralmente las tiendas online, asegurando su correcto funcionamiento e implementando mejoras técnicas, comerciales y de experiencia de usuario. Buscamos una persona capaz de detectar problemas, proponer soluciones, ejecutar cambios y medir sus resultados.

Principales responsabilidades

• Administrar el panel de Tiendanube: productos, categorías, variantes, SKU, precios, stock, promociones, cupones, medios de pago y opciones de envío.
• Realizar cargas y actualizaciones masivas de catálogo, verificando la calidad y consistencia de la información.
• Actualizar y optimizar la página de inicio, menús, banners, secciones, páginas de contenido y fichas de producto.
• Mejorar la navegación y la experiencia de compra en celulares y computadoras.
• Implementar ajustes de diseño y presentación, incluyendo modificaciones acotadas mediante HTML y CSS, según las posibilidades de la plataforma.
• Revisar el recorrido completo de compra y resolver errores de configuración, promociones, pagos y envíos.
• Configurar aplicaciones y supervisar integraciones con sistemas de stock, facturación, ERP, logística y herramientas de marketing.
• Detectar fallas de sincronización, documentarlas y gestionar su resolución con proveedores, verificando el resultado.
• Analizar tráfico, ventas, conversión, ticket promedio y abandono del proceso de compra.
• Aplicar mejoras de SEO en productos, categorías y contenidos.
• Implementar acciones de recuperación de carritos y recompra.
• Coordinar campañas y mejoras con agencias, diseño, proveedores tecnológicos y el equipo de Atención al Cliente.
• Presentar reportes por marca y mantener un plan de mejoras priorizado según impacto comercial.
• Ejecutar pruebas antes y después de cada cambio, documentando las modificaciones realizadas.

Requisitos excluyentes
• Experiencia comprobable administrando y optimizando tiendas en Tiendanube.
• Dominio avanzado del panel administrador, con autonomía para configurar y resolver necesidades operativas de la tienda.
• Experiencia modificando el diseño, la estructura, los menús y las secciones de una tienda.
• Conocimientos prácticos de HTML y CSS para realizar ajustes de presentación y detectar problemas.
• Manejo de Excel o Google Sheets y archivos CSV para cargas masivas, control de catálogo y análisis.
• Manejo de Google Analytics 4 y capacidad para interpretar el recorrido de compra y los indicadores de conversión.
• Conocimientos de SEO para e-commerce y Google Search Console.
• Conocimientos de píxel de Meta, eventos de conversión, parámetros UTM y Google Tag Manager, suficientes para revisar la medición e identificar errores.
• Experiencia trabajando con aplicaciones e integraciones de pagos, envíos, stock o facturación.
• Capacidad para identificar oportunidades de mejora, implementarlas dentro de su alcance y evaluar sus resultados.
• Disponibilidad para trabajar presencialmente en Zona Este, de lunes a viernes de 8:00 a 17:00 h.

Los desarrollos complejos podrán coordinarse con especialistas externos. La persona deberá poder definir el requerimiento, dar seguimiento y validar técnicamente la solución.

Se valorará adicionalmente
• Experiencia con ERP Kiboo y/o Cover.
• Conocimientos de JavaScript, API y automatizaciones.
• Manejo de CRM y herramientas de email marketing.
• Experiencia en calzado, indumentaria, suplementos o comercios con múltiples variantes de productos.
• Formación en Comercio Electrónico, Marketing Digital, Sistemas o áreas afines.

Cómo postularse
Para que tu postulación sea considerada, el CV o la presentación adjunta deberá indicar:
• Tiendas en Tiendanube que hayas administrado, con enlaces cuando sea posible.
• Funciones que realizabas directamente y herramientas que utilizabas.
• Mejoras técnicas o comerciales que hayas implementado y sus resultados, cuando cuentes con esa información.
• Nivel de manejo de HTML/CSS, Google Analytics 4 e integraciones.
• Disponibilidad para el horario y la modalidad presencial indicados.

Solo avanzarán las postulaciones que acrediten los requisitos excluyentes. El proceso de selección incluirá una evaluación práctica de Tiendanube y resolución de situaciones habituales de una tienda online.

Buscamos un perfil capaz de comunicar tecnología industrial de forma clara, cercana y profesional, generando confianza en potenciales clientes. El rol estará enfocado en la creación de contenido en fábrica sobre maquinaria CNC, láser y procesos productivos.

Modalidad: Trabajo en planta (fábrica) PRESENCIAL lunes a viernes 8 - 17 hs

postings.title: Testing
postings.descriptionText:
¡Estamos buscando una persona para sumarse a nuestro equipo de Testing!

Buscamos una persona analítica, organizada y detallista, con interés en tecnología y orientación a la calidad, para sumarse a nuestro equipo.
¿Cuál será tu desafío?

Ser responsable de validar la calidad funcional de nuestros desarrollos, asegurando que las soluciones respondan a las necesidades del usuario y estén listas para su liberación.

Además, tendrás un rol de coordinación y seguimiento del equipo de Desarrollo, trabajando como nexo con las distintas áreas de la organización.

Tus principales desafíos
Analizar requerimientos y detectar posibles inconsistencias antes del desarrollo.
Coordinar y realizar seguimiento de tareas, prioridades, entregas y releases.
Ejecutar testing funcional, exploratorio y de regresión.
Validar sistemas web, aplicaciones, APIs, integraciones y reportes.
Detectar, documentar y realizar seguimiento de bugs en Azure DevOps.
Realizar re-testing y validaciones en ambientes Preview y Producción.
Validar aspectos de UX/UI desde la perspectiva del usuario.
Proponer mejoras y oportunidades de automatización e IA aplicada a Testing.
¿Qué buscamos?

Requisito: Secundario completo.
Valoramos formación o experiencia en Sistemas, Informática, Programación, QA/Testing o carreras afines.

Será un plus contar con conocimientos de:
Azure DevOps · APIs · SQL · Bases de datos · Automatización · IA aplicada a Testing

postings.title: Ingeniero de Preventas de Seguridad Ssr/Sr
postings.descriptionText:
Somos Ecosistemas, una compañía global de tecnología que conecta a nuestros clientes con soluciones a medida, integrales e innovadoras. Operamos en más de 15 países, incluyendo Argentina, Chile, Brasil, México, Estados Unidos y España.
¡Queremos que seas parte de este gran equipo!
¿Qué estamos buscando?
Ingeniero de Preventas de Seguridad , para unirse a nuestro equipo del cliente .
Lugar de trabajo: Zona Norte - BA
Modalidad: Híbrido
Horario: De 9 a 18 hs
Formación Académica:
Título universitario en Ingeniería en Sistemas, Informática, ingenieros electrónicos o carreras afines.
Inglés Intermedio
Conocimientos:
-Conocimiento de infra de IT, Windows Linux, TCP/IP
-SQL, redes CCTV, Control De Accesos, Intrusión, Sistemas De Alarmas Y Sistemas De Protección Perimetral y Autocad Deseable.
Principales responsabilidades:
-Relevar y analizar las necesidades de los clientes, participando en reuniones técnicas y visitas a instalaciones cuando corresponda.
-Diseñar y dimensionar soluciones de seguridad electrónica que contemplen CCTV, control de accesos, detección de intrusión, alarmas y protección perimetral.
-Evaluar la infraestructura IT necesaria para implementar las soluciones, considerando redes, conectividad, servidores, sistemas operativos y bases de datos.
-Elaborar propuestas técnicas, memorias descriptivas, especificaciones y documentación de respaldo, con una redacción clara y orientada a las necesidades del cliente.
-Colaborar en la preparación de cotizaciones y presupuestos, definiendo equipamiento, licencias, servicios, alcances y requerimientos de implementación.
-Trabajar junto al equipo comercial en la presentación de soluciones y resolución de consultas técnicas.
-Coordinar con las áreas de implementación y operaciones el traspaso de los proyectos adjudicados, asegurando claridad sobre el alcance comprometido.
-Mantenerse actualizado sobre tecnologías y productos de seguridad electrónica, participando en las capacitaciones brindadas por la compañía.
Requisitos:
-Conocimientos de infraestructura IT: entornos Windows y Linux, redes y protocolos TCP/IP.
-Conocimientos de SQL y bases de datos para comprender los requerimientos e integraciones de las soluciones.
-Capacidad para elaborar documentación técnica y propuestas comerciales.
-Buen nivel de comunicación, orientación comercial y capacidad para comprender las necesidades del cliente y traducirlas en propuestas técnicas.
-Disponibilidad para viajar
-Se valorará:.
-Experiencia o conocimientos en sistemas electrónicos de seguridad: CCTV, control de accesos, intrusión, alarmas y protección perimetral.
-Manejo de AutoCAD para lectura y elaboración de planos.
Se ofrecen excelentes beneficios, oportunidades de crecimiento, capacitaciones,y te acompañaremos en tu desarrollo profesional.
En Ecosistemas consideramos que la diversidad enriquece nuestra cultura y perspectivas, por lo que fomentamos activamente un entorno inclusivo donde cada individuo, sin importar su origen, género, orientación, habilidades o creencias, no solo es bienvenido, sino también fundamental para nuestro éxito. Valoramos y respetamos todas las voces, y te invitamos a unirte a nuestro equipo, donde la inclusión es un pilar esencial de nuestros valores.

postings.title: Líderes de Sucursal: Gerentes, Encargadas y Referentes de Turno
postings.descriptionText:
Líderes Operativos de Sucursal
(Múltiples vacantes para diferentes locales dentro de CABA)
Entendemos que una experiencia de cliente sobresaliente es el reflejo directo de un equipo bien liderado. Por eso, no buscamos meros administradores de local: impulsamos la incorporación de líderes operativos con la capacidad de elevar nuestros estándares de calidad, potenciar el talento de su gente y ejecutar procesos con máxima precisión.
Actualmente nos encontramos en la búsqueda de líderes operativos para sumarse a nuestros equipos en Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires (CABA) y formar parte de nuestro plan de próximas aperturas.
Buscamos incorporar talentos para las posiciones de:
Gerente de Sucursal
Encargado/a de Local
Líder de Turno
Nos orientamos a perfiles con alto sentido de la responsabilidad, compromiso y capacidad organizativa para coordinar equipos de trabajo, que reúnan:
Experiencia previa: Mínimo 3 años en posiciones de gerencia, supervisión o liderazgo de equipos (preferentemente en gastronomía o sectores de alta exigencia operativa).
Solvencia operativa: Habilidad para ejecutar y auditar procesos que garanticen la inocuidad alimentaria y la excelencia del producto.
Manejo de herramientas digitales: Dominio intermedio de Excel para el control de inventarios, gestión de planillas y seguimiento de chequeos. Deseable manejo de Ayres, Maxirest, o similares.
Liderazgo equilibrado: Firmeza en el cumplimiento de metodologías y empatía para guiar, motivar y desarrollar equipos de alto rendimiento.
Principales Desafíos
1. Gestión del Talento y Liderazgo Humano
Fomentar un clima laboral positivo basado en la comunicación transparente.
Impulsar la cultura del feedback: realizar evaluaciones de desempeño, identificar oportunidades de mejora y potenciar las capacidades de cada colaborador.
Diagramar y organizar los horarios del personal para asegurar la continuidad y eficiencia del servicio.
2. Control Operativo y Calidad
Velar por el cumplimiento estricto de las normas de seguridad e higiene alimentaria, así como la correcta rotación de insumos (criterio PEPS).
Realizar la gestión rigurosa de stocks, coordinar pedidos y minimizar desperdicios.
Realizar controles administrativos, revisión de checklists y auditoría de procesos operativos.
Analizar indicadores para optimizar el funcionamiento general de la sucursal y asegurar una experiencia memorable para el cliente.
Información de la Propuesta:
Sumate a un proyecto que no para de crecer, donde la gestión de la calidad y la experiencia del cliente son el motor del éxito.
Un entorno que reconoce la calidad y la mejora continua.
Jornada laboral con turnos rotativos, incluyendo fines de semana y feriados (esquema propio de la actividad).
Sucursales distribuidas en diversos barrios de CABA.
Estabilidad Laboral y oportunidades de desarrollo.
Buenas condiciones de contratación.
¿Cumplís con el perfil y querés asumir el desafío de liderar una de nuestras sucursales?
¡Esperamos tu postulación!

postings.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer con experiencia en Node.js y React.js – Remoto (LATAM)
postings.descriptionText:
Sobre Coderio

Coderio diseña y entrega soluciones digitales escalables para empresas globales. Con una base técnica sólida y una mentalidad orientada al producto, nuestros equipos lideran proyectos de software complejos desde la arquitectura hasta la ejecución. Valoramos la autonomía, la comunicación clara y la excelencia técnica. Colaboramos estrechamente con equipos y socios internacionales, construyendo tecnología que genera impacto.

🌍 Más información: http://coderio.com

Qué buscamos

Buscamos un Senior Fullstack Developer (Node.js & React.js) para sumarse a nuestro equipo regional en modalidad 100% remota desde LATAM. En este rol, serás clave en el diseño de arquitecturas escalables, la creación de experiencias de usuario de alto impacto y la evolución de nuestros procesos mediante metodologías avanzadas de desarrollo asistido por Inteligencia Artificial.

Main Stack

• Frontend: React.js (v18+), TypeScript, Vite, Material UI / Tailwind CSS, HTML5/CSS3.

• Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, Express / NestJS, RESTful APIs, GraphQL.

• Databases: Relacionales (PostgreSQL, MySQL / RDS) y NoSQL (MongoDB / DynamoDB).

• Cloud & DevOps: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, ECS/EKS), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform / CloudFormation, CI/CD (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI).

• Version Control & Quality: Git, Jest / React Testing Library.

• Methodologies & AI: Agile (Scrum / Kanban), Spec-Driven Development (SDD), integración y asistencia con IA Generativa.

Main Responsibilities

• Desarrollo Fullstack End-to-End: Diseñar, implementar y evolucionar arquitecturas escalables, desarrollando interfaces web dinámicas en React.js con TypeScript y servicios robustos en el backend con Node.js.

• Gestión de Bases de Datos: Diseñar esquemas eficientes, optimizar consultas e interactuar con bases de datos relacionales (PostgreSQL, SQL / RDS) y entornos NoSQL.

• Infraestructura y CI/CD: Gestionar y aprovisionar recursos en la nube (AWS) mediante Infraestructura como Código (Terraform), implementar contenedores (Docker, Kubernetes) y automatizar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI) para despliegues continuos.

• Desarrollo e Ingeniería Asistida por IA: Incorporar metodologías de desarrollo guiado por especificaciones (SDD) y estructurar prompts avanzados para guiar herramientas de IA en la producción y optimización ágil de código.

• Calidad y Buenas Prácticas: Garantizar la seguridad, estabilidad y rendimiento del código propio y asistido por IA mediante la creación de suites de pruebas unitarias y de integración (Jest / Testing Library) y revisiones de código (code reviews).

• Consultoría Técnica y Colaboración Ágil: Actuar como nexo entre los requerimientos de negocio y la ejecución técnica, traduciendo necesidades funcionales en arquitecturas eficientes dentro de un marco de trabajo Agile.

Requirements & Qualifications

• Experiencia: +5 años de experiencia comprobable en desarrollo de software Fullstack.

• Sólido dominio técnico: Dominio experto de Node.js, React.js y TypeScript.

• Bases de Datos & Cloud: Experiencia en modelado y consultas con PostgreSQL / SQL, así como conocimientos prácticos en AWS, integración de pipelines CI/CD y gestión de contenedores con Docker.

• Nivel de Inglés: Intermedio / B2 (Capacidad para mantener conversaciones fluidas, articular soluciones técnicas y participar en reuniones internacionales).

• Metodologías: Experiencia comprobada trabajando en entornos ágiles (Scrum / Kanban).

• Soft Skills: Capacidad de abstracción, proactividad, buenas habilidades interpersonales para interactuar con áreas de negocio y autonomía para trabajar de forma remota.

Nice to Have / Deseable

• Experiencia en orquestación avanzada con Kubernetes e Infraestructura como Código con Terraform / CloudFormation.

• Conocimientos en arquitecturas orientadas a eventos (SQS / SNS / Kafka) o arquitecturas Serverless (AWS Lambda, API Gateway).

• Familiaridad con APIs de integración de mapas, patrones de diseño de software y prácticas de desarrollo seguro.

Beneficios

• 100% remoto

• Compromiso a largo plazo, con autonomía e impacto

• Rol estratégico y de alta visibilidad en una cultura de ingeniería moderna

• Equipo internacional colaborativo y liderazgo técnico sólido

• Plan de carrera y crecimiento dentro de Coderio

¿Por qué unirte a Coderio?

En Coderio valoramos el talento sin importar la ubicación. Somos una empresa remote-first,apasionada por la tecnología, el trabajo colaborativo y la compensación justa. Ofrecemos un entorno inclusivo, desafiante y con oportunidades reales de crecimiento. Si te motiva construir soluciones con impacto, te estamos esperando.

Postula ahora.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

postings.title: Full-Stack Web Developer
postings.descriptionText:
We're hiring a Full-Stack Web Developer to build and ship web products for US-based clients at Bolder Apps. You'll own features end to end, from the database and API to the React interface users actually touch. Our stack is React and Next.js on the frontend and Node.js on the backend. We use AI coding tools every day, and we still need people who have built real backends and real frontends with their own hands, and who can tell when generated code is almost right but wrong. If you've shipped full-stack products to production and want to work directly with founders, we want to talk.

About Us

Bolder Apps is a product development studio that partners with US-based startups and established companies to build and scale innovative digital products. We specialize in AI-powered development, full-cycle product creation, and engineering team augmentation. Our mission is simple: build bolder, faster, and smarter.

Our Culture & Values (read before applying)

We move fast. We take ownership. We work with AI, not against it. And we expect everyone to bring ideas, not wait for instructions.

There are no daily checklists, no micromanagement, and no corporate politics. Instead, you'll have autonomy, trust, and a team that's always ready to help you grow. At Bolder Apps, impact matters more than titles, and curiosity matters more than seniority.

If you want a place where you can level up fast and actually see your work making a difference - welcome aboard.

Responsibilities

• Build and ship full-stack features for client web products, from data model and API through to the React and Next.js interface

• Design and maintain backend services and APIs in Node.js, including auth, integrations, background jobs, and database work

• Build fast, accessible, responsive frontends in React and Next.js, including server rendering and routing where it fits

• Turn product briefs and designs into working software, and push back early when scope or technical approach is wrong

• Use AI coding tools to move faster, then review, test, and own every line before it reaches production

• Keep code clean, tested, and documented so the next engineer can pick it up

• Work directly with PMs, designers, and US clients on estimates, trade-offs, and launch risk

• Deploy, monitor, and fix production issues on the apps you build

Requirements

• Proven full-stack experience. 3+ years building production web applications where you personally wrote both the backend and the frontend. Your portfolio or work history shows shipped products, not only tutorials or demos

• React. Strong hands-on React experience. Next.js in production is a strong plus

• Backend. Production experience with Node.js, or another popular backend language such as Python, with a clear path to Node.js. You have designed APIs, worked with relational databases, and handled auth and third-party integrations

• TypeScript and modern JavaScript fluency

• Engineering fundamentals. Git, code review, testing, and careful production deploys

• AI-augmented workflow. You use Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar daily, and you can catch and fix what they get wrong

• English at C1 or above. Client calls and written updates go out in your voice

• US hours overlap. Available through roughly 5 PM EST for live client coordination

• Ownership habits. Honest estimates, early blockers, finished work

Nice to have

• Agency or multi-client experience

• Cloud and hosting experience (Vercel, AWS, or similar)

• Experience with Postgres, Prisma, or Supabase

• Some React Native or mobile exposure

Benefits

• Full-time, fully remote role, with overlap into US Eastern time for client coordination

• Opportunity to build exciting products for the US market

• Steady pipeline of client work as part of a growing team

• Real autonomy over how you design and build, with no rigid playbook

• Direct line to decision-makers, no extra layers between you and the people who own the outcome

• A peer network of product-minded engineers working on overlapping projects

postings.title: Especialista en desarrollo de software con IA
postings.descriptionText:
Para las tareas de análisis funcional, comunicación con inteligencia artificial y coordinación de agentes para completar y evolucionar una plataforma de gestión empresarial, buscamos personas que sepan conducir a las IA hasta obtener resultados verificables: dar contexto, preguntar con precisión, cuestionar respuestas y detectar lo que falta.

El proyecto y el objetivo

Incorporamos una persona a un equipo que desarrolla una plataforma de gestión Empresarial mediante múltiples agentes de inteligencia artificial. El producto se encuentra en una etapa avanzada de desarrollo y pruebas.

El primer objetivo es completar las funcionalidades pendientes y su validación durante los próximos 9 meses, para poder comenzar las instalaciones. Buscamos continuidad, con un horizonte de colaboración de al menos 18 meses, acompañando después las instalaciones y la evolución del producto.

Cómo trabajamos

Las funcionalidades se definen en especificaciones documentadas en Markdown, que internamente llamamos contratos funcionales . Cada contrato describe el alcance, las reglas del negocio y el resultado esperado.

Los agentes de IA se coordinan mediante un circuito de instrucciones automatizadas. Las personas que se incorporen continuarán contratos tecnicos encaminados y asumirán los siguientes dentro del alcance asignado, con supervisión del responsable del producto y coordinación del equipo.

Ya contamos con pruebas automatizadas E2E y generación de manuales y videos en funcionamiento. La validación de los procesos estará a cargo de la coordinadora. El cierre de un contrato requiere alcance cumplido, ejecución de E2E y aprobación del responsable del producto.

Qué harás

• Comprender el estado de cada contrato y conducir su implementación hasta completar el alcance acordado.

• Trabajar con agentes de IA de desarrollo, coordinación y revisión, manteniendo el contexto y la continuidad del trabajo.

• Formular instrucciones claras, repreguntar y cuestionar respuestas ambiguas o sin evidencia.

• Detectar omisiones, contradicciones y supuestos que deban consultarse con el responsable del producto.

• Investigar bloqueos, dirigir correcciones y revisar los cambios y resultados de las pruebas automatizadas.

• Resolver las observaciones surgidas de la validación, sin ampliar por cuenta propia el alcance.

• Documentar avances, pendientes y evidencias para facilitar el seguimiento y la aprobación.

Lo que necesitamos de ti

• Experiencia práctica demostrable trabajando con IA en software. Saber qué pedir, cómo decirlo, qué esperar y cuándo cuestionar el resultado.

• Análisis funcional, sentido común y criterio. Comprender reglas de negocio, excepciones y dependencias.

• Autonomía y perseverancia. Investigar y resolver problemas, reconociendo cuándo necesitas una decisión del equipo.

• Capacidad de verificación. No dar una tarea por terminada solamente porque una IA lo afirma.

• Comprensión técnica suficiente para interpretar errores, cambios de código y resultados de pruebas.

• Respeto por el trabajo existente. Recuperar contexto, seguir la arquitectura y mantener el alcance acordado.

• Buena comunicación oral y escrita en español. El español es el idioma de trabajo; no se exige inglés.

No es indispensable ser un programador sénior. Sí es esencial demostrar capacidad para conducir a las IA con criterio y comprender técnicamente sus resultados.

Conocimientos que valoramos

Experiencia con Claude, GPT, agentes de programación, Git/GitHub, WSL2/Linux y documentación en Markdown. El entorno tecnológico incluye FastAPI, PostgreSQL y React.

También valoramos experiencia continuando proyectos existentes, coordinando varios agentes y trabajando con pruebas E2E.

Modalidad de trabajo

Dedicación : Tiempo completo.

Horario argentino : De 8 a 17 o de 9 a 18, a acordar.

Ubicación : Oficina en Rosario, Argentina.

Presencialidad : Preferencia por quienes puedan asistir a la oficina. También se consideran postulaciones remotas.

Continuidad : Horizonte de colaboración de al menos 18 meses.

Idioma : Español, oral y escrito.

Cómo postularte

Envía tu CV o perfil profesional, disponibilidad, posibilidad de asistir a la oficina y remuneración pretendida.

Incluye un ejemplo concreto de un proyecto realizado con IA y explica:

• Qué responsabilidad tuviste y qué herramientas utilizaste.

• Qué error u omisión de la IA detectaste y cómo lo resolviste.

• Cómo comprobaste que el resultado funcionaba y cumplía lo solicitado.

La selección incluirá una instancia práctica para observar cómo trabajas con IA sobre una tarea de software: cómo recuperas contexto, das instrucciones, cuestionas respuestas y verificas resultados.

postings.title: Especialista en desarrollo con IA y seguridad informática
postings.descriptionText:
Buscamos una persona con experiencia práctica en desarrollo de software asistido por inteligencia artificial y conocimientos sólidos y demostrables en seguridad de aplicaciones e infraestructura, especialmente en AWS.

Responsabilidades

• Continuar funcionalidades a partir de especificaciones documentadas, trabajando con agentes de IA de desarrollo, coordinación y revisión.

• Dar instrucciones precisas, mantener el contexto, cuestionar respuestas y verificar los resultados.

• Detectar riesgos de seguridad en el código, las APIs, los permisos y las configuraciones.

• Participar en el diseño y preparación de los entornos de desarrollo, staging y producción en AWS.

• Implementar controles de acceso mínimo para personas, agentes de IA y automatizaciones.

• Proteger credenciales y secretos, y organizar su almacenamiento y rotación.

• Mejorar la seguridad de GitHub y de los procesos de integración y pruebas automáticas.

• Preparar registros, alertas y procedimientos de respuesta y recuperación.

• Documentar las decisiones y trabajar con el responsable del producto y la coordinadora.

Experiencia indispensable con IA

Necesitamos experiencia real utilizando IA para desarrollar o completar software: saber qué pedir, cómo contextualizar, cuándo repreguntar y qué no dar por supuesto.

Debe poder detectar omisiones, cuestionar soluciones aparentemente correctas y exigir evidencia antes de considerar una tarea terminada.

Valoramos especialmente experiencia con Claude, GPT y coordinación de múltiples agentes.

Experiencia indispensable en seguridad

• AWS: IAM, roles, políticas, MFA y mínimo privilegio.

• Redes y servidores: VPC, grupos de seguridad, accesos y administración segura de Linux/Ubuntu.

• Separación de entornos y protección de bases de datos.

• Gestión de secretos y prevención de filtraciones en repositorios, documentación y herramientas de IA.

• Seguridad de aplicaciones y APIs: autenticación, autorización, validación de entradas y aislamiento de datos entre clientes.

• Seguridad de GitHub y CI/CD: protección de ramas, permisos de automatizaciones y ejecución aislada de pruebas.

• Análisis de vulnerabilidades, priorización de hallazgos y verificación de correcciones.

• Registros y monitoreo, backups y pruebas de restauración.

La experiencia debe ir más allá de desplegar aplicaciones en AWS: buscamos capacidad para explicar riesgos, implementar controles y comprobar que funcionan.

Entorno técnico

El proyecto utiliza FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React, GitHub y WSL2/Linux. Las especificaciones funcionales se documentan en Markdown. Ya existe un circuito de pruebas E2E y generación de manuales y videos.

Forma de trabajar

Buscamos autonomía, análisis funcional, sentido común y comunicación clara. La persona deberá respetar el alcance de las tareas, los permisos asignados y el proceso de revisión e integración.

La responsabilidad en seguridad no implica acceso administrativo irrestricto. Los accesos se otorgarán según las tareas y el merge quedará reservado al responsable del proyecto.

Modalidad

• Una vacante a tiempo completo.

• Horario argentino: de 8 a 17 o de 9 a 18, a acordar.

• Oficina en Rosario, Argentina.

• Preferencia por personas que puedan asistir a la oficina; también se consideran postulaciones remotas.

• Horizonte de colaboración de al menos 18 meses.

• Idioma de trabajo: español. Inglés técnico.

Postulación

Envía tu CV o perfil profesional, disponibilidad, posibilidad de asistir a la oficina y remuneración pretendida

Incluye Dos Ejemplos Concretos

• Un proyecto desarrollado con IA: qué hiciste, qué error de la IA detectaste y cómo verificaste el resultado.

• Un trabajo de seguridad, preferentemente en AWS: qué riesgo identificaste, qué controles implementaste y cómo comprobaste su efectividad.

No incluyas credenciales ni información confidencial de otros proyectos.

La selección incluirá una instancia práctica de trabajo con IA y análisis de seguridad en un entorno de prueba.

postings.title: Data Platform Engineer (Mid-level)
postings.descriptionText:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Platform Engineer (Mid-level) based in Argentina.

In this role, you will help transform an established data and machine learning platform into a scalable, self-service environment that empowers engineering teams to work independently. You will build and improve deployment pipelines, infrastructure-as-code modules, and reusable tooling that makes data services easier to launch, manage, and maintain. Working across data engineering, backend development, and infrastructure, you will contribute to reliable systems that support a global shipping and fulfillment platform. You will join an experienced Data & AI team with established engineering standards, giving you a solid foundation to make a tangible impact from your first weeks. The position offers increasing ownership, with the opportunity to lead the roadmap for shared platform tooling within your first six months. You will also work in an AI-enabled engineering culture that values technical judgment, accountability, and the ability to explain and validate the code you deliver.

Accountabilities

• Improve CI/CD pipelines: Analyze existing deployment pipelines, determine the requirements of new tasks, and adapt established workflows to support reliable, repeatable software delivery.

• Develop infrastructure-as-code: Extend and maintain infrastructure modules in line with existing repository patterns, ensuring consistency, reliability, and maintainability across services.

• Apply data governance standards: Implement naming conventions, access controls, retention policies, and other governance requirements for new data services and infrastructure.

• Build self-service platform tooling: Develop and maintain a reusable template repository with preconfigured CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and governance standards so engineering teams can launch new pipelines with minimal manual intervention.

• Create reusable modules: Build tools and modules that simplify pipeline creation and reduce repetitive engineering work, making common platform tasks accessible through standardized workflows.

• Improve technical documentation: Write practical documentation, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides that help engineers understand and operate systems independently without relying on individual team members.

• Own data access workflows: Design and manage access-request processes for data resources, reducing bottlenecks and enabling teams to obtain the permissions they need efficiently.

• Take ownership of platform tooling: Progress toward full responsibility for the template repository and infrastructure modules, including technical direction, prioritization, maintenance, and roadmap decisions.

• Collaborate across engineering disciplines: Work with data engineers, backend engineers, and infrastructure specialists to improve platform reliability and make shared tools useful across teams.

• Use AI tools responsibly: Incorporate AI-assisted development tools into everyday workflows while validating generated code, identifying potential errors, and explaining the reasoning behind technical decisions.

Requirements

• Deployment ownership: Demonstrated experience independently owning a deployment path end to end, including building a pipeline, troubleshooting failures, resolving production issues, and documenting the solution in a runbook.

• Professional experience: Approximately two years or more of professional experience in software, data, platform, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering.

• Technical education: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

• Python and SQL: Practical working knowledge of both languages and the ability to use them regularly in professional engineering tasks.

• CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code: Experience working with deployment pipelines and infrastructure-as-code practices, with the ability to understand, adapt, and improve existing implementations.

• Code analysis and troubleshooting: Ability to navigate an unfamiliar codebase, explain how it works, identify potential failure points, and make sound technical judgments.

• Containers and cloud: Experience with Docker and familiarity with cloud computing concepts, particularly AWS. Previous experience with specific services such as SageMaker is not required.

• Cross-functional technical skills: Willingness and ability to work across data engineering, backend systems, and infrastructure rather than focusing exclusively on one area.

• AI-assisted development: Comfortable using AI coding assistants such as Copilot, Claude, or Cursor. You must be able to review generated code critically, explain why it is correct, and recognize when it is inaccurate or unsafe.

• Ownership and accountability: A proactive mindset, willingness to take responsibility for systems you modify, and honesty about failures, root causes, and lessons learned.

• Respect for established patterns: Ability to understand existing architecture and engineering conventions before deciding what should change.

• Communication and reasoning: Comfortable explaining technical decisions, defending implementation choices, and being evaluated on reasoning as well as delivery.

• Learning mindset: Motivated to develop new skills and explore unfamiliar tools. Prior experience with every technology or the specific business domain is not required.

Benefits

• Competitive salary: Annual compensation ranging from €33,000 to €43,000, determined through an objective salary assessment process.

• Remote flexibility: Work remotely from anywhere worldwide, with company-funded trips to headquarters for team meetups.

• Meal vouchers: Meal vouchers available to remote and office-based employees.

• Mental health and fitness support: Benefits designed to support physical and mental well-being.

• Learning and development: An annual learning budget to support professional growth and technical development.

• AI tools: Access to AI-powered tools for everyday engineering work and experimentation.

• Home office allowance: A one-time allowance to help set up a comfortable and productive workspace.

• Flexible working approach: No clock-in or clock-out policy, supporting autonomy and a focus on results.

• Birthday leave: An additional day off to celebrate your birthday.

• Career Growth Program: Clear development pathways, structured goals, and ongoing feedback to support career progression.

• International team: Collaborate with colleagues in a fast-moving environment that values high-quality engineering, ownership, and continuous improvement.

• Meaningful technical responsibility: Build on an established platform and progressively take ownership of core infrastructure tooling and its roadmap.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

postings.descriptionText:
Security Operations Analyst (AI Training)

About The Role

Your experience in the SOC is more valuable than ever — not just for defending networks, but for shaping the next generation of AI security tools. At Alignerr, we partner with leading AI research labs to build and evaluate advanced AI systems designed for real-world security operations.

We're looking for experienced Security Operations Analysts to work with realistic incident scenarios, validate AI reasoning, and ensure AI outputs reflect how analysts actually detect, triage, and respond to threats. This is a rare opportunity to influence how AI thinks about cybersecurity — from the inside.

• Organization: Alignerr

• Type: Hourly Contract

• Location: Remote

• Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

• Analyze realistic SOC incident and alert scenarios — understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do about it

• Classify severity levels, determine root causes, and recommend appropriate response actions

• Review detection logic and investigation workflows for accuracy and completeness

• Evaluate AI-generated security outputs and flag gaps between AI reasoning and real analyst judgment

• Provide structured, expert feedback that helps AI systems reason more like seasoned practitioners

• Work independently and asynchronously on task-based assignments

Who You Are

• 2+ years of hands-on experience in SOC, incident response, or security operations

• Familiar with SIEM platforms, alert triage workflows, and security investigation processes

• Able to quickly distinguish genuine threats from noise and false positives

• Comfortable communicating your reasoning clearly in writing

• Detail-oriented and self-directed — you don't need someone looking over your shoulder

Nice to Have

• Experience with threat hunting, digital forensics, or detection engineering

• Familiarity with frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK or NIST

• Background in red team / blue team exercises or purple teaming

• Prior experience in AI evaluation or data labeling

Why Join Us

• Work directly on frontier AI systems being built with top research labs

• Fully remote and flexible — work on your schedule, from anywhere

• Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration

• Your expertise shapes how AI handles real-world security challenges

• Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

postings.descriptionText:
About The Role

As a Release Train Engineer (RTE) , you will make an impact by leading Agile Release Trains (ARTs) and enabling teams to deliver business value predictably, efficiently, and at scale. You will be a valued member of the Agile Delivery organization and will work collaboratively with Product Management, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Business Stakeholders, and Agile teams to drive successful program execution.

In This Role, You Will

• Facilitate Program Increment (PI) Planning and key SAFe ceremonies, including Scrum of Scrums, PO Syncs, System Demos, and Inspect & Adapt workshops.

• Drive alignment across multiple Agile teams by managing dependencies, mitigating risks, and removing impediments that impact delivery.

• Track and communicate progress against PI objectives, delivery commitments, and program metrics to stakeholders and leadership.

• Coach Scrum Masters, Product Owners, team members, and leaders on SAFe and Lean-Agile principles to improve team performance and collaboration.

• Partner with business and technology stakeholders to ensure strategic objectives are translated into successful program outcomes.

• Promote continuous improvement, transparency, collaboration, and a culture of accountability across Agile Release Trains.

• Support release readiness activities while ensuring alignment across business and technology teams.

Work Model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position based in Buenos Aires, Argentina , requiring attendance in the office two days per week .

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

• Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina

• Work Model: Hybrid (2 days per week in the office)

• Working Hours: 8:00 AM CST to 5:00 PM CST

• Languages Required: English and Spanish Advanced

What you need to have to be considered

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• 8+ years of experience in Agile delivery, software development, program management, or related disciplines.

• 3+ years of experience working as a Release Train Engineer, Agile Coach, or Senior Scrum Master within a SAFe environment.

• SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE) certification.

• Hands-on experience with Agile delivery tools such as Jira, Jira Align, or Azure DevOps.

• Strong facilitation, stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Spanish.

• Experience managing cross-functional teams, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communications in complex delivery environments.

These will help you stand out

• Additional SAFe certifications such as SA, SPC, SSM, or POPM.

• Experience supporting multiple Agile Release Trains (ARTs) or large-scale Solution Trains.

• Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, test automation, and modern software delivery practices.

• PMP, PMI-ACP, Certified Scrum Professional, or similar Agile certifications.

• Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.

• Domain experience in areas such as Financial Services, Life Sciences, Healthcare, CRM, or Enterprise Platforms.

Why Cognizant?

Cognizant is one of the world's leading professional services companies, transforming clients’ business, operating, and technology models for the digital era. Our unique industry-based, consultative approach helps clients envision, build, and run more innovative and efficient businesses.

At Cognizant, we are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We believe that our people are our greatest asset, and we invest in their growth through continuous learning, career development, and meaningful opportunities to make an impact.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can contribute in a variety of ways. Even if you don't meet every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply and share how your experience may align with the role.

postings.title: Freelance -  Senior Data Engineer (LATAM based)
postings.descriptionText:
Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact — guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact, guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

We’re hiring a Freelance Data Engineer to build the structured core of a governed data foundation on Databricks , used by AI agents, applications, and business teams. You own everything that has to be exact: business entities reconciled across systems that use different identifiers, facts with their source and validity period, business definitions turned into certified tables, access control, and the APIs and MCP tools that serve this data with the caller’s permissions.

Conflicting definitions and identifiers are business problems as much as joins. The right person has spent years on Databricks making data correct and consistent, has enforced access control in production, and knows where platform controls stop and application-level enforcement has to start. You work autonomously with business stakeholders and ask the uncomfortable questions about definitions and permissions early.

You’ll work in a small team (solution architect, AI engineer, full-stack engineer, data quality lead, product and project managers) alongside the client’s data platform team. You follow their conventions and hand over what you build. The AI engineer owns the parts that need a model: knowledge from documents, retrieval, agent behavior, and evals. You give them the trusted data those parts depend on. AI tools speed up your modeling, SQL, testing, and documentation every day, and you know exactly when to trust the output and when not to.

Required Qualifications

• 6+ years of professional data engineering, building production-grade pipelines and data models

• 3+ years hands-on with Databricks in production, including Unity Catalog

• Expert SQL and Python: writes, debugs, optimizes, and refactors pipelines unaided. Spark/PySpark a plus

• Strong data modeling, including history-aware techniques (SCD Type 2, effective dating, temporal validity), with provenance and lineage designed in from the start

• Data quality and testing discipline: tests and expectations in pipelines (dbt tests, Great Expectations, or similar) and CI/CD for data

• Reconciling data across systems: entity resolution or master data

• Incremental and change-driven processing (CDC, streaming, or incremental frameworks) against freshness targets

• Practical data governance: has implemented access control in production (row-level security, column masking, or role/attribute-based access) and knows where platform-level controls stop and application-level enforcement has to start

• Has built APIs or services that serve data

• Senior judgment: works autonomously, challenges unclear definitions, prioritizes by risk, owns outcomes without micromanagement

• Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, or similar), with the judgment to know when to trust the output

• C1 English; comfortable working fully remote and directly with a client team

Preferrable

• Exposing data to applications through APIs or MCPs

• Multi-tenant data isolation for customer-facing products, with security and negative testing

• Finance or CRM data (NetSuite, Salesforce)

• Consolidating data across acquired companies or business units

• Ingesting and governing unstructured content (documents, wikis, contracts) alongside structured data

• Turning business definitions into a shared semantic or metrics layer with business or finance stakeholders

• FinOps / cost attribution on data platforms

Perks

💵 Monthly USD Service Fee

🌴 20 business days of paid Agreed Time Off—Annual + 6 Local Holidays

🐣Caregiver Time Off

💻A dynamic remote work culture. You can work from anywhere!

🚀An entrepreneurial environment.

About Us

In 2010, our founders dreamed up a company that could positively impact the world. Since then, we've been in permanent evolution: from business consulting to innovation and design, and now to building amazing digital products powered by AI. We scaled globally, launched AI Labs and Reshape Studios, and claimed our space as an AI consulting firm — helping organizations move from pilots to production through accountable AI. Today, we're expanding our impact across industries, driving real AI adoption through accountability, governance, and value at scale. Dreamers first, builders always.

• Extracts and harmonizes Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud objects together with Direct-to-Consumer transaction data.
