postings.title: Data Architect
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are
At MAS Global Consulting, we are a premium digital engineering partner trusted by innovative startups and Fortune 100 companies, delivering high-impact solutions through agile delivery, deep technical expertise, and a strong people-first culture across the Americas.
We build long-term partnerships, not just software. MAS means "more" in Spanish, and that mindset drives our commitment to greater opportunity, inclusion, and impact.
Founded by a Latina engineer from Medellín and headquartered in Tampa, Florida, MAS Global Consulting is a 100% Hispanic and woman-owned company, recognized as a Great Place to Work and one of the Fastest-Growing Companies in the US.
Who You Are
You are a senior Data Architect who will own the technical design of a governed data platform on Microsoft Fabric for a US-based industrial manufacturer. The client runs on more than a dozen systems with no shared keys between them. The platform has two parts: a medallion lakehouse for analytics in Power BI, and a master data hub that keeps one golden record per key entity and syncs corrected values back to the operational systems. The first domain is Workforce: one trusted employee record across Workday HCM, payroll, Epicor ERP and the physical security system.
You lead a small team, a Data Engineer and a Power BI Developer. You turn the client's data ownership into rules the platform applies, and you explain decisions in business terms to IT, business owners and leadership. The role is remote from LATAM with US time-zone overlap, client-facing through MAS Global.
What You'll Do

• Define the Fabric architecture: environments, one lakehouse with bronze, silver and gold schemas, and the master data hub in a Fabric SQL database.

• Design the enterprise data model, and classify each entity as master data or domain data.

• Design the Employee master: golden record, cross-reference of every system ID, attribute lineage and audit.

• Define the matching rules (shared ID, exact and probabilistic, plus blocking), with thresholds the business can tune in configuration tables.

• Turn system ownership into survivorship rules per attribute. For example, Workday wins job and compensation data and Epicor wins labor rates.

• Design the stewardship model and the sync back to Epicor, payroll and security, through Fabric pipelines or MuleSoft.

• Secure sensitive employee data with Entra ID and row-level security.

• Set the engineering standards: Git, deployment pipelines, tests built from known match cases, and documentation.

• Lead the build-vs-buy evaluation for MDM.

What You Bring

• 8+ years in data, including 3+ as architect or technical lead on Azure.

• Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience, or deep Synapse or Databricks on Azure plus active Fabric adoption.

• Designed a medallion architecture in production.

• MDM or entity resolution design: matching without shared keys, survivorship, stewardship.

• Data modeling for Power BI and for operational hubs.

• Integration patterns: APIs, file extracts, and write-back to source systems.

• Hands-on MuleSoft experience designing integrations.

• Governance and security for sensitive data.

• English C1, comfortable presenting to executives.

Nice to Have

• Profisee, Informatica MDM or Reltio.

• Workday, payroll or Epicor data.

• Microsoft Purview.

• Manufacturing data.

• DP-600, DP-700 or AZ-305 certification.

postings.descriptionText:
About You
You are a Senior Data Engineer passionate about building scalable, production-grade data pipelines and transforming complex data from multiple sources into reliable, business-ready datasets. You thrive when working with Azure Databricks, Python, and Spark to solve data integration challenges and support enterprise data ecosystems.

You enjoy connecting data across business platforms, optimizing data transformations, and ensuring accuracy and consistency throughout the data lifecycle. You take ownership of your work, ask the right questions early, and proactively communicate risks and blockers. You value clear documentation, technical discipline, and delivering high-quality solutions that support business needs.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

• 5+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering, designing, building, and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.

• Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks.

• Advanced Python skills for data processing, transformation, and pipeline development.

• Solid experience with Apache Spark, including PySpark and/or Spark SQL, for processing data at scale.

• Advanced SQL proficiency, including complex transformations, data validation, and query performance optimization.

• Strong knowledge of data warehousing and dimensional modeling, including facts, dimensions, and data marts.

• Experience integrating data from multiple sources, including REST APIs, relational databases, cloud storage, and SFTP.

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure data services for data ingestion, storage, processing, and integration.

• Experience implementing data quality checks and validating consistency between source systems and target data models.

• Ability to troubleshoot pipeline failures, investigate data discrepancies, and implement reliable solutions.

• Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills.

• Ability to work autonomously, take ownership, and follow established engineering practices and documentation standards.

• Strong English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with a US-based team.

Nice to have:

• Experience migrating SQL-based data workloads to Azure Databricks.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

• Design, build, and maintain reliable, production-grade data pipelines using Azure Databricks and Python.

• Develop scalable data transformations using PySpark or Spark SQL to integrate data from multiple business systems.

• Ingest and process data from APIs, relational databases, cloud storage, and SFTP sources.

• Integrate data from ticketing, CRM, marketing, retail, and other enterprise platforms into a centralized Data Hub.

• Develop and maintain data warehouse structures, dimensional models, and data marts aligned with business requirements.

• Write, optimize, and maintain SQL transformations to ensure data accuracy and processing efficiency.

• Implement data quality validations and consistency checks between source systems and target models.

• Build and maintain outbound data feeds for third-party systems according to defined specifications.

• Investigate data discrepancies, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and implement appropriate corrective actions.

• Document data pipelines, transformation logic, dependencies, and technical processes.

• Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to clarify requirements, identify risks early, and deliver reliable data solutions.

• Communicate progress, blockers, and potential delays proactively, proposing clear next steps to keep deliverables on track.

Qualifications

• Strong proficiency in Azure Databricks, Python, and Apache Spark.

• Advanced SQL skills and solid knowledge of data warehousing and dimensional modeling.

• Proven experience developing and maintaining production data pipelines.

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure data services and integrating data from multiple enterprise systems.

• Strong understanding of data quality, validation, and consistency across source and target systems.

• Strong ownership, autonomy, documentation, and communication skills.

• Ability to communicate effectively in English and collaborate with a US-based enterprise team.

Additional Information
About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

Nuestros beneficios están diseñados para cuidar tu bienestar integral mediante programas de salud física y mental, bienestar financiero y apoyo a las familias. Ofrecemos cobertura de atención médica para ti y tu familia, descuentos en seguros para proteger tu hogar, automóvil y mascotas, así como licencia parental. A través de nuestras subsidiarias y afiliadas, ofrecemos seguros, anualidades, beneficios para empleados y soluciones de gestión de activos a clientes individuales e institucionales. Nuestro propósito es simple: ayudar a nuestros colaboradores, clientes, comunidades y a la sociedad en general a construir un futuro más seguro y confiable. Guiados por nuestros valores Ganamos Juntos, Hacemos lo Correcto, Generamos Impacto por Encima de la Actividad y Pensamos en el Futuro, trabajamos para transformar el futuro de los servicios financieros.

postings.title: Technical Support Specialist - LED Lighting Controls (DMX/Pixel) - Argentina Rem
postings.descriptionText:
We're Green LED Lighting Solutions, a Canadian LED manufacturer. Our systems go into buildings, signs and entertainment venues across North America, and when an installer is on a job site with a controller that won't talk to the pixels, they call us. We need one more person on that phone.

SHIFT: North American business hours, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern (10:00 AM to 7:00 PM Buenos Aires). Fixed schedule, Monday to Friday. Remote, contract.

What You'll Do

• Take technical support calls and emails from North American electricians and installers during our support window. Diagnose live: pixel data problems, DMX addressing, voltage drop, controller setup, warranty issues

• Write the fix down so the same call doesn't come back. Knowledge base articles, checklists, short videos

• Between calls, produce wiring diagrams and fixture layouts in AutoCAD from our design lead's markups, and build the costed bill of materials that goes with them

NOT A FIT IF

• You want a drafting or estimating job with a few calls. This is a phone job with design packages in the gaps

• You get rattled by a frustrated caller

• You need a script

TO APPLY

Put the word PIXEL in the first line of your cover letter. Then attach: (1) a link to a 2-minute video of you explaining voltage drop on a 12V LED run to an electrician who's never heard the term, (2) one wiring diagram or schematic you drew yourself. Applications without both won't be reviewed.

Requirements

• 2+ years in technical support, field service or commissioning for LED lighting, lighting controls, AV or similar low-voltage electronics

• Working knowledge of DMX512 addressing and topology, SPI pixel basics, and low-voltage DC power (voltage drop, power injection, PSU sizing). We'll test this

• AutoCAD, well enough to turn a markup into a clean electrical schematic

• Spoken English you can run a troubleshooting call with. Our callers are electricians on job sites, on bad connections, behind schedule. You'll do a live phone screen

• Daily use of AI tools in your work. Show us how, don't tell us

• Full availability for the fixed shift (10:00 AM to 7:00 PM Buenos Aires, Monday to Friday)

Nice to have: hands-on time with Advatek, Falcon, PixLite, ENTTEC, Pharos or Madrix; experience with RMA or warranty processes; Elfsquad, Business Central or a similar CPQ/ERP.

postings.title: Dynamics 365 Business Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
About The Role

As a Dynamics 365 Business Analyst , you will make an impact by translating business requirements into scalable customer service solutions within Microsoft Dynamics 365. You will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, helping organizations optimize customer service operations, improve agent productivity, and enhance customer experiences.

You will be a valued member of the Dynamics 365 delivery team and work collaboratively with business stakeholders, product owners, solution architects, developers, quality assurance teams, and project managers throughout the entire project lifecycle.

In This Role, You Will

• Lead requirements gathering workshops and discovery sessions to understand business needs and define scalable Dynamics 365 Customer Service solutions.

• Analyze business processes, perform fit-gap assessments, and create functional designs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.

• Configure and support Dynamics 365 Customer Service capabilities, including case management, routing, queues, SLAs, entitlements, knowledge management, and agent productivity tools.

• Collaborate with technical teams on integrations, data migration, reporting, security design, testing, deployment, and release readiness activities.

• Drive user acceptance testing (UAT), support stakeholder adoption, develop training materials, and provide post-go-live support to ensure successful business outcomes.

Work model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants across Nearshore locations . Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina

Work Model: Hybrid (2 days per week in office)

Languages: English and Spanish (Advance)

Schedule: 8:00 AM CST – 5:00 PM CST

What you need to have to be considered

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, including 3+ years working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CRM).

• Experience delivering at least two end-to-end Dynamics 365 Customer Service implementations.

• Strong knowledge of customer service processes, including case management, queues, routing, SLAs, entitlements, and knowledge management.

• Hands-on experience configuring Dynamics 365, including forms, views, business rules, Power Automate workflows, and security roles.

• Experience working within Agile delivery environments and using Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar backlog management tools.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.

These will help you stand out

• Experience implementing Omnichannel for Customer Service, including chat, voice, SMS, social messaging, unified routing, and chatbot-to-agent handoff.

• Microsoft certifications such as PL-200, MB-230, PL-900, or equivalent Dynamics 365 and Power Platform certifications.

• Experience with Dynamics 365 Contact Center, Copilot for Customer Service, or Customer Insights.

• Familiarity with Power Platform solutions, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Dataverse.

• Experience integrating Dynamics 365 with telephony, contact center, ERP, and third-party enterprise applications.

• Knowledge of CRM data migration, APIs, Azure integration patterns, and enterprise solution architecture.

• Experience working in enterprise-scale environments, regulated industries, or global delivery models.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role

postings.title: Technical Project Manager (Software)
postings.descriptionText:
We're hiring a Technical Project Manager to run software projects for US-based clients at Bolder Apps. This role is for people who have managed web and mobile builds at a software agency, consultancy, or dev studio, usually several clients at once. You'll own delivery from kickoff to launch: scoping and estimates with engineers, sprints and timelines, keeping scope under control, and keeping clients informed. Our engineering teams use AI tools every day, so we move fast and we need a PM who keeps that speed predictable for the client. This is a full-time, fully remote role open to candidates in Argentina, Colombia, Mexico, Uzbekistan and Georgia, with daily overlap into US Eastern time. If you've kept multiple client projects on track at the same time and you're more at home in delivery than in product strategy, we want to talk.

About Us

Bolder Apps is a product development studio that partners with US-based startups and established companies to build and scale innovative digital products. We specialize in AI-powered development, full-cycle product creation, and engineering team augmentation. Our mission is simple: build bolder, faster, and smarter.

Our Culture & Values (read before applying)

We move fast. We take ownership. We work with AI, not against it. And we expect everyone to bring ideas, not wait for instructions.

There are no daily checklists, no micromanagement, and no corporate politics. Instead, you'll have autonomy, trust, and a team that's always ready to help you grow. At Bolder Apps, impact matters more than titles, and curiosity matters more than seniority.

If you want a place where you can level up fast and actually see your work making a difference - welcome aboard.

Responsibilities

• Own delivery for several client software projects at the same time, each with its own scope, stakeholders, budget, and timeline

• Scope new work and build estimates together with engineers, then turn them into realistic plans, milestones, and sprints

• Run the sprint cycle: planning, backlog grooming, standups, demos, and retros, and keep timelines on track

• Spot risk early and control scope creep. Push back on unrealistic asks and handle change requests with a clear impact on time and cost

• Keep clients informed with clear written updates and live status calls and demos during US business hours

• Coordinate developers, designers, and QA so work flows without blockers and nothing ships without a real check

• Keep Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or the client's tool of choice accurate, so anyone can see status without a meeting

• Plan and run launches and releases for web and mobile apps, including staging, App Store and Google Play submissions, and post-launch fixes

Requirements

• 3+ years managing web and mobile app projects as a project manager, technical project manager, delivery manager, or similar

• Mobile app delivery. You've taken client iOS and/or Android apps from kickoff through App Store and Google Play review and release. This is weighted heavily; strong web-focused delivery experience is still considered

• Agency, consultancy, or dev studio experience. You've delivered software for external clients and managed multiple client projects at the same time

• Technical fluency. You don't need to write code, but you can talk with engineers about web and mobile architecture, APIs, releases, and bugs, and you know what they mean for the timeline

• Proven ability to run several projects at once without losing quality or deadlines on any of them

• English at C1 or above. You'll run client calls and write updates that clients read directly

• Available to overlap with US Eastern time through about 5 PM EST for live client coordination

• Strong written client communication. Clear status updates, change requests, and bad news delivered early, with a plan

• AI-augmented workflow. You use AI tools daily in your own work and understand how AI-assisted development changes estimation and QA

Nice to have

• Agile or Scrum certification (PSM, CSM, PMP, or similar)

• Experience with budgets, hourly or fixed-price client contracts, and change orders

• Experience working with US-based startups or founders

• A technical background (former developer, QA, or business analyst)

Benefits

What we offer:

• Full-time, fully remote role, with overlap into US Eastern time for client coordination

• Opportunity to deliver exciting products for the US market

• Steady pipeline of client work as part of a growing team

• Real autonomy over how you run your projects. We don't hand you a rigid PM playbook

• Direct line to decision-makers, no extra layers between you and the people who own the outcome

• A peer network of other operators working on overlapping projects

Position available for candidates based in La Plata, Bahía Blanca, CABA, Córdoba, Rosario, or Mendoza.

As an IT Risk Analyst, you'll play a key role in protecting Avature's information assets by helping identify, assess, and manage information security and compliance risks across the organization. Working closely with technical and business stakeholders, you'll contribute to the continuous improvement of our security, risk, and compliance programs while supporting customers, vendors, and internal teams on information security matters.

Your challenges and objectives:

• Contribute to the ongoing maturity of Avature’s risk management and compliance programs.

• Identify, assess, and communicate information security risks affecting the organization.

• Support the implementation and monitoring of risk treatment and mitigation activities.

• Support informed business decision-making by providing timely and accurate risk assessments and security guidance.

• Become a trusted advisor on information security, risk, and compliance topics for both internal and external stakeholders.

• Promote the consistent application of security, risk, and compliance practices across the organization.

• Stay informed on emerging threats, industry best practices, and evolving regulatory requirements.

Your day-to-day activities:

• Respond to compliance, risk and information security queries from customers, prospects, and internal teams.

• Perform information security risk assessments and document identified risks and recommendations.

• Monitor emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and regulatory updates that may impact the organization.

• Conduct vendor security assessments and identify risks related to third-party partnerships.

• Support cross-functional projects requiring information security or risk management expertise.

About you:

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

• Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work both independently and collaboratively.

• Solid understanding of information systems and information security principles.

• Bachelor's degree in Information Systems or similar is a plus

• Familiarity with information security and compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, SOC 2, or similar) is a plus

• Professional information security certifications are a plus.

• Comfortable using AI tools to enhance day-to-day work and interested in staying up to date with emerging AI capabilities.

About us:
Avature is a market-leading enterprise SaaS provider for global talent acquisition and talent management. We have a strong commitment to high-quality engineering and customer service and are recognized innovators in the large enterprise market. Leading organizations around the world rely on Avature, including Fortune 500 companies, global consulting firms, some of the world's largest banks and manufacturers, and government organizations.

We design, build, implement, and support our product ourselves. With a strong culture of ownership and innovation, we continuously evolve our platform to help organizations meet the changing demands of talent acquisition and talent management. As technology continues to reshape the world of work, we leverage AI and emerging technologies to help organizations innovate, adapt, and gain competitive advantage.

At Avature, we value opportunities to learn and grow within a dynamic, creative, and collaborative environment. We encourage autonomy and empower our people to approach challenges innovatively while bringing their unique perspective to the table. We believe curiosity, continuous learning, and openness to emerging technologies are essential to building the future. Through our career development programs, mentorship, and leadership opportunities, we support each person's professional growth while making a meaningful impact on our product and our customers' success.

What we offer:

• A fast-paced, energetic, and engaging environment.

• We combine flexible remote work with in-person collaboration, encouraging team members to spend one day a week at their nearest office. We have workplaces in Buenos Aires (Palermo, La Plata and Bahía Blanca), Rosario, Mendoza and Córdoba.

• Flexible hours.

• Periodic salary reviews.

• Three weeks vacations from the first year.

• Four weeks paternity leave.

• OSDE 360 health coverage (family plan).

• Four days a year to attend events related to professional development.

• Paid internet service expenses.

An organizational culture that empowers everyone to be themselves is key to thrive in business, but more importantly, it is a pathway for creating a more equitable society. Avature fosters a diverse and inclusive environment and celebrates that each unique person brings something different to our team. We are committed to considering all qualified applicants equally and to promoting equal opportunities within our organization.

postings.title: SAP SD Solution Architect
postings.descriptionText:
Chevron Global Business Services (GBS), located in Buenos Aires (Puerto Madero), Argentina, is accepting applications for the position of SAP SD Solution Architect . Successful candidates will join the ERP Digital Core Team , which is part of a multifunction service and technical center with a workforce of more than 1800 employees that deliver business services and solutions to the corporation across the globe.

Overview

The SAP SD Solution Architect is responsible for providing end-to-end solution leadership for SAP Sales & Distribution and Order-to-Cash processes. This role combines deep SAP SD functional and technical expertise with strong architecture capabilities to design scalable solutions, guide complex business and technical discussions, and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards and long-term business objectives. The position plays a key role supporting current SAP landscapes while defining future-state architectures and roadmaps across a complex SAP ecosystem.

Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to:

• Design and deliver end-to-end SAP SD and Order-to-Cash solutions aligned with business and enterprise architecture objectives.

• Lead architecture discussions with business stakeholders, technical teams, and cross-functional partners to define scalable and sustainable solutions.

• Define solution architectures, integration strategies, technical designs, and implementation roadmaps for SAP Sales processes.

• Provide deep expertise across SAP SD processes including Order Management, Pricing, Billing, Shipping, Returns, and Credit Management.

• Collaborate with teams supporting MM, EWM, TM, FI/CO, PP, and other SAP modules to ensure end-to-end process integration.

• Guide technical teams, review solution designs, and ensure adherence to architecture standards and governance practices.

• Evaluate business requirements, identify risks and dependencies, and drive resolution of complex business and technical issues.

• Support SAP S/4HANA transformation initiatives, migrations, and continuous improvement efforts.

• Partner with development teams to review custom solutions, integrations, interfaces, and technical approaches.

• Contribute to enterprise architecture standards, governance models, and strategic technology roadmaps.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or related discipline.

• 12+ years of SAP experience with at least 8+ years focused on SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) and Order-to-Cash processes.

• Proven experience as a Solution Architect delivering SAP SD solutions in large-scale and complex enterprise environments.

• Strong SAP S/4HANA Sales experience, including implementation, migration, or transformation programs.

• Deep expertise in SAP SD configuration and business processes including Order Management, Pricing, Billing, Shipping, Returns, and Credit Management.

• Strong understanding of integrations across SAP modules including MM, EWM, TM, FI/CO, and PP.

• Experience defining solution architectures, technical designs, and enterprise integration strategies.

• Strong knowledge of SAP integration technologies including IDocs, APIs, middleware platforms, and SAP/non-SAP integrations.

• Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and cross-functional teams.

• Advanced English communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• SAP Architecture, SAP S/4HANA, or related SAP certifications.

• Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and SAP Integration Suite.

• Knowledge of Logistics Execution, Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), Transportation Management (TM), or Global Trade Services (GTS).

• Experience with API-led integration approaches and event-driven architectures.

• Experience defining enterprise architecture standards, governance models, and long-term technology roadmaps.

• Experience supporting cloud-based SAP environments and hybrid integration architectures.

Relocation Options:

Relocation may be considered.

International Considerations

Expatriate assignments will not be considered.

Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.

postings.title: Compliance Operations & Technology Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena is committed to a people-first approach. Our teams enjoy a culture focused on prioritizing a flexible work environment that empowers individual growth, well-being, and belonging. We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity—driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.

At Ciena, we believe strong compliance goes beyond policies and processes. It’s about having the right systems, trusted data, and timely risk insights to help the business make confident decisions. As compliance continues to evolve, technology, analytics, and automation are increasingly central to how effective programs operate at scale. Reporting to Ciena’s Head of Corporate Compliance & Ethics, you’ll bring these worlds together, combining compliance expertise with technology and risk intelligence to strengthen controls, sharpen decision-making, and build smarter, more scalable compliance operations across the business.

How You Will Make An Impact

• Partner across the business to operationalize, automate, and refine compliance controls and workflows.

• Translate policy and regulatory requirements into sustainable, measurable operational processes.

• Develop standardized processes, documentation, and workflows supporting compliance operations.

• Identify and implement opportunities to improve workflow efficiency.

• Analyze data and report findings for internal audits, investigations, risk assessments, and regulatory inquiries.

• Administer compliance operational systems and technology platforms.

• Partner internally and with vendors to design, test, validate, and deploy system changes, integrations, upgrades, and improvements.

The Must Haves

• Education: Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Finance, Ethics, Technology, Data, or other related area of study.

• Experience: 3+ years of professional experience in Compliance, Ethics, Risk Management, Internal Controls, Legal Operations, or related disciplines.

• Experience supporting compliance programs within a multinational public company.

• Demonstrated experience administering and optimizing compliance technology platforms and operational workflows.

• Experience developing dashboards, KPIs, metrics, and executive reporting.

• Ability to transform complex data into actionable business insights.

• Experience managing cross-functional projects and technology implementations.

Nice To Haves

• Certifications: Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP), Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), or equivalent combination of certification and experience.

• Experience with compliance-related platforms for third-party due diligence and risk management solutions; gifts and entertainment management tools; conflict of interest disclosure systems; investigation and case management platforms; policy management and attestation systems; and privacy regulatory compliance.

• Experience with business operations systems including Corporate ERP, sales opportunity management, supplier lifecycle management, and expense reporting platforms.

• Experience applying AI responsibly to address compliance challenges and support efficiency and effectiveness.

• Experience with business intelligence and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

• Knowledge of anti-corruption, anti-bribery (including the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act and U.K. Bribery Act), third-party risk, insider trading, investigations, conflicts of interest, privacy, Gifts and Entertainment management, and compliance program governance leading practices.

At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.

postings.title: Finance Analyst (Account Payable)
postings.descriptionText:
Get On Board for a Dynamic and Purposeful Career

DRIVING CONNECTIVITY

Chart your Course with PIL

With over 55 years of leadership in the global shipping industry, Pacific International Lines (PIL) is looking for proactive individuals to drive innovation and sustainable shipping solutions. If you’re fuelled by pioneering ideas, enjoy challenging the status quo, and are determined to make a significant impact, PIL wants you as a part of our dynamic community of maritime professionals. At PIL, we provide local experiences with a global reach. With our headquarters in Singapore, and services offered at over 500 locations in 90 countries, you will have ample opportunities to work with colleagues from different cultures and communities.

Get On Board for a Dynamic and Purposeful Career

We are seeking a detail-oriented and process driven Finance Analyst – (AP) to join our dynamic team at PIL in Argentina, Buenos Aires to support the Oracle GFS rollout at the country level, with a primary focus on Accounts Payable (AP), Cost Controlling, Intercompany/ASA flow reconciliation, Rate/Tariff updates, and control of AP open transactions. The role requires strong alignment with statutory accounting principles and local tax compliance, contributing directly to both implementation and post-Go Live operational finance tasks. This is an operational finance role requiring strong organization, persistence, and attention to detail, but no mandatory English proficiency spoken.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist in the configuration and functional testing of Oracle modules: AP, GL

• Validate localization settings for taxes, invoices, vendors, and cost centers

• Coordinate with Outsourcing or Offshore support teams to resolve AP issues

• Support monthly closing processes, AP reconciliations, and vendor aging reports

• Monitor cost allocation complianceDocument workflows, SOPs, and testing traceability for audit readiness

• Engage in PB1 and UAT cycles with accountability for defect resolution

Key Accountabilities – Post Go-Live (Finance Operations)

• Post-Go-Live Stabilization: Participate in hypercare activities to ensure functional and compliance success.

• Provide training and ongoing support to end-users during and after the implementation

• Execute operational finance tasks across AP and Reporting using Oracle GFS as main tool

• Perform accurate month-end closings, reconciliations, and AP Subledger processing

• Ensure tax declarations and compliance with local reporting obligations

• Maintain process documentation, support audits, and drive operational excellence

• Collaborate with LARO and HQ Finance teams for performance reporting and improvements

Skills & Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, AP, cost control, accounting or related disciplines.

• 3+ years of experience in finance operations and ERP Oracle or SAP environments.

• Familiarity with AP, GL and Tax modules.

• Previous experience in accounting, tax, controlling, and external audit in shipping and logistics.

• Bilingual: Spanish native / English Advanced.

• Advanced Excel (financial analysis, reconciliations, data validation).

• High ethical standards, accuracy, and ability to work under pressure.

• Proactive, process-driven, and detail-oriented with good communication skills.

WHY JOIN US

• Be part of a leading global carrier with a strong focus on sustainability and innovation.

• Work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

• Opportunities for professional growth and development.

APPLICATION PROCESS

To apply for this exciting opportunity, please submit your resume in English outlining your qualifications and experience to PIL Career Website.

Eligibility To Apply

This position is open to Argentinian nationals or individuals who currently have the legal right to work in Argentina. Please note that applicants without this eligibility will not be considered.

About Us

Incorporated in 1967, Pacific International Lines (PIL) is ranked 12th among the world’s top container shipping lines and is also the largest home-grown carrier in Southeast Asia. Based in Singapore, PIL is a global carrier with a focus on Asia, China, Africa, the Middle East, Latin America, Oceania, and the Pacific Islands.

Together with its affiliated companies Mariana Express Lines (MELL) and Malaysia Shipping Corporation, PIL serves customers at over 500 locations in more than 90 countries worldwide with a fleet of 100 container and multi-purpose vessels.

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Analista de Gestión e Indicadores de Seguridad Personal para nuestro equipo de Seguridad Personal de la Refinería.

El objetivo principal del rol será:

• Brindar soporte analítico y de gestión al equipo de Seguridad Personal mediante la consolidación, análisis y visualización de información; la administración de indicadores y registros; y el seguimiento de acciones, capacitaciones y competencias críticas. La posición contribuirá a transformar datos en información útil para la toma de decisiones, asegurando integridad, trazabilidad y disponibilidad de la información, y promoviendo la mejora continua del desempeño en seguridad..

Responsabilidades:

• Gestionar y analizar indicadores de desempeño de Seguridad Personal a través del desarrollo de tableros de gestión para identificar tendencias, desvíos, recurrencias y oportunidades de mejora.

• Asegurar la integridad, consistencia, disponibilidad y trazabilidad de los registros. Mantener disponible la evidencia necesaria para auditorías y revisiones de gestión.

• Seguimiento de acciones: Administrar las acciones derivadas de investigaciones, auditorías, inspecciones y observaciones. Monitorear responsables, fechas comprometidas, vencimientos y estado de avance. Emitir alertas oportunas sobre desvíos y compromisos vencidos. Elaborar reportes periódicos sobre el avance y la efectividad de los planes.

• Capacitaciones: Mantener actualizada la matriz de capacitación de Seguridad Personal. Coordinar la planificación y logística administrativa de actividades formativas de Seguridad. Monitorear habilitaciones, certificaciones y competencias críticas próximas a vencer.

• Mejoras y digitalización: Identificar oportunidades de simplificación, automatización y digitalización. Participar en el desarrollo de tableros, flujos de trabajo y soluciones de seguimiento. Brindar soporte durante auditorías internas, externas y evaluaciones corporativas.

postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

Wood está buscando un Ing. de Instrumentación Sr. capaz de liderar proyectos técnicamente para unirse a su unidad de negocio de Procesos y Químicos. Esta oportunidad es presencial en Capital Federal, Argentina.

El Rol

Wood está en búsqueda de un/a Ing. de Instrumentación Sr. Lider técnico , con más de 8 años de experiencia. La posición se situará en Capital Federal, Argentina. Apuntamos a un profesional universitario con buen nivel inglés conversacional, y con una sólida experiencia evaluando la viabilidad y solidez de los diseños de ingeniería, productos y equipos propuestos.

Nuestros clientes y proyectos Diseñando el futuro. Transformando el mundo.

El negocio de Procesos y Químicos de Wood es un jugador líder en sectores clave del mercado, incluyendo refinación tradicional, petroquímicos, productos químicos especializados, materiales avanzados, producción de hidrógeno y CCUS. Ofrecemos una gama completa de servicios de ingeniería y gestión de proyectos y somos integradores líderes en el mercado de instalaciones de refinería y petroquímicos, impulsando la innovación en combustibles sostenibles y materiales avanzados para la transición energética.

Lo que podemos ofrecer

• Proyectos significativos e interesantes entregados a líderes de la industria en el sector de Procesos y Químicos.

• Arreglos de trabajo flexibles que equilibran las necesidades del cliente, del equipo y del individuo.

• Compromiso con la diversidad e inclusión en toda nuestra empresa, con redes de empleados comprometidas a dar voz a todos los empleados.

• Paquete de beneficios flexibles que se puede adaptar a tu estilo de vida.

• Compromiso con el desarrollo profesional continuo a través de planes de desarrollo personalizados.

• Conexiones globales con expertos líderes de la industria.

Responsibilities

• Desarrollar documentos de ingeniería de detalle de la disciplina: bases y criterios de diseño, especificaciones de instrumentos y válvulas, memorias de cálculo (Sizing de válvulas de control y de alivio/PSV), hojas de datos de instrumentos, listado de instrumentos y listado de señales.

• Definir diagramas de lazos, planos de arquitectura de sistemas de control, localización de instrumentos, ruteo de última milla y diagramas de conexionado.

• Administrar la información de instrumentación en base de datos especializada Smart Plant Instrumentation (SPI / Intools) — catálogos, datasheets, loop & index, wiring e integración con P&ID — y generar desde ella los entregables de la disciplina.

• Coordinar la disciplina I&C, revisar y verificar el trabajo de los perfiles semi-senior y proyectista, y liderar la interfaz técnica con Procesos y demás especialidades.

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de códigos y normas internacionales (API, ANSI, ASME, NFPA, ISA, IEC) y de las especificaciones/estándares del cliente.

• Disponibilidad para visitas de campo de levantamiento y adquisición de información cuando el proyecto lo requiera.

Qualifications

¿Qué te hace extraordinario?

En Wood, estamos comprometidos con la igualdad de oportunidades y damos la bienvenida a todos los individuos talentosos para considerar unirse a nuestro equipo. Así que, incluso si no cumples con cada declaración a continuación pero sientes que tienes algo de la experiencia, conocimiento o habilidades necesarias para este rol, te animamos a aplicar. Nos tomará a todos trabajando juntos para ofrecer soluciones a los desafíos más críticos del mundo.

Esperado

• Título universitario en Ing. Instrumentación/Eléctrico o una disciplina relevante.

• Matrícula habilitante vigente.

• AutoCAD; CADWorx ; Navisworks (mand.); AVEVA E&I (pref.); Conval / Fisher VCALC / InstruCalc (mand.)

Conocimientos, Habilidades y Experiencia

• Competente técnicamente en su propia disciplina, busca el desarrollo profesional continuo de habilidades y conocimientos conforme a los estándares.

• Capacidad para supervisar, gestionar, motivar y asesorar a profesionales técnicos.

• Conocimiento multidisciplinario, así como de principios y técnicas avanzadas de ingeniería, además de estándares y prácticas de gestión de calidad requeridos.

• Reconocido como un experto técnico con capacidad para desarrollar y guiar al personal más joven.

• Capacidad para ejecutar y supervisar el alcance, presupuesto y cronograma de proyectos.

• Demuestra constantemente creatividad e innovación al encontrar soluciones y alternativas para abordar requerimientos complejos del cliente.

• Habilidades efectivas de comunicación e interpersonales para llevar a cabo interacciones interdepartamentales y externas de la empresa.

• Capacidad para diagnosticar y resolver problemas significativos e inusuales, y generar mejoras sustanciales en prácticas y procedimientos.

• Ágil, con capacidad para adaptarse y resolver problemas.

• Capacidad para interpretar ampliamente principios, teorías y conceptos de una especialidad de ingeniería.

• Posee un buen conocimiento de las distintas Unidades de Negocio, Funciones, Sectores y servicios ofrecidos dentro del área de negocios, una comprensión general de otras ofertas comerciales de Wood y cierta capacidad para establecer redes y conectar a los interesados internos.

• Posee un conocimiento profundo de la posición comercial de Wood y de sus objetivos comerciales, y es capaz de implementar mejoras recomendadas para dichos objetivos. Comprende y puede gestionar riesgos técnicos y comerciales

Aptitudes Personales

• Resolutivo y creativo, capaz de aplicar procesos y ser riguroso para ofrecer soluciones de calidad.

• Persuasivo, tanto de forma verbal como escrita.

• Buenas habilidades interpersonales y de trabajo en equipo; construye relaciones positivas con supervisores, subordinados, colegas y clientes.

• Entusiasta, consciente y comprometido con el desarrollo profesional continuo propio y de los demás.

• Alto nivel de conciencia y compromiso con la seguridad en todos los aspectos del trabajo diario.

• Fuertes habilidades organizativas y atención al detalle.

• Altamente motivado y demuestra iniciativa personal.

• Posee integridad, una sólida ética de trabajo, actitud positiva y es confiable.

• Adaptable y flexible ante las necesidades cambiantes de los proyectos.

About Us

Wood is a global leader in consulting, engineering and operations for the energy and materials sectors. With 33,000 people in around 50 countries, Wood supports clients across the full asset lifecycle, delivering safe, predictable outcomes while enabling resilient operations and a lower carbon future. Wood forms the Energy & Materials pillar of Sidara - a global partnership uniting leading multidisciplinary engineering, design, and project management companies. www.woodgroup.com

Diversity Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer that recognises the value of a diverse workforce. All suitably qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment on the basis of objective criteria and without regard to the following (which is a non-exhaustive list): race, colour, age, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or other characteristics in accordance with the relevant governing laws.

postings.title: BIM Team Leader MEP
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are

ENG (engbim.com) is a BIM company that specializes in hands-on, field-focused BIM services. Founded in 2007, we have positioned ourselves as the largest and most experienced BIM production service provider in the United States, having completed 5,000 BIM projects with a dedicated team of over 600 staff members. We provide MEP Modeling, VDC/BIM Management, Laser Scanning, and Scan to BIM services, as well as a comprehensive array of BIM production services to architects, engineers, and owners.

The Role

We are looking for a Job Captain to lead multidisciplinary modeling teams across complex architectural and engineering projects. This role requires a strong command of BIM software, leadership skills, and a strategic mindset to drive quality and coordination across project stages.

As a Job Captain, you will be responsible for supervising and mentoring modelers, ensuring adherence to best practices, project standards, and timelines. You will proactively identify missing or conflicting information, manage RFIs and RFCs efficiently, and conduct in-depth Quality Control reviews across assigned disciplines. Your role goes beyond execution—you will influence modeling strategies and ensure seamless collaboration within the team and with external stakeholders.

The ideal candidate combines advanced modeling capabilities with solid experience overseeing documentation workflows, driving cross-disciplinary coordination, and proactively addressing complex technical challenges. This role calls for a strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to lead with confidence and clarity.

Minimum mandatory requirements include:

• An excellent level of English is an absolute must, both spoken and written . Aspiring candidates must be able to keep up with fluent conversations both with native and non-native speakers. Candidates without this requirement will NOT be considered .

• Solid experience modeling HVAC and plumbing in Revit for commercial, industrial, healthcare, and residential construction . This can include things like process piping , ductwork, sheet metal , mechanical equipment ( pumps , AHUs , RTUs , chillers, and boilers ), for plumbing, domestic water , sanitary drainage, gray water , stormwater , medical gases , compressed air lines , pumps , heaters, and hangers .

• Experience coordinating or clash-detecting through Navisworks (Revizto can also be considered, but Navisworks will be prioritized), knowledge of BIM coordination, clash report , QAQC, and model accuracy .

• A mechanical or civil engineering bachelor's degree (architects could be considered, but only if they have extensive experience modeling and coordinating MEP trades themselves).

• +5 years of experience using Revit and Navisworks for large-scale MEP projects.

• Skilled in QAQC , with the ability to anticipate issues by leveraging team members’ strengths and weaknesses.

• Strong understanding of the project's end-to-end scope, kick-off and set up, requirements, applicable standards, and all related technical documentation.

• Experience managing project budgets, with a strong focus on cost control and alignment with project objectives.

• Experience managing teams of modelers and dealing directly with clients .

• Excellent communication skills .

Nice to have: Familiarity with U.S.-based construction projects.

Please know that if you don't have experience working with Revit in formal jobs, it will be hard to consider your profile. Please DON'T apply if you don't have the necessary English level.

Company Culture and Values
🤝 Candor: We value honesty, openness, and sincerity in all interactions.
🎯 Accountability: We take ownership and are committed to delivering high-quality work on time.
🌟 Win-Win Mentality: We strive for mutual success in all business relationships.

Growth Opportunities
As part of our commitment to your career progression, we offer:
🚀 Career Development Programs.
🔄 Internal Mobility.
📈 Performance-Based Promotions.
👥 Leadership Opportunities.
🌍 Project Diversity.

Why join us? Explore our amazing benefits! ✨
🌍 Work from Anywhere: Flexibility to work remotely or from a coworking space.
🌴 No-Policy for PTO: Recharge with flexible paid time off when you need it.
🎉 Wellness & Culture: Freedom and responsibility culture, healthy snack allowances, fun challenges, and team celebrations.
🎓 Continuous Learning: Programs to develop your technical and soft skills.
💻 Work Equipment to Keep You Productive: We provide everything you need to create the perfect workspace.
🎧 Tech & Office Allowances: Upgrade your workspace with our one-time allowances. With "Pimp up your Devices" and “Home Office set up allowance,” you can upgrade gadgets for a better experience.
📶 Monthly Internet Allowance: Stay connected with a monthly allowance for internet and expenses.
💵 Highly Competitive Compensation Package: Includes both fixed and variable payments, all processed in our local currency, USD.

Location:
🌍 All positions at ENG are fully remote.

Contact Information
📧 Apply through the link. Before you apply, make sure your CV is in English; otherwise, your application can’t be considered.

Join us and grow in a flexible, innovative environment! 🚀

postings.descriptionText:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

Disclaimer: This is a Talent Pool posting and not an active vacancy. Applications submitted through this posting will be reviewed and considered for future opportunities that align with your skills and experience. If a relevant position becomes available, our Talent Acquisition team will contact you directly.

Monks is looking for a seasoned and experienced 3D Technical Director/Pipeline Engineer who can solve technical issues, and develop pipelines and workflows for the 3D Animation team in Buenos Aires and beyond. In this role, you will work on demanding CGI projects for premium customers with the highest demands on quality and aesthetics.

Our ideal candidate can communicate with the art and production team on the needed technical components and pipeline improvements. Has people management skills and is focused on finding technical solutions. You will be involved in all aspects of the pipeline: from scoping alongside with the producers, through setting up a team until the delivery.

Key Responsibilities

• You’re able to understand the brief and find technical solutions to make the artistic goals of the project work within time and budget. You will be responsible for helping define the right team and maintaining and updating CG pipelines based on the project need. This can vary from ad hoc short projects to long term setups.

• You’ll work closely with the Director, 3D lead and all the artists involved in a project. Hands-on involvement in 3D production on projects is a must.

postings.title: SSr. Automation and Control Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Sobre Meitner Energy
La misión de Meitner Energy es transformar el panorama energético global mediante soluciones nucleares limpias, sostenibles y escalables. Estamos comprometidos con redefinir cómo el mundo alimenta a la industria y al comercio para liderar la transición hacia un futuro más limpio.
En el centro de nuestro trabajo está el ACR300: un reactor modular pequeño (SMR) Gen III+ de 300 MWe diseñado para tener impacto a escala de red desde el primer día. Construido sobre tecnología probada de agua liviana con innovación dirigida y orientada a la ejecución, el ACR300 ofrece desempeño de carga base de alta utilización, independiente de las condiciones climáticas o las limitaciones de almacenamiento. Es el único SMR diseñado para ser a la vez escalable y rentable, con la menor carga de construcción física por megavatio entre los SMR de escala de red.
Nuestro equipo de clase mundial está basado en Argentina, los Estados Unidos y el Reino Unido, trabajando juntos hacia una sola meta: electrificación a escala, comenzando en 2030.

La Oportunidad
Como SSr. Automation and Control Engineer, vas a desarrollar y verificar la ingeniería de los sistemas de Instrumentación y Control (I&C) del proyecto ACR300, asegurando la calidad técnica y el cumplimiento de los requisitos normativos internacionales y de la autoridad regulatoria nuclear nacional.
Este rol es clave para Meitner en este momento porque los sistemas de I&C son los que traducen el diseño en operación real de la planta. Tu trabajo hoy define qué arquitectura de control llega al sitio, cómo se integra con las demás disciplinas y cómo se sostiene frente al regulador.
Este rol es ideal para alguien que:

• Cree que la energía nuclear es esencial para un futuro energético limpio y se toma la seguridad nuclear como parte central del trabajo.

• Disfruta del diseño de arquitecturas de control, la lógica de protección y la verificación de requisitos técnicos.

• Tiene capacidad analítica, atención al detalle y autonomía creciente en la resolución de problemas técnicos.

• Quiere crecer en una empresa donde sus definiciones técnicas efectivamente moldean la ingeniería de I&C del reactor y mentorear a colegas más juniors.

Lo que harás
Diseño y Documentación de Sistemas I&C

• Desarrollar y revisar los documentos de diseño de los sistemas de I&C (especificaciones funcionales, arquitectura de sistemas, lógica de protección, diagramas de lazo).

• Definir y gestionar los requisitos de los sistemas I&C según la normativa aplicable, asegurando su trazabilidad desde las bases de diseño hasta la verificación.

• Participar en las revisiones de diseño y en las actividades de V&V de los sistemas bajo su responsabilidad.

Coordinación Interdisciplinaria e Integración

• Colaborar con el equipo de HFE y HSI en la definición de las señales, alarmas, indicadores, etc.

• Coordinar con el resto de las disciplinas (Nuclear, Process, Mechanical, Electrical, Nuclear Safety y Cybersecurity) para la integración de los sistemas I&C en el diseño global de la planta, dando soporte a otros sectores de ingeniería cuando se requiera.

• Interactuar con proveedores de plataformas de control digital (DCS/PLC nuclear) para la evaluación técnica de soluciones y cumplimiento de requisitos.

Licenciamiento y Mentoría

• Colaborar en la preparación de la documentación técnica ante la autoridad regulatoria nuclear en el marco del proceso de licenciamiento.

• Orientar técnicamente a los ingenieros Junior de la División, contribuyendo en la capacitación interna del equipo.

Seguimiento del Proyecto y Mejora Continua

• Reportar el avance de sus entregables al Senior y/o Jefe de División, alertando desvíos respecto al cronograma.

• Proponer mejoras en procesos de diseño y verificación a partir de su experiencia en las tareas asignadas.

Lo que buscamos
Aspectos innegociables
Orientación a la Seguridad Nuclear y Rigurosidad Técnica

• Orientación a la seguridad nuclear y cultura de seguridad.

• Capacidad analítica y atención al detalle aplicados al diseño y verificación de sistemas de I&C.

Autonomía, Comunicación y Trabajo en Equipo

• Proactividad y autonomía creciente en la resolución de problemas técnicos.

• Comunicación efectiva oral y escrita, en particular en la elaboración de documentos técnicos.

• Trabajo en equipo multidisciplinario y disposición para recibir y dar retroalimentación técnica.

Organización y Adaptabilidad

• Organización y cumplimiento de plazos en proyectos con hitos regulatorios.

• Adaptabilidad ante requisitos cambiantes en proyectos de largo plazo.

Requisitos

• Graduado/a universitario en Ingeniería Electrónica, Electromecánica, en Automatización o carreras afines.

• Experiencia de 3 a 8 años en industria nuclear, energía, oil & gas o procesos industriales.

• Inglés avanzado.

• Manejo del paquete Microsoft Office y de plataformas DCS/PLC.

• Disponibilidad para viajar a nivel nacional.

¿Por qué unirte a Meitner Energy?
Una misión que importa. Vas a ayudar a poner en línea energía nuclear limpia y escalable, no como una promesa futura, sino como un plan ejecutable que arranca en 2030. El trabajo que hagas acá acelera directamente la transición energética global.
Ownership real. Meitner es lo suficientemente chica como para que tus decisiones moldeen visiblemente la empresa, y lo suficientemente ambiciosa como para que esas decisiones importen. Contratamos personas que quieren ser dueñas de los resultados, no solo de tareas.
Equipo de clase mundial en tres continentes. Vas a trabajar con ingenieros, operadores y constructores en Argentina, EE. UU. y el Reino Unido, con experiencia profunda en lo nuclear, lo industrial y la ejecución.
Ejecución por encima del hype. El ACR300 está construido sobre tecnología probada de agua liviana con innovación dirigida, porque desplegar energía limpia a escala es un problema de ejecución, no un experimento científico. Valoramos el rigor, el criterio y el seguimiento.

Para postularte
Si estás listo/a para sumarte a nuestro equipo, enviá tu CV a hiring@meitner.energy con el nombre del rol en el asunto.

Wood está buscando un Ing. Civil Sr. capaz de liderar proyectos de ingeniería, para unirse a su unidad de negocio de Procesos y Químicos. Esta oportunidad es en Capital Federal, Argentina.

Apuntamos a un profesional universitario con buen nivel inglés conversacional, y con una sólida experiencia evaluando la viabilidad y solidez de los diseños de ingeniería, productos y equipos propuestos.

El negocio de Procesos y Químicos de Wood es un jugador líder en sectores clave del mercado, incluyendo refinación tradicional, petroquímicos, productos químicos especializados, materiales avanzados, producción de hidrógeno y CCUS. Ofrecemos una gama completa de servicios de ingeniería y gestión de proyectos y somos integradores líderes en el mercado de instalaciones de refinería y petroquímicos, impulsando la innovación en combustibles sostenibles y materiales avanzados para la transición energética.

• Paquete de beneficios flexibles que se puede adaptar a tu estilo de vida.

Responsibilities

• Participa en la definición de enfoques de ingeniería y en la planificación y programación del trabajo.

• Adhiere y cumple con los procedimientos específicos de la disciplina y proporciona retroalimentación para la mejora continua.

• Realiza tareas de ingeniería complejas relacionadas con unidades específicas de proyectos importantes.

• Participa en visitas al sitio, reuniones de revisión de proyectos, revisiones de diseño y otros talleres según sea necesario.

• Organiza y participa activamente en revisiones de diseño

• Aplica un criterio profesional maduro en la identificación de las implicancias de los resultados experimentales.

• Entiende las necesidades del cliente y aplica soluciones técnicas para alcanzar objetivos.

• Proporciona aportes técnicos y apoyo a propuestas según sea necesario.

• Apoya y supervisa la delegación de tareas al equipo

Qualifications

¿Qué te hace extraordinario?

En Wood, estamos comprometidos con la igualdad de oportunidades y damos la bienvenida a todos los individuos talentosos para considerar unirse a nuestro equipo. Así que, incluso si no cumples con cada declaración a continuación pero sientes que tienes algo de la experiencia, conocimiento o habilidades necesarias para este rol, te animamos a aplicar. Nos tomará a todos trabajando juntos para ofrecer soluciones a los desafíos más críticos del mundo.

Esperado

• Título universitario en Ingeniería Civil.

• Matrícula habilitante vigente.

• Dominio de filosofías de diseño sísmico y de viento para instalaciones O&G en Argentina. Autosuficiencia.

• Staad Pro, AutoCAD, Navisworks

Conocimientos, Habilidades y Experiencia

• Competente técnicamente en su propia disciplina, busca el desarrollo profesional continuo de habilidades y conocimientos conforme a los estándares.

• Conocimiento profesional del marco regulatorio y legislación relevante; y en sistemas como Staad Pro, AutoCAD, Navisworks.

• Capacidad para supervisar, gestionar, motivar y asesorar a profesionales técnicos.

• Conocimiento multidisciplinario, así como de principios y técnicas avanzadas de ingeniería, además de estándares y prácticas de gestión de calidad requeridos.

• Reconocido como un experto técnico con capacidad para desarrollar y guiar al personal más joven.

• Capacidad para ejecutar y supervisar el alcance, presupuesto y cronograma de proyectos.

• Demuestra constantemente creatividad e innovación al encontrar soluciones y alternativas para abordar requerimientos complejos del cliente.

• Habilidades efectivas de comunicación e interpersonales para llevar a cabo interacciones interdepartamentales y externas de la empresa.

• Capacidad para diagnosticar y resolver problemas significativos e inusuales, y generar mejoras sustanciales en prácticas y procedimientos.

• Ágil, con capacidad para adaptarse y resolver problemas.

• Capacidad para interpretar ampliamente principios, teorías y conceptos de una especialidad de ingeniería.

• Posee un buen conocimiento de las distintas Unidades de Negocio, Funciones, Sectores y servicios ofrecidos dentro del área de negocios, una comprensión general de otras ofertas comerciales de Wood y cierta capacidad para establecer redes y conectar a los interesados internos.

• Posee un conocimiento profundo de la posición comercial de Wood y de sus objetivos comerciales, y es capaz de implementar mejoras recomendadas para dichos objetivos. Comprende y puede gestionar riesgos técnicos y comerciales

Aptitudes Personales

• Fuertes habilidades organizativas y atención al detalle.

• Altamente motivado y demuestra iniciativa personal.

• Posee integridad, una sólida ética de trabajo, actitud positiva y es confiable.

• Adaptable y flexible ante las necesidades cambiantes de los proyectos.

About Us

Wood is a global leader in consulting, engineering and operations for the energy and materials sectors. With 33,000 people in around 50 countries, Wood supports clients across the full asset lifecycle, delivering safe, predictable outcomes while enabling resilient operations and a lower carbon future. Wood forms the Energy & Materials pillar of Sidara - a global partnership uniting leading multidisciplinary engineering, design, and project management companies. www.woodgroup.com

Diversity Statement

postings.title: Ingeniero/a de Sistemas de Control y Automatización – DCS
postings.descriptionText:
Transform the everyday: Tu impacto en Siemens

En Siemens unimos el mundo real y el digital para transformar el día a día de millones de personas. Como Ingeniero/a de Sistemas de Control y Automatización (DCS), serás clave en la modernización y digitalización de procesos industriales críticos, liderando proyectos de ingeniería, integración y puesta en marcha con tecnologías de vanguardia como SIMATIC PCS 7, TIA Portal y arquitecturas distribuidas.

Si te apasiona la tecnología con propósito, resolver desafíos técnicos complejos y ver el impacto tangible de tu trabajo en la industria, ¡este desafío es para vos!

Tus principales desafíos y responsabilidades

• Diseño e Ingeniería: Desarrollar la ingeniería básica y de detalle de sistemas de control y automatización para soluciones de alta complejidad basadas en arquitecturas DCS, PLC y HMI/SCADA.

• Integración y Configuración: Programar, configurar y probar arquitecturas de control, redes y comunicaciones industriales, asegurando la integración eficiente entre sistemas.

• Puesta en Marcha y Pruebas: Liderar y participar activamente en relevamientos técnicos, pruebas FAT/SAT, integración y comisionamiento en planta (sitio y remoto).

• Consultoría Técnica y Relacionamiento: Participar en reuniones técnicas con clientes, proveedores y equipos multidisciplinarios para relevar requerimientos y definir especificaciones óptimas.

• Soporte y Mejora Continua: Brindar asistencia técnica especializada durante la ejecución y garantía del proyecto, identificando oportunidades de optimización y mitigación de riesgos.

• Cultura Colaborativa: Documentar las soluciones técnicas y compartir conocimientos con el equipo, impulsando un entorno de aprendizaje continuo.

Requisitos clave:

• Formación en Ingeniería Electrónica, Automatización, Control, Eléctrica o carreras afines (graduados/as o estudiantes avanzados/as).

• Experiencia práctica o sólidos conocimientos en sistemas de control y automatización de procesos industriales (PLC, DCS, SCADA).

• Experiencia en integración, pruebas de fábrica (FAT) y comisionamiento/puesta en marcha de sistemas de control.

• Conocimientos en redes y protocolos de comunicación industrial (ej. PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Industrial Ethernet).

• Nivel de inglés avanzado (capacidad de interacción técnica y lectura fluida).

• Disponibilidad para realizar viajes a plantas y proyectos dentro y fuera del país.

Sumas puntos si cuentas con:

• Experiencia con el ecosistema Siemens: SIMATIC PCS 7, TIA Portal, STEP 7 y WinCC.

• Conocimientos en procesos Batch (ISA-88), Seguridad Funcional (Functional Safety), Ciberseguridad Industrial o virtualización aplicada a entornos OT.

¿Qué te ofrecemos en Siemens?

• Impacto desde el Día 1: Trabajarás en proyectos que impulsan la sostenibilidad, la eficiencia energética y la transformación digital de la industria.

• Flexibilidad y Bienestar: Esquema de trabajo flexible, promoviendo el equilibrio entre tu vida personal y profesional.

• Cultura Abierta e Inclusiva: Un entorno donde cada voz cuenta, se fomenta la diversidad y puedes ser tú mismo/a.

• Crecimiento Continuo: Acceso a plataformas globales de aprendizaje, certificaciones técnicas oficiales en tecnologías Siemens y oportunidades de desarrollo de carrera a nivel local e internacional.

• Licencias co-parentales

• Medicina prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs

Valoramos tu identidad y perspectiva únicas, reconociendo que nuestra fortaleza proviene de las diversas experiencias y pensamientos de las personas que integran nuestro equipo. Tenemos un compromiso en proporcionar oportunidades equitativas y construir un lugar de trabajo que refleje la diversidad de la sociedad. También te apoyamos en tu viaje personal y profesional al brindarte recursos para ayudarte a prosperar. Ven, trae tu yo auténtico y crea un mejor mañana con nosotros.

Es nuestro compromiso proteger el medio ambiente, mejorar y fomentar la salud de nuestros equipos y asegurar que todas las actividades que realizamos se ejecuten en entornos y condiciones seguras.

postings.title: SSr. Automation, Control Room & HSI Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Sobre Meitner Energy
La misión de Meitner Energy es transformar el panorama energético global mediante soluciones nucleares limpias, sostenibles y escalables. Estamos comprometidos con redefinir cómo el mundo alimenta a la industria y al comercio para liderar la transición hacia un futuro más limpio.
En el centro de nuestro trabajo está el ACR300: un reactor modular pequeño (SMR) Gen III+ de 300 MWe diseñado para tener impacto a escala de red desde el primer día. Construido sobre tecnología probada de agua liviana con innovación dirigida y orientada a la ejecución, el ACR300 ofrece desempeño de carga base de alta utilización, independiente de las condiciones climáticas o las limitaciones de almacenamiento. Es el único SMR diseñado para ser a la vez escalable y rentable, con la menor carga de construcción física por megavatio entre los SMR de escala de red.
Nuestro equipo de clase mundial está basado en Argentina, los Estados Unidos y el Reino Unido, trabajando juntos hacia una sola meta: electrificación a escala, comenzando en 2030.

La Oportunidad
Como SSr. Automation, Control Room & HSI Engineer, vas a diseñar, especificar y gestionar la adquisición de los sistemas HSI del proyecto ACR300. El rol transforma definiciones conceptuales en soluciones técnicas completas: desde las bases de diseño normativas (IEC 61513, NUREG-0711, IEEE 603, entre otras) hasta las especificaciones técnicas para la contratación de ingeniería de detalle y suministro de equipos. El alcance abarca Sala de Control Principal, Sala de Apagado Remoto y Puntos de Control Locales.
Este rol es clave para Meitner en este momento porque la sala de control y los HSI son la interfaz real entre los operadores y la planta. Tu trabajo define qué se ve, dónde se ve y cómo se actúa sobre cada sistema.
Este puesto es ideal para alguien que:

• Cree que la energía nuclear es esencial para un futuro energético limpio y se toma la operabilidad humana como parte central del diseño.

• Disfruta del diseño de salas de control, de la especificación de displays y de la integración DCS/SCADA.

• Tiene capacidad para estructurar soluciones técnicas completas y gestionar interfaces multidisciplinarias.

• Quiere crecer en una empresa donde sus decisiones de diseño definen la sala de control real del reactor.

Qué Harás
Diseño de Sistemas HSI

• Desarrollar bases de diseño de los HSI: filosofía de operación, criterios de zonificación funcional de la sala de control, asignación de variables a displays y paneles.

• Elaborar layouts de las Salas de Control, asegurando cumplimiento de NUREG-0700.

• Evaluar y seleccionar tecnologías aplicables al proyecto, considerando requisitos de calificación de equipos.

• Incorporar criterios ergonómicos en el diseño de displays y paneles.

Especificación Técnica y Contratación

• Elaborar especificaciones técnicas para la contratación de ingeniería básica, de detalle y suministro de equipos de HSI: displays, consolas de operación, sistemas de anunciación, estaciones de trabajo de respaldo.

• Revisar y aprobar documentación de proveedores: diseños de ingeniería, programas de calificación (EQ), pruebas de fábrica (FAT) y documentación as-built.

• Participar en negociaciones técnicas con proveedores y en la evaluación de ofertas.

Layout, Routing y Coordinación de Espacios

• Dimensionar los espacios requeridos para las salas de control.

• Definir routing de cables de señales, interfases con sistemas de cableado estructurado y gestión de EMI/EMC.

Gestión de Interfaces y Proyectos

• Gestionar interfaces técnicas entre el HSI y los sistemas de I&C.

• Realizar seguimiento de actividades, avance de proveedores y cumplimiento de hitos del cronograma de ingeniería.

• Participar en revisiones de diseño formales y gestionar la documentación resultante.

Qué Buscamos
Estructuración Técnica y Autonomía

• Capacidad de estructurar soluciones técnicas completas desde el requisito normativo hasta la especificación.

• Autonomía y gestión del tiempo en proyectos de largo plazo con hitos de licenciamiento.

Adaptabilidad y Gestión de Interfaces

• Adaptabilidad ante requisitos cambiantes en proyectos de largo plazo.

• Gestión de interfaces multidisciplinarias con Engineering (mechanical, electrical, civil, instrumentation y piping), Nuclear Safety y Licensing.

Trabajo en Equipo Multidisciplinario

• Capacidad de trabajo en equipo multidisciplinario con stakeholders internos y externos.

• Comunicación técnica clara, escrita y verbal.

Requisitos

• Graduado/a en Ingeniería Electrónica, Electromecánica o afines.

• Especialidad en Control y Automatización.

• Experiencia mínima de 3 años en Energía, Oil & Gas, Minería, Petroquímica o Nuclear.

• Experiencia comprobable en diseño de sistemas de control de proceso complejo con alcance en HSI/HMI: especificación de pantallas, layouts de sala de control, integración DCS/SCADA.

• Participación en tareas de gestión de proyectos (planificación, seguimiento de actividades, interfaces).

• Inglés avanzado.

• Manejo de plataformas DCS/PLC y de herramientas CAD.

• Disponibilidad para viajar a nivel nacional.

• Experiencia en Factores Humanos, ergonomía y gestión de alarmas.

• Experiencia en proyectos de industria nuclear, conocimiento de normativa y calificación de equipos.

¿Por qué unirte a Meitner Energy?
Una misión que importa. Vas a ayudar a poner en línea energía nuclear limpia y escalable, no como una promesa futura, sino como un plan ejecutable que arranca en 2030. El trabajo que hagas acá acelera directamente la transición energética global.
Ownership real. Meitner es lo suficientemente chica como para que tus decisiones moldeen visiblemente la empresa, y lo suficientemente ambiciosa como para que esas decisiones importen. Contratamos personas que quieren ser dueñas de los resultados, no solo de tareas.
Equipo de clase mundial en tres continentes. Vas a trabajar con ingenieros, operadores y constructores en Argentina, EE. UU. y el Reino Unido, con experiencia profunda en lo nuclear, lo industrial y la ejecución.
Ejecución por encima del hype. El ACR300 está construido sobre tecnología probada de agua liviana con innovación dirigida, porque desplegar energía limpia a escala es un problema de ejecución, no un experimento científico. Valoramos el rigor, el criterio y el seguimiento.

Para postularte
Si estás listo/a para sumarte a nuestro equipo, enviá tu CV a hiring@meitner.energy con el nombre del rol en el asunto.
