As an Amazon Operations Manager, you will work across multiple client brands and Amazon marketplaces, primarily in the UK, EU, and US, as well as Canada, Mexico, Australia, and Japan. Your responsibilities will involve analyzing sales and inventory data, identifying operational issues and growth opportunities, making recommendations based on your findings, and executing tasks that support each client's goals. You will need to understand how different aspects of Amazon operations affect a brand's performance, from inventory availability and product listings to promotions and new product launches.

A significant part of this role involves problem-solving. Amazon is a constantly evolving platform, and you will regularly encounter situations that require you to investigate unfamiliar issues, evaluate available information, and find practical solutions. You will work closely with the wider This is Unicorn team, receive training on the agency's processes and ways of working, and participate in regular training and feedback sessions to continuously develop your expertise.

About the Role:

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Amazon Operations Manager is to ensure that the operational activities of our clients' Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts are managed accurately and effectively, while supporting their business growth through data-driven decisions, consistent execution, and proactive problem-solving.

As our Amazon Operations Manager, this will include monitoring and managing inventory, identifying replenishment priorities, supporting product launches and promotional activities, analyzing sales and operational performance, and providing recommendations that help clients make informed decisions. You will be expected to approach challenges logically, take initiative in finding solutions, improve existing processes, and maintain a high standard of accuracy across your work.

General Responsibilities:

• Managing and supporting the day-to-day operations of assigned clients' Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts across different marketplaces

• Setting up, monitoring, and managing inventory to support product availability and meet client requirements

• Analyzing inventory levels, historical sales, and product performance to identify products that require replenishment or are at risk of running out of stock

• Identifying products with excess inventory and recommending appropriate actions based on sales performance and available stock

postings.title: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
About Tort Experts

At Tort Experts, we are redefining the landscape of performance marketing in the legal sector. Our mission is to democratize access to information for individuals who have been injured, connecting them with law firms that can truly advocate for their rights and achieve successful outcomes. As an innovative, vertically integrated legal case acquisition marketing company, we leverage cutting-edge technology, data-driven insights, and a commitment to transparency to disrupt the status quo.

Joining Tort Experts means becoming part of a dynamic team that is passionate about making a meaningful impact. We foster a collaborative environment where creativity thrives, and every team member plays a vital role in connecting qualified claimants with the representation they deserve. If you’re looking for a workplace where your contributions can truly make a difference, and where innovation meets purpose, Tort Experts is the perfect place for you.

About The Role

The CRO Specialist owns the testing and optimization of our direct-response, lead-generation funnels, including landing pages, lead forms, qualification flows, and thank-you pages that receive traffic from paid media across multiple platforms. This person generates split test ideas, maintains a prioritized testing calendar, and sees each test through from concept to build to readout, working closely with our media buying, creative, and dev/tech teams. They focus on conversion rate, cost-per-lead efficiency, and lead quality, not just raw form fills. This is a hands-on, process-driven role focused on experimentation velocity and measurable results.

Location: Remote 9am to 5pm US Eastern.

What You'll Do

Test ideation and hypothesis development

• Generate a steady flow of split test ideas across headlines, copy angles, layouts, form length and field order, qualification questions, CTAs, trust elements, and page speed.

• Use PostHog analytics, session replays, and heatmaps, along with platform data and lead quality feedback, to identify friction points and build clear, data-backed hypotheses.

• Research competitor funnels and industry best practices to surface new testing opportunities.

Testing calendar and pipeline management

• Own and maintain the split test calendar/pipeline, tracking every test from idea to backlog, build, QA, live, and readout.

• Prioritize tests based on expected impact, confidence, and level of effort (e.g., ICE scoring) so the highest-value ideas ship first.

• Ensure tests run long enough to reach meaningful sample sizes and avoid overlapping tests that could contaminate results.

• Keep a central log of test results and findings so wins are rolled out and losses aren't repeated.

Conversion design

• Design every test variant end to end: layout, visual hierarchy, CTAs, color, imagery, form design, and mobile experience.

• Produce build-ready designs in Figma or similar design software (e.g., Sketch, Penpot, Framer), using AI design tools to explore options and speed up production.

• Hand designs to dev/tech with clear specs: responsive behavior, states, tracking events, and acceptance criteria.

• Make design decisions based on evidence (heatmaps, session replays, funnel data, competitor research, past test results), and document the rationale for each.

• Keep designs consistent with our brand and claimant audience: clear, trustworthy, accessible, and mobile-first.

Dev/tech coordination and implementation

• Write clear test briefs and specs for the dev/tech team, including variant details, success metrics, tracking requirements, and launch dates.

• Coordinate build timelines and act as the point of contact between Marketing and dev/tech for all testing and new funnel features.

• QA tests and new features before launch, confirming that pages, forms, pixels, UTMs, and lead routing/CRM integrations work correctly on desktop and mobile.

• Request and help scope new features or tools that would increase testing speed or conversion performance.

Analysis and reporting

• Monitor key metrics including conversion rate, CPL, lead quality/qualification rate, form abandonment, and downstream conversion to signed cases.

• Analyze test results with appropriate statistical rigor and deliver clear readouts with a recommendation: roll out, iterate, or kill.

• Share weekly testing updates and monthly performance summaries with the Marketing team.

Cross-team collaboration

• Partner with media buyers to align landing page tests with ad angles, audiences, and traffic sources.

• Provide creative and copy feedback based on what's actually converting.

• Work with Intake and Compliance to ensure funnel changes support lead quality and advertising/consent requirements.

Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience in conversion rate optimization, growth marketing, or performance marketing.

• Proven track record of running A/B or multivariate tests and driving measurable lifts in conversion rate or CPL.

• Experience optimizing lead-generation funnels is strongly preferred.

• Familiarity with PostHog (analytics, experiments/split testing, and session replay) or a comparable platform (e.g., VWO, Optimizely, Convert). Hands-on experience with PostHog is a strong plus.

• Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and landing page builders or CMS platforms.

• Strong understanding of statistical significance, sample size, and test design.

• Proficient in Google Sheets or Excel for tracking and analysis.

• Able to look past top-line conversion rate and evaluate lead quality and downstream results.

• Solid understanding of conversion tracking, pixels, UTMs, and attribution.

• Highly organized, with experience managing a pipeline or roadmap of multiple projects at once.

• Able to write clear, detailed briefs that developers can build from without guesswork, and comfortable holding cross-functional teams to timelines.

• Curious, skeptical, and driven by "what does the data say?" Able to manage priorities independently in a fast-moving, test-and-learn remote environment.

Nice to Have

• Basic HTML/CSS knowledge, enough to write precise specs and QA builds confidently.

• Experience with lead routing or CRM platforms.

• Call tracking platforms (e.g., CallRail, Invoca, Ringba).

• TCPA and consent capture tools (e.g., TrustedForm).

• Legal, insurance, healthcare, or other regulated-industry marketing.

Success metrics (first 90 days)

• Review of the current PostHog setup, tracking, and past tests completed, with recommendations delivered (first 30 days).

• Metric definitions documented and agreed with Marketing (first 30 days).

• Landing page template inventory and documentation completed (first 30 days).

• Design tool recommendation made and agreed with dev/tech (first 30 days).

• Testing calendar/pipeline built and shared, with a prioritized backlog of test ideas.

• Test brief, readout, and QA templates in use.

• At least 2 tests launched per month starting in month 2, with all variants designed by this role.

• Every test has a brief before launch, passes QA, and gets a written readout.

• Weekly testing updates and a monthly performance summary delivered to Marketing.

• Every test checked for tracking health and correct traffic split within 48 hours of launch.

• Implementation tickets for winning tests delivered to dev/tech within 3 business days of a test being called.

• Post-launch performance tracked on every shipped winner, with the lift confirmed or any regression flagged.

Benefits

• Uncapped quarterly profit-sharing bonuses based on company performance

• 100% company-paid monthly premiums for Fortune 500 level quality insurance plans for you and any/all dependents (US based employees):

•

• medical (Aetna)

• dental (Guardian)

• vision (Guardian)

• 100% company match on any employee contributions to either HSA or FSA flex benefits plans (US based employees):

•

• $500 free FSA company contribution, even if $0 employee contribution

• 401k plan with full company match of up to 6% of salary and no vesting period required (US based employees)

• Unlimited paid time off with planned role/responsibilities coverage

• Wellhub wellness benefit — access to 20,000+ gyms, studios, and wellness apps, fully covered by the company

• Work from home equipment budget (at company's discretion)

• Forever remote work environment

Why Join Us?

At Tort Experts, we believe in empowering our team members with growth opportunities, a flexible work environment, and the chance to make a tangible impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and are driven, client-focused, and eager to contribute to our mission of connecting clients with top-tier legal representation. Are you ready to lead the next wave of growth in legal marketing? Apply today and help us transform access to justice!

Please note that you may receive emails on behalf of Tort Experts from no-reply@ats.rippling.com. This is not spam and has been sent from our HR/Payroll system, Rippling.

If you are selected to move forward in the process, we will contact you directly. We kindly ask that you do not reach out to inquire about the status of your application . Due to the volume of submissions, we are unable to respond to individual application status requests.

Role Summary
We are seeking a proactive, customer-focused Customer Success & Digital Marketing Manager to support the growth and customer experience of an AI-powered donor research and prospecting tool serving nonprofit organizations, development directors, grant writers, and consultants.

This role combines hands-on customer success with digital marketing ownership. You will serve as the primary point of contact for users, guide new customers through their free trials, help convert trial users into paying subscribers, and support customer retention through responsive communication and ongoing engagement.

You will also own the tool's marketing plan, manage Google Search advertising, monitor search and AI-driven visibility, and coordinate marketing initiatives across internal and external partners. The ideal candidate combines strong customer communication skills with practical digital marketing experience and a data-driven approach to improving signups, conversions, and customer satisfaction.

This is a remote position focused on candidates based in Latin America.

Key Responsibilities
Customer Success & User Support

• Serve as the primary human point of contact for users of the AI-powered donor research and prospecting platform.

• Respond promptly and professionally to customer emails, calls, and website inquiries, including "Talk to us" requests.

• Welcome new trial users and help them get started through onboarding emails, short instructional guides, and videos.

• Proactively engage users during their 30-day free trial to answer questions, encourage product adoption, and support conversion to paid subscription plans.

• Handle billing inquiries, subscription plan changes, and cancellation requests.

• Gather cancellation reasons and customer feedback to identify opportunities to improve retention and the overall customer experience.

• Collect and organize product feedback, feature requests, and user-reported issues for internal review.

• Maintain accurate, helpful customer-facing resources, including the help page and frequently asked questions.

• Manage the customer referral program and coordinate referral incentives.

• Encourage satisfied customers to share reviews on G2 and Capterra and participate in customer testimonials or success stories.

Digital Marketing & Customer Acquisition

• Own and execute the marketing plan for the software platform, focusing on customer acquisition, trial signups, and paid conversions.

• Set up, manage, test, and optimize Google Search advertising campaigns within established budgets.

• Monitor campaign performance and prioritize advertising strategies that generate qualified signups.

• Track search engine optimization (SEO) performance, including Google search rankings and organic visibility.

• Monitor generative engine optimization (GEO), including the platform's visibility and mentions in AI-powered tools such as ChatGPT.

• Manage and maintain the platform's profiles on G2, Capterra, Crunchbase, and Google Business Profile.

• Support company leadership in drafting monthly LinkedIn articles and related thought-leadership content.

• Prepare and distribute a concise monthly email or newsletter to customers and trial users.

• Coordinate website content and demo video updates as new platform features become available.

• Identify opportunities to improve marketing messaging, product awareness, and the customer signup journey.

Performance Tracking & Reporting

• Monitor key customer and marketing metrics, including trial signups, free-to-paid conversions, customer engagement, and cancellations.

• Use Google Analytics and advertising performance data to assess customer acquisition and marketing effectiveness.

• Evaluate Google Ads results, identify effective campaigns, and recommend improvements based on performance.

• Track changes in SEO rankings and AI-powered search visibility.

• Prepare monthly marketing performance reports for company leadership.

• Communicate customer feedback, recurring issues, marketing insights, and opportunities for improvement.

Cross-Functional & External Partner Coordination

• Maintain clear, consistent communication with the external marketing agency regarding marketing initiatives, campaign execution, and performance.

• Coordinate with the software development and maintenance partner on customer-reported issues, feature updates, and technical matters.

• Work closely with internal stakeholders to align customer experience, marketing priorities, and product improvements.

• Follow up on customer issues and requested enhancements to ensure appropriate internal coordination.

• Keep relevant stakeholders informed of customer needs, campaign progress, and product-related updates.

Required Qualifications

• Experience in customer success, account management, or digital marketing , ideally supporting a software product or subscription-based platform.

• Hands-on experience setting up, managing, and optimizing Google Ads campaigns , particularly Google Search advertising.

• Comfortable using Google Analytics , interpreting marketing performance data, and reviewing monthly metrics.

En el año 2018 modificamos nuestra denominación y nos convertimos en GPAT Compañía Financiera S.A.U., al ser Banco Patagonia S.A. nuestro único accionista.

Nuestros clientes son fundamentales, por eso desarrollamos productos pensados para todas sus necesidades, y ofrecemos un servicio diferencial traducido en obtener altos estándares de calidad de atención.

The role
We’re hiring an Account Manager to lead 2 to 4 of our Shopify DTC brands strategically. You’ll be the primary point of contact for your clients, the strategic glue across our paid, email, social, creative, and production teams, and the person who turns a client’s goals into real campaigns that move the needle.

You’ll own your accounts end to end, mentor one Junior Account Manager on your pod, and have a clear path into leadership as the agency grows.

A note on English
This role is 100% client-facing with North American brands. Fluent, confident spoken and written English is non-negotiable. If your English isn’t at a level where you’d feel comfortable leading a strategic client call tomorrow, this role isn’t the right fit.

What you bring

• Fluent, confident English, both spoken and written. This is a requirement.

• Strong grasp of digital marketing fundamentals across paid media, email, social, creative, and analytics

• Comfort working inside Klaviyo, Shopify, Asana, Airtable, and Slack (or equivalents)

• Fully remote, based in Argentina with in-person sessions in Buenos Aires

• Direct ownership of high-growth DTC brands across North America

• A clear growth path. The agency doubled last year, and senior strategy and leadership seats are opening.

• A culture built on momentum, ownership, and AI-forward thinking

How to apply
Send your CV and a short note on why this role fits you to sean@impulsomedia.ca.

Client Success Manager

Location: Remote (Latin America preferred; candidates in other markets outside the U.S. will also be considered)

Employment Type: Full-time, independent contractor

Schedule: Primary availability 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM Eastern Time, with occasional later client calls

Reports To: Founder

Base Compensation: USD $3,000 - $3,500 per month

Variable Compensation: Upsell commission, monthly retention bonus, and quarterly performance bonus (details below)

About The Company

Our client is a specialized medical marketing agency that helps U.S. healthcare practices attract and convert new patients. The agency currently focuses on marketing a specialized procedure used to address knee pain. It primarily runs proven Meta Ads campaigns and helps clinic teams strengthen lead follow-up, consultation booking, and patient conversion.

The agency is growing and is building a scalable, high-quality client success function.

The Opportunity

The company is looking for a confident, analytically strong Client Success Manager to become the primary advisor and relationship owner for its medical practice clients.

This is not a relationship-management-only position. You will interpret patient-acquisition data, determine whether performance challenges originate in the marketing or in the clinic's follow-up, coach practice owners and their teams, and coordinate solutions across internal departments.

Over time, you will progressively take over client-facing responsibilities from the founder, giving you substantial ownership and the opportunity to help shape the client success function from the ground up.

What You'll Do

• Lead new-client onboarding, coordinate account access, and guide clinic teams through GoHighLevel training and lead-management workflows

• Run weekly client performance calls during the first six weeks after launch, followed by support and review calls as needed

• Analyze cost per lead, cost per booked consultation, speed to lead, outbound call activity, appointment booking and show rates, and patient conversion

• Diagnose bottlenecks in lead quality, clinic follow-up, and patient acquisition, then translate your findings into clear, actionable recommendations for practice owners

• Coach clinics on follow-up processes, call activity, and conversion improvements, including having constructive conversations when clinic-side execution is the problem

• Collaborate with media buying, creative, operations, and other internal teams to recommend campaign changes, track deliverables, and resolve client issues

• Own client communication, satisfaction, account health, and retention; proactively identify risks and follow through on commitments

• Identify suitable opportunities to add proven service lines, coordinate approvals, and collect payment when appropriate

How The Role Works

The marketing team handles campaign execution. Your focus is diagnosis, strategic recommendations, relationship ownership, and coordination.

The role may involve approximately 20-30 client calls per week across onboarding, platform training, performance reviews, and support. The team values autonomy, direct communication, collaboration, and meaningful work over unnecessary meetings.

What Success Looks Like

Success means independently managing client conversations, diagnosing and resolving performance issues, maintaining strong relationships, and reducing the founder's involvement in day-to-day account management.

Performance will be measured on client retention, client satisfaction, speed to onboarding activation, response time, performance improvements, and ownership of client issues.

Earning Potential

Base Compensation

• USD $3,000 - $3,500 per month

Variable Compensation (performance-based, not guaranteed)

postings.title: Product Marketing Associate, Banking & Lending
postings.descriptionText:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a Product Marketing Associate, Banking & Lending to bring go-to-market plans to life across Sezzle’s growing set of financial products, both live and upcoming. The Head of Product Marketing owns strategy and go-to-market for these products. You’ll own execution: turning those plans into shipped tests, campaigns, and lifecycle messaging, and reporting back what the data says.

This role is well-suited for someone who loves getting things built and out the door, is energized by data, and wants to learn how product marketing strategy is made by working right next to it. Priorities follow company goals and key performance metrics, so you’ll spend more time on some products than others as launches and opportunities shift.

The salary range for this role is $2,500 - $3,333 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Testing & Optimization

• Turn insights about where users drop off in product journeys into experiments that improve the experience

• Build and run tests in whatever form they take, from in-app copy and design changes to targeted email and push campaigns, working with product managers and designers

• Share results clearly and quickly, and flag anything that suggests we should change course

• Treat everything as a test: design for learning, monitor results, and iterate based on what the data tells you

Research & Insights

• Run user research end to end once the questions are set: build the survey or study, send it to the right group of users, analyze the results, and write them up

• Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to surface patterns, friction points, and opportunities

• Use AI tools to speed up analysis and sharpen the insights you bring back

Go-to-Market Execution

• Turn launch and marketing plans into clear project timelines with owners and dates

• Partner with our marketing communications team to bring email, push, and in-app campaigns to life

• Guide marketing materials through compliance and legal review in a regulated industry

• Coordinate everything needed to get new products ready for launch

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation

• Work closely with product managers, marketing communications, design, compliance, and data teams on every product you touch

• Share regular progress updates with the team and cross-functional partners

• Document research findings and test results, and keep team strategy documents up to date

• Adapt quickly as priorities and launch timing shift

Qualifications

Required

• 2+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Growth, Lifecycle Marketing, Consumer Research, or a related field

• Strong analytical skills: comfortable working with funnel data, behavioral data, and survey results, and using AI to evaluate them

• Highly organized and execution-minded, with a track record of getting work shipped on time across multiple stakeholders

• Clear, concise written communicator in English, able to turn complex results into a sharp readout

• Curious about AI tools and eager to use them to work smarter. Bonus if you’re already using them regularly

Nice to Have

• Experience in fintech, banking, lending, payments, or credit products

• Experience getting marketing copy through compliance or legal review in a regulated industry

• Experience running A/B tests or in-product experiments

• Experience with lifecycle messaging, in-product copy, or Braze (or similar)

• Consumer-facing or mobile product experience

• Familiarity with user research methodologies

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

#Full-time

Depending on your experience and seniority, you may coordinate bid activities, manage workstreams or lead deal teams through the development, submission and negotiation stages of an opportunity.

You will use your knowledge of sales and proposal processes to align stakeholders, manage timelines and risks, and ensure the appropriate resources are engaged to address client requirements.

• Facilitate communication and alignment among sales teams, deal leadership and other internal stakeholders.

• Build productive working relationships with key deal-team stakeholders.

• Support bids through preparation, proposal development, submission and, when applicable, negotiation.

• Identify opportunities to improve bid management processes, tools and ways of working.

• Contribute to continuous learning, knowledge sharing and professional development across the team.

• At more senior levels, lead deal teams, manage complex bids and support the development of less-experienced team members.

• Ability to coordinate activities, timelines and stakeholders across multiple workstreams.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to collaborate with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage priorities in deadline-driven environments.

• Relevant years and type of experience

• Experience managing workstreams or complete bid lifecycles

postings.title: Embedded systems Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
#poweringyouringenuity 🚀

Our mission is to bridge top-level technology companies with engineering talent from across the globe. With presence in LATAM, USA and Europe, we empower companies by providing remote engineering teams of all levels tailored to the needs of each project.

Our teams are passionate about technology and thrive on challenges. We value technical expertise and a willingness to learn new things. Each development is tailored to the needs of each project, so being passionate about learning and using new languages, tools, and frameworks is part of our DNA. Our software engineering teams focus on best coding practices to ensure readability, reusability, and scalability of our systems' designs and developments.

Senior Embedded Software Engineer

We’re looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to join a project building a new generation of vision processing units (VPUs). You’ll sit between the board support package (BSP) team and the middleware and platform team that builds on it, and your job is to catch integration issues early. Before a BSP release reaches the platform team, you will already have run their integration tests against it on real hardware, filed what broke, and worked with both teams on the fix.

This is a hands-on, test-first role, and over time you’ll become the go-to person for any question that crosses the boundary between the operating system and the software running on it. You’ll work with a very senior team, so we’re looking for someone independent who delivers fast and brings opinions on what to focus on next.

Your Role And Responsibilities

• Own the BSP integration test suites in a Python-based integration-test framework

• Run them on dedicated test benches and on hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) infrastructure, validating every BSP release on real hardware before handover

• File, track, and drive to resolution the issues you find

• Turn what the platform team needs from the BSP into requirements and tests the BSP team can build against

• Troubleshoot on hardware using logs, debuggers, and bus analyzers, bisecting problems across kernel, driver, and user-space layers

• Read, debug, and modify Linux sensor and kernel drivers when the fix requires it

• Work with both teams to define and implement fixes

• Suggest where the team should focus next

• Pass on your passion for technology and professionalism to your peers

• Be receptive and empathetic with your team and technical communities

If You

• Have demonstrated experience as an embedded software developer on Linux-based products

• Have strong hands-on experience troubleshooting embedded systems (logs, debuggers, bus analyzers)

• Use C/C++, Rust, and Python in your daily work

• Have experience with Yocto-based, customizable BSPs: meta-tegra or a comparable layer for NVIDIA Jetson-class compute

• Have experience reading, debugging, and modifying Linux sensor and kernel drivers

• Write tests alongside your changes and run them in continuous integration

• Work independently, deliver quickly, and propose priorities rather than wait for them

• Are comfortable in technical discussions with senior engineers and can propose solutions

• Have solid technical English, spoken and written

It’d Be a Plus If You

• Have run CI for embedded targets with hardware-in-the-loop test farms

• Have experience with pytest (or similar) and test-report tooling

• Have worked with camera, IMU, or other sensor pipelines on embedded Linux

• Are familiar with CAN or Ethernet network stacks on embedded systems

• Have worked as a liaison between a platform team and the teams that build on it

• Have used requirements management tooling and requirement-to-test traceability

• Have contributed to open source projects

• Are an active member of a tech community or have done public speaking on technical topics

Join us to be part of a dynamic community where your skills and contributions truly matter!

postings.descriptionText:
Identity & Access Management (IAM) Analyst (AI Training)

About The Role

Identity is at the heart of modern enterprise security — and also at the heart of most major breaches. We're partnering with leading AI research labs to build AI systems that truly understand how identity and access management works in the real world: how it's designed, where it breaks, and how attackers exploit it.

If you've spent time working with IAM, SSO, or access control systems and you understand what goes wrong in practice — not just in theory — this role puts that expertise to work in a meaningful new way.

• Organization: Alignerr

• Type: Hourly Contract

• Location: Remote

• Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

• Analyze realistic IAM, SSO, and access control scenarios to identify weaknesses, misconfigurations, and failure points

• Classify permission issues, privilege escalation paths, and identity-related security failures

• Evaluate zero-trust models, access design decisions, and least-privilege implementations

• Generate and validate realistic identity security scenarios used to train and evaluate AI systems

• Provide structured expert feedback that helps AI reason accurately about IAM risk

Who You Are

• 2+ years of hands-on experience with IAM, SSO, or enterprise identity platforms

• Strong familiarity with RBAC, least-privilege models, and access review processes

• Solid understanding of how identity failures occur and how they are exploited

• Ability to explain complex access control concepts clearly in writing

• Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently

Nice to Have

• Experience with platforms such as Okta, Azure AD, CyberArk, SailPoint, or similar

• Familiarity with zero-trust architecture frameworks

• Background in penetration testing, red teaming, or security auditing

• Experience writing security documentation, threat models, or access control policies

Why Join Us

• Work directly on frontier AI systems with top research labs

• Fully remote and flexible — set your own schedule

• Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and collaboration with a global expert community

• Your real-world security expertise directly improves how AI understands and reasons about enterprise risk

• Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

Launch Your Next Successful Chapter with Veta Virtual! 🚀

💸 Competitive Pay in USD | 🌍 100% Remote (ET or EU Hours) | 🧭 Chief of Staff + Operations + Executive Support | 🔄 Contract-to-Hire

Veta Virtual is hiring a Chief of Staff & Executive Operations for one of our clients, a senior executive running several businesses and initiatives at once. This individual contributor role blends three jobs: one third chief of staff (priorities, projects, follow-through), one third office manager (systems, tools, processes), and one third executive assistant (calendar and travel). The executive moves fast, doesn't micromanage, and expects proactivity, clear ownership, and results, with plenty of freedom in return.

🔑 Your Role

Priorities, Projects & Follow-Through

• Own the master list of active projects across the businesses (deadlines, deliverables, owners, next steps), keep the largest initiatives on target, and act as the buffer that protects the executive's time.

• Act as a trusted point of contact for a high-level network (investors, high-net-worth individuals, institutions, senior executives, government officials), speaking with them directly in meetings, by phone, and by email, including when the executive isn't present.

• Triage messages, draft correspondence on the executive's behalf, and make sure every important external follow-up happens on time.

Office Management, Systems & Tools

• Set up and run the project management system (Notion, Asana, or similar), move work out of Google Sheets, and build dashboards showing where every project and priority stands.

• Find, test, and roll out new tools, including AI tools, and write simple processes, templates, and checklists so work keeps moving when someone is away.

Calendar, Travel & Logistics

• Manage a fast-changing calendar across multiple time zones, protect time for high-priority work, and prepare the executive for key meetings with agendas, background notes, and concise research.

• Arrange domestic and international travel (flights, hotels, ground transportation, itineraries), planning far enough ahead that surprises are rare and handling the ones that happen calmly.

✅ What You'll Need

• Excellent verbal and written English and a high-energy, personable presence: polished and comfortable talking to anyone, from a new teammate to an investor, senior executive, or government official, including on camera.

• A calm, adaptable self-starter who is excited by freedom: you handle changes of plan gracefully, don't need step-by-step direction, respectfully push back or follow up with the executive, and welcome genuine constructive feedback.

• Availability on a consistent Eastern Time or EU schedule (ET preferred), with adjustments planned ahead around the executive's travel. This is not a 24/7, on-call role.

• Bonus: experience working with investors, high-net-worth individuals, institutions, senior executives, or government officials, or a STEM, finance, or nonprofit/ESG/sustainability background.

• Bonus: hands-on experience setting up Notion, Asana, or similar with dashboards, building presentations and dashboards with AI tools (deployed on platforms like Lovable or Vercel), and working with distributed teams across time zones (EMEA, NAM/LATAM).

• To be considered for this role, you must be currently based in Latin America (LATAM) or Europe.

💼 What We Offer

• 💸 Competitive compensation in USD, paid consistently every month.

• 🔄 Contract-to-hire: an initial 1-month period, with strong performers considered for permanent placement.

• 💻 100% remote on a consistent schedule, with changes planned ahead around travel.

• 🧭 A direct partnership with a senior executive: real ownership, lots of freedom, and a leader who pushes you to stretch beyond what you thought possible. You report directly to the executive as an individual contributor.

• 🤝 A supportive culture through Veta Virtual and our client.

Ready to Apply?

If you're excited to know what comes next before anyone asks, can hold a confident conversation with an investor, and love building a better dashboard or process, apply now and launch your next chapter with Veta Virtual.

Your short 2-minute video question is a key part of our screening, so treat it as a first impression: look professional and presentable, speak in clear, confident English, and answer authentically in your own words, without reading from a script or notes. We can't wait to meet you!

postings.title: Senior Account Executive - USA Software Sales (Remote)
postings.descriptionText:
Location: Remote
Team: Sales
Reports to: Head of Sales

About Carepatron
Carepatron is the healthcare platform helping more than 100,000 professionals across over 100 specialties care for their clients and get their time back. Therapists, psychologists, counselors, dietitians and whole multidisciplinary clinics in more than 120 countries run their working day on us: scheduling, telehealth, clinical notes, AI scribe, invoicing and insurance claims.

We started Carepatron after watching our own partners, a psychologist and a surgeon, lose their evenings to paperwork. That is still the problem we are solving. Less back-office work, more headspace for care.

The United States is our largest market, and behavioral health is where the need is sharpest. Practices there are losing hours every week to documentation, claims and credentialing, they are paying more each year for software that keeps adding per-clinician fees, and they are actively looking for something simpler. Almost all of our growth so far has come from practitioners finding us and recommending us to each other. We are now putting a real sales motion behind that, and this is the role that starts it.

The role
This is a full-cycle role. You will run the conversations and close the business. You will have an SDR booking demos into your calendar, and inbound arriving from the US every week. What you will not have is a finished playbook. You are the person who builds that.

There are four parts to the job.

The demos. Your SDR books meetings into your calendar, and your job is to turn them into pipeline. That partnership only works in both directions, so you will feed back honestly on which accounts and messages are converting, and you will still open your own priority accounts yourself rather than waiting on the calendar to fill. Self-serve is also how most practices meet Carepatron, so a real share of your pipeline is people who have already used the product and need a reason to move their whole practice onto it.

Closing. You own every deal end to end: discovery, demo, security and compliance questions, migration planning, pricing and the close. Solo and small practices decide in weeks. Larger group practices take longer, because they are moving years of client records and putting us through security review. The buyer is usually a practice owner or clinical director who is also seeing clients. Being efficient with their time is part of the pitch.

The playbook. You will decide what our ICP actually is, which segments convert, which messages land, what a good demo looks like and what belongs in the CRM. Everyone we hire into US sales after you will start from what you wrote.

The market. You will be closer to the US behavioral health buyer than anyone else at Carepatron. What you learn about billing, payers, migration blockers and competitors has to get back to product, marketing and leadership quickly enough for us to act on it.

What you will own

Closing and revenue

• Carry a new business quota and own the full cycle behind it: discovery, demo, trial, proposal, close.

• Convert the demos your SDR books. Show up prepared on every one, run it properly, and give the meeting the same respect whether it came from a cold call or a referral.

• Run demos that speak to how a US behavioral health practice actually operates: intake and scheduling, notes and treatment plans, telehealth, superbills, electronic claims and ERAs through our clearinghouse integration, and supervising associate clinicians.

• Handle the questions that stall healthcare software deals: HIPAA and security review, migrating years of client records off an incumbent EHR, insurance and billing workflows, and per-clinician pricing.

• Grow accounts after the first signature. Most practices start with a handful of clinicians and add more.

• Work with onboarding and support so the practices you sell actually go live, stay, and tell other practices about us.

Pipeline and partnership

• Work as one unit with your SDR. Agree the target list together, brief them on what a good meeting looks like, review booked demos before they happen, and tell them quickly when a segment or a message is not landing.

• Open your own accounts too. The best AEs here will not sit on a quiet calendar, and some doors only open when the person who can close walks through them.

• Target US behavioral health practices, weighted toward group practices with three or more clinicians, across calls, email, LinkedIn and industry events.

• Work the inbound properly. Trials, free-plan practices and demo requests arrive from the US every week, and the ones with room to grow are some of our best conversations.

• Research accounts and buyers before you reach out. A practice owner can tell within one sentence whether you understand their week.

• Run nurture for the practices that are not ready yet, and reopen the conversations that went quiet.

• Keep the CRM accurate enough that a forecast means something. We run on Pipedrive.

Building the function

• Write the first version of our US sales playbook: ICP, cadences, discovery questions, demo flow, objection handling and competitive positioning, for you and for the SDR working alongside you.

• Test channels honestly, measure them, and without waiting to be told, kill the ones that are not working.

• Bring evidence back to product and marketing on what is winning and losing deals, and what we would need to build or say to change that.

• Help us hire. As the team grows you will interview, onboard and set the standard for the people who follow you.

What success looks like

• In your first 30 days. You can demo Carepatron without help and explain how a US insurance claim moves through it. You have spoken to enough practice owners to hold your own view of the ICP rather than ours, and your SDR has that view too because you gave it to them. There is pipeline in the CRM from both of you.

• By 90 days. You are closing. The first written version of the playbook exists, you know which channel and which segment are working, and you can show the numbers behind that instead of a feeling.

• Within 12 months. You are consistently at or above quota, the motion is repeatable enough that the next hire can run it, and US behavioral health group practices are a predictable source of revenue rather than a hope.

What you will bring

• Several years in B2B SaaS sales, including a full-cycle closing role where you carried a quota. Tell us your numbers and how you got them.

• Evidence that you can create pipeline yourself and close what you created. Self-sourced pipeline and the revenue that came out of it matter more to us than logos.

• Excellent written and spoken English. Clear, warm and direct, with no filler.

• Real listening and real curiosity. The best discovery calls here are mostly the practice owner talking.

• A competitive streak, and the ambition to beat the number rather than land on it.

• Resilience and pace. You will be told no often, and the job is to iterate rather than stall.

• Comfort in ambiguity. No playbook yet, and little brand recognition in the US yet. Some people find that energizing and some find it exhausting, and it is worth being honest with yourself about which you are.

• The instinct to work well with an SDR rather than around one. Coaching them, briefing them and closing the loop with them is part of your job, not a favor.

• Comfort with software. You can learn a deep product quickly and demo it confidently, including the billing and compliance detail that healthcare buyers always ask about.

• Discipline with your CRM and your own numbers. You know your conversion rates without having to look them up.

• Willingness to work US business hours and give US practices reliable coverage, with some overlap with our team in New Zealand.

• A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. We care about what you can do, not where you studied.

Bonus points

• You have sold into US behavioral health, mental health or allied health practices, or sold practice management, EHR or medical billing software.

• Working knowledge of US insurance workflows: claims and clearinghouses, ERAs, superbills, credentialing, or the psychotherapy CPT codes practices bill every day.

• You have been an early or founding account executive somewhere and built the motion from scratch.

• You have sold against SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, Jane, Valant, or platforms like Headway, Alma and Grow Therapy, and you can articulate where Carepatron fits better.

• Experience selling a product with a free or self-serve tier, where the job is expansion rather than introduction.

• Hands-on with Pipedrive, and with the outbound stack around it.

How we work

• We are a global, remote, mission-driven team, and we hire people who do not need to be managed into caring. Four things we hold to:

• Radical accessibility. Beautiful software should be accessible to every health practitioner around the world.

• Collaboration. People do their best work when they do it together.

• Customization. Practitioners deserve to work according to their own needs, not someone else’s.

• Modern technology. Technology can change the future of healthcare for both patients and practitioners.

• In practice that means independent thinkers, high standards, real ownership and direct communication.

• You will work closely with leadership who have built products at Xero, EzyVet, Halter and Serato, and you will get the access and the latitude that comes with being an early hire in a new market.

postings.title: Liquor Sales Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Turn your knowledge of spirits into standout guest experiences, from tastings and cocktail conversations to premium liquor sales at sea.
We’re looking for Liquor Sales Specialists to join our onboard retail teams, working on cruise ships around the world.
This role is for someone who knows their way around premium spirits and enjoys sharing that knowledge with others. You might come from a retail liquor background, duty free, hospitality, bar work, mixology or brand ambassador experience. What matters is that you can talk confidently about different spirits, explain flavour profiles, recommend products and create a tasting experience that guests remember.
About Harding+
Harding+ is a leading cruise retail business, working closely with cruise line partners and brand partners to make every cruise better. Our onboard boutiques offer guests a carefully selected range across liquor, fragrance, beauty, fashion, jewellery, watches, confectionery and logo products.
We are proud to have been recognised as Cruise Retailer of the Year in 2022, 2023 and 2025, reflecting our focus on excellent service, strong brand partnerships and memorable guest experiences.
What You’ll Do
As a Liquor Sales Specialist , you’ll be the person who helps guests discover, understand and enjoy our premium liquor range. You’ll introduce products with confidence, explain the difference between spirits, talk through flavour notes and make recommendations that feel relevant to the guest, whether they are buying a gift, choosing something for an occasion or treating themselves.
You’ll support tastings, seminars, in-store events and promotional activity, using these moments to create interest, start conversations and convert sales. You’ll be comfortable holding the attention of a small group, answering questions and making the experience feel relaxed, enjoyable and informative.
This is a hands-on sales role. You’ll need to approach guests naturally, spot buying signals, suggest complementary products and keep momentum without making the interaction feel forced. You’ll also help maintain strong visual standards, accurate stock handling and compliance processes, while sharing your product knowledge with the wider team.
What You’ll Bring
We’re looking for someone with strong knowledge of spirits and experience using that knowledge in a customer-facing environment.
You’ll Bring

• Experience in liquor retail, duty free, hospitality, mixology, bar work, brand ambassador work or premium retail

• Strong knowledge of different spirits, such as whisky, rum, gin, vodka, tequila, cognac or liqueurs

• Confidence discussing flavour profiles, serves, cocktail ideas, gifting options and brand stories

• The ability to host or support tastings, demonstrations, seminars or promotional events

• Motivation and ambition to achieve sales targets and maximise every sales opportunity

• A positive, team-focused attitude and willingness to share knowledge

• Fluency in English; additional languages would be an advantage

• A good level of physical fitness, as the role involves being active throughout the day

What You’ll Get

• Competitive salary with target-based commission

• Included Accommodation and meals provided onboard

• No household bills while you are working at sea

• Support with necessary visas and seafaring documents

• Dedicated in-house training across sales, product and brand knowledge

• The opportunity to travel the world while earning

• Contracts of up to 6 months onboard, usually followed by 1 to 2 months at home between contracts

• On selected cruise lines, the opportunity to travel independently after your contract, with support for your return travel home afterwards

Ready to bring your spirits knowledge to sea? Apply Now!

In All Media (IAM) is an established technology services company helping organizations build, scale, and modernize their engineering capabilities.
Through a global talent community with strong engineering expertise, we provide nearshore software development, staff augmentation, dedicated engineering teams, and flexible delivery models.

As technology and AI reshape how companies build software, IAM is evolving its commercial approach and service offerings to meet changing market needs.
We are looking for a senior technology services leader who can bring established client relationships and help build IAM's next stage of growth.

Location & Work Arrangement
Remote, with location flexibility. Candidates may be based in the U.S., Latin America, or elsewhere, provided they can effectively engage U.S. clients and collaborate across relevant time zones.
An established U.S. commercial network matters more than physical location.

What You’ll Do

• Generate opportunities through your own relationships, introductions, and outreach.

• Expand client engagements into additional projects, teams, or services.

Lemon Adds
Remote LATAM · Full-time · U.S. Pacific Hours · Immediate Start
You know when a signup offer needs rethinking, which audience needs a different message, and where a flow is losing sales. You bring the recommendation—and own the execution.
Lemon Adds is hiring a senior email marketer who can turn those insights into measurable growth.

Who We Are
Lemon Adds is a performance marketing agency helping DTC brands grow through paid media, creative, influencer marketing, retention, and ecommerce execution.
You’ll own email strategy and execution across client accounts, working alongside creative and performance specialists. Your ideas will shape campaign plans, customer journeys, and the next experiments we run.

What You’ll Own

• Find growth opportunities. Audit accounts, challenge assumptions, prioritize improvements, and build campaign calendars. Bring clear recommendations without waiting to be asked.

• Grow and nurture the audience. Improve signup rates through testing forms, offers, targeting, timing, and mobile experiences. Build smart segments around engagement, purchase behavior, customer value, and lifecycle stage. Nurture subscribers and re-engage eligible inactive customers.

Private portfolio links and redacted results are welcome. Relevant DTC experience, advanced Klaviyo skills, and a portfolio are required.

Ferrero comenzó su trayectoria en la pequeña ciudad de Alba en Piamonte, Italia, en 1946 . Hoy en día, es una de las empresas de alimentos dulces envasados más grandes del mundo, con muchas marcas icónicas que se venden en todo el mundo. Descubre más sobre Ferrero en ferrero.com.

About The Role

You'll own lifecycle marketing at Optery end-to-end: email, in-app messaging, and push notifications across the full customer journey. This includes onboarding, activation, engagement, upgrade/cross-sell, renewal, churn prevention, and win-back. This is a senior IC role with full ownership of strategy and execution: you'll design the journeys, build the campaigns, write (or direct) the copy, run the experiments, and report on the results.

What You'll Do

• Own the lifecycle marketing roadmap: map the customer journey and identify the highest-impact opportunities across activation, conversion, retention, and expansion

• Build, launch, and iterate on automated campaigns and triggered flows in our marketing automation platform (we use Customer.io; equivalents include Iterable, Braze, or Klaviyo)

• Own in-app messaging and transactional-adjacent communications in partnership with product and engineering

• Build and optimize mobile push notification strategy: permission opt-in flows, triggered and campaign-based pushes, frequency capping, and coordination with email so channels complement rather than compete

• Develop segmentation and personalization strategies using behavioral and account data, including dynamic templating and conditional content logic

• Run a disciplined experimentation program: A/B tests on sequences, subject lines, timing, and offers, with clear holdouts and measurement

• Manage email deliverability, list hygiene, and suppression strategy to protect sender reputation

• Partner with analytics to instrument and measure lifecycle performance (we use Amplitude and connect campaigns to revenue outcomes

• Collaborate with paid acquisition, product, and support teams so messaging is coordinated across the entire customer experience

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of significant hands-on experience owning lifecycle, CRM, retention, or email marketing programs, ideally for a subscription-based service.

• Fluency in a modern marketing automation platform (e.g., Customer.io, Iterable, Braze, Klaviyo) including segmentation, triggered workflows, and templating languages like Liquid

• Strong copy instincts: you can write clear, persuasive messaging and know when to test rather than debate

• Comfort with data: you can define your own metrics, pull your own reports, and interpret results honestly (SQL and product analytics experience are a plus)

• Understanding of email deliverability fundamentals and compliance (CAN-SPAM, GDPR/CCPA basics)

• Experienced with AI and actively leveraging it in your current workflows

• A builder's mindset: you're energized by owning a function, not just executing tickets

• Bonus: experience in privacy, security, or consumer subscription products; experience with both B2C and B2B messaging

Location

While Optery is a fully-remote global team, this position is based in the United States and is required to work regular U.S. business hours, i.e. in the U.S. Eastern, Central, Mountain, and/or Pacific time zones.

Compensation & Benefits

• Base salary: $80K - $90K

• Great health, dental, and vision insurance

• 401k program with employer match

• Paid time off policy

Equal Opportunity

Optery values diversity and is an equal opportunity employer. Optery does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factor.

postings.title: Product and Procurement Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Impacto Talent is hiring on behalf of a fast-growing North American manufacturer of commercial and industrial LED lighting. The company is building its team in Argentina and is looking for a Product & Procurement Manager to own how its products are defined, sourced and delivered.
About the role You’ll connect the company’s overseas suppliers with its internal teams (sales, engineering, project management, logistics and finance). Your job is to make sure every product arrives on spec, on budget and on time. You’ll work with factories in Asia, so you’ll sometimes need to follow up outside regular hours.
What you’ll do
Product

• Set up and maintain SKUs, specifications and product data in the ERP

• Manage sample and material requests from start to finish

• Coordinate custom shop drawings and revisions with engineering and suppliers

Sourcing & supply

• Find, assess and onboard new suppliers

• Negotiate pricing, terms, MOQs and lead times

• Issue purchase orders and follow each one through production and delivery

• Plan container shipments with forwarders and customs brokers, tracking landed costs, duties and tariffs

• Monitor inventory and forecast demand, balancing product availability against cash flow

Quality & compliance

• Coordinate pre-shipment and arrival inspections, and follow up on corrective actions with suppliers

• Run supplier audits and keep certifications (UL/cUL, ETL, DLC) and compliance records up to date

Reporting & coordination

• Share regular updates on orders, lead times, inventory, costs and supplier performance

• Flag delays, shortages or defects early, and bring options for solving them

• Keep records organized and help build processes as the company scales

What we’re looking for

• 3+ years in procurement, product management or supply chain, ideally in lighting, electrical or manufacturing

• Hands-on experience buying from overseas suppliers and managing container imports (Asia is a strong plus)

• Comfortable with LED product specs and reading shop drawings

• Knowledge of import/export, customs and US/Canada logistics

• Strong negotiation and cost-control skills

• Background in quality control, supplier audits or vendor compliance

• ERP/MRP experience (Odoo a plus) and advanced Excel

• Fluent English; French is a plus

You’ll thrive here if you

• Negotiate firmly while keeping supplier relationships healthy

• Notice when a spec, price or date doesn’t add up

• Raise issues early and bring solutions with them

• Enjoy fast-paced, growing environments

Work arrangement

• Contract Type: Independent contractor | Monthly Salary | USD Payment.

• 2 weeks of paid vacation.

• Canadian (Quebec) public holidays.

• Work Schedule: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM.

En Find Bandit creemos que una buena experiencia comienza con procesos honestos y bien comunicados. Por eso, buscamos generar vínculos de largo plazo, cuidando tanto a las personas como a las empresas con las que trabajamos. Nos interesa que cada incorporación sea una decisión consciente, sostenible y positiva para ambas partes.

• Coordinar las actividades diarias del área, distribuyendo tareas y definiendo responsabilidades dentro del equipo.

• Atender consultas y situaciones del personal de planta, manteniendo una comunicación clara, firme y respetuosa.

• Revisar las liquidaciones de haberes realizadas por el estudio contable, detectar inconsistencias y coordinar su corrección.

• Asegurar la continuidad y organización del área durante la licencia por maternidad de la Jefa de Recursos Humanos.

Requisitos:

• Formación en Recursos Humanos, Relaciones Laborales o carreras afines, o trayectoria equivalente en el área.

• Al menos cinco años de experiencia en Recursos Humanos.

• Experiencia coordinando equipos de al menos dos personas.

• Conocimientos de legislación laboral argentina y sus actualizaciones.

• Conocimientos de liquidación de haberes suficientes para revisar y validar el trabajo del estudio contable. No se requiere realizar la liquidación.

• Capacidad para delegar, supervisar y trabajar en equipo.

• Comunicación asertiva, iniciativa y buen manejo de las relaciones interpersonales.

• Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión, gestionar prioridades y resolver situaciones con criterio.

• Disponibilidad para trabajar de manera presencial en Garín.

• No se requiere inglés.

Beneficios
• Posición permanente.

• Jornada presencial en Garín, Zona Norte de lunes a viernes, de 9:00 a 18:00.

• Cobertura médica de primera linea

postings.title: Gerente/a de Recursos Humanos para Institución de Salud - La Plata
postings.descriptionText:
En CUBI HR Capacidad de Conectar® nos encontramos acompañando a IMAR , un instituto de referencia en salud comprometido con la excelencia en la atención y el desarrollo profesional de su equipo, en la búsqueda de su próximo/a Gerente/a de Recursos Humanos en La Plata .
Buscamos un/a profesional con experiencia en gestión estratégica de Recursos Humanos, liderazgo de equipos y desarrollo organizacional, capaz de impulsar el talento y fortalecer la cultura institucional.

¿Cuál será el desafío?
Liderar integralmente la gestión de Recursos Humanos, alineando las políticas y los procesos del área con la estrategia institucional de IMAR. Promover el desarrollo de las personas, fortalecer el clima laboral y acompañar el crecimiento de la organización a través de una gestión eficiente, estratégica y orientada a la mejora continua.

Te contamos algunas de las principales responsabilidades:

• Diseñar, implementar y supervisar políticas y procedimientos de Recursos Humanos alineados con la estrategia institucional y la normativa laboral vigente.

• Gestionar los procesos de reclutamiento, selección, inducción y retención del talento.

• Supervisar la administración de personal, asegurando el cumplimiento de las obligaciones legales y laborales.

• Liderar programas de capacitación, desarrollo profesional y evaluación de desempeño.

• Promover la comunicación interna y fortalecer la cultura organizacional.

• Analizar indicadores de gestión, costos, productividad y clima laboral, impulsando mejoras y planes de acción.

• Liderar y acompañar al equipo de Recursos Humanos, promoviendo la eficiencia y la mejora continua.

• Asesorar a la Gerencia en materia laboral, estratégica y organizacional.

Requisitos:
Lo que buscamos:

• Título universitario en Recursos Humanos, Administración, Relaciones del Trabajo, Relaciones Laborales, Psicología y/o carreras afines ( excluyente ).

• Experiencia mínima de 5 años en posiciones de gestión de Recursos Humanos, preferentemente en instituciones de salud.

• Experiencia liderando equipos de RRHH y proyectos estratégicos.

• Manejo de herramientas digitales de gestión de personal.

• Residencia en La Plata y alrededores ( excluyente ).

Valoramos especialmente:

• Liderazgo y capacidad para motivar y desarrollar equipos.

• Planificación estratégica y visión de desarrollo organizacional.

• Comunicación efectiva y habilidades para la gestión de conflictos.

• Capacidad analítica y toma de decisiones basada en datos.

• Conocimiento actualizado de legislación laboral y buenas prácticas de Recursos Humanos.

Jornada laboral: Disponibilidad para trabajar en modalidad presencial full time, de Lunes a Viernes en La Plata.

postings.descriptionText:
¡Esta propuesta te puede interesar!

Generalista de Recursos Humanos

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Generalista de Recursos Humanos para sumarse al equipo de una importante empresa del rubro de logística.

Principales Responsabilidades:

•
Relación con el cliente: Desarrollar una relación duradera con el/la cliente y resaltar constantemente el valor agregado del servicio.

•
Planificación: Participar en reuniones de planificación y ejecutar el plan de acción definido para el/la cliente.

•
Acompañamiento operativo: Acompañar a los/as colaboradores/as del/de la cliente en la operación diaria.

•
Atracción de talento: Llevar a cabo los procesos de reclutamiento y selección de personal.

•
Gestión administrativa: Ejecutar tareas administrativas relativas al/a la cliente y a los/as trabajadores/as, manteniendo a ambas partes informadas sobre los procedimientos a seguir.

•
Liquidación de haberes: Brindar apoyo en la gestión y liquidación de sueldos.

¿Qué buscamos?

•
Formación: Técnicos/as o licenciados/as graduados/as en carreras afines (Administración de Empresas, Recursos Humanos, Psicología, etc.) (excluyente).

•
Experiencia en selección: Experiencia comprobable en procesos de reclutamiento y selección de perfiles (excluyente).

•
Experiencia en nómina: Experiencia en gestión de nómina y liquidación de sueldos (excluyente).

•
Gestión de personas: Experiencia en gestión y contacto constante con colaboradores/as (excluyente).

•
Conocimiento del rubro: Experiencia previa en el rubro de logística y gestionando perfiles operativos (excluyente).

•
Competencias clave: Actitud proactiva, orientación a resultados, vocación de servicio y adaptabilidad a los cambios.

Condiciones de Contratación y Ubicación:

•
Ubicación: Buenos Aires.

•
Modalidad de trabajo: Híbrida (esquema 3x2: 3 días presenciales en oficinas/planta del/de la cliente y 2 días remotos).

•
Jornada laboral: Lunes a jueves de 09:00 a 18:00 hs.

Si consideras que reunís los requisitos para el puesto y te gustan los desafíos, no lo dudes…. ¡Postulate!

Sobre Randstad

En Randstad nos moviliza ayudar a las personas y a las organizaciones a desarrollar todo su potencial. Ese es el compromiso que asumimos como compañía en todo el mundo, un compromiso que nos impulsa a ir más allá para lograr que nuestros clientes y candidatos alcance n el éxito. ¿Cómo lo hacemos?, combinando nuestra pasión por las personas con el poder de la tecnología, creando experienci as más humanas, que nos permitan ser una fuente de inspiración y apoyo para quienes nos eligen. Porque estamos convencidos de que mejores personas hacen mejores empresas.

postings.title: Responsable Comercial y Ventas (Logística y Transporte)
postings.descriptionText:
Título del puesto: Responsable Comercial y Ventas (Logística y Transporte)
Reporta a: Gerencia General / Director de la Empresa
Tipo de jornada: Completa (presencial/campo)
Objetivo del puesto
Desarrollar y ejecutar la estrategia comercial de la empresa para captar nuevos clientes, fidelizar la cartera actual y optimizar la ocupación de la flota de camiones (refrigerados, congelados y secos). El objetivo principal es generar acuerdos a mediano y largo plazo con dadores de carga de alta exigencia, maximizando la rentabilidad de las rutas operadas por la compañía.
Principales responsabilidades y tareas

• Gestión Comercial y Captación de Clientes

• Identificar y prospeccionar activamente nuevos clientes potenciales dentro de los sectores clave (industria alimenticia, cárnica, láctea, pesquera, retail/supermercados, farmacéutica y consumo masivo).

• Relevar las necesidades logísticas de los prospectos (volumen, frecuencia de viajes, rutas, requerimientos de temperatura y ventanas horarias).

• Elaborar, presentar y defender propuestas técnico-comerciales y cotizaciones de servicios de transporte.

• Negociación y Cierre de Acuerdos

• Liderar las negociaciones de tarifas, condiciones de pago, contratos de servicio y penalizaciones (SLAs) con los clientes.

• Diseñar estrategias de precios adaptadas al tipo de carga (seco vs. frío) y a las fluctuaciones del mercado de transporte (costo del combustible, estacionalidad, kilómetros en vacío).

• Coordinar con la Gerencia la viabilidad operativa y financiera de los contratos de gran envergadura antes del cierre.

• Fidelización y Gestión de Cuentas (Key Account Management)

• Actuar como el canal principal de comunicación con las cuentas clave de la empresa, garantizando altos niveles de satisfacción.

• Realizar reuniones periódicas de seguimiento con los clientes para evaluar la calidad del servicio e identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio.

• Gestionar y resolver reclamos comerciales complejos en conjunto con el área de Operaciones y Tráfico.

• Análisis de Mercado y Reportes

• Monitorear las acciones de la competencia, tarifas de referencia del mercado (por ej., CATAC / FADEEAC) y tendencias logísticas del sector multitemperatura.

• Elaborar informes de gestión comercial, embudo de ventas, proyecciones de facturación y kpis de rendimiento del área para la Gerencia.

Requisitos del perfil
Formación y experiencia

• Profesional graduado o estudiante avanzado en Comercialización, Marketing, Logística, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines (deseable).

• Experiencia comprobable mínima de 3 a 5 años en ventas B2B, preferentemente comercializando servicios de transporte de carga pesada, logística de frío o servicios corporativos de cadena de suministro.

• Red de contactos previa en el sector de dadores de carga alimenticios o farmacéuticos (altamente valorado).

Conocimientos técnicos requeridos

• Comprensión sólida de la estructura de costos del transporte (costos fijos, variables, kilómetros, peajes, incidencias del frío).

• Conocimiento práctico de normativas básicas de transporte de alimentos (SENASA, Código Alimentario Argentino) para poder argumentar el valor de la flota frente al cliente.

• Manejo intermedio/avanzado de herramientas de oficina (Excel para presupuestos) y sistemas CRM de gestión de ventas.

Competencias y habilidades

• Marcado perfil comercial, proactivo y orientado a resultados basados en objetivos.

• Excelentes habilidades de negociación, comunicación persuasiva y relaciones interpersonales.

• Capacidad para comprender problemas logísticos y proponer soluciones creativas (optimización de retornos vacíos, viajes combinados).

Requisitos adicionales

• Movilidad propia y licencia de conducir vigente (excluyente para visitas presenciales a plantas y oficinas de clientes).

• Disponibilidad para viajar al interior del país en caso de que las cuentas o rutas lo requieran.

postings.title: Brand Marketing Manager - Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
Local Brand Marketing Manager – Argentina | Ironside Fitness

Ironside Fitness es una compañía de equipamiento fitness con marca propia, presente en Chile, México, Argentina y Perú, y en plena expansión a Brasil y Estados Unidos. Diseñamos, importamos y comercializamos soluciones para gimnasios, boxes, estudios y usuarios finales, y crecemos a un ritmo acelerado año tras año.
Buscamos a la persona que liderará la marca Ironside en Argentina y la convertirá en la referencia del equipamiento fitness en el país.

EL ROL
Serás responsable de generar demanda medible para nuestros canales B2B (gimnasios, boxes, estudios y proyectos corporativos) y B2C (ecommerce y showroom), administrando el presupuesto de marketing en función de su retorno. Reportarás al VP de Marketing y trabajarás en coordinación directa con el equipo comercial de Argentina.

RESPONSABILIDADES
Demanda y performance

• Generar leads B2B calificados para el equipo comercial y tráfico con conversión para el ecommerce.

• Gestionar campañas en Meta, Google y otros canales, con responsabilidad directa sobre CAC, ROAS y costo por lead.

• Coordinar con ventas el ciclo completo del lead, desde la captura hasta el cierre.

•
Marca y posicionamiento

• Adaptar la estrategia global de marca y de las submarcas Ironside al mercado argentino.

• Ejecutar y medir la estrategia de medios offline y OOH en Buenos Aires.

• Desarrollar la comunidad local de atletas, coaches, influencers y dueños de gimnasios.

Showroom y activaciones

• Convertir el showroom de Recoleta en un motor comercial mediante eventos, lanzamientos y demostraciones.

• Planificar y ejecutar la presencia de Ironside en ferias, competencias y eventos de la industria.

Gestión

• Administrar agencias y proveedores locales.

• Reportar semanalmente los KPIs de marketing y ajustar la inversión según los resultados y el contexto económico.

QUÉ ESPERAMOS EN LOS PRIMEROS 12 MESES

• Un plan de marketing con presupuesto asignado por canal y retorno esperado.

• Un tablero de KPIs semanal compartido con el equipo comercial.

• Crecimiento sostenido de leads B2B calificados y de venta ecommerce.

• Un calendario anual de activaciones con retorno medible.

REQUISITOS

• 2 o más años de experiencia en marketing, con al menos 2 a cargo de una marca o mercado con responsabilidad sobre resultados.

• Experiencia administrando presupuestos de marketing relevantes.

• Manejo personal de Meta Ads, Google Ads y GA4 o herramientas equivalentes.

• Experiencia generando leads B2B para equipos de venta.

• Experiencia gestionando agencias y proveedores externos.

• Conocimiento del mercado argentino y de la gestión de presupuestos en contexto inflacionario.

Valoraremos

• Experiencia en fitness, deporte, retail o consumo masivo.

• Experiencia en empresas de alto crecimiento.

• Experiencia en eventos, activaciones y trabajo con influencers o atletas con KPIs medibles.

• Experiencia adaptando estrategias regionales o globales al mercado local.

LO QUE OFRECEMOS

• Liderar la marca en un mercado clave para una compañía en expansión internacional.

• Remuneración competitiva con componente variable ligado a resultados.

• Autonomía real y acceso directo a la dirección de la compañía.

• Un entorno exigente, orientado a resultados y con alta velocidad de ejecución.

CONDICIONES

• Jornada completa presencial, de lunes a viernes de 09:00 a 13:00 y de 14:00 a 18:00.

• Lugar de trabajo: showroom y oficinas Ironside, Av. Santa Fe 1644, Recoleta, Buenos Aires.

Si generas resultados medibles y quieres construir una marca líder, postula y responde las preguntas de selección.
