postings.title: Growth Marketing Manager
postings.descriptionText:
About The Role

You'll own lifecycle marketing at Optery end-to-end: email, in-app messaging, and push notifications across the full customer journey. This includes onboarding, activation, engagement, upgrade/cross-sell, renewal, churn prevention, and win-back. This is a senior IC role with full ownership of strategy and execution: you'll design the journeys, build the campaigns, write (or direct) the copy, run the experiments, and report on the results.

What You'll Do

• Own the lifecycle marketing roadmap: map the customer journey and identify the highest-impact opportunities across activation, conversion, retention, and expansion

• Build, launch, and iterate on automated campaigns and triggered flows in our marketing automation platform (we use Customer.io; equivalents include Iterable, Braze, or Klaviyo)

• Own in-app messaging and transactional-adjacent communications in partnership with product and engineering

• Build and optimize mobile push notification strategy: permission opt-in flows, triggered and campaign-based pushes, frequency capping, and coordination with email so channels complement rather than compete

• Develop segmentation and personalization strategies using behavioral and account data, including dynamic templating and conditional content logic

• Run a disciplined experimentation program: A/B tests on sequences, subject lines, timing, and offers, with clear holdouts and measurement

• Manage email deliverability, list hygiene, and suppression strategy to protect sender reputation

• Partner with analytics to instrument and measure lifecycle performance (we use Amplitude and connect campaigns to revenue outcomes

• Collaborate with paid acquisition, product, and support teams so messaging is coordinated across the entire customer experience

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of significant hands-on experience owning lifecycle, CRM, retention, or email marketing programs, ideally for a subscription-based service.

• Fluency in a modern marketing automation platform (e.g., Customer.io, Iterable, Braze, Klaviyo) including segmentation, triggered workflows, and templating languages like Liquid

• Strong copy instincts: you can write clear, persuasive messaging and know when to test rather than debate

• Comfort with data: you can define your own metrics, pull your own reports, and interpret results honestly (SQL and product analytics experience are a plus)

• Understanding of email deliverability fundamentals and compliance (CAN-SPAM, GDPR/CCPA basics)

• Experienced with AI and actively leveraging it in your current workflows

• A builder's mindset: you're energized by owning a function, not just executing tickets

• Bonus: experience in privacy, security, or consumer subscription products; experience with both B2C and B2B messaging

Location

While Optery is a fully-remote global team, this position is based in the United States and is required to work regular U.S. business hours, i.e. in the U.S. Eastern, Central, Mountain, and/or Pacific time zones.

Compensation & Benefits

• Base salary: $80K - $90K

• Great health, dental, and vision insurance

• 401k program with employer match

• Paid time off policy

Equal Opportunity

Optery values diversity and is an equal opportunity employer. Optery does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factor.

postings.title: Inside Sales Representative
postings.descriptionText:
Job Overview
We are seeking a results-driven Bilingual Inside Sales Representative (Home Services) to recover open estimate opportunities and drive revenue. In this role, you will manage an assigned pipeline of pending replacement and repair estimates, proactively contacting past customers to uncover objections and present value. You will handle concerns, discuss approved financing options, and close sales while maintaining accurate CRM records.

Salary Range: 1200usd to 1275usd.

Schedule: Remote, Full Time | Mon-Fri, 8 AM - 5 PM PST with some rotation on weekends (40 hrs. per week). with occasional weekend rotations.

Responsibilities

• Manage open estimates: Review assigned opportunities, previous conversations, technician or salesperson notes, pricing, and proposed work before contacting customers.

• Conduct outbound sales follow-up: Proactively call customers with outstanding estimates and maintain a structured follow-up cadence using approved phone, email, and text channels.

• Identify the actual objection: Determine whether the customer’s hesitation involves price, timing, financing, competing proposals, unanswered questions, or confidence in the proposed solution.

• Explain value clearly: Help customers understand the benefits of the proposed work, approved options, warranties, and available promotions without making unsupported technical claims.

• Handle objections and close: Respond confidently to concerns, guide the conversation toward a decision, and directly ask for the sale when appropriate.

• Present approved financing options: Explain available financing programs using company-approved information, without promising approval or unapproved terms.

• Stay within pricing authority: Follow established pricing and discount guidelines. Any exception must receive approval before being offered to the customer.

• Coordinate sold work: Ensure accepted estimates are accurately documented and handed off to the appropriate scheduling, dispatch, sales, or installation coordination team.

• Maintain accurate records: Document every meaningful interaction, objection, commitment, follow-up date, and sales outcome in the company’s CRM.

• Own the pipeline: Keep every active opportunity assigned a clear next step. Close out opportunities accurately when the customer declines or the opportunity is no longer viable.

• Escalate appropriately: Recognize when technical questions, customer concerns, or pricing exceptions require assistance, while independently handling routine sales conversations.

• Protect the customer experience: Remain professional, respect contact preferences, and avoid pressure tactics or promises the company cannot fulfill.

Requirements

• Exceptional spoken and written English: Candidates must be easy to understand, communicate naturally, use accurate grammar, and explain information without repeated clarification. This needs to be demonstrated in a live conversation.

• Must be based in or near the client's timezone for work schedule alignment

• Proven phone sales experience: A demonstrated background in inside sales, outbound sales, estimate follow-up, retention, or another role requiring objection handling and closing.

• Evidence of results: Candidates should be able to explain their previous sales goals, conversion performance, sales volume, and personal contribution to results.

• Strong listening skills: Ability to uncover the customer’s concern and respond thoughtfully instead of relying entirely on a script.

• Confidence asking for the sale: Comfortable discussing price, handling rejection, and requesting a clear purchasing decision.

• Organization and persistence: Ability to manage multiple opportunities, prioritize follow-ups, and maintain accurate records without constant reminders.

• Independent remote work habits: Reliable attendance, consistent availability during assigned hours, and the ability to remain productive without continuous supervision.

• Technology proficiency: Comfortable using CRM systems, phone platforms, email, and multiple applications during a customer conversation.

• Suitable remote workspace: Reliable internet, a quiet and professional environment, and a quality headset for clear customer calls.

• Relevant industry experience: HVAC, plumbing, construction, home improvement, or other home-services sales experience is strongly preferred.

Independent Contractor Perks

• Permanent work from home

• Immediate hiring

• Health Insurance Coverage

• Performance-based monthly bonus ranging from $500 to $2,000 USD based on qualifying rehash sales.

Note
Please click the "Apply" button to complete your application, including the assessment questions, technical check, and voice recording. Your hourly pay rate will be established based on your performance in the application process; submissions with all requirements fulfilled will receive priority review.

One application, multiple possibilities: When you apply, our team reviews your background against all current openings, not just this one! If a different role fits your skills, we'll get in touch! We also encourage you to keep exploring our job board and apply directly to any position that excites you.

https://www.linkedin.com/redir/suspicious-page?url=Tixta%2ecom is a Miami-based tech company helping 3,000+ doctors dominate Instagram and TikTok with AI-powered content.

Why work with us:

• $300+ for every meeting that shows. This is commission only, with one of the highest per-meeting payouts in the industry.

• All of our current openers book 10-40 shows per month and make $50K–$150K per year.

• You could (and should) be booking a few shows per day.

• No waiting on someone else to close. You get paid when your meeting shows up, so your income is 100% in your hands.

• Learn from the best, if you’re smart and hardworking, we’ll devote our time to teaching you how to make money NOW. Daily live coaching over Zoom plus analysis of your actual calls.

• Fast progression, management and closer paths open quickly for the right candidates.

• You’ll never dial a junk list. Our data engine verifies every lead: real doctors, real practices, real direct cell phones. That’s the job.

•

What you’ll do:

• Hit 200-300 dials + 80 live decision-makers daily

• Book qualified appointments with surgeons and practice owners

• Handle objections like a pro

• Show up camera-on for daily team huddles and coaching sessions

DO NOT apply if:

• You don’t have fluent, business-level English for high-stakes sales calls.

• You need a base salary to feel safe. This is commission only, $300+ per meeting show , If you bet on yourself, the upside is unlimited.

• You can’t be logged in, camera-on, and dialing by 9am EST every morning. Remote doesn’t mean flexible hours.

• You don’t have a quiet workspace, a reliable high-speed internet connection, and a quality headset.

We want you if:

• You are serious about making $150K+ this year

• You’re self-driven and don’t need a manager standing over you to hit your numbers

• You’re hungry for success and want to be surrounded by winners who make you better every single day

• You bring energy that comes through the phone and the screen

• You like to underpromise and over-deliver

Experience is a plus, however, we will take a hungry rookie who’s eager to learn over a tired “veteran” every day of the week.

Outbound experience (SDR/BDR/Appointment Setter) helps, but if you’re smart, coachable, and relentless, we’ll teach you the rest.

Culture is everything for us.

Comp & structure:
$50K–$150K+ OTE
$300+ per meeting that shows, plus accelerators and performance spiffs for top bookers

Remote. Mon–Fri 9am–6pm EST, weekends off.

We’re looking for someone who is motivated to keep learning and developing. You don’t need to know every brand inside out but you should be curious, open to feedback, and willing to step outside your comfort zone. That could be demonstrating products, supporting in-store events, or speaking to small groups.
You’ll also bring a positive, team-focused mindset and the adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where every day is different.
What You’ll Gain
This is more than a job it’s an experience that builds both your confidence and your career.

El rol Buscamos a alguien que lidere la estrategia de caja de un grupo con operaciones en varios países y monedas. Vas a reportar a la Head of Finance & Administration y vas a tener impacto directo en cómo se fondea y crece Filadd: vas a definir el plan de fondeo regional, tomar decisiones de tipo de cambio y negociar con bancos, checkouts y procesadores.
Vas a trabajar en un equipo de Finanzas que ya usa IA y automatizaciones en producción. Tu rol va a ser mejorarlas e implementar nuevas. Valoramos a quien analiza con autonomía, arma alternativas y llega con una recomendación clara.

• Caja y fondeo: mantener el cashflow consolidado, seguir su ejecución cada semana, anticipar faltantes y gestionar el plan de fondeo regional.

• Partners financieros: negociar comisiones, retenciones y plazos de liberación, y gestionar reclamos ante bancos y procesadores.

• IA y automatización: validar los resultados de la IA, ajustar reglas, supervisar las automatizaciones y priorizar mejoras según su impacto en caja.

• Experiencia sólida en Tesorería y Cash Management, con cashflow, fondeo y saldos en distintas monedas.

• Experiencia tomando decisiones de tipo de cambio.

• Negociaciones con bancos o procesadores, con resultados que puedas mostrar con números.

• Experiencia diseñando controles de pagos.

Buenos Aires

DRIVING CONNECTIVITY

Chart your Course with PIL

With over 55 years of leadership in the global shipping industry, Pacific International Lines (PIL) is looking for proactive individuals to drive innovation and sustainable shipping solutions. The Accountant will be responsible for ensuring full accuracy, integrity, and regulatory compliance of accounting, tax, statutory reporting, payroll obligations, and HQ reporting for the country.

Key Responsabilities

• Financial Accounting & Reporting

• Maintain statutory accounting.

• Ensure accurate reconciliation of: Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Payroll & social security accruals.

• Fixed Assets & Depreciation

• Banks, suspense, and clearing accounts

• Prepare annual statutory financial statements, including Notes to the Financial Statements.

• Prepare and submit all consolidation of Monthly reporting to HQ using Oracle GFS / FCCS within Day +5 deadline.

• Ensure proper application of exchange rate rules for financial reporting

• Taxation & Regulatory Compliance

• Guarantee full compliance with national tax requirements

• Coordinate with tax advisors, regional Tax, and HQ Tax on fiscal interpretations and compliance.

• Transfer Pricing (TP) & Intercompany

• Validate intercompany charges, shared services, management fees, and Cost Plus margins.

• Coordinate with external TP advisors and HQ Tax to ensure alignment with Group policy.

• Audit & Assurance (External & Internal)

• Lead annual external audit and statutory review processes.

• Ensure full audit readiness: reconciliations, supporting documents, tax files, and control evidence.

• Coordinate internal audit visits (LARO / HQ) and follow up on audit findings.

• Internal Controls & Governance

• Maintain a robust internal control environment aligned with regional and HQ Internal Audit.

• Enforce segregation of duties and HQ Delegation of Authority (DoA).

• Ensure strict compliance with Group policies: No CSR – No Payment

• Vendor onboarding & procurement rules

• Cash and treasury controls

• Documentation and retention rules

• Monitor and assess quality of deliverables from outsourcing providers (if applicable).

• Treasury, Banking & Intercompany/ASA Oversight

• Oversee daily bank reconciliations and ensure alignment with balances.

• Manage local banking relationships, ensuring compliance with dual-approval schemes.

postings.descriptionText:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

Business Operations Specialist, Inventory, Data Automation

About The Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and execution-oriented Business Operations Specialist to support a fast-paced and complex technology services operation.

This position will own and continuously improve critical processes across inventory control, DSA management, system and process mapping, logistics operations, and operational reporting, while expanding the role's capabilities in data analytics, automation, and project management.

The successful candidate will act as a bridge between logistics operations, systems, data, and business stakeholders, transforming operational data into actionable insights, identifying process gaps, driving automation opportunities, and leading cross-functional improvement initiatives.

The role requires a strong combination of hands-on logistics expertise and analytical/problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver results in a dynamic technology environment.

This position is hybrid based in MTY or Lima PE

What You’ll Do

• Inventory Control Operational Governance

• Own and support inventory control processes, ensuring inventory accuracy, system integrity, and operational compliance.

• Monitor inventory performance, aging, discrepancies, adjustments, and reconciliation activities.

• Identify inventory risks and drive corrective and preventive actions with operational teams.

• Develop and maintain operational controls to reduce inventory discrepancies, losses, and process failures.

• Support cycle counts, physical inventory activities, root-cause analysis, and inventory audits.

• Partner with warehouse/FSL, transportation, planning, finance, and service teams to resolve inventory-related issues.

• Monitor key operational KPIs and proactively escalate risks requiring leadership attention.

• System Process Mapping

• Own and maintain end-to-end system and process maps for critical logistics processes.

• Document system interactions, transactions, data flows, handoffs, dependencies, and operational controls.

• Identify system gaps, duplicate activities, manual processes, and control weaknesses.

• Translate operational requirements into clear business and system requirements.

• Support implementation and testing of system enhancements.

• Create and maintain SOPs, process flows, work instructions, and operational documentation.

• Data Analytics Business Insights

• Analyze large and complex operational datasets to identify trends, risks, exceptions, and performance opportunities.

• Develop operational dashboards, scorecards, and management reports.

• Establish metrics that provide visibility into areas such as: Inventory accuracy Inventory aging SLA performance Operational exceptions Logistics cycle time Transportation performance Reverse logistics Cost and productivity

• Perform root-cause analysis using data and recommend corrective actions.

• Translate detailed operational data into clear business insights and executive-level recommendations.

• Build mechanisms for proactive exception identification rather than reactive issue management.

• Automation Digital Transformation

• Identify repetitive/manual processes that can be simplified or automated.

• Develop or coordinate automation solutions for operational reporting, reconciliations, exception management, and process controls.

• Improve the reliability, scalability, and speed of operational reporting.

• Partner with IT, system teams, and operational stakeholders to implement digital solutions.

• Promote a continuous-improvement and automation-first mindset within the operation.

• Track automation benefits, including hours saved, error reduction, improved controls, and productivity gains.

• Project Continuous Improvement Management

• Lead small-to-medium operational improvement projects from problem identification through implementation and stabilization.

• Develop project plans, milestones, owners, risks, and action trackers.

• Coordinate activities across internal teams, logistics partners, vendors, and other stakeholders.

• Use structured problem-solving methodologies to address complex operational issues.

• Measure project benefits and ensure improvements are sustained after implementation.

• Support new product, service, system, and logistics-process implementations.

• Logistics Operations Expertise

• Act as a subject-matter specialist for logistics processes covering forward and reverse logistics, warehousing/FSL operations, inventory, transportation, and service-parts operations.

• Analyze operational bottlenecks and develop scalable solutions.

• Support logistics-provider performance management and operational reviews.

• Ensure effective coordination across warehouse, transportation, service delivery, and customer-facing operations.

• Provide recommendations balancing service level, cost, operational risk, control, and customer experience

Requirements

Mandatory: (skills that the candidate needs to have to be successful in the role)

3+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Logistics, or Services Operations

Strong data analytics and problem-solving skills, including KPI analysis, root-cause identification, and actionable insights

Experience in process improvement and project management, with the ability to independently drive initiatives through completion

Experience with process automation tools , such as Power Automate, RPA, or similar technologies

Nice to have ( skills that are not mandatory)

Familiarity with AI/GenAI applications for operational efficiency and process improvement

Experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, or other data analytics/visualization tools

Experience with systems/process mapping and global or multi-country supply chain operations

Personal Qualifications

• Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, as the working language.

• Strong sense of responsibility, and a collaborative spirit with excellent communication skills.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.

Company: CNGR Advanced Materials
Industry: Mining / Energy — Large-scale remote industrial project
Location: Jama & Olaroz, Jujuy Province, Argentina
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports to: Operations Manager / Camp Manager

About the Program
CNGR is a global leader in battery materials, building an integrated value chain from lithium resources to batteries. In Argentina, our Jama-Solaroz project in the Puna of Jujuy is central to that vision.
Our Young Graduate Program is for recent graduates (within the last 12 months) who want to start their careers in mining and energy-transition projects.
Participants join one of two tracks: Operations or Environment, Health, Safety & Security (EHSS) . They learn through hands-on experience, rotations across sites and close mentoring from experienced professionals. The goal is to develop the skills needed to take ownership of a specific area or module, and to grow from there into an Analyst or Engineer role.

This is a Junior Role
The position is designed for professionals in the early stages of their career. You will work under the guidance of your Operations or EHSS Manager or Supervisor, take on more autonomy over time and receive continuous training. We value your willingness to learn more than your previous experience.

Key Responsibilities
Operations Track

• Support the administration, maintenance and operation of Jama Camp and Jama Pilot Plant.

• Help coordinate operational tasks across the Jama Project, working with CNGR departments and contractors.

• Monitor fuel consumption and request fuel supplies for project operations.

• Support the supervision, coordination and control of camp services: maintenance, laundry, cleaning, catering, water truck and other services.

• Record service consumption data in the company database and help track key operational indicators.

EHSS Track

• Rotate across administrative offices and operational sites, including laboratories, warehouses and mining projects, to learn the company’s EHSS management system.

• Take part in basic inspections, hazard identification, and risk assessment and control activities.

• Collect, analyze and track EHSS data, indicators and documentation.

• Support document management, follow-up on corrective actions and maintenance of the EHSS management system.

• Build working knowledge of Argentine regulations and internal procedures on occupational health and safety, the environment and asset security.

Qualifications

• Recent graduate (within the last 12 months) in Industrial, Mining, Chemical, Environmental, Mechanical or Civil Engineering; Occupational Health & Safety; Environmental Sciences; Business Administration; or related fields.

• Up to 1 year of professional experience. Internships in mining, energy or industrial settings are a plus.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel. Experience with databases or management systems is a plus.

• Intermediate English. Chinese is a plus.

Skills & Attributes

• Strong willingness to learn and adapt.

• Organized, detail-oriented and data-driven.

• Teamwork and good communication with internal teams and contractors.

• Proactive problem-solving and a sense of ownership.

• Commitment to safety, sustainability and responsible development.

• Interest in mining, lithium and the energy transition.

Special Requirements

• Availability to work on a roster schedule at the Jama Project site, at high altitude (over 4,000 m above sea level) in the Puna region of Jujuy.

• Ability to pass a pre-employment medical exam, including high-altitude fitness.

• Availability to travel and rotate between sites and offices.

• Residence in Jujuy

Compensation & Benefits

• Gross monthly salary: ARS 2.050.000

• Private health insurance: OSDE 210

• Hands-on training, mentoring and a structured development path within a global battery materials company.

postings.title: Fraud Operations Analyst (Argentina)
postings.descriptionText:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Shopper Risk Fraud Operations analyst who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. As part of optimizing the online shopping experience, Sezzle constantly monitors users and transactions for abusive or fraudulent behavior. Our Fraud Operations team reviews suspicious activity flagged by Sezzle’s fraud detection system or escalated from Customer Support agents. Fraud Operations Analysts will block users deemed fraudulent or risky, and clear false positive flags from our automated systems and support agents. We monitor for new trends in fraudulent behavior and continuously evolve our policies and procedures to stay one step ahead. We are looking for a teammate who can work one of the shifts listed below full-time:

• Monday -Friday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm - local time (Central time zone).

This will be a non-exempt/hourly position. Due to the requirements of the position, only English resumes will be accepted.

Compensation:

For this Fraud Operations Analyst the compensation range is $1,500 - $2,000 USD GROSS per month as a contractor. This range is designed to reflect the skills, experience, and value brought to the team, ensuring competitive and fair pay within the industry.

What You'll Do:

• Monitor real-time transactions and other customer behaviors flagged for fraud and abuse for manual review.

• Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to determine if the transactions are fraudulent or not.

• Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis.

• Research fraud and user behavior to contribute to machine learning models, rules and other detection systems.

• Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our fraud prevention mechanisms, processes and tools.

• Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies.

• Maintain or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for timely resolution of queued cases to minimize potential losses.

• Handle escalations from internal and external stakeholders in a professional and efficient manner.

What We Look For:

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution

• Minimum 1 year of experience in investigating and resolving fraud incidents

• Experienced in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment

• Attention to detail and ability to multitask

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills

• Strong business judgment and communication skills

• Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training

• Able to work through holidays

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Qualifications

• Minimum 1 year of experience in investigating and resolving fraud incidents

• Work experience in fintech, payments, lending, banking, or financial institutions is a plus

• Degree in statistics, math, finance, economics, or related quantitative discipline; graduate degree a plus

• Experience in using database query language (e.g. SQL, etc), and data processing and analytics tools such as Python / R / SAS is a plus

• Ideal candidate will be available to start within two weeks following an offer

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

#Full-Time

postings.title: MEP BIM Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are

ENG (engbim.com) is a BIM company that specializes in hands-on, field-focused BIM services. Founded in 2007, we have positioned ourselves as the largest and most experienced BIM production service provider in the United States, having completed 5,000 BIM projects with a dedicated team of over 600 staff members. We provide MEP Modeling, VDC/BIM Management, Laser Scanning, and Scan to BIM services, as well as a comprehensive array of BIM production services to architects, engineers, and owners.

The Role

The BIM Specialist role generally involves covering the modeling of different trades (MEP), depending on your background and expertise, whose extent will depend on the scope of the project (specific zones or entire buildings), and whose quality will go according to clients’ requirements and the services provided by the team you end up joining. This position requires a high level of modeling quality (expertise, technical knowledge, LOD and QAQC capabilities), and more autonomy in its self-management and modeling capabilities (studying whatever's necessary according to each trade). A BIM Specialist saves the client problems, detecting possible conflicts throughout the initial information review and the modeling and coordination phases.

Minimum mandatory requirements include:

• An excellent level of English is an absolute must, both spoken and written . Aspiring candidates must be able to keep up with fluent conversations both with native and non-native speakers. Candidates without this requirement will NOT be considered .

• Solid experience modeling HVAC and plumbing in Revit for commercial, industrial, healthcare, and residential construction . This can include things like process piping , ductwork and sheet metal , and mechanical equipment ( pumps , AHUs , RTUs , chillers and boilers ), and for plumbing, domestic water , sanitary drainage and gray water , stormwater , medical gases , compressed air lines , pumps , heaters and hangers .

• Experience coordinating or clash-detecting through Navisworks (Revizto can also be considered but Navisworks will be prioritized), knowledge of BIM coordination, clash report , QAQC and model accuracy .

• A mechanical or civil engineering bachelors degree (architects could be considered but only if they have extensive experience modeling and coordinating MEP trades themselves).

Specific requirements will vary depending on the position and service. Experience with Level Of Detail (LOD) 400 and projects based in the US , or constructability knowledge related to that country will be a huge differential . Other desirable requirements are:

• Familiarity with BIM add-ins (e.g., Evolve , SysQue , Fabrication Parts ).

• Experience in conceptual design / BIM Design assist.

• AutoCAD Plant 3D knowledge.

• Dynamo/Python knowledge applied to BIM .

• On-site/field experience .

• Ability to produce detailed models, including real-world fittings and connection types .

Please know if you don't have experience working with Revit in formal jobs, it will be hard to consider your profile. Please DON'T apply if you don't have the necessary English level.

Why join us? Explore our amazing benefits! ✨

postings.title: Growth Marketing Operator (Social-First)
postings.descriptionText:
*Job Summary*

JDN Tuition is a fast-growing Australian tutoring company looking for an experienced, proactive, results-driven marketing operator to join our team as a full-time independent contractor.

This isn’t a role for someone who wants a task list. It’s for someone with the drive to achieve growth and meaningful results. You’ll work closely with our Australian team, direct our editors and on-camera tutors, and keep everything moving without needing constant direction. You’ll take ownership of our content and social media from idea to posted, and drive growth across the rest of our marketing: lead generation, campaigns, email, SEO assistance and new launches. You’ll be judged on *results*, not hours.

You’ll work closely with our Australian team to turn creative ideas into engaging content and marketing initiatives, helping us reach more students and tutors while keeping everything moving without needing constant direction.

*Role Details:*

* *Employment type:* Independent contractor, full-time
* *Work arrangement:* Fully remote
* *Working schedule:* Flexible, with agreed overlap with Australian business hours
* *Pay:* Competitive rate negotiable based on experience, skills and portfolio, plus performance bonus tied to results

*Key Responsibilities and Deliverables:*

*1. Content Planning and Creation*

* Own the content strategy for each platform, tailored to its audience (students vs parents).
* Research trends, references and ideas relevant to students, tutors and parents.
* Write scripts, hooks, captions and ad copy that sound human, not AI-generated.
* Develop short-form video concepts, memes and seasonal campaigns, including exam-period content.
* Prepare content briefs, captions and supporting materials for tutor videos, street interviews and other shoots.

*Deliverables:* A consistent pipeline of strong concepts, scripts and briefs, and a clear plan for what’s posting and why.

*2. Video Production and Editor Coordination*

* Brief editors on video requirements, including tutor videos, podcast clips and ads.
* Organise footage, assets and references so editors have everything they need.
* Create and assign tasks, track progress and manage the video pipeline in ClickUp.
* Prioritise the editing queue and make sure every edit matches the brief before it’s scheduled.
* Help coordinate editor sourcing and trials when needed.

*Deliverables:* A video pipeline that never runs dry, with content posting daily.

*3. Social Media Growth and Performance*

* Own organic growth across social channels.
* Support the planning and execution of social media content and advertising campaigns.
* Research and prepare ad concepts that support lead generation.
* Develop campaign content, including educational content, exam preparation themes and tutor-focused promotions.
* Monitor content performance and prepare weekly social media reports.

*Deliverables:* Smooth handoffs between on-the-ground production and the content pipeline, with minimal delays.

*4. Team Coordination*

* Work with our Australian team on shoots, campaigns and priorities.
* Coordinate on shoot plans, scripts and footage requirements.
* Flag delays, missing assets and blockers early, and follow through until resolved.

*Deliverables:* Timely follow-ups, complete content requirements and fewer delays in production.

*5. Lead Generation and Broader Marketing*

* Turn attention into enquiries through ad creative, lead magnets and landing pages.
* Support paid campaigns with concepts and creative.
* Oversee our AI SEO agent, email marketing and website content.
* Drive marketing for new initiatives and launches.

*Deliverables: *A growing flow of enquiries from marketing, tracked to source.

*6. Ownership and Workflow*

* Keep ClickUp tasks, deadlines and statuses accurate and up to date.
* Manage multiple projects and prioritise work based on deadlines and business needs.
* Spot gaps in the workflow and fix them, not just report them.
* Take full ownership of outcomes, from brief to result, with minimal supervision.

*Deliverables:* An organised content pipeline, reliable task completion, and clear visibility of project progress.

*This isn’t for you if:*

* You need to be told what to do next.
* You measure your contribution in hours worked.
* When results dip, your first instinct is to explain why it’s not your fault.

As a Finance Director at CapsLock, you will be responsible for overseeing all financial aspects of the fast-growing marketing business, ensuring accuracy in financial reporting, and providing strategic guidance to support our business goals. postings.title: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
About Tort Experts

At Tort Experts, we are redefining the landscape of performance marketing in the legal sector. Our mission is to democratize access to information for individuals who have been injured, connecting them with law firms that can truly advocate for their rights and achieve successful outcomes. As an innovative, vertically integrated legal case acquisition marketing company, we leverage cutting-edge technology, data-driven insights, and a commitment to transparency to disrupt the status quo.

Joining Tort Experts means becoming part of a dynamic team that is passionate about making a meaningful impact. We foster a collaborative environment where creativity thrives, and every team member plays a vital role in connecting qualified claimants with the representation they deserve. If you’re looking for a workplace where your contributions can truly make a difference, and where innovation meets purpose, Tort Experts is the perfect place for you.

About the role

The CRO Specialist owns the testing and optimization of our direct-response, lead-generation funnels, including landing pages, lead forms, qualification flows, and thank-you pages that receive traffic from paid media across multiple platforms. This person generates split test ideas, maintains a prioritized testing calendar, and sees each test through from concept to build to readout, working closely with our media buying, creative, and dev/tech teams. They focus on conversion rate, cost-per-lead efficiency, and lead quality, not just raw form fills. This is a hands-on, process-driven role focused on experimentation velocity and measurable results.

Location: Remote 9am to 5pm US Eastern.

What you'll do

Test ideation and hypothesis development

Generate a steady flow of split test ideas across headlines, copy angles, layouts, form length and field order, qualification questions, CTAs, trust elements, and page speed.
Use PostHog analytics, session replays, and heatmaps, along with platform data and lead quality feedback, to identify friction points and build clear, data-backed hypotheses.
Research competitor funnels and industry best practices to surface new testing opportunities.
Testing calendar and pipeline management
Own and maintain the split test calendar/pipeline, tracking every test from idea to backlog, build, QA, live, and readout.
Prioritize tests based on expected impact, confidence, and level of effort (e.g., ICE scoring) so the highest-value ideas ship first.
Ensure tests run long enough to reach meaningful sample sizes and avoid overlapping tests that could contaminate results.
Keep a central log of test results and findings so wins are rolled out and losses aren't repeated.
Conversion design
Design every test variant end to end: layout, visual hierarchy, CTAs, color, imagery, form design, and mobile experience.
Produce build-ready designs in Figma or similar design software (e.g., Sketch, Penpot, Framer), using AI design tools to explore options and speed up production.
Hand designs to dev/tech with clear specs: responsive behavior, states, tracking events, and acceptance criteria.
Make design decisions based on evidence (heatmaps, session replays, funnel data, competitor research, past test results), and document the rationale for each.
Keep designs consistent with our brand and claimant audience: clear, trustworthy, accessible, and mobile-first.
Dev/tech coordination and implementation
Write clear test briefs and specs for the dev/tech team, including variant details, success metrics, tracking requirements, and launch dates.
Coordinate build timelines and act as the point of contact between Marketing and dev/tech for all testing and new funnel features.
QA tests and new features before launch, confirming that pages, forms, pixels, UTMs, and lead routing/CRM integrations work correctly on desktop and mobile.
Request and help scope new features or tools that would increase testing speed or conversion performance.
Analysis and reporting
Monitor key metrics including conversion rate, CPL, lead quality/qualification rate, form abandonment, and downstream conversion to signed cases.
Analyze test results with appropriate statistical rigor and deliver clear readouts with a recommendation: roll out, iterate, or kill.
Share weekly testing updates and monthly performance summaries with the Marketing team.
Cross-team collaboration
Partner with media buyers to align landing page tests with ad angles, audiences, and traffic sources.
Provide creative and copy feedback based on what's actually converting.
Work with Intake and Compliance to ensure funnel changes support lead quality and advertising/consent requirements.

Qualifications

3+ years of experience in conversion rate optimization, growth marketing, or performance marketing.
Proven track record of running A/B or multivariate tests and driving measurable lifts in conversion rate or CPL.
Experience optimizing lead-generation funnels is strongly preferred.
Familiarity with PostHog (analytics, experiments/split testing, and session replay) or a comparable platform (e.g., VWO, Optimizely, Convert). Hands-on experience with PostHog is a strong plus.
Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and landing page builders or CMS platforms.
Strong understanding of statistical significance, sample size, and test design.
Proficient in Google Sheets or Excel for tracking and analysis.
Able to look past top-line conversion rate and evaluate lead quality and downstream results.
Solid understanding of conversion tracking, pixels, UTMs, and attribution.
Highly organized, with experience managing a pipeline or roadmap of multiple projects at once.
Able to write clear, detailed briefs that developers can build from without guesswork, and comfortable holding cross-functional teams to timelines.
Curious, skeptical, and driven by "what does the data say?" Able to manage priorities independently in a fast-moving, test-and-learn remote environment.

Nice to Have

Basic HTML/CSS knowledge, enough to write precise specs and QA builds confidently.
Experience with lead routing or CRM platforms.
Call tracking platforms (e.g., CallRail, Invoca, Ringba).
TCPA and consent capture tools (e.g., TrustedForm).
Legal, insurance, healthcare, or other regulated-industry marketing.

Success metrics (first 90 days)

Review of the current PostHog setup, tracking, and past tests completed, with recommendations delivered (first 30 days).
Metric definitions documented and agreed with Marketing (first 30 days).
Landing page template inventory and documentation completed (first 30 days).
Design tool recommendation made and agreed with dev/tech (first 30 days).
Testing calendar/pipeline built and shared, with a prioritized backlog of test ideas.
Test brief, readout, and QA templates in use.
At least 2 tests launched per month starting in month 2, with all variants designed by this role.
Every test has a brief before launch, passes QA, and gets a written readout.
Weekly testing updates and a monthly performance summary delivered to Marketing.
Every test checked for tracking health and correct traffic split within 48 hours of launch.
Implementation tickets for winning tests delivered to dev/tech within 3 business days of a test being called.
Post-launch performance tracked on every shipped winner, with the lift confirmed or any regression flagged.

Benefits

Uncapped quarterly profit-sharing bonuses based on company performance
100% company-paid monthly premiums for Fortune 500 level quality insurance plans for you and any/all dependents (US based employees):
medical (Aetna)
dental (Guardian)
vision (Guardian)
100% company match on any employee contributions to either HSA or FSA flex benefits plans (US based employees):
$500 free FSA company contribution, even if $0 employee contribution
401k plan with full company match of up to 6% of salary and no vesting period required (US based employees)
Unlimited paid time off with planned role/responsibilities coverage
Wellhub wellness benefit — access to 20,000+ gyms, studios, and wellness apps, fully covered by the company
Work from home equipment budget (at company's discretion)
Forever remote work environment

Why Join Us?

At Tort Experts, we believe in empowering our team members with growth opportunities, a flexible work environment, and the chance to make a tangible impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and are driven, client-focused, and eager to contribute to our mission of connecting clients with top-tier legal representation. Are you ready to lead the next wave of growth in legal marketing? Apply today and help us transform access to justice!

If you are selected to move forward in the process, we will contact you directly. We kindly ask that you do not reach out to inquire about the status of your application. Due to the volume of submissions, we are unable to respond to individual application status requests.

postings.title: Channels Senior Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Nuestro equipo de Channels

Vas a formar parte del equipo de Channels de Marketing Nube, unidad de negocio que nació a partir de la adquisición de Perfit, una solución de email marketing y automatización en América Latina con más de 5.000 clientes y con gran adopción entre los usuarios de Marketing Nube. Nuestro trabajo es ayudar a nuestros clientes a enviar contenido relevante a sus contactos, mejorando la tasa de conversión de sus negocios digitales.

El área de Channels busca ofrecer un programa para agencias, freelancers y cualquier empresa que brinde servicios de creación y gestión de tiendas online, y convertirlo en un canal relevante de adquisición de nuevos negocios para Marketing Nube.

Para acelerar hacia ese objetivo, buscamos una persona que lidere todas las acciones de Marketing Nube con este canal, trabajando de forma integrada con el Programa de Partners de Tiendanube.

El tamaño de tu desafío
Diseñar, revisar y gobernar el playbook de gestión de la cartera de partners, actualizado con benchmarks de mercado y adaptado a distintos perfiles de agencia.
Monitorear y reportar los KPIs estratégicos del canal (nuevas suscripciones, revenue generado, adopción de GMV, share of wallet, retención, NPS y CSAT de partners, entre otros) y llevar recomendaciones de mejora al liderazgo.
Desarrollar planes comerciales junto a los partners: metas conjuntas, planificación de pipeline y estrategias de go-to-market.
Asegurar que los partners tengan los recursos que necesitan (capacitaciones, herramientas, incentivos y soporte) para alcanzar y superar sus objetivos.
Monitorear de forma continua el desempeño y la calidad de los servicios de las agencias, y proponer mejoras y programas de capacitación que aseguren la excelencia.
Trabajar con el equipo de Partners de Tiendanube en campañas de venta, webinars y eventos.
Aportar a la evolución de la propuesta de valor del programa para que las agencias con tengan mejor posicionamiento, beneficios y acceso.
Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios (Sales, Growth, Marketing, Producto, Customer Success) para asegurar alineamiento estratégico y ejecución integrada de las iniciativas que impactan a los partners.
Ser la voz del partner hacia adentro: traer insights de mercado, necesidades del ecosistema y tendencias para la evolución del programa y del producto.

Lo que buscamos
Experiencia en ventas (hunter y/o farmer) en empresas de tecnología, SaaS o similares.
Capacidad para definir y operacionalizar iniciativas comerciales de go-to-market.
Perfil comercial orientado a la gestión de ventas, a la administración de una cartera de partners y a la buena interlocución con stakeholders.
Habilidades de relacionamiento, negociación e influencia con niveles de gestión.
Mindset estratégico con alta capacidad de ejecución hands-on en entornos dinámicos.
Disponibilidad para trabajar con una modalidad híbrida al menos 1 vez a la semana (estamos ubicados en Nuñez - CABA).
Es un plus
Conocimiento del mercado de e-commerce, en especial de plataformas de e-commerce.
Conocimiento del mercado de agencias digitales en Argentina y/o México.
Experiencia con herramientas de email marketing, marketing automation y CRM.

Nuestro proceso

Queremos que tengas la mejor experiencia posible a lo largo de nuestro proceso de selección. Después de que te postules, el equipo de Talent Acquisition va a analizar tu perfil con atención e, independientemente del resultado, vas a recibir una respuesta.

Las etapas y los plazos pueden variar según cada vacante, pero no te preocupes — vamos a mantenernos en contacto con vos durante todo el proceso.

Lo que te proponemos
Cobertura de salud OSDE 310 para el grupo familiar (cónyuge + hijos);
Clases de portugués 100% cubiertas;
Reintegro del servicio de Internet;
Descuentos en cursos de Coderhouse;
La asistencia de guardería es un beneficio que tiene como objetivo apoyar a los colaboradores en la provisión de un entorno seguro para sus hijos desde los 45 días de vida, hasta los 3 años de edad, durante tu jornada laboral;
Licencia familiar extendida a 21 días corridos para personas no gestantes o adoptantes;
15 días hábiles de vacaciones a lo largo del año;
Además de las vacaciones, disponemos de una semana de descanso para recargar energías entre final/principio de nuevo año;
Una Tiendanube gratuita para vos o alguien de tu entorno;
Somos #remotefirst, priorizamos el trabajo remoto dentro del país de contratación, siempre que el rol lo permita;
Es un entorno de desafío constante, propósito y protagonismo — acá la innovación nace de pensar en grande y tener actitud gigante.

Política de Privacidad

Tiendanube se compromete a proteger la privacidad y garantizar la seguridad de las personas indicadas para las vacantes que ofrecemos.

Para analizar tu solicitud, tendremos acceso a parte de tu información que será revisada antes de continuar. Utilizaremos estos datos para realizar los procesos de reclutamiento y selección. Además, cuidamos muy en serio a nuestras personas y solo compartimos información realmente necesaria. En última instancia, solo los mantendremos en nuestro sistema durante el tiempo que realmente lo necesitemos.
Tiendanube nació con un propósito grandioso: hacer que las marcas sean dueñas de su canal, de sus datos y de su relación con el cliente.
Creemos que el emprendimiento real no se construye en canal ajeno — se construye con autonomía, con presencia propia, con una recurrencia que le pertenece a la marca, no a quien intermedia la venta.

Nuestra ambición es ser la opción obvia para todas las marcas que quieren crecer con autonomía — desde la primera tienda hasta las que escalan millones.

Para ello, construimos el ecosistema más completo de e-commerce en América Latina : soluciones integradas, desarrolladas de forma nativa, que absorben la complejidad del comercio de punta a punta.

Estar entre los grandes exige compromiso, foco y resiliencia, en un camino que es intrínsecamente largo. Entendemos que solo las personas apasionadas por su trabajo logran conectar con nuestra dinámica.

Si buscás comodidad, soluciones fáciles o caminos ya recorridos, y creés que la recompensa llega antes que el resultado, Tiendanube no es para vos.
Ahora, si tenés sed de innovación, sos consciente de las dificultades y de la necesidad de adaptación continua, te gusta la autonomía, buscás entregar resultados de excelencia que agreguen valor a los clientes y deseás estar en un entorno que te desafíe constantemente, entonces estás en el lugar correcto.

Tiendanube
Hecha por quienes piensan en grande y tienen actitud gigante.

postings.title: Trade Sales & Enablement Manager (LATAM - Remote)
postings.descriptionText:
About Havenly

At Havenly Brands, we’re building this generation’s premier destination for all things home. Alongside our award winning Havenly design services, we proudly own and operate some of the best home furnishings brands in the business including Havenly, Interior Define, The Citizenry, Burrow, Inside, and St.Frank. Our family of brands is growing and we’re looking for amazing people to join us on this journey!

Havenly is not just the #1 residential interior design service in America - we're architecting the future of how millions design their homes. With our proprietary 3D visualization technology, our worldwide network of designers empowered with AI tools, and our revolutionary customer-facing AI design assistant, we're at the inflection point of a massive market transformation. This isn't just another operations role, it's the opportunity to build the category-defining business at the intersection of AI, design, and commerce.

Our Core Values

Exhibit Gumption: meet every challenge with spirit and energy; believe the impossible is possible.
Overperform: work hard, move fast, be scrappy.
Stay Playful: no jerks, no whiners; have fun and keep perspective.
Act Like an Owner: be accountable, speak up, act in Havenly's best interest.

This is a remote position located in Latin America. It will be a long-term contract. Resumes must be submitted in English. Any resumes submitted in other languages will not be considered.

Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive Trade Sales & Enablement Manager based in LATAM to drive the day-to-day execution behind Havenly’s fast-growing trade business. You will turn trade strategy and analysis into shipped work, put a prioritized book in front of our inside and outside sales reps, and push them to work it. You will partner closely with U.S.-based sales, marketing, CX, supply chain, and RevOps through both real-time collaboration and strong async execution.

This is a build-and-automate role as much as a sales role. Leadership sets the strategy, targets, and definitions. You own the execution and the feedback loop, leaning on tooling, dashboards, and triggered alerts rather than manual follow-up. You will move the metrics that matter most: application-to-order conversion, repeat rate, cross-brand shopping, and active-account growth.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Execution & Rep Enablement

Own the routing logic behind rep books across inside (retail) and outside sales: prioritization, assignment, reassignment, and firm-linking
Drive sales teams to work their trade pipeline using triggered alerts and account-prioritization views
Build enablement for DE and retail teams, including training, playbooks, perks and tier fluency, and a central resource hub
Motivate a large retail team through contests, SPIFFs, and clear targets, in partnership with retail leadership

Trade Program Operations

Manage tier-progression mechanics and verify delivery of earned perks and benefits
Manage promo and pricing mechanisms that support cross-brand shopping
Run the trade special-order request process from intake and approval through delivery
Feed what you learn on the ground back to marketing and sales leadership

Campaigns & Lifecycle

Write, QA, and iterate on trade sequences across acquisition, onboarding, and re-engagement
Keep messaging on-brand and consistent
Test and optimize to lift conversion, repeat, and cross-brand rates

CRM, Reporting & Analytics

Handle day-to-day trade CRM and HubSpot administration and data integrity, working with our HubSpot Admin
Build self-serve dashboards and automated alerts covering application health, application-to-order conversion, and tier movement
Surface leading indicators like primed leads, idle accounts, stalled deals, and tier gaps
Deliver clear recommendations on book structure, engagement volume, sales activities, and deal management

CX & Supply Chain Partnership

Act as the single point of contact for trade across CX and Supply Chain
Define escalation steps and expected response times
Find and unblock stuck orders before delivery friction costs us accounts we have already won

Qualifications

6+ years of hands-on experience in B2B, trade, or wholesale sales operations and enablement
CRM administration and reporting experience (HubSpot strongly preferred), plus experience building automated outreach sequences and lifecycle campaigns
Proven experience working remotely with U.S.-based teams
Strong English communication skills, written and verbal
Demonstrated ability to work independently in an async environment
Strong analytical skills, including building funnel reporting and turning findings into a prioritized plan of action
Experience driving a sales team to a number without managing it directly
Clean, on-brand customer-facing writing, and the ability to QA someone else’s
Comfort working cross-functionally and owning an escalation process other teams depend on
Bonus: experience with loyalty or membership programs, multi-brand or marketplace retail, or CX and supply chain escalation design
We are building with AI as part of how we work. We are looking for people who are curious about AI-assisted tools and eager to adopt them.

Success Metrics

Application-to-first-order conversion (approved applicants who order within 90 days)
90-day repeat rate and 12-month trade LTV
Tier progression rate
Cross-brand shopping, total trade revenue, and active-account growth
Fast, reliable response times to requests from sales, CX, and supply chain

What We’re Looking For

Highly responsive and dependable during U.S. working hours overlap
Self-starter who does not need step-by-step direction
Clear communicator who keeps stakeholders informed without being asked
Builder and automator who reaches for tooling and triggers before manual follow-up
Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting prioritiess

The Details

Engagement type: Long-term contract, remote
Location: Latin America: Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay, Mexico, Costa Rica

postings.title: Business Operations Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
You are one of the key support pillars as Avicado continues to grow. As the Business Operations Coordinator, you are the teammate who keeps things moving. You'll work hand in hand with our internal teams, picking up the hands-on work that helps projects close cleanly, people changes land on time, and our data stay accurate.

Every 6 months, you'll look back and see that you've taken real work off your teammates' plates, freeing them to focus on higher impact problems. You'll see that the details you handled made our tools and reports more trustworthy, and that you spotted gaps along the way that became opportunities to build a better Avicado.

We're a growing company, and growing companies run on people who pitch in where they're needed, ask questions early, get the details right, and take pride in making their teammates' jobs easier. That's the culture of this role and this team: when we succeed, we make everyone's job easier at Avicado.

Core Responsibilities

Opportunity Closeout and Project Onboarding

Run our Opportunity Closeout process accurately, translating a closed Salesforce opportunity into an active project in Toggl, our Main Project List (Excel), and Notion
Use judgment on the gray areas the SOP cannot fully cover, such as whether a deal is a new project or an addition to an existing one, and know when to make the call yourself and when to elevate it.
Close completed projects across multiple systems
Proactively track down missing or conflicting information from Sales, Contracts, Finance, and consulting teams before it becomes a billing problem

Project and People Support

Support project managers with requests to make changes to our time entry tool, such as adding new hires to projects or moving time entries
Make adjustments to our internal tools and data sets so that project and client data stays accurate and reliable
Update internal data sets when people are hired or move teams internally
Make bulk changes to data in our tools, such as uploading CSVs and running weekly data quality checks
Run recurring weekly and monthly maintenance SOPs on schedule, such as quality checks on our project data, people data, and system backups

Cross-team Support and Collaboration

Join closeout, kickoff, and renewal conversations with Sales and our consultants, take action items, and help make sure our systems match what the team expects
Support month-end close with Finance and our directors, from pre-invoicing prep to the project data updates that feed invoicing
Take on recurring manual work from teammates across Biz Ops, Finance, Sales, and Consulting, and document what you do as an SOP
Help refine our SOPs, and surface the bottlenecks and blockers you find along the way
You will love this job if...
Take pride in doing your work accurately
You feel fulfilled when your work makes your teammates' jobs easier
You like following a process and making it more reliable than you found it
You can operate in some gray spaces—some of this work requires good judgement and knowing when to elevate a question and when to take action with the information you have
You double-check your work without being asked, and you are comfortable saying "I'm not sure, let me confirm"
You enjoy figuring out why something is off and fixing the root cause
You are a self-starter who loves to learn new tools
Ideal Background

You should have:

Strong spreadsheet skills. You are comfortable in Excel with lookups, filters, pivot tables, and cleaning and uploading CSV files
Experience in an onboarding process for employees, clients, or projects
Experience following SOPs with precision. You can run a multi-step process the same way every time, and you notice when a situation does not fit the process
Experience with SaaS business tools. A CRM such as Salesforce, a time tracking tools, and a workspace tool such as Notion are all examples. You do not need to know ours already, but you learn tools quickly
Sound judgment. Some of our work is gray, not black and white. You can make a reasoned call, explain it, and know what to ask when you cannot
Clear written English and strong remote communication.
Comfort with AI tools. You use AI assistants, and more importantly, you check what they produce before trusting it

Preferred:

Experience in professional services (consulting, legal, accounting, architecture and engineering, IT services, marketing, or similar), especially familiarity with concepts like billable time, backlog, and invoicing
Experience working in or alongside a finance team on invoicing or recurring financial reporting.
Experience maintaining data quality in Excel
Characteristics of an ideal candidate
Responsive; Avicado takes great pride in reacting quickly and positively to our clients and teammates, both internal and external
Innovative; a desire to drive innovation through new and unique solutions while embracing creative ideas
Entrepreneurial; the drive to take initiative, deliver results, and create value for our clients
Empowered; bring solutions instead of problems
Performance Driven & Accountable; sets goals and challenges our high-performance culture
Even-tempered; handles pressure and thrives in a fast-paced environment
Coachable; recognizes strengths & weakness and open to guidance
Why Avicado
Competitive compensation
Health insurance
401k with employer match
Flexible PTO
Remote work
Philanthropic Matching Gift Program And more…
About Avicado

Avicado, LLP was established in 2015 with a focus on utilizing the latest cloud-based tools and applications to enhance our clients' experience. As a technology consultancy, we empower construction owners to make the most of their systems and data. Our team of experts collaborates with enterprise organizations such as data centers, universities, hospitals, and real estate developers to promote seamless interoperability across their teams and technologies. We are experiencing an exciting phase of expansion and actively searching for new talent to join our team.

We’re a close-knit team with a high-performance culture, but we don’t like to take ourselves too seriously.

Our diversity and inclusivity are a point of pride, and we have created a highly interactive remote work environment that encourages mutual respect and individuality while fostering opportunities for employees to excel both personally and professionally. We offer competitive benefits, remote work experiences, flexible work arrangements, various career development opportunities, employee resource groups, and more.

Avicado's unwavering dedication to creating a remarkable workplace experience has been widely acknowledged by experts in the industry. We are thrilled to have attained the highly coveted "Great Place to Work" certification and to have been included on Inc.'s esteemed Best Workplaces list for three consecutive years. Additionally, we are humbled to have received the AYA Award, which recognizes allies who promote equality and actively foster positive change for women in technology. At Avicado, we take great pride in fostering a culture that is both inclusive and supportive, especially for women in the technology industry.

These accolades are a testament to our ongoing efforts to foster a culture of inclusion, mutual respect, and professional growth for all members of our team.

If you are a self-motivated individual who wants to work with Fortune 500 clients in a rapidly growing company, we encourage you to join us!

postings.title: Technical Operations Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Technical Operations Specialist

About Us
Property Leads is a fast-growing performance marketing company specializing in connecting motivated homeowners with real estate investors, with expanding operations across home services and other consumer verticals.

We're a lean, fast-moving startup that values ownership, resourcefulness, and results. We operate across multiple marketing channels, manage a growing network of partners, and move quickly to capitalize on new opportunities.

We don't believe in unnecessary bureaucracy or meetings for the sake of meetings. We believe in hiring smart, capable people who can solve problems, take initiative, and make things happen. If you thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities evolve and your work has an immediate impact, you'll fit right in.

About the Role
We're looking for a technically savvy, highly organized operations generalist to help manage the day-to-day technical and operational needs of our growing business.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of technical operations, partner tech operations, campaign execution, creative compliance, and process improvement. You'll work closely with our affiliate team, internal stakeholders, and external partners to ensure campaigns launch smoothly, technical integrations function properly, and operational workflows run efficiently.

You'll be responsible for everything from partner onboarding and technical troubleshooting to coordinating creative approvals, managing campaign configurations, and identifying opportunities to streamline processes.

We're not looking for someone who needs a rigid job description or constant direction. We're looking for someone who can juggle multiple priorities, recognize what needs attention, take ownership, and figure out how to get things done.

This is an operations-first role that requires strong technical aptitude, not a traditional software engineering position.

Key Responsibilities
1. Partner & Campaign Operations

Own the operational and technical setup of new partners, campaigns, and traffic sources, ensuring launches are accurate, timely, and seamless.
Work closely with the affiliate team and external partners to coordinate integrations, troubleshoot issues, and resolve technical or operational roadblocks.
Manage campaign configurations, tracking implementations, payout updates, and other technical adjustments across our platforms.
Support the implementation and maintenance of various partner integrations, lead delivery systems, and marketing technologies.
Serve as a reliable point of contact for operational and technical requests, communicating clearly and keeping projects moving without unnecessary delays.

2. Creative Approvals & Workflow Management

Manage high-volume creative approval workflows, coordinating between external partners, clients, and internal teams.
Track submissions, feedback, revisions, and approvals to ensure timely turnaround and accurate documentation.
Maintain organized records and processes to ensure campaigns meet internal requirements and client expectations.
Identify bottlenecks and develop more efficient systems for managing recurring approvals and operational requests.

3. Technical Troubleshooting & Support

Investigate and resolve tracking discrepancies, integration issues, data inconsistencies, and other technical challenges.
Perform quality assurance checks on partner setups, campaign launches, tracking, and lead delivery processes.
Collaborate with internal technical resources when necessary, while independently resolving issues within your scope.
Proactively monitor workflows and identify potential problems before they impact campaign performance or partner relationships.

4. Process Improvement & Automation

Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve operational workflows across teams.
Leverage AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, streamline repetitive tasks, improve documentation, and increase overall efficiency.
Build and maintain organized processes that can scale as the company grows.
Help develop SOPs, internal resources, and reporting systems that reduce friction and improve execution.
Adapt quickly as new partnerships, channels, tools, and business priorities emerge.

What We're Looking For

Experience in technical operations, marketing operations, affiliate operations, ad operations, or a similarly technical and execution-focused role.
Strong technical aptitude and the ability to learn new platforms, troubleshoot integrations, and navigate unfamiliar systems independently.
Familiarity with performance marketing technologies, tracking platforms, APIs, pixels, or lead management systems is highly desirable.
Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of requests, projects, and competing priorities without losing attention to detail.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience using AI tools to improve productivity, solve problems, and optimize workflows. We want someone who actively explores how technology can make them more effective.
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset. You don't wait for someone to tell you there's a problem or exactly how to solve it.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment where priorities can shift quickly and responsibilities aren't always neatly defined.
Strong sense of accountability and follow-through. If you own something, you see it through to completion.
Ability to work independently with minimal oversight while knowing when to communicate, collaborate, or escalate.

Bonus Points

Experience with affiliate tracking platforms such as TUNE, Everflow, or similar systems.
Familiarity with lead generation, ping/post integrations, call tracking, or performance marketing campaign setups.
Experience with workflow automation tools, CRM systems, or project management platforms.
Experience working directly with affiliate publishers, advertisers, or external marketing partners.
Familiarity with data analysis, reporting, or basic API troubleshooting.

What Success Looks Like
In your first 90 days, success means:

Seamless partner launches: New partners, campaigns, and integrations are set up accurately and efficiently, with minimal delays or unnecessary back-and-forth.
Operational ownership: The affiliate team and external partners can rely on you to handle technical requests, troubleshoot issues, and keep workflows moving without constant follow-up.
Efficient creative approvals: High-volume approval processes are organized, responsive, and consistently managed.
Proactive problem-solving: You're identifying issues, anticipating needs, and resolving operational bottlenecks before they become larger problems.
Smarter processes: You've identified and implemented meaningful improvements, including AI-powered efficiencies and automation where appropriate.
Independence and adaptability: You've demonstrated that you can manage competing priorities, pivot quickly, and take ownership of new challenges with minimal oversight.

The Bottom Line
We're looking for someone who is equal parts technical, operational, and resourceful. Someone who can manage the details, solve problems, keep people aligned, and make sure things get done. This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in a growing company, take ownership of important processes, and help build the operational infrastructure that supports our next stage of growth.
