postings.descriptionText:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

What does a Interactive PM do at Hogarth?

The Interactive Project Manager works closely with the Clients Producers to work on campaigns. The PM is expected to lead and manage digital projects while bringing together a multi-disciplinary team comprising of internal and external resources as required. They needs to provide an optimum interactive solution for the client that answers the brief within all the necessary specified style and technical guidelines.

As a member of the project management team on this business, you are pivotal to the smooth running of projects. You will be required to have a thorough understanding of the client's requirements and be responsible for all aspects of your projects. You will build strong client relationships, managing communication through the project team, providing consistent and accurate project reporting, project planning, and ensuring that expectations are managed and delivered.

You will:

Set and manage client expectations regarding deliverables and timeframe while coordinating and ensuring all parties follow the agreed workflows
Identify and escalate areas for improvement of existing workflow and processes
Build strong, trusting relationships and communication with all key stakeholders, function leads, cross functional producers, senior managers, and 3rd party vendors that are directly involved with the work
Manage the approval of quarterly budgets and proactively manage your projects within time and budget, escalating any risks to project delivery
Demonstrate ability to write, prepare and present documents, presentations, and reports to support your work
Ensure your projects deliver consistently against all contractual obligations including SLAs and KPIs
Act as a brand QC/Guardian – always ensure brand guidelines, QC checklists and procedures are understood and followed by the project team
Monthly financial reconciliation on projects

Requirements

Demonstrable project management experience related to the digital space
Very high competence in project management software such as Microsoft Project and Omniplan
Experience in costing, quotations, and project scope definition
Analytical and detailed in project documentation, accountability, and tracking
Pragmatic team player with excellent written and verbal communication skills
Prioritization, time management, and attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills, written and verbal
Possess technical understanding of mobile and web technologies necessary to run projects and convey details. Examples would be:
iOS and Android development
Cloud computing
HTML5/CSS/Javascript
eCommerce/Shopping Carts
Social Media Strategies/Platforms

#LI-NC1

#LI-Hybrid

Why work here:
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. Who We Are

Political Asylum Lawyers is a Houston-based immigration law firm focused on asylum cases. We help immigrants all over the United States secure their futures here through asylum, combining exceptional standards with deep respect for the human reality behind every case.

Our work changes lives. The standards we maintain, the discipline behind our work, and the way we show up every day can determine whether someone is able to stay safe and build a stable future in the United States. That is why we operate with integrity, urgency, and excellence, and why we expect every team member to take full ownership of their role.

Everything we do is guided by our core values: integrity, excellence, accountability, teamwork and passion.

Working here means:

High-stakes responsibility: our work is of great consequence for our clients
Deeply meaningful outcomes: our work changes lives for the better
Emotionally demanding moments: resilience and maturity are essential
High standards and constant growth: excellence and continuous improvement are expected
Mission-driven teamwork: we’re passionate about helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum, and we know that meeting our high standards requires each of us to take ownership, communicate proactively, and support one another

If you want a career where your skills create tangible change in the world, this is it.

Learn more about what it’s like to work with us here: politicalasylumlawyers.com/careers

The Role

In this role, you'll be an integral part of our team's mission of helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum. We believe that those fleeing persecution deserve expert guidance and unwavering support as they seek safety and a new beginning in the United States.

The Accounting & Finance Manager (Hands-on) is responsible for managing the firm’s financial operations, accounting systems, billing, accounts receivable, cash flow forecasting, financial reporting, trust accounting compliance, payroll oversight, tax reporting coordination, internal controls, and finance-related operational projects.

This role serves as the firm’s first level of financial analysis and operational financial control. The Accounting & Finance Manager ensures that financial records are accurate, timely, compliant, and useful for decisions. This is a hands-on role. The initial focus is to learn the firm’s systems, work with existing staff and providers, and establish accurate, reliable financial operations.

Recurring accounting and billing work will be delegated progressively, while the manager retains responsibility for controls, review, quality, and results. As readiness and scope are agreed with leadership and current senior finance support, the manager will gradually assume selected planning and reporting responsibilities from that support.

The Accounting & Finance Manager must explain complex financial information in plain English, identify financial risks, recommend corrective action, and follow approved actions through implementation and verified results. The role supports leadership decisions on budgeting, profitability, cash management, pricing, collections, and strategic planning.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day responsibilities will vary based on the firm’s needs, but will include a combination of the following:

Financial Operations Management

Perform and manage day-to-day financial operations, working with existing staff and service providers and documenting procedures so the work is completed accurately and on time.
Follow financial issues through to resolution: identify who is responsible for each next step and its deadline, follow up, raise problems with recommended solutions, and confirm that the agreed actions were completed correctly.
Ensure accurate execution of accounting, billing, A/R, A/P, payroll, trust accounting, collections, tax coordination, and general ledger maintenance.
Maintain clean and current financial records in the accounting system.
Ensure the legal team is supported with accurate financial information related to client matters, billing, retainers, and collections.
Monitor daily cash balances, bank accounts, credit card activity, merchant activity, and other key financial accounts.
Ensure bills, vendor payments, check requests, and reimbursements are processed accurately and on time.

Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and Forecasting

Prepare, review, and analyze monthly financial statements and key financial reports on time.
Validate supporting records, calculations, and assumptions; investigate material inconsistencies and disclose unresolved limitations.
Ensure monthly financial reports are completed accurately and on time.
Prepare annual and periodic budgets and forecasts as required throughout the year. Provide budget variance reports and explain the results to the Owner/CFO in clear business language, including conclusions, recommendations, and decisions needed.
Support the creation, maintenance, and monitoring of the annual budget.
Maintain a forward-looking cash flow forecast to help leadership anticipate shortfalls, plan distributions, and manage working capital.
Track year-over-year revenue growth, gross profit, operating profit, and other key financial trends.
Provide analysis that supports strategic planning, operational planning, and financial decision-making.

Billing, Collections, and Accounts Receivable

Own and continuously improve the firm’s billing and collections process.
Supervise timely preparation and delivery of client invoices.
Monitor payment plans and ensure clients comply with payment terms.
Track, measure, and report accounts receivable aging.
Ensure collection protocols are followed consistently and professionally.
Work with billing staff and leadership to prevent A/R from accruing unnecessarily.
Address client billing questions and payment concerns professionally while protecting the firm’s financial interests.
Own the operational handling of chargebacks, refund requests, billing disputes, and merchant service issues through documented resolution.
Review billing records, payment history and related correspondence to understand and resolve chargebacks, refund requests and billing disputes. Coordinate follow-up, obtain required approvals, and confirm that any approved refunds, credits or other adjustments are correctly recorded in the relevant systems and account balances.
Recommend process improvements to increase collection rate and reduce financial leakage.

Trust Accounting and Compliance

Ensure trust/IOLTA account activity is properly monitored, reconciled, and documented.
Own or review three-way trust reconciliations.
Identify and resolve trust accounting discrepancies with urgency.
Ensure compliance with applicable legal, ethical, and accounting requirements.
Work with the Owner/CFO and CPA to correct accounting or reporting issues.
Maintain strong internal controls to protect the integrity of firm financials.

Internal Controls and Risk Management

Design, recommend, and enforce financial controls that protect the firm.
Identify financial risks, reporting gaps, compliance issues, cash flow risks, billing breakdowns, and process weaknesses.
Recommend practical corrective actions to leadership and work within approved policies and authority limits.
Support audits, tax preparation, financial reviews, and outside accounting reviews.
Ensure balance sheet reconciliations, payroll liability reconciliations, and bank reconciliations are completed accurately.
Monitor payroll taxes, tax liabilities, vendor obligations, debt obligations, and compliance deadlines.

Finance Team and Vendor Oversight

Oversee existing staff and providers formally assigned to the role, including the bookkeeper, billing specialist, payroll provider, outsourced finance vendors, and other accounting support.
Provide direction, accountability, and feedback to finance/accounting staff.
Progressively delegate recurring accounting and billing work while retaining controls, review, and accountability for results, as appropriate.
Participate in onboarding, training, and performance reviews for other assigned finance-related positions.
Ensure finance team members understand expectations, deadlines, reporting requirements, and quality standards.
Hold vendors accountable for timely and accurate work.
Serve as the internal subject matter expert for accounting software, billing systems, chart of accounts, reporting processes, and financial workflows.
Identify practical improvements in QuickBooks, Stripe, Google Sheets, Asana, and related workflows.
Define financial requirements and implement, test, and document changes with technical support as needed.
Maintain controls, data quality, security, and approval boundaries, and own completion and accuracy even when technical colleagues build the solution.

Financial Analysis and Business Support

Analyze profitability by service, SKU, practice area, attorney, labor cost, marketing channel, and client/matter type when data is available.
Support pricing reviews to ensure services produce adequate gross profit.
Evaluate underperforming investments, expense categories, vendors, and initiatives.
Track production labor return, utilization, realization, collection rate, and cost of acquisition where applicable.
Help leadership understand Total Owner Benefit, owner distributions, working capital needs, and firm financial health.
Support centralized KPI reporting and scorecard development.

Requirements

Who You Are

We're looking for professionals who combine technical competence with genuine passion for our mission. The ideal candidate brings:

Blue Border gives IT a simpler, device-agnostic way to secure remote work, enable contractor and BYOD workforces, govern AI usage, and replace VDI. About Venn

Venn is the leader in workspace security for remote and contractor workforces. Built on Venn's patented technology, Blue Border™ protects company data, applications, and AI workflows on any computer, without VDI and without fully managing the endpoint. Installing Blue Border creates a company-controlled secure enclave directly on the user's Mac or PC. All business activity, including data, applications, networking, and AI workflows, runs locally and stays isolated from personal use, while everything outside the enclave remains private.

Blue Border gives IT a simpler, device-agnostic way to secure remote work, enable contractor and BYOD workforces, govern AI usage, and replace VDI. More than 700 security and compliance-driven organizations, including Fidelity, Guardian, Whatnot, and the IMF, trust Venn to meet HIPAA, FINRA, SEC, NAIC, SOC 2, PCI, and GDPR standards.

The Opportunity

As the Revenue Operations Engineer at Venn, you'll make our go-to-market systems work as one. Our revenue stack spans HubSpot, Vitally, Nooks, Swan AI, Gong, and Zuora.You will own how those tools connect, how data flows between them, and how the business gets trustworthy reporting out of them. You'll sit in Finance and work daily with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, so that lead generation, pipeline, and customer data tie cleanly together from first touch through renewal. This is a hands-on, builder-minded role: you'll design integrations and automations, fix the data problems behind the numbers, and give leadership a single, reliable view of revenue.

What You'll Do

Own the integrations and data flows between our GTM systems, including HubSpot (CRM), Vitally (customer success), Nooks (AI phone dialer), Swan AI, Gong, and Zuora so that data moves accurately and automatically between them
Build and maintain automations and workflows that reduce manual work for Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams
Serve as the technical owner of HubSpot, including objects, properties, workflows, lead routing, lifecycle stages, and data hygiene
Design and maintain reporting and dashboards for pipeline generation, conversion, sales activity, forecasting, and customer health, working with Finance on revenue reporting
Define and document metrics and data definitions so Sales, Marketing, CS, and Finance all work from the same numbers
Partner with Marketing on lead flow, attribution, and campaign reporting from first touch through closed-won
Partner with Sales leadership on pipeline visibility, forecast inputs, and rep productivity reporting
Partner with Customer Success on connecting customer health, usage, and renewal data to the CRM
Audit data quality across systems, find and fix sync errors, duplicates, and gaps, and put safeguards in place to prevent them
Evaluate new GTM tools and AI-driven workflows, and manage vendor setup, permissions, and integrations
Document systems, processes, and integrations so the revenue stack is easy to maintain and scale
Support Finance with revenue, bookings, and pipeline data for board reporting, planning, and audits

What You Bring

3-5 years of experience in revenue operations, GTM operations, marketing operations, sales operations, or a similar technical GTM role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company
Deep, hands-on experience with HubSpot, including workflows, custom properties and objects, reporting, and integrations
You know the Model Context Protocol (MCP). You can connect AI tools to business systems with MCP connectors (for example, HubSpot, Zuora, and Google Drive)
Experience connecting systems and building integrations through native connectors, APIs, webhooks, and iPaaS tools (e.g., Zapier, Workato, Make, n8n, or similar)
Strong reporting and analytics skills, with experience building dashboards and translating messy data into clear answers for leadership
Familiarity with the types of tools in our stack, such as customer success platforms, sales dialers and engagement tools, and conversation intelligence platforms (Vitally, Nooks, and Gong experience is a plus)
Comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, and explaining technical concepts to non-technical teammates
A detail-oriented, systems-thinking approach, with a habit of documenting what you build
Strong problem-solving instincts and the ability to prioritize competing requests from multiple stakeholders
Comfort in a startup or scale-up environment, with a bias toward action and a willingness to build process as you go

Nice to Have

Working knowledge of SQL, JavaScript or Python, or scripting for data transformation and API work
Experience with BI or data tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Metabase, Google Sheets or BigQuery modeling)
Experience supporting finance reporting, such as bookings, ARR, and revenue recognition inputs
Experience with AI-driven GTM tools and automation
HubSpot certifications

Why You'll Love Working Here

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our team's health, well-being, and work-life balance, including:

Competitive compensation
Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
Healthcare FSA, HSA, and commuter benefits
Unlimited paid time off, paid sick time, NYSE company holidays, and a paid birthday off
The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing startup with a collaborative, high-impact team where every voice is valued and there are clear paths for growth and promotion

We operate with Trust, Humility, Relationships, Innovation, Vigor, and Empowerment, and we look for teammates who do the same.

postings.descriptionText:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

We are looking for a strategic Senior Marketing Analyst to join our growing data and analytics (DNA) team at Thomasnet.com and serve as the analytical engine behind our paid and owned marketing strategy. This is a role that sits at the intersection of marketing performance, data engineering, and executive storytelling. You will own paid marketing analytics end-to-end: building the data infrastructure that powers our reporting, running attribution analysis across channels, and — critically — translating complex data into the clear narratives that drive budget, strategy, and product decisions. We don't just need someone who can build a dashboard. We need someone who knows what it means, and can make a room of senior leaders feel it. This role bridges Marketing, Sales, Yield, and Product. Your work will directly influence how we allocate marketing spend, price our inventory, and grow revenue.

About Thomas

For over 125 years, Thomas has been the definitive resource for industrial buyers and suppliers across North America. Today, thomasnet.com is the leading digital platform for industrial product discovery and supplier selection connecting more than 1.4 million active buyers including engineers, procurement managers, and MRO professionals with over 500,000 North American manufacturers and distributors across 70,000 product categories. No other platform in the industrial space operates at this depth or scale. Thomas Data and Analytics team is the data and intelligence function at the heart of that network — owning the analytical infrastructure that connects buyer demand to supplier performance and drives Thomas's growth strategy and data-informed decision makings.

How You'll Contribute:

Paid Marketing Analytics

Own end-to-end analytics for paid channels: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and any emerging paid media — from impression to revenue attribution
Build and maintain attribution models and funnel reporting across paid and organic channels to measure true ROAS, CAC, and long-term LTV outcomes
Monitor campaign pacing, budget utilization, and performance against targets; surface anomalies and recommend actions in real time

Insights & Storytelling

Transform raw marketing data into clear, executive-ready narratives — not just "what happened," but "why it happened" and "what we should do"
Develop weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance recaps for leadership that drive decisions, not just inform them
Proactively identify trends, risks, and opportunities across marketing channels and synthesize them into a point of view — with a recommendation
Partner with the marketing and sales teams to answer the "so what" behind every metric

Analytics Engineering

Build and maintain robust data models in Snowflake (SQL, dbt, or similar) integrating data from Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Segment, Salesforce, Iterable, and ad servers
Manage and improve reverse-ETL pipelines that feed performance data back into operational tools (Google Ads API, campaign management platforms)
Create and own Looker dashboards aligned to marketing KPIs, campaign health, and revenue forecasting

Testing & Experimentation

Design and analyze A/B tests for paid campaigns, landing pages, and yield strategies; translate statistical results into plain-language recommendations
Support channel-level experiments: bid strategies, audience segmentation, creative performance

What You'll Bring to Xometry:

Experience

5+ years in marketing analytics, growth analytics, or a closely related field — ideally in a marketplace, B2B SaaS, AdTech, or lead-gen environment
Demonstrated experience owning paid marketing analytics (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta); you understand how the platforms work, not just how to report on them
Track record of producing analysis that changed a decision — and you can tell that story in an interview

Technical Skills

Expert-level SQL; strong Python for data manipulation and analysis
Hands-on with Snowflake and dbt (or equivalent modern data stack)
Proficient in Looker (or Tableau/similar) — you build dashboards that people actually use
Familiarity with Google Ads API, Microsoft Ads API, Segment event tracking, and CRM data (Salesforce, HubSpot)
Bonus: experience with ad servers or yield platforms (Kevel, Placements.io)

Communication & Storytelling

Exceptional written and verbal communication — you write crisp, jargon-free analyses that a CMO would forward to a CEO
Ability to structure ambiguous problems, frame a hypothesis, and present findings with confidence and a point of view
Comfort presenting to senior stakeholders; you don't hide behind the data, you use it to make an argument

Domain Knowledge

Deep understanding of paid marketing KPIs: ROAS, CPC, CPL, impression share, quality score, attribution windows
Familiarity with marketing attribution methodologies (last-click, data-driven, multi-touch)
Understanding of lead funnels from impression through conversion and renewal

Responsibilities

TikTok's Global Business Solutions (GBS) regional sales and advertising teams drive revenue growth by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding clients, and running campaigns that deliver measurable results. Client needs, market trends, and performance expectations shift constantly, and differently in every market. We build strategy accordingly, turning those moving pieces into advertising solutions that work and client partnerships that last. You will help businesses grow on a global platform, working on the campaigns and relationships that turn advertisers into long-term partners. We are looking for a Business Partnerships Manager, Financial Services to drive growth with FinServ advertisers across Colombia, Argentina, Peru, Chile. This person will manage a defined set of client relationships, execute against full-funnel growth plans, and help turn platform capabilities into measurable business outcomes for banks, fintechs, payments companies, lending players, wallets, investment platforms, and insurance advertisers. The right candidate combines solid commercial instincts with hands-on performance-marketing fluency. They can discuss CAC, ROAS, funnel leakage, app acquisition, web conversion, lead quality, creative testing, and measurement with a performance team, and are learning to translate those topics into a clear growth narrative for client stakeholders. They are also building an understanding of digital media partnerships: how platforms, networks, creators, placements, ad products, measurement solutions, incentives, and joint business plans come together to create durable client growth. This is an individual contributor role for someone who learns aggressively and wants to develop into a senior sales person. They will own client outcomes from day one, while partnering closely with senior BPMs and regional leads on the most strategic conversations, and will be expected to grow from managing accounts well toward thinking about how the broader FinServ industry should grow with TikTok and partner media solution. Responsibilities 1. Account Growth and Execution - Manage and grow a defined portfolio of Colombia, Argentina, Peru, Chile FinServ advertisers, with a focus on revenue delivery, forecast accuracy, and strong day-to-day client relationships. - Execute account plans that connect client business priorities to measurable media outcomes, including user acquisition, funded accounts, loan applications, card acquisition, deposits, app activation, qualified leads, and brand consideration. - Identify share-of-wallet opportunities in assigned accounts and support entry strategies for accounts where platform adoption is still early. - Help close quarterly forecast gaps through account-level actions, including upsell opportunities, incentive plans, creative actions, measurement fixes, and partner-product adoption. 2. Performance Marketing Excellence - Serve as a credible day-to-day performance partner for client marketing and growth teams, media agencies, and internal performance specialists. - Diagnose campaign performance across funnel stage, objective, optimization event, audience setup, creative volume, bidding, budget allocation, landing-page or app flow, and measurement setup. - Contribute to and execute scalable performance playbooks for FinServ use cases, including app acquisition, web conversion, lead generation, retargeting, creator-led performance, and branding-to-performance handoffs. - Help clients move from tactical media buying toward structured test-and-learn programs with clear hypotheses, clean measurement, and repeatable decision rules. - Surface technical or operational blockers — campaign pauses, event setup, creative shortages, tracking gaps, product readiness — and drive them toward commercial resolution rather than letting them sit outside the revenue plan. 3. Digital Media Partnerships - Support partnership motions that connect TikTok, Pangle, partner inventory, measurement, creative, incentives, and product adoption into one client growth story. - Contribute to joint business plans with FinServ clients, including quarterly priorities, product adoption roadmap, investment commitments, operating cadence, and checkpoints. - Work with internal partner teams to build proposals that reflect how banks, fintechs, lenders, and payments companies actually make media decisions. - Help clients understand when to use branding, performance, app, web, lead-generation, consideration, and partner-network solutions, and how those motions reinforce each other. - Represent the FinServ vertical in cross-functional discussions with support from senior BPMs, developing a clear industry point of view on partnerships, measurement, and incentives. 4. Industry Development - Build a strong view of FinServ trends in Colombia, Argentina, Peru, Chile, including digital banking, credit, payments, wallets, super-apps, lending cycles, regulatory sensitivity, app adoption, and competitive media behavior. - Translate market changes into practical client actions, for example competitive-response plays, app-growth recovery plans, or wallet-share expansion ideas. - Help develop repeatable vertical narratives that explain why TikTok and partner media solutions matter for the next phase of FinServ growth. - Learn FinServ business models, client decision cycles, risk constraints, and the difference between brand, acquisition, and monetization objectives, and start coaching junior or cross-functional stakeholders on them.

postings.descriptionText:
_Please read the job description in full and follow the application instructions below. Applications sent through Indeed will not be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!_

Location: Remote

Compensation: $2,000 - $4,000 USD / month

Type: Full-Time, Contract

Time Zone: US Hours, 8am to 4pm PST

*Section 01: About Flax Labs*

Flax Labs is a full-service D2C ecommerce growth agency based in Canada, working exclusively with US Shopify brands. We run Meta and Google ads, creative production, landing pages, and email/SMS for brands doing $50K to $500K+ per month in revenue.

We're building the most AI-integrated agency in the space. Our proprietary dashboard and automation tools give our clients a level of visibility and speed that traditional agencies can't match. We're a small, fast-moving team that punches way above our weight.

Creative is the biggest lever in paid social right now, and we need someone who can produce a high volume of ads that convert. Statics, edited video, AI UGC, animated ads. You'll make all of it, and you'll know why each one exists.

*Section 02: The Role*

You'll be the creative engine behind our clients' paid social. This isn't a "make it look pretty" role. Every ad you build has a job: stop the right person mid-scroll, speak to where they are in their buying journey, and get them to act.

You'll produce statics, edit video ads, generate AI UGC, and build animated ads across our client portfolio. You'll study competitor ad libraries, understand the personas we're targeting for each brand, and know which awareness stage a concept is built for before you open Canva or Premiere.

You'll also be the main point of contact for clients on creative testing. That means walking them through what we're testing, why, and what we learned. Clear, confident communication matters as much as the work itself.

*You'll Own:*

* Static ads. Build high-volume static creative using Canva, Arcads, Higgsfield, and proven ad templates. Product shots, comparison ads, testimonial cards, us vs. them, listicles, founder notes, and whatever's working this month.
* Video editing. Edit video ads in Premiere following organic Reels and UGC best practices. Scroll-stopping hooks, native-feeling pacing, clean caption editing, and multiple hook variations per concept.
* AI UGC. Own the full process: write the script, generate the creator and footage with AI tools, and edit it into an ad that feels real and converts.
* Animated video ads. Script, generate, and edit animated and motion ads, from product explainers to problem/solution stories.
* Competitor research. Dig through Meta Ad Library and competitor accounts regularly. Spot the styles, angles, and formats that are working in each category, swipe them, and adapt them to our brands.
* Persona-led creative. Know the personas we're targeting for each brand inside and out. What they care about, what they're skeptical of, how they talk. Write and design for them, not at them.
* Full-funnel ad styles. Build TOF, MOF, and BOF creative and know the difference. A cold-audience hook isn't a retargeting ad, and you don't treat them the same.
* Awareness-stage strategy. Use the 5 stages of awareness (unaware, problem aware, solution aware, product aware, most aware) to shape every concept based on the persona and stage we're targeting.
* Creative testing. Stay current on ecommerce creative testing, from concept vs. iteration testing to hook testing and how Meta's algorithm handles creative diversity. Bring new ideas to the table.
* Client communication. Be the main point of contact for clients on creative testing. Educate them on why we’re testing certain concepts, make revisions when needed.
* Systems. Use AI to systematize and productize your own workflow so we can ship more, faster, without dropping quality.

*Section 03: The Team*

You'll report to the Head of Delivery as well as the CEO, and work alongside:

Head of Delivery: Keeps operations running. She'll set priorities and timelines, and you own your creative deliverables from brief to final export.

Founder/CEO: Sets the overall direction for the agency and our creative offer. Expect direct feedback and fast decisions.

Media Buying Strategist: Your closest working partner. You'll run a tight feedback loop together: they share what's spending, what's converting, and what's fatiguing, and you use that to decide what to build next. Winners get iterated, losers get killed, and new angles get tested.

*Section 04: What We're Looking For*

Must-Haves

* English fluency. You'll be presenting creative and testing results to clients directly. Clear, natural, and confident on calls and in writing.
* 3+ years creating paid social ads for D2C ecommerce brands. You've made statics and video ads that ran on Meta for brands doing real revenue.
* Strong static design skills. You're fast in Canva, comfortable with AI design tools like Arcads and Higgsfield, and know how to pump out statics fast with AI tools and little to no editing needed in Canva. You know what a high-converting static looks like in 2026, not just a pretty one.
* Video editing in Premiere. You understand what makes organic Reels and UGC work: hooks in the first 1 to 3 seconds, pacing, captions, B-roll, and sound.
* Hands-on AI creative experience. You've scripted, generated, and edited AI UGC and/or animated ads, and you know how to make AI output feel human.
* Copy and scripting chops. You can write hooks, scripts, and on-screen text that speak directly to a persona's pain points and desires.
* Funnel and awareness fluency. You know TOF, MOF, and BOF ad styles and the 5 stages of awareness, and you can explain why a concept fits a specific stage.
* Competitor research habits. You already live in ad libraries and know how to swipe a style without copying it.
* Creative testing knowledge. You follow what's happening in ecommerce creative testing and can talk about it confidently.
* Fast learner who loves AI. You're excited to build systems, templates, and AI workflows that make you faster every month.

Nice-to-Haves

* 1+ year working at a performance marketing agency
* Experience managing multiple brands at once
* Motion design skills (After Effects or similar)
* Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS)
* Experience with supplement, beauty, or other regulated categories and their ad compliance rules

*Section 05: What Success Looks Like*

First 30 Days: Learned every client brand, their personas, and their current creative mix. Reviewed each brand's top performers and competitor ad libraries. Shipping statics and video edits on time with no missed deadlines. Set up your core templates and a weekly feedback loop with the Media Buying Strategist.

First 60 Days: Producing a consistent weekly volume of statics, video edits, AI UGC, and animated ads across all clients. Every concept is tagged by persona, funnel stage, and awareness level. Leading creative testing conversations on client calls. At least one AI workflow documented and saving you real time each week.

First 90 Days: Your concepts are producing winners that scale for multiple clients. You're iterating on winners fast. Your AI workflows are documented so the process can be repeated by others. You're the go-to voice on creative strategy in client calls and internal planning.

*Section 06: Why Flax Labs*

#1: Real Impact. Your ads go live and you see how they perform. No creative sitting in a folder for weeks. You'll know exactly which of your concepts are driving revenue.

#2: AI Powered Tools. You'll work with the latest AI creative tools and our proprietary dashboard, which shows how every ad performs. We actively want you to experiment and build better workflows.

#3: Growth Trajectory. As we scale, this role can grow into leading a creative team.

#4: No Bureaucracy. Small team, fast decisions, direct access to the founder. Competitive USD compensation with performance upside as the agency grows.

*How to Apply*

Send an email to hiring@flaxlabs.com using the subject line [First Name Last Name - Application for Flax Creative Designer].

Include in your email:

* A brief intro: who you are, where you're located, and why this role fits.
* Your portfolio, with a mix of statics, edited video ads, and AI-generated ads (AI UGC or animated). Results are a big plus (ROAS, CPA, CTR, hook rate, or spend behind a winner).
* One example of an ad or concept that became a winner for a D2C brand. Who was the persona, what awareness stage were you targeting, what did you make, and what happened? (2-3 paragraphs)
* A short note on the AI tools you use today and one way you've used AI to speed up your workflow.

Please no cover letter templates. No "I'm passionate about making ads that convert." Show us your work. We can't wait to see it!

What you'll own

- Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen/YouTube) and Meta Ads (Advantage+ Sales, prospecting, retargeting), end to end.

- Creative strategy. On Meta especially, creative is the targeting. You'll start from our full-year marketing plan, then expand and adapt it: briefing and testing truly different concepts, writing hooks and copy, and working with our creators and editors to turn raw athlete footage into ads that sell.

You must have

- A creative eye. You can tell why one ad works and another doesn't, and you've got the hit rate to show for it.

- Strong written English. We work async over messages, so clear writing matters more than meetings.

Bonus points

- All ad accounts, pixels, catalogs and billing stay in Loogaroo's name. You get added as a user.

postings.title: Technical Product Owner
postings.descriptionText:
Who is UJV?

Planning and managing a 5-star vacation from scratch requires expertise, cleverness, and a genuine passion for detail. That's what UJV is all about. UJV is a service-driven team of experts that work behind the scenes, engineering luxury travel experiences for advisors globally, so they can grow their business and fully satisfy their exclusive clients.

We are the luxury travel advisor’s right hand. How?

UJV is a team of travel experts that advises and supports luxury travel advisors worldwide.

We work behind the scenes as allies of top luxury travel advisors, to offer a 5 Star experience for their clients.

We offer travel advisors the knowledge and tools needed to grow their business and better serve their exclusive clients.

We offer an experience-centered service based on passion, expertise, integrity

and attention to detail.

We are willing to do the hard work in order to see our clients shine.

Role Mission

The Technical Product Owner leads the strategy and delivery of UJV's e-commerce platform: the B2B, B2C, client, advisor, partner, and white-label online booking portals, and the API integrations behind them. Together, these products shape how UJV does business with clients, advisors, partners, and vendors. You will sit at the intersection of users, business, and technology: understanding what each audience needs, deciding what is worth building, and working with engineering to bring it to life.

As product owner, you will define the vision and roadmap, prioritize with a clear view of impact and effort, and measure success through adoption and business results. You will work hands-on, using customer research, data, and AI-enabled tools to test ideas early and make confident decisions. This is a high-visibility role for someone who enjoys real ownership, thrives in a small and fast-moving team, and wants to build the technology behind a leading luxury travel brand.

You will also serve as UJV's product practice lead. Several leaders across reservations operations, the Admin platform, and supplier inventory (the Product Vault) own products without the PM title, and part of your role is to make them stronger at scoping, prioritizing, writing requirements, and measuring adoption. You lead by example and by coaching, not by authority.

Responsibilities
Product Ownership and Roadmap

Own the roadmap, backlog, and prioritization for UJV's e-commerce platform (B2B, B2C, client, advisor, partner, and white-label online booking portals, including API integrations), turning business goals into multi-quarter roadmaps and quarterly goals.

Act as the single point of product ownership: the one person engineering, operations, and leadership go to for product decisions.

Lock requirements and acceptance criteria before each sprint, and manage change through the roadmap rather than mid-cycle.

Decide what will not be built this sprint or quarter, protecting a coherent experience for advisors, hotels, partners, and clients.

Discovery and Prototyping

Stay close to the user's pain points: run discovery directly with advisors and hotel partners, including time embedded with hotel operations.

Build working prototypes and applications with AI tools (such as Lovable, Cursor, or Claude) to validate workflows before engineering commits.

Translate user pain points into clear technical requirements, with cost, impact, and effort made explicit for each.

Adoption, Analytics, and Observability

Own adoption, not just delivery: drive advisor activation, search-to-booking conversion, and bookings.

Define and instrument product analytics from day one, including activation funnels, conversion, performance, and failure points, and report on them in the weekly leadership meeting.

Set non-functional acceptance criteria with engineering, including performance on production-scale data.

Cross-Team Partnership

Direct the Portal engineering team and any external build partners on product priorities, acting as the bridge so engineers do not have to field raw user requests.

Sequence which inventory and verticals (hotels, services, packaging, and beyond) reach the Portal together with the Product Vault owner, and coordinate shared trip-building logic with the Admin product owner.

Partner with Hotel Partnerships on hotel relationships, reporting, and co-op marketing; with Marketing on the public site and landing pages; and with Data on reporting.

Work with the Tech Lead to design and embed AI assistants and agentic workflows into the portals.

Backlog and Prioritization

Own the Jira backlog for the portals end to end: intake, triage, prioritization, ticket quality, and sprint readiness. A ticket without a clear problem statement, acceptance criteria, and test cases does not enter the sprint.

Run one prioritization system across Jira (engineering execution, bugs, QC) and Asana (business requests, cross-department projects, quarterly rocks), so every request has one home, one owner, and one priority. If you bring better tickets or want to build one, we are open to explore buy vs build.

Run weekly backlog grooming with engineering leads and external build partners, and publish what moved up, what moved down, and what was cut, with the reason.

Trace every ticket to a quarterly rock or roadmap item, and challenge work that cannot be traced.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For:

To support the expansion of Zebra’s market share by managing and nurturing relationships with assigned accounts and channel partners. A Junior KAM at Zebra acts as a strategic bridge, driving transactional and moderately complex solution sales (such as Mobile Computing, Barcode Scanning, RFID, and Software solutions) across key verticals. The role operates under general supervision, making decisions of moderate complexity that directly impact project deliverables, and exercising professional judgment to assess operational trade-offs.
1. Account Management & Relationship Building
Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within assigned accounts.
Identify opportunities to upsell and cross-sell within existing accounts to maximize revenue potential and increase Zebra’s wallet share.
Work closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., technical pre-sales, marketing, product development, and channel operations) to ensure seamless service delivery and high customer satisfaction.
2. Strategic Sales Execution
Develop and execute comprehensive sales strategies aligned with both Zebra's organizational goals and customer business objectives.
Apply solution-selling techniques to propose tailored products and services that effectively address customer challenges and deliver measurable business results.
Meet or exceed individual sales quotas , revenue targets, and customer satisfaction benchmarks.
3. Solution Expertise & Market Alignment
Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Zebra products, solutions, and technologies to effectively address customer needs and provide tailored recommendations.
Contribute to the development of business products and services while understanding, respecting, and adhering to multi-business protocols and internal guidelines.
Monitor industry trends and competitor activities to position Zebra's solutions effectively in the market.
Decision-Making & Autonomy (Scope of Work)
Work under general supervision , receiving guidance on overall objectives but owning the tactical execution.
Make decisions of moderate complexity that directly impact project deliverables and account milestones.
Exercise judgment in approach , demonstrating the agility to assess situations and handle trade-offs when navigating client or channel requirements.
Requirements & Competencies
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related technology field.
Experience: 1.5 to 3 years of experience in B2B technology sales, Inside Sales, or Channel Account Management (experience in hardware distribution, telecom, or SaaS is a plus).
Key Systems: Familiarity with CRM tools (ideally Salesforce / SFDC) to track opportunities and manage sales pipelines.
Language: Advanced / Fluent English (essential for interacting with regional leadership and global teams).
1. B2B Sales & Account Management Basics
Relationship Management: Ability to nurture, build, and maintain long-term trust-based relationships with key decision-makers and partner ecosystems .
Sales Cycle Management: Familiarity with the end-to-end B2B sales cycle, including prospecting, qualifying leads, managing pipeline health, and closing deals .
Pipeline & Forecast Accuracy: Proficiency in tracking sales opportunities, utilizing CRM software (preferably Salesforce / SFDC ), and submitting weekly sales forecasts .
2. Business & Financial Acumen
Solution Selling & ROI Articulation: Ability to clearly communicate the Return on Investment (ROI) of Zebra's hardware and software portfolios to address operational pain points (e.g., reducing shrinkage, accelerating fulfillment, improving asset visibility) .
Market & Competitive Intelligence: Capability to conduct basic competitor analysis and pricing reviews to effectively position Zebra against competitors .
3. Channel & Partner Enablement (Zebra’s Core Model)
Indirect Sales Ecosystems: Understanding of how to sell through and support distributors, Tier 1/2 resellers, and independent software vendors (ISVs) .
Co-Marketing & Funding: Basic knowledge of driving joint business activities and coordinating Marketing Development Funds (MDF) to support partner campaigns .
Joint Business Planning (JBP): Supporting senior sales leaders in developing basic joint plans with partners to capture larger market wallet share .
4. Technical Aptitude & Zebra Portfolio Familiarity
Product Knowledge: Readiness to learn and build a basic-to-moderate understanding of Zebra's core portfolio, including: Enterprise Mobile Computers & Tablets . Barcode Scanners & Thermal Printers . RFID & Locationing Technologies . SaaS / Enterprise Software Solutions .
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to sync with Solutions Engineers, Technical Support, and Product Managers to resolve minor technical compatibility issues during a sale .
5. Soft Skills & Productivity Tools
Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills: Confident in delivering product demonstrations and business reviews virtual or over the phone .
Agile Mindset & Proactivity: High degree of self-motivation, a strong work ethic, and adaptability in a fast-paced technology landscape .
MS Office Proficiency: Advanced skill level in MS Excel (for data and pricing reviews), PowerPoint (for customer presentations), and Outlook .
Ideal Candidate Requirements (Qualifications)
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related technology field .
Experience: 1.5 to 3 years of experience in B2B tech sales, Inside Sales, or Channel Account Management (hardware or SaaS background is highly preferred) .
Language: Advanced or fluent English communication skills (written and spoken) .

Benefits:

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

Job Posting Statement:

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. B2B Software Sales Representative
Philippines, South Africa, Latin America
Remote

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing, early-stage B2B SaaS company serving field service and operations businesses. Sales has been founder-led to date, and this is the first dedicated sales hire, giving the right person real influence over how the sales function is built. The company sells both software subscriptions and professional services and onboarding packages.

About the Role

We're looking for a B2B Software Sales Representative to be the first dedicated sales hire, owning the entire sales funnel end to end: inbound lead response, outbound prospecting, discovery, demo, proposal, and close. This is not an appointment-setting role.

You'll be the single sales seat reporting directly to the founder, with full ownership of pipeline, CRM hygiene, SOP execution, and closing. If you're a proven closer who can work independently, follow a documented process without being micromanaged, and take genuine ownership of revenue outcomes in an early-stage environment, this role is a strong fit.

Responsibilities

Own the complete sales cycle from research and outreach through qualification, demo, proposal, close, and handoff to onboarding
Respond to inbound leads immediately via call, email, and SMS as defined in the sales SOP, as speed to lead is a hard expectation
Run structured discovery conversations covering pain, current tools, decision process, timeline, and budget signals
Lead product demos with support from the customer success team
Send proposals and quotes, chase signatures, and confirm kickoff details for every won deal
Close both software subscription plans and professional services and onboarding packages
Research target accounts, build call lists, and run a consistent cold and warm outbound motion alongside inbound response
Own CRM management day to day, including pipeline stages, tags, sequences, and logging every touch, keeping next steps, close dates, and notes current
Provide light weekly reporting on activity, pipeline, wins, losses, and blockers
Feed product and marketing teams with call insights, including ICP feedback, common objections, and feature requests
Help refine scripts, talk tracks, and ICP definitions as sales scales from founder-led to team-led
Handle objections and negotiate within approved pricing guidelines, escalating edge cases to leadership

What We're Looking For

Proven experience closing, or strongly contributing to closing, B2B software or high-consideration sales (not appointment setting only)
Excellent spoken English with the confidence and presence to lead live demos and discovery calls independently
Self-directed, high-ownership mindset, comfortable being the only salesperson reporting directly to a founder
Strong CRM discipline, with the ability to follow a documented sales SOP consistently without being reminded
Reliable availability during US business hours with strong outbound phone skills

Nice to Have

Spanish language skills for communicating with Spanish-speaking clients
Experience selling to SMB, field service, or trade service businesses
Prior experience as an early or first sales hire at a startup
Familiarity with CRM tools such as HubSpot or GoHighLevel

Work Schedule

100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
This position operates on a full-time basis, with dedicated hours to ensure alignment with the team and delivery of quality work
Availability during US business hours

Compensation & Time Off

Compensation paid in USD
Paid bi-monthly on the 15th and 30th
Additional financial incentives for professional services closings
Paid Time Off according to company policy
Holidays observed according to company guidelines

Application Requirements

Please submit:

An updated resume
A 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, describing your full-cycle B2B sales experience, and walking through a deal you owned from first contact through close, including how you ran discovery and handled objections

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

Atención de la casilla de productos para colaboradores BP

Con el respaldo de Banco Patagonia y Banco do Brasil, la entidad bancaria más importante de Latinoamérica, ofrecemos productos financieros altamente competitivos, posicionándonos entre los 3 líderes del mercado prendario argentino de los últimos 10 años.

Este nuevo paso reafirma la estrategia de crecimiento de Banco Patagonia, respaldada en su solidez institucional, solvencia, seriedad y transparencia.
En el año 2018 modificamos nuestra denominación y nos convertimos en GPAT Compañía Financiera S.A.U., al ser Banco Patagonia S.A. nuestro único accionista.

Somos un equipo especializado, con profundo conocimiento del mercado de financiamiento de vehículos.

postings.title: Ejecutiva de Ventas B2B | Captación de Empresas y Llamadas en Frío
postings.descriptionText:
*Publipromo Spain* es una agencia de marketing directo que ayuda a empresas de toda España a captar nuevos clientes y generar oportunidades de negocio.

Buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo una *comercial B2B con experiencia en prospección telefónica y venta consultiva*, que disfrute captando clientes, generando oportunidades y cerrando ventas.

_*¿Qué harás?*_

* Realizar llamadas en frío a empresas para presentar nuestros servicios y captar nuevos clientes.
* Identificar oportunidades comerciales y detectar necesidades.
* Gestionar objeciones, negociar y avanzar hacia el cierre de ventas.
* Preparar y realizar seguimiento de propuestas y presupuestos.
* Gestionar y fidelizar clientes, buscando nuevas oportunidades comerciales.
* Utilizar herramientas digitales e inteligencia artificial para apoyar las tareas comerciales.

*Importante:* la prospección telefónica es una parte esencial del puesto. La actividad puede alcanzar aproximadamente las 100 llamadas diarias, entre captación y seguimiento comercial.

_*¿Qué buscamos?*_

* *Perfil comercial con trayectoria profesional consolidada*, experiencia demostrable en ventas B2B, seguridad en la comunicación, autonomía y capacidad para desenvolverse en un entorno comercial dinámico.
* Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en prospección comercial, call center o ventas telefónicas. No solo en atención al cliente.
* Experiencia demostrable realizando llamadas en frío, preferiblemente B2B.
* Buena comunicación, capacidad de persuasión y orientación a resultados.
* Experiencia trabajando con objetivos comerciales.
* Organización, autonomía y facilidad para aprender nuevas herramientas.
* Constancia, iniciativa y capacidad para desenvolverse ante situaciones nuevas.

Valoraremos especialmente la experiencia en *venta consultiva B2B y comercialización de servicios para empresas*.

_*¿Qué ofrecemos?*_

* Trabajo 100 % remoto desde Argentina.
* Remuneración de *USD 1.500 a 2.000 mensuales*, según jornada, experiencia y objetivos.
* Contrato indefinido.
* Horario de lunes a viernes, de *10:30 a 19:30 h (hora de España)*, fijo.
* Formación inicial remunerada según las condiciones acordadas.
* Incorporación progresiva: etapa inicial de formación y evaluación a tiempo parcial, con paso a jornada completa al superarla.

_*¿Te interesa?*_

Si tienes experiencia captando clientes mediante llamadas en frío y te gusta trabajar con objetivos comerciales, ¡nos encantará conocerte!

Responde a las preguntas de postulación con información concreta sobre tu experiencia.

*IMPORTANTE — ANTES DE POSTULARTE*

Asegúrate de que tu CV refleje claramente tu experiencia en *prospección telefónica, llamadas en frío y ventas comerciales*.

Al responder las preguntas, indica *en qué empresa realizabas esas funciones*, especialmente si mencionas experiencia haciendo llamadas de captación.

La información proporcionada debe ser coherente con tu trayectoria laboral. *Las candidaturas cuya experiencia no pueda identificarse o verificarse serán descartadas del proceso de selección.*

Sueldo: $1.500,00 - $2.000,00 al mes

Pregunta(s) de postulación:
* 1. ¿Cuántas llamadas realizabas por día haciendo prospección o llamadas en frío? Indica la empresa y el período trabajado.
* 2. Si un cliente está interesado pero deja de responderte después de varios contactos, ¿Qué harías?
* 3. Estás teniendo un día complicado con muchas llamadas, varios “no” y estás lejos de tu objetivo. ¿Cómo reaccionas?
* 4. Si te encuentras con algo que no sabes hacer o no sabes responder, ¿Qué haces primero?
* 5. ¿Qué es lo que más te gusta de vender y qué es lo que menos?
* 6. En el puesto utilizamos herramientas de IA (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) para crear y adaptar contenidos, investigar y resolver tareas. ¿Qué herramientas de IA utilizas actualmente y para qué?

Lugar de trabajo: Empleo remoto

postings.title: General Medicines Product Manager
postings.descriptionText:
En GSK, trabajamos para adelantarnos a las enfermedades y mejorar la salud de millones de personas. Buscamos un profesional con visión estratégica, mentalidad analítica y pasión por el marketing que quiera contribuir al crecimiento sostenible de nuestras marcas y transformar la manera en que nos conectamos con los profesionales de la salud.

Como Product Manager, serás responsable de desarrollar e implementar la estrategia integral de las marcas asignadas, impulsando su crecimiento, posicionamiento y desempeño comercial a través de una combinación efectiva de estrategia de marca, marketing omnicanal y decisiones basadas en datos e insights.

Trabajarás de manera transversal con equipos de Ventas, Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, Supply Chain y Finanzas para convertir las oportunidades del mercado en iniciativas concretas, generar experiencias relevantes para los profesionales de la salud y maximizar el impacto de las inversiones promocionales.

Este rol ofrece la oportunidad de combinar pensamiento estratégico, análisis de negocio y ejecución práctica, liderando iniciativas e influyendo en equipos multifuncionales para alcanzar objetivos compartidos.

Principales responsabilidades

Estrategia de marca y crecimiento del negocio: Desarrollar e implementar los planes estratégicos y operativos de las marcas asignadas, definiendo posicionamiento, segmentación, targeting, propuesta de valor y prioridades promocionales para impulsar el crecimiento sostenible, la participación de mercado y la rentabilidad.
Estrategia y ejecución omnicanal: Transformar la estrategia de marca en campañas y journeys integrados, combinando canales presenciales y digitales, contenido relevante, capacidades CRM e insights de clientes para ofrecer experiencias consistentes, personalizadas y medibles a los profesionales de la salud (HCP).
Contenido y excelencia promocional: Liderar la planificación de contenidos y la ejecución de campañas en colaboración con equipos multifuncionales y agencias externas, asegurando el desarrollo, la adaptación, la aprobación, el despliegue y la actualización oportuna de los materiales promocionales, de acuerdo con los requisitos regulatorios y las políticas internas.
Analítica, desempeño comercial y forecasting: Analizar resultados de ventas, participación de mercado, tendencias competitivas, efectividad promocional, presupuestos y retorno de inversión (ROI). Generar insights accionables, desarrollar forecasts y contribuir a la planificación de demanda para respaldar decisiones comerciales y favorecer la disponibilidad de producto.
Liderazgo e influencia multifuncional: Colaborar con Ventas, Medical, Regulatory, Market Access, Supply Chain, Finanzas y Commercial Operations para alinear prioridades de marca, fortalecer la efectividad de la fuerza de ventas y movilizar stakeholders hacia objetivos comunes, ejerciendo liderazgo por influencia y promoviendo una ejecución coordinada.
Excelencia operativa y mejora continua: Gestionar presupuestos promocionales y prioridades operativas, coordinar actividades de planificación de demanda y muestras médicas cuando corresponda, e identificar oportunidades para optimizar procesos, mejorar la efectividad de las campañas y fortalecer los resultados del negocio mediante decisiones basadas en datos.

Requisitos esenciales

Título universitario en Marketing, Administración de Empresas, Publicidad, Comunicación, Farmacia, Bioquímica, Medicina, Economía, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.
4 años de experiencia profesional en la industria farmacéutica, marketing, gestión de marcas, excelencia comercial u omnicanalidad.
Experiencia en el desarrollo e implementación de planes de marca, campañas promocionales y estrategias orientadas al crecimiento del negocio.
Experiencia trabajando con equipos de ventas y fuerza de visita médica, con exposición a presupuestos, forecasts y análisis de desempeño comercial.
Experiencia en marketing digital, CRM, desarrollo de contenidos y ejecución de campañas o journeys omnicanal.

Requisitos deseables

Experiencia como Product Manager, Associate Product Manager o en posiciones equivalentes con responsabilidad sobre marcas y resultados comerciales.
Experiencia en marcas establecidas, General Medicines, compañías multinacionales o iniciativas de alcance regional.
Participación en proyectos de transformación digital, automatización de marketing o mejora de la experiencia de los profesionales de la salud.
MBA o posgrado en Marketing, Negocios, Dirección Comercial o áreas relacionadas.
Formación complementaria en marketing digital, estrategia omnicanal, analítica de datos, automatización de marketing o gestión de proyectos.

Skills

Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Marketing Campaign Planning, Marketing Measurement, Marketing Strategy Implementation, Omnichannel Marketing, Scientific Literacy

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Liderará el desarrollo de una estrategia centrada en el cliente, alineada con los objetivos generales del negocio, identificando oportunidades clave para fortalecer el relacionamiento y la satisfacción. ¿Listo para comenzar?

Experiencia con gestión de proyectos ágiles y liderazgo de equipos multifuncionales.

Agilidad y creatividad: Flexibilidad para ajustar estrategias en tiempo real según el feedback de clientes y los cambios del mercado, con creatividad para crear experiencias diferenciadoras e innovadoras.
Colaboración y alineación estratégica: Habilidad para trabajar eficazmente con Brand Leads y equipos multifuncionales, asegurando la coherencia entre las estrategias de relacionamiento y de marca, y actuando como modelo de los comportamientos PTW.
Dominio digital y metodologías modernas: Conocimiento de herramientas digitales de relacionamiento, aplicación de IA para personalizar interacciones, y manejo de metodologías como Agile, Scrum, Lean Startup, Nudge y Design Thinking.
Conocimiento técnico y regulatorio del sector: Comprensión de regulaciones locales, estándares éticos de salud, HCPs, clientes clave, canales de interacción y Customer Journey.

postings.title: Document & Business Solutions - Operations Team Leader - Print / Mail Center
postings.descriptionText:
JOB DESCRIPTION

As an Operations Team Leader (Print / Mail Center), you will work in a hands-on production role supporting high-volume print center operations. You will produce, finish, and distribute customer print requests while meeting established service-level agreements (SLAs), quality standards, compliance requirements, and productivity targets. You may be required to provide coverage across multiple production locations and shifts based on business need. You will also deliver mail and create print and document products. In partnership with your direct manager, you will coordinate daily mail activities and support clients with document preparation, using digital and technical products in line with global control procedures.

Schedule & Work Arrangement

Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
100% onsite (in-office) role; no remote/hybrid arrangement.

Flexibility / Coverage Requirements

Must be flexible to work additional hours, including early/late coverage, and on occasions at the weekends as business needs require (e.g., peak production periods, urgent client deadlines, outages, or special projects).

Key Responsibilities

Operate high-volume production print equipment (digital print engines/MFDs) and associated finishing systems (binding, folding, cutting, stapling, punching, laminating, etc.).
Produce and release print jobs accurately from queue to completion, (print settings, paper selection, finishing instructions) and reprints as needed.
Perform print finishing and bindery work to specification, including booklets and other finishing methods used at the site.
Receive, prioritize, and process incoming and outgoing production work; validate job tickets and ensure accurate delivery/packaging/distribution.
Maintain intermediate recordkeeping and tracking (job logs, volumes, turnaround, exceptions, rework) per management requirements.
Identify non-compliant activities (e.g., confidentiality handling, release errors, process deviations, unsafe practices) and escalate appropriately.
Provide first-line troubleshooting for print/finishing equipment (clearing jams, replacing consumables, basic calibration steps) and coordinate service calls when required.
Manage inventory for print supplies and finishing materials (paper, toner, binding spines/coils, covers, etc.); support replenishment and fulfillment.
Respond to end-user inquiries regarding print requests, timelines, delivery options, and service capabilities; provide clear status updates and set expectations.
Support broader DBS operational functions as needed (e.g., scanning, mail/receiving, distribution, overnight shipping, courier coordination, manifests/documentation).
Operating functional equipment and related technologies; including mail, printing, scanning, inserting, sortation, confidential paper bins and other equipment, as applicable.
Scan documents/files and integrate into agreed digital mail or other document workflow/depositories.
Handle receipt and collection of mail and courier items including x-ray screening, required manifest(s) and documentation.
Resolve discrepancies, perform research for complex inquiries, and complete escalations through defined channels.
Participate in cross-training and continuous improvement efforts; recommend process improvements to increase quality, reduce rework, and improve turnaround times.
Other duties as assigned, including potential rotation between multiple locations within the state/country and variation in work hours to meet coverage needs.

Necessary Skills & Experience

Demonstrated experience in a high-volume print center / production print environment, including machine printing and bindery/finishing operations.
Strong attention to detail and deadlines; commitment to safeguarding confidential and personal information.
Ability to follow direction, show initiative, and independently drive tasks to completion in a production setting.
Strong customer service orientation; able to communicate professionally with end users and partners.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced team environment with fluctuating priorities and SLA-driven delivery.
Self-motivated with proven ability to learn; proactive in cross-training and using downtime to build skills.
Ability to recommend process improvements and contribute to team initiatives/meetings.
Reliable, responsible, and accountable; accepts constructive feedback and collaborates effectively.
Ability to resolve complicated problems and escalate appropriately when needed.
Basic understanding of risk and control for the activities responsible; awareness and maintenance of safe working practices related to Health & Safety.
Ability to guide and train others and allocate tasks according to priority and timeframe.
Proficiency with basic business technology and advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook including email and calendar).
Strong oral and written communication skills.
Intermediate written and spoken English and communication skills.
High school diploma or equivalent required.
ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

Integrations & System Reliability

Qualifications

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

Success Metrics
Fast, reliable response times to inbound requests
Reduction in workflow errors and system issues
Improved data cleanliness and CRM accuracy
Increased efficiency and performance of automation and sequences
Strong adoption and satisfaction from internal teams

What We’re Looking For

Highly responsive and dependable during U.S. working hours overlap
Self-starter who does not require step-by-step direction

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities

Freelance Creative Strategist / Copywriter

Role Summary

Big ideas. Sharp copy. Creative that moves.
Alpha Lion is building a network of freelance Creative Strategists and Copywriters who know how to turn customer insight into performance creative that wins. You'll research audiences, uncover compelling angles, write scroll-stopping concepts and scripts, and use real results to make the next idea stronger. This is a remote freelance opportunity with the potential to grow into a longer-term or full-time role based on performance, business needs, and mutual fit.
This posting supports an ongoing talent pool, so project timing and weekly hours may vary.

What You'll Do
Turn customer research, market signals, competitor activity, and performance data into original creative concepts.
Develop sharp angles, hooks, scripts, briefs, and ad copy for paid-social creative.
Build concepts around customer awareness, motivations, objections, and the language people actually use.
Partner with editors, designers, creators, and media buyers to bring ideas from brief to finished asset.
Review creative performance and explain why an ad won, lost, or deserves another iteration.
Transform winning ideas into thoughtful new tests without simply producing surface-level variations.
Manage your assignments independently, communicate clearly, and deliver polished work on schedule.
Help Alpha Lion build a faster, smarter, more repeatable creative-testing engine.

What Success Looks Like
Your concepts are grounded in clear customer insight and a defensible testing hypothesis.
Briefs and scripts reach production on time and require minimal clarification.
Creative partners describe your direction and feedback as clear, decisive, and useful.
Performance learnings consistently inform stronger concepts and iterations.
You demonstrate the judgment, reliability, and results needed for expanded assignments or a potential full-time opportunity.

What You Bring
Demonstrated experience in DTC/eCommerce creative strategy, direct-response copywriting, or both.
A portfolio featuring paid-social concepts, scripts, briefs, or copy that you personally helped create.
A strong understanding of customer research, consumer psychology, awareness levels, hooks, angles, and creative testing.
The ability to connect creative decisions to performance—not just personal taste.
Experience collaborating with video editors, designers, creators, or media-buying teams.
Clear written communication, dependable follow-through, and comfort working independently in a remote environment.
Familiarity with Meta performance creative; experience with TikTok, YouTube, VSLs, UGC, health, wellness, supplements, or fitness is a plus.
Openness to beginning with freelance assignments and, where there is mutual fit, exploring a longer-term or full-time opportunity.

Liderar y desarrollar al equipo de ejecución de campo (Repositores y Merchandisers) para impulsar el crecimiento de las ventas y garantizar una ejecución y visibilidad de excelencia de las marcas Ferrero en los puntos de venta del territorio asignado.

Construir relaciones sólidas con los clientes, capitalizar oportunidades comerciales y utilizar información del mercado y de la ejecución para definir acciones que contribuyan al cumplimiento de los objetivos del territorio.

Gestionar los procesos de selección, contratación, desvinculación, desempeño y provisión de materiales de trabajo del equipo de merchandisers y repositores, coordinando con recursos humanos y el gerente del sector, para garantizar que el equipo cuente con los recursos necesarios y cumpla con los estándares operativos.
Desarrollar al equipo mediante formación continua en categorías, visibilidad, calidad, promoción y relaciones interpersonales, aplicando planes de capacitación específicos, para fortalecer sus competencias y asegurar una ejecución de excelencia en el punto de venta.
Planificar, organizar y ejecutar la ruta de trabajo del territorio asignado, priorizando clientes y oportunidades según su potencial, frecuencia de visita, objetivos y lineamientos comerciales.
Mantener las rutas actualizadas y asegurar su cumplimiento, optimizando la asignación de los recursos de merchandising de acuerdo con las prioridades comerciales y necesidades de cada cliente.
Garantizar una ejecución de excelencia de acuerdo con la estrategia My Perfect Store y los Action Standards definidos para cada categoría y canal.

Supervisar la implementación de todas las actividades de venta y eventos definidos por la compañía, coordinando con equipos internos y externos, para asegurar su correcta ejecución en tiempo y forma en cada punto de contacto con el consumidor.
