postings.descriptionText:
Financial Analyst & Reporting Specialist

Remote from LATAM | Full-Time | MST Hours | USD 2,800 – 3,800/month

About the Opportunity

A fast-growing U.S.-based financial consulting firm is seeking a Financial Analyst & Reporting Specialist to support its Fractional CFO services division. This role is ideal for someone with a strong background in financial forecasting, modeling, reporting, and business analysis who enjoys turning data into actionable insights.

The company partners primarily with 7- and 8-figure service-based businesses across industries such as beauty, med spa, interior design, and related sectors. The selected candidate will play a key role in helping clients improve financial visibility, optimize performance, and make strategic business decisions.

This is a highly collaborative and proactive role that combines financial analysis, reporting oversight, and strategic support. Candidates must be comfortable working during U.S. business hours.

Key Responsibilities
Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow Management

Build and manage annual budgets and rolling forecasts for multiple clients.

Develop financial models to evaluate revenue trends, cost structures, and profitability.

Monitor cash flow activity and identify opportunities to optimize working capital.

Conduct scenario planning and “what-if” analysis to support strategic decision-making.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports with clear insights and recommendations.

Perform variance analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

Build and maintain KPI dashboards using financial reporting platforms such as Fathom HQ or similar tools.

Translate complex financial data into actionable business recommendations.

Monitor financial performance indicators to support growth strategies.

Data Quality & Financial Oversight

Collaborate with the bookkeeping team to review monthly close outputs and flag anomalies or inconsistencies.

Apply GAAP knowledge to identify issues in financial records and escalate concerns when necessary.

Work within accounting systems such as QuickBooks, Xero, or similar platforms to organize and analyze financial data.

Recommend process improvements to enhance reporting accuracy and operational efficiency.

Strategic Support & Client Deliverables

Provide recommendations related to cost savings, profitability, and revenue optimization.

Prepare financial presentations and client-facing materials for CFO-led engagements.

Partner closely with leadership to align reporting with business goals and strategic initiatives.

Stay informed on industry trends, financial regulations, and best practices.

Team Collaboration & Ownership

Contribute proactively to financial strategy discussions and internal process improvements.

Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure financial recommendations align with operational realities.

Take ownership of deliverables and ensure reports and analyses are accurate, timely, and valuable.

Communicate financial concepts clearly to both internal stakeholders and external clients.

Qualifications

3+ years of experience in financial analysis, FP&A, or financial reporting within a U.S.-based company.

Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, cash flow analysis, and financial modeling.

Proficiency in QuickBooks.

Experience with Fathom HQ or similar reporting platforms preferred.

Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills, including financial modeling, pivot tables, and complex formulas.

Strong analytical mindset with exceptional attention to detail.

Comfortable reviewing transactional-level financial data for accuracy and quality control.

Self-starter with a proactive and solutions-oriented approach.

Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Availability to collaborate during U.S. business hours.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

Work directly alongside experienced Fractional CFO professionals.

Gain exposure to high-revenue service-based businesses across multiple industries.

Play an active role in strategic financial decision-making.

Enjoy a remote-first environment with structured processes and long-term growth potential.

Take ownership of meaningful financial deliverables that directly impact client success.

postings.descriptionText:
Your Work Context

As a Junior Accounting Analyst at Jan De Nul in Argentina- Vía Navegable Argentina (VNA), you support the financial and administrative processes of our local activities. Our projects keep open the navigation channels that carry Argentina's exports to sea, deepen and maintain river and coastal ports, and build land reclamation and coastal protection schemes. You will work in a dynamic international environment and gain valuable experience along the way.

To keep our activities in Argentina running smoothly, we need accurate, structured and proactive people who ensure that invoices are properly documented, reviewed and approved on time. We are looking for a Junior Accounting Analyst to join our team and support the invoice administration and approval process, working closely with colleagues, service requesters and management.

Your Role

As a Junior Accounting Analyst, you will support the team in the administrative processing and follow-up of supplier invoices.

Your responsibilities will include:

Receiving and registering supplier invoices and organizing the related information in Excel.
Identifying, collecting and checking the supporting documentation required for each invoice.
Contacting the colleagues who requested the services and the relevant managers to obtain invoice approvals.
Drafting and sending emails requesting approvals and following up on outstanding items.
Processing the responses received and requesting any missing information or documentation.
Maintaining accurate and up-to-date Excel files and ensuring that invoice records and supporting documents are properly organized.
Using Outlook to manage correspondence, track pending approvals and coordinate with the relevant stakeholders.
Ensuring that invoices are properly documented and that the approval process progresses in a timely and organized manner.
Of course, you will not be doing this on your own: you can rely on the support of colleagues who will guide you through the processes and help you develop your accounting skills.
Your Base in Buenos Aires
You will be based at our office in Buenos Aires, working from Monday to Friday. The position starts with a six-month contract, with the possibility of permanent employment depending on business needs and performance.

What Do You Need to Have?

You are organized, accurate and proactive, with an eye for detail. You enjoy working with information, keeping track of pending tasks and following up with different people to make sure things get done.
Studies in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics or a related field.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Outlook, particularly for managing invoice records, documentation and email follow-ups.
Basic to intermediate English skills, especially written English, to understand and occasionally reply to emails.
Good communication skills and the ability to follow up with colleagues and managers in a professional and constructive way.
A structured approach to work, attention to detail and the ability to organize and prioritize tasks.
Initiative, willingness to learn and adaptability to new processes.
The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with the wider team.
The ability to manage deadlines and follow up on outstanding items consistently.
You live in or near Buenos Aires and are entitled to work here.
Working at Jan De Nul
An initial six-month employment contract, with the possibility of permanent employment
A salary package that includes medical insurance.
A caring culture through our 4 corporate programmes (LEARN, FIT, SHIFT and S.A.F.E.): o LEARN stimulates a learning culture that triggers all Can-Do people to learn continuously and take ownership of their learning journey.o FIT allows us to monitor your well-being. The programme is centred around exercise, food and a healthy work-life balance.o SHIFT: we want sustainability to be part of everything we do. This requires a new way of thinking and acting: a shift towards bold ideas, smarter solutions and long-term thinking.o S.A.F.E. unites us in our commitment to achieve equal safety standards for every co-worker at Jan De Nul.

The world is what you make it

Jan De Nul Group shapes water and land around the world, addressing some of the most important challenges of our time. We boost the energy transition with infrastructure for renewable offshore energy. We focus on nature-inclusive dredging solutions to build harbours and protect our coastlines from the rising sea. We develop innovative construction projects for smart mobility and durable buildings. And we invest in planet redevelopment, giving new purpose to polluted sites. At Jan De Nul, the world is what you make it.Jan De Nul Group promotes diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We are an equal opportunities and anti-discrimination employer.

Financial Services
Working at Jan De Nul
On projects worldwide
Education
Bachelor's degree

postings.title: Head of Financial Planning
postings.descriptionText:
Overview

World Business Lenders (WBL) provides general-purpose, short-term, real estate-collateralized commercial loans to small and medium-sized businesses throughout the United States that may not have access to traditional sources of funding. WBL is a U.S.-based company.
Typically, the work schedule is from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, though additional hours may be required based on business needs.

About the Role

The Head of Financial Planning is responsible for budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and management reporting across WBL. The position leads the FP&A team and works closely with department heads to assess performance, plan expenditures, and evaluate business decisions. Responsibilities include consolidated financial forecasts, portfolio and capital planning, and presentations to executive management, investors, and the board. The successful candidate will be an experienced finance leader who can direct the function while remaining closely involved in financial modeling and analysis.

Key Responsibilities

Direct company-wide budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and management reporting.
Manage the annual budget, periodic reforecasts, and long-term financial plans, including departmental submissions, planning assumptions, and deadlines.
Develop and maintain consolidated income statement, balance sheet, and cash-flow forecasts, incorporating operating expense and headcount plans.
Oversee origination and loan portfolio forecasting, including nonperforming loans (NPL), real estate owned (REO), recoveries, and the financial impact of portfolio performance.
Forecast cash requirements, liquidity, financing facility utilization, and covenant compliance in coordination with Accounting and Treasury; evaluate capital needs under different business scenarios.
Build and review financial models, scenario analyses, and sensitivity analyses to assess growth plans, financing alternatives, and changes in business conditions.
Evaluate channel and product profitability, unit economics, pricing, and proposed business initiatives.
Prepare management reports comparing actual results with budgets and forecasts, explain significant variances, and recommend corrective actions.
Work with department heads to review assumptions, assess staffing and expenditure requests, and address financial and operating performance.
Prepare and present financial plans, forecasts, performance analyses, and recommendations to executive teams, investors, and boards.
Apply U.S. GAAP and IFRS to financial planning and reporting, working with Accounting to ensure forecasts reflect the appropriate accounting treatment.
Manage FP&A team leaders and analysts, assign priorities, review work, and provide coaching and performance feedback.
Establish and maintain controls over financial models and reports, including documented assumptions, supporting schedules, reconciliations, version control, and change logs.
Standardize and automate recurring planning and reporting processes, resolve data discrepancies with the responsible departments, and oversee financial analysis for due diligence and other special projects.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

At least 20 years of progressive finance experience, including a minimum of eight years leading FP&A or financial planning teams.
Demonstrated experience in a senior finance leadership role.
Extensive, hands-on knowledge of both U.S. GAAP and IFRS, with demonstrated ability to apply both frameworks to financial planning and reporting.
Expertise in financial modeling and scenario analysis.
A proven record of working with department heads and presenting financial plans, results, and recommendations to executive teams, investors, and boards.
A recognized professional qualification, such as CPA, CA, or equivalent, and a degree in finance, accounting, or economics.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to build, connect, and review three-statement financial models and reconcile outputs to source data and financial statements.
Sound financial judgment and the ability to identify significant performance drivers, assess assumptions, and resolve gaps in financial and operational data.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to explain financial results, assumptions, and risks to finance and non-finance stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, recurring deadlines, and a remote finance team.

Preferred Experience

Experience as a divisional CFO of an international entity.
Experience in commercial lending, mortgage lending, specialty finance, banking, or another financial-services environment.
Experience overseeing lending portfolio analysis, liquidity and capital planning, financing facilities, and covenant forecasting.
Experience improving or automating financial planning, modeling, and management reporting processes.

Work Requirements

Must be available to work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time.
Must have a stable internet connection and professional remote working setup.
Resume must be submitted in English to be considered.

Benefits

What We Offer

Compensation in USD.

️ Benefits include paid time off (PTO).

Work Environment: Fully remote work environment.

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you - submit your CV in English and hit Apply

postings.title: Staff Data Scientist
postings.descriptionText:
Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.
We've earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

As a Staff Data Scientist, you own the modeling work behind our hardest AI and machine learning problems: framing ambiguous business questions, building and validating models, and getting them into production. You bring deep applied ML and statistical rigor, the engineering judgment to ship at scale, and the credibility to explain it all to a room of executives.

You'll work alongside scientists, data engineers, developers, and product partners across client engagements, with real autonomy over technical direction. You set the standard for scientific rigor, mentor junior data scientists, and thrive where the problem is ambiguous, the data is messy, and the answer has to work in production.

Why This Role Matters

Staff Data Scientists are where Robots and Pencils' promise of "production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days" is backed by evidence. On the engagements you lead, you decide which approach is worth building, how success gets measured, and whether a model is ready for real users. The work moves only as fast as someone is willing to own the science, test the hypothesis, and ship the result.

What You'll Do

Craft & Delivery

Design, build, and evaluate predictive and prescriptive models across domains such as customer behavior, operational efficiency, and personalization
Apply machine learning, deep learning, and statistical techniques to solve real-world business challenges
Drive end-to-end ML and GenAI projects with a high degree of ambiguity, scale, and complexity, from proof of concept through production
Build, optimize, and deploy models into production, working with scientists and software engineers to deliver solutions that last
Establish scalable, automated processes for large-scale data analysis, model development, validation, and serving
Run A/B and multivariate experiments and apply causal inference to validate hypotheses and measure impact

Collaboration & Communication

Analyze large, complex datasets and translate what you find into clear, strategic recommendations
Explain scientific methodology and results to technical and non-technical audiences, using data visualization that makes the point
Partner with product managers and business stakeholders to identify opportunities and frame data science solutions
Work closely with data engineers, analysts, and software developers to build scalable, data-powered applications

Leadership & Influence

Serve as the technical practitioner in AI/ML, leading efforts within your team and across other teams
Research new and innovative science approaches and bring the best of them into client work
Mentor junior data scientists, supporting their technical development and scientific rigor
Build reusable assets, tools, and processes that increase team velocity and impact

What You'll Bring

5+ years of professional experience in data science, statistics, and applied machine learning, including 3+ years building models for business applications
PhD, or a Master's degree with 4+ years of experience, in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
Deep proficiency in Python or R, with strong skills in libraries like scikit-learn and TensorFlow/PyTorch, and fluency in models, algorithms, and ontologies
Experience programming in Java, C++, or a related language
Proven track record in statistical modeling, time series forecasting, NLP, or optimization
Experience in one or more of: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, or high-performance computing
Experience designing and analyzing controlled experiments (e.g., A/B testing, uplift modeling)
Demonstrated success deploying models into production using APIs, pipelines, or ML frameworks
Hands-on experience with Databricks, AWS (SageMaker), and Snowflake
Experience building and deploying Data Mesh architectures

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

Palantir experience
AWS cloud certifications or ML specialty credentials

You'll Do Well Here if You Are

A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
Calm when it gets hot. When scope, timeline, and stakeholders pull in three directions, you slow the room down enough to make the right call. You'd rather raise the hard trade-off in week two than absorb it in week eight.
Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

postings.title: Controller Financiero
postings.descriptionText:
Buscamos incorporar un/a *Controller Financiero* para asumir una posición gerencial y transversal dentro de un holding diversificado, con compañías pertenecientes a distintos rubros, entre ellos *agro, real estate, turismo, biotecnología y negocios vinculados a la industria ecuestre*, entre otros.

La posición tendrá como objetivo liderar el planeamiento y control financiero del grupo, asegurando información confiable y oportuna para la toma de decisiones y trabajando en contacto directo con la Dirección y los responsables de las distintas compañías.

*Principales responsabilidades*

● Liderar los procesos de *planeamiento, presupuesto, forecast y control de gestión* del holding.

● Supervisar la consolidación y análisis de la información financiera de las distintas sociedades y unidades de negocio.

● Liderar el seguimiento y análisis del *Estado de Resultados, Cash Flow y Posición Financiera y Patrimonial* de cada compañía y del holding en su conjunto.

● Analizar resultados reales vs. presupuesto y forecast, identificando desvíos, causas y acciones necesarias.

● Supervisar y analizar el *cash flow* de corto, mediano y largo plazo.

● Monitorear las necesidades de fondos, liquidez, capital de trabajo y asignación de recursos entre las distintas compañías.

● Realizar el seguimiento de *CAPEX*, analizando su impacto financiero y económico.

● Analizar la *rentabilidad y performance* de empresas, unidades de negocio, proyectos e inversiones.

● Definir y supervisar *KPIs financieros y de gestión*.

● Liderar la elaboración del *reporting ejecutivo* para CEO, accionistas y Directorio, aportando análisis y recomendaciones para la toma de decisiones.

● Evaluar financieramente nuevos proyectos e inversiones y participar en decisiones de asignación de capital.

● Coordinar transversalmente con *Contabilidad, Tesorería, Administración, Impuestos y responsables de las unidades de negocio*.

● Fortalecer los *procesos de control interno, circuitos financieros y calidad de la información* del grupo.

● Supervisar la correcta utilización de *Finnegans* como ERP y promover la estandarización de procesos e información entre las distintas compañías.

● Participar progresivamente en decisiones vinculadas con *financiamiento, estructura de capital, relación con bancos y planificación financiera estratégica*.

● Liderar y desarrollar al equipo bajo su responsabilidad.

*Experiencia*

● *Más de 10 años de experiencia profesional* en Finanzas, Planeamiento Financiero, FP&A, Control de Gestión o posiciones relacionadas.

● *Mínimo 5 años en posiciones gerenciales o de liderazgo*, con responsabilidad sobre equipos, procesos y resultados.

● Experiencia trabajando con *múltiples sociedades o unidades de negocio*, idealmente dentro de holdings, grupos empresarios diversificados o family offices.

● Experiencia sólida en *Estado de Resultados, Cash Flow, Posición Financiera y Patrimonial, presupuesto, forecast y análisis de desvíos*.

● Experiencia interactuando y presentando información a *CEO, accionistas y/o Directorio*.

● Se valorará experiencia en evaluación de inversiones, financiamiento y decisiones de asignación de capital.

*Requisitos*

● Graduado/a de *Ingeniería, Economía, Contador Público* o carreras afines.

● Se valorará especialmente contar con *MBA, Maestría en Finanzas o formación de posgrado equivalente*.

● *Inglés *

● Experiencia trabajando con sistemas ERP.

Sueldo: $4.000.000,00 - $5.000.000,00 al mes

Lugar de trabajo: Empleo presencial

postings.title: Governance & Risk (Information Security) | AMBA
postings.descriptionText:
Buscamos un/a *Governance & Risk (Information Security)* para sumarse a una importante empresa del ecosistema de medios de pago, con foco en el gobierno de la Seguridad de la Información, la gestión de riesgos tecnológicos y el seguimiento de controles, vulnerabilidades, auditorías y planes de remediación.

La posición tendrá un rol transversal, actuando como nexo entre los equipos internos, los proveedores de servicios de Seguridad Informática y las distintas áreas de control de la organización. Será responsable de asegurar la trazabilidad de los compromisos, el seguimiento de riesgos y acciones correctivas, y la mejora continua de los procesos de gobierno y gestión de Seguridad.

*¿Cuáles serán tus principales responsabilidades?*

* Gestionar la relación con proveedores de servicios de Seguridad Informática, realizando el seguimiento de compromisos, entregables, iniciativas y cumplimiento de SLA/KPI, y participando en revisiones de servicio y renovaciones contractuales cuando corresponda.
* Gestionar el ciclo de vida de las vulnerabilidades identificadas mediante escaneos, pentests, auditorías y evaluaciones de terceros, coordinando su priorización según criticidad, remediación y cierre con evidencia.
* Administrar el registro de riesgos de Seguridad de la Información, realizando el seguimiento de responsables, planes de tratamiento, controles, fechas comprometidas y eventuales excepciones o aceptaciones de riesgo.
* Coordinar planes de remediación derivados de auditorías, evaluaciones de riesgo, incidentes y requerimientos regulatorios, especialmente aquellos vinculados con el BCRA y PCI DSS.
* Coordinar iniciativas y proyectos de Seguridad Informática, definiendo alcance, responsables, hitos, dependencias, riesgos y mecanismos de seguimiento.
* Participar en la gestión y seguimiento de incidentes de ciberseguridad, articulando con Tecnología, Continuidad, Riesgos, Compliance y proveedores especializados.
* Elaborar indicadores, tableros y reportes ejecutivos sobre riesgos, vulnerabilidades, controles, incidentes, auditorías y planes de acción.
* Coordinar evaluaciones de seguridad sobre nuevas iniciativas tecnológicas, cambios relevantes y servicios de terceros, trabajando junto con los especialistas y equipos responsables.
* Impulsar la mejora continua de los procesos de gobierno, gestión de riesgos y supervisión de los servicios de Seguridad Informática, promoviendo mejores prácticas, procedimientos y mecanismos de control.

*¿Qué buscamos?*

* Al menos 5 años de experiencia en Seguridad de la Información, Seguridad Informática, Gobierno de TI, Riesgos Tecnológicos, GRC (_Governance, Risk & Compliance_) o áreas relacionadas.
* Experiencia en gestión de vulnerabilidades, incluyendo seguimiento de remediaciones, priorización según criticidad, negociación de plazos e indicadores de cumplimiento.
* Experiencia en gestión de riesgos, seguimiento de controles, auditorías y planes de remediación.
* Experiencia coordinando iniciativas transversales con equipos técnicos, áreas de negocio y múltiples interlocutores.
* Capacidad para coordinar e influir sobre distintos equipos e interlocutores, sin autoridad jerárquica directa.
* Experiencia en gestión y seguimiento de proveedores tecnológicos o servicios tercerizados.
* Experiencia en elaboración de reportes de gestión, indicadores, documentación y evidencias para auditorías y procesos de control.
* Capacidad para realizar seguimiento de compromisos, identificar desvíos y coordinar acciones correctivas con diferentes equipos.
* Conocimientos de criterios de criticidad y priorización de vulnerabilidades.

*Se valorará*

* Experiencia en entidades financieras, medios de pago, fintech o industrias con servicios críticos y requerimientos regulatorios.
* Conocimientos de marcos y estándares como ISO 27001, NIST, COBIT y PCI DSS.
* Conocimiento de requerimientos regulatorios aplicables a entidades financieras, especialmente los vinculados con el BCRA.
* Certificaciones como CISA, CISM, CRISC o ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.
* Nivel de inglés técnico.

*¿Qué ofrece el cliente?*

* Relación de dependencia directa con una empresa líder en soluciones de pagos.
* Modalidad híbrida: 2 días de presencialidad y 3 remoto (CABA).
* 30 días al año de trabajo remoto desde cualquier parte del mundo.
* Bono anual por performance y revisión salarial periódica.
* Reintegro mensual de internet y crédito en plataformas de delivery.
* Prepaga de primer nivel para vos y tu grupo familiar.
* Días hábiles de vacaciones y licencias extendidas de familia.
* Acceso a formación continua, certificaciones y convenios educativos.
* Espacios de trabajo atractivos y tecnológicos.

Pregunta(s) de postulación:
* Por favor, indicanos tu remuneración bruta pretendida

postings.title: Senior SDET, Agentic Quality
postings.descriptionText:
About Onfleet

Onfleet’s mission is to power the future of commerce by enabling businesses of all sizes to move goods more efficiently and delightfully. Our product includes intuitive smartphone apps for drivers, a powerful modern web dashboard for logistics teams, and automatic notifications and real-time tracking for recipients. Onfleet powers millions of deliveries every week for thousands of businesses around the world across a range of industries, from grocery and prepared meals to pharmacy, flowers, and furniture.

About the role

Onfleet is hiring two senior SDETs to shape how our engineering teams build and trust automated quality. At Onfleet, the team that builds a feature owns its quality. Developers write and maintain their own tests. Your job is to make those teams better at it: you pair with them, teach, review, and find the cases they missed. You will not be the person who tests everyone else's work.

Together with our quality leads, you’ll own our test frameworks and the shared quality tooling every team depends on. You’ll also do feature development in production code and internal tooling. You’ll be part of our core quality engineering group, sometimes embedded on one team and sometimes working across several.

You’ll start by taking ownership of our existing automation and making it more reliable and complete, alongside greenfield work on new platform services. We measure this role by what the teams can do because you were there.

How We Work

We code using agents, and nearly 100% of our code is written this way. Generating code is the easy part. Knowing what good looks like, and holding the bar, is the job. The engineers who thrive here are scrutinizing and questioning: they reject AI slop and catch the wrong call before it ships.

Every engineer helps improve how we work instead of only following it. For this role that means building and improving the agentic tooling itself: test generation, review, verification, and the workflows around them.

We are candid and have a low ego. Challenge us on tooling direction, and expect to be challenged back.

What You’ll Do:

Strengthen the current suite. Improve reliability, extend coverage, and modernize patterns. A flaky test is a failing test.
Own the test frameworks. Unit, integration, and end-to-end, treated with the same care as production code.
Own the quality gates in CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous delivery). Pipelines, checks, and gates, so standards are enforced by the system and not by people.
Build agentic quality tooling. Extend the agents and workflows we use for test design, review, and verification.
Raise the bar through teams. Pair on test design, review code, help make hard-to-reach code testable, and write things down so the practice outlives any one person.
Ask the testability question early. In planning, ask how we'll test it and how we'll know it broke in production.
Know when a release is healthy. Metrics, dashboards and alerts that tell us something is wrong before a customer does, and that tell a team whether a release is safe to keep rolling out.
Ship features. Full-stack work in production code and internal tooling, alongside the teams you support.

What You'll Bring (required):

8 or more years of professional software development experience, in any role.
5 or more years where building and maintaining test automation was a core part of your job, as an SDET, test automation engineer, or software engineer who owned test infrastructure. Your title matters less than the work.
You build software, not just tests: test frameworks, internal tools, CI tooling, or product features. You want feature development in production code and internal tooling to be part of your job here.
Depth across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, including hands-on work with a browser framework such as Playwright or Cypress.
Hands-on CI ownership: you have created, configured, or fixed a CI pipeline (GitHub Actions or equivalent), not just used one.
A track record of being the person who drove automated test coverage on a team, whatever your role was.
Working knowledge of DevOps practice: how code is built, deployed and monitored in production. You have added metrics, dashboards or alerts so a team knew when something broke.
Daily professional use of AI coding agents, and experience building or improving agentic tooling, not just using it.
A multiplier mindset: you get your satisfaction from the team shipping safer and faster, not from your own test count.
Excellent written and spoken English, roughly C1 level, and experience working day to day on an international team.

Nice To Have:

Mobile development (Android or iOS) and mobile test automation, using native frameworks such as Espresso or XCUITest, or cross-platform tools such as Appium or Maestro.
TypeScript, Node.js, and React.
Rust, or another statically typed language.
Clear evidence of driving CI/CD practice for a whole team or company.
Production canaries and progressive delivery: you have used production signals (error rates, latency, business metrics) to decide whether a release continues or rolls back, through canaries, feature flags or automated rollback.
Test data and environment management: getting a realistic system into a known state quickly and repeatably.
Test-driven development (TDD).
AWS and cloud-native services.

Location and Benefits:

Remote, open to candidates based in Canada or Latin America.
The team works on US Pacific Time. You'll need to reliably work a schedule that frequently matches US Pacific business hours (9am to 5pm PT).
Flexible PTO.
Laptop and work-from-home setup stipend.
Monthly technology stipends (internet and AI tooling).
Onfleet is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Onfleet's culture is one that strongly values diversity in its workplace and we are committed to working with potential team members who can bring diverse perspectives and experience to our company and culture.

We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law.

We highly encourage members of underrepresented groups to apply and we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $70,000 to $95,000 USD per year for candidates in both Canada and Latin America, depending on experience, skills, and background. Where an offer lands within that range reflects the depth and experience a candidate brings to the role.

How We Hire

You need an identity-verified LinkedIn profile to apply. That's the free "Verified" badge, the shield icon next to your name. We check for it, and applications without it don't move forward.

Before any offer, we verify your identity and work history. That includes a live video ID check and reference calls. We use AI, automated systems, and a person to review applications: every application that meets the requirements is also read by an engineering leader or a recruiter. If you misrepresent your identity or experience, the process ends.

This role is responsible for independently leading complex implementation activities and providing technical expertise throughout the customer onboarding and deployment lifecycle.

As a primary customer-facing technical resource, the Associate, Technical Product Implementation Specialist partners closely with healthcare administrators, clinical stakeholders, customer IT teams, project managers, logistics teams, and internal cross-functional partners to ensure successful implementation outcomes. The role requires advanced knowledge of networking, hardware, software, workflow integration, and troubleshooting methodologies to resolve technical challenges and drive customer adoption.

This position exercises significant judgment in managing multiple concurrent implementations, identifying and mitigating risks, resolving complex technical issues, and recommending solutions that align with business objectives and customer requirements. The Associate, Technical Product Implementation Specialist also contributes to process improvement initiatives, implementation standards, and knowledge-sharing efforts that support organizational growth and operational excellence.

Implementation Leadership

Independently lead customer implementation activities from pre-deployment planning through successful go-live and project closure.
Manage multiple complex implementation projects simultaneously while meeting quality, timeline, and customer satisfaction objectives.
Serve as the primary technical point of contact during implementation activities.
Partner with Technical Project Managers to execute implementation plans and support overall program delivery goals.
Coordinate with logistics, support, engineering, product, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful deployments.

Technical Expertise

Evaluate customer technical environments and provide recommendations related to infrastructure readiness and implementation requirements.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues.
Collaborate with customer IT teams to assess firewall, routing, wireless, VPN, and network configurations.
Ensure all deployed systems meet operational, clinical, and performance requirements.
Conduct validation testing and acceptance activities to confirm successful implementation outcomes.

Customer Engagement

Communicate implementation requirements, project milestones, risks, and technical recommendations to customer leadership and technical teams.
Deliver customer training and knowledge transfer activities to support successful adoption and ongoing use of Teladoc solutions.
Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the implementation lifecycle.

Risk Management and Problem Resolution

Identify implementation risks, dependencies, and challenges proactively.
Develop and execute mitigation plans to maintain project objectives and delivery schedules.
Escalate critical issues appropriately and provide timely resolution recommendations.
Drive issue ownership through completion while maintaining strong customer communication.

Process Improvement and Operational Excellence

Contribute to the development and refinement of implementation standards, playbooks, and best practices.
Provide feedback to Product, Engineering, and Operations teams regarding system enhancements and customer experience improvements.
Analyze implementation trends and recurring issues to recommend process and technology improvements.
Participate in pilot deployments, new product introductions, and implementation readiness activities.

Documentation and Quality

Maintain accurate and complete implementation records, technical documentation, testing results, training documentation, and deployment acceptance materials.
Ensure all implementation deliverables support operational, compliance, and revenue recognition requirements.
Adhere to established quality standards, policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Support emergency troubleshooting and repair activities when necessary.

Additional Responsibilities

Mentor and provide guidance to less experienced implementation team members.
Share technical knowledge and contribute to team capability development.
Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.

Key areas supported by this role include:

Technical Product Implementations
Device Deployment and Configuration
Software Installation and Validation
Network and Connectivity Optimization
Product and System Integrations
Clinical Workflow Enablement
Customer Technical Readiness
Implementation Process Improvement
Technical Escalation Management

No

Professional Skills

Strong customer relationship management skills.
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Exceptional organizational and project management skills.
Ability to prioritize and manage competing priorities.

Qualify accounts at depth: validate company HR challenges, decision-maker map, timing, and budget potential before booking the AE meeting.
Conduct discovery-level conversations to surface corporate wellness pain points and position Wellhub's value proposition compellingly.
Maintain pipeline hygiene in Salesforce: accurate contact records, opportunity stage, and activity logs at all times.
Consistently achieve monthly qualified-meeting quota and contribute to team pipeline goal. Identify and propose improvements to outbound cadences or ICP targeting based on personal prospecting data; share winning approaches with the team.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

3+ years of experience in outbound prospecting, business development, or sales for large/complex Strategic accounts.
Previous experience with CRM & sales-engagement tools (Salesforce, Salesloft/Outreach); comfort directing AI-assisted outreach; LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
Experience with the Argentinian and Latam Market.
Fluent English — you'll interact with global teams and resources.

Organized and self-motivated — you can handle multiple priorities in a fast-growing organization.
Coachable, curious, and always seeking to learn and improve.

For this specific role, please note that prior experience in outbound prospecting and with sales tech stack like CRM, AI, and Sales Navigator are mandatory requirements.

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

HEALTHCARE: Health and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office equipment reimbursement and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It's important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days off per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!)

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025!

Experience owning product or technology roadmaps and delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives in a global environment.

Experience as a Product Owner, Service Owner, Platform Owner or Technology Manager in a global, regulated or highly matrixed enterprise.

postings.title: Senior AI Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to own and scale the AI layer of one of our core D2C subscription products. You will be fully responsible for production LLM features and the browser automation built around them end to end — prompt systems, structured outputs, evaluation, observability, and model selection — from first experiment to live release, with quality, reliability, and cost as your accountability.

This is a high-impact role suited for someone who decides with data, not intuition. Unmeasured prompt changes, untraced failures, and model swaps without benchmarks are not acceptable. You work in a modern TypeScript stack — Next.js, Cloudflare Workers and Containers with Hono, Hatchet task queues, Drizzle on Supabase Postgres, Vercel Blob. Browser automation on Browserbase and Playwright is roughly half of the job.

Key Responsibilities
Prompt Systems & Structured Outputs

Design dynamic prompt templates with conditional logic and context injection that maximise generation quality

Enforce predictable outputs with JSON mode, function calling, Zod/JSON schemas, validators, and repair loops

Own complex LLM workflows (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom) that integrate cleanly into application logic

Browser Automation

Build and maintain browser automation on Browserbase Functions and Playwright that traverses web flows reliably

Classify screens with a model inside each traversal, and decide what the model handles versus deterministic code

Ship automations as frozen, published workers — versioned, reproducible, and safe to roll back

Orchestrate runs through Hatchet with retries, timeouts, and failure traces that explain every broken run

Evaluation & Experimentation

Build evaluation pipelines — test datasets, LLM-as-a-judge, RAGAS-style metrics — and score responses and screen classifications in Langfuse

Trace complex LLM chains to find bottlenecks in cost, latency, and context-window usage

Run A/B experiments across models and prompts through an AI gateway (OpenRouter, Cloudflare AI Gateway); release only on quantitative benchmarks

Re-evaluate models as new architectures emerge; fine-tune when domain requirements demand it

Production Ownership

Take AI features from experiment to live production on Cloudflare Workers and Containers, and stay accountable after release

Manage rate limits, fallbacks, and model cost so features stay reliable at scale

Resolve production incidents in owned AI and automation systems with documented root-cause analysis

Qualifications
Must-Have Experience

【5+】 years of software engineering with Node.js, TypeScript, Next.js, and Postgres, including edge or serverless runtimes such as Cloudflare Workers

Production browser automation with Playwright (Browserbase or similar): resilient selectors, retries, failure handling at scale

Production experience with dynamic prompting — content that depends on input variables and injected context

Structured outputs in production: JSON mode, function calling, Zod/JSON schemas

Experience with unified LLM APIs or AI gateways (OpenRouter, Cloudflare AI Gateway): rate limits, fallbacks, cost-effective model selection

LLM observability with Langfuse or similar: tracing, test datasets, scoring integration

Evaluation methodology: RAGAS or custom LLM-as-a-judge systems

Leadership Attributes

Decides on benchmarks and trace data, not intuition

Analytical — converts generation logs into metrics a business can act on

Iterative — builds feedback loops and improves continuously

Owns the outcome from experiment to production, and after

Verifies before trusting — treats LLM output as unproven until validated

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1_mni_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

Interview Process

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

Technical Interview (60 minutes)

Final Interview (30 minutes)

Life at Ruby Labs

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

postings.title: GBS Human Resources Services Senior Manager
postings.descriptionText:
How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

A world leader in gases, technologies and services for Industry and Health, Air Liquide is present in 80 countries with approximately 66,000 employees and serves more than 3.6 million customers and patients. Air Liquide’s ambition is to lead its industry, deliver long term performance and contribute to sustainability thanks to a customer-centric transformation strategy relying on operational excellence, selective investments, open innovation and a network organization. Air Liquide has identified three major trends which represent growth opportunities, and among them digitization.

Air Liquide's Business Service Center (ALABS) comprises a dedicated unit (including people, processes and technologies) that is structured as a centralized point of service focused on defined business functions.

Air Liquide's Shared Services workforce is a dedicated team of people who provide services that have previously been found in more than one part of the organization or group; thus, the funding and resourcing of the service is shared and the providing department effectively becomes an internal service provider

The GBS HR Services Sr. Manager reports directly to the Air Liquide Argentina Business Shared Services General Manager. This position leads the strategic direction and operational execution of HR services across the Americas, covering 10 countries and multi-cluster businesses (NAM & Latam) in a fast pace growth environment of its portfolio offering. The Senior Manager has a team of 5 direct reports that include Senior Supervisors and a total ~65 headcount. This role is responsible for ensuring the efficient and effective delivery of HR processes, driving continuous improvement, and fostering a customer-centric culture. The Sr. Manager will manage a diverse team of HR professionals, optimize technology utilization, and maintain compliance with relevant regulations across multiple jurisdictions, all in alignment with the organization’s goals.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Management

Lead the delivery of standardized and efficient HR processes across multiple countries, including but not limited to:
Talent Acquisition Administration
Employee Data Management
Payroll Administration
Compensation, Benefits & International Mobility Administration and Support
Learning & Development Administration
Employee Relations Support
HR Reporting and Analytics
Manage day-to-day operations of the HR GBS Services team, ensuring legal compliance and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) to ensure service quality and efficiency.
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of HR professionals across multiple languages.
Foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that promotes teamwork, innovation, and customer satisfaction.
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide feedback and coaching to team members.
Develop and implement training programs to enhance team skills and knowledge.
Manage team capacity and workload to ensure efficient service delivery.
Ensure best practices for compliance, effectiveness and efficiency

Stakeholder Management & Communication:

Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including HR Business Partners, Centers of Excellence, business leaders, and employees across all supported countries, as the case may be.
Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders on HR service-related matters.
Develop and implement effective communication strategies to ensure clear and timely communication with stakeholders.
Manage vendor relationships and ensure service quality.
Lead and manage cross functional projects.
Drive strategic HR GBS Services program initiatives and deliver an excellent employee experience at a fast-growing global capacity

Budget/Financial planning & reporting

Follow-up financial performance and cost base reduction opportunities
Report HR GBS Services performance

Process Improvement

Actively participate and implement at local level and work directly with internal stakeholders and third party to successfully implement the Global HR GBS Services service delivery model
Develop expert communities, best practice sharing, lessons learned and cross training to eliminate single points of failure and increase collaboration between teams
Identify efficiencies and recommend process improvements to reduce costs and ensure compliance with company policies
Proactively identify new trends and technologies for possible implementation and make recommendations on replacing or improving existing ineffective systems or processes
Monitoring of initiatives implementation

HR Digital Solutions

Oversee the management of employee records and HR systems, ensuring data accuracy, security, and compliance
Implement automation and process improvements to enhance service delivery and reduce administrative burden

HR Data Management

Lead the production of accurate and timely HR reports and dashboards for senior leadership
Analyze operational data to identify trends, measure efficiency, and recommend actionable improvements
Proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with HR GBS Operations and service delivery

___________________
Are you a MATCH?

Education

University degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or related field

Experience

Minimum of 8–10 years of HR experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role in a shared services environment
Proven track record of managing multiple HR functions in a shared services or center of excellence environment
Experience in managing international payroll and benefits administration.
Experience in HR systems and data analytics tools

Skills & Competencies

Leadership: Strong ability to inspire, motivate and develop diverse teams
Strategic Thinking: Capable of aligning HR strategies with business objectives
Demonstrated experience in managing HR services in a multi-language and multi-country environment.
Ability to adapt communication strategies to meet the needs of diverse populations.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels
Analytical Skills: Proficient in data analysis and interpretation to drive decision-making
Project Management: Skilled in managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders
Change Management: Ability to lead and manage change initiatives effectively.
Problem-Solving: Adept at addressing operational challenges with innovative solutions
HR Process Expertise: Deep understanding of core HR processes and best practices.
Compliance & Risk Management: Knowledge of relevant labor laws, data privacy regulations, and compliance requirements.
Language Proficiency: Fluency in English is essential. Additional language proficiency relevant to the supported countries is highly desirable.
Highly organized and managing priorities
Working in a fast-pace multicultural environment : adaptation & decision making
Technical Proficiency: Knowledge of HRIS platforms, reporting tools and Google Suite

Our Differences make our Performance

At Air Liquide, we are committed to build a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the diversity of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders and cultures across the world.

We welcome and consider applications from all qualified applicants, regardless of their background. We strongly believe a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

postings.title: Digital Imaging Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Overview of the Position

The Digital Imaging Specialist supports the preparation, classification, and quality control of image data used by the Diagnostics team. In this role, you will review and label device images, verify classification accuracy, monitor work queues and throughput, identify edge cases, and maintain the records needed to understand progress and quality.

This is an execution-focused, shared-resource position. You will work through established procedures, classification standards, quality checks, trackers, and escalation paths. When labeling demand permits, you may also assist with related data, reporting, documentation, and process-improvement activities.

This position does not include client-facing responsibilities.

What Makes Us Different?
Work with image data that supports Diagnostics operations and data-driven decision-making.
Gain hands-on experience with image classification, quality control, reporting, and operational analytics.
Build knowledge of mobile-device imagery, device conditions, and diagnostics-related terminology.
Use tools such as Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Microsoft 365, and Microsoft Copilot to organize work and monitor results.
Contribute to process improvements that increase labeling accuracy, consistency, and efficiency.
Collaborate with distributed teams while managing clearly defined responsibilities in a remote environment.

What Will Be My Duties and Responsibilities in This Job?
Review and classify screen and back-of-device images using approved categories, labeling standards, and documented guidance.
Apply classifications consistently across categories such as Hand, Partial, Obstruction, Not Device, Blurry, Good Image, and other approved labels.
Review image metadata and available contextual information before assigning or updating a classification.
Reclassify images when quality reviews identify an incorrect or inconsistent label.
Record clear notes for ambiguous images and escalate unresolved cases through the appropriate process.
Perform quality spot-checks and second-pass reviews of completed labeling work.
Identify inconsistent labels, unclear category boundaries, duplicate records, unsuitable images, and other data-quality concerns.
Recognize image and device edge cases, including folded devices, partial devices, obstructions, reflections, visual artifacts, and dead-pixel lines.
Document exceptions, monitor recurring error patterns, and confirm that required corrections are completed.
Recommend updates or clarifications to labeling guidance and quality-review checklists when recurring issues are identified.
Track daily labeling volume and throughput for screen and back-of-device work against assigned goals.
Monitor backlog, aging, completion status, quality-control queues, and shortfalls against expected output.
Maintain labeling assignments and help ensure that priority queues and quality-control work remain covered.
Provide concise status updates summarizing completed volume, outstanding work, quality concerns, and blockers.
Escalate capacity constraints or significant deviations from expected throughput.
Maintain accurate trackers, logs, procedures, category definitions, and status records.
Support ad hoc data pulls, basic analysis, reporting, documentation, and cross-project assignments as needed.
Participate in process-improvement activities designed to increase accuracy, consistency, and operational efficiency.
Protect confidential information and comply with applicable data-handling and access requirements.

What Are the Requirements Needed for This Position?
An associate degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
At least one year of experience in data labeling, data entry, content review, quality assurance, operations, reporting, or another detail-oriented role.
Experience following documented procedures and completing recurring or repetitive work accurately.
Experience using spreadsheets, trackers, work queues, or similar tools to organize and monitor assignments.
Strong visual attention to detail and the ability to apply classification standards consistently.
Ability to recognize image-quality conditions and identify ambiguous, unusual, or potentially misclassified cases.
Working proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365 applications.
Ability to organize assigned work, manage recurring deadlines, and communicate blockers promptly.
Basic analytical skills, including the ability to review volumes, trends, exceptions, completion status, and backlog.
Clear written communication and disciplined process-documentation skills.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment while following established priorities, procedures, and escalation paths.
Ability to perform detailed, computer-based work for extended periods.

What Other Skills or Experience Would Be Helpful to Have?
Experience with image annotation, image labeling, computer-vision training data, or digital-content quality review.
Experience using image annotation or labeling platforms.
Experience with Microsoft Power BI or another data-reporting or visualization tool.
Familiarity with mobile devices, device diagnostics, screen imagery, back-case imagery, or device-condition terminology.
Experience using approved AI tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, to support documentation, summaries, or routine analysis.
Experience supporting distributed teams or working within an external service-delivery model.
Experience identifying data-quality trends and recommending improvements to procedures, classification guidance, or review checklists.

What Are the Working Conditions and Physical Requirements of This Job?

This role is primarily performed in a remote, computer-based environment using standard collaboration, data, reporting, and work-management tools.

The position requires the ability to:

Perform detailed screen-based work for extended periods.
Review and compare visual information accurately.
Use a computer, spreadsheet applications, and collaboration tools throughout the workday.
Participate in virtual meetings and communicate with distributed team members.
Manage recurring assignments independently in accordance with established procedures and deadlines.

Reasonable accommodations may be made where applicable.

How Much Should I Expect to Travel?

No regular travel is expected for this position.

Disclaimer

The information above describes the general nature and level of work expected for this position. It is not intended to be a comprehensive inventory of every duty, responsibility, or qualification associated with the role. Responsibilities and work priorities may be adjusted across supported initiatives based on business needs.

If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

You will communicate clearly with stakeholders, building trust and credibility while influencing improvements to the control environment.

You will lead the development and execution of control frameworks, coordinate audit and compliance reviews, and drive risk mitigation strategies. In this role, you will partner with cross-functional teams, leverage advanced analytics, and implement innovative technology solutions to enhance operational controls. You will be empowered to anticipate challenges, take ownership, and continuously improve our risk management practices. Your dedication will help foster a culture of risk awareness and operational excellence, making a meaningful impact on our team and the wider firm.

Conduct functional deep dive reviews and targeted risk assessments to identify, analyze, and address control gaps and emerging risks within operational processes.

Partner with Audit, Compliance, and Regulatory teams to assess incidents, perform root cause analysis, and drive remediation of control issues.

Design and execute risk mitigation strategies based on findings from audits, deep dives, and risk reviews, ensuring sustainable control enhancements.

Develop, analyze, and publish standardized control metrics; leverage business analytics tools (e.g., Tableau, Qlik) to identify trends, errors, and opportunities for process improvement.

Drive control remediation and risk mitigation programs using data-driven insights and metric-based analysis.

Manage governance and reporting of control and risk initiatives through advanced business analytics and visualization tools.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

Demonstrated experience in internal/external audit, operational risk reviews, or targeted risk assessments within financial services or a related industry.

Strong business analytics skills: ability to extract, analyze, and interpret large data sources using tools such as Tableau, Qlik, Alteryx, or similar platforms.

Full-time

Company Description

Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change.

By combining world-class engineering, industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses.

From prototype to real-world impact - be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.

The role also owns community engagement, employee advocacy and social listening activities, helping strengthen Endava’s brand reputation, foster meaningful conversations, and generate actionable insights that support both Business-to-Consumer (B2C) and Employer Branding strategies. The specialist monitors audience sentiment, identifies engagement opportunities, escalates reputational risks, and translates community and social listening insights into recommendations that improve content performance and audience engagement across the region.

Responsibilities may evolve depending on business priorities, platform developments and the maturity of the employee advocacy and social listening programmes.

Key Responsibilities

Execute and optimize social media strategy across North America (NA) and Latin America (LATAM), aligning campaigns with business objectives and regional priorities.
Partner with regional and business stakeholders to understand communication needs, business goals, and audience engagement opportunities.
Develop, manage, and publish social media content and campaign plans across multiple platforms using social media management and automation tools.
Support both organic and paid social media initiatives, including campaign setup, execution, and performance monitoring.
Monitor, analyze, and report on social media performance using analytics tools, providing recommendations based on KPIs, audience insights, and campaign outcomes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Employer Branding, PR, Content, and Design to deliver engaging and brand-consistent social media content.

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.

ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.

How will you contribute to our magical experience?

Content Platforms & Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product & Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams.

This is a Full Stack Software Engineer role with an emphasis on backend development (approximately 70%) and frontend development (approximately 30%), supporting end-to-end application delivery across music supply chain platforms.

This position might be a great fit if you:

Are a curious and efficient engineer who wants to help shape the direction of development and collaborate closely with some of the brightest minds in our organization.
Thrive in an agile, collaborative environment where teamwork and innovation are valued.

In this role, you will focus on the music integration workstream, working with data streams between our music metadata repertoire system and upstream/downstream applications. You will collaborate closely with multiple internal and external teams to enable robust data integration capabilities.

The Music Supply Chain fleet oversees products and optimizes workflows that enable users to manage both publishing and recorded music businesses—from acquisition and distribution to administration and monetization—leveraging analytics to drive data-informed decision making.

The Software Engineer will be responsible for:

Experience deploying and maintaining containerized applications on AWS environments using Kubernetes (EKS), Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR), and modern CI/CD practices.
Experience across the full software development lifecycle, including CI, unit/integration and functional testing, code reviews, and documentation.
Experience designing, building, and integrating APIs.
Knowledge of OAuth, authentication, authorization, and access management.
Practical experience with AWS services including S3, RDS, messaging, VPC, and related infrastructure.
Strong understanding of data integration concepts and workflows.
Experience with event-driven architecture (EDA) and publish/subscribe messaging (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, SNS).

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
