About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

11

Role: Manager, In-Business Control, AI & Digital

About the Role/The Team:

The In-Business Control (IBC) team plays a crucial role in shaping the strategic approach to operational risk management and the control framework. As a key part of the broader IBC group, we are committed to overseeing business controls and risks within the first line for the S&P Global Energy division. This position emphasizes AI and digital functions across all business lines within the division.

Our integrated operating model promotes close collaboration with the Operating Committee (OpCo) and fosters strong partnerships with Legal, Risk, and Compliance teams, ensuring comprehensive risk coverage and representation.

The AI Risk Manager, based in the In-Business Controls (IBC) team, will help shape how we deploy AI safely, ethically and at pace across the division. You’ll sit in the first line, partnering closely with IT, Legal, Compliance and 2nd Line Risk, to design fit‑for‑purpose controls and SOPs, build dynamic monitoring to spot issues early, and lead incident readiness for AI systems and algorithms. There will be hands‑on problem solving as well as exposure to senior stakeholders, and the chance to influence how AI supports our business strategy. It involves turning complex risks into clear, practical controls, promoting cross-functional collaboration, and creating opportunities to help the business adapt to changing regulations and standards. This is a high‑impact opportunity to shape CI’s AI control framework and grow your career at scale.

By joining our team, you will be part of a dynamic and forward-thinking group that values diverse perspectives and encourages collaboration. You will have the opportunity to work alongside industry leaders, contribute to strategic initiatives, and enhance your skills in a supportive environment focused on innovation and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

Risk Assessment: Identify and evaluate potential risks associated with AI technologies and their applications within the organization.

Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Development: Review and develop existing SOPs to mitigate identified risks, ensuring compliance with in-house requirements and industry standards.

Collaboration: Working closely with IT, legal, and compliance teams to ensure that AI initiatives align with organizational risk management frameworks, as well as working collaboratively with 2nd line risk, commercial, and corporate teams.

Monitoring and Reporting: Establish a dynamic monitoring system to proactively identify and address control deficiencies, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution to sustain compliance and operational integrity, as well as ensuring adherence to policies.

Incident Management : In conjunction with 2nd line risk, Develop and execute response plans for potential incidents related to AI systems, including data breaches or algorithmic failures.

Stakeholder Engagement : Build and maintain strategic relationships with key stakeholders and senior management in the business to ensure alignment of control strategies with business objectives and broader business goals.

Innovation: Champion innovative approaches in control processes, leveraging technology and best practices to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and adaptability to changing S&P strategy.

Continuous Improvement: Regularly reviewing and updating risk management strategies and controls based on emerging trends, technologies, and regulatory changes.

What We’re Looking For:

Basic Qualifications:

At least 3 years of experience in a risk, compliance, or control-oriented function with experience with AI/ technology infrastructure.

Knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts, including familiarity with algorithms, data handling, and ethical implications.
Strong ability to simplify processes, identify risks, and drive automation and operational efficiency
Exceptional analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and provide actionable insights.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, demonstrating stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders.
Ability to work effectively in a global fast-paced environment, appreciating diverse perspectives and cultural differences.
Bachelor's Degree in related field.

Preferred Qualifications:

Master's degree in a relevant field, such as Business Administration, Cybersecurity, or AI-related disciplines.
Professional certification in Operational Risk Management such as the PRMIA Operational Risk Management (ORM) Certificate or ISO 31000.
GARP RAI (Risk and AI) Certificate.
In-depth understanding of regulatory frameworks and standards related to AI, such as GDPR, ISO standards, and industry best practices.
Experience with project management methodologies and tools, particularly in overseeing AI-related projects.
Familiarity with data analytics tools and risk management software, as well as programming languages relevant to AI (e.g., Python, R, C++) and/or other programming languages such as VBA, SQL.
Knowledge of governance frameworks that pertain to AI ethics, bias mitigation, and accountability.
Understanding of Data IP business or industries.

About S&P Global Energy
At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.

S&P Global Energy is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise, and technology to make decisions with conviction. We are Advancing Essential Intelligence through world-leading benchmarks, data, and insights that customers need in order to plan confidently, act decisively, and thrive economically in a rapidly changing global landscape. Learn more at www.spglobal.com/energy .

Our Mission:

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

Our People:

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

Our Values:

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.

For more information on benefits by country visit: https://spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. postings.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer con experiencia en Node.js y React.js – Remoto (LATAM)
postings.descriptionText:
Sobre Coderio

Coderio diseña y entrega soluciones digitales escalables para empresas globales. Con una base técnica sólida y una mentalidad orientada al producto, nuestros equipos lideran proyectos de software complejos desde la arquitectura hasta la ejecución. Valoramos la autonomía, la comunicación clara y la excelencia técnica. Colaboramos estrechamente con equipos y socios internacionales, construyendo tecnología que genera impacto.
\uD83C\uDF0D Más información: http://coderio.com

Qué buscamos

Buscamos un Senior Fullstack Developer (Node.js & React.js) para sumarse a nuestro equipo regional en modalidad 100% remota desde LATAM. En este rol, serás clave en el diseño de arquitecturas escalables, la creación de experiencias de usuario de alto impacto y la evolución de nuestros procesos mediante metodologías avanzadas de desarrollo asistido por Inteligencia Artificial.

Main Stack

Frontend: React.js (v18+), TypeScript, Vite, Material UI / Tailwind CSS, HTML5/CSS3.

Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, Express / NestJS, RESTful APIs, GraphQL.

Databases: Relacionales (PostgreSQL, MySQL / RDS) y NoSQL (MongoDB / DynamoDB).

Cloud & DevOps: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, ECS/EKS), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform / CloudFormation, CI/CD (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI).

Version Control & Quality: Git, Jest / React Testing Library.

Methodologies & AI: Agile (Scrum / Kanban), Spec-Driven Development (SDD), integración y asistencia con IA Generativa.

Main Responsibilities

Desarrollo Fullstack End-to-End: Diseñar, implementar y evolucionar arquitecturas escalables, desarrollando interfaces web dinámicas en React.js con TypeScript y servicios robustos en el backend con Node.js.

Gestión de Bases de Datos: Diseñar esquemas eficientes, optimizar consultas e interactuar con bases de datos relacionales (PostgreSQL, SQL / RDS) y entornos NoSQL.

Infraestructura y CI/CD: Gestionar y aprovisionar recursos en la nube (AWS) mediante Infraestructura como Código (Terraform), implementar contenedores (Docker, Kubernetes) y automatizar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI) para despliegues continuos.

Desarrollo e Ingeniería Asistida por IA: Incorporar metodologías de desarrollo guiado por especificaciones (SDD) y estructurar prompts avanzados para guiar herramientas de IA en la producción y optimización ágil de código.

Calidad y Buenas Prácticas: Garantizar la seguridad, estabilidad y rendimiento del código propio y asistido por IA mediante la creación de suites de pruebas unitarias y de integración (Jest / Testing Library) y revisiones de código (code reviews).

Consultoría Técnica y Colaboración Ágil: Actuar como nexo entre los requerimientos de negocio y la ejecución técnica, traduciendo necesidades funcionales en arquitecturas eficientes dentro de un marco de trabajo Agile.

Requirements & Qualifications

Experiencia: +5 años de experiencia comprobable en desarrollo de software Fullstack.

Sólido dominio técnico: Dominio experto de Node.js, React.js y TypeScript.

Bases de Datos & Cloud: Experiencia en modelado y consultas con PostgreSQL / SQL, así como conocimientos prácticos en AWS, integración de pipelines CI/CD y gestión de contenedores con Docker.

Nivel de Inglés: Intermedio / B2 (Capacidad para mantener conversaciones fluidas, articular soluciones técnicas y participar en reuniones internacionales).

Metodologías: Experiencia comprobada trabajando en entornos ágiles (Scrum / Kanban).

Soft Skills: Capacidad de abstracción, proactividad, buenas habilidades interpersonales para interactuar con áreas de negocio y autonomía para trabajar de forma remota.

Nice to Have / Deseable

Experiencia en orquestación avanzada con Kubernetes e Infraestructura como Código con Terraform / CloudFormation.

Conocimientos en arquitecturas orientadas a eventos (SQS / SNS / Kafka) o arquitecturas Serverless (AWS Lambda, API Gateway).

Familiaridad con APIs de integración de mapas, patrones de diseño de software y prácticas de desarrollo seguro.

Beneficios
100% remoto
Compromiso a largo plazo, con autonomía e impacto
Rol estratégico y de alta visibilidad en una cultura de ingeniería moderna
Equipo internacional colaborativo y liderazgo técnico sólido
Plan de carrera y crecimiento dentro de Coderio
¿Por qué unirte a Coderio?

En Coderio valoramos el talento sin importar la ubicación. Somos una empresa remote-first,apasionada por la tecnología, el trabajo colaborativo y la compensación justa. Ofrecemos un entorno inclusivo, desafiante y con oportunidades reales de crecimiento. Si te motiva construir soluciones con impacto, te estamos esperando.
Postula ahora.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

postings.descriptionText:
Overview

At World Business Lenders (WBL), we provide flexible, short-term commercial loans backed by real estate to help small and medium-sized businesses across the United States, particularly those facing difficulties with traditional financing.
This position is a Contract/Consultant role with working hours typically from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. Applicants should have an excellent command of the English language, both spoken and written.
Applicants are requested to submit their CV in English.

About the Role

World Business Lenders (WBL) is seeking a highly organized and proactive Legal Administrative Assistant to provide administrative and operational support to the Corporate Legal Department.
This role will focus on coordinating schedules and meetings, organizing documentation, maintaining internal trackers, following up on administrative tasks and deadlines, and facilitating communication across the Legal Department and other business teams.
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, dependable, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, remote environment. This individual will help ensure the Legal Department's day-to-day administrative activities run smoothly and efficiently.
This is an individual-contributor role focused on administrative support and coordination, with no direct reports or management responsibilities.

What Success Looks Like

Departmental calendars, meetings, and administrative activities are well organized and coordinated.
Documents, records, and digital files are maintained accurately and remain accessible to authorized team members.
Internal trackers and task management systems are kept up to date.
Administrative requests, pending tasks, and deadlines receive timely follow-up.
Communication and coordination between Legal and other internal departments run smoothly.
Administrative processes and workflows are maintained consistently and efficiently

Core Responsibilities

Administrative and Scheduling Support

Coordinate calendars, meetings, appointments, and internal discussions for the Legal Department.
Schedule meetings across time zones and ensure participants receive invitations, relevant materials, and necessary updates.
Prepare meeting agendas, organize supporting documents, and track follow-up items as needed.
Assist with travel arrangements and other administrative logistics, as required.
Help coordinate incoming administrative requests and departmental activities.

Documentation and Records Management

Organize, maintain, and update departmental files, folders, and administrative records.
Ensure documents are properly named, stored, and accessible to authorized team members.
Assist with document preparation, formatting, proofreading, and distribution.
Maintain organized records of meetings, action items, and administrative processes.
Handle confidential information with discretion and follow appropriate document access and handling procedures.

Tracking and Coordination

Maintain and update internal dashboards, trackers, and project management systems, including Monday.com.
Track administrative deadlines, pending requests, follow-up items, and outstanding documentation.
Coordinate with team members to collect updates and help ensure tasks progress on schedule.
Assist with gathering and organizing information for internal reports and departmental updates.
Follow up on assigned action items and communicate status updates to relevant stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Communication and Support

Maintain and update internal dashboards, trackers, and project management systems, including Monday.com.
Track administrative deadlines, pending requests, follow-up items, and outstanding documentation.
Coordinate with team members to collect updates and help ensure tasks progress on schedule.
Assist with gathering and organizing information for internal reports and departmental updates.
Follow up on assigned action items and communicate status updates to relevant stakeholders.

Process Organization and Improvement

Maintain administrative procedures, checklists, templates, and workflows.
Help identify and resolve scheduling conflicts, missing information, and outstanding administrative tasks.
Support the consistent use of departmental tools, systems, and administrative processes.
Suggest practical improvements to filing, scheduling, tracking, and coordination activities.

Requirements

Education

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Office Administration, Legal Administration, or a related field preferred.

Required Experience

Ideally 2+ years of experience in administrative support, executive assistance, office coordination, or a similar role.
Experience supporting a legal department, law firm, executive team, or corporate department is preferred.
Experience coordinating calendars, meetings, documentation, and multiple competing priorities.
Familiarity with project management tools, internal trackers, and document management systems is an advantage.

Preferred Industry Experience

Experience in a corporate environment, professional services firm, legal department, financial services organization, or another structured business environment is preferred.

Technical Skills Required
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams.
Experience with project management and task tracking tools, such as Monday.com.
Ability to maintain organized digital files and document repositories.
Strong calendar management, meeting coordination, and administrative tracking skills.
Ability to learn and use internal systems and software efficiently.

Essential Soft Skills
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Clear and professional written and verbal communication in English.
Proactive approach to administrative support and follow-up.
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage competing deadlines.
Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative mindset.
Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.
Adaptability and willingness to assist with a variety of administrative needs.

Work Requirements

Must be available to work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time.
Must have a stable internet connection and professional remote working setup.
Resume must be submitted in English to be considered.

Benefits

What We Offer

Compensation in USD.

️ Benefits include paid time off (PTO).

Manage external legal counsel effectively and efficiently, maintaining appropriate cost discipline and supporting financial objectives.

Demonstrated experience working independently in a dynamic and complex environment within a leading law firm or the legal department of a multinational organization.
Strong legal judgment with a practical approach to problem-solving and risk management.
Ability to translate complex legal concepts into practical business advice.
Excellent legal skills combined with strong commercial understanding.
Positive, proactive, and solution-oriented approach.
Strong prioritization and project management skills, with the ability to perform under pressure.
Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders across countries and global functions.
Strong collaboration and communication skills.
High ethical standards, integrity, and personal accountability.

You will review legal and commercial documents to understand client activity, structure, and associated risks, execute AML policies, and act as a key point of coordination across Sales/Bankers (Front Office), internal Lines of Business, and partner teams including Legal, Compliance, Internal Controls, Technology, Client Services, and regional/global Client Onboarding teams. You will also contribute to quality control, reporting, metrics, and procedure maintenance to ensure compliant onboarding outcomes.

Job Responsibilities

You will perform KYC and client documentation analysis to support approvals for new customers and amendments to existing clients.
You will identify and apply regulatory requirements across applicable jurisdictions and internal procedures.
You will analyze legal and commercial documentation to understand client activity, ownership/structure, and risk profile.
You will execute AML policies and internal procedures in line with local and global principles.
You will partner daily with Sales/Bankers (Front Office) to obtain required documentation and resolve onboarding requirement/status questions.
You will perform quality control checks to ensure onboarded clients meet applicable rules, protecting the bank's reputation, assets, and finances.
You will track and follow up on pending client documentation by liaising with internal Lines of Business and other stakeholders.
You will maintain Standard Operating Procedures and produce client searches, reports, and regional client setup metrics as required (including regulatory needs).

University degree (Business Administration, Economics, Law, Information Technology, Engineering, or related).

5+ years of relevant experience, preferably within a financial institution.
Excel skills (plus Word and PowerPoint).

Experience leading or participating in special projects.
Experience organizing workload across team members and setting priorities.
Management experience with small teams (team lead/supervisor).
Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
Strong organization, prioritization, problem-solving, and control mindset; ability to deliver timely, accurate support.
Ability to work under pressure, adapt to changing priorities, and lead internal meetings/calls to provide process status updates.

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. About Teramind

Teramind is a global leader in workforce analytics, insider threat detection, data loss prevention (DLP), and business process optimization. We help organizations of all sizes protect sensitive data, ensure compliance, and optimize workforce performance. Our platform is trusted by enterprise clients across financial services, healthcare, government, and technology sectors worldwide.

About the Role

Teramind is growing rapidly, and so is the legal work required to support that growth. Our General Counsel manages a high volume of enterprise contracts, vendor agreements, compliance requirements, and commercial negotiations across North America, EMEA, and APAC. We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Law Clerk or Paralegal to serve as her right hand, taking ownership of operational legal tasks, enabling faster contract throughput, and ensuring no ball gets dropped.

This is a high visibility role in a lean, fast-moving legal function. You will work closely with the GC on everything from first pass contract review to research, documentation, and cross-functional coordination with Sales, Finance, and HR.

Key Responsibilities
Review, draft, and redline commercial agreements including MSAs, SOWs, NDAs, vendor contracts, and SaaS subscription agreements
Support the General Counsel in managing the contract pipeline: tracking status, deadlines, open items, and follow-ups
Conduct initial review of incoming customer and vendor contracts; flag non-standard terms and escalate as appropriate
Maintain and organize the contract repository; ensure executed agreements are filed, version-controlled, and accessible
Coordinate with outside counsel: prepare documents, manage communications, and track billing
Support responses to fraud inquiries, subpoenas, regulatory requests, and government correspondence
Assist with employment-related documentation including offer letters, severance agreements, and policy updates in coordination with HR
Conduct legal research on topics including data privacy, cross-border regulatory requirements, and SaaS commercial norms
Support the GC in educating internal stakeholders (particularly Sales) on contract standards, liability positions, and acceptable terms
Assist in maintaining and updating legal playbooks, contract templates, and standard operating procedures
Manage and organize legal holds and related documentation

Qualifications

Required:
Paralegal certificate, law degree, or J.D. (non-practicing or pre-bar)
2–5 years of experience in a legal, law firm, or in-house corporate legal environment
Strong working knowledge of commercial contract structures and common SaaS agreement terms
Experience reviewing, redlining, and negotiating NDAs, MSAs, and vendor agreements
Exceptional written and verbal communication; ability to translate complex legal concepts for non-legal audiences
Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
Proficiency with contract management tools, document management systems, and Microsoft Office / Google Workspace
Preferred:
Experience supporting a General Counsel or senior attorney in a tech or SaaS company
Exposure to data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2 context, HIPAA)
Familiarity with cross-border commercial agreements (EMEA, APAC)
Experience with e-signature platforms (DocuSign, Adobe Sign) and CLM tools
Background in or exposure to cybersecurity, DLP, or workforce analytics industries
What Success Looks Like in Year 1
Contract turnaround time reduced from 3–5 days to same-day or next-day for standard agreements
GC's time freed from first pass review and administrative coordination, redirected to strategic legal matters
Outside counsel spend meaningfully reduced
Contract repository fully organized and maintained
Sales team supported with faster legal responses, reducing deal friction and limiting exposure to unfavorable commercial terms

postings.descriptionText:
Gerente General de Hotel

El Gerente General es el máximo responsable estratégico, operativo y comercial de la propiedad hotelera. Su misión principal consiste en liderar la operación integral del hotel, garantizando la máxima rentabilidad financiera (GOP), la excelencia en los estándares de servicio al huésped, el posicionamiento de marca y el desarrollo continuo del equipo humano, en estricto cumplimiento con las normativas legales y corporativas.

Responsabilidades Principales1. Gestión Financiera y Revenue Management

* Supervisar la elaboración, ejecución y control del presupuesto anual operativo (P&L) y de capital (CAPEX).
* Monitorear los principales indicadores financieros: *RevPAR*, *ADR*, *Occupancy Rate*, *GOPPAR* y *EBITDA*, implementando ajustes tácticos ante desvíos.
* Coordinar con el equipo comercial y de Revenue Management las estrategias de pricing dinámico, segmentación de mercado y optimización de canales de distribución (OTAs, venta directa y corporativos).
* Controlar los costos operativos directos e indirectos, mermas e inventarios sin comprometer la calidad del servicio.

2. Operaciones y Calidad de Servicio (Guest Experience)

* Asegurar el cumplimiento homogéneo de los estándares operativos (SOPs) en todas las áreas: Recepción, Housekeeping, Alimentos y Bebidas (F&B), Mantenimiento y Seguridad.
* Monitorear activamente las métricas de satisfacción del cliente (NPS, CSAT, reseñas en plataformas digitales como TripAdvisor o Google Reviews) y liderar planes de acción correctiva inmediata.
* Supervisar el plan de mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo de la infraestructura e instalaciones para preservar el valor del activo.

3. Liderazgo y Gestión de Talento

* Dirigir, evaluar y motivar al comité ejecutivo del hotel (Jefes de Departamento / Directores de Área).
* Fomentar una cultura organizacional orientada a la excelencia en el servicio, la equidad y el compromiso.
* Trabajar con Recursos Humanos en planes de retención, capacitación continua, desarrollo de línea de carrera y mitigación de la rotación laboral.

4. Relaciones Institucionales, Seguridad y Compliance

* Representar formalmente al hotel ante autoridades regulatorias, asociaciones gremiales, cámaras turísticas y clientes corporativos clave.
* Garantizar el estricto cumplimiento de normativas locales e internacionales de higiene, seguridad laboral, manipulación de alimentos (HACCP) y licencias comerciales.
* Liderar la gestión de crisis y protocolos de contingencia ante emergencias o incidentes operativos mayores.

* Licenciatura en Administración Hotelera, Turismo, Administración de Empresas, Economía o carreras afines.
* Se valorará especialmente Posgrado, Máster (MBA) o especialización en Gestión Hotelera, Finanzas o Revenue Management.

Experiencia Laboral

* *Mínimo 8 años de experiencia comprobable* como Gerente General (o Director de Operaciones en hoteles de gran porte) en propiedades hoteleras de 4 o 5 estrellas, cadenas hoteleras o resorts de categoría similar.
* Historial comprobado de cumplimiento de metas financieras (P&L), optimización de costos y mejora de índices de satisfacción del cliente.

Idiomas y Conocimientos Técnicos

* Conocimiento profundo de marcos normativos laborales, impositivos y de seguridad e higiene aplicables al sector.

Our client views bookkeeping and accounting as an essential customer service experience powered by cutting-edge technology. As an AI-native accounting firm, their mission is to help entrepreneurs build profitable businesses that bless their family, their team, and their community.

You will be far more than an external service provider—you will serve as an indispensable embedded partner to your clients. Their culture values autonomy, continuous learning, absolute transparency, and collaborative problem-solving using modern AI tools and automated workflows across time zones.

Our client is looking for a detail-oriented Bookkeeper to manage end-to-end bookkeeping for multiple Canadian clients, ensuring accurate records, timely reconciliations, and complete month-end closes.

You'll work closely with senior accountants, maintain regular communication with clients via email and Zoom, and use modern cloud accounting tools to streamline workflows.

This is a client-facing role that requires strong ownership, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering excellent customer service.

What You'll Do

Cloud Accounting System Management: Maintain full end-to-end management of client cloud accounting platforms (Xero or QuickBooks Online) with meticulous accuracy.

Document Processing & Data Extraction: Manage incoming receipts, bills, and source documents using automated fetching and extraction tools (e.g., Dext, Hubdoc).

Bank & Credit Reconciliations: Code daily bank feed entries and perform rigorous monthly reconciliations of bank, credit card, supplier, and clearing accounts.

Canadian Payroll & Statutory Compliance: Process Canadian payroll transactions and manage statutory compliance filings (CPP, EI, and T4 summaries/slips).

Payables & Receivables Oversight: Manage Accounts Payable workflows and monitor Accounts Receivable to help maintain healthy client cash flow.

Management Close & Reporting: Execute complete month-end closes and draft published financial reports under the supervision of senior accountants.

Proactive Client Communication: Serve as a direct, responsive point of contact for routine client inquiries, addressing operational needs and solving problems collaboratively.

Ideal Profile

Education & Credentials: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent practical experience.

Public Practice Experience: Prior bookkeeping or accounting firm/BPO experience managing multiple client accounts.

Cloud Tech Stack Mastery: Hands-on experience with Xero or QuickBooks Online (certification expected), alongside modern document collection tools like Double, Dext, and Hubdoc.

Canadian Compliance Knowledge: Solid working understanding of Canadian bookkeeping standards, sales tax frameworks (GST/HST/PST), and payroll processing.

High ownership mentality and exceptional attention to detail.

Comfortable with repetitive monthly deadline cycles.

An AI-first problem-solving mindset, proactive adaptability, and exceptional client empathy.

Independent worker who enjoys getting things done, checking off tasks, and meeting deadlines.

Comfortable working independently while welcoming support and collaboration from the wider team.

Excellent communication and English language skills.

Strong appreciation for foundational bookkeeping and a commitment to craftsmanship and technical excellence.

Tools & Software

Some of the tools used every day include:

Xero & QuickBooks Online (you will be expected to get certified).

Google Apps Workspace suite.

Dext.

Double.

Payroll software (QuickBooks Online Payroll, Payment Evolution, Wagepoint).

Training & Development

Our client provides full training and development.

Your first few months will focus on learning their systems and standards while working closely with other members of the team. Once you have proven your skills and aptitude, you will be assigned your own clients.

Candidates who already have experience as bookkeepers will still go through the training and mentorship program. Our client is very particular about their processes and how things are done, and sometimes needs to correct bad habits picked up elsewhere. However, candidates with the right skills and aptitude will progress through the program faster.

The goal is to develop you into a bookkeeping ninja—an expert in accounting tools, excellent in client service, and fast in your ability to keep everything up to date.

Why Join

To thrive in this role, you will love the repetition of serving a stable group of clients every month while cherishing the diversity of problem-solving that comes with it.

You'll be part of a collaborative international team that values autonomy, continuous learning, transparency, and modern technology.

You'll have the opportunity to develop your expertise in cloud accounting tools, client service, and efficient bookkeeping workflows while becoming an essential part of your clients' business operations.

If this sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now!

Job description
Requisition ID: 1746408

About EY
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. Job Summary
Enterprise Technology is a global organization that delivers reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to enable an exceptional technology experience for EY people. As part of the Enterprise Technology Risk & Compliance (ETRC) team, the Finance Governance role will lead the operational governance of the Finance risk and control matrix and support a consistent, integrated control landscape. Reporting to the Risk & Controls Governance Lead, this role will maintain the Finance control inventory, lead control design and impact assessments, coordinate control changes and ownership alignment, and provide risk and control input to Finance technology transformation initiatives.
Responsibilities
The Finance RACM role will provide domain leadership for the Finance control landscape and coordinate delivery of RACM governance activities under the direction of the Risk & Controls Governance Lead.
Key responsibilities include
• Own and maintain the Finance risk and control matrix and related control inventory, ensuring alignment with the ETRC RACM methodology, taxonomy and governance requirements.
• Maintain Finance risk-to-control mappings and support an integrated view of applications, processes, risks, controls, ownership, access, vendors and key technology dependencies.
• Coordinate Finance control additions, updates and removals with control owners, delegates, Operations & Reporting and Assurance & Compliance stakeholders.
• Consolidate Finance control changes and prepare accurate RACM and ISQM updates that reflect approved control design activities.
• Assess Finance applications, processes and technology changes to identify requirements for new or updated controls, including IT general controls, SDLC controls, interfaces, access and segregation of duties.
• Lead control rationalization and control impact assessments, identify duplication or coverage gaps and recommend changes to control design, ownership and accountability.
• Manage the design and readiness process for new or updated Finance controls, including stakeholder consultation, required approvals, sign-offs and readiness for implementation.
• Coordinate Finance input to the annual ET controls certification cycle, review reported exceptions and track remediation actions arising from certification outcomes.
• Provide risk and control governance input to strategic Finance technology initiatives and perform control gap analysis with practical remediation recommendations.
• Monitor changes in control ownership and delegate arrangements, maintain effective stakeholder alignment and escalate unresolved ownership or control design matters.
• Identify recurring control themes and systemic gaps and provide clear management insights and recommendations to support the Finance control environment.
• Partner with the Non-Finance RACM role, Risk & Controls Analyst and other ETRC pillars to support one consistent and integrated ET control landscape.
Analytical / Decision-Making Responsibilities
The role applies sound judgment and strong analytical thinking to assess technology and process changes, evaluate control coverage, identify gaps or duplication and determine when controls require addition, redesign, rationalization or escalation. The individual will balance Finance-specific requirements with the ETRC control framework, prioritize competing governance activities and provide evidence-based recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements
The role requires a strong understanding of technology risk and controls, RACM governance, control design and Finance technology environments. The successful candidate will be able to connect business and technology risks to practical controls, challenge unclear ownership or design, and translate complex requirements into clear documentation and actionable recommendations. Strong stakeholder management, organization, attention to detail and written communication skills are essential.
Job Requirements
To qualify, candidates must have
• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Accounting, Finance, Risk Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 6 years of experience in technology risk, internal controls, IT audit, compliance, risk and control matrix management or a related field.
• Demonstrated experience maintaining RACMs, performing control design or impact assessments and translating risks and requirements into clear control activities.
• Strong understanding of IT general controls, technology change, access management, SDLC, interfaces and segregation of duties concepts.
• Experience working with Finance technology platforms, SAP environments, ERP transformation or similar large-scale technology programs is preferred.
• Experience coordinating control owners and senior stakeholders across technology, risk, audit, information security and business functions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify control gaps, assess impact and develop practical recommendations.
• Strong organizational and project coordination skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, approvals, dependencies and deliverables.

¿Cuáles serán sus principales tareas?

1. Estudios y formulación de proyectos de inversión vial

Analizar propuestas técnicas y económicas de proyectos viales.
Definir especificaciones técnicas de diseño geométrico, pavimentos, drenajes, señalización y estructuras.
Colaborar en la valoración económica de obras lineales, ensayos de calidad, movimiento de suelos y obras complementarias.
Aportar información clave para asegurar viabilidad técnica y económica.

Alinear entregables de ingeniería con estándares DNV/DPV, especificaciones YPF y mejores prácticas del sector.

3. Elaboración y seguimiento del Plan de Ejecución del Proyecto (PEP)

Liderar la preparación del PEP en fases de anteproyecto, proyecto y ejecución.
Asegurar que cronogramas, alcances, hitos y estrategias constructivas respondan a la estrategia técnica definida.
Coordinar la planificación de frentes de obra, desvíos de tránsito, interferencias y logística de materiales (áridos, asfaltos, hormigones).

4. Gestión de riesgos en todas las fases del proyecto

Identificar, analizar y mitigar riesgos asociados a suelos, clima, obra en operación, contratistas, interferencias y expropiaciones.
Implementar estrategias preventivas para cumplir objetivos de plazo, costo y calidad.

5. Participación en estimaciones de costos y plazos

Aportar información para la preparación de estimados de ingeniería, ejecución y mantenimiento vial.
Analizar desviaciones entre estimados de distintas fases.
Evaluar impacto de alternativas técnicas y cambios de alcance.

6. Preparación de pliegos y análisis de ofertas

Coordinar la elaboración de pliegos técnicos y comerciales para contrataciones viales.
Definir alcances para proyectos de ingeniería, inspección y construcción.
Participar en la revisión técnica y económica de ofertas y en la preparación de informes de adjudicación.
Asegurar alineación contractual con la estrategia del proyecto y mitigación de riesgos (plazos, garantías, mediciones, ensayos, penalidades).

7. Coordinación de equipos multidisciplinarios

Gestionar equipos de trabajo internos y externos (ingeniería, construcción, inspección, topografía, QA/QC) para el seguimiento de la empresa contratista.
Conducir reuniones de avance, resolución de interferencias y coordinación semanal con contratistas y organismos viales.
Asegurar alineación y comunicación fluida entre las partes involucradas.

8. Control y aprobación de ingeniería

Gestionar las aprobaciones de los proyectos con Vialidad, así como los cambios y modificaciones que puedan surgir en obra.
Asegurar ingeniería apta para construcción y para licitación.

9. Gestión Económica y avance de las obras

Responsable del correcto registro y control de los pagos efectuados a los contratistas (Constructora, inspección, ingenierías).
Seguimiento y reporting del proyecto.

Nos encontramos en búsqueda de un Programador Logístico RTIC - NOC

Recibir y transferir información crítica de la operación, garantizando la continuidad operacional mediante la comunicación efectiva de novedades, contingencias, recursos disponibles y pedidos pendientes.
Recepcionar, analizar, validar y planificar los requerimientos logísticos, priorizando recursos en función de la criticidad operativa y los compromisos asumidos con los clientes internos.
Controlar permanentemente el estado operativo de las unidades, conductores y equipos asociados, asegurando la disponibilidad necesaria para la ejecución de los servicios programados.

Analizar y resolver situaciones imprevistas durante la operación, evaluando alternativas logísticas y coordinando acciones con clientes, contratistas y áreas de soporte para garantizar la continuidad del servicio.
Mantener comunicación permanente con supervisores, contratistas y clientes internos mediante correo electrónico, telefonía y sistemas corporativos, asegurando información oportuna y confiable.
Brindar soporte operativo a los solicitantes de transporte, informando el estado de sus requerimientos, tiempos estimados y eventuales desvíos.
Realizar la carga y actualización de información operacional en los sistemas corporativos, garantizando la integridad, trazabilidad y calidad de los datos.
Verificar la correcta ejecución de los servicios programados y registrar indicadores operativos asociados a productividad, utilización de flota y nivel de servicio.
Identificar situaciones operativas que puedan afectar la seguridad de las personas, los activos o el medio ambiente, promoviendo acciones preventivas y escalando oportunamente los eventos que requieran intervención.
Coordinar la ejecución de los servicios con las empresas prestadoras, verificando la disponibilidad de recursos comprometidos y comunicando restricciones o contingencias que afecten la operación.

Reporte directo: Jefe de operaciones logística real time

Modalidad: 7x7

Trabaja con excelencia y profesionalismo.

Da lo mejor cada día, valora la meritocracia y busca siempre la milla extra.

Vive los desafíos como oportunidades para innovar y aprender.

Disfruta del trabajo en equipo y del intercambio de distintos puntos de vista.

Promueve un buen clima de trabajo, con empatía, escucha activa y respeto.

Un entorno donde podés aportar lo más valioso que tenés: tu energía. Esa energía que impulsa, que se adapta, que aprende, que suma, que transforma.

Impulsar tu desarrollo al siguiente nivel con nuevas oportunidades de aprendizaje.

Crear soluciones innovadoras que impactan en el país.

Formar parte de una empresa comprometida con la equidad y la inclusión.

Iniciativas para estar cerca en los momentos familiares claves: ayuda escolar, licencias parentales extendidas y regalo de nacimiento.

postings.title: Associate Operations Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Overview of Position

The Associate Operations Analyst supports client and community onboarding for Assurant’s Renters business, helping move requests from intake through production launch. In this role, you will configure information across internal systems, coordinate with Business, Operations, and IT partners, test solutions, troubleshoot issues, and help ensure each implementation is accurate and delivered on time.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional who is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and interested in developing skills across operations, systems, testing, analytics, and stakeholder management.

What makes us different?

• Your work has direct business impact: faster, accurate onboarding helps communities go live and supports premium growth.

• You will gain cross-functional exposure by partnering with Business, Operations, IT/development, and Global Housing leaders.

• You will receive structured, hands-on training from the manager and experienced team members.

• You can build practical experience with operational analytics, testing, troubleshooting, process improvement, and production support.

• You will join a collaborative team that encourages questions, recognizes improvement ideas, and supports long-term career development within Assurant.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

• Support the end-to-end onboarding of clients and communities, from request intake through production launch.

• Review onboarding requests and accurately configure community and client information across multiple internal systems and applications.

• Manage tickets, priorities, and deliverables while meeting service-level expectations and escalating risks or blockers early.

• Partner with Business, Operations, IT/development, and other internal teams to clarify requirements and resolve implementation or production issues.

• Perform user acceptance testing, regression testing, peer reviews, audits, and maintenance activities to support high-quality launches.

• Troubleshoot service and system issues, identify root causes, recommend solutions, and coordinate timely resolution.

• Maintain clear documentation and status updates, and contribute to onboarding reporting for leadership.

• Participate in daily team huddles, training, knowledge sharing, and continuous-improvement initiatives.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

• Up to 2 years of relevant professional experience in operations, implementation, production support, business analysis, systems support, quality assurance, or a related environment. Equivalent internship or early-career experience will be considered.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with US-based and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Excellent attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple requests in a high-volume environment.

• Strong computer literacy and working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel.

• Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and communicate recommended actions.

• Ability to work with urgency, maintain accuracy under deadlines, and take ownership of tasks through completion.

• Ability to learn new systems, applications, processes, and technical concepts quickly.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

• A bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Operations, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Exposure to SQL, Postman, SOAP UI, system integrations, APIs, or application-support tools.

• Experience with user acceptance testing, regression testing, requirements documentation, ticket management, or production support.

• Experience in insurance, insurtech, financial services, property-management technology, SaaS, shared services, or another technology-enabled operational environment.

• Experience working with performance measures, service-level agreements, operational KPIs, standard operating procedures, or process-improvement initiatives.

• A collaborative mindset, curiosity, adaptability, and confidence asking questions or escalating issues when needed.

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?

General office demands. This Argentina-based position supports a US business team and requires schedule alignment with US operating hours. The final work arrangement and specific schedule will be communicated during the recruiting process.

If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Helping People Thrive in a Connected World
Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we’ll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at jobs.assurant.com.

What’s the culture like at Assurant?
Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. It also partners with Product Management, Development, and communications stakeholders to support tool enhancements, releases, operational maintenance, service disruptions, and P1–P3 incidents.

Administers GOCT configuration, communications templates, shared mailboxes, OneAccess groups, audience targeting, and supporting documentation in accordance with brand and governance standards.

Coordinates GOCT enhancements and releases by documenting requirements, supporting user acceptance testing, preparing release communications, and validating production updates in partnership with Product Management and Development teams.

postings.descriptionText:
Descripción General:

QUIÉNES SOMOS

AVI-SPL es un proveedor de soluciones de habilitación digital que transforma la manera en que las personas y la tecnología se conectan, con el objetivo de mejorar las experiencias, generar nuevo valor y permitir que las organizaciones prosperen y crezcan. Somos el mayor proveedor de soluciones tecnológicas para la colaboración, incluidos nuestros servicios gestionados, reconocidos por su excelencia.

Nuestros expertos altamente certificados y líderes en innovación comparten una visión: ayudar a las personas a trabajar de manera más inteligente y vivir mejor. Nuestro éxito comienza con nuestra gente; y un entorno laboral que promueve una cultura de inclusión y pertenencia nos permite crecer y prosperar juntos.

QUÉ HARÁS

Este puesto es responsable de realizar las pruebas finales y la puesta en marcha de sistemas audiovisuales complejos durante y después de la fase de construcción del proyecto. Asimismo, brindará liderazgo técnico y de gestión en tareas importantes o asignaciones tecnológicas, y establecerá objetivos y planes que permitan cumplir con los objetivos del proyecto.

Trabajará en estrecha colaboración con el Project Manager para documentar los resultados de las pruebas de los sistemas y de su puesta en marcha.

Responsabilidades diarias

Leer e interpretar esquemas electrónicos y planos arquitectónicos.

Verificar el funcionamiento punto a punto de los sistemas.

Revisar el alcance del trabajo del proyecto (SOW, Scope of Work) para garantizar la calidad y la integridad de la instalación.

Probar sistemas integrados y realizar tareas de diagnóstico y resolución de problemas en sistemas AMX/Crestron y DSP.

Realizar la instalación en campo de programas de control (AMX/Crestron), con capacidad para cargar y descargar programas.

Escribir código para sistemas DSP (procesamiento digital de señales).

Realizar modificaciones menores de programación bajo la supervisión de un ingeniero o programador.

Ajustar y optimizar los sistemas de audio y video para garantizar su máximo rendimiento.

Configurar dispositivos con direcciones IP para establecer la comunicación dentro de una red.

Capacitar a los clientes y preparar la documentación final del proyecto, según sea necesario.

Actuar como enlace con el cliente en ausencia del Project Manager.

Elaborar, realizar el seguimiento y completar una lista de pendientes del proyecto (Punch List).

Tener disponibilidad para trasladarse a diferentes lugares de trabajo.

Realizar otras tareas, asumir responsabilidades y participar en proyectos adicionales según sea necesario para brindar soporte al equipo y a la organización, adaptándose con flexibilidad a las prioridades y los objetivos cambiantes.

Aspectos a tener en cuenta

AVI-SPL se reserva el derecho de modificar los horarios y el lugar de trabajo según sea necesario. Los horarios pueden variar de acuerdo con los requerimientos del cliente y pueden incluir viajes a distintas ubicaciones para brindar soporte a la cuenta.

Este puesto se desempeñará generalmente en las instalaciones de los clientes y puede desarrollarse en entornos de trabajo similares a los de una obra en construcción.

QUÉ BUSCAMOS
Requisitos indispensables

Comunicarse e interactuar de manera profesional y oportuna con los empleados internos, clientes y colegas.

Contar con habilidades comprobadas de redacción profesional y comercial.

Tener dominio del uso de equipos de prueba y calibración.

Brindar soporte durante las pruebas de aceptación del usuario (User Acceptance Testing, UAT).

Contar con conocimientos de programación básica en AMX/Crestron, incluyendo modificaciones y resolución de problemas.

Tener capacidad para diagnosticar problemas complejos en los sistemas.

Poseer conocimientos avanzados sobre el flujo de señales de audio, video y control.

Comprender los fundamentos de redes IP.

Tener un nivel avanzado de manejo de PC.

Contar con habilidades efectivas de comunicación e interacción con empleados, clientes y colegas.

Tener excelentes capacidades para gestionar múltiples tareas y adaptarse a prioridades cambiantes.

Ser capaz de trabajar y tomar decisiones de manera independiente, cumpliendo con los plazos establecidos.

Poseer sólidas habilidades organizativas y una excelente atención al detalle.

Contar, como mínimo, con título secundario completo o equivalente.

Tener capacidad para subir y trabajar regularmente en escaleras a alturas de hasta 35 pies (aproximadamente 10,7 metros), así como para levantar y manipular equipos, herramientas y materiales.

Requisitos deseables

Se valorará contar con formación formal en Electrónica o en un campo relacionado.

Se valorará contar con un mínimo de cinco años de experiencia en instalaciones audiovisuales (AV).

Se podrá considerar un título universitario de cuatro años o experiencia militar como alternativa a la experiencia laboral requerida.

Experiencia con soluciones de videoconferencia empresarial, tanto en hardware como en software, como Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, BlueJeans, Cisco TelePresence, entre otras.

Se valorará contar con la certificación AVIXA CTS (Certified Technology Specialist), correspondiente a la certificación general de especialista en tecnología audiovisual.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI & Data Platform
postings.descriptionText:
We are looking for an engineer to build and scale the software, data infrastructure, and AI systems behind our business. Our platform connects operational systems and marketplace data, powers analytics and internal applications, and enables AI agents to execute business workflows. We serve multiple brands from one platform, so automation and data quality directly determine how far we can scale without adding headcount.

You will work closely with our IT & Operations Lead to turn complex business problems into reliable production systems. This is a hands-on role with meaningful architectural ownership: you will design systems, write code, ship to production, and own the results.

*ABOUT THE ROLE*

Our platform brings together operational data and large volumes of public Amazon marketplace data to support executive decisions, internal operations, and AI-assisted workflows. It includes a data warehouse, reporting tools, business applications, marketplace integrations, and agents that act on that data.

The next stage means connecting more systems, handling more volume, and giving agents greater responsibility. We need reliable foundations: trustworthy data, clear system boundaries, observable workflows, and controls over how automated decisions become actions. Errors here do not happen once. A wrong number or a bad agent decision repeats across every brand we serve and every workflow that depends on it.

You will help shape that architecture and write a substantial share of the code. Your scope spans the data platform and the applications and agents built on top of it, from data quality and modeling to APIs, internal tools, and production workflows. You will also improve how we test, deploy, and build with coding agents.

*What you’ll build and own*

* *Data reliability and correctness. *Make sure the data our business, reports and agents rely on is right. Validate what arrives from ingestion, define data contracts with the teams and partners who produce it, and build automated data tests, reconciliation and freshness and quality checks so discrepancies are caught before anyone acts on them.
* *Testing and production reliability. *Build the right mix of unit, integration, contract, end-to-end and data tests across the platform. Own deployment, monitoring and incident response for your systems. Turn production failures into concrete improvements in design, safeguards and test coverage.
* *Platform architecture and business systems. *Design and build the services, APIs, integrations and internal applications that support our operations. Define system boundaries, workflow state, caching, queues and failure handling. Keep data models and business logic clean, documented and portable. Document consequential decisions and make practical build-versus-buy recommendations.
* *Operational workflows and integrations.* Connect our platform to Amazon and other business systems. Build workflows that move from insight to action, including catalog and listing management, operational reviews and approved updates to external systems. Make those actions auditable, safe to retry and recoverable when dependencies fail.
* *Agent systems.* Build agents that carry out meaningful business workflows using tools, structured data and application services. Own orchestration, context and retrieval, persistent state, permissions, human approvals and recovery. Define where autonomy is useful and where a person must retain control. When agents work in sequence, add validation between steps so errors are caught where they start, not at the end.
* *Agent evaluation and observability.* Build evaluation datasets and regression checks for agent behavior. Use release gates appropriate to each workflow’s risk, and monitor task success, output quality, cost, latency and failure patterns in production.
* *AI-native engineering.* Help define how we build with coding agents: shared skills, clear specifications, repositories agents can navigate, and review standards that keep delivery fast and code maintainable.

*What you’ll work with*

Python, TypeScript, SQL databases and a data warehouse, LLM-based agents, marketplace APIs, and cloud infrastructure. You will work across backend services, data pipelines, and internal web applications. We will discuss the current architecture and technical trade-offs during the interview process.

*What we’re looking for*

* *Production ownership. *You have taken substantial systems from design through deployment and ongoing operation. You can explain the decisions you made, the failures you encountered, and how the system evolved.
* *Strong data engineering. *You are fluent in SQL, data modeling, and reliable pipeline design. You can diagnose query performance, write data tests, and reconcile operational or financial data across systems. You have worked with more than one database or warehouse engine.
* *Architecture and system design. *You have evolved systems beyond their first version. You understand queues, concurrency, caching, consistency, and partial failure, and can choose an approach that fits the problem without overengineering it.
* *Applied AI experience.* You have shipped LLM-powered workflows or tool-using agents to production. You understand structured outputs, retrieval, tool interfaces such as MCP, and human approval patterns. You can explain how you evaluated performance and managed failure, cost, and latency.
* *Engineering quality.* You know how to test business logic, integrations, data transformations, and nondeterministic outputs. You can distinguish tests that establish correctness from tests that merely repeat the implementation.
* *AI-native development.* Coding agents are part of your daily workflow. You use them to accelerate implementation, investigation, and testing, and take responsibility for understanding and reviewing the code you ship.
* *Python and TypeScript.* You are strong in Python and comfortable delivering production features in TypeScript, including the services and interfaces needed to make your work usable.
* *Judgment and execution.* You turn ambiguous business needs into a bounded design, explain trade-offs clearly, and deliver useful increments quickly. You know when to move fast and when correctness requires deeper investigation.
* *Communication.* You communicate clearly in written and spoken English and work effectively with technical and operational teammates.

*Nice to have*

* Experience with Amazon APIs or marketplace data, including advertising, settlements, and catalogs.
* Experience with dbt, Airflow, Dagster, or comparable transformation and orchestration tools.
* Experience building internal tools, analytics products, or approval-based operational workflows.
* Front-end experience building web applications with React or a similar modern framework.

*What great looks like in your first 6 months*

* You understand the platform’s major dependencies and have shipped an architectural improvement with a measurable impact on reliability, cost, or speed.
* You have delivered a meaningful business workflow across its data, application, and integration layers.
* Key metrics in your area reconcile automatically against their sources, with discrepancies surfaced for investigation.
* The agents you own have repeatable evaluations, production monitoring, and clear approval and recovery paths.
* You independently own a major area of the platform and help the team make better engineering decisions.

*This role is not a fit if…*

* You need detailed tickets. You will get requirements in plain English and figure out the technical approach.
* You build prototypes but have not owned systems in production.
* You focus only on frontend, or only on analysis, without building backend and data systems.

*How to apply*

Send your CV or LinkedIn, your GitHub profile, and examples of work you have built: repositories, demos, or technical write-ups.

Include:

* A system you owned in production and an important architectural trade-off you made.
* A case where you reconciled data across systems or investigated numbers that did not tie out.
* An AI-powered workflow you shipped and how you measured whether it worked.

If your work is proprietary, an anonymized technical write-up is welcome. We want to understand your contribution, your judgment, and the results.

Job Type: Full-time

Application Question(s):
* Can you walk me through a software system or platform you've developed and successfully deployed? What was your role, and which technologies did you use?
* Have you worked on projects involving data pipelines, databases, or integrating multiple systems? Can you share an example and explain how you ensured the data was accurate and reliable?
* Have you developed or implemented AI-powered applications, particularly using large language models (LLMs) or AI agents? Can you describe a project you've worked on and how it was used in actual business operations?

Work Location: Remote

*Full Stack Engineer (Independent Contractor)*

*Location* | Latin America — Remote
*Engagement Type* | Independent contractor (services agreement)

*About LoanBud*

LoanBud is a fast-growing fintech platform dedicated to SBA financing, connecting entrepreneurs to a nationwide network of lenders and helping small business owners access capital through a streamlined, technology-driven process. We pride ourselves on a collaborative culture, meaningful work, and a strong commitment to supporting the backbone of the economy — small businesses.

*Engagement Overview*

LoanBud is seeking an independent contractor to provide senior full stack engineering services, helping build, maintain, and improve our proprietary lending and workflow platform.

The platform is used by borrowers, loan officers, processors, underwriters, referral partners, lenders, and internal operating teams. It supports the financing process from initial application through document collection, prequalification, underwriting, lender collaboration, approval, and closing.

This is a hands-on engagement with a strong backend focus. Services will be delivered primarily within our Java and Spring Boot environment, while also contributing to TypeScript front-end functionality, third-party integrations, database development, background processing, cloud infrastructure, and other parts of the LoanBud technology platform.

We are looking for a provider comfortable working inside an existing production application. We are not looking for someone who immediately wants to rebuild the platform from the ground up. We need someone who can understand the current architecture, improve it thoughtfully, resolve technical bottlenecks, and deliver reliable functionality.

The contractor will coordinate with LoanBud's leadership, product, operations, lending, and other development resources as needed to deliver the agreed services. This engagement calls for strong technical judgment, clear communication, and the ability to own a deliverable from initial requirements through production deployment.

*Scope of Services*

The contractor will provide services which may include:

* Build, test, deploy, and maintain functionality across the LoanBud platform.
* Develop backend services, APIs, business logic, security controls, and integrations using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
* Build and improve front-end functionality using TypeScript.
* Design and maintain PostgreSQL database models, queries, relationships, and migrations.
* Use Spring Data JPA to develop reliable and maintainable database access.
* Create and manage database migrations using Liquibase.
* Build secure authentication and authorization functionality using Spring Security and JWT.
* Develop and maintain API specifications, interfaces, and models using OpenAPI.
* Integrate internal and external services using REST APIs, webhooks, and OpenFeign.
* Build and support asynchronous jobs, scheduled processes, retries, and workflow monitoring using JobRunR.
* Implement and maintain business and underwriting rules using Drools.
* Support document storage and retrieval through AWS S3.
* Build and maintain email, PDF, and document-generation functionality using Thymeleaf and Playwright.
* Support SMS and communications functionality using Twilio.
* Maintain appropriate caching and application-performance controls using Caffeine.
* Support integrations between LoanBud's internal systems and customer-facing applications.
* Contribute to PHP-based backend functionality when required.
* Help maintain and improve AWS infrastructure and Terraform configurations.
* Diagnose and resolve production bugs, failed jobs, performance issues, security concerns, and integration failures.
* Improve application speed, reliability, mobile responsiveness, security, and usability.
* Produce clean, maintainable, tested, and well-documented code.
* Contribute to code reviews, technical planning, testing, release management, and production deployments.
* Improve monitoring, logging, error handling, and visibility into production systems.
* Evaluate technical tradeoffs based on speed, scalability, maintainability, cost, and business impact.
* Communicate clearly about progress, risks, dependencies, and blockers.
* Take ownership of agreed deliverables and follow through until the functionality is working properly in production.

*Required Experience and Capabilities*

* Five or more years of professional software engineering experience.
* Strong professional experience with Java and Spring Boot.
* Experience building and maintaining production APIs and backend services.
* Strong understanding of relational databases and PostgreSQL.
* Experience with Spring Data JPA or a comparable ORM.
* Experience building front-end functionality using TypeScript.
* Experience designing and integrating REST APIs and webhooks.
* Experience with authentication, authorization, JWT, and role-based permissions.
* Experience working with background jobs, scheduled processes, queues, or asynchronous workflows.
* Experience deploying and supporting applications within AWS or a comparable cloud environment.
* Understanding of Git, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and production deployment practices.
* Ability to troubleshoot issues across the front end, backend, database, infrastructure, and third-party integrations.
* Understanding of secure software-development practices and the handling of sensitive customer and financial information.
* Ability to understand a business or operational problem and translate it into practical software.
* Strong written and spoken English.
* General availability for collaboration overlapping U.S. Eastern Time business hours.
* Strong organizational skills, personal accountability, and attention to detail.
* Ability to work autonomously while maintaining clear communication and visibility.
* Willingness to work within and improve an existing platform rather than unnecessarily replacing working systems.

*Nice to Have*

Java 21 / Spring Boot 3; Liquibase, MapStruct, OpenAPI Generator, OpenFeign, Caffeine or Lombok; JobRunR or another job framework; Drools or another rules engine; Thymeleaf, Playwright or HTML-to-PDF; Twilio; AWS S3; Terraform; PHP; fintech/lending/regulated-industry experience; loan origination, CRM, borrower portal, underwriting or document-management systems; OCR, document classification, financial spreading or data extraction; AI/LLM in production; multi-tenant apps and complex permissions; distributed teams; early/growth-stage companies.

*Working Arrangement*

This is a fully remote independent contractor engagement. The contractor determines their own working schedule, methods, and location, and provides their own equipment, workspace, and internet access.

For collaboration purposes, the contractor should generally be reachable during an availability window overlapping U.S. Eastern Time business hours to participate in planning sessions, technical discussions, code reviews, and occasional production support. This reflects when real-time coordination typically occurs; it is not a mandated work schedule or a minimum-hours requirement.

We are looking for a provider who communicates proactively and maintains clear visibility on progress and blockers.

*Engagement Terms*

This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment. The contractor is responsible for their own taxes, social contributions, insurance, and any registrations required in their jurisdiction, and is not entitled to employee benefits.

Service fees will be based on experience, technical ability, communication skills, and the level of ownership the contractor can assume. Fee structure, invoicing, engagement term, and other commercial terms will be discussed during the selection process.

The contractor is free to provide services to other clients; exclusivity is not required.

*Selection Process*

Interested providers should submit a current résumé, along with any work samples or links (GitHub, portfolio) where available.

The selection process includes an initial HR conversation, a practical technical evaluation, conversations with our technical leadership, and a final conversation on culture, scope, and terms. We'll share details on each step as you move through the process.

*Be Part of Our Growth Story*

LoanBud is building a better way for entrepreneurs to access capital. Technology is central to that effort.

This role is an opportunity to help shape a core financial technology platform, solve real operating problems, and build tools that help borrowers move faster, help partners close more transactions, and give lenders a clearer path to approving and funding loans.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates directly, follows through, and cares about building technology that works in the real world.

Our mission is to empower entrepreneurs to gain access to capital.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to support and execute a critical observability migration. In this role, you will lead the transition of our application and infrastructure telemetry from New Relic to a modern, OpenTelemetry (OTel) Collector-based architecture. You will be responsible for re-instrumenting applications, updating infrastructure manifests, validating telemetry outputs, and ensuring seamless monitoring coverage across our high-scale ecosystem without compromising operational visibility.

Key Responsibilities
Migrate existing application instrumentation, tracing, and telemetry configurations from New Relic to OpenTelemetry.
Update YAML configuration files, environment variables, and deployment manifests according to established architecture standards.
Execute unit tests and validation suites to verify that telemetry is accurately generated, transformed, and exported to target backends.
Perform telemetry gap analysis, comparing existing New Relic data against OTel outputs to identify missing traces, metrics, logs, or resource attributes.
Assist in updating dashboards, monitoring documentation, and troubleshooting guides to reflect the OTel architecture.
Investigate telemetry collection and export errors, identifying root causes and collaborating with core platform engineers on complex edge cases.
Maintain clear tracking and reporting of implementation progress, edge cases, and potential migration risks.
Requirements

Must-Have:

Proven experience in software engineering with proficiency in at least one modern language (Java, Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript).
Hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel) concepts, including distributed tracing, metrics, logs, and OTel Collector configurations.
Deep experience with cloud observability paradigms and transitioning off legacy platforms like New Relic.
Solid understanding of HTTP, APIs, environment-based configurations, and reading/modifying complex YAML/JSON manifests.
Strong background in software testing, debugging, log analysis, and validating high-cardinality telemetry data.
Familiarity with modern software delivery workflows (Git, PRs, CI/CD pipelines).

Nice-to-Have:

Experience operating or configuring OTel Collectors in Kubernetes or containerized environments.
Knowledge of FinOps and cost-optimization strategies related to telemetry ingestion rates.
Key Deliverables & Success Criteria
Execution: Successfully updated application instrumentation, validated OTel Collector configs, and verified end-to-end telemetry delivery to designated backends.
Documentation: Updated technical documentation, migration checklists, and runbooks.
Quality & Continuity: Zero removal of critical monitoring coverage during the migration window, with all pull requests passing automated tests and code reviews.

Direct involvement in modernizing core platform observability for a high-growth fintech ecosystem.

Lead the layering work already in flight. Moving streaming-protocol concerns out of the player and behind a clean API.

Work directly with QC operators to turn observed pain into product-shaped requirements.
Lead deployment quality and stability strategy, including testing approach and player telemetry/RUM.
Provide technical expertise and mentoring to the engineers on the team, and raise the bar through review.
Unblock issues that are blocking the testing and release of content to our customers.
Provide on-call rotational support as needed.

What we need from you to be part of this story:

5+ years of experience building and delivering production-grade software applications.
Advanced level of English.
Hands-on coding. You will implement and debug in an unfamiliar codebase.
Concrete system design. Handed an unfamiliar problem, you get down to the actual interfaces, interactions, and responsibilities.
