Experience integrating media players into web applications.
Solid grasp of async programming models (events, callbacks, promises, async/await) and concurrency.
Experience designing or maintaining a library/package consumed by other teams (versioning, backward compatibility, breaking-change management).
Source control, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub; comfort with containerized build and deploy tooling.
Problem-solving skills to identify the root cause.

Job Requirements

BUILD SOMETHING BIGGER THAN YOURSELF

The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise with the following business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, Disney Parks, and Experiences and Products. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished.

How will you contribute to our magical experience?

Contribute architectural redesign to reduce complexity, streamline and automate workflows, modernize and consolidate systems, and improve test automation. The engineer will deliver new features and enhancements while transforming applications into scalable, modern platforms, and will serve as a key on-call resource via PagerDuty for incident response and disaster recovery.

Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology

· Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

· The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.

Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

· Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.

· Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands –and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.

· Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

· Content Platforms & Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product & Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior DevOps Engineer to join our content platform engineering team, focusing on building, supporting, and enhancing platforms, workflows, and products with a strong emphasis on platform availability, scalability, and reliability. Our team develops and manages a diverse suite of products, workflows, and services that power Disney’s entertainment and sports media supply chain, enabling content ingestion, processing and delivery for iconic brands like Disney+, ESPN+, Hulu, ABC, Freeform, FX, National Geographic, and Disney kid’s networks content.

In this role, you will ensure our workflows & products are highly performant, available, and facilitate operational efficiency. You will contribute to creating software that empowers operators to troubleshoot and resolve customer-impacting issues independently, as well as contribute to on-call support, internal testing, and development of workflows & integrations with our media supply chain services platform. Leveraging modern software engineering practices and cloud infrastructure, you will build solutions for Observability, Continuous Integration & Deployments, distributed systems, and platform development that enable content ingestion, preparation, distribution, and content operations at scale.

The Sr. DevOps Engineer will be responsible for:

• Write and Maintain Software Solutions: Design, write, test, and deploy high-quality code to develop reliable, maintainable software solutions.

• Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work closely with product software engineers, platform engineers, product teams, and content operations teams to ensure technical solutions effectively support business goals and content strategies.

• Production Support: Monitor and optimize production systems, ensuring platform stability, performance, and uptime.

• Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous learning.

What we need from you to be part of this story:

· Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, Mathematics, or a closely related field.

· 3+ years of experience in SRE/DevOps roles.

· Experience operating distributed systems, especially in cloud environments

· Strong experience with Linux Systems Administration.

· Experience with Incident Management, Change Management, and On-call support.

· Strong working experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Container Orchestration

· Familiarity with advanced backend technologies such as gRPC, GraphQL, or reactive programming frameworks (plus).

· Good knowledge of Networking protocols and components: TCP/IP Stack, Switches, Routers, Load Balancers.

· Experience with source control, CI/CD platforms (Gitlab CI, GitHub Actions or Jenkins), strong systems development (Go, Python) and cloud automation tools (CloudFormation, Terraform).

· Must be able to work with a geographically dispersed team.

· Excellent problem-solving.

· Understanding of security best practices in cloud-based environments (plus).

· Experience working with Kubernetes, distributed messaging technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, etc.), object storages and SQL/NOSQL Databases (plus).

· Proven architectural skills and ability to communicate about software processes, architectures, and design patterns (plus).

· Strong curiosity about how Disney delivers the Magic and a desire to be a part of it (plus).

· Familiarity with advanced backend technologies such as gRPC, GraphQL, or reactive programming frameworks (plus).

· Knowledge of streaming workflows, video content delivery, or media distribution pipelines.

· Previous experience working in media, entertainment, or sports tech environments (plus).

Additional Information:

At Disney, we believe it takes great people to create the memorable experiences, products and services our consumers know and love. We are a team of storytellers and hire under equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, disability and gender identity. We foster a corporate culture of belonging and inclusiveness, which empowers our staff and company to thrive. At Disney, everyone has the opportunity to speak up and participate, grow and share ideas.

“You can design and create, and build the most wonderful place in the world. But it takes people to make the dream a reality.” Walt Disney

Coordinación de escalaciones con otras áreas y proveedores, manteniendo informados a los usuarios y cumpliendo los niveles de servicio acordados.

· Administración de herramientas y procesos de backup y recuperación: seguimiento de ejecuciones, resolución de fallas y realización de pruebas periódicas de restauración. postings.title: Credit Risk Sr Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
PedidosYa forma parte de Delivery Hero, empresa líder mundial en servicios de delivery con presencia en ~65 países. PedidosYa es la empresa de tecnología líder en delivery y quick-commerce en Latinoamérica. Es una plataforma simple, rápida y accesible que conecta a millones de personas usuarias, empresas y repartidores con una amplia variedad de productos y servicios. PedidosYa opera en 15 países en latinoamérica, y en 2020 lanzó PedidosYa Markets, el primer mercado 100% digital que entrega alimentos y artículos para el hogar en 15 minutos. Delivery Hero cotiza en la Bolsa de Frankfurt desde 2017 y forma parte del índice bursátil MDAX.

Descripción del empleo

Tenemos una oportunidad para vos, estamos buscando Credit Risk Sr Analyst en Buenos Aires.

Qué desafíos te esperan:

• Diseñar, optimizar e implementar políticas de crédito y ajustar el pricing mensual por país, asegurando cumplimiento regulatorio y objetivos de negocio.

• Colaborar en el desarrollo y la implementación de modelos de scoring de crédito junto con el equipo de Data Analytics.

• Monitorear la evolución del default, realizar análisis de datos para identificar desviaciones y proponer estrategias de mitigación para un crecimiento sostenible.

• Liderar la evaluación del riesgo en el lanzamiento de nuevos productos y la expansión a mercados emergentes, participando en iniciativas estratégicas.

• Implementar y validar cambios en el motor de riesgo, realizando pruebas exhaustivas para asegurar su correcto funcionamiento.

• Ser el referente de riesgo en diferentes paises, coordinando con equipos cross-funcionales y exponiendo hallazgos y recomendaciones a stakeholders clave mediante presentaciones mensuales.

Requisitos

¿Qué esperamos de vos?

• Formación universitaria en Actuaría, Economía, Estadística, Ingeniería o carreras afines.

• Experiencia previa en análisis de riesgo en banca, fintech o consultoría financiera.

• Experiencia en seguimiento de KPIs de riesgo y análisis de crédito.

• Conocimiento en Excel avanzado, SQL, y herramientas de análisis de datos.

• Capacidad analítica para interpretar tendencias y proponer acciones.

Información adicional

• Crear valor para un gran ecosistema de negocio.

• Jugar en equipo, siempre: Pensar soluciones y construir colaborativamente, con buena energía.

• Moverte a la velocidad de tus ideas y emprender.

• Aprender, desarrollarte y reinventarte: Permitirte equivocarte, aprender haciendo, iterar y adaptarte a los cambios.

• Generar impacto positivo en las personas y el planeta.

• Trabajar de otra manera, en #ModoPeYa: no importa el tiempo ni el lugar desde donde trabajas, lo que importa es la agilidad con la que tomas decisiones, la flexibilidad para adaptarte y los resultados que alcanzas en equipo.

En PedidosYa, el impacto no se mide solo en resultados sino en cómo los alcanzamos. Buscamos al mejor talento: personas que vibren con nuestros valores, la forma en la que pensamos, decidimos y colaboramos todos los días.

Lo que lográs es clave, pero el “cómo” lo hacés es lo que nos define. Jugando en equipo, hacemos que el negocio y nuestro ecosistema sigan creciendo, mientras le simplificamos el día a día a millones de personas.

👉 Conocé nuestros valores aquí.

La diversidad de talento potencia nuestra Cultura y nuestra organización. Jugamos en equipo en todo lo que hacemos, y lo que más nos gusta de eso es que promovemos la creación de equipos diversos e inclusivos que puedan aportar diferentes perspectivas a PedidosYa. Nuestras oportunidades laborales están abiertas a todas las personas, independientemente de su identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico, religión, edad, discapacidad y/o otras características individuales.

En caso de necesitar algún ajuste razonable o accesibilidad particular para tener la entrevista, por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación. Además, siéntete libre de indicarnos tus pronombres (él/ella/elle) desde el primer contacto.

• Drive the modernization of existing processes by collaborating closely with regional Controllership teams, sharing insights, providing technical accounting guidance, and ensuring compliance with corporate policies.

• Facilitate and influence the implementation of global accounting policies updates by reviewing, communicating and proposing critical changes to be incorporated into the Corporate Circular Letters (CCL), collaborating closely with regional Controllership.

• Collaborate on training for regional Controllership teams related to new or change accounting policies.

• At least two years of relevant professional experience.

• Intermediate English proficiency or higher.

• Knowledge of US GAAP.

• Identificar oportunidades para Producto: Traducir problemas y necesidades de negocio en propuestas concretas, dimensionando su alcance e impacto esperado. Relevar requerimientos y aportar evidencia para la definición y priorización del roadmap.

• Construir y actualizar casos de negocio: Colaborar en la evaluación de funcionalidades, lanzamientos, acuerdos e iniciativas comerciales. Relevar y validar supuestos, comparar escenarios de adopción, volumen, ingresos, costos y retorno, y contrastar los resultados reales con las proyecciones.

• Comprender las necesidades del cliente: Trabajar con Comercial, CX y UX para relevar necesidades y fricciones de comercios, emprendedores, empresas y usuarios de crédito. Utilizar entrevistas, encuestas, motivos de contacto y datos de comportamiento para proponer mejoras.

• Colaborar en iniciativas comerciales y de crecimiento: Analizar segmentos y canales de adquisición, dar seguimiento a leads y su conversión, y evaluar acciones con partners. Identificar oportunidades para aumentar la cantidad de clientes activos y la adopción de los productos.

• Implementar campañas y comunicaciones: Colaborar con Marketing, Comercial y CX en briefs, segmentación de bases, revisión de contenidos y coordinación de piezas y materiales. Gestionar las validaciones necesarias con las áreas correspondientes y analizar los resultados.

Qué buscamos para este rol

• Experiencia en análisis de datos y elaboración de recomendaciones para la toma de decisiones.

• Experiencia en ejecución y seguimiento de iniciativas en coordinación con distintas áreas.

• Se valorará experiencia en investigación de mercado, construcción de casos de negocio y trabajo con equipos de Producto, Comercial y Marketing.

• Estudiante avanzado o graduado de Economía, Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Finanzas o carreras afines (no excluyente).

• Conocimiento práctico de SQL para consultar y analizar bases de datos (no excluyente).

• Manejo de herramientas de visualización y dashboards, deseable.

¿Por qué trabajar en Ualá?

¿Por qué trabajar en Ualá?Queremos compartir con vos...

• Ambiente laboral flexible, en crecimiento y con un enorme potencial de desarrollo profesional.

• Acceso a formación en instituciones educativas de primer nivel con descuentos en capacitaciones, cursos y carreras.

• Valoramos el equilibrio entre la vida profesional y personal, por eso contamos con tres semanas de vacaciones, licencias extendidas, día libre en tu cumpleaños, políticas de trabajo flexible y más.

• También brindamos cobertura de medicina prepaga para grupo familiar, descuento en gimnasios, cashback del 70% en tus compras con la tarjeta de Ualá con tope de reintegro, bono por referidos y otros beneficios que te acompañan dentro y fuera del trabajo.

Creemos que las mejores ideas nacen de la diversidad de miradas y experiencias, por eso, creamos un espacio seguro y colaborativo, en el que todas las voces cuentan.En Ualá contamos con representantes de 11 nacionalidades, de diversos orígenes y experiencias. El 46% del equipo son mujeres, un hito en una empresa tecnológico-financiera. Si lo comparamos con América Latina, menos del 30% del personal que trabaja en empresas fintech son mujeres. Esa diversidad nos fortalece y es la única manera de desarrollar un producto inclusivo para competir con las mejores empresas de la región y el mundo.Si te motiva transformar la industria y hacer las cosas de otra manera, te estamos buscando. Porque desde el primer día construímos el equipo con una máxima: sólo el mejor equipo puede hacer el mejor producto. Por eso contratar, retener, y apostar al talento es lo más importante que hacemos.

You will connect business systems, manage data, automate workflows, and create dashboards that help internal teams and clients run their operations. You will also learn to improve and integrate our AI agents, with technical guidance and code review from our Lead Architect.

• Strong SQL and practical PostgreSQL experience: Comfortable with joins, aggregations, data updates, table relationships, and data quality.

• API integration: Experience with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and handling failed requests.

• Familiarity with Git, basic testing, logging, and debugging.

• Clear written and spoken English and the ability to work directly with business users.

• Initiative, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to learn new tools, including AI agents.

Nice to Have

• Personal or professional experience building AI agents or LLM-powered workflows.

• JavaScript and React experience for building interactive application interfaces.

• Automation platforms such as n8n or Make.

• Cloud hosting, Docker, or application deployment.

• Experience supporting Sales, Marketing, or Recruiting workflows.

Compensation & Details

• Location: Remote, Latin America, India, Philippines.

• Compensation: Competitive, based on experience and demonstrated skills.

• Schedule: Regular overlap with US working hours.

• Support: Technical guidance and code review from our Lead Architect.

• Benefits: Equipment provided and health insurance included.

To apply, share your resume and brief examples of a Python automation or integration and a Power BI dashboard you built. Explain your contribution and the business problem each solved.

postings.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (CX Platform) (Buenos Aires)
postings.descriptionText:
About Us

At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.

We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.

Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long because we are obsessed with our customers . We get things done with urgency and focus , driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego , fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together. Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay insatiably curious —always experimenting, building the future today, and delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better.

About The Role

We are transitioning our core operational capabilities from third-party low-code solutions to a robust, highly scalable, in-house ecosystem. As part of the CX Platform team, you will own the construction of the operational modules that power our daily business, building features end-to-end from the React UI down to the Node.js services that aggregate and protect our data.

You will own the modules, screens, and APIs that the CX team relies on every day, designing, building, and shipping them end-to-end. Your work has a direct, measurable impact: every feature you ship reduces handling times, removes friction, and gives our operators superpowers.

If you love taking features from idea to production without artificial silos between frontend and backend, and you get satisfaction from shipping tools that real humans rely on to do real work, this is your place.

Technology Stack:

We care more about strong engineering fundamentals than expertise in any specific tool. If your foundations are solid, picking up adjacent technologies should be second nature. That said, here is the stack you will be working with day to day:

• Front-end: Advanced React, TypeScript, Component-Driven UI, Modular CSS Architectures.

• Back-end: Node.js + TypeScript, REST API design, secure aggregation layers, Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) patterns.

• Data Layer: Relational data modeling (PostgreSQL or similar), schema design, query optimization, transactional integrity.

• Security & Access: RBAC, secure handling of sensitive data, strict environment isolation.

• Tooling & Delivery: Modern build tools and bundlers, Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines.

Responsibilities

• End-to-End Feature Ownership: Build complete operational modules, from the React UI down to the Node.js services and data models that power them. You own the feature, not just a layer of it.

• Module Development: Design and ship the modules that live on top of our CX platform: high-density data views, complex operational workflows, and internal tools that drastically reduce cognitive load for our operators.

• Secure Integration Layer: Implement intermediary layers (BFFs, aggregators) that consume internal microservices and external providers, standardize payloads, and enforce strict authorization rules before data reaches the client.

• Operational Efficiency: Collaborate shoulder-to-shoulder with core business stakeholders to deeply understand their daily workflows, then translate that understanding into technical solutions that materially reduce handling times.

• Engineering Craft: Champion clean patterns, pragmatic design, and a high quality bar across the modules you ship. Mentor peers and elevate the broader engineering culture.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Fluent or advanced English.

• Advanced React & UI Engineering: Deep understanding of React and solid foundations in web standards (HTML/DOM, CSS, HTTP). TypeScript proficiency is expected.

• Solid Node.js / Backend Skills: Proven ability to design and build well-structured REST APIs in Node.js. Strong grasp of API design, service boundaries, error handling, and clean backend patterns.

• Data Modeling: Comfortable designing relational schemas, writing performant queries, and reasoning about transactional integrity.

• Security & Authorization: Hands-on experience implementing authentication and authorization flows, especially Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) over sensitive data.

• Aggregation / BFF Patterns: Ability to design backend-for-frontend or aggregation layers that consume multiple microservices and expose a clean, secure surface to the client.

• Problem Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills with a balance of creative UI implementation and strict engineering rigor on the backend.

Nice to have (highly desirable):

• Technical Leadership: Track record of mentoring engineers, raising the bar in code reviews, and influencing architectural decisions beyond your immediate scope.

• Internal Tools / Enterprise Ops: Experience building internal tools, CRM systems, or high-density data applications focused on operational efficiency and scale.

• Regulated Environments: Background in highly regulated sectors (Fintech, Healthcare) dealing with strict role-based access control (RBAC) and data isolation.

What We Offer

• Competitive salary

• Initial stock options grant

• Annual performance bonus

• Health, dental, and vision plans

• Work model: currently fully remote, with a future transition to a hybrid setup.

• Continuous learning opportunities

• Continuous learning opportunities

• Unlimited PTO

• Paid parental leave

• Empowering opportunities for growth in a dynamic entrepreneurial environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Félix, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and termination.

Want to learn more about our privacy practices? Check out our Privacy Policy .

postings.descriptionText:
Overview of Position

The Software Engineer will design, develop, and implement software applications that support and enhance industrial automation systems. This role partners with multidisciplinary engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance automation solutions that drive operational efficiency across reverse logistics operations. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering expertise with experience in automation technologies, machine vision, data processing, and cloud-based solutions.

What makes us different?

• Opportunity to work on cutting-edge industrial automation and reverse logistics solutions.

• Exposure to machine vision, machine learning, and emerging technologies in a fast-paced environment.

• Collaborative, global team of software and automation engineering professionals.

• Ability to influence architecture, technical strategy, and innovation initiatives.

• Career growth through challenging projects and continuous learning opportunities.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

• Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain software applications supporting industrial automation systems.

• Develop scalable libraries, tools, APIs, reporting platforms, and visualization solutions to improve operational performance.

• Integrate machine vision systems, machine learning models, and data processing technologies into automation workflows.

• Collaborate with project managers, automation engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to define technical requirements and deliver solutions.

• Participate in technical leadership activities including architecture discussions, code reviews, best practice development, and research initiatives.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of professional software development experience.

• Strong programming experience with C++, Python, and/or C#.

• Experience designing and integrating RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Experience building scalable software solutions in industrial automation, manufacturing, logistics, or related environments.

• Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases, data modeling, and performance optimization.

• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

• Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, Docker, Kubernetes, and microservice architectures.

• Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

• Experience with machine vision technologies, including OpenCV and hardware integration.

• Experience developing or integrating machine learning solutions using frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.

• Experience working with large datasets, real-time data streaming, and data visualization tools.

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, OPC-UA, and EtherCAT.

• Experience integrating with PLC, SCADA, and HMI systems.

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?

General office environment with frequent collaboration across engineering, operations, and technology teams. Work may include occasional interaction with industrial automation equipment and software systems.

If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Helping People Thrive in a Connected World

Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we’ll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at jobs.assurant.com.

What’s the culture like at Assurant?

Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

Company Overview

Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

AI and Biometric Usage

Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.

Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant’s privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Assurant is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not use or consider race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in employment decisions.

Job Scam Alert

Please be aware that during Assurant's application process, we will never ask for personal information such as your Social Security number, bank account details, or passwords. Learn more about what to look out for and how to report a scam here.

postings.descriptionText:
About Shop Innovator

We help premium, high-ticket Shopify brands scale by building high-converting sales machines. We are looking for a hands-on Shopify professional who can build polished storefronts, maintain client stores, and manage day-to-day website updates.

About The Role

This hybrid role combines Shopify front-end development, website maintenance, content management, and direct client support. You will convert Figma designs into code, optimize storefront performance, and serve as a reliable technical point of contact for our clients and internal team.

What You'll Do

• Shopify Development: Build responsive pages, sections, and OS 2.0 templates using Liquid, HTML5, CSS3, and JS. Convert Figma designs into pixel-perfect code using Git/GitHub workflows.

• Store Management & Maintenance: Maintain client stores, troubleshoot theme bugs, install/configure apps, manage content updates, and optimize page speed and Core Web Vitals.

• Client & Team Collaboration: Communicate directly with clients via email and calls (5–10 calls/month) to explain technical solutions, gather requirements, and manage task updates in ClickUp.

• CRO & Marketing Support: Build landing pages, add conversion elements (reviews, trust badges, FAQs), and configure third-party tools like Klaviyo, Judge.me, GA4, and Meta Pixel.

What We're Looking For

• At least three years of professional Shopify development or website-management experience.

• Strong knowledge of Shopify Liquid.

• Strong HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript skills.

• Experience with Shopify Online Store 2.0.

• Experience creating reusable Shopify sections, blocks, and templates.

• Experience converting Figma designs into responsive Shopify pages.

• Experience with Git and GitHub.

• Experience installing and configuring Shopify apps.

• Experience managing products, collections, pages, blogs, navigation, and website content.

• Working knowledge of ecommerce SEO and on-page optimization.

• Strong understanding of responsive web development.

• Excellent attention to visual detail.

• Strong written communication skills.

• Ability to produce accurate, polished work with minimal supervision.

Who You Are

You're someone who:

• Loves working with Shopify.

• Is reliable, responsive, and dependable.

• Works quickly without sacrificing accuracy.

• Notices UX, content, and visual issues before anyone else.

• Has a strong eye for design, spacing, consistency, and presentation.

• Thinks beyond writing code and considers the full customer experience.

• Understands that premium products require trust-building content and thoughtful presentation.

• Enjoys solving problems independently.

• Is highly organized and communicates clearly.

• Takes ownership of projects from assignment through testing and deployment.

• Tests everything before marking a task complete.

• Can comfortably manage multiple client projects and priorities.

• Collaborates well with designers, marketers, project managers, and clients.

• Is comfortable asking questions when requirements are unclear.

• Looks for ways to improve a page instead of simply completing the requested update.

Bonus Points

Experience with any of the following would be an asset: Shopify Markets, Shopify Flow, Shopify Functions, Checkout UI Extensions, Metafields and metaobjects, Klaviyo, Judge.me, Shopify Search & Discovery, GA4 and Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Schema markup, Core Web Vitals optimization, Accessibility and WCAG standards, Conversion rate optimization, A/B testing platforms, Image and video editing tools, AI coding assistants such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or ChatGPT.

Schedule: Remote with required 3–4 hours of daily overlap with 10 AM – 5 PM EST.

Why Join Shop Innovator?

• Work with premium ecommerce brands rather than commodity products.

• Build websites that directly contribute to business growth.

• Be part of a small, experienced, and collaborative team.

• Work on a variety of interesting Shopify projects.

• Develop your knowledge of high-ticket ecommerce, UX, CRO, and customer buying psychology.

• Learn from experienced ecommerce strategists, designers, developers, and marketers.

• Enjoy flexible remote working hours.

• Grow with the agency as we expand.

Ready to build high-converting Shopify experiences with us? Click Apply Now to submit your application!

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Python Application Security Engineer to automate security controls and integrate application security into software development and cloud workflows.

MUST HAVES
- 3+ years of experience combining software engineering experience, security implementation and/or architecture experience.
- Strong coding and architectural proficiency in Python (for security automation and scripting).
- Hands-on experience or familiarity with Wiz, Prisma Cloud, or similar tools for cloud security posture management and threat detection.
- Implementation experience with deploy-time checks against Infrastructure as Code (IaC) / Terraform.
- Implementation experience with runtime checks through Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM).
- Fully autonomous execution capability, requiring no daily supervision to map out and build automated security runbooks.
- Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Deep, hands-on expertise deploying and tuning modern application security testing tools (SAST, DAST, SCA) and integrating them into complex CI/CD orchestration ecosystems.
- Experience integrating LLMs, AI agents, or automated coding assistants to streamline vulnerability triaging or secure code generation.
- Advanced application threat modeling experience.
- Ability to confidently read, review, and secure enterprise source Java code.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Pipeline Integration: Write and maintain the scripts necessary to integrate security gates (SAST, DAST, SCA) seamlessly into the CI/CD pipeline.
- Security Data Triage: Continuously tune and configure existing security scanning tools to eliminate false positives and deliver high-confidence alerts.
- Baseline Automation: Assist in coding and deploying automated hardened baselines and secure coding patterns.
- Code-Level Remediation: Work directly with product development teams to provide actionable, code-level remediation guidance in Java and Python.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth : Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation : USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
- Exciting projects : Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
- Flextime : Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

postings.title: AWS Data Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About The Opportunity

This is a pipeline requisition for future opportunities. While we are not hiring immediately, we regularly seek top talent for this role and encourage you to express interest.

Netrix Global is looking for a AWS Data Engineer with hands-on AWS experience for the Professional Services – Data Intelligence department. The Data Engineer will be responsible for supporting the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the client's data platform. The candidate should be comfortable working across multiple aspects of data ecosystems, including Lakehouse architectures, data pipelines, data modeling, and cloud-based analytics solutions.

Often, a Data Engineer will also serve as a critical communicator between other data science team members, working directly with the data scientists who develop the models for building AI systems and the people who construct and run them.

About The Team

• Our team works remote base, in a collaborative environment

• We have a strong team with opportunities to expand their skillsets and gain further knowledge across multiple parts of the organization 

How You Will Make An Impact

• Identifying, creating, preparing data required for modern Data solutions and Data for AI

• Designing ETLs and ELTs for data transformations

• Designing, building and management of Datalakes architectures

• Working with Apache Hadoop projects (Spark, Hive, Pig, Oozie, Airflow, etc)

• Integrating and testing Data solutions

• Creating and documenting the tests to meet requirements

• Working with Bigdata Environments

• Managing Data Cloud services, data access, security and data governance

• Analyzing and prepare data for Machine Learning workloads

• Managing monitoring and logs of applications and services

What You Will Bring To The Table

• Experience in Data Engineer/Architect role and tasks as ETL, data prepare & ingest, data streaming.

• Experience working in AWS environments

• Knowledge of Python, R or other data process tools

• Intermediate/ Upper English Level

• Experience with Apache Spark

• Experience using AWS Data services: S3, AWS or Microsoft Glue, Athena, Sagemaker, etc.

• Experience using Devops tools (Git, pipelines)

• Experience working in an Agile Scrum team

• Experience working with infrastructure as a code (Terraform, Cloudformation, etc.)

Location

Argentina (any part of the country its great for us!)

Shift

9 a.m to 6 p.m from Monday to Friday

What We Offer

• Swiss Medical: SMG-30 (family members included).

• AWS and Azure certifications.

• Happy club: Pedidos Ya

• Internet and connectivity.

• Competitive salary and benefits.

• English in company.

• Ability to work remotely.

• An awesome learning environment for you to develop.

About Us

At Netrix Global our values are the philosophies and principles that we live by. They support our vision, help us achieve our goals and commit us to a common purpose.

We Own Outcomes, Win Together, Make An Impact, Enjoy The Journey, and Respect All!

Netrix Global is a mission-driven organization with the goal of providing the people, processes, and technology needed to run and scale modern, data-driven businesses that are always on and always secure. Our breadth of capabilities allows us to provide holistic offerings that solve even today’s most complex business challenges, delivering to you an integrated, optimized, and future-proof solution.

What You Can Expect From Us

We offer a competitive compensation package, comprehensive group benefits to meet the needs of you and your family, flexibility, and time off when you need it, and a casual work environment. The role can be remote/home office, with some travel required.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Our hiring, promotion and compensation processes are based on merit, skills, and qualifications, to ensure a fair and unbiased approach for our candidates and employees. As part of this commitment, we will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations.

If you need a reasonable accommodation, please let us know by contacting NetrixHR@Netrixglobal.

To learn more about Netrix Global please go to www.netrixglobal.com

Nuestro Stack Tecnológico

Trabajarás principalmente con AWS , Kubernetes /EKS, Java , Node .js, Aurora PostgreSQL, Apache Kafka /MSK, GitLab CI/CD, Datadog , Backstage y Cloudflare. (No es obligatorio dominar todo el stack, valoramos la capacidad de aprendizaje y resolución de problemas arquitectónicos complejos) .

Sumarte a La Experiencia NX Es

🌍 #WorkFromAnywhere: desde cualquier parte del país o el mundo.

👶 Licencia extendida y flexibilidad al regreso para gestantes y no gestantes. + Licencias especiales para el cuidado de tu familia.

• Develop and maintain reusable Terraform modules and Jenkins/Groovy CI/CD pipelines.

• Operate and optimize streaming platforms, data infrastructure, and distributed systems.

• Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and proactive incident resolution.

• Continuously optimize AWS costs through resource right-sizing, waste reduction, and cost-conscious architecture decisions.

• Automate operational processes using Python, Bash, and AWS Lambda.

• Strengthen infrastructure security, vulnerability management, and CI/CD security controls.

• Own infrastructure projects end-to-end, from design and deployment to documentation and ongoing support.

• Create clear technical documentation and step-by-step runbooks for first-level support teams.

• Manage infrastructure changes through reviewed Pull Requests using a single main branch.

• Use performance metrics, operational data, and cost analysis to guide technical decisions and advise leadership.

• Leverage AI tools to improve productivity while maintaining code quality and review standards.

Nice to Have

• Experience in AdTech or Real-Time Bidding (RTB) environments.

• AWS CloudFormation.

• Java development experience.

postings.descriptionText:
About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

• Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.

• Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.

• Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.

• Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.

• Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a Senior Agentic .NET Engineer (6 month engagement).

• You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of professional experience with .NET and C#.

• Advanced English is required.

• Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.

• Has integrated, deployed, and managed production applications on Microsoft Azure using cloud-native services.

• Has integrated AI-enabled features or agentic workflows into a production .NET application.

• Has shipped at least one cloud-native application on Microsoft Azure using microservices or API integrations.

• Has built RESTful APIs and backend services integrated with enterprise databases.

• Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.

• Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.

• Forensic attention to detail.

• A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.

• Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams.

• Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.

• Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.

• Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Nice To Have

We’re Seeking Engineers Who Are AI-enthusiastic In Their Workflow. Professional Experience Or Personal Project Work With The Following Is a Significant Plus

• Cursor, Windsurf, or Google Antigravity.

• Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Copilot CLI.

Work Authorization Requirements

• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.

• FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

• Competitive pay.

• 100% remote work.

• The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.

• Continuing education opportunities.

• Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

postings.title: Cloud Security Architect
postings.descriptionText:
¿Te animas a construir el futuro de Latinoamérica? 🚀

En Rappi construimos la SuperApp que cambia la vida de millones de personas cada día. Somos un equipo apasionado por la velocidad, la ejecución y los resultados reales.

Aquí hacemos que las cosas pasen. Si te mueve resolver problemas de escala real, aprender en tiempo récord y ver el impacto de tus ideas en cuestión de días, este es tu lugar.

¿Quieres construir los sistemas que mueven a millones de personas cada día? 🛠️

El reto

Buscamos un SysAdmin orientado a la nube que administre, mantenga y haga evolucionar las plataformas sobre las que corre la organización, en un entorno 100% cloud sobre AWS. El foco principal del rol es operar y mantener la infraestructura y las plataformas —cómputo, redes, almacenamiento, identidad— con alta disponibilidad, confiabilidad y buenas prácticas operativas.

Es un rol híbrido con un fuerte componente de seguridad operativa (similar al perfil de Blue Team, pero desde el lado de la administración): hardening, parcheo, gestión de accesos y respuesta a eventos de infraestructura. No se requiere ser un experto en Blue Team, pero sí sentirse cómodo aplicando controles de seguridad y colaborando con el equipo de seguridad en el día a día.

Trabajarás de forma autónoma en un equipo distribuido globalmente, con impacto directo en la estabilidad y la postura de seguridad de las plataformas.

RESPONSABILIDADES

Implementar y mantener infraestructura como código (Terraform, AWS CDK) y gestión de configuración (Ansible)

Monitorear la salud de las plataformas con observabilidad (CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana) y responder a alertas de disponibilidad y performance

Gestionar backups, estrategias de recuperación ante desastres (DR) y continuidad del negocio

Administrar redes cloud: VPC, subnets, routing, DNS (Route53), VPN y conectividad híbrida

Mantener documentación operativa, runbooks y procedimientos de guardia (on-call)

Automatizar tareas operativas repetitivas mediante scripting (Python, Bash)

Ejecutar el ciclo de parcheo y hardening de servidores, AMIs y contenedores siguiendo benchmarks (CIS)

Gestionar Security Groups, NACLs y controles de acceso de red aplicando least privilege

Colaborar con el equipo de seguridad en la remediación de findings de vulnerabilidades (AWS Inspector, escáneres)

Mantener logging y auditoría de infraestructura (CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs) y apoyar en la respuesta a eventos de seguridad en plataformas

Gestión segura de secretos y credenciales (AWS Secrets Manager, SSM Parameter Store)

Ejecutar y optimizar procesos de Information Security II en Rappi, aplicando expertise técnico y generando insights que impulsen decisiones de negocio.

Tus desafíos

• Ejecutar procesos y análisis de alta complejidad

• Generar insights y recomendaciones basadas en datos

• Colaborar con stakeholders para resolver desafíos

• Documentar procesos y mejores prácticas

• Mentorear a miembros junior del equipo

Serás un gran fit

• Experiencia: 4 años en roles similares

• Inglés: Básico-intermedio

• Experiencia previa en startups tech, e-commerce o marketplaces (deseable)

• Experiencia en squads ágiles y entornos remote-first (deseable)

Lo que necesitas dominar

• 4+ años de experiencia como SysAdmin, Cloud Engineer o Platform Engineer

• Dominio de administración de sistemas Linux y Windows Server.

• Experiencia sólida operando infraestructura en AWS: EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, Load Balancers, Auto Scaling

• Experiencia con contenedores y orquestación: Docker y Kubernetes (EKS/ECS)

• Infraestructura como código: Terraform o AWS CDK; gestión de configuración (Ansible deseable)

• Scripting y automatización: Python y Bash

• Conocimiento de redes cloud: VPC, subnets, routing, DNS, VPN, Security Groups, NACLs

• Experiencia con observabilidad y monitoreo: CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana

• Fundamentos de seguridad operativa: hardening, parcheo, least privilege, gestión de accesos y secretos

• Experiencia participando en esquemas de guardia (on-call)

Lo que te hace diferente

Real ownership from day one, not check-ins and micromanagement. That's what the Business Development Representative role at Nortal looks like.

• Support beyond the job. Our People Care team helps with time off, wellness, and anything in between.

What You Get

• Full remote work, with coworking spaces across LATAM if you want to meet the team in person.

• Paid time off under your country's rules, at full salary.

• National holidays.

• Sick leave, no stress attached.

• A yearly refundable credit. Spend it on anything related to your health and well-being.

• A day off for your birthday.

About This Search

Great talent doesn't wait for job postings, so we don't either. We're building a network of skilled professionals for roles that come up regularly with our clients.

Join our Future Talent network and you'll be one of the first people we reach when the right opening appears. We make around 160 hires a year, so it happens often.

The role

As a Business Development Representative, you will think like an account-based marketer. You'll design and run the strategy to attract new opportunities and relevant connections for Nortal, with a clear target of opportunities detected each period.

You'll spend as much time designing and testing ABM plays as you do on outreach, and you'll own the results from first touch to handoff to our new business team..

Your Day-to-day

Design the attraction strategy

• Design and execute the strategy to attract new opportunities and build relevant connections for Nortal in the US.

• Build and maintain a tiered target account list (one-to-one, one-to-few, one-to-many) with sales leadership.

• Research each priority account: business priorities, tech stack, recent triggers such as funding, leadership changes, or modernization programs, and the buying committee.

Run ABM campaigns that convert

• Turn account research into campaign concepts with a clear message, offer, and call to action for each person.

• Write the copy and launch the campaign: email sequences, LinkedIn content, landing pages, direct mail, and event invitations.

• Coordinate plays across email, LinkedIn, paid social, intent-based advertising, webinars, and events, so sales and marketing hit each account with one story.

Generate and qualify opportunities

• Hit your target of opportunities detected and qualified.

• Prospect into VP, C-level, and senior IT and digital leaders at mid-market and enterprise companies.

• Book discovery meetings, qualify them against our criteria, and hand them over with full context.

• Keep the CRM clean so anyone can see where every account stands.

Test and Challenge

• Try new channels, messages, and formats, and challenge the way we do things today.

• Run A/B tests on messages, offers, and channels, and report what worked and what didn't.

• Share what you learn so the next play starts smarter.

postings.title: Content Manager
postings.descriptionText:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

What does a Content Manager do at WPP Production?

The Content Manager is responsible for moderating internal content and publishing high-profile, fast-turnaround web, in-store, and marketing assets. This role emphasizes regional and global content, necessitating close collaboration with other hubs situated across various countries. Such collaboration is critical to achieving success.

Core Responsibilities

• Manage day-to-day Digital Content Publisher tasks, both regionally and globally, across various platforms.

• Review all materials delivered for publishing and implement all publishing protocols.

• Understand and contribute to the ever-evolving workflows to ensure flawless delivery.

• Liaise with Project Management and Design teams to ensure consistency and quality across materials, with a focus on continuous improvement and increased efficiency.

• Flag any concerns or issues encountered with the format in which work is received, ensuring that feedback is provided and processes are consistently adhered to.

• Support the final publication of content within the client's proprietary CMS.

• Maintain a thorough knowledge and understanding of the client brand guidelines and expectations, staying updated with any changes as they evolve.

• Ensure a comprehensive understanding of the client’s platform guidelines, reviewing and evaluating content accordingly.

• Escalate complex cases or content requiring further review to senior moderators or other departments.

Requirements:

• 2 to 4 years of experience working with a content management system and managing content for a global audience.

• Experience in client services or production agencies.

• An exceptional eye for detail, with the ability to work at pace while maintaining absolute focus, particularly in an open-plan environment, is essential for success.

• Highly detail-oriented, organized, and capable of handling ambiguity.

• Experience with Wrike or other project management tools to track workload and progress.

• Ability to multitask and prioritize work effectively.

• Ability to work under tight deadlines.

• Ability to clearly document and troubleshoot errors.

• Capacity to quickly acquire new responsibilities.

• Analytical mindset and problem-solving aptitude.

• Proactive with strong communication skills, both verbal and written.

Why work here:

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data

We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.

postings.title: Digital Analytics Leader
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description Summary

The Digital Analytics Leader serves as the analytics business partner for a key commercial area of GE HealthCare’s global marketing organization and owns the analytics products built for it. The role works directly with business stakeholders to understand their decision needs, translates those needs into clear requirements and KPIs, and steers delivery through launch and adoption. This is a business-partnering and product-ownership position, focused on shaping and prioritizing what gets built and driving its use rather than hands-on development.

Job Description

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator with over 100 years of healthcare industry experience and around 50,000 employees globally.

We enable clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics, applications and services, supported by our Edison intelligence platform. We operate at the center of an ecosystem working toward precision health -digitizing healthcare, helping drive productivity and improving outcomes for patients, providers, health systems and researchers around the world.

Roles And Responsibilities

• Builds trusted relationships with business stakeholders and develops a deep understanding of their priorities, decisions and reporting gaps. Translates business needs into use cases, requirements, KPIs and acceptance criteria.

• Owns the roadmap, backlog, milestones and governance for the assigned analytics portfolio. Coordinates delivery across business stakeholders, developers, IT and platform owners, tracking scope, risks and dependencies.

• Runs workshops, design reviews, demonstrations and user-acceptance testing to confirm products meet business needs. Leads communications, training, launch and adoption, and monitors usage, satisfaction and business value after release.

• Manages stakeholder expectations against available capacity and escalates competing priorities early. Is accountable for stakeholder relationships, product roadmap and delivery, requirements and KPI definitions, and business acceptance and adoption.

Required Qualifications

• This role requires advanced experience in marketing analytics, business intelligence or a comparable analytical business-partnering role. Knowledge level is comparable to a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college in marketing, business, economics, statistics, information systems or a related field.

• Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of an analytics or reporting product, from requirements through adoption. Working knowledge of Power BI or an equivalent BI tool, sufficient to shape requirements and challenge design without building. Fluent English.

Desired Characteristics

• Strong oral and written communication skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders across regions and time zones. Proven ability to turn ambiguous business questions into structured requirements and defined KPIs.

• Familiarity with the marketing and analytics stack, including Adobe Analytics, Salesforce (SFDC), Marketo, Sprinklr and Meltwater. Understanding of marketing measurement, including campaign performance, funnel metrics, attribution and digital analytics.

• Experience in healthcare, medical technology, life sciences or another regulated industry. Experience bringing social listening, media monitoring and paid media data into unified reporting, and exposure to data governance such as taxonomy, campaign tagging and metric definitions.

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

Video Editor/Animator

About The Role

As a Semi Senior Video Editor, you’ll transform footage into engaging and polished stories that capture attention and move audiences. You’ll play a vital role in a fast-paced creative team with a high end technical focus, working on distinctive brand campaigns and collaborating with visionary producers and creative leaders. Whether fine-tuning short-form social content, dynamic digital ads, or cinematic brand films, you’ll be instrumental in shaping compelling narratives for internationally recognized brands. We are looking for someone who is passionate about seeking new opportunities to create impactful work.

Responsibilities

• Edit and assemble footage into polished final products suitable for customer objectives and platform requirements

• Craft beautiful motion graphics assets for all types of platforms

• Collaborate with producers, designers, and creative teams to understand project vision, narrative structure, and key messaging

• Oversee and mentor junior editors to help them learn and improve their craft

• Enhance videos with graphics, sound, music, and effects in line with brand and campaign guidelines

• Organize and manage media assets, project files, and version control for efficient workflow and collaboration

• Ensure all videos meet technical specifications and quality standards, performing color correction and audio balancing as needed

• Support multiple projects simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines and adapting quickly to shifting priorities

• Incorporate feedback from creative direction and customers, iterating on edits as required

• Stay current on industry trends, editing techniques, and new software/tools to continually elevate the standard of our video output

About You

The essentials:

• 3+ years’ experience in video editing, preferably within a creative agency or production studio

• Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and other industry-standard post production tools like Da Vinci Resolve

• Solid knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator and Figma to be able to extract graphics and import them into your post production softwares.

• Strong storytelling instincts with a keen eye for pacing, continuity, and visual impact

• Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail

• Able to manage multiple projects and thrive in a deadline-driven environment

• Creative problem solving skills and a good tolerance for uncertainty

• Excellent understanding of color grading, audio mixing, and motion graphics fundamentals

• Clear communicator with a collaborative, positive, and customer-centric approach

Not a Must But a Plus

About Monks

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

postings.title: Video Editor
postings.descriptionText:
Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Meet the Team

Secret Media Network is a digital media group focused on recommending perfect plans, discovering great places, sharing things to do and relevant breaking news in different cities around the world. Our family is composed of Secret Chicago, Secret LA, Secret NYC, Secret Miami, Secret Toronto, Secret London, Paris Secret, Madrid Secreto, and more!

The Role

We are looking for a Buenos Aires-based Video Editor to join our team and support content creation across North America, with a particular focus on branded content and event coverage.

Working within a fun, dynamic and fast-growing start-up, this role offers an exciting opportunity to shape how audiences discover and experience cities, brands and experiences through video. As part of the Secret Media team, you’ll turn a constant flow of creative briefs, event footage and existing video assets into distinctive, high-quality, social-first content.

This is a hands-on editing role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can manage a high volume of requests and consistently delivers excellent work at high speed. You’ll work closely with teams across North America, transforming raw footage into engaging videos, particularly Reels and short-form branded content, while ensuring deadlines and quality standards are met.

Beyond editing individual videos, you’ll help build scalable workflows and a library of reusable footage that enables teams across our global network to create content efficiently. You’ll play a key role in establishing editing standards, optimising tools and processes, and ensuring that our video output remains consistent, polished and adaptable across markets.

What You’ll Do

• Edit engaging, social-first videos, particularly Reels and short-form content for branded campaigns, events and social media.

• Manage a high volume of requests, prioritise competing deadlines and deliver high-quality edits at speed.

• Adapt footage into multiple versions, formats and creative approaches to meet different briefs, platforms and audience needs.

• Organise and maintain reusable footage libraries, making assets easy to find, adapt and use by teams worldwide.

• Establish and maintain minimum quality standards across editing, colour, sound, captions, graphics and exports.

• Optimise editing workflows using templates, presets, automation and tools that improve speed, consistency and scalability.

• Collaborate with teams across North America and other markets to understand briefs, manage feedback and deliver content that meets creative and brand requirements.

• Stay up to date with social video trends, editing techniques and tools to continuously improve creative output and efficiency.

Who You Are

We want you to join us if you have:

• 3-5 years of experience.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken, for internal communications. Additional languages are a plus.

• Proven experience in professional video editing, with a strong portfolio of social-first content, Reels and ideally branded videos.

• Excellent storytelling, pacing and visual judgement, with a strong understanding of what makes content engaging on social media.

• The ability to work at high speed, manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines without compromising quality.

• A structured, proactive approach to prioritisation, file management and problem-solving.

• Experience adapting content for different platforms, formats and audiences.

• The ability to collaborate with stakeholders across teams and time zones, particularly North America.

• A continuous-improvement mindset, with an interest in making editing workflows more efficient and scalable.

Experience with branded content, commercial campaigns or event footage is a strong plus. A formal degree is welcome but not essential; your portfolio and practical skills matter most.

Preferred skills:

• Advanced editing: Expert knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and strong command of professional editing workflows. Adobe Media Encoder is essential; Photoshop and After Effects are a plus.

• Social video: Strong understanding of Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, hooks, pacing, captions and platform-specific formats.

• Post-production: Confident with colour correction, sound mixing, basic motion graphics and final quality control.

• Technical knowledge: Understanding of codecs, resolutions, aspect ratios, frame rates, compression and export specifications.

• Asset management: Ability to organise large volumes of footage and maintain reusable, accessible media libraries.

• Workflow optimisation: Experience with templates, presets and efficient project structures to support high-volume, scalable editing.

The ideal candidate is an editor first and foremost: someone who can turn raw footage into polished, compelling videos quickly, maintain consistent quality under pressure and help teams across North America and worldwide create better content at scale.

Why You’ll Love It Here

• Attractive compensation package with room to grow.

• 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.

• 20 days of paid annual leave to support your well-being and personal time outside of work.

• Private health & dental insurance: OSDE 410 plan fully covered by Fever.

• Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Silver plan.

• Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons.

• Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Buenos Aires office location.

• Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

Application Process

For the path forward, here's what to expect:

• A video call interview with our Talent team

• A 60 min psychometric online test

• An interview with our SMN team

• A video editing test to showcase your expertise and knowledge

• A conversation with our management team to explore alignment and potential

Elevate Your Video Production Journey with Us: Apply Now!

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.
