postings.title: Ejecutivo/a de Ventas y Operaciones
postings.descriptionText:
En AMV Travel DMC llevamos más de 20 años creando experiencias de viaje en Argentina y la región . Somos una compañía de turismo receptivo con presencia en Argentina y Perú , en pleno crecimiento y con la pasión por el turismo que nos acompaña desde el inicio.

Hoy buscamos sumar un/a Ejecutivo/a de Ventas y Operaciones para seguir creciendo juntos.
La posición formará parte del área de Ventas y Operaciones y tendrá foco especialmente en los mercados de Estados Unidos y Canadá , trabajando de manera articulada con el área Comercial.

🌎 Objetivo del puesto:
Gestionar de forma integral la venta y operación de reservas FITs y grupos, abarcando desde el diseño y la cotización hasta la confirmación, coordinación y ejecución de los servicios contratados.
La posición será responsable de impulsar ventas rentables, asegurar una operatoria eficiente y garantizar que cada viaje se desarrolle conforme a lo cotizado y a las expectativas del cliente, brindando experiencias de excelencia y contribuyendo al crecimiento sostenido de AMV.

🌎 Principales responsabilidades:

• Diseñar y cotizar itinerarios de FITs y grupos según los requerimientos del cliente.

• Interpretar e indagar sobre necesidades y presupuesto para ofrecer propuestas competitivas.

• Asesorar y acompañar al cliente durante todo el proceso comercial.

• Seleccionar y recomendar hoteles y servicios analizando precio, calidad y relación comercial.

• Maximizar la rentabilidad de cada propuesta.

• Presentar nuevos productos que agreguen valor a la experiencia.

• Realizar seguimiento de cotizaciones para maximizar oportunidades de cierre.

• Operar reservas y asegurar la disponibilidad de los servicios.

• Registrar los servicios confirmados en el sistema interno.

• Coordinar con Administración los cobros y pagos.

• Trabajar junto a Tráfico y Producto para garantizar la correcta ejecución de las reservas.

• Resolver contingencias operativas durante la estadía.

• Mantener contacto permanente con clientes vía mail, teléfono y WhatsApp.

• Mantener actualizado el registro de ventas y seguimiento.

• Cumplir con los objetivos comerciales definidos por la compañía.

🌎 Requisitos:

• Experiencia mínima de 2 años en turismo receptivo (excluyente) .

• Experiencia en cotización y manejo de FITs y grupos (excluyente) .

• Conocimiento de destinos de Argentina (excluyente) y países limítrofes.

• Inglés avanzado oral y escrito (excluyente) .

• Manejo de GDS Amadeus (deseable).

• Fuerte orientación comercial y foco en rentabilidad.

• Capacidad de negociación y análisis.

• Organización, proactividad y orientación a resultados.

• Graduados/as o estudiantes avanzados/as de Turismo o carreras afines.

🌎 ¿Qué ofrecemos?

• Modalidad híbrida: 2 días presenciales por semana en nuestra oficina del Centro de CABA .

• Día de cumpleaños libre. 🎂

• Snacks y frutas a disposición en la oficina.

• Un entorno colaborativo y flexible, con autonomía, responsabilidad y comunicación abierta.

• Espacio para proponer, impulsar ideas y generar mejoras.

• La posibilidad de desarrollarte en una compañía con más de 20 años de trayectoria y en pleno crecimiento regional .

• Un equipo apasionado por el turismo y por crear experiencias que nuestros pasajeros recuerden.

Si te entusiasma ser parte de AMV y sentís que tu experiencia se alinea con este desafío, queremos conocerte. 💜

Buscamos personas con una marcada orientación comercial, excelentes habilidades de
comunicación y vocación de servicio, capaces de acompañar a futuros estudiantes en la elección
de su formación académica y transformar oportunidades de contacto en inscripciones efectivas.
Valoramos especialmente la iniciativa, la escucha activa, la orientación a resultados y la
adaptación a entornos comerciales dinámicos y tecnológicos.

Principales responsabilidades
• Gestionar oportunidades comerciales provenientes de campañas digitales, canales de atención y
otras acciones de captación.
• Desarrollar conversaciones consultivas para identificar necesidades, motivaciones y expectativas
de futuros estudiantes.
• Asesorar sobre oferta académica, modalidades, requisitos de ingreso y alternativas de
inscripción.
• Realizar seguimiento proactivo de oportunidades, gestionar objeciones y facilitar el avance hacia
la inscripción.

comercial.

Requisitos excluyentes
• Experiencia comprobable en ventas consultivas, gestión de oportunidades y cumplimiento de
objetivos.
• Experiencia en atención y seguimiento comercial por canales digitales y telefónicos.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita.
• Manejo de herramientas digitales y sistemas de gestión comercial (CRM).
• Orientación a resultados, autonomía y capacidad de organización.
Se valorará especialmente
• Experiencia comercial en educación, servicios u organizaciones con procesos de venta consultiva.
• Gestión de leads provenientes de campañas digitales y conocimientos de negociación y cierre.
• Familiaridad con automatización e inteligencia artificial.
• Formación terciaria o universitaria, completa o en curso.

postings.title: Ejecutivo Comercial – Soluciones Tecnológicas para Negocios y Retail
postings.descriptionText:
Descripción de la empresa CITS SA es una empresa líder, fundada en 1993, especializada en el asesoramiento, importación y distribución mayorista con valor agregado de soluciones tecnológicas para negocios y retail. Trabajamos con equipamiento para puntos de venta, puntos de cobranza y puntos de servicio, colaborando con marcas de referencia internacional en cajas registradoras, impresoras fiscales, lectores de código de barras, terminales POS y sistemas de pesaje. Nuestra empresa ofrece un servicio de posventa sólido, orientado a garantizar alta confiabilidad operativa a supermercados, gastronomía, shoppings, hotelería, turismo, comercio, finanzas e industrias. Contamos con una amplia red de representantes en todo el territorio nacional para dar soporte inmediato a socios de negocios, distribuidores y usuarios corporativos.
Descripción del puesto Como Ejecutivo/a Comercial – Soluciones Tecnológicas para Negocios y Retail, te encargarás de gestionar y desarrollar la cartera de clientes, identificando oportunidades de negocio y proponiendo soluciones tecnológicas para puntos de venta, cobranza y servicio. En tu día a día, realizarás visitas comerciales presenciales, presentarás productos y servicios, elaborarás propuestas económicas, harás seguimiento de ofertas y coordinarás el cierre de acuerdos comerciales. También colaborarás con el equipo técnico y de posventa para asegurar una experiencia excelente al cliente y mantendrás actualizada la información en los sistemas de gestión comercial. Este es un puesto de jornada completa, se desempeña en modalidad presencial y está ubicado en Greater Buenos Aires.
Requisitos

• Aptitudes comerciales sólidas, experiencia en ventas consultivas y gestión de cuentas en soluciones tecnológicas para negocios y retail.

• Experiencia en gestión comercial y seguimiento (following up) de oportunidades, control de pipeline y cumplimiento de objetivos de ventas.

• Excelentes aptitudes de comunicación, tanto oral como escrita, capacidad para realizar presentaciones y negociar con diferentes tipos clientes.< li>

• Orientación al servicio al cliente, vocación de asistencia posventa y capacidad para construir relaciones de largo plazo con distribuidores y usuarios corporativos.

• Formación en administración, comercialización, marketing, tecnología o áreas afines; manejo de herramientas ofimáticas, CRM y disposición para trabajar de forma presencial en Greater Buenos Aires.

postings.title: Sales Lead CUP
postings.descriptionText:
Regional Sales Lead – Chile, Uruguay & Paraguay

You’ve built experience, now use it where bold ideas meet real impact. At Opella, we’re challenging how self-care works for millions of people and need leaders and experts ready to shape what’s next. As a Regional Sales Lead – Chile, Uruguay & Paraguay, you’ll bring your skill, your curiosity and your drive to make health simpler, smarter and more human.

About the job:

Lead and accelerate commercial performance across Chile, Uruguay and Paraguay, translating regional business priorities into effective country-level sales strategies and execution. Drive sustainable growth, market share expansion and profitability through strong customer partnerships, commercial excellence and disciplined execution, while developing a high-performing and collaborative sales organization across the three markets.

Main responsibilities:

• Define and execute the sales strategy across Chile, Uruguay and Paraguay, aligned with regional priorities, and own delivery of net sales, market share and profitability targets.

• Lead commercial execution across key channels, strengthening strategic customer partnerships, negotiations, joint business plans and commercial agreements.

• Drive revenue growth through pricing execution, customer and channel mix, trade investment effectiveness, distribution, availability and in-store execution.

• Partner with the Country Head and cross-functional teams including Revenue Growth Management, Marketing, Trade Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and People & Culture to shape priorities and maximize performance.

• Establish robust sales forecasting, performance tracking and business review routines, using market insights and commercial analytics to support data-driven decisions.

• Lead, coach and develop sales teams and/or local commercial partners across the three markets, fostering accountability, collaboration and a high-performance culture.

• Ensure disciplined commercial governance, budget management, policy and regulatory compliance, while anticipating commercial risks and defining mitigation actions.

About you:

• Progressive experience in Sales, Key Account Management or Commercial Leadership, with proven responsibility for commercial performance, strategic customers and sales operations.

• Experience in FMCG, Consumer Healthcare, OTC or related consumer-driven industries; exposure to multiple markets, regional operations or distributor-led models is highly desirable.

• Strong commercial and strategic business acumen, with advanced negotiation capabilities, analytical thinking and financial understanding.

• Ability to translate strategy into actionable commercial plans and influence cross-functional stakeholders in complex environments.

• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, ownership and decision-making capabilities; previous people management experience is preferred.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Engineering or a related field; MBA or postgraduate studies in Business Management are a plus.

• Spanish required; advanced English proficiency is desirable.

This is more than the next step in your career, it’s a chance to lead change and help reinvent self-care for the world. If you’re ready to challenge, inspire and deliver impact that matters, we’re ready for you. We are challengers. We are Opella.

Opella values diversity in all its forms and is committed to fostering a workplace where everyone can belong and excel. We welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.

About Us:

Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over The Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.

Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.

At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.

As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.

An experienced prospector who is excited about mentoring a team of newly hired prospecting reps and facilitating achievement of goals. This will be in addition to your own individual target of generating new qualified leads . You will be working closely with the Commercial Development Manager and will be focused on the front-line interactions for Market Intelligence. You will ensure you execute on the broader level strategy by running a team that generate interests in our offerings and ensures a funnel full of qualified leads for sales teams to pick up.

• Grow your knowledge of market activities including competitive products, pricing and policies, new technology, product specifications and new products and communicate findings to your manager

postings.title: Account Manager
postings.descriptionText:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

Job Family Definition:

Manages one or several larger accounts or acts as the account lead for a substantial part of a top account. Understands the customer’s IT and business objectives, priorities, requirements and challenges, and adds value by implementing HPE’s strategy. Drives business performance for all HPE BUs and manages the portfolio mix to optimize profitability of the account. Accountable for pipeline building; accountable for and supportive in deal closing and orchestrating the deal team. Builds and develops relevant customer relationship networks with key influencers and decision makers in IT and business. Develops and engages with the extended partner ecosystem to maximize HPE’s presence in the account. Constantly develops information technology industry knowledge to position HPE’s portfolio in the account. Orchestrates, engages, guides and provides feedback to the extended account team members. Acts as customer’s advocate inside HPE. Plans for accounts to deliver results through the financial year and beyond.

Management Level Definition

Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Frequently contributes to the development of new ideas and methods. Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors. Leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Acts as an expert providing direction and guidance to process improvements and establishing policies. Frequently represents the organization to external customers/clients. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for accomplishing work and achieving objectives. May provide mentoring and guidance to lower level employees.

Responsibilities

• Articulates a two-way connection between the customer's core KPIs, business priorities and initiatives, and the plan to support the customer with IT solutions. Influences the decision-making of customer executives through describing the value of HPE's solutions and their relevance to the customer's priorities. Positions HPE strategy and solutions in such a way that the customer sees that HPE is critically important to their business. When appropriate, understands the innovation agenda and digital journey of the customer, and provides input into them. Builds a business value framework for the customer.

• Builds and executes a plan to drive growth and profitability across HPE's portfolio, in a structured and recurring way. Drives growth in HPE's strategic value portfolio through positioning these solutions with the customer. Formulates and presents technology choices for the customer that will expand HPE's presence and margin in the account. Leverages HPE programs and tools (e.g. Executive Sponsors, BU deal support, and supply chain programs) to improve business performance. Contributes to internal reviews connected to deals and sales planning.

• Engages with the customer to identify opportunities. Translates customers' business challenges and goals into IT opportunities. Ensures a strong and rightsized pipeline funnel from the account team. Leads pipeline building activities for the account, involving account team members as appropriate. Identifies and develops opportunities for short and mid-term success. Proactively leads early engagements. Accountable for deal closure. Ensures ownership throughout the team for the deals in the pipeline. Drives deals to closure through a multi-disciplinary team, including partners.

• Develops and maintains a professional relationship network within the customer to maximize efficiency and effectiveness for HPE. Understands and leverages the underlying principles for the customer organization's functioning. Builds influential relationships with executives. Defines an effective engagement model with the customer's key influencers and decision makers.

• Develops and maintains a view of the partner landscape in the account. Develops partner relationships. Runs an active governance process for the partner network for the account. Works with the Partner Business Manager to assess and update the partner strategy for the account.

• Develops and updates expertise in IT technology. Engages as appropriate with the customer's CTO/CIO. Articulates relevant modern trends in IT and presents them to executives within the customer when appropriate. Describes HPE's portfolio and references its use in other customers.

• Builds, develops and leads the extended account team. Runs a governance with the extended team and empowers account team to engage on different levels within the account. Establishes a recurring process to provide feedback to the account team members and the relevant managers.

• Provides feedback into other HPE organizations and coordinates with other customer facing HPE organizations to improve the customer experience. Utilizes HPE tools and processes for customer advocacy. Leverages the existing tools, processes and resources to assure customer satisfaction and loyalty.

• Develops and executes a comprehensive account business plan for defined accounts. Manages the collective effort to build and maintain both strategic and tactical elements of the plan. Shares and aligns the plan with relevant stakeholders of the account.

Education And Experience

• University or Bachelor’s Degree preferred, or equivalent experience. Engineering or technology education, advanced degree or MBA desired.

• Typically 6-10+ years account management experience.

• Experience in IT industry preferred. Experience working within an IT department and/or working within customers is a plus.

• Experience in vertical industry preferred.

• Experience in different sales roles is a plus.

Knowledge And Skills

• Drives Results: Shows strong will to win, is persistent in face of obstacles and has a clear results orientation.

• Strategic Planning: Able to skillfully articulate a vision for the future and a path to achieve it in an account business plan, aligned with the HPE strategy, direct leadership, and the HPE business units.

• Sales Execution: Able to efficiently deliver on short term sales engagements and objectives.

• Continuous Learning: Continuously and actively pursues own learning.

• IT Industry Acumen: Builds and maintains thorough knowledge of cutting edge IT industry developments and technology trends with potential impacts to our customers.

• HPE Portfolio Knowledge: Builds and continually updates a thorough understanding of HPE products, solutions, and service offerings - their value propositions, competitive differentiators, and benefits to our customers and our customers' customers.

• Team Leadership: Skilled at leading teams (including dispersed and indirect team members) successfully through sales engagements in a complex matrix organization.

• Network/Relationship Building: Skilled at creating strong professional relationships; understands and leverages the value of networks and collaboration.

• Two-way communication: Able to listen actively to understand the perspectives of others, and to articulate value propositions, plans, and proposals in language relevant to the customer, partner or internal stakeholder.

• Influencing and Negotiating: Understands and proficiently leverages influencing and negotiation techniques.

• Business Acumen: Understands how different parts of a business interoperate to produce business outcomes and how actions impact company results. Has a thorough understanding of general business concepts and the economy. Able to understand financial reports and make relevant conclusions for planning. Similar principles apply to public sector organizations.

• Operational Excellence: Able to show predictability and operational excellence both internally and externally.

• Integrity: Acts with integrity throughout complex situations even if under pressure.

• Vertical/Industry Knowledge Preferred: Understands the customer's industry landscape, enterprise architecture, and partner and influencer ecosystem, and is able to use this knowledge to build and advise the customer on its digital journey plan.

• Consulting: Can synthesize a number of skills and relevant knowledge to guide the customer through a process of achieving business outcomes leveraging HPE's portfolio.

Impact/Scope

• Typically manages 1 to many accounts representing moderate revenue for HPE. One or more accounts may be a large multi-national or global account. May manage a portion of a large Top Account, usually within an assigned geography.

• Typically qualifies and closes large deals of moderate to high complexity and cross-BU scope.

• Works with all levels of decision-makers in the customer organization.

• Orchestrates regional pursuit resources for the account.

• Participates in account investment decisions about pricing and resources.

Complexity

• Leads complex sales engagements, project management and coordination to meet deadlines.

• Typically oversees engagements with cross-BU portfolio solutions.

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

What We Can Offer You

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Let's Stay Connected

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

postings.title: Senior Auditor/Vice-President - Internal Audit Latin America Team
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

You are a Senior Auditor (Vice President) within the Internal Audit Latin America team, based in Buenos Aires and reporting to the Argentina Audit Director. You will execute high-profile audit engagements and risk assessments across LATAM, the Americas, and globally, partnering closely with global audit teams and senior stakeholders across the business. You will gain exposure across markets and trading, finance, payments, and related areas while helping strengthen risk management, governance, and the control environment.

Job Responsibilities

• You will plan, manage, and execute complex local, regional, and global audit engagements and risk assessments.

• You will partner with global audit colleagues and business stakeholders to assess key risks, processes, and controls efficiently and effectively.

• You will evaluate internal controls, determine control adequacy for identified risks, and identify issues in a timely manner.

• You will document audit work comprehensively and concisely, including workpapers, results, and supporting evidence.

• You will draft audit reports, risk assessments, and risk event summaries with clear, actionable articulation of observations.

• You will communicate clearly with stakeholders, building trust and credibility while influencing improvements to the control environment.

• You will drive continuous improvement in audit execution, including the use of bots and/or data analytics where applicable.

• You will manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment, adjusting plans as needed to meet deadlines and audit objectives.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

• 7 + years Experience in internal or external auditing of financial institution, or relevant business experience with transferable skills

• Solid understanding of internal control concepts and ability to evaluate control adequacy against a defined set of risks related to financial institution.

• Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills to engage effectively with colleagues and stakeholders.

• Ability to influence business actions to improve the control environment.

• Proven ability to multi-task and prioritize effectively in a dynamic environment.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills.

• Professional certifications such as CPA, CA, CIA, or equivalent.

• Bachelor's degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Experience in data analytics and tools such as Alteryx or Excel VBA.

• Willingness to travel when required.

About Us

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

The Audit department provides independent assessments to evaluate, test and report on the adequacy and effectiveness of our governance, risk management and internal controls. The team's priorities are focused on strong governance, transparency, strategic engagement, and fostering a diverse and inclusive culture that develops our talent.

postings.title: Product Analyst – Payments
postings.descriptionText:
Las tarjetas corporativas son el núcleo de la propuesta de Mendel, y este rol existe para definir cómo se usan, se controlan y se procesan en México, Argentina y Chile. Vas a trabajar en la intersección entre producto, tecnología, operaciones y finanzas, con foco en la evolución del producto de tarjetas y la relación con los procesadores.
Como Product Analyst de Payments , vas a tener un rol central en cómo evoluciona uno de los productos más críticos de la compañía.
Producto de tarjetas

• Definir y evolucionar funcionalidades del producto de tarjetas físicas y virtuales: emisión, ciclo de vida, límites, bloqueos y alcance de uso.

• Diseñar y mantener las reglas de tarjetas (restricciones por MCC, comercio, monto, frecuencia, horario) y su relación con las políticas de gasto de cada empresa cliente.

• Trabajar sobre presupuestos: modelos de asignación, reparto entre integrantes, acumulación y su vínculo con las tarjetas.

• Escribir PRDs, historias de usuario y criterios de aceptación, y acompañar al equipo de desarrollo durante la implementación y el lanzamiento.

Procesadores y migraciones

• Gestionar la relación funcional con distintos procesadores: entender sus capacidades, limitaciones y diferencias entre mercados.

• Participar en migraciones de procesador: relevamiento de funcionalidades, mapeo de reglas y configuraciones, plan de migración de tarjetas y clientes, pruebas y seguimiento post go-live.

• Analizar flujos de autorización, liquidación, contracargos, devoluciones y ajustes, e identificar oportunidades de mejora o riesgos.

Operaciones y finanzas

• Trabajar en estrecha relación con Operaciones para entender incidentes, reclamos y procesos manuales, y convertirlos en mejoras de producto.

• Colaborar con Finanzas en conciliación, cierres, facturación, comisiones y líneas de crédito, asegurando que el producto refleje correctamente los flujos de dinero.

• Ser el punto de conexión entre estas áreas y el equipo técnico.

Análisis y métricas

• Definir y seguir métricas de uso, adopción, tasas de aprobación y rechazo, y performance de procesadores.

• Usar datos para priorizar, validar hipótesis y medir el impacto de cada lanzamiento.

Buscamos a alguien semi senior o senior , con criterio para moverse entre negocio, producto, tecnología y finanzas, cómodo trabajando con reglas, procesos y detalles técnicos de pagos.

postings.descriptionText:
Spanish (Spain) Audio Transcript Editor (AI Training)

About The Role

What if your sharp ear and deep knowledge of Castilian Spanish could directly influence how AI understands spoken language? We're looking for meticulous transcript editors in Buenos Aires — especially those with strong familiarity with Spain's Spanish dialect — to review, correct, and refine audio transcripts that will train next-generation AI speech systems.

This is focused, precision-driven work for people who genuinely care about linguistic accuracy. If you can hear the difference between a voiced and unvoiced consonant, notice a misplaced accent, or catch a timestamp that's off by a beat, you'll thrive in this role.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. No prior AI experience needed — just native or near-native command of Castilian Spanish, strong listening skills, and a commitment to doing the work right.

• Organization: Alignerr

• Type: Hourly Contract

• Location: Remote

• Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

• Listen to Castilian Spanish audio recordings and compare them against existing transcripts, correcting errors at the word level

• Fix misheard words, misspellings, punctuation errors, and formatting inconsistencies

• Verify and adjust word-level timestamps to ensure precise synchronisation with the audio

• Apply detailed style and formatting guidelines consistently across all tasks

• Flag unclear audio, overlapping speech, or segments that require additional review

• Maintain high accuracy and quality standards across large volumes of transcript data

• Work independently and asynchronously — fully on your own schedule

Who You Are

• Native or near-native Castilian Spanish speaker — deep familiarity with Spain's pronunciation, vocabulary, and linguistic nuances is essential

• Excellent listening skills with the ability to accurately distinguish words in varied audio conditions

• Highly detail-oriented with a methodical, patient approach to repetitive precision work

• Comfortable working with exact timing and word-level accuracy

• Able to follow and consistently apply detailed style guides and formatting rules

• Strong written communication skills in Spanish

• Self-motivated and reliable when working independently

• No prior AI or tech experience required

Nice to Have

• Experience as a transcriptionist, court reporter, or stenographer

• Background in subtitling, closed-captioning, or subtitle editing

• Linguistics training or academic background in Spanish — particularly Iberian Spanish phonology or grammar

• Prior work with annotation platforms, data labeling tools, or transcript editing software

• Familiarity with phonetics, speech processing, or audio analysis

• Experience following detailed editorial or formatting style guides

Why Join Us

• Work on cutting-edge AI speech and language projects alongside leading research labs

• Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you

• Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, task-based work

• Contribute directly to improving how AI understands and processes spoken Spanish

• Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

• Join a global community of language specialists doing work that matters

postings.title: Contracts Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Sobre Meitner Energy
La misión de Meitner Energy es transformar el panorama energético global mediante soluciones nucleares limpias, sostenibles y escalables. Estamos comprometidos con redefinir cómo el mundo alimenta a la industria y al comercio para liderar la transición hacia un futuro más limpio.
En el centro de nuestro trabajo está el ACR300: un reactor modular pequeño (SMR) Gen III+ de 300 MWe diseñado para tener impacto a escala de red desde el primer día. Construido sobre tecnología probada de agua liviana con innovación dirigida y orientada a la ejecución, el ACR300 ofrece desempeño de carga base de alta utilización, independiente de las condiciones climáticas o las limitaciones de almacenamiento. Es el único SMR diseñado para ser a la vez escalable y rentable, con la menor carga de construcción física por megavatio entre los SMR de escala de red.
Nuestro equipo de clase mundial está basado en Argentina, los Estados Unidos y el Reino Unido, trabajando juntos hacia una sola meta: electrificación a escala, comenzando en 2030.

La Oportunidad
Como Contracts Specialist, vas a gestionar integralmente la contratación de servicios y obras del proyecto ACR300, incluyendo estudios especiales, ingeniería, preparación de sitio y construcción, articulando con proveedores nacionales e internacionales. Vas a estructurar y administrar contratos bajo distintas modalidades comerciales (lump-sum, unit rates, reembolsables e incentivos), asegurando el cumplimiento de los requisitos técnicos, legales, comerciales y regulatorios aplicables, optimizando costos, plazos y la mitigación de riesgos contractuales.
Este rol es clave para Meitner en este momento porque la calidad de la estructura contractual define la previsibilidad de costos, plazos y riesgos del proyecto. Tu trabajo hoy determina cómo se contrata, cómo se ejecuta y cómo se cierran los compromisos con proveedores nacionales e internacionales.
Este rol es ideal para alguien que:

• Cree que la energía nuclear es esencial para un futuro energético limpio y se toma la rigurosidad contractual como parte central del trabajo.

• Disfruta de la negociación, de estructurar acuerdos complejos y de coordinar con áreas técnicas, legales y financieras.

• Tiene autonomía, orientación a resultados y capacidad de sostener múltiples prioridades bajo plazos exigentes.

• Quiere crecer en una empresa donde las decisiones contractuales que toma definen la ejecución real del proyecto.

Lo que harás
Ciclo de Contratación y Modalidades Comerciales

• Gestionar el ciclo completo de contratación de servicios y obras: definición del alcance, elaboración de pliegos, proceso licitatorio, evaluación de ofertas, adjudicación y administración contractual.

• Estructurar contrataciones bajo distintas modalidades comerciales — lump-sum (precio global fijo), unit rates (precios unitarios), reembolsables (cost-plus) y esquemas con incentivos — seleccionando la más adecuada según el tipo de servicio u obra y el perfil de riesgo.

Coordinación con Áreas Técnicas y Calidad

• Gestionar contrataciones de estudios especiales, ingeniería, preparación de sitio y empresas constructoras, coordinando con las áreas técnicas y de Calidad (QA/QC nuclear) la definición de requisitos, entregables y requisitos de aseguramiento de calidad aplicables a proveedores nuclear-grade.

Negociación y Administración Contractual Internacional

• Negociar y administrar contratos de ingeniería y suministro con empresas del exterior, gestionando términos comerciales, condiciones de pago, garantías e implicancias aduaneras y de comercio exterior.

• Negociar condiciones contractuales clave (alcance, precio, plazos, propiedad intelectual, límites de responsabilidad, garantías y moneda), en coordinación con las áreas Legales y Finanzas.

• Administrar los contratos durante su ejecución: control de cumplimiento, gestión de cambios (change orders), certificaciones, reclamos (claims) y cierre contractual.

Cumplimiento Regulatorio y Gestión de Riesgos

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de los marcos regulatorios y normativos aplicables (ARN, ASME III, normativa de calidad nuclear, legislación laboral y aduanera argentina, restricciones OFAC y acuerdos bilaterales).

• Identificar, evaluar y mitigar riesgos contractuales, y mantener la documentación y trazabilidad del proceso conforme a los procedimientos internos del área de Compras y Contrataciones.

Lo que buscamos
Aspectos innegociables
Negociación y Criterio Contractual

• Capacidad de negociación con proveedores nacionales e internacionales y criterio para seleccionar modalidades contractuales acordes al riesgo.

Comunicación Interdisciplinaria y Trabajo en Equipo

postings.descriptionText:
Job Description Summary

The LATAM Customs Compliance Leader is responsible for driving customs governance, compliance, and risk management across the Latin America region. This role ensures compliance with applicable customs regulations, GE HealthCare policies, and trade requirements through robust monitoring, auditing, broker management, and stakeholder engagement.

The role serves as a trusted advisor to business and operations teams, leading customs compliance programs, identifying risks, implementing corrective actions, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen regional customs processes and controls.

Job Description

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator with over 100 years of healthcare industry experience and around 50,000 employees globally.

We enable clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics, applications, and services, supported by our Edison intelligence platform. We operate at the center of an ecosystem working toward precision health -digitizing healthcare, helping drive productivity and improving outcomes for patients, providers, health systems and researchers around the world.

Roles And Responsibilities

• Lead Customs Compliance governance activities across LATAM, ensuring adherence to applicable customs regulations and GE HealthCare policies.

• Plan, execute, and coordinate internal audits, external regulatory audits, and regional customs monitoring reviews.

• Assess customs-related processes and controls, identifying risks and driving corrective and preventive actions.

• Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, and business stakeholders to ensure compliant import and export activities across the region.

• Lead Customs Broker Management processes, including performance oversight, compliance reviews, and governance initiatives.

• Manage third-party Due Diligence and approval processes in accordance with company compliance requirements.

• Serve as the regional customs compliance advisor, providing guidance on regulatory requirements, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement opportunities.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in International Trade, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics, Law, Finance, or a related field.

• Significant experience in Customs Compliance, Global Trade, Import/Export Operations, Trade Compliance, or Customs Governance.

• Experience managing or participating in customs audits, regulatory reviews, and compliance assessments.

• Knowledge of customs regulations and trade compliance requirements across LATAM countries.

• Experience working with customs brokers and third-party service providers.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess risk and develop corrective actions.

• Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and work across multiple countries and business functions.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and Spanish.

Desired Characteristics

• Experience working in multinational companies with regional customs compliance responsibilities.

• Knowledge of FTAs, tariff classifications, valuation, origin determination, and customs programs.

• Experience supporting healthcare, medical device, manufacturing, or highly regulated industries.

• Familiarity with internal control frameworks, compliance monitoring programs, and risk management methodologies.

• Portuguese language skills are highly desirable.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a regional environment.

• Continuous improvement mindset.

GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

At GE HealthCare, requesting medical certificates of non-pregnancy or Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) status as a requirement for employment, continued employment, or promotion is strictly prohibited.

postings.title: GNOC Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

We are seeking a GNOC Engineer to join our growing global operations team. This role is responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining a geographically distributed communications network infrastructure to ensure high availability and service reliability. In addition to network operations responsibilities, the GNOC Engineer will support spare parts inventory management, warehouse operations, and travel to remote sites for equipment maintenance, replacement, and troubleshooting activities.

Key Responsibilities

• Monitor connectivity, performance, and operational status of distributed communications and network infrastructure.

• Investigate network, RF, and system anomalies; perform troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and escalation management as required.

• Maintain accurate incident records, trouble tickets, maintenance logs, and operational reports.

• Provide service assurance through proactive monitoring and timely incident response.

• Deliver first-line technical support to customers and internal stakeholders via phone, email, and other communication channels.

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on communications, network, and related infrastructure systems.

• Collaborate with engineering, operations, and support teams on escalations, upgrades, and service-impacting changes.

• Utilize monitoring and fault management platforms to track system health, performance, and availability.

• Manage spare parts inventory, including receiving, storage, stock tracking, audits, and inventory documentation.

• Coordinate logistics and shipment of replacement equipment to support maintenance and repair activities.

• Travel to operational sites throughout North America to perform equipment replacement, troubleshooting, testing, and maintenance activities.

• Participate in a 24x7 operational support environment, including shift work, weekends, and on-call support as required.

Qualifications:

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.

• Relevant industry certifications are a plus (e.g., CompTIA Network+, CCNA, Satellite Communications, RF, or equivalent).

Experience

• A minimum of 3 years of experience supporting satellite, wireless, telecommunications, network operations, or related communications infrastructure environments.

• Experience troubleshooting complex technical systems in a mission-critical or operational support setting.

• Hands-on experience working with RF, networking, and communications equipment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting Network Operations Centers (NOC), Global Network Operations Centers (GNOC), or telecommunications operations environments.

• Knowledge of satellite communications infrastructure and ground-based communications systems.

• Experience with inventory management, warehouse operations, or spare parts logistics.

• Familiarity with fiber optic infrastructure and broadband networking technologies.

• Experience performing field maintenance and supporting remote operational sites.

• Understanding of preventative maintenance programs and operational readiness processes.

• Experience working in a shift-based, 24x7 operational environment.

Soft Skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to remain composed and effective during high-priority incidents.

• Strong organizational and documentation skills.

• Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy.

• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

• Adaptable and flexible in a fast-paced operational environment.

Technology Stack

• Network monitoring and fault management platforms

• Ticketing and incident management systems

• Remote access and remote desktop tools

• IP networking technologies (TCP/IP, routing, switching)

• Fiber optic communications systems

• RF communications systems and related infrastructure

• Modems, multiplexers, and broadband communications equipment

• Microsoft Office Suite

• Reporting and operational dashboard tools

• Inventory and asset management systems

Physical Requirements

• Ability to work in a standard office environment and use a computer for extended periods.

• Ability to work rotating shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.

• Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

• Ability to operate a motor vehicle and maintain a valid driver's license.

• Ability to lift and move equipment and spare parts weighing up to 50 pounds.

• Ability to work in equipment rooms, communications facilities, and remote operational sites.

• Ability to stand, walk, bend, and climb ladders occasionally while performing field maintenance activities.

• Ability to travel on short notice in support of business-critical operational needs.

This job description may not be inclusive to the duties and responsibilities listed. Additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time or the scope of the job may change as needed by business demands .

AST SpaceMobile is an Equal Opportunity, at will Employer; employment is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
Support and Services Organization - Motorola Solutions Argentina S.A

Job Description

As members of the post-sales team in the Services organization, Field Engineers focus on the operation and maintenance of communications and video surveillance systems. Utilizing Motorola's broad portfolio, the team works within established SLAs to ensure consistent service for our clientele.

Key responsibilities include the upkeep of a comprehensive video surveillance network, which encompasses fixed cameras, support infrastructure, transport networks, and virtual machines. This position necessitates proficiency in video storage solutions and a thorough understanding of standard industry protocols.

Furthermore, the role involves managing a voice communications network, requiring technical expertise in RF. The engineer must be capable of diagnosing power stage defects, addressing RF interference, and calibrating passive components like cavity combiners or filters.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide local support to the customer (in some cases 24/7 on call Service support)

• Escalate and follow up on factory incidents

• HF component fault detection

• Participate in a call-out rotation

• Perform preventative and corrective maintenance routines to ensure proper system operation with focus on trend analysis and documentation of results.

• Perform site inspections and functional checks

• Operate and troubleshoot remote sites infrastructure

• Capacity upgrades/downgrades systems assets

• Coordinate with subcontractors for supplemental support

• Maintain the installation of the system in compliance with Motorola R56 Standard and Guideline

• Provides technical support and consultations for / with the System Integration Centers and clarification of technical issues with the Customer, third parties and within Motorola Solutions.

Basic Requirements

• Onsite / Buenos Aires, Argentina.

• Engineering Degree (Telecommunications, Electrical, or Electronics).

• 4-5+ years of experience in telecommunications, IT, or fixed video systems

• English Level: B1 or above

• Basic OS administration (Windows/Linux)

• Knowledge on Server Management (ESXi, Vsphere)

• Knowledge on Networking

• Familiarity with fixed video platforms and VMS (RSTP, RTMP, SRT)

• Technical knowledge of RF, HF, LMR (P25/TETRA/DMR), microwave systems, or AC/DC power.

• Autonomy and Empowerment to take increasing responsibilities.

Travel Requirements: Over 50%

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.
